declarations.name: CasselsFibre.conic_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem conic_parameter {R : Type} [CommRing R] (β a c s w : R) :
    let X := s^2+3*β*w^2
    let Y := β*a*(s^2-3*β*w^2)-6*β*c*s*w
    let Z := c*(s^2-3*β*w^2)+2*β*a*s*w
    Y^2+3*β*Z^2 = ((β*a)^2+3*β*c^2)*X^2 := by

declarations.name: CasselsFibre.split_quartic
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_quartic {R : Type} [CommRing R] (β a c s w : R) :
    let X := s^2+3*β*w^2
    let Y := β*a*(s^2-3*β*w^2)-6*β*c*s*w
    (2*β*a*X)^2-Y^2 = 3*β^2*(a*s^2+6*c*s*w+9*β*a*w^2)*(a*s^2-2*c*s*w+β*a*w^2) := by

    (b^2+3*β*a^2)*(d^2+3*β*c^2)=(b*d+3*β*a*c)^2+3*β*(c*b-a*d)^2 := by

declarations.name: CasselsFibre.sign_reversal
declarations.snippet:
theorem sign_reversal {R : Type} [CommRing R] (β μ a b : R) :
    let u := β*μ*a-b
    let v := β*a-β*μ*b
    let h := β*(β*μ^2-1)
    v^2-β*u^2=h*(b^2-β*a^2) ∧
    β*μ*u-v=h*a ∧ β*u-β*μ*v=h*b := by

theorem doubled_lift_cocycle {G A} [Mul G] [IntModule A] (torsion : TwoPrimaryExponentTwo A)
    {act : PointAction G A} {m : Nat} {P : A} {V : G → A}
    (hV : ExtraBitLift act m P V) (g h : G) :
    (2 : Nat) • V (g*h) = (2 : Nat) • V g + (act.map g).apply ((2 : Nat) • V h) := by

declarations.name: CentralSpecialization.doubled_lift_additive
declarations.snippet:

    {act : PointAction G A} {m : Nat} {P Q : A} {V W Z : G → A}
    (hV : ExtraBitLift act m P V) (hW : ExtraBitLift act m Q W)
    (hZ : ExtraBitLift act m (P+Q) Z) (g : G) :
    (2 : Nat) • Z g = (2 : Nat) • V g + (2 : Nat) • W g := by

declarations.name: CentralSpecialization.doubled_lift_natural
declarations.snippet:

    (torsion : TwoPrimaryExponentTwo B) (f : AddMap A B)
    {actA : PointAction G A} {actB : PointAction G B}
    (equiv : ∀ g x, f.apply ((actA.map g).apply x) = (actB.map g).apply (f.apply x))
    {m : Nat} {P : A} {V : G → A} {W : G → B}
    (hV : ExtraBitLift actA m P V) (hW : ExtraBitLift actB m (f.apply P) W) (g : G) :
    f.apply ((2 : Nat) • V g) = (2 : Nat) • W g := by

    {act : PointAction G A} {m : Nat} {P : A} {V W : G → A}
    (low : ExtraBitLift act m P V) (high : ExtraBitLift act (m+1) P W) (g : G) :
    (2 : Nat) • V g = (2 : Nat) • ((2 : Nat) • W g) := by

declarations.name: CentralSpecialization.corrected_kummer_cocycle
declarations.snippet:
theorem corrected_kummer_cocycle {G A} [Mul G] [IntModule A] (act : PointAction G A)
    (m : Nat) (P R : A) (W : G → A)
    (hR : (2^m : Nat) • R = P)
    (multiple : ∀ g, (2^m : Nat) • W g = (act.map g).apply P - P)
    (cocycle : ∀ g h, W (g*h) = W g + (act.map g).apply (W h)) :
    let b := fun g => ((act.map g).apply R - R) - W g
    (∀ g h, b (g*h) = b g + (act.map g).apply (b h)) ∧
    (∀ g, (2^m : Nat) • b g = 0) := by

declarations.name: CentralSpecialization.mixed_pair_cancellation

theorem mixed_pair_cancellation {K R S D T Z : Type}
    (i : K → R) (s : S → D) (q : D → T) (jInv : T → S)
    (pairR : R → S → Z) (pairK : K → D → Z)
    (adjoint : ∀ x y, pairR (i x) y = pairK x (s y))
    (injective : ∀ a b, q a = q b → a = b)
    (rightInverse : ∀ y, q (s (jInv y)) = y) (x : K) (P : D) :
    pairR (i x) (jInv (q P)) = pairK x P := by

theorem sharp_progression (q a : Int) (hq : (q-97)%192=0)
    (h : (q+1-a)%32=0) : (a-2)%32=0 ∧ ((a-2)%64=0 ∨ (q+1-a)%64=0) := by omega

declarations.name: EulerCorrection.chart_denominator
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_denominator {K : Type} [CommRing K] (c x D f : K) (h : x*f=1) :
    (c*x+D)^2*f = c^2*x+2*c*D+D^2*f := by grobner

declarations.name: EulerCorrection.chart_abscissa
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_abscissa {K : Type} [Field K] (d v N F f : K)
    (hd : d ≠ 0) (hv : d*v=N) : F*f=v^2 ↔ F*(d^2*f)=N^2 := by

declarations.name: EulerCorrection.chart_logarithm
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_logarithm {K : Type} [Field K] (u t a B N A L V : K)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : u*t= -a*B) (hN : u*N=A) :
    t*L+a*N*V=0 ↔ B*L=A*V := by

declarations.name: HeckeShell.shell
declarations.snippet:
def shell (p a k : Int) : Nat → Int
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => a - k
  | s + 2 => a * shell p a k (s + 1) - p * shell p a k s

declarations.name: HeckeShell.difference_mod_four
declarations.snippet:
theorem difference_mod_four (p h k : Int) (s : Nat) :
    4 ∣ shell p (p+1+4*h) k (s+1) - shell p (p+1+4*h) k s - p^s*(p-k) := by

declarations.name: HeckeShell.odd_power
declarations.snippet: private theorem odd_power (t : Int) (s : Nat) : ∃ w : Int, (2*t+1)^s=2*w+1 := by

declarations.name: HeckeShell.divided_shell
declarations.snippet:
theorem divided_shell (t h z : Int) (s : Nat) :
    let p := 2*t+1
    let a := p+1+4*h
    let k := 2*z+1
    let d := shell p a k (s+1)-shell p a k s
    2 ∣ d ∧ d/2 % 2 = (a-k-1)/2 % 2 := by

declarations.name: HeckeShell.shared_prime
declarations.snippet:
theorem shared_prime (t h : Int) (s : Nat) :
    let p := 2*t+1
    let a := p+1+4*h
    shell p a 0 s % 2 = 1 - (s : Int) % 2 := by

declarations.name: HeckeShell.dilatedProduct
declarations.snippet:
def dilatedProduct (a : Nat) (f g : Nat → Int) (k : Nat) : Int :=
  ((List.range (k/a+1)).map (fun i => f i * g (k-a*i))).sum

declarations.name: HeckeShell.ordinary_U
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_U (a : Nat) (ha : 0 < a) (f g : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) :
    dilatedProduct a f g (a*n) =
      dilatedProduct 1 f (fun k => g (a*k)) n := by

declarations.name: HeightPoints.gaussian_difference
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussian_difference {A : Type} [CommRing A] (x y g r s : A) :
    (x+g*r)^2+(y+g*s)^2-(x^2+y^2) =
      2*g*(r*x+s*y)+g^2*(r^2+s^2) := by grobner

declarations.name: HeightPoints.parameter_factorization
declarations.snippet:
theorem parameter_factorization {A : Type} [CommRing A] (b k : A) :
    (1-3*b*k^2)^2-b*(2*k)^2 = (1-b*k^2)*(1-9*b*k^2) ∧
    (1+3*b*k^2)^2-(1-3*b*k^2)^2 = 3*b*(2*k)^2 := by

declarations.name: HeightPoints.second_twist
declarations.snippet:
theorem second_twist {A : Type} [CommRing A] (b u w d v : A)
    (hw : w^2=1+3*b*u^2) (hd : d*v^2=1-b*u^2) :
    b*w^2-b*d*v^2=(2*b*u)^2 ∧ b*w^2+3*b*d*v^2=4*b ∧
    (4*b^2*u*w)^2=(b*w^2)*(b*w^2-b*d*v^2)*(b*w^2+3*b*d*v^2) := by

declarations.name: HeightPoints.pole_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_factors {A : Type} [CommRing A] (B U w : A)
    (h : B*w^2 = B+3*U^2) :
    (B*w)^2-B*(B-U^2)=4*B*U^2 ∧
    (B*w)^2+3*B*(B-U^2)=4*B^2 := by

declarations.name: InteriorFibre.symmetric_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem symmetric_factors {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b x y : R) :
    let A := 1-9*b*x^2-9*b*y^2+9*b^2*x^2*y^2
    (3*b*(x+y))^2-b*(1-3*b*x*y)^2 = -b*(A-24*b*x*y) ∧
    (3*b*(x-y))^2-b*(1+3*b*x*y)^2 = -b*(A+24*b*x*y) := by

declarations.name: InteriorFibre.norm_parametrization
declarations.snippet:
theorem norm_parametrization {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b e f s w : R) :
    let y := f*(s^2+b*w^2)+2*e*s*w
    let z := e*(s^2+b*w^2)+2*b*f*s*w
    z^2-b*y^2=(e^2-b*f^2)*(s^2-b*w^2)^2 := by dsimp; grobner

declarations.name: InteriorFibre.small_conic
declarations.snippet:
theorem small_conic {R : Type} [CommRing R] (s w : R) :
    let u := 149*(s^2+5*w^2)+452*s*w
    let v := 113*(s^2+5*w^2)+745*s*w
    5*u^2-4*v^2=59929*(s^2-5*w^2)^2 := by dsimp; grobner

declarations.name: PartnerQuartic.mobius_difference
declarations.snippet:
theorem mobius_difference {R : Type} [CommRing R] (a b c d u v s t : R) :
    (a*u+b*v)*(c*s+d*t) - (a*s+b*t)*(c*u+d*v) =
    (a*d-b*c)*(u*t-s*v) := by grobner

declarations.name: PartnerQuartic.quotient_product
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: PartnerQuartic.base_section
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_section {R : Type} [CommRing R] (β a c : R) :
    let L := c^2-β*a^2
    let H := c^2+3*β*a^2
    let m := β*L*H
    let x := β*H^2
    let y := 4*β^2*a*c*H^2
    x-m = 4*β^2*a^2*H ∧ x+3*m = 4*β*c^2*H ∧ y^2 = x*(x-m)*(x+3*m) := by

declarations.name: PartnerQuartic.canonical_section
PartnerQuartic.canonical_inverse
declarations.snippet:
theorem canonical_inverse {K : Type} [Field K] (β u v w m r : K) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : β*u^2-m=w^2) (h₂ : β*v^2=β*u^2+3*m) (hr : r*w=2*u+v) :
    w^2*((β*r^2-1)*(β*r^2-9)) = 16*β*r^2*m := by

declarations.name: PoleCharts.unordered_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem unordered_factors {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b a c e f : R) :
    let A:=a*e
    let J:=a*f+c*e
    let C:=c*f
    (c^2-b*a^2)*(f^2-b*e^2)=(C+b*A)^2-b*J^2 ∧
    (c^2+3*b*a^2)*(f^2+3*b*e^2)=(C-3*b*A)^2+3*b*J^2 ∧
    J^2-4*A*C=(a*f-c*e)^2 := by dsimp; constructor; grobner; constructor <;> grobner

declarations.name: PoleCharts.splitting_discriminant
declarations.snippet:
theorem splitting_discriminant {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b u v t : R) :
    b*((u*t+v*t)^2-4*t^2*(u^2-b)) =
    b*t^2*(4*b-(u-v)*(3*u+v)) := by grobner

declarations.name: PoleCharts.raw_point
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: PoleCharts.secant
declarations.snippet:
theorem secant {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b θ r s i j : R)
    (h : r^2-θ*s^2=b) :
    let M:=i^2-θ*j^2-3*b*θ
    let N:=2*(θ*s*j-r*i)
    (r*M+i*N)^2-θ*(s*M+j*N)^2=b*(M^2+3*θ*N^2) := by dsimp; grobner

    -12*cubic z-(z^2+3)^2=-(z^2+6*z-3)^2 ∧
    -12*cubic z+3*(z^2+3)^2=3*(z^2-2*z-3)^2 := by

declarations.name: PrescribedFibres.norm_triple
declarations.snippet:
theorem norm_triple {R : Type} [CommRing R] (u v s t X Y E G norm : R)
    (he : E=u*s+2*v*t+X) (hg : G=u*t+v*s+Y) (hn : norm=u^2-2*v^2) :
    u*E-2*v*G-norm*s+4*v*Y=u*X+2*v*Y ∧
    v*E-u*G+norm*t+2*u*Y=v*X+u*Y ∧ E-u*s-2*v*t=X := by

    (hv : 1-β*u^2=θ*v^2) (hk : 1+3*β*u^2=d*k^2) :
    θ*((s^2-β)*(s^2+3*β))*((1-β*u^2)*(1+3*β*u^2)) =
    (θ*h*d*r*k*v)^2 := by

def affinePoint (f : K[X]) (x y : B) (h : y^2 = aeval x f) : Cover f →ₐ[K] B where
  toFun z := aeval x z.re + aeval x z.im * y
  map_one' := by change aeval x 1 + aeval x 0*y = 1; simp
  map_zero' := by change aeval x 0 + aeval x 0*y = 0; simp
  map_add' a b := by
    change aeval x (a.re+b.re) + aeval x (a.im+b.im)*y = _
    simp only [map_add]; ring
  map_mul' a b := by
    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
    linear_combination -((aeval x a.im)*(aeval x b.im)) * h
  commutes' k := by
    change aeval x (C k) + aeval x 0*y = _
    simp

def quadraticPair (u v : Rˣ) (h2 : (v:R)=2) : StandardEtalePair R where
  f := X^2-C (u:R)
  monic_f := monic_X_pow_sub_C _ (by decide : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0)
  g := 1
  cond := by
    let a : R := ↑v⁻¹ * (↑u⁻¹ : R)
    refine ⟨C a*X,-C (↑u⁻¹ : R),0,?_⟩
    have D : derivative (X^2-C (u:R)) = C (2:R)*X := by simp [map_ofNat]; ring
    rw [D,pow_zero]
    have hv : (2:R)*↑v⁻¹=1 := by rw [←h2]; simp
    have hcoeff : (2:R)*a = ↑u⁻¹ := by dsimp [a]; rw [← mul_assoc,hv,one_mul]
    calc
      _ = C ((2:R)*a)*X^2-C (↑u⁻¹ : R)*X^2+C ((↑u⁻¹:R)*(u:R)) := by simp only [map_mul]; ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hcoeff]; simp

def infinityPoint (s t : R) : SpecOver (R := R) (Cover s) ⟶ model s t := by
  let T := Cover s
  let w : T := QuadraticAlgebra.omega
  have hw : w^2=aeval (0:T) (C s*infinityForm t) := by
    change (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : Cover s)^2 = _
    rw [infinity_coeffs]
    simp [T,Cover,sq,QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap]
  let ev := IntegralCover.affinePoint (C s*infinityForm t) (0:T) w hw
  let j : SpecOver (R:=R) T ⟶ SpecOver (R:=R) (Cover (C s*infinityForm t)) :=
    Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom)) (by
      change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
      rw [←Spec.map_comp]
      exact congrArg Spec.map (CommRingCat.hom_ext ev.comp_algebraMap))
  exact j ≫ chartInclusion R _ _ (overlap s t) true

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixJacobian.signedCokernel
declarations.snippet:
private def signedCokernel {X : Scheme.{0}} (c : X ⟶ Spec (.of ℚ)) (v : X.TwoAffineOpenCover)
    (W : X.Opens) (h : W=v.U0 ⊓ v.U1) :
    (v.structureSheafSections c).H1 ≃+
      Γ(X,W) ⧸ (difference v.U0 v.U1 W (h ▸ inf_le_left) (h ▸ inf_le_right)).range := by
  subst W
  let D := difference v.U0 v.U1 (v.U0 ⊓ v.U1) inf_le_left inf_le_right
  let S := v.structureSheafSections c
  have rev (a : Γ(X,v.U0)) (b : Γ(X,v.U1)) : S.cechDiff (a,b) = -D (a,b) := by
    rw [TwoChartCech.Sections.cechDiff_apply]
    change (1 : Γ(X,v.U0 ⊓ v.U1)) * _ - _ = -(_ - _)
    rw [one_mul, neg_sub]
    rfl
  apply QuotientAddGroup.congr _ _ (AddEquiv.refl Γ(X,v.U0 ⊓ v.U1))
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-(a,b), (map_neg D (a,b)).trans (rev a b).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_,⟨-(a,b),rfl⟩,?_⟩
    change S.cechDiff (-(a,b)) = D (a,b)
    rw [map_neg,rev,neg_neg]

    ((twoCharts u).structureSheafSections (paperModel ℚ u).hom).H1 ≃ₗ[ℚ] ℚ × ℚ := by
  let e := signedCokernel (paperModel ℚ u).hom (twoCharts u) _
    (atlas_intersection ℚ _ _ (paper_overlap ℚ u))
  let f := (coordinateQuotient ℚ (paper_overlap ℚ u)).trans
    (quotientEquiv ℚ (paper_overlap ℚ u)).toAddEquiv
  let E := e.trans f
  exact { E with map_smul' := map_rat_smul E }

  let : IsProper (c u) := paper_proper ℚ u
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (c u) := curve_dimension hu
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (c u) := geometricallyIntegral_paperModel hu
  exact JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.presentation ℚ (c u)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixJacobian.jacobian
declarations.snippet:
def jacobian {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) : AbelianModel.GroupScheme ℚ := by
  let : IsProper (c u) := paper_proper ℚ u
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (c u) := curve_dimension hu
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (c u) := geometricallyIntegral_paperModel hu
  let f := JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.toBase ℚ (c u)
  let G := JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.groupLaw ℚ (c u)
  let : GrpObj (Over.mk f) := G.grpObjOverMk
  let : IsCommMonObj (Over.mk f) := G.isCommMonObj_grpObjOverMk_iff_mul_comm.mpr
    (JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.groupLaw_commutative ℚ (c u))
  exact ⟨Over.mk f⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.fourthRoot

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.eighthRoot
declarations.snippet: abbrev eighthRoot (x : ℝ) := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt x))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.rootDistortion
declarations.snippet:
def rootDistortion (a : Fin 10 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (∑ i, fourthRoot (a i)) / (⨆ i, eighthRoot (a i))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.eighth_power

    euclideanHeight x=normalizedHeight x+
      (∑ σ : K →+* ℂ, Real.log (rootDistortion (fun i => ‖σ ((x i)^8)‖))) /
        (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.chars

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.halfPeriod
declarations.snippet:
def halfPeriod : Fin 6 → Char2 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.riemannConstant
declarations.snippet: def riemannConstant : Char2 := chars 1 1 0 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.pairChar

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.pairChar_eq

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.prefactor

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.scaleOf
declarations.snippet:
def scaleOf (detA : ℂ) (hn : detA ≠ 0) : ℂˣ :=
  Units.mk0 ((prefactor detA)^4) (pow_ne_zero _ (div_ne_zero hn (by
    have hp : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ hp))))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.euclidean_of_branches
declarations.snippet:
theorem euclidean_of_branches {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (hd : δ≠0)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hΩ : IsSiegel Ω)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hz : ∀ i, Polynomial.aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u δ)=0)
    {detA : ℂ} (hn : detA≠0) (h : FirstThomae Ω (finiteBranches r) detA)
    {L : Type} [Field L] [NumberField L] (emb : L →+* ℂ) (z : Char2 → L)
    (c : ℂ) (hc : c≠0) (hzθ : ∀ m, emb (z m)=c*thetaConst Ω m) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hd hz
    euclideanHeight z = normalizedHeight (weights r)/8 + branchCorrection (weights r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.exact_pazuki_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem exact_pazuki_height {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (hd : δ≠0)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hΩ : IsSiegel Ω)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hz : ∀ i, Polynomial.aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u δ)=0)
    {detA : ℂ} (hn : detA≠0) (h : FirstThomae Ω (finiteBranches r) detA) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hd hz
    (∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : NumberField L) (emb : L →+* ℂ) (z : Char2 → L) (c : ℂ),
      c≠0 ∧ (∀ m, emb (z m)=c*thetaConst Ω m) ∧ z pivot=1 ∧
      euclideanHeight z=intrinsicThetaHeight (weights r)) ∧
    0 ≤ branchCorrection (weights r) ∧ branchCorrection (weights r) ≤ Real.log 10 / 2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.branch_budget_of_printed_comparison
declarations.snippet:
theorem branch_budget_of_printed_comparison {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (w : Fin 10 → K)
    (F H : ℝ) (hb : F≤H) (corr : 0≤branchCorrection w)
    (comparison :
      |max 1 (intrinsicThetaHeight w) - max 1 (F+Real.log Real.pi)/2| ≤
      ThetaMetric.pazukiConstant * Real.log (min (max 1 (intrinsicThetaHeight w))
        (max 1 (F+Real.log Real.pi)) + 2)) :
    normalizedHeight w ≤ 2^26 * max 1 H := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixMetric.branch_le_of_R22

    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hz : ∀ i, Polynomial.aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u δ)=0)
    (hR : R22_Pazuki) (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (A : AbVar K)
    (hA : A.dim = (2 : WithBot ℕ∞)) (F X : ℝ) (hF : stableFaltingsHeight A=F)
    (hX : max 1 (F+Real.log Real.pi)≤X) (σ : K →+* ℂ) (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin 2 → ℂ))
    (Φ : (Fin 2 → ℂ) → CPts A σ) (hΦ : IsUniformization σ Λ Φ)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hΩ : IsSiegel Ω) (hP : IsPeriodMatrix Λ Ω)
    (detA : ℂ) (hn : detA≠0) (hT : FirstThomae Ω (finiteBranches r) detA) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hd hz
    normalizedHeight (weights r) ≤ 8*(X/2 + pazukiC2*Real.log (X+2)) := by

    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hz : ∀ i, Polynomial.aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u δ)=0)
    (hR : R22_Pazuki) (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (A : AbVar K)
    (hA : A.dim = (2 : WithBot ℕ∞)) (F : ℝ) (hF : stableFaltingsHeight A=F)
    (hrd : F ≤ HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u) (σ : K →+* ℂ) (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin 2 → ℂ))
    (Φ : (Fin 2 → ℂ) → CPts A σ) (hΦ : IsUniformization σ Λ Φ)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hΩ : IsSiegel Ω) (hP : IsPeriodMatrix Λ Ω)
    (detA : ℂ) (hn : detA≠0) (hT : FirstThomae Ω (finiteBranches r) detA) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hd hz
    normalizedHeight (weights r) ≤ 2^26 * max 1 (HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u) := by

    have h0 := (m.2 0).isLt;have h1 := (m.2 1).isLt
    have h2 := (m.1 0).isLt;have h3 := (m.1 1).isLt;omega⟩

  toFun n := (n 0,n 1)
  invFun v := ![v.1,v.2]
  left_inv n := by ext i;fin_cases i <;> rfl
  right_inv v := by cases v;rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalTheta.originalTerm

def originalTerm (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (m : Char2) (n : Fin 2 → ℤ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Real.pi * I *
        ((fun i => (n i : ℂ) + ((m.1 i : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2) ⬝ᵥ
          Ω.mulVec (fun i => (n i : ℂ) + ((m.1 i : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2)) +
      2 * Real.pi * I *
        ((fun i => (n i : ℂ) + ((m.1 i : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2) ⬝ᵥ (fun i => ((m.2 i : ℕ) : ℂ) / 2)))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalTheta.periodOf
declarations.snippet:
def periodOf (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (h : IsSiegel Ω) : SiegelPeriod where
  z11 := Ω 0 0
  z12 := Ω 0 1
  z22 := Ω 1 1
  im11 := h.2.diag_pos
  imdet := by
    have hs : Ω 1 0 = Ω 0 1 := congrFun (congrFun h.1 0) 1
    simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two,Matrix.map_apply,hs,pow_two] using h.2.det_pos

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalTheta.marked_original_representative
declarations.snippet:
theorem marked_original_representative {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ≠0)
    (Ω : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hΩ : IsSiegel Ω)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (distinct : Function.Injective r)
    (root : ∀ i, Polynomial.aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u δ)=0)
    (label : Fin 10 ≃ Partition) (scale : ℂˣ)
    (id : ∀ i, (thetaConst Ω (characteristic (evenIndices i)))^8=
      (scale:ℂ)*branchValue (finiteBranches r) (label i)) :
    ∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : NumberField L) (emb : L →+* ℂ) (z : Char2 → L) (c : ℂ),
      c≠0 ∧ (∀ m, emb (z m)=c*thetaConst Ω m) ∧ z pivot=1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Rank.scaleY
ZInQBlueprint.Rank.scaleHom
declarations.snippet:
private def scaleHom : (short a).Point →+ (short b).Point where
  toFun := scalePoint f a b k hk hb
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := by
    rintro (_ | @⟨x₁,y₁,h₁⟩) (_ | @⟨x₂,y₂,h₂⟩)
    any_goals rfl
    have hx : k^2*f x₁=k^2*f x₂ ↔ x₁=x₂ := by simp [hk,f.injective.eq_iff]
    have hy : k^3*f y₁= -(k^3*f y₂) ↔ y₁= -y₂ := by
      have t : k^3*f y₁ = k^3*f (-y₂) ↔ y₁ = -y₂ :=
        ⟨fun h => f.injective (mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hk) h), fun h => by rw [h]⟩
      simpa only [map_neg,mul_neg] using t
    have hxy : (k^2*f x₁=k^2*f x₂ ∧ k^3*f y₁ = (short b).negY (k^2*f x₂) (k^3*f y₂)) ↔
        (x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=(short a).negY x₂ y₂) := by
      simp only [negY,short,WeierstrassCurve.toAffine,zero_mul,sub_zero,hx,hy]
    by_cases h : x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=(short a).negY x₂ y₂
    · rw [Point.add_of_Y_eq h.1 h.2]
      have h' := hxy.mpr h
      exact (Point.add_of_Y_eq h'.1 h'.2).symm
    · have h' := mt hxy.mp h
      rw [Point.add_some h]
      change Point.some _ = Point.some _ + Point.some _
      rw [Point.add_some h', Point.some.injEq]
      constructor
      · rw [scale_slope f a b k hk hb, scaleX]
      · rw [scale_slope f a b k hk hb, scaleY]

  let a : ℚ := x.re
  let b : ℚ := x.im
  let leading := Nat.lcm (2*a).den (a^2-2*b^2).den
  let conjugate₁ : ℝ := a + b * Real.sqrt 2
  let conjugate₂ : ℝ := a - b * Real.sqrt 2
  (Real.log leading + Real.log (max 1 |conjugate₁|) + Real.log (max 1 |conjugate₂|)) / 2

      (∀ i, ∃ y : K, coordinates (n i • P) = some (x i,y)) ∧
      (∀ i, CanonicalHeightValue (n i • P) (h i)) ∧
      (∑ i, h i) ≤ Mplus * ratHeight (∑ i, x i).re + Cplus ∧

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.Gaussian
declarations.snippet: abbrev Gaussian := ℤ × ℤ

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianNorm
declarations.snippet: def gaussianNorm (z : Gaussian) : ℕ := (z.1^2 + z.2^2).natAbs

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianMul
declarations.snippet: def gaussianMul (z w : Gaussian) : Gaussian := (z.1*w.1-z.2*w.2,z.1*w.2+z.2*w.1)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianPrime
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianPrime (z : Gaussian) : Prop := gaussianNorm z > 1 ∧
  ∀ a b : Gaussian, gaussianMul a b = z → gaussianNorm a = 1 ∨ gaussianNorm b = 1

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.adjacentNorm
declarations.snippet:
def adjacentNorm (z : Gaussian) (plus : Bool) : ℕ :=
  gaussianNorm (z.1 + (if plus then 1 else -1), z.2)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianCongruent
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianCongruent (m : ℕ) (z w : Gaussian) : Prop :=
  Int.ModEq m z.1 w.1 ∧ Int.ModEq m z.2 w.2

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.squarefree
declarations.snippet: def squarefree (a : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬ p^2 ∣ a

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianPattern
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianPattern {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℤ) (q M u w : ℕ) (p : Fin k → ℕ) : Prop :=
  q ∣ w ∧ ∃ π : Fin k → Gaussian,
    (∀ j, (p j:ℤ) = u + c j * (w:ℤ)^2 ∧ (p j).Prime ∧
      gaussianPrime (π j) ∧ gaussianNorm (π j) = p j ∧
      gaussianCongruent 16 (π j) (9,0) ∧ gaussianCongruent 7 (π j) (1,3) ∧
      gaussianCongruent M (π j) (0,1)) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → Odd l → ¬ (l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) false ∧ l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) true)) ∧
    (∀ j h, j ≠ h → ∀ e f : Bool, ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → Odd l →
      ¬ (l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) e ∧ l ∣ adjacentNorm (π h) f)) ∧
    (∀ j, padicValNat 2 (adjacentNorm (π j) false) = 6 ∧ padicValNat 2 (adjacentNorm (π j) true) = 2) ∧
    (∀ j h, Nat.gcd (adjacentNorm (π j) false) (adjacentNorm (π h) true) = 4) ∧
    (∀ j e, (adjacentNorm (π j) e).Coprime (7*M))

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.GaussianTuples
declarations.snippet:
def GaussianTuples : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ c : Fin k → ℤ, Function.Injective c →
  ∀ q M : ℕ, 0 < q → 0 < M → Odd M → squarefree M → ¬ 7 ∣ M →
  ∀ H Y : ℝ, 0 < H → 0 < Y → ∃ u w : ℕ, 0 < u ∧ 0 < w ∧ H < (u:ℝ)/w^2 ∧
  ∃ p : Fin k → ℕ, gaussianPattern c q M u w p ∧ ∀ j, Y < (p j:ℝ)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.GaussianCount
declarations.snippet:
def GaussianCount : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ c : Fin k → ℤ, Function.Injective c →
  ∀ q M : ℕ, 0 < q → 0 < M → Odd M → squarefree M → ¬ 7 ∣ M →
  ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1/2 → ∃ c₀ C : ℝ, ∃ τ : ℝ → ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧
    (∀ X, 0 < τ X) ∧ Antitone τ ∧ Tendsto τ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun X => τ X * Real.exp ((1/2-α)*Real.log X) / (Real.log X)^k) atTop atTop ∧
    ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in atTop, let T := ⌊τ X * Real.sqrt X⌋₊
      ∃ ω : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ,
        (∀ u w, 0 ≤ ω u w ∧ ω u w ≤ C*(Real.log X)^k) ∧
        (∀ u w, ω u w ≠ 0 → X/2 ≤ (u:ℝ) ∧ (u:ℝ) ≤ X ∧ 1 ≤ w ∧ w ≤ T ∧
          ∃ p : Fin k → ℕ, gaussianPattern c q M u w p) ∧
        c₀*X*T ≤ ∑ u ∈ Finset.range (⌊X⌋₊+1), ∑ w ∈ Finset.range (T+1), ω u w

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.localSquareAt
declarations.snippet: def localSquareAt (p a : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ t : ℤ, Int.ModEq ((p:ℤ)^k) (t^2) a

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.twistPointInClass
declarations.snippet:
def twistPointInClass (β l : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ t y : ℚ, t ≠ 0 ∧
  let x := β*t^2
  y^2 = x*(x-l)*(x+3*l)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.SimultaneousTwists
declarations.snippet:
def SimultaneousTwists : Prop := ∀ β θ : ℕ, 0 < β → 0 < θ → squarefree β → squarefree θ →
  β.Coprime θ → β.Coprime 6 → θ.Coprime 6 → β % 24 = 17 → θ % 24 = 1 →
  (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ θ → localSquareAt p β) →
  (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ β → localSquareAt p θ) →
  ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ squarefree n ∧ n.Coprime (6*θ) ∧ twistPointInClass β n ∧ twistPointInClass β (n*θ)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.ratOrder
declarations.snippet: def ratOrder (p : ℕ) (b : ℚ) : ℤ := (padicValNat p b.num.natAbs : ℤ) - padicValNat p b.den

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.PoleCompleteness
declarations.snippet:
def PoleCompleteness : Prop := ∀ B : ℚ, (∃ d : ℕ, B.den = d^2) → 0 < B → B < 1/2 →
  (∀ p ∈ ({2,3,5,7,13} : Finset ℕ), 4 ≤ ratOrder p B) → pole B

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.locallySquareRat
declarations.snippet:
def locallySquareRat (p : ℕ) (b : ℚ) : Prop := b ≠ 0 ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ t : ℤ, Int.ModEq ((p:ℤ)^k) (t^2) (b.num*b.den)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.preparedPole
ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.ZeroPreparation
declarations.snippet:
def ZeroPreparation : Prop := ∀ b : ℚ, b ≠ 0 →
  (preparedPole b → ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∉ ({2,3,17}: Finset ℕ) → ¬ (ratOrder p b < 0 ∧ Odd (ratOrder p b))) ∧
  ((∃ d : ℕ, b.den = d^2) → 0 < b → b < 17 →
    (∀ p ∈ ({2,3,17}:Finset ℕ), locallySquareRat p b) →
    3 ≤ ratOrder 2 b → 1 ≤ ratOrder 3 b → 2 ≤ ratOrder 17 b → preparedPole b)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.twist
declarations.snippet: def twist (l : ℕ) : WeierstrassCurve ℚ := ⟨0,2*l,0,-3*(l:ℚ)^2,0⟩

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.RestrictedConverse
declarations.snippet:
def RestrictedConverse (selmerCorank₂ orderAtOne : WeierstrassCurve ℚ → WithTop ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < l → squarefree l → l % 12 = 11 → selmerCorank₂ (twist l) = 1 → orderAtOne (twist l) = 1

declarations.snippet:
private def substitute {f g : K[X]} (c : K[X])
    (relation : expand K 2 g = c^2 * expand K 2 f) :
    Cover g →ₐ[K] Cover (expand K 2 f) where
  toFun a := ⟨expand K 2 a.re, c * expand K 2 a.im⟩
  map_zero' := by ext <;> simp
  map_one' := by ext <;> simp
  map_add' a b := by ext <;> simp [mul_add]
  map_mul' a b := by apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [relation] <;> ring
  commutes' k := by
    change (⟨expand K 2 (C k), c * expand K 2 0⟩ : Cover (expand K 2 f)) = ⟨C k,0⟩
    simp

def OnAbelDifferences {C : Over (Spec (.of Qbar))} {A : GroupScheme Qbar}
    (m : C ⟶ A.X) (a : A ≅ A) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : C ≅ C, ∀ p q : base Qbar ⟶ C,
    (Additive.ofMul ((p ≫ m) ≫ (underlying a).hom) : sections A) -
      (Additive.ofMul ((q ≫ m) ≫ (underlying a).hom) : sections A) =
      (Additive.ofMul ((p ≫ c.hom) ≫ m) : sections A) - Additive.ofMul ((q ≫ c.hom) ≫ m)

    (h : ∀ p : base Qbar ⟶ C, (Additive.ofMul ((p ≫ m) ≫ (underlying a).hom) : sections A) =
      Additive.ofMul ((p ≫ c.hom) ≫ m) + t) : OnAbelDifferences m a := by

def RationalAbelMarking {C : Over (Spec (.of Qbar))} (A : GroupScheme ℚ)
    (m : C ⟶ ((baseChange (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).obj A).X) (z : Qbar) : Prop :=
  let J := (baseChange (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).obj A
  ∃ act : LevelThree.O →+* End J, Function.Injective act ∧
    ∀ σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar, σ z = z → ∃ φ : J ≅ (conjugation σ.toRingEquiv).mapCommGrp.obj J,
      (act sqrtThree).asHom ≫ φ.hom =
        φ.hom ≫ (conjugation σ.toRingEquiv).mapCommGrp.map (act sqrtThree).asHom ∧
      OnAbelDifferences m (φ ≪≫ (rationalGroupComparison A σ).symm)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeierstrassCoordinates.HasFiniteAction
declarations.snippet:
def HasFiniteAction (C : Over (Spec (.of Qbar))) (F : Qbar × Qbar → Qbar)
    (read : Finite F → Sections Qbar C) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : C ≅ C, ∃ (m : (Qbar × Qbar) ≃ₗ[Qbar] (Qbar × Qbar)) (k : Qbarˣ),
    (∀ v, F (m v) = (k : Qbar)^2 * F v) ∧
    ∀ p : Finite F, (m (p.1.1,1)).2 ≠ 0 → ∃ q : Finite F,
      read p ≫ e.hom = read q ∧
      q.1.1 = (m (p.1.1,1)).1 / (m (p.1.1,1)).2 ∧
      q.1.2 = (k : Qbar) * p.1.2 / (m (p.1.1,1)).2^3

    ∀ eval : (∀ x : Qbar, aeval x f = F (x,1)),
    HasFiniteAction (gluedOver Qbar f g overlap) F (finiteReader f g overlap F eval)

declarations.name: WeakBisection.inverse_slope

theorem inverse_slope {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b x B A : R) :
    let a := x*B+3*b*A
    let m := x*A-B
    a*x-3*b*m=(x^2+3*b)*B ∧ m*x+a=(x^2+3*b)*A ∧
      a^2+3*b*m^2=(x^2+3*b)*(B^2+3*b*A^2) := by

declarations.name: WeakBisection.bisection_witness
declarations.snippet:
theorem bisection_witness {R : Type} [CommRing R] (b t x a m h n : R)
    (hq : h^2-b*n^2=a^2+3*b*m^2) :
    let B := a*x-3*b*m
    let A := m*x+a
    let e := x*B+b*A
    let g := B+x*A
    let u := h*e+b*n*g
    let v := h*g+n*e
    t*u=v →
      ((x^2+3*b)*(1-b*t^2)*u)^2 =
        (1-b*t^2)*(x^2-b)*(x^2+3*b)*(B^2-b*A^2)*(B^2+3*b*A^2) := by

declarations.name: CompanionTrace.beta
declarations.snippet: private def beta : Nat := 412690661369

declarations.name: CompanionTrace.slopeTest
declarations.snippet:
def slopeTest (p x u : Nat) : Bool :=
  let square := fun (z : Nat) =>
    (List.range p).any fun y => y*y % p == z % p
  let b := beta % p
  let n := twist % p
  if x % p == n then
    square (1 + 3*b*u*u)
  else
    (List.range p).any fun s =>
      (x+p-n)*s*s % p == b*(x+3*n) % p &&
      square ((s*s+3*b)*((s+b*u)^2+3*b*(1+s*u)^2))

declarations.name: CompanionTrace.slopeTest_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem slopeTest_iff (p x u : Nat) :
    slopeTest p x u = true ↔
      if x % p = twist % p then
        ∃ y < p, y*y % p = (1+3*(beta%p)*u*u) % p
      else
        ∃ s < p, (x+p-twist%p)*s*s % p = (beta%p)*(x+3*(twist%p)) % p ∧
          ∃ y < p, y*y % p =
            ((s*s+3*(beta%p))*((s+(beta%p)*u)^2+3*(beta%p)*(1+s*u)^2)) % p := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.NormalDescent.deck
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def deck (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    pullback s (specExtension K L) ⟶ pullback s (specExtension K L) :=
  pullback.lift (pullback.fst _ _)
    (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom)) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
      have h : (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom =
          CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L) := CommRingCat.hom_ext σ.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap
      rw [h]
      exact pullback.condition)

def pointwisePreadditive (C : Type*) [Category* C]
    [CartesianMonoidalCategory C] [BraidedCategory C] : Preadditive (CommGrp C) where
  homGroup P Q :=
    ((InducedCategory.homEquiv : (P ⟶ Q) ≃ (P.toGrp ⟶ Q.toGrp)).trans Additive.ofMul).addCommGroup
  add_comp _ _ _ f g h := InducedCategory.hom_ext (MonObj.mul_comp f.hom g.hom h.hom)
  comp_add _ _ _ f g h := InducedCategory.hom_ext (MonObj.comp_mul f.hom g.hom h.hom)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.NormalDescent.changeEndRing
declarations.snippet:
def changeEndRing (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Braided] (A : CommGrp C) :
    End A →+* End (F.mapCommGrp.obj A) where
  toFun f := End.of (F.mapCommGrp.map f.asHom)
  map_one' := (F.mapCommGrp.mapEnd A).map_one
  map_mul' := (F.mapCommGrp.mapEnd A).map_mul
  map_zero' := by
    have : F.mapCommGrp.Additive := additive_mapCommGrp F
    exact congrArg End.of (F.mapCommGrp.map_zero A A)
  map_add' f g := by
    have : F.mapCommGrp.Additive := additive_mapCommGrp F
    exact congrArg End.of (F.mapCommGrp.map_add (f := f.asHom) (g := g.asHom))

def DDMMCriterion (jac : Qp[X] → GroupScheme Qp) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℚ) (v a : Zpˣ) (t : Zp) (m : ℕ),
    17 ≤ p → 0 < m →
    ∀ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p : W)^m),
      let f := polynomial p u v a t
      f.natDegree = 6 → f.Separable →
      (f.Splits ∨ f.IsSplittingField Qp L) →
      (Module.Finite Zp W ∧ Algebra.Etale Zp W) → IsIntegralClosure W Zp L →
      (∀ s ∈ tree, s ≠ Finset.univ → Odd s.card) →
      (∀ s (hs : principal s), Even (principalOrder (equation p u v a t) T s hs)) →
      HasGoodReduction p (jac f)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.Presentation.sheafRepresentation
declarations.snippet:
def Presentation.sheafRepresentation :
    (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroSheaf c).obj.RepresentableBy (Over.mk P.toBase) := by
  have : Flat (specMap R A) := (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Flat)).2
    (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.2 inferInstance)
  have : Surjective (specMap R A) := ((flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff _).mpr
    (RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance)).2
  have : LocallyOfFinitePresentation (specMap R A) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFinitePresentation)).2
      (RingHom.finitePresentation_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
  let F := Unrigidified.zeroPresheaf c
  let eRaw := representableByRestrict c A P.localSection P.represents
  let eSheaf := DescentAction.sheafifiedLocalRepresentation (specMap R A) F P.picard.toBase eRaw
  have hc : DescentAction.eRel (specMap R A) P.picard.toBase P.toBase P.comparison
      P.comparison_over ≫ DescentAction.repAct (specMap R A) (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroSheaf c).obj
      P.picard.toBase eSheaf = (DescentAction.canonical (specMap R A) P.toBase).act ≫ P.comparison.hom :=
    (congrArg (fun a => DescentAction.eRel (specMap R A) P.picard.toBase P.toBase P.comparison
      P.comparison_over ≫ a)
      (DescentAction.repAct_sheafifiedLocalRepresentation (specMap R A) F P.picard.toBase eRaw)).trans P.descent
  exact DescentAction.globalRepresentation (specMap R A) (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroSheaf c).obj
    P.picard.toBase eSheaf P.toBase P.comparison P.comparison_over
    (DescentAction.isSheafFor_coverT_of_isSheaf (specMap R A) (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroSheaf c).obj
      (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroSheaf c).property) hc

ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.CurveMap.pull
declarations.snippet:
def pull (φ : C ⟶ D) : zeroCommGrpPresheaf D.hom ⟶ zeroCommGrpPresheaf C.hom where
  app T := by
    letI : CommGroup ((zeroPresheaf D.hom).obj T) := zeroCommGroup T
    letI : CommGroup ((zeroPresheaf C.hom).obj T) := zeroCommGroup T
    exact CommGrpCat.ofHom (pullPoint φ T.unop)
  naturality {X Y} ψ := by
    ext x
    rcases x with ⟨x,hx⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    induction x using Quot.ind with
    | _ M =>
      let q : SchemeHomOver Y.unop.hom X.unop.hom := ⟨ψ.unop.left, Over.w ψ.unop⟩
      exact Quot.sound (baseTwist_of_iso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (onTest φ Y.unop.hom) (baseChangeSnd D.hom q)).app M.1 ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (onTest_natural φ X.unop.hom q).symm).app M.1 ≪≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (baseChangeSnd C.hom q) (onTest φ X.unop.hom)).app M.1).symm))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.CurveMap.pullIso

def pullIso (e : C ≅ D) : zeroCommGrpPresheaf D.hom ≅ zeroCommGrpPresheaf C.hom where
  hom := pull e.hom
  inv := pull e.inv
  hom_inv_id := by
    ext T x
    rcases x with ⟨x,hx⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    induction x using Quot.ind with
    | _ M =>
      let eT := (Over.forget _).mapIso ((Over.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso e)
      exact Quot.sound (baseTwist_of_iso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp eT.inv eT.hom).app M.1 ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eT.inv_hom_id).app M.1 ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app M.1))
  inv_hom_id := by
    ext T x
    rcases x with ⟨x,hx⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    induction x using Quot.ind with
    | _ M =>
      let eT := (Over.forget _).mapIso ((Over.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso e)
      exact Quot.sound (baseTwist_of_iso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp eT.hom eT.inv).app M.1 ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eT.hom_inv_id).app M.1 ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app M.1))

def baseChangeToRepresentative {R L : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing L] [Algebra R L]
    {C X : Over (Spec (.of R))} {D Y : Over (Spec (.of L))}
    (hC : Representative C X) (hD : Representative D Y)
    (e : (Over.pullback (specMap R L)).obj C ≅ D) :
    (AbelianModel.baseChange (algebraMap R L)).obj
        (groupObject (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf C.hom).obj hC) ≅
      groupObject (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf D.hom).obj hD :=
  groupObjectPullbackIso (specMap R L) _ hC ≪≫ SchemeTheory.RepresentedGroups.iso
    ((Over.map (specMap R L)).op ⋙ (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf C.hom).obj)
    (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf D.hom).obj
    (SchemeTheory.WeilRestriction.representableByBaseChange (specMap R L) hC) hD
    ((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of L))) CommGrpCat.{1}).mapIso
      ((scalarSheafIso C.hom L).symm ≪≫ curveSheafIso (C := (Over.pullback (specMap R L)).obj C) (D := D) e))

def unpointed_baseChangeIso {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of K))) (D : Over (Spec (.of L)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [IsProper D.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible D.hom]
    (e : (Over.pullback (specMap K L)).obj C ≅ D) :
    (AbelianModel.baseChange (algebraMap K L)).obj (groupScheme K C.hom) ≅ groupScheme L D.hom :=
  (AbelianModel.baseChange (algebraMap K L)).mapIso (sheafGroupSchemeIso K C.hom).symm ≪≫
    baseChangeToRepresentative (C:=C) (D:=D) (groupSheafRepresentation K C.hom)
      (groupSheafRepresentation L D.hom) e ≪≫ sheafGroupSchemeIso L D.hom

    (q : ℚˣ →* H) (injective : Function.Injective q)
    (centre : ∀ z : H, π z = 1 → (∀ y : H, π y = 1 → z*y=y*z) → ∃ a : ℚˣ, q a = z)
    (scalars : ∀ a : ℚˣ, π (q a) = 1) :
    ∃ (s : G → H) (c : G × G → ℚˣ), s 1 = 1 ∧ (∀ g, π (s g) = g) ∧
      (∀ g y, π y = 1 → s g*y = y*s g) ∧
      (∀ g h, s g*s h = q (c (g,h))*s (g*h)) ∧
      (∀ g, c (1,g)=1 ∧ c (g,1)=1) ∧
      ∀ g h j, c (g*h,j)*c (g,h) = c (h,j)*c (g,h*j) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.CommonWittField.extendSplitting
declarations.snippet:
def extendSplitting {a b e : ℤ} {q : WittRing p} (D : FiniteSplitting p a b e q)
    (k : Subfield (Residues p)) [Finite k] (sub : D.field ≤ k) : FiniteSplitting p a b e q := by
  let i : WittVector p D.field →+* WittVector p k := WittVector.map (Subfield.inclusion sub)
  have comp (x : WittVector p D.field) : inclusion p k (i x) = inclusion p D.field x := by
    ext j
    rfl
  exact {
    field := k
    finite := inferInstance
    rho := i D.rho
    inclusion_rho := (comp D.rho).trans D.inclusion_rho
    radical := fun z h => by
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := D.radical z h
      exact ⟨i v,(comp v).trans hv⟩
    splits := by
      have h := D.splits.map i
      simpa [twisted,upper,lower,sextic_map,map_ofNat] using h
  }

    (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] M) (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (B : GroupScheme ℚ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=

  let J := familyJacobian t (e : ℚ) ht (twist_ne s) (AlgEquiv.refl : fixedField ≃ₐ[ℚ] fixedField)
  ∀ (q : PicardLocal.WittRing p) (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (m : ℕ) (D : FibreData p s.num s.den e q A m),

    let k := D.finiteModel.field

    letI := wittCharZero p k
    let S := WittVector p k

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartApplication.quaternionVarietyOfTensor
declarations.snippet:
def quaternionVarietyOfTensor {E D : Type} [Field E] [NumberField E] [Ring D] [Nontrivial D] [Algebra ℚ D]
    (B : GroupScheme ℚ) (hB : IsAbelianScheme B)
    (dim : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (2 * Module.finrank ℚ E) B.X.hom)
    (e : (E ⊗[ℚ] D) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End B))
    (i j : D) (hi : i^2 = -3) (hj : j^2 = 2) (skew : j*i = -(i*j)) : QuaternionVariety E := by
  let A := ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End B
  let T := E ⊗[ℚ] D
  let ι := e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E T)
  let alg : Algebra E A := ι.toAlgebra' fun x y => by
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
    change e _ * e z = e z * e _
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Algebra.commutes]
  let tower : IsScalarTower ℚ E A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    change _ = e (algebraMap E T (algebraMap ℚ E x))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, e.commutes]
  let ne : Nontrivial A := e.injective.nontrivial
  let ιD : D →ₐ[ℚ] A := e.toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  exact { B := B, abelian := hB, dimension := dim, nontrivialEnd := ne, centralScalars := alg,
          tower := tower, i := ιD i, j := ιD j,
          sq_i := by rw [← map_pow, hi, map_neg, map_ofNat],
          sq_j := by rw [← map_pow, hj, map_ofNat],
          skew := by rw [← map_mul, skew, map_neg, map_mul] }

    (J A : GroupScheme M)
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)ˣ) where
  B : GroupScheme ℚ
  abelian : IsAbelianScheme B
  dimension : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (2 * Module.finrank ℚ (coefficientField b)) B.X.hom
  endomorphisms :
    (coefficientField b ⊗[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((geometric M).obj J))) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End B)
  nontrivial : Nontrivial (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((geometric M).obj J))
  i : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((geometric M).obj J)
  j : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((geometric M).obj J)
  sq_i : i^2 = -3
  sq_j : j^2 = 2
  skew : j*i = -(i*j)
  representation : coefficientField b →ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((geometric M).obj A))
  κ : (geometric M).obj A ⟶
    (geometric M).obj ((baseChange (algebraMap ℚ M)).obj B)
  finite : IsFinite κ.hom.hom.hom.left
  onto : AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective κ.hom.hom.hom.left
  splitting : GeometricLaw M (A:=A) (B:=(baseChange (algebraMap ℚ M)).obj B) b representation κ

    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)ˣ) :=
  GeometricIsogenyData M (surface M ψ t ht) (sourcePower M ψ t ht b) b

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartApplication.marked_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem marked_fibre (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
    (J A : GroupScheme M) (hA : IsAbelianScheme A)
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)ˣ) (c : Gal(M/ℚ) × Gal(M/ℚ) → ℚˣ) (hc : c (1,1) = 1)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h))
    [NumberField (coefficientField b)]
    (multiply : Multiplications) (W : GeometricIsogenyData M J A b) :
    ∃ V : QuaternionVariety (coefficientField b),
      ∃ f : A ⟶ (baseChange (algebraMap ℚ M)).obj V.B,
        IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartApplication.TateSplitting
declarations.snippet:
def TateSplitting (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/ℚ) coefficients),
    ∃ b : LocallyConstant Gal((AlgebraicClosure ℚ)/ℚ) coefficients,
      ∀ σ τ : Gal((AlgebraicClosure ℚ)/ℚ), c (restriction L σ, restriction L τ) = coboundary b σ τ

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartApplication.GeometricSystems
declarations.snippet:
def GeometricSystems (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
    (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] L) (except : Finset ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet), picardParameter t ∉ except →
    ∃ c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ, c (1,1) = 1 ∧
      (∀ g h j, c (g*h,j) * c (g,h) = c (h,j) * c (g,h*j)) ∧
      ∀ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (le : L ≤ M)
        (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)ˣ),
        (∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (finiteRestriction le g, finiteRestriction le h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) →
        Nonempty (GeometricIsogeny M ((IntermediateField.inclusion le).comp ψ) t ht b)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartApplication.uniform_marked_isogenies
declarations.snippet:
theorem uniform_marked_isogenies (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
    (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] L) (except : Finset ℚ) (tate : TateSplitting L)
    (multiplication : Multiplications) (systems : GeometricSystems L ψ except) :
    ∃ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (le : L ≤ M),
      MarkedIsogenies ((IntermediateField.inclusion le).comp ψ) (Module.finrank ℚ M) except := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.changeHom
ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.changeHom_tmul
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem changeHom_tmul {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (φ : K →+* L)
    {X Y : GroupScheme K} (r : ℚ) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    changeHom φ (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f) = r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (baseChange φ).map f := by rfl

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.pull
declarations.snippet: abbrev pull (σ : Gal(L/ℚ)) (J : GroupScheme L) := (baseChange σ.toRingHom).obj J

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.Maps
declarations.snippet: abbrev Maps (J : GroupScheme L) := (σ : Gal(L/ℚ)) → QHom (pull σ J) J

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.Compatible
declarations.snippet:
def Compatible (J : GroupScheme L) (μ : Maps J) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ, (∃ ν : QHom J (pull σ J), comp (μ σ) ν = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 (pull σ J) ∧
    comp ν (μ σ) = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 J) ∧
    ∀ z : QEnd J, comp (asHom (pull σ J) (change σ.toRingHom J z)) (μ σ) =
      comp (μ σ) (asHom J z)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.Multiplier
declarations.snippet:
def Multiplier (J : GroupScheme L) (μ : Maps J) (c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ τ, let i : pull (σ*τ) J ≅ pull σ (pull τ J) :=
      WittAscent.baseChangeCompIso τ.toRingHom σ.toRingHom J
    comp ((1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] i.hom) (comp (changeHom σ.toRingHom (μ τ)) (μ σ)) =
      (↑(c (σ,τ)) : ℚ) • μ (σ*τ)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartCocycle.choose_maps
declarations.snippet:
theorem choose_maps (J : GroupScheme L)
    (given : ∀ σ : Gal(L/ℚ), ∃ (m : QHom (pull σ J) J) (n : QHom J (pull σ J)),
      comp m n = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 (pull σ J) ∧ comp n m = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 J ∧
      ∀ z : QEnd J, comp (asHom (pull σ J) (change σ.toRingHom J z)) m =
        comp m (asHom J z)) : ∃ μ : Maps J, Compatible J μ := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.GeometricLaw
declarations.snippet:
def GeometricLaw {A B : GroupScheme M}
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ)
    (φ : coefficientField b →ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((F).obj A)))
    (κ : (F).obj A ⟶ (F).obj B) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ : Gal(Qbar/M), (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (conjugate κ σ) = afterHom κ
    (φ (↑((coefficientUnit b (restriction M (σ.restrictScalars ℚ)))⁻¹) : coefficientField b))

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.Multiplications
declarations.snippet:
def Multiplications : Prop :=
  ∀ A : GroupScheme Qbar, IsAbelianScheme A → ∀ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 →
    let f := (z • 𝟙 A).hom.hom.hom.left
    IsFinite f ∧ Flat f ∧ Surjective f

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.descended_isogeny
declarations.snippet:
theorem descended_isogeny {A B : GroupScheme M} (a : IsAbelianScheme A) (d : IsAbelianScheme B)
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ) (c : Gal(M/ℚ) × Gal(M/ℚ) → ℚˣ) (hc : c (1,1) = 1)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h))
    (φ : coefficientField b →ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((F).obj A)))
    (κ : (F).obj A ⟶ (F).obj B) (hf : IsFinite κ.hom.hom.hom.left) (hs : Surjective κ.hom.hom.hom.left)
    (multiply : Multiplications) (law : GeometricLaw M b φ κ) :
    ∃ f : A ⟶ B, IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.MultiplicationTheorem
declarations.snippet:
def MultiplicationTheorem : Prop :=
  ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [CharZero K] (A : GroupScheme K), IsAbelianScheme A →
    ∀ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 → let f := (z • 𝟙 A).hom.hom.hom.left
      IsFinite f ∧ Flat f ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective f

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.CompatibleIsogenies
declarations.snippet:
def CompatibleIsogenies {L : Type} [Field L] [CharZero L] (Y : GroupScheme L) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ : Gal(L/ℚ), ∃ m : pull σ Y ⟶ Y, IsFinite m.hom.hom.hom.left ∧
    AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective m.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ ∀ z : QEnd Y,
      comp (asHom (pull σ Y) (change σ.toRingHom Y z)) (PicardIntegralHom.integral _ _ m) =
        comp (PicardIntegralHom.integral _ _ m) (asHom Y z)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.compatible_isogenies
declarations.snippet:
theorem compatible_isogenies {K : Type} [Field K] [CharZero K] (Y : GroupScheme K)
    (ab : IsAbelianScheme Y) (multi : MultiplicationTheorem) (maps : ∃ μ : Maps Y, Compatible Y μ) :
    CompatibleIsogenies Y := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.IntegralMaps
ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.RationalMultipliers
declarations.snippet:
def RationalMultipliers : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ PicardConjugation.Qbar) (Y : GroupScheme L),
    IsAbelianScheme Y → SmoothOfRelativeDimension 2 Y.X.hom →
    PicardPrym.QuaternionModel Y → CompatibleIsogenies Y →
    ∃ (μ : Maps Y) (c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ),
      Compatible Y μ ∧ IntegralMaps μ ∧ Multiplier Y μ c ∧ c (1,1) = 1 ∧
      ∀ g h j, c (g*h,j)*c (g,h) = c (h,j)*c (g,h*j)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartSurfaces.GeometricDescent
declarations.snippet:
def GeometricDescent : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ PicardConjugation.Qbar)
    (ψ : k →ₐ[ℚ] L) (X : GroupScheme k), let Y := (baseChange ψ.toRingHom).obj X
    IsAbelianScheme Y → SmoothOfRelativeDimension 2 Y.X.hom → PicardPrym.QuaternionModel Y →
    ∀ (μ : Maps Y) (c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ),
      Compatible Y μ → IntegralMaps μ → Multiplier Y μ c → c (1,1) = 1 →
      ∀ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ PicardConjugation.Qbar) (le : L ≤ M) (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → PicardConjugation.Qbarˣ),
        (∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (finiteRestriction le g, finiteRestriction le h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) →
        let Z := (baseChange ((IntermediateField.inclusion le).comp ψ).toRingHom).obj X
        Nonempty (GeometricIsogenyData M Z (AbelianPowers.power Z (Module.finrank ℚ (coefficientField b)-1)) b)

declarations.snippet:
theorem compatible_maps (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ PicardConjugation.Qbar) (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] L)
    (t d : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (q : PicardPrym.QuaternionModel (familyOver ψ t d ht hd)) :
    ∃ μ : Maps (familyOver ψ t d ht hd), Compatible _ μ := by

theorem systems_of_endomorphisms (multi : MultiplicationTheorem) (multipliers : RationalMultipliers) (descent : GeometricDescent)
    (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ PicardConjugation.Qbar) (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] L) (except : Finset ℚ)
    (dim : ∀ (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet), SmoothOfRelativeDimension 2 (surface L ψ t ht).X.hom)
    (ends : ∀ (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet), picardParameter t ∉ except →
      Nonempty (PicardPrym.QuaternionModel (surface L ψ t ht))) : GeometricSystems L ψ except := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.IsogenyHeight.kernelDegree
ZOverQ.Qualitative.IsogenyHeight.IsIsogeny
declarations.snippet:
def IsIsogeny {A B : GroupScheme M} (f : A ⟶ B) : Prop :=
  IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.IsogenyHeight.DegreeBound
declarations.snippet:
def DegreeBound (F : GroupScheme M → ℝ) (G : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ (X Y : GroupScheme M) (g : ℕ), 0 < g → g ≤ G →
    IsAbelianScheme X → IsAbelianScheme Y → SmoothOfRelativeDimension g X.X.hom →
    (∃ f : Y ⟶ X, IsIsogeny f) → ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, IsIsogeny f ∧
      0 < kernelDegree f ∧ (kernelDegree f : ℝ) ≤ c * (max 1 (F X))^k

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.IsogenyHeight.StableHeight
declarations.snippet:
structure StableHeight (F : GroupScheme M → ℝ) : Prop where
  powers : ∀ (J : GroupScheme M), IsAbelianScheme J → ∀ n : ℕ,
    F (AbelianPowers.power J n) = ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * F J
  isogeny : ∀ {X Y : GroupScheme M}, IsAbelianScheme X → IsAbelianScheme Y →
    ∀ f : X ⟶ Y, IsIsogeny f → |F Y - F X| ≤ Real.log (kernelDegree f) / 2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.IsogenyHeight.uniform_power_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem uniform_power_bound (F : GroupScheme M → ℝ) (G : ℕ)
    (stable : StableHeight F) (gr : DegreeBound F G) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ ∀ (B J : GroupScheme M) (g n : ℕ), 0 < g → g ≤ G →
      IsAbelianScheme B → IsAbelianScheme J → SmoothOfRelativeDimension g B.X.hom →
      (∃ f : AbelianPowers.power J n ⟶ B, IsIsogeny f) →
      max 1 (F J) ≤ a * max 1 (F B) + b := by

    ∃ T : Finset ℚ, T.card ≤ 6*finiteness.toFinset.card ∧
      ∀ t, t ∈ T ↔ markedValue (picardParameter t) ∈ CM := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.canonicalPolynomial
declarations.snippet: def canonicalPolynomial (j : Qbar) : Qbar[X] := C (1/2) * sextic j 1

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.published_equation
declarations.snippet:
theorem published_equation {j : Qbar} (hj : j ≠ 1) :
    ∃ a w : Qbar, 1-a^2/(4*w^3)=j ∧ ∀ x y,
      Prym.prymequation a w x y ↔ y^2 = (canonicalPolynomial j).eval x := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.regular
declarations.snippet:
theorem regular (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) :
    let s := picardParameter t
    U s ≠ 0 ∧ V s ≠ 0 ∧ U s-V s ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.actual_moduli_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem actual_moduli_parameter (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) :
    let s := picardParameter t
    let u : fixedField := (s:fixedField)+ρ
    let v : fixedField := (s:fixedField)-ρ
    fixedField.val (1-(Prym.a u v)^2/(4*(Prym.cubeRoot u v)^3)) = markedValue s := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.geometricFibre
ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.geometric_fibre_iso
declarations.snippet:
theorem geometric_fibre_iso (t d : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    let g := canonicalPolynomial (markedValue (picardParameter t))
    ∃ (dg : g.natDegree = 6) (sg : g.Separable),
      Nonempty (geometricFibre t d ht hd ≅ completionJacobian g dg sg) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardCM.nonsimple_fibres
declarations.snippet:
theorem nonsimple_fibres
    (finite : {j : Qbar | j ∈ splitValues ∧ Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮j⟯ ≤ 2}.Finite) :
    ∃ T : Finset ℚ, T.card ≤ 6*finite.toFinset.card ∧
      ∀ (t d : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (hd : d ≠ 0),
        t ∈ T ↔ HasEllipticSubgroup (geometricFibre t d ht hd) := by

    (cm : FiniteSplitValues) (prym : PicardPrym.PublishedPrymEndomorphisms)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConclusion.HeightComparisons
declarations.snippet:
def HeightComparisons (hF : GroupScheme ℚ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ Qbar,

      IsogenyHeight.StableHeight F ∧ IsogenyHeight.DegreeBound F (2 * Module.finrank ℚ M) ∧
      (∀ B : GroupScheme ℚ, IsAbelianScheme B → F ((baseChange (algebraMap ℚ M)).obj B) = hF B) ∧
      PicardPeriods.SexticPeriods η F

private def conjugateIntegral (e : X ≅ Y) : End X ≃+* End Y :=

    map_add' := fun f g => by
      apply End.ext
      change e.inv ≫ (f.asHom+g.asHom) ≫ e.hom =
        (e.inv ≫ f.asHom ≫ e.hom) + (e.inv ≫ g.asHom ≫ e.hom)
      simp }

  __ := conjugateIntegral e
  commutes' n := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    change (conjugateIntegral e) (n • (1 : End X)) = n • (1 : End Y)
    rw [map_zsmul,map_one]

declarations.snippet:
private def intAlgChange {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (φ : K →+* L) (J : GroupScheme K) :
    End J →ₐ[ℤ] End ((baseChange φ).obj J) where
  __ := changeEndRing (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) J
  commutes' n := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    change (changeEndRing (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) J) (n • (1:End J)) = n • 1
    rw [map_zsmul,map_one]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugateEnd.family_quasi_isogeny
declarations.snippet:
theorem family_quasi_isogeny {L D : Type} [Field L] [CharZero L] [DivisionRing D] [Algebra ℚ D]
    (ψ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] L) (t d : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (str : D ≃ₐ[ℚ] QEnd (familyOver ψ t d ht hd))
    (i j : D) (hi : i*i = algebraMap ℚ D (-3)) (hj : j*j = algebraMap ℚ D 2)
    (skew : j*i = -(i*j)) (gen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ ({i,j} : Set D) = ⊤) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    let Y := familyOver ψ t d ht hd
    let X := (baseChange σ.toRingHom).obj Y
    ∃ (μ : QHom X Y) (ν : QHom Y X),
      comp μ ν = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 X ∧ comp ν μ = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 𝟙 Y ∧
      ∀ z : QEnd Y, comp (asHom X (change σ.toRingHom Y z)) μ = comp μ (asHom Y z) := by

ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardDescent.coordinateHom
declarations.snippet:
private def coordinateHom (u v r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) :
    CoordRing (c u v) →ₐ[K] CoordRing (c v u) :=
  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K _).comp (substitution r)) fun p hp => by
    have le : (equationsIdeal (c u v)).toIdeal ≤
        RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (equationsIdeal (c v u)).toIdeal).comp (substitution r)) := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
      change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (substitution r (quadrics (c u v) j)) = 0
      rw [substitution_quadrics _ _ _ hr]
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _))
    exact le hp

  __ := (coordinateHom u v r hr).toRingHom
  map_mem := by
    intro n x hx
    obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := (TauCeti.GradedAlgebra.mem_quotientPiece_iff _ _).mp hx
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (substitution r p) ∈ _
    apply TauCeti.GradedAlgebra.mk_mem_quotientPiece
    rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule]
    have hh : p.IsHomogeneous n := hp
    simpa only [one_mul,substitution] using hh.aeval (subVars r)
      (fun i => (isHomogeneous_X K (perm i)).C_mul (weight r i))

def jacobian (u v : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hD : u-v ≠ 0) :
    ZInQBlueprint.AbelianModel.GroupScheme K := by
  let : IsProper (projectiveStructure (c u v)) := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (projectiveStructure (c u v)) := (geometry u v hu hv hD).1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (projectiveStructure (c u v)) := (geometry u v hu hv hD).2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardDescent.jacobianIso
declarations.snippet:
def jacobianIso (u v r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hD : u-v ≠ 0) :
    jacobian u v hu hv hD ≅ jacobian v u hv hu (sub_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mp hD).symm) := by
  let hD' := sub_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mp hD).symm
  let C := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c u v))
  let D := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c v u))
  let : IsProper C.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : IsProper D.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).1
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom := (geometry v u hv hu hD').1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).2
  let : GeometricallyIntegral D.hom := (geometry v u hv hu hD').2
  let e : D ≅ C := overIso u v r hr
  let sh := (presheafToSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of K))) CommGrpCat.{1}).mapIso
    (ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.CurveMap.pullIso e)
  exact (sheafGroupSchemeIso K C.hom).symm ≪≫ SchemeTheory.RepresentedGroups.iso
    (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf C.hom).obj (ordinaryRelativePicardZeroGroupSheaf D.hom).obj
    (groupSheafRepresentation K C.hom) (groupSheafRepresentation K D.hom)
    ((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of K))) CommGrpCat.{1}).mapIso sh) ≪≫
    sheafGroupSchemeIso K D.hom

declarations.snippet:
private def coefficientBaseChange {L : Type} [Field L] [CharZero L] (φ : K ≃+* L)
    (u v : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hD : u-v ≠ 0) :
    (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))).obj
      (Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c u v))) ≅ Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c (φ u) (φ v))) := by
  have hs := PicardLocal.good_fibre_separable (by norm_num : (2:K)≠0) (by norm_num : (3:K)≠0)
    hu hv hD
  have e := projectiveBaseChange φ (PicardLocal.sextic u v) (fibre_degree u v hv) hs
  have hm : (PicardLocal.sextic u v).map φ.toRingHom = PicardLocal.sextic (φ u) (φ v) := by
    simp [PicardLocal.sextic,PicardLocal.quadratic,PicardLocal.quartic]
  rw [hm,polynomial_coefficients u v,polynomial_coefficients (φ u) (φ v)] at e
  exact e

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardDescent.jacobianBaseChange
declarations.snippet:
def jacobianBaseChange {L : Type} [Field L] [CharZero L] (φ : K ≃+* L)
    (u v : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hD : u-v ≠ 0) :
    (ZInQBlueprint.AbelianModel.baseChange φ.toRingHom).obj (jacobian u v hu hv hD) ≅
      jacobian (φ u) (φ v) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hu) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hv)
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (φ.injective.ne (sub_ne_zero.mp hD))) := by
  let : Algebra K L := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let C := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c u v))
  let D := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (c (φ u) (φ v)))
  let : IsProper C.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : IsProper D.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).2
  have gd := geometry (φ u) (φ v) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hu) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hv)
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr (φ.injective.ne (sub_ne_zero.mp hD)))
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom := gd.1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral D.hom := gd.2
  exact ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.unpointed_baseChangeIso C D (coefficientBaseChange φ u v hu hv hD)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardGoodReduction.SplitSexticDDMM
declarations.snippet:
def SplitSexticDDMM : Prop := ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 2 < p →
  ∀ (k : Subfield (Residues p)) [Finite k],
  letI := wittCharZero p k
  let S := WittVector p k
  let K := FractionRing S
  ∀ (f : S[X]) (x : Index → S),
    f.Splits → (∀ w, f.IsRoot w ↔ ∃ i, x i = w) →
    let dist := fun i j => addVal S (x i - x j)
    let P := clusterTree dist
    (∀ s ∈ P, s ≠ Finset.univ → Odd s.card) →
    (∀ s, picturePrincipal P s → Even (pictureNu P ((addVal S f.leadingCoeff).toNat : ℤ) dist s)) →
    ∀ (dg : (f.map (algebraMap S K)).natDegree = 6) (sg : (f.map (algebraMap S K)).Separable),
      GoodWitt p k (completionJacobian _ dg sg)

ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardLocalization.geometry
ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardLocalization.jacobianScalarExtension
declarations.snippet:
def jacobianScalarExtension (φ : K →+* L) (u v : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hD : u-v ≠ 0) :
    (ZInQBlueprint.AbelianModel.baseChange φ).obj (jacobian u v hu hv hD) ≅
      jacobian (φ u) (φ v) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hu) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hv)
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (φ.injective.ne (sub_ne_zero.mp hD))) := by
  let : Algebra K L := φ.toAlgebra
  let C := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (Picard.coefficients u v))
  let D := Over.mk (projectiveStructure (Picard.coefficients (φ u) (φ v)))
  let : IsProper C.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : IsProper D.hom := proper_projectiveStructure _
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral C.hom := (geometry u v hu hv hD).2
  have gd := geometry (φ u) (φ v) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hu) ((map_ne_zero_iff φ φ.injective).mpr hv)
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr (φ.injective.ne (sub_ne_zero.mp hD)))
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom := gd.1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral D.hom := gd.2
  have sep := PicardLocal.good_fibre_separable (by norm_num : (2:K)≠0) (by norm_num : (3:K)≠0) hu hv hD
  have e := projectiveScalarExtension φ (PicardLocal.sextic u v) (fibre_degree u v hv) sep
  have he : (PicardLocal.sextic u v).map φ = PicardLocal.sextic (φ u) (φ v) := by
    simp [PicardLocal.sextic,PicardLocal.quadratic,PicardLocal.quartic]
  rw [he,polynomial_coefficients u v,polynomial_coefficients (φ u) (φ v)] at e
  exact ZInQBlueprint.IntegralPicard.unpointed_baseChangeIso C D e

  let p := completion_geometry deg sep
  let : IsProper D.hom := p.1
  let : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom := p.2.1
  let : GeometricallyIntegral D.hom := p.2.2
  exact JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.groupScheme K D.hom

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardPeriods.SexticPeriods

def SexticPeriods (η : M →+* ℂ) (F : GroupScheme M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : M[X]) (df : f.natDegree = 6) (sf : f.Separable),
    ∃ (N : Type) (_ : Field N) (_ : NumberField N) (ι : N →+* ℂ) (x : Fin 16 → N)
      (Z : SiegelMatrix) (p w : ℂˣ),
      (∀ i, ι (x i) = (p:ℂ) * nulls Z i) ∧
      -120 * secondInvariant (fun i : Fin 7 => (f.map η).coeff i) =
        (w:ℂ) * h12 (nulls Z) / h10 (nulls Z) ∧
      (f.map η).discr = (w:ℂ)^5 * h10 (nulls Z) ∧
      PazukiAt (euclideanHeight x) (F (completionJacobian f df sf))

declarations.snippet:
private theorem primitive_sextic (η : M →+* ℂ) (s : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (q : M) :
    let c := 2*(e:ℂ)*(s.den:ℂ)^6
    (LocalSupport.twisted s.num s.den e q).map η =
      PicardLocal.sextic (c*(((s:ℂ)+η q)^6)) (c*(((s:ℂ)-η q)^6)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardPeriods.periods_of_twist
declarations.snippet:
private def periods_of_twist {N : Type} [Field N] {s : ℚ} {q : M} {e : ℤ}
    (η : M →+* ℂ) (hq : q^2 = -3) (he : e ≠ 0)
    {x : Fin 16 → N} {ι : N →+* ℂ} (Z : SiegelMatrix) (p w : ℂˣ)
    (coords : ∀ i, ι (x i) = (p:ℂ)*nulls Z i)
    (two : -120 * secondInvariant
      (fun i : Fin 7 => ((LocalSupport.twisted s.num s.den e q).map η).coeff i) =
      (w:ℂ) * h12 (nulls Z) / h10 (nulls Z))
    (ten : ((LocalSupport.twisted s.num s.den e q).map η).discr = (w:ℂ)^5 * h10 (nulls Z)) :
    PeriodForms s x ι := by
  let U := ((s:ℂ)+η q)^6
  let V := ((s:ℂ)-η q)^6
  let c := 2*(e:ℂ)*(s.den:ℂ)^6
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast he))
    (pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast s.den_nz))
  have hρ : (η q)^2 = -3 := by rw [← map_pow,hq,map_neg,map_ofNat]
  have hs : (s:ℂ)^2+3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h : (s^2+3 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hV : V ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul ((sixth_product (s:ℂ) _ hρ).trans_ne (pow_ne_zero _ hs))
  have poly : (LocalSupport.twisted s.num s.den e q).map η = PicardLocal.sextic (c*U) (c*V) :=
    primitive_sextic η s e q
  rw [poly, PicardDescent.polynomial_coefficients] at two
  rw [poly, discr_sextic _ _ (mul_ne_zero hc hV)] at ten
  have scale₂ : secondInvariant (coefficients (c*U) (c*V)) = c^2 * secondInvariant (coefficients U V) := by
    rw [secondInvariant_eq,secondInvariant_eq]; ring
  have scale₁₀ : discriminantValue (c*U) (c*V) = c^10*discriminantValue U V := by
    unfold discriminantValue; ring
  change -120 * secondInvariant (coefficients (c*U) (c*V)) = _ at two
  rw [scale₂] at two
  rw [scale₁₀] at ten
  let v : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 c hc
  have eff : ((w/v^2 : ℂˣ):ℂ) = (w:ℂ)/c^2 := by simp [v]
  refine ⟨η q,hρ,nulls Z,p,coords,w/v^2,?_,?_⟩ <;> rw [eff]
  · change -120*secondInvariant (coefficients U V) = ((w:ℂ)/c^2)*h12 (nulls Z)/h10 (nulls Z)
    calc
      _ = ((w:ℂ)*h12 (nulls Z)/h10 (nulls Z))/c^2 := by
        apply (eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hc)).2
        linear_combination two
      _ = _ := by ring
  · change discriminantValue U V = ((w:ℂ)/c^2)^5*h10 (nulls Z)
    field_simp [hc]
    linear_combination ten

  (((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.toAddMonoidHom).comp (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _)) -

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardSurfaceDimension.signedCokernel
declarations.snippet:
private def signedCokernel {X : Scheme.{0}} (c : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (v : X.TwoAffineOpenCover)
    (W : X.Opens) (h : W=v.U0 ⊓ v.U1) :
    (v.structureSheafSections c).H1 ≃+
      Γ(X,W) ⧸ (difference v.U0 v.U1 W (h ▸ inf_le_left) (h ▸ inf_le_right)).range := by
  subst W
  let D := difference v.U0 v.U1 (v.U0 ⊓ v.U1) inf_le_left inf_le_right
  let S := v.structureSheafSections c
  have rev (a : Γ(X,v.U0)) (b : Γ(X,v.U1)) : S.cechDiff (a,b) = -D (a,b) := by
    rw [TwoChartCech.Sections.cechDiff_apply]
    change (1 : Γ(X,v.U0 ⊓ v.U1)) * _ - _ = -(_ - _)
    rw [one_mul, neg_sub]
    rfl
  apply QuotientAddGroup.congr _ _ (AddEquiv.refl Γ(X,v.U0 ⊓ v.U1))
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-(a,b), (map_neg D (a,b)).trans (rev a b).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_,⟨-(a,b),rfl⟩,?_⟩
    change S.cechDiff (-(a,b)) = D (a,b)
    rw [map_neg,rev,neg_neg]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.WittAscent.baseChangeCompIso
declarations.snippet:
def baseChangeCompIso {R S T : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (A : GroupScheme R) :
    (baseChange (g.comp f)).obj A ≅ (baseChange g).obj ((baseChange f).obj A) := by
  let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)
  have H : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.comp f)) = b ≫ a :=
    Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom f) (CommRingCat.ofHom g)
  let e : Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.comp f))) ≅ Over.pullback a ⋙ Over.pullback b := by
    rw [H]
    exact Over.pullbackComp b a
  exact (Functor.mapCommGrpNatIso e).app A ≪≫ Functor.mapCommGrpCompIso.app A

declarations.snippet:
theorem family_reduction_after_enlargement (criterion : SplitSexticDDMM) (hp : 3 < p) (st : SerreTateAt p)
    (t : ℚ) (ht : t ∉ contactSet) (hev : ¬ Odd (padicValRat p (primitiveBranch (picardParameter t)))) :
    let s := picardParameter t
    let e : ℤ := PrimitiveTwist.twist s
    ∃ (q : PicardLocal.WittRing p) (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (m : ℕ) (D : FibreData p s.num s.den e q A m),
      let k := D.finiteModel.field
      letI : Finite k := D.finiteModel.finite
      letI := wittCharZero p k
      let S := WittVector p k
      let K := FractionRing S
      let J := familyJacobian t (e:ℚ) ht (rational_twist_nonzero s) (AlgEquiv.refl : fixedField ≃ₐ[ℚ] fixedField)
      ∃ φ : fixedField →ₐ[ℚ] K, φ ρ = algebraMap S K D.finiteModel.rho ∧
        ∀ (l : Subfield (Residues p)) [Finite l] (h : k ≤ l),
          let Jl := (baseChange ((fractionInclusion p h).comp φ.toRingHom)).obj J
  …

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.fieldTest

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.coefficient
declarations.snippet:
def coefficient (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) : fieldTest K L ⟶ fieldTest K L :=
  Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom)) (by
    change Spec.map _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ specExtension K L = 𝟙 _ ≫ specExtension K L
    rw [Category.id_comp, ←Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg Spec.map (CommRingCat.hom_ext σ.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.galoisPoint
declarations.snippet:
def galoisPoint {X : Over (Spec (.of K))} (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (p : fieldPoint L ⟶ (Over.pullback (specExtension K L)).obj X) :
    fieldPoint L ⟶ (Over.pullback (specExtension K L)).obj X :=
  equivPoints X (coefficient σ ≫ (equivPoints X).symm p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.coefficient_inv
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coefficient_inv (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    coefficient σ ≫ coefficient σ.symm = 𝟙 _ := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.galoisEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def galoisEquiv (X : Over (Spec (.of K))) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    Equiv.Perm (fieldPoint L ⟶ (Over.pullback (specExtension K L)).obj X) where
  toFun := galoisPoint σ
  invFun := galoisPoint σ.symm
  left_inv p := by
    unfold galoisPoint
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply,←Category.assoc]
    have e : coefficient σ.symm ≫ coefficient σ = 𝟙 _ := coefficient_inv σ.symm
    rw [e,Category.id_comp,Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  right_inv p := by
    unfold galoisPoint
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply,←Category.assoc,coefficient_inv,Category.id_comp,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AbelGalois.differenceBundle
declarations.snippet:
def differenceBundle (p q : SchemeHomOver t c) : Unrigidified.LineBundle c t :=
  let P := RelEffCartierDiv.ofPoint c p.1 p.2
  let Q := RelEffCartierDiv.ofPoint c q.1 q.2
  ⟨P.lineBundle ⊗ Q.idealModule,
    (RelEffCartierDiv.isInvertible_I P).isInvertible_invModule.tensor (RelEffCartierDiv.isInvertible_I Q).isInvertible_module⟩

    let Q := RelEffCartierDiv.ofPoint c (move c s p).1 (move c s p).2
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (baseChangeSnd c s)).obj P.lineBundle ≅ Q.lineBundle) ∧
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (baseChangeSnd c s)).obj P.idealModule ≅ Q.idealModule) := by

ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelMap.divisorData_of_principal
declarations.snippet:
def divisorData_of_principal {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (h : PrincipalFibres hu) :
    DivisorData hu where
  abel := weightedAbel hu
  generate := weighted_generate hu
  fibres p q := by
    let := sourceIntegral hu
    let := (baseToFunctionField (paperCurve u).hom).toAlgebra
    let N := signedModel hu
    let := N.curve
    let e := geometricDeck hu
    let P := weightedEquiv_pullback hu p
    let Q := weightedEquiv_pullback hu q
    have hp := h (normalizedPlace N P) (normalizedPlace N Q)
    rw [←normalizedPlace_action N e P,←normalizedPlace_action N e Q] at hp
    change abel hu P + abel hu (weightedEquiv_pullback hu (negY _ p)) =
      abel hu Q + abel hu (weightedEquiv_pullback hu (negY _ q))
    rw [weighted_deck hu p,weighted_deck hu q]
    exact (realization hu).sum_eq_of_principal P (P ≫ e.hom) Q (Q ≫ e.hom) hp

  let p : (base K ⟶ C) ≃ {z : Spec (.of K) ⟶ M.C // z ≫ M.toBase = 𝟙 _} :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.left ≫ i.inv,by rw [←hbase,Category.assoc,i.inv_hom_id_assoc];exact x.w⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelMap.pointsIso
declarations.snippet:
def pointsIso {V W : AbelianModel.GroupScheme K} (e : V ≅ W) :
    Additive (base K ⟶ V.X) ≃+ Additive (base K ⟶ W.X) where
  toFun a := Additive.ofMul (a.toMul ≫ e.hom.hom.hom.hom)
  invFun a := Additive.ofMul (a.toMul ≫ e.inv.hom.hom.hom)
  left_inv a := by
    have q : e.hom.hom.hom.hom ≫ e.inv.hom.hom.hom = 𝟙 V.X :=
      congrArg (fun m : V ⟶ V => m.hom.hom.hom) e.hom_inv_id
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (a.toMul ≫ ·) q).trans (Category.comp_id _))
  right_inv a := by
    have q : e.inv.hom.hom.hom ≫ e.hom.hom.hom.hom = 𝟙 W.X :=
      congrArg (fun m : W ⟶ W => m.hom.hom.hom) e.inv_hom_id
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (a.toMul ≫ ·) q).trans (Category.comp_id _))
  map_add' a b := MonObj.mul_comp a.toMul b.toMul _

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelMap.pointedPoints
declarations.snippet:
def pointedPoints :
    letI := PGroup C ε h
    Additive (base K ⟶ (groupScheme K C.hom).X) ≃+ Additive (base K ⟶ Over.mk D.toBase) := by
  letI := PGroup C ε h
  let e : (groupScheme K C.hom).X ≅ Over.mk D.toBase := (presentation K C.hom).pointedComparisonOver ε h
  refine { toFun := fun a => Additive.ofMul (a.toMul ≫ e.hom)
           invFun := fun a => Additive.ofMul (a.toMul ≫ e.inv)
           left_inv := fun a => show (a.toMul ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv = a.toMul by simp
           right_inv := fun a => show (a.toMul ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom = a.toMul by simp
           map_add' := ?_ }
  intro a b
  apply (overHomEquivSchemeHomOver (base K) D.toBase).injective
  have hm := pointedComparison_mul C.hom ε h (𝟙 (Spec (.of K)))
    (overHomEquivSchemeHomOver (base K) _ a.toMul) (overHomEquivSchemeHomOver (base K) _ b.toMul)
  have hi := (groupLaw K C.hom).overHomEquivSchemeHomOver_mul (base K) a.toMul b.toMul
  exact (congrArg (pointedComparisonPoint C.hom ε h (𝟙 (Spec (.of K)))) hi).trans hm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.restricted_differentials
declarations.snippet:
theorem restricted_differentials {F M : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra ℂ F]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module F M] [Module ℂ M] [IsScalarTower ℂ F M] [CharZero F]
    (D : Derivation ℂ F M) (p s : ℂ) (x y : F) (hx : x ≠ algebraMap ℂ F p)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    let r := algebraMap ℂ F p
    let t := algebraMap ℂ F s
    let z := (x-r)⁻¹
    let w := y/(t*(x-r)^3)
    let ω₁ := (2*y)⁻¹ • D x
    let ω₂ := (x/(2*y)) • D x
    (2*w)⁻¹ • D z = (t*r) • ω₁ + (-t) • ω₂ ∧
      (z/(2*w)) • D z = (-t) • ω₁ := by

theorem invariant_tensor {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℂ M] (x y : M)
    (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree=6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) (s : ℂ) (hs : s^2=ordinateFactor (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ) r) :
    ((2:ℂ)^8*(quintic r).discr)^2 • PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ
       (fun _ : Fin 20 => exteriorPower.ιMulti ℂ 2
         ![(s*r (Fin.last 5)) • x + (-s) • y, (-s) • x]) =
    ((2:ℂ)^8*(f.discr:ℂ))^2 • PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ
       (fun _ : Fin 20 => exteriorPower.ιMulti ℂ 2 ![x,y]) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.lockhart_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem lockhart_eq (Z : SiegelPeriod) :
    lockhart Z = 2^8 * π^20 * ‖rawChi Z‖ * (imDet Z)^5 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.metric_log
declarations.snippet:
theorem metric_log {Z : SiegelPeriod} (nz : rawChi Z ≠ 0) :
    log (lockhart Z) = 10*log π + log (peterssonFactor Z) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.quintic_open
declarations.snippet:
private theorem quintic_open {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) :
    ∃ j : SpecOver (R:=ℂ) (Cover (quintic r)) ⟶ oddCurve hr, IsOpenImmersion j.left := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.restricted_chart_every_embedding
declarations.snippet:
theorem restricted_chart_every_embedding (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    ∃ r : Fin 6 → ℂ, Function.Injective r ∧ (quintic r).Monic ∧
      (quintic r).natDegree = 5 ∧ (quintic r).Separable ∧
      (∀ i, aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u 1)=0) ∧
      ∀ σ : K →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ∃ j : SpecOver (R:=ℂ) (Cover (quintic r)) ⟶ embeddedCurve u σ,
        IsOpenImmersion j.left := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.vFive
declarations.snippet: private def vFive (u : Fin 5 → ℂ) : ℂ := ∏ i, ∏ j, if i < j then u i - u j else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.point_slope
declarations.snippet:
private theorem point_slope (z : Fin 5 → ℂ) (i : Fin 5) :
    (∏ j, (X - C (z j))).derivative.eval (z i) = ∏ j, (if i = j then 1 else z i - z j) := by
