ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.quintic_discriminant
declarations.snippet: private theorem quintic_discriminant (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : (quintic r).discr = (vFive (finiteBranches r))^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.gap
declarations.snippet: private def gap (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 5) := r i.castSucc-r (Fin.last 5)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.six_edges
declarations.snippet:
private theorem six_edges (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : vandermonde r =
    vFive (fun i => r i.castSucc) * ∏ i, gap r i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.five_edge_units
declarations.snippet:
private theorem five_edge_units (u : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (∏ i : Fin 5, ∏ j : Fin 5, if i < j then -(u i*u j) else 1) = (∏ i, u i)^4 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.inverse_edges
declarations.snippet:
private theorem inverse_edges (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r) :
    vFive (finiteBranches r) * (∏ i, gap r i)^4 = vFive (fun i => r i.castSucc) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.sextic_discriminant
declarations.snippet:
theorem sextic_discriminant (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree=6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) (s : ℂ)
    (hs : s^2 = ordinateFactor (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ) r) :
    (quintic r).discr * s^20 = (f.discr : ℂ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.rationalTerm
declarations.snippet: abbrev rationalTerm (f : ℚ[X]) (V : ℝ) := (2:ℝ)^8 * ‖(f.discr:ℂ)‖ * V^5

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.odd_covolume_invariant
declarations.snippet:
theorem odd_covolume_invariant (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree=6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) (s : ℂ)
    (hs : s^2=ordinateFactor (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ) r) (V : ℝ) :
    (2:ℝ)^8*‖(quintic r).discr‖*(‖s‖^4*V)^5 = rationalTerm f V := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.signed_covolume_invariant
declarations.snippet:
theorem signed_covolume_invariant {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (SexticThetaHeight.sextic u 1)=0)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : s^2=ordinateFactor ((paper ℚ u false).leadingCoeff : ℂ) r)
    (L L' : Submodule ℤ PeriodSpace)
    [DiscreteTopology L] [DiscreteTopology L'] [IsZLattice ℝ L] [IsZLattice ℝ L']
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℤ L) (b' : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℤ L')
    (b₀ : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℝ PeriodSpace) (μ : Measure PeriodSpace) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (transforms : ∀ i, (b' i : PeriodSpace)=realChange (r (Fin.last 5)) s (b i : PeriodSpace)) :
    (2:ℝ)^8*‖(quintic r).discr‖*(ZLattice.covolume L' μ)^5 =
      rationalTerm (paper ℚ u false) (ZLattice.covolume L μ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ArchimedeanHeight.igusa_of_rational_covolume
declarations.snippet:
def igusa_of_rational_covolume {K : Type} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {hF : AbelianModel.GroupScheme ℚ → ℝ} {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet)
    (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (localFormula : GoodLocalIgusa u I)
    (Z : SiegelPeriod) (red : InStrengDomain Z) (nz : rawChi Z ≠ 0) (V : ℝ)
    (lockhartValue : rationalTerm (paper ℚ u false) V = lockhart Z)
    (degree : (Module.finrank ℚ K:ℝ)*hF (SixJacobian.jacobian hu) =
      log (I.absNorm:ℝ)/60-(Module.finrank ℚ K:ℝ)*log (rationalTerm (paper ℚ u false) V)/10) :
    IgusaPeriod K hF hu := by
  refine ⟨Z,red,I,hI,localFormula,?_⟩
  rw [lockhartValue,metric_log nz] at degree
  linarith only [degree]

ZInQBlueprint.ThetaClass.GoodLocalIgusa
declarations.snippet:
def GoodLocalIgusa (u : ℚ) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K), (12 : 𝓞 K) ∉ v.asIdeal →
      ((normalizedFactors I).count v.asIdeal : ℤ) =
       max 0 (-WithZero.log (v.valuation K
        (((igusaJ10 (BinaryCover.paper ℚ u false) / (igusaJ2 (BinaryCover.paper ℚ u false))^5 : ℚ) : K))))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaClass.orders_of_local_igusa

theorem orders_of_local_igusa {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (localFormula : GoodLocalIgusa u I) :
    ∀ P ∈ normalizedFactors (Ideal.span {((SixContact.J u).den : 𝓞 K)}),
      2*(normalizedFactors (Ideal.span {((SixContact.J u).den : 𝓞 K)})).count P =
        (normalizedFactors I).count P := by

structure MarkedAction (u : ℚ) (A : GroupScheme ℚ) where
  embedding : realOrder →+* End ((Over.pullback (specExtension ℚ Qbar)).mapCommGrp.obj
    A)
  faithful : Function.Injective embedding
  polarized : let X := ((Over.pullback (specExtension ℚ Qbar)).mapCommGrp.obj
    A).X.left
    (X ⟶ X) → Prop
  labelled : IsSquare (-(27 * SixContact.J u + 16) / SixContact.J u) →
    let E := (embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).asHom.hom.hom.hom.left
    ∀ σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar, ∃ a, polarized a ∧
      (deck A.X.hom σ ≫ a) ≫ E =
        E ≫ deck A.X.hom σ ≫ a
  signs : SixContact.J u * (64 * SixContact.J u - 81) * (27 * SixContact.J u + 16) ≠ 0 →
    ∀ a, polarized a → a = 𝟙 _ ∨ a = (GrpObj.inv (X :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddModel.infinityChartIso
declarations.snippet:
def infinityChartIso {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} {f : ℂ[X]} (s : ℂˣ)
    (he : algEquivAevalXAddC (r (Fin.last 5)) f = C (s.val^2) * infinityChart r) :
    SpecOver (R := ℂ) (Cover (infinityChart r)) ≅ SpecOver (Cover f) :=
  specIso (squareEquiv (algEquivAevalXAddC (r (Fin.last 5))) (Units.map C.toMonoidHom s) (by simpa using he))

theorem paper_odd_completion {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) {r : Fin 6 → ℂ}
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u 1) = 0) :
    ∃ (s : ℂˣ) (he : algEquivAevalXAddC (r (Fin.last 5)) (paper ℂ u false) = C (s.val^2) * infinityChart r),
      s.val^2 = ordinateFactor ((paper ℚ u false).leadingCoeff : ℂ) r ∧
      ∃! e : oddCurve hr ≅ paperPullback ℂ u,
        chartInclusion ℂ _ _ (reverse_sextic_overlap (infinity_degree hr)) false ≫ e.hom =
          (infinityChartIso s he).hom ≫ baseChangedFiniteChart ℂ u := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem degree_linearProduct (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : (linearProduct r).natDegree = 6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.slopeProduct
declarations.snippet:
private def slopeProduct (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 6) : ℂ :=
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r i - r j)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.slope_at_root
declarations.snippet:
private theorem slope_at_root (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 6) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.slope_ne_diagonal
declarations.snippet:
private theorem slope_ne_diagonal (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 6) :
    slopeProduct r i = ∏ j, (if i = j then 1 else r i - r j) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.signed_difference
declarations.snippet:
private theorem signed_difference (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i j : Fin 6) :
    (if i = j then 1 else r i-r j) =
    (if j < i then -1 else 1) *
    ((if i < j then r i-r j else 1) * (if j < i then r j-r i else 1)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.pairSign
declarations.snippet: private def pairSign (i j : Fin 6) : ℤ := if j < i then -1 else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.sign_product
declarations.snippet:
private theorem sign_product :
    (∏ i : Fin 6, ∏ j : Fin 6, (if j < i then -1 else 1 : ℂ)) = -1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.product_slopes
declarations.snippet: theorem product_slopes (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : (∏ i, slopeProduct r i) = - (vandermonde r)^2 := by

    (f.discr : ℂ) = (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ)^10 * (vandermonde r)^2 := by

    letI := signedProper u
    letI := signedIntegral hu
    letI := signedDimension hu
    let e := IntegralPicard.paperJacobian_baseChangeIso Qbar hu (paperCurve u) (Iso.refl _)
    Pointed (basepoint hu) e (rigidMorphism hu) := by

      Nontrivial (W.sectionsOf (fibreAt C.hom J.toBase x.left)

      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.lift (𝟙 C.left) (C.hom ≫ x.left)
        (by rw [Category.id_comp,Category.assoc,show x.left ≫ J.toBase = 𝟙 (Spec (.of K)) from x.w, Category.comp_id]))).obj h.poincare.L ⊗
       (((schemePoint b).1.ker)^d).invModule)).H0 ↔ T) :

    (Y Z : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (surface : UpperHalfPlane → GroupScheme ℂ) : Prop :=

declarations.snippet:
def OrdinarySurface.toRepresentative {M : Over (Spec (.of ℚ))} {C : CoarseInterpretation M}
    {chart : Line ⟶ M} {ι : Qbar →+* ℂ} (hom : HomBaseChange ι) {p : ConicPoint}
    (w : OrdinarySurface) (hw : C.read (linePoint p.quotientCoordinate ≫ chart) = w.coarseClass) :
    PeriodRepresentative C chart ι hom p where
  surface := w.surface
  abelian := w.abelian
  theta := w.theta
  principal := w.principal
  complexOrder := w.order.trans (endBaseEquiv hom w.surface w.abelian)
  represents := by
    have h : descendedOrder hom w.surface w.abelian
        (w.order.trans (endBaseEquiv hom w.surface w.abelian)) = w.order := by
      apply RingEquiv.ext
      intro r
      exact (endBaseEquiv hom w.surface w.abelian).symm_apply_apply _
    rw [h]
    exact hw

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.evalF
declarations.snippet:
def evalF {n : ℕ} (f : Coeff K n) (x z : K) : K :=
  ∑ i : Fin (n+1), (n.choose i.val:K)*f i*x^i.val*z^(n-i.val)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.Change
declarations.snippet:
inductive Change (K : Type*) where
  | shift (h : K)
  | swap
  | diag (p q : K)
deriving Inhabited

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.xy
declarations.snippet:
def xy (g : Change K) (x z : K) : K×K :=
  match g with
  | .shift h => (x+h*z,z)
  | .swap => (z,x)
  | .diag p q => (p*x,q*z)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.det
declarations.snippet:
def det (g : Change K) : K :=
  match g with
  | .shift _ => 1
  | .swap => -1
  | .diag p q => p*q

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.act2
declarations.snippet:
def act2 (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 2) : Coeff K 2 :=
  match g with
  | .shift h => ![f 0+2*h*f 1+h^2*f 2, f 1+h*f 2, f 2]
  | .swap => ![f 2, f 1, f 0]
  | .diag p q => ![q^2*f 0, p*q*f 1, p^2*f 2]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.eval_act2
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_act2 (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 2) (x z : K) :
    evalF (act2 g f) x z=evalF f (xy g x z).1 (xy g x z).2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.act4
declarations.snippet:
def act4 (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 4) : Coeff K 4 :=
  match g with
  | .shift h => ![f 0+4*h*f 1+6*h^2*f 2+4*h^3*f 3+h^4*f 4, f 1+3*h*f 2+3*h^2*f 3+h^3*f 4, f 2+2*h*f 3+h^2*f 4, f 3+h*f 4, f 4]
  | .swap => ![f 4, f 3, f 2, f 1, f 0]
  | .diag p q => ![q^4*f 0, p*q^3*f 1, p^2*q^2*f 2, p^3*q*f 3, p^4*f 4]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.eval_act4
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_act4 (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 4) (x z : K) :
    evalF (act4 g f) x z=evalF f (xy g x z).1 (xy g x z).2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.eval_act6
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_act6 (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) (x z : K) :
    evalF (act6 g f) x z=evalF f (xy g x z).1 (xy g x z).2 := by

def geometricPointEquiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :
    JacobianPoints hu ≃ Point (geometricJacobian hu).X.hom where
  toFun p := ⟨p.toMul.left, Over.w p.toMul⟩
  invFun p := Additive.ofMul (Over.homMk p.val p.property)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

structure DivisorData {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) where
  abel : FibrePoints u → JacobianPoints hu
  generate : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun r : FibrePoints u × FibrePoints u =>
    abel r.1-abel r.2))=⊤
  fibres : ∀ p q, abel p+abel (negY (paperForm u (δ u)) p)=
    abel q+abel (negY (paperForm u (δ u)) q)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.GeometricMarking.DivisorData.comparison

    PicardComparison hu (JacobianPoints hu) where
  abel := D.abel
  generate := D.generate
  fibres := D.fibres
  point := geometricPointEquiv hu
  inversion _ := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.GeometricMarking.groupAction
declarations.snippet:
def groupAction {u : ℚ} {hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet} (a : geometricJacobian hu ≅ geometricJacobian hu) :
    JacobianPoints hu →+ JacobianPoints hu where
  toFun p := Additive.ofMul (p.toMul ≫ a.hom.hom.hom.hom)
  map_zero' := by
    change (1 : basePoint ⟶ (geometricJacobian hu).X) ≫ a.hom.hom.hom.hom=1
    exact MonObj.one_comp _
  map_add' p q := by
    change (p.toMul*q.toMul) ≫ a.hom.hom.hom.hom=_
    exact MonObj.mul_comp p.toMul q.toMul _

  ∀ a, preserves a → ∃ t : Lift u (δ u), ∀ p q,
    groupAction a (D.abel p-D.abel q)=D.abel (t.action p)-D.abel (t.action q)

    (G : Type w) [AddCommGroup G] where
  abel : P → G
  generate : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun r : P × P => abel r.1-abel r.2))=⊤
  fibres : ∀ p q, abel p+abel (ι p)=abel q+abel (ι q)

  inversion : ∀ g, (point g).val ≫ inv=(point (-g)).val

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedPicard.Comparison.represents

    (D : Comparison s inv P ι G) (a : X ⟶ X) (f : G →+ G) : Prop :=
  a ≫ s=s ∧ ∀ g, (D.point g).val ≫ a=(D.point (f g)).val

    (D : PicardComparison hu G) (polarized : SchemeEnd hu → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, polarized a → ∃ f : G →+ G, D.represents a f ∧ ∃ t : Lift u (δ u),
    ∀ p q, f (D.abel p-D.abel q)=D.abel (t.action p)-D.abel (t.action q)

def Labelled {u : ℚ} {hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet}
    (embedding : realOrder →+* End (geometricJacobian hu))
    (polarized : SchemeEnd hu → Prop) : Prop :=
  IsSquare (-(27*SixContact.J u+16)/SixContact.J u) →
    let E := (embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).asHom.hom.hom.hom.left
    ∀ σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar, ∃ a, polarized a ∧
      (deck (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X.hom σ ≫ a) ≫ E =
        E ≫ deck (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X.hom σ ≫ a

def markedAction {u : ℚ} {hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet} {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (D : PicardComparison hu G) (polarized : SchemeEnd hu → Prop)
    (T : TorelliOnDifferences D polarized)
    (embedding : realOrder →+* End (geometricJacobian hu)) (injective : Function.Injective embedding)
    (labelled : Labelled embedding polarized) : MarkedAction u (SixJacobian.jacobian hu) where
  embedding := embedding
  faithful := injective
  polarized := polarized
  labelled := labelled
  signs := fun _ a ha => polarized_signs D T a ha

declarations.snippet:
theorem rationalRM {u : ℚ} {hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet} {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (D : PicardComparison hu G) (polarized : SchemeEnd hu → Prop)
    (T : TorelliOnDifferences D polarized)
    (embedding : realOrder →+* End (geometricJacobian hu)) (injective : Function.Injective embedding)
    (labelled : Labelled embedding polarized) : RationalRM (SixJacobian.jacobian hu) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paperForm
declarations.snippet: def paperForm (u : ℚ) (δ : K) (p : K×K) := δ*evalAt p (paperSextic u)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paperScale
declarations.snippet:
def paperScale (u : ℚ) (δ : K) :=
  δ*(yScale u:K)^2*(-6)*(homogeneousG u:K)*(left u:K)^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paper_formula
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_formula {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (δ x z : K) :
    paperForm u δ (x,z)=paperScale u δ * form 1 (parameter u:K) x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paperScale_ne
declarations.snippet:
theorem paperScale_ne {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) {δ : K} (hd : δ≠0) :
    paperScale u δ≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paper_stabilizer
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_stabilizer [Infinite K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) {δ : K} (hd : δ≠0)
    {a b c d μ : K} (hM : a*d-b*c≠0)
    (act : ∀ x z, paperForm u δ (a*x+b*z,c*x+d*z)=μ*paperForm u δ (x,z)) :
    b=0 ∧ c=0 ∧ a=d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.paper_matrix_signs
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_matrix_signs [Infinite K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) {δ : K} (hd : δ≠0)
    {a b c d e : K} (hM : a*d-b*c≠0)
    (act : ∀ x z, paperForm u δ (a*x+b*z,c*x+d*z) = e^2*paperForm u δ (x,z)) :
    b=0 ∧ c=0 ∧ a=d ∧ a≠0 ∧ (e=a^3 ∨ e= -a^3) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.identityLift
declarations.snippet:
def identityLift (u : ℚ) (δ : K) : Lift u δ :=
  ⟨LinearEquiv.refl K _,1,fun p => by simp⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.hyperellipticLift
declarations.snippet:
def hyperellipticLift (u : ℚ) (δ : K) : Lift u δ :=
  ⟨LinearEquiv.refl K _, -1,fun p => by simp⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.identityLift_action
declarations.snippet:
theorem identityLift_action (u : ℚ) (δ : K) :
    (identityLift u δ).action=Equiv.refl _ := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.hyperellipticLift_action
declarations.snippet:
theorem hyperellipticLift_action (u : ℚ) (δ : K) :
    (hyperellipticLift u δ).action=negY (paperForm u δ) := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.opposite_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem opposite_differences {P G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (i : P → P) (j : P → G)
    (fibres : ∀ p q, j p+j (i p)=j q+j (i q)) (p q : P) :
    j (i p)-j (i q)= -(j p-j q) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.picard_action_sign
declarations.snippet:
theorem picard_action_sign [Infinite K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet)
    {δ : K} (hd : δ≠0) {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (j : Points (paperForm u δ) → G)
    (gen : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun p : Points (paperForm u δ) ×
        Points (paperForm u δ) => j p.1-j p.2))=⊤)
    (fibres : ∀ p q, j p+j (negY (paperForm u δ) p)=j q+j (negY (paperForm u δ) q))
    (f : G →+ G) (t : Lift u δ)
    (act : ∀ p q, f (j p-j q)=j (t.action p)-j (t.action q)) :
    f=AddMonoidHom.id G ∨ f= -(AddMonoidHom.id G) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.factor_matrix
declarations.snippet:
theorem factor_matrix {a b c d : K} (hn : a*d-b*c≠0) :
    ∃ w : Word K, delta w=a*d-b*c ∧
      ∀ x z, point w x z=(a*x+b*z,c*x+d*z) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.veronese
declarations.snippet: def veronese (x z : K) : Fin 3 → K := ![z^2,2*x*z,x^2]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.dot_eval
declarations.snippet:
private theorem dot_eval (q : Coeff K 2) (x z : K) :
    q ⬝ᵥ veronese x z=evalF q x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.trivial_stabilizer
declarations.snippet:
theorem trivial_stabilizer [CharZero K] [Infinite K] (f : Coeff K 6)
    (hf : (Matrix.det (rows f : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K))≠0)
    {a b c d μ : K} (hM : a*d-b*c≠0)
    (action : ∀ x z, evalF f (a*x+b*z) (c*x+d*z)=μ*evalF f x z) :
    b=0 ∧ c=0 ∧ a=d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.scale
declarations.snippet: def scale {n : ℕ} (a : K) (f : Coeff K n) : Coeff K n := fun i => a*f i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.invariant
declarations.snippet:
def invariant (f : Coeff K 6) : K :=
  f 0*f 6 - 6*f 1*f 5 + 15*f 2*f 4 - 20*f 3*f 3 + 15*f 4*f 2 - 6*f 5*f 1 + f 6*f 0

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.contract42
declarations.snippet:
def contract42 (v : Coeff K 4) (q : Coeff K 2) : Coeff K 2 :=
  ![v 0*q 2 - 2*v 1*q 1 + v 2*q 0,
    v 1*q 2 - 2*v 2*q 1 + v 3*q 0,
    v 2*q 2 - 2*v 3*q 1 + v 4*q 0]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.quartic_cov
declarations.snippet:
theorem quartic_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) :
    quartic (act6 g f)=scale ((det g)^4) (act4 g (quartic f)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.invariant_cov
declarations.snippet:
theorem invariant_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) :
    invariant (act6 g f)=(det g)^6*invariant f := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.contract64_cov
declarations.snippet:
theorem contract64_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) (v : Coeff K 4) :
    contract64 (act6 g f) (act4 g v)=scale ((det g)^4) (act2 g (contract64 f v)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.contract42_cov
declarations.snippet:
theorem contract42_cov (g : Change K) (v : Coeff K 4) (q : Coeff K 2) :
    contract42 (act4 g v) (act2 g q)=scale ((det g)^2) (act2 g (contract42 v q)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.quartic_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem quartic_scale (a : K) (f : Coeff K 6) :
    quartic (scale a f)=scale (a^2) (quartic f) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.invariant_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem invariant_scale (a : K) (f : Coeff K 6) :
    invariant (scale a f)=a^2*invariant f := by dsimp [invariant,scale]; ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.contract64_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem contract64_scale (a b : K) (f : Coeff K 6) (v : Coeff K 4) :
    contract64 (scale a f) (scale b v)=scale (a*b) (contract64 f v) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.contract42_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem contract42_scale (a b : K) (v : Coeff K 4) (q : Coeff K 2) :
    contract42 (scale a v) (scale b q)=scale (a*b) (contract42 v q) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.Lift
declarations.snippet:
structure Lift (u : ℚ) (δ : K) where
  lin : (K×K) ≃ₗ[K] (K×K)
  unitY : Kˣ
  equation : ∀ p, paperForm u δ (lin p)=(unitY:K)^2*paperForm u δ p

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.Lift.action
declarations.snippet:
def Lift.action {u : ℚ} {δ : K} (t : Lift u δ) : Equiv.Perm (Points (paperForm u δ)) :=
  coordinateEquiv t.lin t.unitY t.equation

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.negY
declarations.snippet:
def negY (F : K×K → K) : Equiv.Perm (Points F) :=
  coordinateEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl K _) (-1 : Kˣ) (fun p => by simp)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.base_matrix
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_matrix (g : (K×K) ≃ₗ[K] (K×K)) :
    ∃ a b c d : K, a*d-b*c≠0 ∧ ∀ x z, g (x,z)=(a*x+b*z,c*x+d*z) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.lift_action_sign
declarations.snippet:
theorem lift_action_sign [Infinite K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) {δ : K} (hd : δ≠0)
    (t : Lift u δ) : t.action=Equiv.refl _ ∨ t.action=negY (paperForm u δ) := by

declarations.snippet:

  lin : (K×K) ≃ₗ[K] (K×K)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.Lift.unitY
declarations.snippet:
structure Lift where

declarations.snippet: def q₁ (f : Coeff K 6)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.q₂

declarations.snippet: def q₃ (f : Coeff K 6)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.rows
declarations.snippet:
def rows (f : Coeff K 6) : Fin 3 → Coeff K 2 :=
  ![scale ((invariant f)^2) (q₁ f),scale (invariant f) (q₂ f),q₃ f]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.scale_comp
declarations.snippet: theorem scale_comp {n : ℕ} (a b : K) (f : Coeff K n) : scale a (scale b f)=scale (a*b) f := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.scale_one'
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem scale_one' {n : ℕ} (f : Coeff K n) : scale 1 f=f := by funext i; simp [scale]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.scale_eq
declarations.snippet: theorem scale_eq {n : ℕ} {a b:K} (h:a=b) (f:Coeff K n) : scale a f=scale b f := by rw [h]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.act2_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem act2_scale (g : Change K) (c : K) (q : Coeff K 2) :
    act2 g (scale c q)=scale c (act2 g q) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.eval_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_scale {n : ℕ} (c : K) (f : Coeff K n) (x z : K) :
    evalF (scale c f) x z=c*evalF f x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.q₁_cov
declarations.snippet: private theorem q₁_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) : q₁ (act6 g f)=scale ((det g)^8) (act2 g (q₁ f))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.q₂_cov
declarations.snippet: private theorem q₂_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) : q₂ (act6 g f)=scale ((det g)^14) (act2 g (q₂ f))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.q₃_cov
declarations.snippet: private theorem q₃_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) : q₃ (act6 g f)=scale ((det g)^20) (act2 g (q₃ f))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.rows_cov
declarations.snippet:
theorem rows_cov (g : Change K) (f : Coeff K 6) (i:Fin 3) :
    rows (act6 g f) i=scale ((det g)^20) (act2 g (rows f i)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.rows_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem rows_scale (c : K) (f : Coeff K 6) (i:Fin 3) :
    rows (scale c f) i=scale (c^7) (rows f i) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.Word
declarations.snippet:
inductive Word (K : Type*) where
  | one
  | comp (g : Change K) (rest : Word K)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.point
declarations.snippet:
def point : Word K → K → K → K×K
  | .one,x,z => (x,z)
  | .comp g w,x,z => let b:=xy g x z; point w b.1 b.2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.delta
declarations.snippet:
def delta : Word K → K
  | .one => 1
  | .comp g w => det g*delta w

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.sexticAction
declarations.snippet:
def sexticAction : Word K → Coeff K 6 → Coeff K 6
  | .one,f => f
  | .comp g w,f => act6 g (sexticAction w f)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.sextic_action_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem sextic_action_eval (w : Word K) (f : Coeff K 6) (x z : K) :
    evalF (sexticAction w f) x z=evalF f (point w x z).1 (point w x z).2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.row_action_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem row_action_eval (w : Word K) (f : Coeff K 6) (i:Fin 3) (x z:K) :
    evalF (rows (sexticAction w f) i) x z=
      (delta w)^20 * evalF (rows f i) (point w x z).1 (point w x z).2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedForm.q
declarations.snippet: def q₁ (f : Coeff K 6) := contract64 f (quartic f)

declarations.name: SixContactFour.fixedBranch
declarations.snippet: def fixedBranch : Index := (0,0)

declarations.name: SixContactFour.other_neq
declarations.snippet: private theorem other_neq (i : Fin 5) : fixedBranch ≠ others i := by fin_cases i <;> decide

declarations.name: SixContactFour.others_inj
declarations.snippet: private theorem others_inj : Function.Injective others := by decide

declarations.name: SixContactFour.withinCount
SixContactFour.withinCount_val
declarations.snippet:
private theorem withinCount_val (i j : Fin 5) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    withinCount i j=1 ∨ withinCount i j=3 := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.valuation_prod
declarations.snippet:
private theorem valuation_prod {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    (t : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 5 → S) :
    addVal S (∏ i ∈ t, f i) = ∑ i ∈ t, addVal S (f i) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.oddRoot_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem oddRoot_order {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    (r : Index → S) (c : S) (lead d : ℕ) (hc : addVal S c=(lead:ℕ∞))
    (dist : ∀ i j : Index, i ≠ j → addVal S (r i-r j) =
      ((if i.1=j.1 then d else 0 : ℕ):ℕ∞))
    (i j : Fin 5) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    addVal S (oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) i-oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) j) =
      ((lead+withinCount i j*d : ℕ):ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.all_even
declarations.snippet:
theorem all_even {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    (r : Index → S) (c : S) (lead d : ℕ) (hc : addVal S c=(lead:ℕ∞))
    (dist : ∀ i j : Index, i ≠ j → addVal S (r i-r j) =
      ((if i.1=j.1 then d else 0 : ℕ):ℕ∞))
    (parity : Even (lead+d)) (i j : Fin 5) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, addVal S (oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) i -
      oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) j)=((2*e:ℕ):ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.ordinary_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_differences {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    (r : Index → S) (c : S) (hc : IsUnit c)
    (separate : ∀ i j : Index, i ≠ j → IsUnit (r i-r j)) (i j : Fin 5) (ij : i ≠ j) :
    addVal S (oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) i - oddRoot c (r fixedBranch) (r ∘ others) j)=0 := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.square_times_unit
declarations.snippet:
theorem square_times_unit {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    {x π : S} (hp : Irreducible π) {e : ℕ} (h : addVal S x=((2*e:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ a : Sˣ, x = (π^e)^2*(a:S) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.branchScale
declarations.snippet: def branchScale (c b : R) (r : Fin 5 → R) : R := c*∏ i, (b-r i)

declarations.name: SixContactFour.oddRoot
declarations.snippet:
def oddRoot (c b : R) (r : Fin 5 → R) (i : Fin 5) : R :=
  -c*∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, (b-r k)

declarations.name: SixContactFour.branchScale_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem branchScale_eq (c b : R) (r : Fin 5 → R) (i : Fin 5) :
    branchScale c b r = -(b-r i)*oddRoot c b r i := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.oddRoot_sub
declarations.snippet:
theorem oddRoot_sub (c b : R) (r : Fin 5 → R) (i j : Fin 5) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    oddRoot c b r i-oddRoot c b r j =
      -c*(r i-r j)*∏ k ∈ (univ.erase i).erase j, (b-r k) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.monic_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_product (c b : K) (r : Fin 5 → K) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ r i) :
    ∏ i, (-oddRoot c b r i) = c*(branchScale c b r)^4 := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.monic_quintic
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_quintic (c b : K) (r : Fin 5 → K) {x y : K}
    (hx : x ≠ b) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ r i)
    (he : y^2=c*(x-b)*∏ i, (x-r i)) :
    (y/(x-b)^3*(branchScale c b r)^2)^2 =
      ∏ i, (branchScale c b r/(x-b)-oddRoot c b r i) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.transformed
declarations.snippet:
def transformed {f : W[X]} {s : W} (T : SexticFibre f s) (c : W) (i : Fin 5) : W :=
  oddRoot c (point T fixedBranch) (point T ∘ others) i

declarations.name: SixContactFour.etale_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem etale_square {R : Type} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (two : IsUnit (2:R)) {π x : R} (hπ : Irreducible π)
    {n : ℕ} (h : addVal R x=((2*n:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, Module.Finite R (Cover (u:R)) ∧ Algebra.Etale R (Cover (u:R)) ∧
      ∃ z : Cover (u:R), z^2=algebraMap R (Cover (u:R)) x := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.chart_radicals
declarations.snippet:
private theorem chart_radicals {u : ℚ} {v a : Zpˣ} {t : Zp} {k l : ℕ}
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^k))
    (hc : addVal W (equation p u v a t).leadingCoeff=(l:ℕ∞))
    (he : Even (l+k)) (i j : Fin 5) (ij : i ≠ j) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, addVal W (transformed p T (equation p u v a t).leadingCoeff i -
      transformed p T (equation p u v a t).leadingCoeff j)=((2*n:ℕ):ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.chartDifferences
declarations.snippet:
def chartDifferences {f : W[X]} {s : W} (T : SexticFibre f s) (c : W) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Fin 5, i ≠ j → ∃ n : ℕ, addVal W (transformed p T c i-transformed p T c j)=((2*n:ℕ):ℕ∞)

declarations.name: SixContactFour.even_contact_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_contact_differences (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (hf : addVal Zp (F p u)=((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^k),
        chartDifferences p T (equation p u v a t).leadingCoeff := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.pole_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_differences (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0<g)
    (hG : addVal Zp (G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p (t:Zp))) ((p:W)^g),
        chartDifferences p T (equation p u 1 a t).leadingCoeff := by

declarations.name: SixContactFour.branchScale_ne_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem branchScale_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] {c b : K} {r : Fin 5 → K}
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ r i) : branchScale c b r ≠ 0 :=

declarations.name: SixContactFour.affineMovingEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def affineMovingEquiv {K : Type*} [Field K] (c b : K) (r : Fin 5 → K)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hb : ∀ i, b ≠ r i) :
    {P : K×K // P.1 ≠ b ∧ P.2^2=c*(P.1-b)*∏ i, (P.1-r i)} ≃
    {P : K×K // P.1 ≠ 0 ∧ P.2^2=∏ i, (P.1-oddRoot c b r i)} := by
  let D := branchScale c b r
  have dn : D ≠ 0 := branchScale_ne_zero hc hb
  let toPoint (x y : K) := (D/(x-b),y/(x-b)^3*D^2)
  let fromPoint (z w : K) := (b+D/z,w*D/z^3)
  have forward (x y : K) (h : x ≠ b) :
      (toPoint x y).2^2 = ∏ i, ((toPoint x y).1-oddRoot c b r i) ↔
        y^2=c*(x-b)*∏ i, (x-r i) := by
    constructor
    · intro H
      have nz := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
      have factor (i : Fin 5) :
          D/(x-b)-oddRoot c b r i = (-oddRoot c b r i)*(x-r i)/(x-b) := by
        dsimp only [D]
        rw [branchScale_eq c b r i]
        field_simp
        ring
      have scaleProd := monic_product c b r hb
      dsimp only [toPoint] at H
      simp_rw [factor] at H
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib,Finset.prod_mul_distrib,scaleProd] at H
      simp only [Finset.prod_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] at H
      change (y/(x-b)^3*D^2)^2 = c*D^4*(∏ i, (x-r i))/(x-b)^5 at H
      field_simp [nz] at H
      simpa only [mul_comm c (x-b)] using H
    · exact fun hE => monic_quintic c b r h hb hE
  have inv1 (x y : K) (hx : x ≠ b) :
      fromPoint (toPoint x y).1 (toPoint x y).2=(x,y) := by
    have nz := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx
    dsimp [toPoint,fromPoint]
    apply Prod.ext <;> field_simp [dn,nz] ; ring
  have inv2 (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
      toPoint (fromPoint z w).1 (fromPoint z w).2=(z,w) := by
    dsimp [toPoint,fromPoint]
    apply Prod.ext <;> field_simp [dn,hz] <;> ring
  have back (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (he : w^2=∏ i, (z-oddRoot c b r i)) :
      (fromPoint z w).1 ≠ b ∧ (fromPoint z w).2^2 = c*((fromPoint z w).1-b)*∏ i, ((fromPoint z w).1-r i) := by
    have e : (fromPoint z w).1 ≠ b := by
      dsimp [fromPoint]
      exact fun eq => div_ne_zero dn hz (by linear_combination eq)
    refine ⟨e,(forward _ _ e).mp ?_⟩
    simpa only [inv2 _ _ hz] using he
  exact { toFun := fun P => ⟨toPoint P.1.1 P.1.2,div_ne_zero dn (sub_ne_zero.mpr P.2.1),
    (forward _ _ P.2.1).mpr P.2.2⟩,
          invFun := fun P => ⟨fromPoint P.1.1 P.1.2,back _ _ P.2.1 P.2.2⟩,
          left_inv := fun P => Subtype.ext (inv1 _ _ P.2.1),
          right_inv := fun P => Subtype.ext (inv2 _ _ P.2.1) }

    let v := vHalf (C a) (C b) (C c) (C d) t

        firstSymm a b c d*(a*b*c*d) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantAutoduality.sliceIso
declarations.snippet:
private def sliceIso {k : Type} [Field k] {X C : Scheme} (x : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (L : (pullback c x).Modules) (p : SchemeHomOver (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) c) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (baseChangeSnd x p)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackSymmetry x c).hom).obj L) ≅
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst x (𝟙 _))).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (rigSection c x p)).obj L) := by
  have w : baseChangeSnd x p ≫ (pullbackSymmetry x c).hom =
      pullback.fst x (𝟙 _) ≫ rigSection c x p := by
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc,pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst,baseChangeSnd,rigSection,
        pullback.map,pullback.lift_snd,pullback.lift_fst]
      rw [←Category.assoc,pullback.condition,Category.comp_id]
    · simp only [Category.assoc,pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd,baseChangeSnd,rigSection,
        pullback.map,pullback.lift_fst,pullback.lift_snd,Category.comp_id]
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp _ _).app L ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr w).app L ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp _ _).app L).symm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantAutoduality.picardZero
declarations.snippet:
def picardZero {k : Type} [Field k] {X : Scheme} (x : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) :
    AddSubgroup (Additive (PicUnits X)) where
  carrier := {c | ∃ (L : X.Modules) (hL : L.IsInvertible), IsAlgEquivZero x L ∧ c = Additive.ofMul (lineClass L hL)}
  zero_mem' := by
    obtain ⟨N,hN,hn,⟨iso⟩⟩ := ThetaClass.SameClass.refl x (𝟙_ X.Modules)
    refine ⟨N,hN,hn,?_⟩
    change (1 : PicUnits X) = lineClass N hN
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.val_one,lineClass_val,Skeleton.one_eq]
    exact toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff.mpr ⟨iso.symm ≪≫ λ_ N⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨L,hL,h,rfl⟩ ⟨M,hM,k,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨L ⊗ M,hL.tensor hM,h.tensor k,congrArg Additive.ofMul (lineClass_tensor hL hM).symm⟩
  neg_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨L,hL,h,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨N,hN,⟨z⟩⟩ := hL.exists_tensor_inverse
    refine ⟨N,hN,h.of_tensor_iso_unit z,?_⟩
    change (lineClass L hL)⁻¹ = lineClass N hN
    apply inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one.mpr
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.val_one,Units.val_mul,lineClass_val,lineClass_val,←Skeleton.toSkeleton_tensorObj,Skeleton.one_eq]
    exact toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff.mpr ⟨z⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantAutoduality.lineClass
declarations.snippet:
def lineClass {X : Scheme.{0}} (L : X.Modules) (hL : L.IsInvertible) : PicUnits X := by
  let V := hL.exists_tensor_inverse.choose
  let e := hL.exists_tensor_inverse.choose_spec.2.some
  exact ⟨toSkeleton L,toSkeleton V,
    (Skeleton.toSkeleton_tensorObj L V).symm.trans ((toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff.mpr ⟨e⟩).trans Skeleton.one_eq.symm),
    (mul_comm _ _).trans ((Skeleton.toSkeleton_tensorObj L V).symm.trans
      ((toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff.mpr ⟨e⟩).trans Skeleton.one_eq.symm))⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantAutoduality.polarization
declarations.snippet:
def polarization (hA : IsAbelianScheme A) (L : A.X.left.Modules) (hL : L.IsInvertible) :
    sections A →+ Additive (PicUnits A.X.left) where
  toFun x := Additive.ofMul (translatedClass L hL x / lineClass L hL)
  map_zero' := by
    change translatedClass L hL 0 / lineClass L hL = 1
    apply (div_eq_one).mpr
    apply (lineClass_eq _ _).mpr
    unfold translated
    rw [translation_zero]
    exact ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app L⟩
  map_add' x y := by
    have e := (lineClass_eq ((hL.pullback (translation x).hom.left).tensor (hL.pullback (translation y).hom.left))
      ((hL.pullback (translation (x+y)).hom.left).tensor hL)).mpr (square hA L hL x y)
    rw [lineClass_tensor,lineClass_tensor] at e
    change translatedClass L hL (x+y) / lineClass L hL =
      (translatedClass L hL x / lineClass L hL) * (translatedClass L hL y / lineClass L hL)
    change translatedClass L hL x * translatedClass L hL y =
      translatedClass L hL (x+y) * lineClass L hL at e
    rw [div_mul_div_comm,e]
    exact (mul_div_mul_right_eq_div _ _ _).symm

def graphEffectiveCartierDivisor
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] (g : Y ⟶ S)
    (a : Y ⟶ X) (ha : a ≫ f = g) :
    Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor (pullback f g) := by
  have : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (C := Scheme.{u}) (fun {_ _} h => SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 h) :=
    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange (n := 1)
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd f g) :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := fun {_ _ : Scheme.{u}} h => SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 h)
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) inferInstance
  exact ⟨(graphOver f a ha).ker,
    (Scheme.Hom.isInvertible_ker_of_comp_eq_id
      (graphOver f a ha) (graphOver_snd f a ha)).isEffectiveCartier⟩

def CanonicalPartner (q : CurvePoints u) : Prop :=
  letI := sourceIntegral hu
  letI := (baseToFunctionField (paperCurve u).hom).toAlgebra
  let N := signedModel hu
  letI := N.curve
  letI := paper_essentially_finite hu
  let F := (paperCurve u).left.functionField
  letI : HasCanonicalDivisor (K:=Qbar) (F:=F) := hasCanonicalDivisor_of_isCurveOver
  let b := normalizedPlace N (basepoint hu)
  ∃ (ω : Ω[F⁄Qbar]) (hω : ω ≠ 0), Divisor.IsPrincipal
    (Finsupp.single (normalizedPlace N q) 1 - (canonicalDivisorOf hω - Finsupp.single b 1))

    overSections X L →ₗ[Qbar] overSections X M where
  toFun := fun x => j.app ⊤ x
  map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
  map_smul' := fun a x => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul j

def external (u : ℚ) (L M : (paperCurve u).left.Modules) : (curveSquare u).left.Modules :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantSections.externalSections
declarations.snippet:
def externalSections (L M : (paperCurve u).left.Modules) :
    (overSections (paperCurve u) L ⊗[Qbar] overSections (paperCurve u) M) →ₗ[Qbar]
      overSections (curveSquare u) (external u L M) := by
  let a := sectionsPull (first u) L
  let b := sectionsPull (second u) M
  let S := (curveSquare u).left
  let act := (Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.algebraOfHom (curveSquare u).hom ⊤).algebraMap
  apply TensorProduct.lift
  refine LinearMap.mk₂ Qbar (fun x y => Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (a x) (b y)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro x y z; rw [map_add,Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_add_left]
  · intro r x y; rw [map_smul]
    exact Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_smul_left (act r) (a x) (b y)
  · intro x y z; rw [map_add,Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_add_right]
  · intro r x y; rw [map_smul]
    exact Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_smul_right (act r) (a x) (b y)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DeterminantSections.sectionsPull
declarations.snippet:
def sectionsPull (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.left.Modules) :
    letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.moduleSectionsOfHom X.hom L ⊤
    letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.moduleSectionsOfHom Y.hom ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f.left).obj L) ⊤
    Γ(L,⊤) →ₗ[k] Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f.left).obj L,⊤) := by
  let η := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f.left).unit.app L
  letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.algebraOfHom X.hom ⊤
  letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.algebraOfHom Y.hom ⊤
  letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.moduleSectionsOfHom X.hom L ⊤
  letI := Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.moduleSectionsOfHom Y.hom ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f.left).obj L) ⊤
  refine { toFun := fun x => η.app ⊤ x, map_add' := fun _ _ => map_add _ _ _, map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro r x
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f.left).obj L
  change η.app ⊤ ((algebraMap k Γ(X.left,⊤) r) • x) = ringAction M (algebraMap k Γ(Y.left,⊤) r) (η.app ⊤ x)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  change ringAction M (f.left.app ⊤ (algebraMap k Γ(X.left,⊤) r)) (η.app ⊤ x) =
    ringAction M (algebraMap k Γ(Y.left,⊤) r) (η.app ⊤ x)
  apply congrArg (fun a => ringAction M a (η.app ⊤ x))
  rw [Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.algebraMap_algebraOfHom,Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.algebraMap_algebraOfHom,←f.w]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  change (X.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top ≫ f.left.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_rfl) _ = _
  erw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.IntegralOrder.adj
declarations.snippet:
private def adj (f : B →ₐ[ℚ] D) (u : Bˣ) : D →ₐ[ℚ] D where
  toFun x := f (u:B)*x*f (↑u⁻¹:B)
  map_zero' := by simp
  map_one' := by simp [←map_mul]
  map_add' x y := by simp [mul_add,add_mul]
  map_mul' x y := by
    have h : f (↑u⁻¹:B)*f (u:B) = 1 := by rw [←map_mul,Units.inv_mul,map_one]
    change f (u:B)*(x*y)*f (↑u⁻¹:B) = _
    calc
      _ = f (u:B)*(x*(f (↑u⁻¹:B)*f (u:B))*y)*f (↑u⁻¹:B) := by rw [h,mul_one]
      _ = _ := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  commutes' t := by
    change f (u:B)*algebraMap ℚ D t*f (↑u⁻¹:B) = _
    rw [←Algebra.commutes t (f (u:B)),mul_assoc,←map_mul,Units.mul_inv,map_one,mul_one]

ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.IntegralOrder.commutingWith
declarations.snippet:
private def commutingWith (x : D) : Subalgebra ℚ D where
  carrier := {y | x*y=y*x}
  add_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    change x*a=a*x at ha
    change x*b=b*x at hb
    change x*(a+b)=(a+b)*x
    rw [mul_add,add_mul,ha,hb]
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    change x*a=a*x at ha
    change x*b=b*x at hb
    change x*(a*b)=(a*b)*x
    rw [←mul_assoc,ha,mul_assoc,hb,mul_assoc]
  algebraMap_mem' a := (Algebra.commutes a x).symm

ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.IntegralOrder.fullActionOfScalarCenter
declarations.snippet:
def fullActionOfScalarCenter (a : O →+* E) (incl : E →+* D)
    (faithful : Function.Injective incl)
    (comm : commutingQuaternionCentralizer (extendRationalAction (incl.comp a)))
    (center : ∀ x : D, (∀ y : D, x*y=y*x) → ∃ r : ℚ, x = algebraMap ℚ D r) :
    O ≃+* E := by
  let f := extendRationalAction (incl.comp a)
  have surj := rational_action_surjective_of_scalar_center f comm center
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨rational_action_injective f,surj⟩
  exact fullAction a (e.symm.toRingHom.comp incl) (e.symm.injective.comp faithful) (fun x =>
    (congrArg e.symm (extendRationalAction_embed (incl.comp a) x).symm).trans
      (e.symm_apply_apply (embed x)))

    (faithful : Function.Injective incl)

    (center : ∀ x : D, (∀ y : D, x*y=y*x) → ∃ r : ℚ, x = algebraMap ℚ D r)
    (x : O) : fullActionOfScalarCenter a incl faithful comm center x = a x := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.QuaternionLift.Equivalent
declarations.snippet:
def Equivalent (A B : RealLabel) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : A.surface ≅ B.surface,
    A.generator.asHom ≫ f.hom = f.hom ≫ B.generator.asHom ∧
    SameClass A.surface.X.hom A.line (pullModule (underlying f).hom B.line)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.QuaternionLift.conjugateLabel
declarations.snippet:
def conjugateLabel (σ : Gal) (A : RealLabel) : RealLabel where
  surface := (conjugateFunctor σ).obj A.surface
  line := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (projection A.surface σ)).obj A.line
  generator := End.of ((conjugateFunctor σ).map A.generator.asHom)

    SameClass ((conjugateFunctor σ).obj A).X.hom
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projection A σ)).obj L)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projection A σ)).obj M) := by

def conjugateModuli (σ : Gal) (m : ModuliClass) : ModuliClass :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.QuaternionLift.ConicPoint.w3
declarations.snippet:
def ConicPoint.w3 (p : ConicPoint) : ConicPoint where
  y := -p.y
  z := -p.z
  onCurve := by rw [neg_sq,neg_sq]; exact p.onCurve
  y_ne := neg_ne_zero.mpr p.y_ne
  z_ne := neg_ne_zero.mpr p.z_ne

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.QuaternionLift.ConicPoint.conjugate
declarations.snippet:
def ConicPoint.conjugate (σ : Gal) (p : ConicPoint) : ConicPoint where
  y := σ p.y
  z := σ p.z
  onCurve := by simpa [map_ofNat] using congrArg σ p.onCurve
  y_ne := (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).mpr p.y_ne
  z_ne := (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).mpr p.z_ne

    ∃ (p : ConicPoint), FibrePoint u p ∧
    ∃ (d : Qbar) (hd : d^2 = 6) (v : Qbar) (hv : v^2 = PrintedModel.factor u d),
      Nonempty (PolarizedRealization U p (PrintedModel.jacobian hu hd)
        (printedBundle (PrintedModel.jacobianIso hu hd v hv) (signedThetaLine hu)))

    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 2 B.X.hom → Nonempty (LevelThree.O ≃+* End A) → EffectivePrincipal ab L → EffectivePrincipal bb M →

def splitQuadratic {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] {a d : K}
    (hd : d^2 = a) (hn : d ≠ 0) : QuadraticAlgebra K a 0 ≃ₐ[K] K × K where
  toFun z := (z.re + z.im*d, z.re - z.im*d)
  invFun z := ⟨(z.1+z.2)/2, (z.1-z.2)/(2*d)⟩
  left_inv z := by ext <;> simp; field_simp; ring
  right_inv z := by ext <;> simp <;> field_simp <;> ring
  map_add' x y := by ext <;> simp <;> ring
  map_mul' x y := by ext <;> simp [← hd] <;> ring
  commutes' x := by ext <;> simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CoarseConic.coarseFibreEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def coarseFibreEquiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    FibreAlgebra u ≃ₐ[ℚ] Gaussian × Gaussian := by
  letI : Fact (¬ IsSquare (9*J u)) := ⟨by
    rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    rw [first_square] at ha
    have hr := (radical_units hu).1
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hr, sq_nonneg a]⟩
  let e := firstEquiv hu
  let z : Gaussian := ⟨0,4*h u⟩
  have hz : z^2 = algebraMap ℚ Gaussian (-27*J u-16) := by
    rw [second_square, sq]
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change 0*0 + (-1:ℚ)*(4*h u)*(4*h u) = -(4*h u)^2
      ring
    · change 0*(4*h u) + 4*h u*0 + 0*(4*h u)*(4*h u) = (0:ℚ)
      ring
  have hn : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz0
    have him := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im hz0
    have hh := (radical_units hu).2
    change 4*h u = 0 at him
    exact hh (by linarith)
  have hs : (e.symm z)^2 = algebraMap ℚ (First u) (-27*J u-16) := by
    rw [← map_pow, hz, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  have hne : e.symm z ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff e.symm e.symm.injective).2 hn
  exact ((splitQuadratic hs hne).restrictScalars ℚ).trans (AlgEquiv.prodCongr e e)

ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.signedNormalizedComplex
declarations.snippet:
private def signedNormalizedComplex {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) {p : ConicPoint}
    (hp : FibrePoint u p) {e l : Qbar} (he : e^2 = -6) (hl : l^2 = 2)
    (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) (hn : ((modularPolynomial (e*p.y/3) (l*p.z)).map ι).natDegree = 6) :
    paperPullback ℂ u ≅ sexticCompletion ((modularPolynomial (e*p.y/3) (l*p.z)).map ι) hn := by
  let s := e*p.y/3
  let k := l*p.z
  let d := rad (u:=u) (p:=p) (e:=e)
  obtain ⟨hd, hs, hk, hk₀⟩ := rad_spec hu hp he hl
  have hd' : (ι d)^2 = 6 := by simpa [d, map_ofNat] using congrArg ι hd
  have hs' : argument u (ι d) = -(ι s) := by
    simpa [argument,d,s] using congrArg ι hs
  have hk' : (ι k)^2 = 9*(ι s)^2-32 := by simpa [s,k,map_ofNat] using congrArg ι hk
  have hk₀' : ι k ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero ι).mpr hk₀
  choose v hv using IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (factor u (ι d)) (by decide : 0 < 2)
  choose w hw using IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (-4*(ι k)^6) (by decide : 0 < 2)
  let iso := (modular_completion hu hd' hs' hk' hk₀' hw).exists.choose
  exact PrintedModel.curveIso hu hd' v hv ≪≫ iso.symm ≪≫
    eqToIso (completion_eq (map_modular ι s k).symm _ hn)

private def rationalPullback (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) (u : ℚ) :
    paperPullback ℂ u ≅ (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))).obj (paperPullback Qbar u) := by
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)
  have h : f ≫ scalarMap ℚ Qbar = scalarMap ℚ ℂ := by
    simp only [f,scalarMap,← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1
    ext q
    exact map_ratCast ι q
  exact ((eqToIso (congrArg (fun g => Over.pullback g) h.symm)) ≪≫
    Over.pullbackComp f (scalarMap ℚ Qbar)).app (paperModel ℚ u)

    {A Y Z : ℂ} (above : LiesAbove ι A Y Z p) :
    let f := rawPolynomial A (ι e*Y) (2*ι l*Z)
    ∃ (hd : f.natDegree = 6), f.Separable ∧
      ∃ (_ : IsProper (sexticCompletion f hd).hom)
        (_ : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (sexticCompletion f hd).hom)
        (_ : GeometricallyIrreducible (sexticCompletion f hd).hom),
        Nonempty ((baseChange ι).obj (modularJacobian hu hp he hl) ≅
          groupScheme ℂ (sexticCompletion f hd).hom) := by

  ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, let f := rawPolynomial (A τ) (B τ) (D τ)
    ∀ (hd : f.natDegree = 6), f.Separable →
      ∀ [IsProper (sexticCompletion f hd).hom]
        [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (sexticCompletion f hd).hom]
        [GeometricallyIrreducible (sexticCompletion f hd).hom],

declarations.snippet:
def canonicalPeriods_of_raw {M : Over (Spec (.of ℚ))} {C : CoarseInterpretation M}
    {chart : Line ⟶ M} {ι : Qbar →+* ℂ} {hom : HomBaseChange ι}
    (e l : Qbar) (he : e^2 = -6) (hl : l^2 = 2)
    (A Y Z : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (surface : UpperHalfPlane → GroupScheme ℂ)
    (covers : ∀ p : ConicPoint, ∃ τ : UpperHalfPlane, LiesAbove ι (A τ) (Y τ) (Z τ) p)
    (representative : ∀ (j : ℚ), OutsideCM j → ∀ p : ConicPoint, p.y^2 = 9*(j:Qbar) →
      ∃ w : PeriodRepresentative C chart ι hom p, ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane,
        LiesAbove ι (A τ) (Y τ) (Z τ) p → Nonempty ((baseChange ι).obj w.surface ≅ surface τ))
    (cor : RawCorollary315 A (fun τ => ι e * Y τ) (fun τ => 2 * ι l * Z τ) surface) :
    CanonicalPeriods C chart ι hom where
  e := e
  l := l
  e_square := he
  l_square := hl
  A := A
  Y := Y
  Z := Z
  surface := surface
  covers := covers
  representative := representative
  cor315 := by
    intro u hu p hp τ above
    obtain ⟨hd,hs,proper,smooth,irreducible,⟨g⟩⟩ := raw_jacobian hu hp he hl ι above
    obtain ⟨letter⟩ := @cor τ hd hs proper smooth irreducible
    exact ⟨letter ≪≫ g.symm⟩

def standardEquiv : O₃ ≃+* A where
  toFun := standard

  left_inv x := by ext <;> simp [standard,halfBasis] <;> mod_ring
  right_inv x := by ext <;> simp [standard,halfBasis] <;> mod_ring
  map_mul' x y := by
    rcases x with ⟨a,b,c,d⟩
    rcases y with ⟨e,f,g,h⟩
    ext <;> simp [standard] <;> mod_ring <;> rw [show (2:F) = -1 by decide] <;> ring
  map_add' x y := by ext <;> simp [standard] <;> ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.HomBaseChange
ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.descendIso
declarations.snippet:
def descendIso {ι : Qbar →+* ℂ} (hom : HomBaseChange ι) {A B : GroupScheme Qbar}
    (ab : IsAbelianScheme A) (bb : IsAbelianScheme B)
    (e : (baseChange ι).obj A ≅ (baseChange ι).obj B) : A ≅ B := by
  let F := baseChange ι
  let f := ((hom A B ab bb).2 e.hom).choose
  let g := ((hom B A bb ab).2 e.inv).choose
  have hf : F.map f = e.hom := ((hom A B ab bb).2 e.hom).choose_spec
  have hg : F.map g = e.inv := ((hom B A bb ab).2 e.inv).choose_spec
  exact ⟨f,g,(hom A A ab ab).1 (by rw [F.map_comp,F.map_id,hf,hg,e.hom_inv_id]),
    (hom B B bb bb).1 (by rw [F.map_comp,F.map_id,hg,hf,e.inv_hom_id])⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.endBaseEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def endBaseEquiv {ι : Qbar →+* ℂ} (hom : HomBaseChange ι) (A : GroupScheme Qbar)
    (ab : IsAbelianScheme A) : End A ≃+* End ((baseChange ι).obj A) := by
  let f : End A →+* End ((baseChange ι).obj A) := changeEndRing (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))) A
  refine RingEquiv.ofBijective f ?_
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    exact End.homEquiv.injective ((hom A A ab ab).1 (congrArg End.asHom h))
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := (hom A A ab ab).2 y.asHom
    exact ⟨End.of x,End.homEquiv.injective hx⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.period_polynomial
declarations.snippet:
theorem period_polynomial {s k : K} (hk : k^2 = 9*s^2-32) (hn : k ≠ 0) :
    dilate (Units.mk0 (-k) (neg_ne_zero.mpr hn)) (SexticCalibration.sextic (-s)) =
      C (-4*k^6) * modularPolynomial s k := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modular_regular
ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modularChartIso
declarations.snippet:
def modularChartIso {u : ℚ} {d s k v : K} (hs : argument u d = -s)
    (hk : k^2=9*s^2-32) (hn : k≠0) (hv : v^2 = -4*k^6) :
    SpecOver (R := K) (Cover (modularPolynomial s k)) ≅
      SpecOver (R := K) (Cover (SexticCalibration.sextic (argument u d))) := by
  have : v ≠ 0 := by intro eq; rw [eq,zero_pow (by decide : 2≠0)] at hv; exact (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ hn)) hv.symm
  let v' := Units.mk0 v this
  apply specIso (squareEquiv (dilate (Units.mk0 (-k) (neg_ne_zero.mpr hn))) (Units.map C.toMonoidHom v') ?_)
  change _ = C v ^2 * _
  rw [←map_pow,hv,hs]
  exact period_polynomial hk hn

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modular_completion
declarations.snippet:
theorem modular_completion {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) {d s k v : K}
    (hd : d^2=6) (hs : argument u d = -s) (hk : k^2=9*s^2-32) (hn : k≠0)
    (hv : v^2 = -4*k^6) :
    let hd' := (modular_regular hu hd hs hk hn).1
    let P := modularPolynomial s k
    let i := chartInclusion K P P.reverse (reverse_sextic_overlap hd') false
    let j := (modularChartIso hs hk hn hv).hom ≫
      chartInclusion K _ _ (reverse_sextic_overlap (printed_degree hu hd)) false
    ∃! e : sexticCompletion P hd' ≅ PrintedModel.model hu hd, i ≫ e.hom = j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.LiesAbove

def LiesAbove (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) (A Y Z : ℂ) (p : ConicPoint) : Prop :=
  A ≠ 0 ∧ 4*Y = A*ι p.y ∧ 4*Z = A*ι p.z

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.raw_equation
declarations.snippet:
theorem raw_equation (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) {A Y Z : ℂ} {p : ConicPoint}
    (above : LiesAbove ι A Y Z p) (e l : Qbar) (x z : ℂ) :
    modularBinary A (ι e*Y) (2*ι l*Z) x z =
      A * modularBinary 1 (3*ι (e*p.y/3)/4) (ι (l*p.z)/2) x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.specHom
declarations.snippet:
def specHom {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ A] [Algebra ℚ B]
    (f : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) : SpecOver (R := ℚ) B ⟶ SpecOver (R := ℚ) A := by
  refine Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) ?_
  change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact RingHom.ext f.commutes

    specHom g ≫ specHom f = specHom (g.comp f) := by

declarations.snippet: def radicalCoordinate (p : ConicPoint) : Qbar := 12 / p.y

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.conic_equation
declarations.snippet:

    (radicalCoordinate p)^2 = -p.quotientCoordinate^2-27 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.conicAlgebraPoint
declarations.snippet:
def conicAlgebraPoint (p : ConicPoint) : ConicRing →ₐ[ℚ] Qbar := by
  let eval := aeval (R := ℚ) p.quotientCoordinate
  letI : Algebra ℚ[X] Qbar := eval.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower ℚ ℚ[X] Qbar := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r => (eval.commutes r).symm)
  let a := radicalCoordinate p
  have h : a*a = (-(X : ℚ[X])^2-27) • (1 : Qbar) + (0 : ℚ[X]) • a := by
    rw [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,zero_smul,add_zero]
    change a*a = eval _
    simpa [eval,a,sq,map_ofNat] using conic_equation p
  exact (QuadraticAlgebra.lift ⟨a,h⟩).restrictScalars ℚ

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.rad_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem rad_spec :
    (rad (u:=u) (p:=p) (e:=e))^2=6 ∧ argument u (rad (u:=u) (p:=p) (e:=e)) = -(e*p.y/3) ∧
    (l*p.z)^2=9*(e*p.y/3)^2-32 ∧ l*p.z≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modularCurve
declarations.snippet:
abbrev modularCurve := sexticCompletion (modularPolynomial (e*p.y/3) (l*p.z))
  (modular_regular hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.1
    (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.2).1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modularCurveIso
declarations.snippet:
def modularCurveIso :
    modularCurve hu hp he hl ≅ PrintedModel.model hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1 := by
  let chooseRoot := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (-4*(l*p.z)^6) (by decide : 0<2)
  let v := chooseRoot.choose
  have hv := chooseRoot.choose_spec
  exact (modular_completion hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.1
    (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.2 hv).exists.choose

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.signedToModular
declarations.snippet:
def signedToModular : paperPullback Qbar u ≅ modularCurve hu hp he hl := by
  let chooseRoot := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (factor u (rad (u:=u) (p:=p) (e:=e))) (by decide : 0<2)
  let v := chooseRoot.choose
  have hv := chooseRoot.choose_spec
  exact PrintedModel.curveIso hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1 v hv ≪≫ (modularCurveIso hu hp he hl).symm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modular_proper
declarations.snippet:
instance modular_proper : IsProper (modularCurve hu hp he hl).hom :=
  (sexticCompletion_geometry _ (modular_regular hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1
    (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.2).2).2.1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modular_smooth
declarations.snippet:
instance modular_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (modularCurve hu hp he hl).hom := by
  obtain ⟨hI,_,hS,hD,_⟩ := sexticCompletion_geometry _ (modular_regular hu (rad_spec hu hp he hl).1
    (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.1 (rad_spec hu hp he hl).2.2.2).2
  let : AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral (modularCurve hu hp he hl).left := hI
  let : Smooth (modularCurve hu hp he hl).hom := hS
  exact SixJacobian.relative_dimension_one _ hD

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modular_geom
declarations.snippet:
instance modular_geom : GeometricallyIrreducible (modularCurve hu hp he hl).hom := by
  let a := signedToModular hu hp he hl
  let : IsIso a.inv.left := inferInstanceAs (IsIso (((Over.forget _).mapIso a).inv))
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (paperModel ℚ u).hom := geometricallyIntegral_paperModel hu
  have h : GeometricallyIrreducible (paperPullback Qbar u).hom := inferInstanceAs (GeometricallyIrreducible (Limits.pullback.snd (paperModel ℚ u).hom (scalarMap ℚ Qbar)))
  have sq : IsPullback a.inv.left (modularCurve hu hp he hl).hom (paperPullback Qbar u).hom (𝟙 _) :=
    IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso ⟨by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact a.inv.w⟩
  exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @GeometricallyIrreducible) sq h

ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modularBinary
declarations.snippet:
def modularBinary {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (A B C x z : K) : K :=
  A*(x^6-21*x^4*z^2-21*x^2*z^4+z^6) +
  B*(x^6+9*x^4*z^2-9*x^2*z^4-z^6) +
  C*x*z*(3*x^4-2*x^2*z^2+3*z^4)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.period_binary
declarations.snippet:
theorem period_binary {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (s k x z : K)
    (hk : k^2 = 9*s^2-32) :
    SexticConjugation.binary (-s) (-k*x) z =
      -4*k^6 * modularBinary 1 (3*s/4) (k/2) x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.periods_to_printed
declarations.snippet:
theorem periods_to_printed {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (A Y Z e l s k x z : K) (hy : e*Y = A*(3*s/4))
    (hz : 2*l*Z = A*(k/2)) (hk : k^2 = 9*s^2-32) :
    A*SexticConjugation.binary (-s) (-k*x) z =
      -4*k^6 * modularBinary A (e*Y) (2*l*Z) x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.modularPolynomial
declarations.snippet:
def modularPolynomial {K : Type*} [Field K] (s k : K) : K[X] :=
  modularBinary 1 (C (3*s/4)) (C (k/2)) X 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.eval_modular
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_modular {K : Type*} [Field K] (s k x : K) :
    (modularPolynomial s k).eval x = modularBinary 1 (3*s/4) (k/2) x 1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.compatible_radicals
declarations.snippet:
theorem compatible_radicals {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) {p : ConicPoint}
    (hp : FibrePoint u p) (e l : Qbar) (he : e^2 = -6) (hl : l^2 = 2) :
    let s := e*p.y/3
    let k := l*p.z
    ∃ d : Qbar, d^2 = 6 ∧ argument u d = -s ∧ k^2 = 9*s^2-32 ∧ k ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.CoarseInterpretation

structure CoarseInterpretation (M : Over (Spec (.of ℚ))) where
  read : (geometricDomain ⟶ M) → ModuliClass
  natural : ∀ (σ : Gal) (x : geometricDomain ⟶ M),
    read (galoisPoint σ ≫ x) = conjugateModuli σ (read x)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.shimuraClassMap
declarations.snippet:
def shimuraClassMap {M : Over (Spec (.of ℚ))} (C : CoarseInterpretation M)
    (chart : Line ⟶ M) : ShimuraClassMap where
  value p := C.read (linePoint p.quotientCoordinate ≫ chart)
  rational σ p := by
    rw [coordinate_conjugate, ← linePoint_conjugate, Category.assoc]
    exact C.natural σ _
  forget_w3 p := by rw [(deck_coordinate p).2]

      C.read (specHom (conicAlgebraPoint p) ≫ quotientMorphism ≫ chart) := by

def rawPolynomial (A B D : ℂ) : ℂ[X] :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.raw_polynomial_equation
declarations.snippet:
theorem raw_polynomial_equation (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) {A Y Z : ℂ} {p : ConicPoint}
    (above : LiesAbove ι A Y Z p) (e l : Qbar) :
    rawPolynomial A (ι e*Y) (2*ι l*Z) =
      C A * (modularPolynomial (e*p.y/3) (l*p.z)).map ι := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ShimuraAtlas.raw_models
declarations.snippet:
theorem raw_models {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) {p : ConicPoint}
    (hp : FibrePoint u p) {e l : Qbar} (he : e^2=-6) (hl : l^2=2) (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ)
    {A Y Z : ℂ} (above : LiesAbove ι A Y Z p) :
    let n := (modularPolynomial (e*p.y/3) (l*p.z)).map ι
    let raw := rawPolynomial A (ι e*Y) (2*ι l*Z)
    ∃ (hN : n.natDegree = 6) (hR : raw.natDegree = 6),
      n.Separable ∧ raw.Separable ∧
      ∃ (a : SpecOver (R := ℂ) (Cover n) ≅ SpecOver (R := ℂ) (Cover raw)),
        ∃! f : sexticCompletion n hN ≅ sexticCompletion raw hR,
          chartInclusion ℂ _ _ (reverse_sextic_overlap hN) false ≫ f.hom =
            a.hom ≫ chartInclusion ℂ _ _ (reverse_sextic_overlap hR) false := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixThetaRestriction.translation
declarations.snippet:
def translation (t : sections A) : A.X ≅ A.X where
  hom := translateHom t
  inv := translateHom (-t)
  hom_inv_id := by
    rw [comp_translate]
    change ((𝟙 A.X) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul)) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul⁻¹) = 𝟙 A.X
    rw [GrpObj.comp_inv,mul_inv_cancel_right]
  inv_hom_id := by
    rw [comp_translate]
    change ((𝟙 A.X) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul⁻¹)) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul) = 𝟙 A.X
    rw [GrpObj.comp_inv,inv_mul_cancel_right]

declarations.snippet:
theorem comp_translate {T : Over (Spec (.of Qbar))} (p : T ⟶ A.X) (t : sections A) :
    p ≫ translateHom t = p * (toBase T ≫ t.toMul) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixThetaRestriction.translate_point
declarations.snippet:
theorem translate_point (p t : sections A) :
    Additive.ofMul (p.toMul ≫ translateHom t) = p+t := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixThetaRestriction.translation
declarations.snippet:
def translation (t : sections A) : A.X ≅ A.X where
  hom := translateHom t
  inv := translateHom (-t)
  hom_inv_id := by
    rw [comp_translate]
    change ((𝟙 A.X) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul)) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul⁻¹) = 𝟙 A.X
    rw [GrpObj.comp_inv,mul_inv_cancel_right]
  inv_hom_id := by
    rw [comp_translate]
    change ((𝟙 A.X) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul⁻¹)) * (toBase A.X ≫ t.toMul) = 𝟙 A.X
    rw [GrpObj.comp_inv,inv_mul_cancel_right]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelComparison.onPoints
declarations.snippet:
def onPoints (f : V ⟶ W) : Additive (base K ⟶ V.X) →+ Additive (base K ⟶ W.X) where
  toFun p := Additive.ofMul (p.toMul ≫ f.hom.hom.hom)
  map_zero' := by
    change (1 : base K ⟶ V.X) ≫ f.hom.hom.hom = 1
    exact MonObj.one_comp _
  map_add' p q := MonObj.mul_comp p.toMul q.toMul _

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TorsionHeight.oddPolynomial
declarations.snippet:
def oddPolynomial (f : K[X]) (a : K) : K[X] :=
  let g := taylor a f
  let c := f.derivative.eval a
  X^5 + C (g.coeff 2) * X^4 + C (c * g.coeff 3) * X^3 +
    C (c^2 * g.coeff 4) * X^2 + C (c^3 * g.coeff 5) * X + C (c^4 * g.coeff 6)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TorsionHeight.shifted_eval
declarations.snippet:
private theorem shifted_eval {f : K[X]} {a x : K} (hd : f.natDegree ≤ 6)
    (ha : f.IsRoot a) :
    f.eval x = (f.derivative.eval a)*(x-a) + (taylor a f).coeff 2*(x-a)^2 +
      (taylor a f).coeff 3*(x-a)^3 + (taylor a f).coeff 4*(x-a)^4 +
      (taylor a f).coeff 5*(x-a)^5 + (taylor a f).coeff 6*(x-a)^6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TorsionHeight.odd_evaluation
declarations.snippet:
theorem odd_evaluation {f : K[X]} {a x : K} (hd : f.natDegree ≤ 6) (ha : f.IsRoot a)
    (hx : x ≠ a) :
    (oddPolynomial f a).eval (f.derivative.eval a / (x-a)) * (x-a)^6 =
      (f.derivative.eval a)^4 * f.eval x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TorsionHeight.oddOpenEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def oddOpenEquiv {f : K[X]} {a : K} (hd : f.natDegree ≤ 6) (ha : f.IsRoot a)
    (hs : f.derivative.eval a ≠ 0) :
    {p : K × K // p.2^2 = f.eval p.1 ∧ p.1 ≠ a} ≃
    {p : K × K // p.2^2 = (oddPolynomial f a).eval p.1 ∧ p.1 ≠ 0} where
  toFun p := by
    let t := p.1.1 - a
    have ht : t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr p.2.2
    let c := f.derivative.eval a
    refine ⟨(c/t, c^2 * p.1.2 / t^3), ?_, div_ne_zero hs ht⟩
    have H := odd_evaluation hd ha p.2.2
    change (oddPolynomial f a).eval (c/t) * t^6 = c^4 * f.eval p.1.1 at H
    rw [←p.2.1] at H
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow]
    apply (div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero 3 ht))).2
    linear_combination -H
  invFun p := by
    let c := f.derivative.eval a
    let z := p.1.1
    have hz : z ≠ 0 := p.2.2
    have hca : a+c/z ≠ a := by
      intro h; have := div_ne_zero hs hz
      apply this; simpa using sub_eq_zero.mpr h
    refine ⟨(a+c/z, c*p.1.2/z^3), ?_, hca⟩
    have H := odd_evaluation hd ha hca
    have hcancel : a+c/z-a = c/z := by ring
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := hs
    have hinv : c/(c/z) = z := by field_simp [hc,hz]
    change (oddPolynomial f a).eval (c/(a+c/z-a)) * (a+c/z-a)^6 =
        c^4*f.eval (a+c/z) at H
    rw [hcancel,hinv,←p.2.1] at H
    change (c*p.1.2/z^3)^2 = _
    field_simp [hz] at H ⊢
    linear_combination H
  left_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [hs,sub_ne_zero.mpr p.2.2]; ring
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [hs,p.2.2] <;> ring

theorem odd_zero (hd : f.natDegree = 6) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TorsionHeight.reciprocalSextic
declarations.snippet:
def reciprocalSextic (f : K[X]) (a : K) : K[X] :=
  let g := taylor a f
  let c := f.derivative.eval a
  X + C (g.coeff 2) * X^2 + C (c * g.coeff 3) * X^3 +
    C (c^2 * g.coeff 4) * X^4 + C (c^3 * g.coeff 5) * X^5 + C (c^4 * g.coeff 6) * X^6

      (reciprocalSextic f a).reverse = oddPolynomial f a ∧
      ∃ j : SpecOver (R := K) (Cover (reciprocalSextic f a)) ⟶ paperPullback K u,
        IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧
        ∃! e : sexticCompletion (reciprocalSextic f a) deg ≅ paperPullback K u,
          chartInclusion K _ _ (reverse_sextic_overlap deg) false ≫ e.hom = j := by

    (f : F[X]) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra F K) (_ : FiniteDimensional F K),
      (f.map (algebraMap F K)).Splits ∧
      ∀ (L : Type) [Field L] [Algebra F L] (i : K →ₐ[F] L) (y : Points F A L),

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.LineFibre
declarations.snippet:
abbrev LineFibre := {m : Sections K (gluedOver K f g h) //
  m.left ≫ toLine K f g h = point K (RingHom.id K) x i}

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.fibreOfOrdinate
declarations.snippet:
def fibreOfOrdinate (y : { y : K // y^2 = aeval x (if i then g else f) }) : LineFibre f g h i x :=
  ⟨chartSection f g h i ⟨(x,y.1),y.2⟩,chartSection_line _ _ _ _ _⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.fibreEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def fibreEquiv : {y : K // y^2 = aeval x (if i then g else f)} ≃ LineFibre f g h i x := by
  apply Equiv.ofBijective (fibreOfOrdinate f g h i x)
  constructor
  · intro y w he
    have eq := chartSection_injective f g h i (congrArg Subtype.val he)
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun p => p.1.2) eq)
  · rintro ⟨m,hm⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨a,b⟩,hp⟩,ea,ep⟩ := chartSection_above f g h m i x hm.symm
    change a = x at ea
    subst a
    exact ⟨⟨b,hp⟩,Subtype.ext ep⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.nonzeroSquares
declarations.snippet:
def nonzeroSquares [CharZero K] (w : K) (hw : w≠0) : Bool ≃ {y : K // y^2 = w^2} := by
  let q : Bool → {y : K // y^2=w^2} := fun b => ⟨if b then w else -w, by cases b <;> simp⟩
  apply Equiv.ofBijective q
  have wne : -w ≠ w := fun eq => hw (by linear_combination -(1/2:K)*eq)
  constructor
  · intro a b e
    have h₀ := congrArg Subtype.val e
    cases a <;> cases b
    · rfl
    · exact (wne h₀).elim
    · exact (wne h₀.symm).elim
    · rfl
  · rintro ⟨y,hy⟩
    rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hy) with yr | yr
    · exact ⟨true,Subtype.ext yr.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨false,Subtype.ext yr.symm⟩

def coordinateEquiv (u : ℚ) : Normal (F K u) ≃ GluedCoords (paper K u false) (paper K u true) :=
  Equiv.sumCongr
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivProp (by funext p; simp only [paper_evaluate, Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]))
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivProp (by funext y; simp only [paper_evaluate, ite_true]))

  ((normalEquiv _ (paper_homogeneous K hu)).symm.trans (coordinateEquiv K u)).trans
    (gluedPointEquiv _ _ (paper_overlap K u))

    weightedSections K hu (toWeighted _ (.inl p)) =

        ⟨p.val, by simpa only [paper_evaluate,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using p.property⟩ := by

    weightedSections K hu (toWeighted _ (.inr p)) =

        ⟨p.val, by simpa only [paper_evaluate,ite_true] using p.property⟩) := by

  congr 1
  exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext s.commutes)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.starComponent
declarations.snippet:
def starComponent (f g : K[X]) (h : SexticOverlap K f g) :
    (i : WidePushoutShape Bool) → (diagram K f g h).obj i ⟶ (diagram K f g h).obj i
  | none => starSpec (Punctured K f)
  | some i => starSpec (Cover (if i then g else f))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.starDiagram
declarations.snippet:
def starDiagram (f g : K[X]) (h : SexticOverlap K f g) : diagram K f g h ⟶ diagram K f g h where
  app := starComponent f g h
  naturality := by
    intro i j a
    change WidePushoutShape.Hom i j at a
    cases a with
    | id i => exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm
    | init i => exact arrow_star f g h i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.deck
declarations.snippet:
def deck (f g : K[X]) (h : SexticOverlap K f g) : glued K f g h ⟶ glued K f g h :=
  colimMap (starDiagram f g h)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.deck_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem deck_chart (f g : K[X]) (h : SexticOverlap K f g) (i : Bool) :
    (chartInclusion K f g h i).left ≫ deck f g h =
      starSpec (Cover (if i then g else f)) ≫ (chartInclusion K f g h i).left :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.deck_sq
declarations.snippet: theorem deck_sq (f g : K[X]) (h : SexticOverlap K f g) : deck f g h ≫ deck f g h = 𝟙 _ := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.star_scalar
ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.deck_line
declarations.snippet: theorem deck_line : deck f g h ≫ toLine K f g h = toLine K f g h := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.deckOver
declarations.snippet:
def deckOver : gluedOver K f g h ≅ gluedOver K f g h := by
  let e : glued K f g h ≅ glued K f g h := ⟨deck f g h, deck f g h, deck_sq f g h, deck_sq f g h⟩
  refine Over.isoMk e ?_
  change deck f g h ≫ (gluedOver K f g h).hom = (gluedOver K f g h).hom
  rw [←curve_structure, ←Category.assoc,deck_line]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.flip
declarations.snippet:
def flip (p : AffineCoords K f) : AffineCoords K f :=
  ⟨(p.1.1,-p.1.2),by simpa using p.2⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.affine_flip
declarations.snippet:
theorem affine_flip (p : AffineCoords K f) :
    (affineSection K f p).left ≫ starSpec (Cover f) = (affineSection K f (flip f p)).left := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.chart_deck
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_deck (i : Bool) (p : AffineCoords K (if i then g else f)) :
    chartSection f g h i p ≫ (deckOver f g h).hom = chartSection f g h i (flip _ p) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.chart_fixed_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_fixed_iff (i : Bool) (p : AffineCoords K (if i then g else f)) :
    chartSection f g h i p ≫ (deckOver f g h).hom = chartSection f g h i p ↔ p.1.2=0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.fixedSections
declarations.snippet:
abbrev fixedSections (u : ℚ) :=
  { m : Sections K (paperModel K u) // m ≫ (paperDeck u).hom = m }

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.rootSection
declarations.snippet:
def rootSection (u : ℚ) (a : {x : K // (paper K u false).IsRoot x}) :
    fixedSections K u :=
  ⟨chartSection _ _ (paper_overlap K u) false (branchCoords _ a.1 a.2),
    (chart_fixed_iff _ _ (paper_overlap K u) false _).2 rfl⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.rootSection_bijective
declarations.snippet:
theorem rootSection_bijective {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.finite_degree
declarations.snippet: theorem finite_degree {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) : (paper K u false).natDegree=6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.fixed_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixed_count [IsAlgClosed K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.A
declarations.snippet: private abbrev A := algebraMap K[X] (Cover f)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.pointIdeal_pair
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointIdeal_pair :
    pointIdeal f p = Ideal.span {A f (X-C p.1.1), QuadraticAlgebra.omega - A f (C p.1.2)} := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.regular_local_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem regular_local_parameter [CharZero K] (hn : p.1.2 ≠ 0) :
    let J := localMap f p
    Ideal.span {J (A f (X-C p.1.1))} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (pointLocal f p) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.paper_regular_local_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_regular_local_parameter [CharZero K] (u : ℚ) (i : Bool)
    (p : AffineCoords K (paper K u i)) (hn : p.1.2≠0) :
    Ideal.span {localMap _ p (algebraMap K[X] (Cover (paper K u i)) (X-C p.1.1))} =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (pointLocal _ p) := regular_local_parameter _ p hn

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_reglued
declarations.snippet:
def weightedEquiv_reglued {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :
    FibrePoints u ≃ (basePoint ⟶ paperModel Qbar u) := weightedSections Qbar hu

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.baseChangeIso
declarations.snippet:
def baseChangeIso {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :
    paperModel Qbar u ≅ paperPullback Qbar u := (unique_reglued_baseChange Qbar hu).exists.choose

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.baseChangeIso_finiteChart
declarations.snippet:
theorem baseChangeIso_finiteChart {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :
    chartInclusion Qbar _ _ (paper_overlap Qbar u) false ≫ (baseChangeIso hu).hom =
      baseChangedFiniteChart Qbar u := (unique_reglued_baseChange Qbar hu).exists.choose_spec

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback
ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback_apply
declarations.snippet:
theorem weightedEquiv_pullback_apply {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (p : FibrePoints u) :
    weightedEquiv_pullback hu p = weightedEquiv_reglued hu p ≫ (baseChangeIso hu).hom := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.pullbackDeck
declarations.snippet:
def pullbackDeck {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) : paperPullback Qbar u ≅ paperPullback Qbar u :=
  (baseChangeIso hu).symm ≪≫ paperDeck u ≪≫ baseChangeIso hu

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback_deck
declarations.snippet:
theorem weightedEquiv_pullback_deck {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (p : FibrePoints u) :
    weightedEquiv_pullback hu (negY _ p) = weightedEquiv_pullback hu p ≫ (pullbackDeck hu).hom := by

ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback_line
declarations.snippet:

    (weightedEquiv_pullback hu p).left ≫ pullbackProjection hu =
      (weightedEquiv_reglued hu p).left ≫ toLine Qbar _ _ (paper_overlap Qbar u) := by
