declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.primeAt
declarations.snippet:
def primeAt (f : K[X]) (p : AffineCoords K f) : PrimeSpectrum (Cover f) :=
  ⟨pointIdeal f p,inferInstance⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.section_support
declarations.snippet:
theorem section_support (f : K[X]) (p : AffineCoords K f) :
    (affineSection K f p).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = primeAt f p := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.chartPoly
declarations.snippet: private abbrev chartPoly := if i then g else f

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.support
declarations.snippet: abbrev support := (chartSection f g h i p).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.pointStalk
declarations.snippet: abbrev pointStalk := (glued K f g h).presheaf.stalk (support f g h i p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.chartStalkEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def chartStalkEquiv : pointStalk f g h i p ≃+* pointLocal _ p := by
  change (glued K f g h).presheaf.stalk
    ((chartInclusion K f g h i).left ((affineSection K _ p).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K))) ≃+* _
  rw [section_support]
  let q := primeAt _ p
  let j := (chartInclusion K f g h i).left
  let e := (asIso (j.stalkMap q)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact e.trans (Spec.stalkIso (.of _) q).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.baseUniformizerGerm
declarations.snippet:
def baseUniformizerGerm : pointStalk f g h i p := (chartStalkEquiv f g h i p).symm
  (localMap _ p (algebraMap K[X] (Cover _) (X-C p.1.1)))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.regular_fibre_stalk
declarations.snippet:
theorem regular_fibre_stalk [CharZero K] (hy : p.1.2 ≠ 0) :
    Ideal.span {baseUniformizerGerm f g h i p} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (pointStalk f g h i p) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.paper_branch_stalk
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_branch_stalk [CharZero K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) (j : Bool) (x : K)
    (hx : (paper K u j).IsRoot x) :
    let f₀ := paper K u false
    let g₀ := paper K u true
    let v : AffineCoords K (chartPoly f₀ g₀ j) := by
      cases j <;> exact branchCoords _ x hx
    Ideal.span {baseUniformizerGerm f₀ g₀ (paper_overlap K u) j v} =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (pointStalk f₀ g₀ (paper_overlap K u) j v))^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.sectionClosed
declarations.snippet:
def sectionClosed (C : Over (Spec (.of K))) [IsAlgClosed K] [LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom] :
    Sections K C ≃ closedPoints C.left :=
  Equiv.trans (⟨fun p => ⟨p.left,p.w⟩,fun p => Over.homMk p.1 p.2,fun _ => rfl,fun _ => rfl⟩ :
    Sections K C ≃ {p : Spec (.of K) ⟶ C.left // p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 _}) (pointEquivClosedPoint C.hom)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.weightedClosed
declarations.snippet:
def weightedClosed [CharZero K] [IsAlgClosed K] {u : ℚ} (hu : u∉ZInQ.contactSet) :
    CurveChart.Points (F K u) ≃ closedPoints (paperModel K u).left := by
  let _ := paper_proper K u
  exact (weightedSections K hu).trans (sectionClosed _)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.Finite
declarations.snippet: abbrev Finite := {q : K × K // q.2 ^ 2 = F (q.1, 1)}

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.Infinity
declarations.snippet: abbrev Infinity := {y : K // y ^ 2 = F (1, 0)}

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.Normal
declarations.snippet: abbrev Normal := Finite F ⊕ Infinity F

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.finiteRep
declarations.snippet:
def finiteRep (q : Finite F) : Rep F :=
  ⟨(q.1.1, 1), q.1.2, by simp, q.2⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.infinityRep
declarations.snippet:
def infinityRep (q : Infinity F) : Rep F :=
  ⟨(1, 0), q.1, by simp, q.2⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.toWeighted
declarations.snippet:
def toWeighted : Normal F → Points F
  | .inl q => Quotient.mk _ (finiteRep F q)
  | .inr q => Quotient.mk _ (infinityRep F q)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.toWeighted_injective
declarations.snippet: theorem toWeighted_injective : Function.Injective (toWeighted F) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.scaleRep
declarations.snippet:
def scaleRep (hom : ∀ c x z : K, F (c*x,c*z) = c^6 * F (x,z))
    (r : Rep F) (c : Kˣ) : Rep F where
  base := c • r.base
  y := (c : K)^3 * r.y
  nonzero := by
    intro h
    apply r.nonzero
    simpa using congrArg (fun t : K × K => c⁻¹ • t) h
  equation := by
    change ((c : K)^3 * r.y)^2 = F ((c : K)*r.base.1, (c : K)*r.base.2)
    rw [hom, mul_pow, r.equation]
    ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.toWeighted_surjective
declarations.snippet:
theorem toWeighted_surjective (hom : ∀ c x z : K, F (c*x,c*z) = c^6 * F (x,z)) :
    Function.Surjective (toWeighted F) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WeightedCurvePoints.normalEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def normalEquiv (hom : ∀ c x z : K, F (c*x,c*z) = c^6 * F (x,z)) :
    Normal F ≃ Points F :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (toWeighted F) ⟨toWeighted_injective F,toWeighted_surjective F hom⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.targetPair
declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet:
theorem archimedean_euclidean_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (x : Fin 16 → K) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.ratHeight_le_level_two_exact
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.l4

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.l3
declarations.snippet: private def l3 (t : R) := -(5*t^2-4*t+27)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.l2
declarations.snippet: private def l2 (t : R) := 3*(t^3-2*t^2+9*t-12)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.l1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.r1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.deriv_monic
declarations.snippet: private theorem deriv_monic (t : R) : (monicSextic t).derivative = r5 t := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.step
declarations.snippet:
private theorem step (f g h q : R[X]) (k : ℕ) (a b : R)
    (hq : q.natDegree ≤ 1) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ k+1) (hh : h.natDegree ≤ k)
    (he : C a*f = C b*h + g*q) :
    a^(k+1) * resultant f g (k+2) (k+1) =
      b^(k+1)*(g.coeff (k+1))^2 * resultant g h (k+1) k := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.deg2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.deg1

private theorem step6 (t : R) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.quarticB
declarations.snippet: def quarticB (q₀ q₁ q₂ q₃ q₄ : ℚ) : ℚ := 2*q₀*q₄ - q₁*q₃/2 + q₂^2/6

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.igusaI4
declarations.snippet: def igusaI4 (f : ℚ[X]) : ℚ := -720*(sexticA f.coeff)^2 + 6750*sexticB f.coeff

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.igusaI4_C_mul
declarations.snippet: theorem igusaI4_C_mul (s : ℚ) (f : ℚ[X]) : igusaI4 (C s * f) = s^4*igusaI4 f := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.monic_coeff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem monic_coeff (t : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    (monicSextic t).coeff n =
      (if n=6 then 1 else 0) + (if n=5 then 9-t else 0) +
      (if n=4 then 27-9*t else 0) + (if n=3 then t^2-32*t+27 else 0) +
      (if n=2 then 6*t^2-54*t else 0) + (if n=1 then 12*t^2-36*t else 0) +
      (if n=0 then 8*t^2 else 0) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.coefficients
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coefficients (t : ℚ) :
    (monicSextic t).coeff 0 = 8*t^2 ∧ (monicSextic t).coeff 1 = 12*t^2-36*t ∧
    (monicSextic t).coeff 2 = 6*t^2-54*t ∧ (monicSextic t).coeff 3 = t^2-32*t+27 ∧
    (monicSextic t).coeff 4 = 27-9*t ∧ (monicSextic t).coeff 5 = 9-t ∧
    (monicSextic t).coeff 6 = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.familyA
declarations.snippet:
private theorem familyA (t : ℚ) :
    sexticA (monicSextic t).coeff = -(t^2-8*t+27)*(t^2+8*t+27)/20 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticInvariants.igusaI4_family
declarations.snippet:
theorem igusaI4_family (s t : ℚ) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.numerator
declarations.snippet: def numerator (z : Fin 10 → K) : K := 3779136 * (∏ i, z i)^4

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.denominator
declarations.snippet: def denominator (z : Fin 10 → K) : K := (∑ i, z i ^ 8)^5

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.pair
declarations.snippet: private def pair (z : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 2 → K := ![numerator z, denominator z]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.prod_bound
declarations.snippet:
private lemma prod_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (z : Fin 10 → K) :
    v (∏ i, z i) ≤ (⨆ i, v (z i)) ^ 10 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.summand_bound
declarations.snippet:
private lemma summand_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (z : Fin 10 → K) (i : Fin 10) :
    v (z i ^ 8) ≤ (⨆ j, v (z j)) ^ 8 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.archimedean_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem archimedean_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (z : Fin 10 → K) :
    (⨆ i, v (pair z i)) ≤ 3779136 * (⨆ i, v (z i)) ^ 40 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.nonarchimedean_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem nonarchimedean_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (z : Fin 10 → K) : (⨆ i, v (pair z i)) ≤ (⨆ i, v (z i)) ^ 40 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.sup_pow
declarations.snippet:
private lemma sup_pow (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (z : Fin 10 → K) :
    (⨆ i, v ((z ^ 40) i)) = (⨆ i, v (z i)) ^ 40 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.multiplicative_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem multiplicative_bound [AdmissibleAbsValues K] (z : Fin 10 → K)
    (hd : denominator z ≠ 0) :
    mulHeight (pair z) ≤ (3779136 : ℝ) ^ totalWeight K * mulHeight z ^ 40 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.normalizedHeight
declarations.snippet:
def normalizedHeight {ι : Type*} (z : ι → K) : ℝ :=
  logHeight z / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.maximum_pair
declarations.snippet:
private lemma maximum_pair (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (a b : K) :
    (⨆ i, v (![a,b] i)) = max (v a) (v b) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.finite_coprime
declarations.snippet:
private lemma finite_coprime (v : nonarchAbsVal (K := K)) (j : ℚ) :
    (⨆ i, v.val (![(j.num : K),(j.den : K)] i)) = 1 := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem relative_rational_height (j : ℚ) :
    Height.logHeight₁ (j : K) = (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) * ZInQ.ratHeight j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.log_coefficient_le
declarations.snippet: theorem log_coefficient_le : Real.log 3779136 ≤ 16 := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem ratHeight_le_sixteen (z : Fin 10 → K) (j : ℚ)
    (h : (j : K) = numerator z / denominator z) (hd : denominator z ≠ 0) :
    ZInQ.ratHeight j ≤ 40 * normalizedHeight z + 16 := by

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.euclideanHeight
declarations.snippet:
def euclideanHeight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → K) : ℝ :=
  if x = 0 then 0 else
    Real.log ((archAbsVal.map (fun v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ ↦
      Real.sqrt (∑ i, v (x i) ^ 2))).prod *
       ∏ᶠ v : nonarchAbsVal, ⨆ i, v.val (x i)) / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.normalizedHeight_le_euclideanHeight
declarations.snippet:
theorem normalizedHeight_le_euclideanHeight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (x : ι → K) :
    normalizedHeight x ≤ euclideanHeight x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaQuotient.evenCharacteristic
declarations.snippet:
def evenCharacteristic (m : Fin 16) : Bool :=

declarations.snippet:

    (hd : denominator (x ∘ evenIndices) ≠ 0) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.K

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.Gal
declarations.snippet: abbrev Gal := K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.targetAction
declarations.snippet:
def targetAction (σ : Gal) : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Point →+ Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Point :=
  shortCurveScaling σ.toRingHom (-1) (-1) 1 one_ne_zero (by simp)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.targetAction_coords
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem targetAction_coords (σ : Gal) (x y : K) (h : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    targetCoords (targetAction σ (.some x y h)) = some (σ x, σ y) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sourceAction
declarations.snippet:
def sourceAction (σ : Gal) : genusCurve.toAffine.Point →+ genusCurve.toAffine.Point :=
  shortCurveScaling σ.toRingHom 4 4 1 one_ne_zero (by
    rw [one_pow,one_mul]
    exact (map_natCast σ 4).symm)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sourceAction_some
ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.GaloisMinus
declarations.snippet:
def GaloisMinus (d : ℕ) (P : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Point) : Prop := ∀ σ : Gal,
  targetAction σ P = if σ (Rank.sqrtMinus d) = Rank.sqrtMinus d then P else -P

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.conjugate_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem conjugate_root (σ : Gal) (d : ℕ) :
    σ (Rank.sqrtMinus d) = Rank.sqrtMinus d ∨ σ (Rank.sqrtMinus d) = -Rank.sqrtMinus d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.fixes_imaginaryField_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixes_imaginaryField_iff (d : ℕ) (σ : Gal) :
    σ ∈ (Rank.imaginaryField d).fixingSubgroup ↔ σ (Rank.sqrtMinus d) = Rank.sqrtMinus d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.fixed_is_rational
declarations.snippet: private theorem fixed_is_rational (x : K) (hx : ∀ σ : Gal, σ x = x) : ∃ u : ℚ, (u : K) = x :=

declarations.snippet: private theorem coords_injective : Function.Injective targetCoords := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem isogeny_galois (σ : Gal) (P : genusCurve.toAffine.Point) :
    targetAction σ (tyzIsogeny P) = tyzIsogeny (sourceAction σ P) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.neg_coords
declarations.snippet:
private theorem neg_coords (x y : K) (h : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    targetCoords (-Point.some x y h) = some (x,-y) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.minus_iff_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem minus_iff_coordinates {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (P : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Point) :
    GaloisMinus d P ↔ P = 0 ∨ ∃ (u v : ℚ) (h : Rank.baseCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular
      (u : K) ((v : K) * Rank.sqrtMinus d)), Point.some _ _ h = P := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.SubfieldQ
declarations.snippet: abbrev SubfieldQ := IntermediateField ℚ K

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sqrtDivisor
declarations.snippet: def sqrtDivisor (m : ℕ) : K := Rank.sqrtMinus 1 * Rank.sqrtMinus m

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sqrtDivisor_sq
declarations.snippet: theorem sqrtDivisor_sq (m : ℕ) : sqrtDivisor m ^ 2 = (m : K) := by

ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.base_le_pointField
declarations.snippet: theorem base_le_pointField (H : SubfieldQ) (P : A) : H ≤ pointField H P := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.radicalField
declarations.snippet:
def radicalField (n : ℕ) : SubfieldQ := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
  (insert (Rank.sqrtMinus 1) (sqrtDivisor '' (↑n.divisors : Set ℕ)))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.genusCompositum
declarations.snippet:
def genusCompositum (H' : ℕ → SubfieldQ) (n : ℕ) : SubfieldQ :=
  radicalField n ⊔ (n.divisors.filter fun m => m%8=5 ∨ m%8=6).sup H'

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.i_mem_compositum
declarations.snippet:
theorem i_mem_compositum (H' : ℕ → SubfieldQ) (n : ℕ) :

declarations.snippet:
theorem generator_mem_compositum {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ n.divisors) (H' : ℕ → SubfieldQ) :
    sqrtDivisor m ∈ genusCompositum H' n :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.classField_le_compositum
declarations.snippet:
theorem classField_le_compositum {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ n.divisors) (hr : m%8=5 ∨ m%8=6)
    (H' : ℕ → SubfieldQ) : H' m ≤ genusCompositum H' n :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.compositum_mono
declarations.snippet:
theorem compositum_mono {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ∣ n) (hn : n ≠ 0) (H' : ℕ → SubfieldQ) :
    genusCompositum H' m ≤ genusCompositum H' n := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.pointsOver
declarations.snippet:
def pointsOver (F : SubfieldQ) : AddSubgroup A where
  carrier := {P | ∀ σ : Gal, σ ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → sourceAction σ P = P}
  zero_mem' := fun _ _ => map_zero _
  add_mem' := by intro P Q hP hQ σ hσ; rw [map_add,hP σ hσ,hQ σ hσ]
  neg_mem' := by intro P hP σ hσ; rw [map_neg,hP σ hσ]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sourceAction_some_eq
declarations.snippet:
private theorem sourceAction_some_eq (σ : Gal) (x y : K) (h : genusCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    sourceAction σ (.some x y h) = .some x y h ↔ σ x = x ∧ σ y = y := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem some_mem_pointsOver (F : SubfieldQ) (x y : K) (h : genusCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    Point.some x y h ∈ pointsOver F ↔ x ∈ F ∧ y ∈ F := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.pointField_le_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointField_le_iff (H F : SubfieldQ) (P : A) :
    pointField H P ≤ F ↔ H ≤ F ∧ P ∈ pointsOver F := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.pointsOver_mono
declarations.snippet: theorem pointsOver_mono {F F' : SubfieldQ} (hF : F ≤ F') : pointsOver F ≤ pointsOver F' := by

declarations.snippet: def multiplyI : A →+ A := tyzCMI

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.GaussianUnit
declarations.snippet: inductive GaussianUnit where | one | negOne | i | negI

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.GaussianUnit.act
declarations.snippet:
def GaussianUnit.act (e : GaussianUnit) (P : A) : A :=
  match e with
  | .one => P
  | .negOne => -P
  | .i => multiplyI P
  | .negI => -(multiplyI P)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.GaussianUnit.act_mem
declarations.snippet:
theorem GaussianUnit.act_mem (e : GaussianUnit) {F : SubfieldQ} (hi : Rank.sqrtMinus 1 ∈ F)
    {P : A} (hP : P ∈ pointsOver F) : e.act P ∈ pointsOver F := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.recursionFactors
declarations.snippet:
def recursionFactors (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := n.divisors.filter fun d₁ =>
  1 < d₁ ∧ (d₁%8=1 ∨ d₁%8=2 ∨ d₁%8=3) ∧
  ((n/d₁)%8=5 ∨ (n/d₁)%8=6 ∨ (n/d₁)%8=7)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.cofactor_lt
declarations.snippet: private theorem cofactor_lt {n d₁ : ℕ} (h : d₁ ∈ recursionFactors n) : n/d₁ < n := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.RecursionData
declarations.snippet:
structure RecursionData where
  trace : ℕ → A
  L : ℕ → ℤ
  epsilon : ℕ → ℕ → GaussianUnit

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.CMTraces
declarations.snippet:
structure CMTraces where
  hilbert : ℕ → SubfieldQ
  modularPoint : ℕ → A
  lifts : ℕ → Finset Gal

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.CMTraces.extended
declarations.snippet: def CMTraces.extended (S : CMTraces) (n : ℕ) : SubfieldQ := pointField (S.hilbert n) (S.modularPoint n)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.CMTraces.trace
declarations.snippet:
def CMTraces.trace (S : CMTraces) (n : ℕ) : A :=
  ∑ σ ∈ S.lifts n, sourceAction σ (S.modularPoint n)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.CMTraces.recursion
declarations.snippet:
def CMTraces.recursion (S : CMTraces) (L : ℕ → ℤ) (eps : ℕ → ℕ → GaussianUnit) : RecursionData :=
  ⟨S.trace,L,eps⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sourceAction_mem
declarations.snippet:
theorem sourceAction_mem {F : SubfieldQ} (σ : Gal) (hF : ∀ x ∈ F, σ x ∈ F)
    {P : A} (hP : P ∈ pointsOver F) : sourceAction σ P ∈ pointsOver F := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.CMTraces.trace_mem
declarations.snippet:
theorem CMTraces.trace_mem (S : CMTraces) (n : ℕ)
    (preserve : ∀ σ ∈ S.lifts n, ∀ x ∈ S.extended n, σ x ∈ S.extended n) :
    S.trace n ∈ pointsOver (S.extended n) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.representative
declarations.snippet:
def representative (D : RecursionData) (n : ℕ) : A :=
  D.trace n - ∑ d₁ ∈ (recursionFactors n).attach,
    (D.L d₁.val) • (D.epsilon (n/d₁.val) d₁.val).act (representative D (n/d₁.val))
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact cofactor_lt d₁.property

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.liftAction
declarations.snippet:
def liftAction (σ : Gal) : A ≃+ A where
  toFun := sourceAction σ
  invFun := sourceAction σ.symm
  map_add' := map_add _
  left_inv := by
    intro P
    cases P with
    | zero => simp only [show Point.zero = (0:A) from rfl, map_zero]
    | some x y h =>
      obtain ⟨h₁,e₁⟩ := sourceSome σ x y h
      obtain ⟨h₂,e₂⟩ := sourceSome σ.symm _ _ h₁
      rw [e₁,e₂]; erw [Point.some.injEq]; simp
  right_inv := by
    intro P
    cases P with
    | zero => simp only [show Point.zero = (0:A) from rfl, map_zero]
    | some x y h =>
      obtain ⟨h₁,e₁⟩ := sourceSome σ.symm x y h
      obtain ⟨h₂,e₂⟩ := sourceSome σ _ _ h₁
      rw [e₁,e₂]; erw [Point.some.injEq]; simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.fieldLift
declarations.snippet:
def fieldLift {F : SubfieldQ} (σ : Gal) (hf : ∀ x ∈ F, σ x ∈ F)
    (hi : ∀ x ∈ F, σ.symm x ∈ F) : pointsOver F ≃+ pointsOver F where
  toFun P := ⟨sourceAction σ P.val, sourceAction_mem σ hf P.property⟩
  invFun P := ⟨sourceAction σ.symm P.val, sourceAction_mem σ.symm hi P.property⟩
  left_inv P := Subtype.ext ((liftAction σ).left_inv P.val)
  right_inv P := Subtype.ext ((liftAction σ).right_inv P.val)
  map_add' P Q := Subtype.ext (map_add _ P.val Q.val)

structure LocalTraceLaw (D : RecursionData) (σ : Gal) (N : ℕ) : Prop where
  fixesI : σ (Rank.sqrtMinus 1) = Rank.sqrtMinus 1
  cusps : ∃ U V : A, (2:ℕ) • U = 0 ∧ (2:ℕ) • V = twiceCusp ∧
    (∀ e, e ∣ N → e%8=5 → ∃ k : ℤ, sourceAction σ (D.trace e) + D.trace e =
      genusNumber e • U + k • twiceCusp) ∧
    (∀ e, e ∣ N → e%8=7 → sourceAction σ (D.trace e) + D.trace e = genusNumber e • V)

    (hi : σ (Rank.sqrtMinus 1) = Rank.sqrtMinus 1) (V : A)
    (hV : (2:ℕ) • V = twiceCusp)
    (five : ∀ e, e ∣ N → e%8=5 → ∃ k : ℤ, sourceAction σ (D.trace e) + D.trace e =
      genusNumber e • (V - multiplyI V) + k • twiceCusp)
    (seven : ∀ e, e ∣ N → e%8=7 → sourceAction σ (D.trace e) + D.trace e = genusNumber e • V) :
    LocalTraceLaw D σ N := ⟨hi,V - multiplyI V,V,doubled_cusp_difference V hV,hV,five,seven⟩

declarations.snippet: private theorem large_of_factors {n t : ℕ} (ht : t ∣ n) (h1 : small t) (h2 : large (n/t)) : large n := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem kernel_row (L : ℕ → ℤ) (h1 : L 1 = 1) : kernel L * row L = seven := by

    (hr : n%8=5 ∨ n%8=7) : (traceCoefficient L n : ZMod 2) =
    ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e%8=7), (L (n/e) : ZMod 2) * (genusNumber e : ZMod 2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.thirdFactors
ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.mem_thirdFactors
declarations.snippet:
private theorem mem_thirdFactors {m b : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R : Finset ℕ) : (b,R) ∈ thirdFactors m ↔
    b%8=3 ∧ (∀ r ∈ R, 1 < r ∧ r%8=1) ∧ b * (∏ r ∈ R, r) = m := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.thirdSum
declarations.snippet: def thirdSum (m : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ p ∈ thirdFactors m, genusNumber p.1 * ∏ r ∈ p.2, genusNumber r

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.Sevens
declarations.snippet: private abbrev Sevens (n : ℕ) := ↥(n.divisors.filter fun e => e%8=7)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.Splits
declarations.snippet: private abbrev Splits (n : ℕ) := (e : Sevens n) × ↥(thirdFactors (n/e.val))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.splitTerm
declarations.snippet:
private def splitTerm {n : ℕ} (hd : n%8=5) (T : BracketTerm n) : Splits n := by
  have h0 := T.d₀mod
  have he : T.d₀ ∣ n := ⟨_,by rw [←Nat.mul_assoc]; exact T.product.symm⟩
  let e : Sevens n := ⟨T.d₀,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨he,by omega⟩,h0⟩⟩
  have hm : n/T.d₀ = T.d₁ * (∏ r ∈ T.rest, r) := by
    have eq := congrArg (fun k : ℕ => k / T.d₀) T.product.symm
    exact eq.trans (by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by omega : 0 < T.d₀)])
  have hmpos : 0 < n/T.d₀ := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd he) (by omega)
  exact ⟨e,⟨(T.d₁,T.rest),(mem_thirdFactors hmpos T.rest).mpr ⟨T.second_mod hd,T.rest_factors,hm.symm⟩⟩⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.joinTerm
declarations.snippet:
private def joinTerm {n : ℕ} (p : Splits n) : BracketTerm n := by
  obtain ⟨hdiv,h7⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp p.1.property
  obtain ⟨he,hn⟩ := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hdiv
  have hm := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd he) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  obtain ⟨h3,hR,hprod⟩ := (mem_thirdFactors (b := p.2.val.1) hm p.2.val.2).mp p.2.property
  refine ⟨p.1.val,p.2.val.1,p.2.val.2,h7,Or.inr h3,by omega,hR,?_⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc,hprod,Nat.mul_comm,Nat.div_mul_cancel he]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.splitEquiv
declarations.snippet:
private def splitEquiv (n : ℕ) (hn : n%8=5) : BracketTerm n ≃ Splits n where
  toFun := splitTerm hn
  invFun := joinTerm
  left_inv T := BracketTerm.ext rfl rfl rfl
  right_inv p := by rcases p with ⟨⟨e,h⟩,⟨⟨b,R⟩,k⟩⟩; rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.printedCoefficient_split
declarations.snippet:
theorem printedCoefficient_split {n : ℕ} (hn : n%8=5) : printedCoefficient n hn =
    ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e%8=7), genusNumber e * thirdSum (n/e) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.TraceAction.ClassThreePeriods
declarations.snippet:
def ClassThreePeriods (L : ℕ → ℤ) : Prop :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.fromTable
declarations.snippet:
@[noinline] def fromTable (b : Book) (base : Coords) (stored : Array (Option Cell))
    (top : Nat×ProjectionDescent.Polynomial) (rest : Rows) : Outputs :=
  let env := select base stored
  let a := (clearRow b env top.2).num
  let s := squares b (integer b 0) (rowWords b env rest)
  let input := varWord b 1
  let a2 := times b a a
  ⟨plus b a2 s,plus b a2 (times b (times b input input) s)⟩

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.push
declarations.snippet: private def push (p : List Op) (op : Op) : Emitted := ⟨p++[op],p.length⟩

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.emit
declarations.snippet:
def emit (b : Book) (p : List Op) : Word→Emitted
  | .int k => push p (.int k)
  | .var i => push p (.var i)
  | .ref i => if i<b.ops.size then ⟨p,i⟩ else push p (.int 0)
  | .add a c =>
    let l := emit b p a
    let r := emit b l.code c
    push r.code (.add l.index r.index)
  | .mul a c =>
    let l := emit b p a
    let r := emit b l.code c
    push r.code (.mul l.index r.index)

  | .var i => "v|"++toString i

  | .mul a b => "m|"++toString a++"|"++toString b

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.dump
declarations.snippet:
private def dump (g : Bool) : IO Unit := do
  let seed := Seeds.nodes g
  IO.println s!"SEED {seed.size}"
  for op in seed do IO.println (showNode op)
  let p := published g
  IO.println s!"PROGRAM {p.nodes.length} {p.ordinary} {p.marked}"
  for op in p.nodes do IO.println (showNode op)
  for i in List.range 153 do IO.println s!"SLOT {back (i+1)} {Triangular.Data.w (back (i+1))}"
  for r in source g do
    IO.println s!"SOURCE {r.1}"
    for t in r.2 do IO.println (toString t.coefficient ++ "|" ++ String.intercalate "," (t.monomial.map toString))
  let b := Book.make seed
  let base := initial b code
  let stored := cells b (ps g) base
  let env := select base stored
  for pivot in ps g do
    let c := env pivot.slot
    IO.println s!"PIVOT {pivot.id} {pivot.slot} {reference c.num} {c.den}"
  for row in top::rest g do
    let c := clearRow b env row.2
    IO.println s!"ROW {row.1} {reference c.num} {c.den}"
  IO.println s!"MARK {p.eval true (finiteLift designated)}"
  IO.println "END"

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.badHint
declarations.snippet:
private def badHint (forward : Bool) : Program :=
  let ops : Array Op := if forward then #[.add 1 1,.var 1] else #[.var 1,.mul 0 0]
  let i := if forward then 1 else 0
  let wrong := if forward then 0 else 1
  let index : Std.HashMap Op Nat := ({} : Std.HashMap Op Nat).insert (.add i i) wrong
  let b : Book := ⟨ops,index⟩
  finish b (plus b (.ref i) (.ref i)) (.ref i)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.controlDump
declarations.snippet:
private def controlDump : IO Unit := do
  for forward in [false,true] do
    let p := badHint forward
    IO.println s!"BAD_HINT {forward} {p.nodes.length} {p.ordinary} {p.eval false (fun _ => 3)}"

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.splitAt
declarations.snippet:
private theorem splitAt {ops : List Op} {i : Nat} {op : Op} (h : ops[i]?=some op) :
    ∃ pre tail : List Op, ops=pre++op::tail ∧ pre.length=i := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.instruction
declarations.snippet:
theorem instruction {ops : List Op} {i : Nat} {op : Op} (look : ops[i]?=some op)
    (safe : op.safe i) (x : Assignment) : valueAt ops x i=op.value x (valueAt ops x) := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Book.make

def Book.make (ops : Array Op) : Book :=
  ⟨ops,ops.toList.zipIdx.foldl (fun m p => m.insert p.1 p.2) {}⟩

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Word
declarations.snippet:
inductive Word where
  | ref (index : Nat)
  | int (c : Int)
  | var (i : Nat)
  | add (left right : Word)
  | mul (left right : Word)
  deriving Repr

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Word.value
declarations.snippet:
def Word.value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) : Word→Rat
  | .ref i => valueAt b.ops.toList x i
  | .int n => n
  | .var i => x i
  | .add a c => a.value b x+c.value b x
  | .mul a c => a.value b x*c.value b x

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.reuse
declarations.snippet:
def reuse (b : Book) (op : Op) (fallback : Word) : Word :=
  match b.index[op]? with
  | none => fallback
  | some i => if b.ops[i]?=some op ∧ op.safe i then .ref i else fallback

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.reuse_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem reuse_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (op : Op) (w : Word)
    (eq : w.value b x=op.value x (valueAt b.ops.toList x)) : (reuse b op w).value b x=w.value b x := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.integer
declarations.snippet: def integer (b : Book) (n : Int) := reuse b (.int n) (.int n)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.varWord
declarations.snippet: def varWord (b : Book) (i : Nat) := reuse b (.var i) (.var i)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.integer_value
declarations.snippet: theorem integer_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (n : Int) : (integer b n).value b x=n :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.variable_value
declarations.snippet: theorem variable_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (i : Nat) : (varWord b i).value b x=x i :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Word.number?
declarations.snippet: def Word.number? (b : Book) : Word→Option Int | .int n => some n | .ref i => match b.ops[i]? with | some (.int n) => some n | _ => none | _ => none

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.number_value
declarations.snippet: theorem number_value {w : Word} {b : Book} {n : Int} (h : w.number? b=some n) (x : Assignment) : w.value b x=n := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Kind
declarations.snippet: inductive Kind | add | mul

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Kind.op
declarations.snippet: def Kind.op : Kind→Nat→Nat→Op | .add => Op.add | .mul => Op.mul

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Kind.tree
declarations.snippet: def Kind.tree : Kind→Word→Word→Word | .add => Word.add | .mul => Word.mul

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Kind.act
declarations.snippet: def Kind.act : Kind→Rat→Rat→Rat | .add => (·+·) | .mul => (·*·)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.tree_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem tree_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (k : Kind) (u v : Word) :
    (k.tree u v).value b x=k.act (u.value b x) (v.value b x) := by cases k <;> rfl

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.combine
declarations.snippet:
def combine (b : Book) (k : Kind) (u v : Word) : Word :=
  match u,v with
  | .ref i,.ref j =>
    let node := if i≤j then k.op i j else k.op j i
    reuse b node (k.tree (.ref i) (.ref j))
  | _,_ => k.tree u v

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.combine_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem combine_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (k : Kind) (u v : Word) :
    (combine b k u v).value b x=k.act (u.value b x) (v.value b x) := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.plus
declarations.snippet:
def plus (b : Book) (u v : Word) : Word :=
  match u.number? b,v.number? b with
  | some n,some m => integer b (n+m)
  | some n,none => if n=0 then v else combine b .add u v
  | none,some m => if m=0 then u else combine b .add u v
  | none,none => combine b .add u v

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.plus_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem plus_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (u v : Word) :
    (plus b u v).value b x=u.value b x+v.value b x := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.special
declarations.snippet:
def special (b : Book) (n : Int) (other normal : Word) :=
  if n=0 then integer b 0 else if n=1 then other else normal

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.special_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem special_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (n : Int) (u v : Word)
    (normal : v.value b x=(n:Rat)*u.value b x) : (special b n u v).value b x=(n:Rat)*u.value b x := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.times
declarations.snippet:
def times (b : Book) (u v : Word) : Word :=
  match u.number? b,v.number? b with
  | some n,some m => integer b (n*m)
  | some n,none => special b n v (combine b .mul u v)
  | none,some m => special b m u (combine b .mul u v)
  | none,none => combine b .mul u v

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.times_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem times_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (u v : Word) :
    (times b u v).value b x=u.value b x*v.value b x := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.quartic
declarations.snippet: def quartic (a b z : Rat) : Rat := 1-2*(a+b)*z^2+((a-b)*z^2)^2

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.ordinary
declarations.snippet: def ordinary (a b u : Rat) : Rat := (a^2+b^2)*quartic a b u

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.guarded
declarations.snippet: def guarded (a b h u : Rat) : Rat := (a^2+b^2+(h*u-1)^2)*quartic a b (h*u)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.nonzeroMul
declarations.snippet: private theorem nonzeroMul {a b : Rat} (ha : a≠0) (hb : b≠0) : a*b≠0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.sq_eq_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem sq_eq_zero {r : Rat} (h : r^2=0) : r=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.sq_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem sq_nonneg (r : Rat) : 0≤r^2 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.sum_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem sum_zero {a b : Rat} (ha : 0≤a) (hb : 0≤b) (h : a+b=0) : a=0 ∧ b=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.two_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem two_zero {a b : Rat} (zero : a^2+b^2=0) : a=0 ∧ b=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.cancel
declarations.snippet: private theorem cancel {r x y : Rat} (hr : r≠0) (h : x*r=y*r) : x=y := by grind

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.quartic_ne_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem quartic_ne_zero {a b z : Rat} (point : quartic a b z=0) : z≠0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.quartic_roots
declarations.snippet: theorem quartic_roots {a b z : Rat} (point : quartic a b z=0) : Roots a b := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.reciprocal
declarations.snippet: private theorem reciprocal {x y : Rat} (hxy : x+y≠0) : ∃ z : Rat, quartic (x^2) (y^2) z=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.quartic_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem quartic_iff (a b : Rat) :
    (∃ z : Rat, quartic a b z=0) ↔ Roots a b ∧ ¬(a=0 ∧ b=0) := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.ordinary_iff
declarations.snippet: theorem ordinary_iff (a b : Rat) : (∃ u : Rat, ordinary a b u=0) ↔ Roots a b := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.guarded_iff
declarations.snippet: theorem guarded_iff (a b h : Rat) : (∃ u : Rat, guarded a b h u=0) ↔ h≠0 ∧ Roots a b := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block
declarations.snippet:
structure Block where
  a : Rat
  b : Rat
  c : Rat
  d : Rat
  r : Rat
  s : Rat

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.det
declarations.snippet: def Block.det (B : Block) : Rat := B.a*B.d-B.b*B.c

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.xAdj
declarations.snippet: def Block.xAdj (B : Block) : Rat := B.r*B.d-B.b*B.s

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.yAdj
declarations.snippet: def Block.yAdj (B : Block) : Rat := B.a*B.s-B.r*B.c

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.holds
declarations.snippet: def Block.holds (B : Block) (x y : Rat) : Prop := B.a*x+B.b*y=B.r ∧ B.c*x+B.d*y=B.s

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.scaled
declarations.snippet: def Block.scaled (B : Block) (h x y : Rat) : Prop := B.a*x+B.b*y=h*B.r ∧ B.c*x+B.d*y=h*B.s

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.zeroMatrix
declarations.snippet: def Block.zeroMatrix (B : Block) : Prop := B.a=0 ∧ B.b=0 ∧ B.c=0 ∧ B.d=0

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.zeroSystem
declarations.snippet: def Block.zeroSystem (B : Block) : Prop := B.zeroMatrix ∧ B.r=0 ∧ B.s=0

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.total
declarations.snippet:
def total (f : Block → Rat) : List Block → Rat
  | [] => 0
  | b::bs => f b + total f bs

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.H
declarations.snippet: def H (bs : List Block) := total (fun b => b.det^2) bs

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Nx
declarations.snippet: def Nx (bs : List Block) := total (fun b => b.det*b.xAdj) bs

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Ny
declarations.snippet: def Ny (bs : List Block) := total (fun b => b.det*b.yAdj) bs

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.hNonnegative
declarations.snippet: private theorem hNonnegative (bs : List Block) : 0≤H bs := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.det_zero_of_h_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem det_zero_of_h_zero {bs : List Block} (hz : H bs=0) : ∀ b∈bs, b.det=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.adj_at_solution
declarations.snippet:
private theorem adj_at_solution {b : Block} {x y : Rat} (point : b.holds x y) :
    b.xAdj=b.det*x ∧ b.yAdj=b.det*y := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.numerators
declarations.snippet:
theorem numerators {bs : List Block} {x y : Rat} (sol : ∀ b∈bs, b.holds x y) :
    Nx bs=H bs*x ∧ Ny bs=H bs*y := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.NoRankOne
declarations.snippet: def NoRankOne (bs : List Block) := ∀ b∈bs, b.det=0 → b.zeroMatrix

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Consistent
declarations.snippet: def Consistent (bs : List Block) := ∃ x y : Rat, ∀ b∈bs, b.holds x y

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.RegularRows
declarations.snippet: def RegularRows (bs : List Block) := ∀ b∈bs, b.scaled (H bs) (Nx bs) (Ny bs)

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.ZeroRows
declarations.snippet: def ZeroRows (bs : List Block) := ∀ b∈bs, b.zeroSystem

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.adjugate_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem adjugate_iff {bs : List Block} (shapes : NoRankOne bs) :
    Consistent bs ↔ ((H bs≠0 ∧ RegularRows bs) ∨ ZeroRows bs) := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.paired_projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem paired_projection {bs : List Block} (shapes : NoRankOne bs) (a b c d : Rat) :
    (Consistent bs ∧ Roots a b ∧ Roots c d) ↔
      ∃ u v : Rat, ((RegularRows bs ∧ guarded a b (H bs) u=0) ∨
                    (ZeroRows bs ∧ ordinary a b u=0)) ∧ ordinary c d v=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.squares
declarations.snippet:
private def squares : List Rat → Rat
  | [] => 0
  | x::xs => x^2 + squares xs

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.squares_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem squares_nonneg (xs : List Rat) : 0≤squares xs := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.squares_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem squares_zero (xs : List Rat) : squares xs=0 ↔ ∀ x∈xs, x=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.total_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem total_nonneg (f : Block → Rat) (hf : ∀ B, 0≤f B) (bs : List Block) : 0≤total f bs := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.total_zero
declarations.snippet:
private theorem total_zero (f : Block → Rat) (hf : ∀ B, 0≤f B) (bs : List Block) :
    total f bs=0 ↔ ∀ B∈bs, f B=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.regularValue
declarations.snippet:
private def Block.regularValue (h x y : Rat) (B : Block) :=
  squares [B.a*x+B.b*y-h*B.r,B.c*x+B.d*y-h*B.s]

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.Block.zeroValue
declarations.snippet: private def Block.zeroValue (B : Block) := squares [B.a,B.b,B.c,B.d,B.r,B.s]

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.regular_value
declarations.snippet: private theorem regular_value (h x y : Rat) (B : Block) : B.regularValue h x y=0 ↔ B.scaled h x y := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.zero_value
declarations.snippet: private theorem zero_value (B : Block) : B.zeroValue=0 ↔ B.zeroSystem := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.regularLoss
declarations.snippet:
private def regularLoss (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) :=
  total (Block.regularValue (H bs) (Nx bs) (Ny bs)) bs + (guarded a b (H bs) u)^2

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.zeroLoss
declarations.snippet:
private def zeroLoss (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) :=
  total Block.zeroValue bs + (ordinary a b u)^2

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.pairValue
declarations.snippet:
def pairValue (bs : List Block) (a b c d u v : Rat) :=
  regularLoss bs a b u * zeroLoss bs a b u + (ordinary c d v)^2

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.reg_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem reg_nonneg (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) : 0≤regularLoss bs a b u :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.zero_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem zero_nonneg (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) : 0≤zeroLoss bs a b u :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.pairValue_nonnegative
declarations.snippet: theorem pairValue_nonnegative (bs : List Block) (a b c d u v : Rat) : 0≤pairValue bs a b c d u v :=

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.total_sq
declarations.snippet:
private theorem total_sq (f : Block → Rat) (hf : ∀ B, 0≤f B) (bs : List Block) (z : Rat) :
    total f bs+z^2=0 ↔ (∀ B∈bs, f B=0) ∧ z=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.regular_loss
declarations.snippet:
private theorem regular_loss (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) :
    regularLoss bs a b u=0 ↔ RegularRows bs ∧ guarded a b (H bs) u=0 := by

declarations.name: CircuitTransport.Pair.zero_loss
declarations.snippet:
private theorem zero_loss (bs : List Block) (a b u : Rat) :
    zeroLoss bs a b u=0 ↔ ZeroRows bs ∧ ordinary a b u=0 := by

  ∃ g : Γ, (I.map ι).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = Subgroup.zpowers (s ^ m)

ZInQBlueprint.ContactRamification.TameFibre
declarations.snippet:
structure TameFibre (I : Subgroup A) (ι : A →* Γ) (s₀ sPole s₃ : Γ) (p : ℕ) (u : ℚ) : Prop where
  injective : Function.Injective ι
  zeroOrder : orderOf s₀ = 4
  poleOrder : orderOf sPole = 6
  thirdOrder : orderOf s₃ = 2
  zero : 0 < padicValRat p (J u) → ConjugatePower I ι s₀ (padicValRat p (J u))
  pole : padicValRat p (J u) < 0 → ConjugatePower I ι sPole (-padicValRat p (J u))
  third : 0 < padicValRat p (J u + 16/27) → ConjugatePower I ι s₃ (padicValRat p (J u + 16/27))
  away : padicValRat p (J u) = 0 → padicValRat p (J u + 16/27) ≤ 0 → I.map ι = ⊥

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.admissiblePartitionEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def admissiblePartitionEquiv {d : ℕ} (hd : d % 8 = 5) (hs : Squarefree d) :
    {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃ BracketTerm d := by
  let e : {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃
      ↥(admissibleFactorizations d) := {
    toFun := fun P => ⟨factors P.val,
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨factors_mem hs P.val, (residues_factors P.val).mpr P.property⟩⟩
    invFun := fun F => by
      obtain ⟨hF, hR⟩ := mem_filter.mp F.property
      refine ⟨partitionOf hs F.val hF, (residues_factors _).mp ?_⟩
      rwa [factors_partitionOf]
    left_inv := fun P => Subtype.ext (factors_injective (factors_partitionOf hs (factors_mem hs P.val)))
    right_inv := fun F => Subtype.ext (factors_partitionOf hs (mem_filter.mp F.property).1)
  }
  exact e.trans (bracketEquiv d hd).symm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unique_owner
ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.partitionOf
declarations.snippet:
def partitionOf {d : ℕ} (hs : Squarefree d) (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : F ∈ factorizations d) :
    PrimePartition d := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hlt, hprod⟩ := (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero F).mp hF
  refine Finpartition.ofExistsUnique (F.image (primeBlock d)) (fun _ _ => subset_univ _) ?_ ?_
  · intro p _
    have hpr := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.property).prime
    have hdiv := (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors p.property).trans (dvd_of_eq hprod.symm)
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := (hpr.dvd_finsetProd_iff id).mp hdiv
    refine ⟨primeBlock d a, ⟨mem_image_of_mem _ ha, mem_primeBlock.mpr hpa⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro B ⟨hB, hpB⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hB
    exact congrArg (primeBlock d) (unique_owner hs (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.property)
      hprod hb ha (mem_primeBlock.mp hpB) hpa)
  · intro hemp
    obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := mem_image.mp hemp
    have had : a ∣ d := hprod ▸ dvd_prod_of_mem id ha
    have hone : a = 1 := by
      rw [← dProd_primeBlock hs had, h]
      simp [dProd]
    exact (ne_of_gt (hlt a ha)) hone

  invFun F := partitionOf hs F.val F.property

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unorderedFactorizationEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def unorderedFactorizationEquiv (d : ℕ) (hs : Squarefree d) :
    {s : Multiset ℕ // (∀ a ∈ s, 1 < a) ∧ s.prod = d} ≃ ↥(factorizations d) where
  toFun s := by
    have hsq : Squarefree s.val.prod := by rw [s.property.2]; exact hs
    let F : Finset ℕ := ⟨s.val, nodup_of_squarefree_product s.val hsq s.property.1⟩
    refine ⟨F, (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero F).mpr ⟨s.property.1, ?_⟩⟩
    simpa [Finset.prod, F] using s.property.2
  invFun F := by
    obtain ⟨hlt,hprod⟩ := (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero _).mp F.property
    refine ⟨F.val.val, hlt, ?_⟩
    change (F.val.val.map id).prod = d at hprod
    simpa only [Multiset.map_id] using hprod
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.IntegralOrbit

structure IntegralOrbit (A B : ℕ → O) (n : ℕ) : Prop where
  charts : ∀ i, ∃ a b c : R, coprime a b ∧ chart a b c ∧ A i=asOrder (sq a) ∧ B i=asOrder (sq b)
  origin : B 0=0
  generator : A 1*B1=B 1*A1
  doubleCross : ∀ i, rawA (A i) (B i)*B (2*i)=rawB (A i) (B i)*A (2*i)
  addition : ∀ j : ℕ, j+2≤n →
    let a := A (2*(j+2)); let b := B (2*(j+2))
    let c := A (2*j); let e := B (2*j)
    let i := 4*(j+1)
    (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(A i*B 4+B i*A 4)=(2*(a*e+b*c)*(a*c-D*b*e))*(A i*A 4) ∧
    (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(B i*B 4)=(a*e-b*c)^2*(A i*A 4)

def GoodReductionRows {y : Fin 80 → Rat} (f : RootFractions y) (s : Labels) (i : Fin 4) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : Ideal O) (j : Fin 4), M.IsMaximal → asOrder rho ∉ M → asOrder QuadraticInt.delta ∉ M →
    asOrder (QuadraticInt.sq (f.a i)) ∈ M → asOrder (QuadraticInt.sq (f.b j)) ∈ M →
    ∃ (G : AddGrpCat.{0}) (P T : G), T≠0 ∧ (2:ℤ) • T=0 ∧

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.factor_at_good_places
declarations.snippet:
def factor_at_good_places (y : Fin 80 → Rat) (zero : Binding.V y 9813=0)
    (f : RootFractions y) (s : Labels) (i : Fin 4) (largest : (label s i).natAbs=labelSize s)
    (odd : ∀ j, j≠i → label s j%2=1) (good : GoodReductionRows f s i) : PrimitiveFactor (decoded y) s := by
  let a j:=QuadraticInt.sq (f.a j)
  let b j:=QuadraticInt.sq (f.b j)
  have rows (j) := Primitive.physical_square_representation y j (f.point j)
  refine {row:=i,largest:=largest,a:=a i,b:=b i,e:=otherThree a i,f:=otherThree b i,
          point:=rows i,others:=rest_fraction rows i,primeToDenominator:=?_}
  obtain ⟨h,_,_⟩:=Labels.physical_root_charts y zero i
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩:=clear_chart h (f.point i)
  obtain ⟨atTwo,atSeven⟩:=exceptional_coprime (f.primitive i) hc
  apply coprime_back
  rw [all_denominators]
  exact numerator_coprime_denominators (asOrder (a i)) (asOrder rho) (asOrder QuadraticInt.delta)
    (fun j=>asOrder (b j)) (label s) i (bezout_in_order atTwo) (bezout_in_order atSeven) odd good

    {q : Nat} (two : 2≤q) (growth : (q^((label g.labels g.factor.row).natAbs^2))^2≤(QuadraticInt.norm g.factor.a).natAbs) :
    IntegerData x := by
  refine ⟨g.labels,g.places,?_,g.height,g.oddFirst,g.lastNonzero,g.offsetNonzero,g.anchor⟩
  have h:=greatest_index_bound dom g.factor q growth
  have b:=Nat.pow_le_pow_left two ((labelSize g.labels)^2)

  omega

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.roots
declarations.snippet:
def roots (x : Fin 84 → Rat) (i : Fin 4) : Q2 :=
  match i with
  | 0 => sq (cell x 2,cell x 3)
  | 1 => sq (atWire x 182*cell x 5,atWire x 182*cell x 6)
  | 2 => sq (cell x 7,cell x 8)
  | _ => sq (cell x 10,cell x 11)

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.rest
declarations.snippet:
def rest (x : Fin 84 → Rat) (i : Fin 4) : Q2 :=
  match i with
  | 0 => times (times (roots x 1) (roots x 2)) (roots x 3)
  | 1 => times (times (roots x 0) (roots x 2)) (roots x 3)
  | 2 => times (times (roots x 0) (roots x 1)) (roots x 3)
  | _ => times (times (roots x 0) (roots x 1)) (roots x 2)

    z=times a (times (times b c) d) ∧ z=times b (times (times a c) d) ∧
    z=times c (times (times a b) d) ∧ z=times d (times (times a b) c) := by

    (middle : (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(A*E+B*C) = (2*(a*e+b*c)*(a*c-D*b*e))*(A*C))
    (bottom : (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(B*E) = (a*e-b*c)^2*(A*C))
    (live : d.norm (a*c+D*b*e) ≠ 0)
    (plus : |d.plus (D*b*e)| ≤ |d.plus (a*c)|)
    (minus : |d.minus (D*b*e)| ≤ |d.minus (a*c)|) :

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.PhysicalOrder.realNorm
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def realNorm : NormData O where
  norm := Zsqrtd.normMonoidHom
  plus := Zsqrtd.lift ⟨Real.sqrt 2, by norm_num [Real.mul_self_sqrt]⟩
  minus := Zsqrtd.lift ⟨-Real.sqrt 2, by norm_num [Real.mul_self_sqrt]⟩
  factor := by
    intro z
    change ((z.re*z.re-2*z.im*z.im : ℤ):ℝ) =
      ((z.re:ℝ)+z.im*Real.sqrt 2)*((z.re:ℝ)+z.im*(-Real.sqrt 2))
    push_cast
    linear_combination (z.im:ℝ)^2*(Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2))

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.PhysicalOrder.Coordinates
declarations.snippet:
structure Coordinates (A B : ℕ → O) (n : ℕ) : Prop where
  numeratorLive : ∀ i, realNorm.norm (A i) ≠ 0
  origin : mass realNorm (A 0) = mass realNorm 1
  first : mass realNorm (A 1) = mass realNorm A1
  second : mass realNorm (A 2) = mass realNorm A2
  primitive : ∀ i, ∃ u v : O, u*A i+v*B i=1
  plusBranch : ∀ i, realNorm.plus (D*(B i)^2) ≤ (realNorm.plus (A i))^2
  minusBranch : ∀ i, realNorm.minus (D*(B i)^2) ≤ (realNorm.minus (A i))^2
  plusSign : ∀ i, 0 ≤ realNorm.plus (A i)*realNorm.plus (B i)
  minusSign : ∀ i, 0 ≤ realNorm.minus (A i)*realNorm.minus (B i)
  evenRaw : ∀ i, mass realNorm (rawA (A (2*i)) (B (2*i))) = mass realNorm (A (4*i))
  lastRaw : A (2*n) ∣ rawA (A n) (B n)
  middle : ∀ j : ℕ, j+2 ≤ n →
    let a := A (2*(j+2)); let b := B (2*(j+2))
    let c := A (2*j); let e := B (2*j)
    let i := 4*(j+1)
    (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(A i*B 4+B i*A 4) = (2*(a*e+b*c)*(a*c-D*b*e))*(A i*A 4)
  bottom : ∀ j : ℕ, j+2 ≤ n →
    let a := A (2*(j+2)); let b := B (2*(j+2))
    let c := A (2*j); let e := B (2*j)
    let i := 4*(j+1)
    (a*c+D*b*e)^2*(B i*B 4) = (a*e-b*c)^2*(A i*A 4)

theorem exact_norms :
    Quad.norm (orbit 0).1=41^2 ∧ Quad.norm (orbit 1).1=4905889^2 ∧
    (4:Nat)*41^12<4905889^3 ∧ Quad.norm (⟨12,-6⟩:Quad)=72 := by decide

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.realize
declarations.snippet: def realize (s : K) (x : Quad) : K := (x.a:K)+(x.b:K)*s

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.realize_add
declarations.snippet:
private theorem realize_add (s : K) (x y : Quad) :
    realize s (x.add y)=realize s x+realize s y := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.realize_sub
declarations.snippet:
private theorem realize_sub (s : K) (x y : Quad) :
    realize s (x.sub y)=realize s x-realize s y := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.realize_mul
declarations.snippet:
private theorem realize_mul (s : K) (root : s^2=2) (x y : Quad) :
    realize s (x.mul y)=realize s x*realize s y := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.realize_sq
declarations.snippet:
private theorem realize_sq (s : K) (root : s^2=2) (x : Quad) :
    realize s x.sq=(realize s x)^2 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.coeff
declarations.snippet: private theorem coeff (s : K) (root : s^2=2) : realize s D=(3-s)^2 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.next_values
EllipticHeight.Duplication.start_values
declarations.snippet:
private theorem start_values (s : K) :
    realize s (orbit 0).1=57-28*s ∧ realize s (orbit 0).2=8 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.primitive_in_every_residue_field
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_in_every_residue_field (s : K) (root : s^2=2) (n : Nat) :
    realize s (orbit n).1≠0 ∨ realize s (orbit n).2≠0 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.dyadic_norm_even
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_norm_even (i j : Int) :
    ∃k:Int, Quad.norm (((⟨2*i+1,2*j⟩:Quad).sq).add ⟨1,0⟩)=16*k+4 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.dyadic_norm_odd
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_norm_odd (i j : Int) :
    ∃k:Int, Quad.norm (((⟨2*i+1,2*j+1⟩:Quad).sq).add ⟨1,0⟩)=16*k+8 := by

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.Duplication.seven_nonsquare
declarations.snippet: theorem seven_nonsquare : ∀ x : Fin 7, (x.val^2+1)%7≠0 := by decide

declarations.name: EllipticHeight.numerator_coprime_denominators
declarations.snippet:
theorem numerator_coprime_denominators {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (A r d : R) (B : Fin 4 → R) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) (i : Fin 4)
    (atTwo : IsCoprime A r) (atSeven : IsCoprime A d)
    (odd : ∀ j, j ≠ i → n j % 2 = 1)
    (reduction : ∀ (M : Ideal R) (j : Fin 4), M.IsMaximal → r ∉ M → d ∉ M →
      A ∈ M → B j ∈ M →
        ∃ (G : AddGrpCat.{v}) (P T : G),
          T ≠ 0 ∧ (2 : ℤ) • T = 0 ∧ n i • P = T ∧ n j • P = 0) :
    IsCoprime A (∏ j, B j) := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem tangent_half {K : Type} [Field K] [IsCharP K 0] {h j D t : K} (nonzero : D≠0)
    (chart : j^2=h^4-D) (square : t^2=2*(h^2+j)) :
    let a:=h*t+(h^2+j)
    let b:=a*t
    let slope:=h+t
    b≠0 ∧ b^2=a^3-D*a ∧ 2*b*slope=3*a^2-D ∧
      slope^2-2*a=h^2 ∧ slope*(a-h^2)-b=h*j := by

    (atZ : (slope*z+b)^2=z*(z^2+A*z+B)) :
    x*z*(slope^2-A-x-z)=b^2 := by

  ∀ v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ),
    ∃ x y z : v.adicCompletion ℚ,
      x ^ 2 + 6 * y ^ 2 - 2 * z ^ 2 =

    -f ((1 : ℚ) / 3) * x ^ 2 - f 2 * y ^ 2 + f ((1 : ℚ) / 3) * f 2 * z ^ 2 =

private inductive Op where
  | integer (c : ℤ)
  | param (i : ℕ)
  | root (i : ℕ)
  | plus (a b : ℕ)
  | times (a b : ℕ)

declarations.name: EncodedTower.readOp
declarations.snippet:
private def readOp (s : String) : Option Op := do
  match s.splitOn " " with
  | ["integer",c] => return .integer (← c.toInt?)
  | ["parameter",i] => return .param (← i.toNat?)
  | ["root",i] => return .root (← i.toNat?)
  | ["add",a,b] => return .plus (← a.toNat?) (← b.toNat?)
  | ["multiply",a,b] => return .times (← a.toNat?) (← b.toNat?)
  | _ => none

declarations.snippet: private def lines (s : String) := (s.splitOn "\n").filter (!·.isEmpty)

declarations.snippet: private def numbers (s : String) := (s.splitOn " ").mapM String.toNat?

declarations.name: EncodedTower.Data
EncodedTower.decode
EncodedTower.levels
declarations.snippet:
private def levels (b : Data) (m stages : ℕ) : Option (Array ℕ) :=
  b.ops.foldlM (fun (r : Array ℕ) op => do
    let v : ℕ ← match op with
      | .integer _ => pure 0
      | .param j => if j < m then pure 0 else none
      | .root j => if j < stages then pure (j+1) else none
      | .plus a b | .times a b => (max <$> r[a]? <*> r[b]?)
    return r.push v) #[]

declarations.name: EncodedTower.valid
declarations.snippet:
def valid (b : Data) (m degreeCount nodeCount equationCount : ℕ) : Bool := Id.run do
  let some ℓ := levels b m degreeCount | return false
  let [eqs,guards] := b.tests | return false
  return b.ops.size == nodeCount && b.stages.length == degreeCount && eqs.length == equationCount &&
    guards.length == degreeCount && eqs.all (· < b.ops.size) &&
    (b.stages.zip guards).zipIdx.all fun ((coeff,guard),i) =>
      [1,2,4].contains coeff.length && (guard :: coeff).all (fun j =>
        (ℓ[j]?).any (· ≤ i))

declarations.name: EncodedTower.registers
declarations.snippet:
private def registers (b : Data) (m n : ℕ) : Array (Test m n) :=
  b.ops.foldl (fun r op => r.push (match op with
    | .integer c => (c : Test m n)
    | .param j => if h : j < m then MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X ⟨j,h⟩) else 0
    | .root j => if h : j < n then MvPolynomial.X ⟨n-1-j, by omega⟩ else 0
    | .plus a b => r[a]! + r[b]!
    | .times a b => r[a]! * r[b]!)) #[]

declarations.name: EncodedTower.step
declarations.snippet:
private def step (b : Data) {m n : ℕ} (t : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (ids : List ℕ) :
    ParamTower (Poly m) (n+1) :=
  let values := registers b m n
  let coeff : Fin ids.length → Test m n := fun i => values[ids[i]]!
  let f := Polynomial.X ^ ids.length +
    ∑ i : Fin ids.length, Polynomial.C (coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ (i : ℕ)
  .adjoin t f (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.degree_sum_fin_lt coeff))

declarations.name: EncodedTower.pack
declarations.snippet:
private def pack (b : Data) (m : ℕ) : List (List ℕ) → Σ n, ParamTower (Poly m) n
  | [] => ⟨0,.base⟩
  | c :: cs => let p := pack b m cs; ⟨p.1+1, step b p.2 c⟩

declarations.name: EncodedTower.asBranch
declarations.snippet:
def asBranch (b : Data) (m : ℕ) : RelativeWidth.TowerBranch m :=
  let t := pack b m b.stages.reverse
  let polys := registers b m t.1
  let select := fun (i : ℕ) => b.tests[i]!.map fun j => polys[j]!
  ⟨t.1,t.2,select 0,select 1⟩

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.select_from_full
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def select_from_full {x : Fin 84→Rat} (g : FullArithmetic x) : SelectedArithmetic x := by
  let f:=maximumFrame (M x)
  let V:=detectorConstant*(M x f)^17
  have bound (i : Scale) : comparisonBound x i ≤ V+2 :=
    Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (le_maximum (M x) i) 17)) 2
  have top:=three_max (P:=fun k=>k≤V+2) (bound .first) (bound .second) (bound .third)
  have mid:=Nat.le_trans g.abscissas (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 top) 15)
  have pos:=Nat.pow_pos (scale_radical_pos x f) (n:=17)
  have hi : 32≤V := Nat.le_trans (by decide +kernel : 32≤detectorConstant)
    (by simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left detectorConstant pos)
  refine ⟨g.labels,f,?_,?_,Or.inr ⟨fun p hp=>⟨g.scalarMultiplier,g.scalarCharts p hp⟩,g.scalarHeight⟩,
    g.oddFirst,g.lastNonzero,g.anchorNonzero,g.anchor⟩
  · have charts {i} (a : FullFrame x i g.labels) : ComparisonCharts x i g.labels :=
      fun p hp=>⟨a.multiplier,a.charts p hp⟩
    have all (i : Scale) : ComparisonCharts x i g.labels := by
      cases i with
      | first=>exact charts g.first
      | second=>exact charts g.second
      | third=>exact charts g.third
    exact all f
  · change _ < (2*detectorConstant)*(M x f)^17
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    change _ < 2*V
    omega

def SourceArithmetic.selected {x : Fin 84→Rat} (g : SourceArithmetic x)
    (zero : output false x=0) (scalar : ScalarCondition x g.labels.n₂) : SelectedArithmetic x := by
  have dom:=fromZero_domain x false (by simp) zero
  have tight:=joint_root_bound dom g.product g.height
  have roots : (labelSize g.labels)^2 < rootConstant*(M x (tallest x))^17 := by
    change _ < (2*detectorConstant)*(M x (tallest x))^17
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc];omega
  refine ⟨g.labels,tallest x,?_,roots,
    scalar,g.oddFirst,g.lastNonzero,g.offsetNonzero,g.anchor⟩
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨s⟩:=g.places p hp
  exact ⟨s.multiplier,s.contact hp⟩

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.LogLaw
declarations.snippet:
structure LogLaw (K : Type) [Field K] [LE K] [LT K] where
  log : K→K
  monotone : ∀{x y},0<x → x≤y → log x≤log y
  power : ∀{x},0<x → ∀ n : Nat,log (x^n)=(n:K)*log x
  upper : ∀{x},0<x → log x≤x

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.bigger
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def bigger (x y : K) : K := by classical exact if x≤y then y else x

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.first_le_bigger
declarations.snippet: theorem first_le_bigger (x y : K) : x≤bigger x y := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.bigger_le
declarations.snippet: theorem bigger_le {x y z : K} (hx : x≤z) (hy : y≤z) : bigger x y≤z := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.variation
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def variation (l : LogLaw K) (g d : Nat) (j : K) : K :=
  ((16*g^4:Nat):K)*l.log ((7*g:Nat):K) +
  ((2*g^2:Nat):K)*l.log (d:K) +
  ((2*g^2:Nat):K)*l.log (bigger 1 (bigger (l.log (d:K)) j))

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.lift_le
declarations.snippet: private theorem lift_le {a b : Nat} (h : a≤b) : (a:K)≤(b:K) := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ h

    (dpos : 0<d) (degree : d≤2304*X) (large : 65536≤X) (j : K)
    (belyi : j≤((13000000*g*X^5:Nat):K)) : variation l g d j≤((52*X^5:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.budget_integer
declarations.snippet:
theorem budget_integer (g X : Nat) (gx : 12*g≤X) (large : 65536≤X) :

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.modular_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem modular_height (l : LogLaw K) (g d gf t X : Nat) (gx : 12*g≤X) (gp : 0<g)
    (dpos : 0<d) (degree : d≤2304*X) (large : 65536≤X) (multiplicity : t≤2*gf)
    (hA J U : K) (belyi : J≤((13000000*g*X^5:Nat):K))
    (isogeny : (gf:K)*hA+2*U≤2*J+2*variation l g d J) (bost : -((3*g:Nat):K)≤2*U) :
    (t:K)*hA≤((4333334*X^6:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.tripleDen
declarations.snippet: def tripleDen (a b : Rat) : Nat := Nat.lcm a.den b.den

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.tripleNum
declarations.snippet: def tripleNum (d : Nat) (a : Rat) : Int := ((d/a.den:Nat):Int)*a.num

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.embedRat
declarations.snippet: def embedRat (a : Rat) : K := (a.num:K)/(a.den:K)

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.quadConstant
declarations.snippet: def quadConstant (m n : Int) : Int := m^2-2*n^2

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.quadContent
declarations.snippet: def quadContent (d : Nat) (m n : Int) := Nat.gcd (d^2) (Nat.gcd (2*d*m.natAbs) (quadConstant m n).natAbs)

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.primitiveConstant
declarations.snippet: def primitiveConstant (d : Nat) (m n : Int) := (quadConstant m n).natAbs / quadContent d m n

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.realFactor
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def realFactor (d : Nat) (x : K) : K := bigger (d:K) (bigger x (-x))

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.archProduct
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def archProduct (d : Nat) (m n : Int) (r : K) : K :=
  realFactor d ((m:K)+(n:K)*r)*realFactor d ((m:K)-(n:K)*r)

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.triple_bounds
declarations.snippet:
theorem triple_bounds (a b : Rat) :
    let d:=tripleDen a b
    let J:=jointHeight a b
    0<d ∧ d≤J ∧ (tripleNum d a).natAbs≤J ∧ (tripleNum d b).natAbs≤J := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem scaled_coordinate (a : Rat) (d : Nat) (clear : a.den∣d) :

declarations.snippet:
private theorem positive_factor (d : Nat) (x : K) (pos : 0<d) (dominates : (d:K)≤x) :

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.cast_square
declarations.snippet: private theorem cast_square (x : Int) : (x:K)^2=((x.natAbs^2:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.positive_arch_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_arch_product (d J : Nat) (m n : Int) (r : K) (sqrtTwo : r^2=2)
    (dp : 0<d) (mJ : m.natAbs≤J)
    (plus : (d:K)≤(m:K)+(n:K)*r) (minus : (d:K)≤(m:K)-(n:K)*r) :
    archProduct d m n r=(quadConstant m n:K) ∧ 0<archProduct d m n r ∧ archProduct d m n r≤((J^2:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.physical_places
declarations.snippet:
private theorem physical_places (a b : Rat) (r : K)
    (plus : 1≤embedRat a+embedRat b*r) (minus : 1≤embedRat a-embedRat b*r) :
    let d:=tripleDen a b
    let m:=tripleNum d a
    let n:=tripleNum d b
    (d:K)≤(m:K)+(n:K)*r ∧ (d:K)≤(m:K)-(n:K)*r := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.positive_joint_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_joint_product (a b : Rat) (r : K) (sqrtTwo : r^2=2)
    (plus : 1≤embedRat a+embedRat b*r) (minus : 1≤embedRat a-embedRat b*r) :
    let d:=tripleDen a b
    let m:=tripleNum d a
    let n:=tripleNum d b
    archProduct d m n r=(quadConstant m n:K) ∧ 0<archProduct d m n r ∧
      archProduct d m n r≤(((jointHeight a b)^2:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.positive_joint_log_upper
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_joint_log_upper (l : LogLaw K) (a b : Rat) (r hC : K) (sqrtTwo : r^2=2)
    (plus : 1≤embedRat a+embedRat b*r) (minus : 1≤embedRat a-embedRat b*r)
    (finite : 2*hC≤l.log (archProduct (tripleDen a b) (tripleNum (tripleDen a b) a) (tripleNum (tripleDen a b) b) r)) :
    hC≤l.log ((jointHeight a b:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.quad_content
declarations.snippet:
theorem quad_content (d : Nat) (m n : Int) (dp : 0<d) :
    let g:=quadContent d m n
    0<g ∧ g∣d^2 ∧ g∣2*d*m.natAbs ∧ g∣(quadConstant m n).natAbs := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.primitive_quadratic
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_quadratic (d : Nat) (m n : Int) (dp : 0<d) :
    let g:=quadContent d m n
    Nat.gcd (d^2/g) (Nat.gcd (2*d*m.natAbs/g) ((quadConstant m n).natAbs/g))=1 := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.positive_primitive_constant
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_primitive_constant (d J : Nat) (m n : Int) (r : K) (sqrtTwo : r^2=2)
    (dp : 0<d) (mJ : m.natAbs≤J) (plus : (d:K)≤(m:K)+(n:K)*r) (minus : (d:K)≤(m:K)-(n:K)*r) :
    0<primitiveConstant d m n ∧ primitiveConstant d m n≤J^2 ∧
      ((primitiveConstant d m n:Nat):K)*((quadContent d m n:Nat):K)=(quadConstant m n:K) := by

HeightSpecialization.Analytic.positive_mahler_log_upper
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_mahler_log_upper (l : LogLaw K) (a b : Rat) (r hC : K) (sqrtTwo : r^2=2)
    (plus : 1≤embedRat a+embedRat b*r) (minus : 1≤embedRat a-embedRat b*r)
    (height : let d:=tripleDen a b
      2*hC=l.log ((primitiveConstant d (tripleNum d a) (tripleNum d b):Nat):K)) :
    hC≤l.log ((jointHeight a b:Nat):K) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.Analytic.rational_double_root

    let d:=tripleDen a 0
    let m:=tripleNum d a
    let n:=tripleNum d 0
    d=a.den ∧ m=a.num ∧ n=0 ∧ quadContent d m n=1 ∧ primitiveConstant d m n=a.num.natAbs^2 := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.WeakTrace.cocycle_trace
declarations.snippet:
theorem cocycle_trace {G I : Type} [IntModule G] (keep : I → Prop) [DecidablePred keep]
    (act : I → G → G) (mapAdd : ∀ i x y, act i (x+y) = act i x + act i y)
    (mapSub : ∀ i x y, act i (x-y) = act i x - act i y)
    (U : G) (c : I → G) (orderTwo : ∀ i, c i+c i=0)
    (liftU : ∀ i, act i U=U+c i) :
    (∃ V, ∀ i, act i V=(if keep i then V else -V)+c i) ↔
    (∃ R, ∀ i, act i R=if keep i then R else U+U-R) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.joint_scale_height

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.joint_sharp_family
declarations.snippet:
theorem joint_sharp_family (q : Nat) (pos : 0<q) :
    let U : Nat := (q^2+1)^2
    let a : Rat := U
    let b := (q:Rat)⁻¹
    let l := a⁻¹
    H l=U ∧ H (a^2*l)=U ∧ H ((1+b^2)^2*l)=q^4 ∧ jointHeight a b=U*q := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.strict_square_height
declarations.snippet:

    (H x)^2 + 1 ≤ H (1+x^2) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.refined_scale_heights
declarations.snippet:
theorem refined_scale_heights {l a b : Rat} {U : Nat} (live : l ≠ 0)
    (nonzero : b ≠ 0) (base : H l ≤ U) (first : H (a^2*l) ≤ U)
    (second : H ((1+b^2)^2*l) ≤ U) :
    (H a*H b)^2 ≤ U^2*(U-1) := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.natural_height
declarations.snippet: private theorem natural_height (n : Nat) (pos : 0 < n) : H (n : Rat) = n := by

declarations.name: HeightSpecialization.sharp_scale_family
declarations.snippet:
theorem sharp_scale_family (n : Nat) (pos : 0 < n) :
    let U : Nat := 1+n^2
    let a : Rat := U
    let b : Rat := n
    let l := a⁻¹
    H l = U ∧ H (a^2*l) = U ∧ H ((1+b^2)^2*l) = U ∧
      (H a*H b)^2 = U^2*(U-1) := by

    let a:=radical f.primes
    let b:=radical g.primes
    let c:=radical h.primes

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.largest_powers_le

    let M:=largest (radical f.primes) (radical g.primes) (radical h.primes)
    let F:=lucas ns.n₂ ns.n₃ ns.n₄
    let numerator:=((ns.n₁:Rat)-B).num
    (F≠0 → M^40≤F.natAbs) ∧ (numerator≠0 → M^10≤numerator.natAbs) := by

    (first : E.contains ((m:R)*l-2*(u:R)))
    (second : E.contains (((m:R)-2)*l'-2*((u:R)-(n:R)))) :

declarations.snippet:
def layerModule (N scale : Nat) (odd : N%2=1) : ErrorModule Rat where
  contains := fractionLayer N scale
  add := by
    rintro x y ⟨a,d,hd,dc,hx⟩ ⟨b,e,he,ec,hy⟩
    refine ⟨a*(e:Int)+b*(d:Int),d*e,Nat.mul_pos hd he,dc.mul_left ec,?_⟩
    simp only [Rat.natCast_mul,Rat.intCast_add,Rat.intCast_mul,Rat.intCast_natCast];grobner
  sub := by
    rintro x y ⟨a,d,hd,dc,hx⟩ ⟨b,e,he,ec,hy⟩
    refine ⟨a*(e:Int)-b*(d:Int),d*e,Nat.mul_pos hd he,dc.mul_left ec,?_⟩
    simp only [Rat.natCast_mul,Rat.intCast_sub,Rat.intCast_mul,Rat.intCast_natCast];grobner
  intMul := by
    rintro i x ⟨a,d,hd,dc,hx⟩
    exact ⟨i*a,d,hd,dc,by rw [Rat.intCast_mul];grobner⟩
  half := by
    rintro x ⟨a,d,hd,dc,hx⟩
    refine ⟨a,2*d,Nat.mul_pos (by decide) hd,(odd_coprime N odd).mul_left dc,?_⟩
    rw [Rat.natCast_mul];change x*(2*(d:Rat))=_;grobner

declarations.name: textOp
declarations.snippet:
private def textOp : Op→String
  | .var n => "v|"++toString n
  | .int n => "i|"++toString n
  | .add i j => "a|"++toString i++"|"++toString j
  | .mul i j => "m|"++toString i++"|"++toString j

declarations.name: dump
declarations.snippet:
private def dump (name : String) (seed : Array Op) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (s : Shape) : IO Unit := do
  let c:=build seed fs rs s
  IO.println s!"PROGRAM {name} {c.ordinary} {c.marked} {c.nodes.length}"
  for op in c.nodes do IO.println (textOp op)
  let b:=Book.make seed
  let ws:=tables b fs rs
  for r in s.high.refs++s.low.refs do
    match fromTables b fs rs ws r with
    | .ref i => IO.println s!"ROW {r.cell} {r.node} {r.origin} {i}"
    | _ => IO.println "UNBOUND ROW"
  IO.println "END"

declarations.name: main
declarations.snippet:
def main : IO Unit := do
  for gate in [false,true] do
    let n:=if gate then "67830" else "510"
    let fs:=families gate
    for (ops,i) in fs.toList.zipIdx do
      IO.println s!"FAMILY {n} {i} {ops.length}"
      for op in ops do IO.println (textOp op)
    dump (n++"-74") (oldSeed gate) fs oldRoutes oldShape
    dump (n++"-134") (newSeed gate) fs newRoutes newShape

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Tree
declarations.snippet:
inductive Tree where
  | leaf (r : Ref)
  | sum (a b : Tree)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Tree.refs
declarations.snippet:
def Tree.refs : Tree → List Ref
  | .leaf r => [r]
  | .sum a b => a.refs++b.refs

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Tree.sos
declarations.snippet:
def Tree.sos (f : Ref→Rat) : Tree→Rat
  | .leaf r => f r * f r
  | .sum a b => a.sos f+b.sos f

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Tree.word
declarations.snippet:
def Tree.word (b : Book) (resolve : Ref→Word) : Tree→Word
  | .leaf r => times b (resolve r) (resolve r)
  | .sum a c => plus b (a.word b resolve) (c.word b resolve)

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Tree.word_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem Tree.word_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (resolve : Ref→Word) (t : Tree) :
    (t.word b resolve).value b x=t.sos (fun r=>(resolve r).value b x) := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem sq_nonneg (a : Rat) : 0≤a*a := by

declarations.snippet: theorem Tree.nonnegative (t : Tree) (f : Ref→Rat) : 0≤t.sos f := by

declarations.snippet: theorem Tree.sos_zero (t : Tree) (f : Ref→Rat) : t.sos f=0 ↔ ∀r∈t.refs,f r=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Shape
declarations.snippet:
structure Shape where
  high : Tree
  low : Tree

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.active
declarations.snippet:
def active (s : Shape) (marked : Bool) (x : Assignment) : List Ref :=
  if marked=true ∧ x 1=0 then s.high.refs else s.high.refs++s.low.refs

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.conditions
declarations.snippet:
def conditions (s : Shape) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (marked : Bool) (x : Assignment) : Prop :=
  ∀ r∈active s marked x, rowValue fs rs x r=0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.frameConditions
declarations.snippet:
def frameConditions (s : Shape) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (marked : Bool) (x : Assignment) (frame : Frame) : Prop :=
  ∀ r∈active s marked x, (rs[r.cell]!).frame=frame → rowValue fs rs x r=0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.grouped
declarations.snippet:
theorem grouped (s : Shape) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (marked : Bool) (x : Assignment) :
    conditions s fs rs marked x ↔
    frameConditions s fs rs marked x .common ∧ frameConditions s fs rs marked x .first ∧
    frameConditions s fs rs marked x .second ∧ frameConditions s fs rs marked x .third ∧
    frameConditions s fs rs marked x .scalar := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.build
declarations.snippet:
def build (seed : Array Op) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (s : Shape) : Program :=
  let b:=Book.make seed
  let table:=tables b fs rs
  let get:=fromTables b fs rs table
  let high:=s.high.word b get
  let low:=s.low.word b get
  let X:=varWord b 1
  finish b (plus b high low) (plus b high (times b (times b X X) low))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.outputs
declarations.snippet:
theorem outputs (seed : Array Op) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (s : Shape) (x : Assignment) :
    let f:=rowValue fs rs x
    ((build seed fs rs s).eval false x=s.high.sos f+s.low.sos f) ∧
    ((build seed fs rs s).eval true x=s.high.sos f+(x 1*x 1)*s.low.sos f) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.pointwise
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointwise (seed : Array Op) (fs : Families) (rs : Routes) (s : Shape) (marked : Bool) (x : Assignment) :
    (build seed fs rs s).eval marked x=0 ↔ conditions s fs rs marked x := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem inside (f : Frame) (i : Nat) (h : inFrame f i=true) : 1≤i ∧ i≤134 := by

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.glue_solutions
declarations.snippet:
theorem glue_solutions (g marked : Bool) (inputs : Frame→Fin 134→Rat)
    (common : ∀f i,i.val<17 → inputs f i=inputs .common i)
    (localRows : ∀f,holds g marked (inputs f) f) :
    (splitProgram g).eval marked (vector (glue inputs))=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.parentProgram
declarations.snippet: def parentProgram (g : Bool) : Program := build (oldSeed g) (families g) oldRoutes oldShape

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.splitProgram
declarations.snippet: def splitProgram (g : Bool) : Program := build (newSeed g) (families g) newRoutes newShape

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.holds
declarations.snippet:
def holds (g marked : Bool) (y : Fin 134→Rat) (f : Frame) :=
  frameConditions newShape (families g) newRoutes marked (vector y) f

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.split_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_iff (g marked : Bool) (y : Fin 134→Rat) :
    (splitProgram g).eval marked (vector y)=0 ↔
    holds g marked y .common ∧ holds g marked y .first ∧ holds g marked y .second ∧
    holds g marked y .third ∧ holds g marked y .scalar :=

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.unpaired_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem unpaired_iff (g marked : Bool) (x : Fin 74→Rat) :
    (parentProgram g).eval marked (vector x)=0 ↔
    conditions oldShape (families g) oldRoutes marked (vector x) := pointwise ..

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diagonal_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_iff (g marked : Bool) (x : Fin 74→Rat) :
    (splitProgram g).eval marked (vector (diagonal x))=0 ↔
    (parentProgram g).eval marked (vector x)=0 :=

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diagonal_projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_projection (g marked : Bool) (a : Rat) :
    (∃x : Fin 74→Rat, vector x 1=a ∧ (parentProgram g).eval marked (vector x)=0) →
    ∃y : Fin 134→Rat, vector y 1=a ∧ (splitProgram g).eval marked (vector y)=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.frame_congr
declarations.snippet:
theorem frame_congr (g marked : Bool) (f : Frame) (x y : Fin 134→Rat)
    (same : ∀i,inFrame f i=true → vector x i=vector y i) :
    holds g marked x f ↔ holds g marked y f := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.axis
declarations.snippet: def axis (a : Rat) (i : Nat) : Rat := if i=1 then a else 0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.protected_row
declarations.snippet:
private theorem protected_row {rs : Routes} (fs : Families) (r : Ref)
    (a : Rat) (h : peakOK rs r=true) : rowValue fs rs (axis a) r=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.high_on_axis
declarations.snippet:
theorem high_on_axis (g : Bool) (a : Rat) :
    oldShape.high.sos (rowValue (families g) oldRoutes (axis a))=0 ∧
    newShape.high.sos (rowValue (families g) newRoutes (axis a))=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.separatelyMarked
IndependentIndices.independent_mark
declarations.snippet: theorem independent_mark (g : Bool) (a : Rat) : separatelyMarked g (axis a) 0=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.separate_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem separate_iff (g : Bool) (x : Assignment) (t : Rat) :
    separatelyMarked g x t=0 ↔
      (∀r∈newShape.high.refs,rowValue (families g) newRoutes x r=0) ∧
      (t=0 ∨ ∀r∈newShape.low.refs,rowValue (families g) newRoutes x r=0) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.actual_mark
declarations.snippet:
theorem actual_mark (g : Bool) (x : Assignment) :
    (splitProgram g).eval true x=separatelyMarked g x (x 1) := (outputs ..).2

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.zero_witness
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_witness (g : Bool) :
    (splitProgram g).eval true (vector (fun _ : Fin 134=>0))=0 ∧
    (parentProgram g).eval true (vector (fun _ : Fin 74=>0))=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.vector
declarations.snippet:
def vector {n : Nat} (x : Fin n→Rat) (i : Nat) : Rat :=
  if hi : 0<i ∧ i≤n then x ⟨i-1,by omega⟩ else 0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.parentAt
declarations.snippet:
def parentAt (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if 0<i ∧ i≤134 then parentLookup i else 0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diagonal
declarations.snippet: def diagonal (x : Fin 74→Rat) (i : Fin 134) : Rat := vector x (parentAt (i.val+1))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diagonal_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_at (x : Fin 74→Rat) (i : Nat) :
    vector (diagonal x) i=vector x (parentAt i) := by
