declarations.snippet: theorem first_input (x : Fin 74→Rat) : vector (diagonal x) 1=vector x 1 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.srcRef
declarations.snippet: def srcRef (r : Ref) : Ref := ⟨(newRoutes[r.cell]!).family,r.node,r.origin⟩

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.correctRoute
declarations.snippet:
def correctRoute (k : Nat) : Bool :=
  let c:=newRoutes[k]!
  let old:=oldRoutes[c.family]!
  decide (old.family=c.family ∧ old.slots.toList=c.slots.toList.map parentAt)

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.inFrame
declarations.snippet:
def inFrame (f : Frame) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (1≤i ∧ i≤17) || match f with
  | .common => false
  | .first => decide (18≤i ∧ i≤52)
  | .second => decide (53≤i ∧ i≤87)
  | .third => decide (88≤i ∧ i≤122)
  | .scalar => decide (123≤i ∧ i≤134)

IndependentIndices.covers
declarations.snippet:
def covers (t s : List Ref) : Bool := t.all (fun r=>s.any (fun q=>decide (srcRef r=q))) &&
    s.all (fun r=>t.any (fun q=>decide (srcRef q=r)))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.matchesAt
declarations.snippet:
def matchesAt (t s : List Ref) (i j : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t[i]?,s[j]? with
  | some q,some r => decide (srcRef q=r)
  | _,_ => false

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.ForwardAt
declarations.snippet:
def ForwardAt (t s : List Ref) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q,t[i]?=some q → ∃r∈s,srcRef q=r

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.BackAt
declarations.snippet:
def BackAt (t s : List Ref) (j : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ r,s[j]?=some r → ∃q∈t,srcRef q=r

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.match_forward
declarations.snippet:
theorem match_forward (t s : List Ref) (i j : Nat) (ok : matchesAt t s i j=true) :

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.match_back
declarations.snippet:
theorem match_back (t s : List Ref) (i j : Nat) (ok : matchesAt t s i j=true) :

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Between
declarations.snippet: def Between (P : Nat→Prop) (lo hi : Nat) : Prop := ∀i,lo≤i → i<hi → P i

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.at_one
declarations.snippet: theorem at_one {P : Nat→Prop} {i : Nat} (h : P i) : Between P i (i+1) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.join_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem join_at {P : Nat→Prop} {lo mid hi : Nat} (a : Between P lo mid) (b : Between P mid hi) :
    Between P lo hi := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.covers_by_addresses
declarations.snippet:
theorem covers_by_addresses (t s : List Ref) (f : Between (ForwardAt t s) 0 t.length)
    (b : Between (BackAt t s) 0 s.length) : covers t s=true := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.flag
declarations.snippet: def flag (bs : Array Bool) (i : Nat) : Bool := bs[i]?.getD false

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.zeroStep
declarations.snippet:
def zeroStep (bs : Array Bool) : Op→Bool
  | .var i => decide (i≠0)
  | .int n => decide (n=0)
  | .add i j => flag bs i && flag bs j
  | .mul i j => flag bs i || flag bs j

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.zeroRun
declarations.snippet:
def zeroRun : List Op→Array Bool→Array Bool
  | [],bs => bs
  | op::ops,bs => zeroRun ops (bs.push (zeroStep bs op))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.Good
declarations.snippet:
private def Good (bs : Array Bool) (xs : Array Rat) :=
  bs.size=xs.size ∧ ∀ i,flag bs i=true → CircuitTransport.read xs i=0

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.step_good
declarations.snippet:
private theorem step_good (x : Assignment) (hx : ∀i, i≠0 → x i=0) {bs : Array Bool} {xs : Array Rat} (h : Good bs xs) (op : Op) :
    zeroStep bs op=true → op.value x (CircuitTransport.read xs)=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.push_good
declarations.snippet:
private theorem push_good (x : Assignment) (hx : ∀i, i≠0 → x i=0) {bs : Array Bool} {xs : Array Rat} (h : Good bs xs) (op : Op) :
    Good (bs.push (zeroStep bs op)) (xs.push (op.value x (CircuitTransport.read xs))) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.run_good
declarations.snippet:
private theorem run_good (x : Assignment) (hx : ∀i, i≠0 → x i=0) (ops : List Op) (bs : Array Bool) (xs : Array Rat) (h : Good bs xs) :
    Good (zeroRun ops bs) (execute x ops xs) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.zeroList
IndependentIndices.zeroIndex
declarations.snippet: def zeroIndex (ops : List Op) (k : Nat) := (zeroList ops)[k]?.getD ops.length

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.origin_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem origin_value (ops : List Op) (k : Nat) (x : Assignment) (hx : ∀i, i≠0 → x i=0) :
    valueAt ops x (zeroIndex ops k)=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.peakOK
declarations.snippet:
def peakOK (rs : Routes) (r : Ref) : Bool :=
  r.origin && ((rs[r.cell]!).slots.toList.drop 1).all (fun j=>decide (j≠1))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.parent_peak
declarations.snippet: private theorem parent_peak : oldShape.high.refs.all (peakOK oldRoutes)=true := by decide +kernel

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.split_peak

declarations.snippet:

    newShape.high.refs.all (peakOK newRoutes)=true := ⟨parent_peak,split_peak⟩

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.bounds
declarations.snippet:
theorem bounds :
    (newShape.high.refs++newShape.low.refs).all (fun r=>decide (r.cell<newRoutes.size))=true := by decide

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.routed_map
declarations.snippet:
private theorem routed_map (js : Array Nat) (x : Fin 74→Rat) :
    routed js (vector (diagonal x))=routed (js.map parentAt) (vector x) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diag_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem diag_row (fs : Families) (x : Fin 74→Rat) (r : Ref)
    (mem : r∈newShape.high.refs++newShape.low.refs) :
    rowValue fs newRoutes (vector (diagonal x)) r=rowValue fs oldRoutes (vector x) (srcRef r) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.members_congr
declarations.snippet:
theorem members_congr (fs : Families) (x : Fin 74→Rat) (t s : List Ref) (h : covers t s=true)
    (subset : ∀r∈t,r∈newShape.high.refs++newShape.low.refs) :
    (∀r∈t,rowValue fs newRoutes (vector (diagonal x)) r=0) ↔
      ∀r∈s,rowValue fs oldRoutes (vector x) r=0 := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.diagonal_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_chart (fs : Families) (x : Fin 74→Rat) (m : Bool) :
    conditions newShape fs newRoutes m (vector (diagonal x)) ↔ conditions oldShape fs oldRoutes m (vector x) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.row_local
declarations.snippet:
theorem row_local (fs : Families) (r : Ref) (x y : Assignment)
    (mem : r∈newShape.high.refs++newShape.low.refs)
    (agree : ∀i,inFrame (newRoutes[r.cell]!).frame i=true → x i=y i) :
    rowValue fs newRoutes x r=rowValue fs newRoutes y r := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.routed
declarations.snippet:
def routed (route : Array Nat) (x : Assignment) (i : Nat) : Rat :=
  match route[i]? with
  | none => 0
  | some j => x j

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.letter
declarations.snippet:
def letter (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (i : Nat) : Word :=
  match route[i]? with
  | none => .int 0
  | some j => varWord b j

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.letter_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem letter_value (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (x : Assignment) (i : Nat) :
    (letter b route i).value b x=routed route x i := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.getWord
declarations.snippet: def getWord (xs : Array Word) (i : Nat) : Word := xs[i]?.getD (.int 0)

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.getWord_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem getWord_value (b : Book) (x : Assignment) (xs : Array Word) (i : Nat) :
    (getWord xs i).value b x=read (xs.map (fun w=>w.value b x)) i := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.copied
declarations.snippet:
def copied (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (out : Array Word) : Op → Word
  | .var i => letter b route i
  | .int c => integer b c
  | .add i j => plus b (getWord out i) (getWord out j)
  | .mul i j => times b (getWord out i) (getWord out j)

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.copied_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem copied_value (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (x : Assignment) (out : Array Word) (op : Op) :
    (copied b route out op).value b x =
      op.value (routed route x) (read (out.map (fun w=>w.value b x))) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.renameOps
declarations.snippet:
def renameOps (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) : List Op → Array Word → Array Word
  | [],out => out
  | op::tail,out => renameOps b route tail (out.push (copied b route out op))

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.renameOps_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem renameOps_value (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (x : Assignment) (ops : List Op) (out : Array Word) :
    (renameOps b route ops out).map (fun w=>w.value b x) =
       execute (routed route x) ops (out.map (fun w=>w.value b x)) := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.renamed_reference
declarations.snippet:
theorem renamed_reference (b : Book) (route : Array Nat) (x : Assignment) (ops : List Op) (i : Nat) :
    (getWord (renameOps b route ops #[]) i).value b x=valueAt ops (routed route x) i := by

declarations.name: IndependentIndices.fromTables

  let index:=r.index (fs[(rs[r.cell]!).family]!)
  match ws[r.cell]? with
  | some a => getWord a index
  | none =>
    let c:=rs[r.cell]!
    getWord (renameOps b c.slots (fs[c.family]!) #[]) index

    (F.obj.obj (op S.X₁) ⧸ (sectionDifference S F).range) ≃+ F.H' 1 S.X₄ :=
  AddEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨overlapToH1_injective S F, by
    intro y
    have h : y ∈ (S.toBiprod F 1).hom.ker := by
      change S.toBiprod F 1 y = 0
      rw [S.toBiprod_apply]
      rw [show (F.cohomologyPresheaf 1).map S.f₂₄.op y = 0 from h₂.elim _ _,
        show (F.cohomologyPresheaf 1).map S.f₃₄.op y = 0 from h₃.elim _ _]
      exact map_zero _
    rw [← overlapToH1_range S F] at h
    exact h⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.Cech.differential_formula
ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.Cech.coordinateQuotient
declarations.snippet:
def coordinateQuotient :
    ((F).obj.obj (op (Sq).X₁) ⧸ (sectionDifference Sq F).range) ≃+
    (Punctured k f ⧸ LinearMap.range (differential k h)) := by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.congr (sectionDifference Sq F).range
    (LinearMap.range (differential k h)).toAddSubgroup (coordinateOverlap k h)
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (differential_formula k h a b).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a,b⟩, rfl⟩
    let e := coordinateChart k h false
    let d := coordinateChart k h true
    refine ⟨_,⟨(e.symm a,d.symm b),rfl⟩,?_⟩
    exact (differential_formula k h _ _).trans (congrArg (differential k h)
      (Prod.ext (e.apply_symm_apply a) (d.apply_symm_apply b)))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.Cech.terminalGenerators
declarations.snippet:
def terminalGenerators {T : C} (hT : IsTerminal T) :
    yoneda.obj T ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free ≅ (Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℤ)) := by
  letI (i : Cᵒᵖ) : Unique (i.unop ⟶ T) := ⟨⟨hT.from _⟩, fun j => hT.hom_ext _ _⟩
  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun i => ((FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv (i.unop ⟶ T)).trans
    AddEquiv.ulift.symm).toAddCommGrpIso) ?_
  intro i j e
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  apply FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext
  intro q
  change (ULift.up ((FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv _)
    (FreeAbelianGroup.of (e.unop ≫ q))) : ULift ℤ) = ULift.up ((FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv _)
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of q))
  simp [FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv]

  (presheafToSheaf J _).mapIso (terminalGenerators hT)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.UntwistedBranchHeight
declarations.snippet:
def UntwistedBranchHeight : Prop :=
  ∀ u : ℚ, u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet → ∃ r : Fin 6 → ℂ, Function.Injective r ∧
    (∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u 1) = 0) ∧
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K) (φ : K →+* ℂ) (v : Fin 10 → K),
      (∀ i, φ (v i) = branchRatio r i) ∧
      ThetaQuotient.normalizedHeight v ≤ 2^26 * max 1 (HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.untwisted_iff

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.height_of_branch_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem height_of_branch_coordinates {K : Type} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) {r : Fin 6 → ℂ}
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0)
    (φ : K →+* ℂ) (v : Fin 10 → K) (hv : ∀ i, φ (v i) = branchRatio r i) :
    ZInQ.ratHeight (SixContact.J u) ≤ 5 * normalizedHeight v + Real.log 3779136 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.period_branch_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem period_branch_height {u δ : ℚ} {hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet} {hδ : δ ≠ 0}
    (f : LabelledPeriod u δ hu hδ) :
    let e := eighthData f.toThomae
    letI := numberField (chart (thetaNull f.matrix)) (eighth_ratios_algebraic e)
    ∃ v : Fin 10 → fieldOf (chart (thetaNull f.matrix)),
      (∀ i, (v i : ℂ) = branchRatio f.roots i) ∧
      normalizedHeight v ≤ 8 * chartHeight (thetaNull f.matrix) (eighth_ratios_algebraic e) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.BoundedBranchHeight
declarations.snippet:
def BoundedBranchHeight : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℚ), u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet → ∃ r : Fin 6 → ℂ, Function.Injective r ∧
    (∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u (GlobalTwist.delta u : ℚ)) = 0) ∧
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K) (φ : K →+* ℂ) (v : Fin 10 → K),
      (∀ i, φ (v i) = branchRatio r i) ∧
      normalizedHeight v ≤ 2^26 * max 1 (vonKaenelBudget u)

declarations.snippet:
def invariantPair (b : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 2 → K :=
  ![(3779136:K)^2 * ∏ i, b i, (∑ i, b i)^10]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.product_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem product_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (b : Fin 10 → K) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.arch_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem arch_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (b : Fin 10 → K) :
    (⨆ j, v (invariantPair b j)) ≤ (3779136:ℝ)^2 * (⨆ i, v (b i))^10 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.nonarch_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem nonarch_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.sup_tenth

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.rational_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_height [NumberField K] (b : Fin 10 → K) (j : ℚ)
    (hs : ∑ i, b i ≠ 0) (he : (j:K)^2 = ((3779136:K)^2 * ∏ i, b i)/(∑ i, b i)^10) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.CanonicalBranchBound
declarations.snippet:
def CanonicalBranchBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℚ) (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet), ∃ r : Fin 6 → ℂ, Function.Injective r ∧
    ∃ hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u 1) = 0,
      letI := weight_numberField hu one_ne_zero hz
      ThetaQuotient.normalizedHeight (weights r) ≤ 2^26 * max 1 (HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u)

declarations.snippet:
theorem rootClasses_even {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {S : Finset ℕ} {u : ℚ}
    (hu : u ∉ contactSet) (hp : 5 < p) (hS : p ∉ S) (hout : ¬p ∣ contactSupport S u) :
    Even (padicValRat p (rootClass₁ u)) ∧ Even (padicValRat p (rootClass₂ u)) ∧
      Even (padicValRat p (rootClass₃ u)) := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_weightField_le_eight {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.degree_eight_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem degree_eight_height {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) :

    Module.finrank ℚ (weightField r) ≤ 8 ∧

      ∃ hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u 1) = 0,

declarations.snippet: def rootClass₁ (u : ℚ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.rootClass₂
declarations.snippet: def rootClass₂ (u : ℚ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.rootClass₃
declarations.snippet: def rootClass₃ (u : ℚ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.rootClasses_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem rootClasses_product (u : ℚ) :
    rootClass₁ u * rootClass₂ u * rootClass₃ u = -(30*SixContact.F u)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.quad_discriminant
declarations.snippet: theorem quad_discriminant (b c : ℚ) : (quad b c).discr = b^2-4*c := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.factor_discriminants
declarations.snippet:
theorem factor_discriminants {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    (firstFactor u).discr = (2/(u*(u+30)))^2 * rootClass₁ u ∧
    (secondFactor u).discr = (4/(3*u*(u+20)))^2 * rootClass₂ u ∧
    (thirdFactor u).discr = (1/(3*(u+20)*(u+30)))^2 * rootClass₃ u := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.quad
declarations.snippet: def quad (b c : ℚ) : ℚ[X] := X^2 + C b * X + C c

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.units
declarations.snippet:
private theorem units {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    u ≠ 0 ∧ u+20 ≠ 0 ∧ u+30 ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.affine_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem affine_parameter {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    parameter u = (10*(u+15)*(u+24)*(u+60))/(3*u*(u+20)*(u+30)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.quad_degree
declarations.snippet: theorem quad_degree (b c : ℚ) : (quad b c).Monic ∧ (quad b c).natDegree = 2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.three_quadratics
declarations.snippet:
theorem three_quadratics {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (δ : ℚ) :
    sextic u δ = C (scalar u δ) * (firstFactor u * secondFactor u * thirdFactor u) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.branchRatio
declarations.snippet:
def branchRatio (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) : ℂ :=
  branchValue (finiteBranches r) (pairs i) / branchValue (finiteBranches r) (pairs 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.weightField
declarations.snippet: def weightField (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range (branchRatio r))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.weights
declarations.snippet:
def weights (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) : weightField r :=
  ⟨branchRatio r i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.weight_numberField
declarations.snippet:
theorem weight_numberField {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) : NumberField (weightField r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.paper_pair
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_pair {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) :
    (∑ i, weights r i) ≠ 0 ∧
    (SixContact.J u : weightField r)^2 =
      ((3779136:weightField r)^2 * ∏ i, weights r i) / (∑ i, weights r i)^10 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchHeight.paper_J_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_J_height {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hδ hz
    ZInQ.ratHeight (SixContact.J u) ≤ 5 * normalizedHeight (weights r) + Real.log 3779136 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.rootsCoeff
ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.sixTerms
declarations.snippet:
private def sixTerms (c : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ[X] :=
  C (c 0)+C (c 1)*X+C (c 2)*X^2+C (c 3)*X^3+C (c 4)*X^4+C (c 5)*X^5+C (c 6)*X^6

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.expand_roots
declarations.snippet:
theorem expand_roots (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    (∏ i, (X-C (r i))) = sixTerms (rootsCoeff r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.factor_coeff
declarations.snippet:
theorem factor_coeff (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hh : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) (k : Fin 7) :
    (f.coeff k : ℂ) = f.leadingCoeff * rootsCoeff r k := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.rational_i4_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_i4_sum (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hh : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) :
    (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ)^4 * weightSum r = (igusaI4 f : ℂ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.sextic_i4_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem sextic_i4_sum {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hh : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0) :
    ((sextic u δ).leadingCoeff : ℂ)^4 * weightSum r = (igusaI4 (sextic u δ) : ℂ) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.translate
declarations.snippet: private def translate (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : Fin 6 → ℂ := fun i => r i-z

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.translate_sum
declarations.snippet:
private theorem translate_sum (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    weightSum (translate r z) = weightSum r := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.coefficientQuartic
ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.translate_invariant
declarations.snippet:
private theorem translate_invariant (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    coefficientQuartic (translate r z) = coefficientQuartic r := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.zero_i4
declarations.snippet:
private theorem zero_i4 (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (h : r 5 = 0) :
    weightSum r = coefficientQuartic r := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.monic_i4_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_i4_sum (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    weightSum r = quartic (rootsCoeff r 0) (rootsCoeff r 1) (rootsCoeff r 2)
      (rootsCoeff r 3) (rootsCoeff r 4) (rootsCoeff r 5) (rootsCoeff r 6) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.quartic_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem quartic_eq (f : ℚ[X]) :
    (igusaI4 f : ℂ) = quartic (f.coeff 0) (f.coeff 1) (f.coeff 2)
      (f.coeff 3) (f.coeff 4) (f.coeff 5) (f.coeff 6) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.scale_quartic
declarations.snippet:
theorem scale_quartic (s a b c d e g h : ℂ) :
    quartic (s*a) (s*b) (s*c) (s*d) (s*e) (s*g) (s*h) = s^4*quartic a b c d e g h := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.translate_quartic
declarations.snippet:
theorem translate_quartic (a b c d e g h z : ℂ) :
    quartic (a+z*(b+z*(c+z*(d+z*(e+z*(g+z*h))))))
      (b+z*(2*c+z*(3*d+z*(4*e+z*(5*g+z*6*h)))))
      (c+z*(3*d+z*(6*e+z*(10*g+z*15*h))))
      (d+z*(4*e+z*(10*g+z*20*h))) (e+z*(5*g+z*15*h)) (g+z*6*h) h =
      quartic a b c d e g h := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.factorization
declarations.snippet:
theorem factorization (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hroot : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) :
    f.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) = C (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ) * ∏ i, (X - C (r i)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.triple
declarations.snippet:
def triple (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i j k : Fin 6) : ℂ :=
  (r i-r j)*(r i-r k)*(r j-r k)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.weight
declarations.snippet:
def weight (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i j a b c : Fin 6) : ℂ :=
  (triple r i j 5 * triple r a b c)^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchI4.weightSum
declarations.snippet:
def weightSum (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  weight r 0 1 2 3 4 + weight r 0 2 1 3 4 + weight r 0 3 1 2 4 +
  weight r 0 4 1 2 3 + weight r 1 2 0 3 4 + weight r 1 3 0 2 4 +
  weight r 1 4 0 2 3 + weight r 2 3 0 1 4 + weight r 2 4 0 1 3 +
  weight r 3 4 0 1 2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.quotient_of_scaling
declarations.snippet:
theorem quotient_of_scaling (w v : Fin 10 → ℂ) {d : ℂ} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ i, v i*d = w i) :
    (∑ i, v i)^10/(∏ i, v i) = (∑ i, w i)^10/(∏ i, w i) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.rational_branch_invariant
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_branch_invariant (f : ℚ[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0)
    (label : Fin 10 ≃ Partition) :
    (∑ i, branchValue (finiteBranches r) (label i))^10 /
      (∏ i, branchValue (finiteBranches r) (label i)) =
      (((igusaI4 f^5/f.discr^2 : ℚ) : ℂ))^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.sextic_branch_invariant
declarations.snippet:
theorem sextic_branch_invariant {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ) = 0)
    (label : Fin 10 ≃ Partition) :
    (∑ i, branchValue (finiteBranches r) (label i))^10 /
      (∏ i, branchValue (finiteBranches r) (label i)) =
      (((igusaI4 (sextic u δ)^5/(sextic u δ).discr^2 : ℚ) : ℂ))^2 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.Row
declarations.snippet:
structure Row where
  p : Fin 5
  q : Fin 5
  a : Fin 5
  b : Fin 5
  c : Fin 5
deriving DecidableEq

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.ordered
declarations.snippet:
private theorem ordered (i : Fin 10) : (row i).p < (row i).q ∧
    (row i).a < (row i).b ∧ (row i).b < (row i).c := by decide +revert

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.pair
declarations.snippet:
def pair (i : Fin 10) : Partition :=
  ⟨{(row i).p,(row i).q}, by have h := (ordered i).1.ne; simp [h]⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.pairs
declarations.snippet: def pairs : Fin 10 ≃ Partition := Equiv.ofBijective pair (by decide)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.complement
declarations.snippet:
private theorem complement (i : Fin 10) : Finset.univ \ (pair i).val =
    {(row i).a,(row i).b,(row i).c} := by decide +revert

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.pair_differences
declarations.snippet:
private theorem pair_differences (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) {p q : Fin 5} (h : p < q) :
    differences v {p,q} = v p - v q := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.triple_differences
declarations.snippet:
private theorem triple_differences (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) {a b c : Fin 5} (hab : a<b) (hbc : b<c) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.denominator_row
ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.vandermonde
declarations.snippet:
def vandermonde (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∏ i, ∏ j, if i < j then r i-r j else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.edgeWeight
declarations.snippet:
private def edgeWeight (e : Fin 6 → Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) :=
  let t := row i
  let a := t.a.castSucc
  let b := t.b.castSucc
  let c := t.c.castSucc
  let p := t.p.castSucc
  let q := t.q.castSucc
  ((e p q * e p 5 * e q 5) * (e a b * e a c * e b c))^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.rowWeight
declarations.snippet:
def rowWeight (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) :=
  edgeWeight (fun j k => r j-r k) i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.regroup

declarations.snippet:
theorem clear_row {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (i : Fin 10) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchFormula.prod_rowWeights

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.LabelledPeriod
declarations.snippet:
structure LabelledPeriod (u δ : ℚ) (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) where
  matrix : SiegelPeriod
  roots : Fin 6 → ℂ
  distinct : Function.Injective roots
  root : ∀ i, aeval (roots i) (sextic u δ) = 0
  label : Fin 10 ≃ Partition
  scale : ℂˣ
  thomae : ∀ i, thetaNull matrix (evenIndices i)^8 =
    (scale:ℂ)*branchValue (finiteBranches roots) (label i)
  stable : ℝ
  comparison : let e := of_sextic_thomae hu hδ roots distinct root label scale thomae (thetaNull_odd matrix)
    let h := chartHeight (thetaNull matrix) (eighth_ratios_algebraic e)
    |max 1 h - max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)/2| ≤ ThetaMetric.pazukiConstant *
      Real.log (min (max 1 h) (max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)) + 2)
  reduction : stable ≤ HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.LabelledPeriod.toThomae
declarations.snippet:
def LabelledPeriod.toThomae {u δ : ℚ} {hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet} {hδ : δ ≠ 0}
    (p : LabelledPeriod u δ hu hδ) : ThomaePeriodData u δ hu hδ where
  matrix := p.matrix
  roots := p.roots
  distinct := p.distinct
  root := p.root
  label := p.label
  scale := p.scale
  thomae := p.thomae
  branchInvariant := BranchFormula.sextic_branch_invariant hu hδ p.roots p.distinct p.root p.label
  stable := p.stable
  comparison := p.comparison
  reduction := p.reduction

    (if j < i then -1 else 1) *
    ((if i < j then r i-r j else 1) * (if j < i then r j-r i else 1)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchPlaces.finite_place_profiles
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_place_profiles {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ≠0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ)=0)
    (hp : 17 ≤ p) :
    letI := weight_numberField hu hδ hz
    ∀ w : FinitePlace (weightField r), w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver (rationalPrime p).asIdeal →
      (∀ d : ℕ, 0 < d → addVal Zp (RationalClusters.F p u)=((2*d:ℕ):ℕ∞) →
        ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i : Fin 10, w (sumWeights r i) =
          (w (p:weightField r))^(if i=k then (8*d:ℤ) else 0)) ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, 0 < g → addVal Zp (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞) →
        ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i : Fin 10, w (sumWeights r i) =
          (w (p:weightField r))^(if i=k then (6*g:ℤ) else -(2*g))) := by

        (⨆ i : Fin 10, w (sumWeights r i)) = 1) ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, 0 < g → addVal Zp (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞) →

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DiscEquations.polePolynomial_eq

      (108*t^2) (27*t^2*(28*w-9)) (18*t^3) (t^3*(4*w+3)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DiscEquations.pole_lead

    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k) (hv : addVal ℤ_[p] (contactProduct A B) = ((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞))

declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_coefficients {d : R} (hd : d^2=6) (u : R) :
    let a := -8+4*d
    let b := -8-4*d
    (d*u)*slope₀ a = 4*(2*a+16)^3*((-48*u)*(d-2)^2) ∧
    (d*u)*slope₀ b = 4*(2*b+16)^3*((48*u)*(d+2)^2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ResidualFactors.zero_factor

private theorem zero_factor {a U w : R} (h : U*slope₀ a = 4*(2*a+16)^3*w^2) :
    zeroResidual a U = C (-4*(2*a+16)^3)*X*(X-C w)*(X+C w) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ResidualFactors.zero_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_factors {d u v z : R} (hd : d^2=6) (hv : v^2= -48*u) (hz : z^2=48*u) :
    let a := -8+4*d
    let b := -8-4*d
    zeroResidual a (d*u) =
      C (-4*(2*a+16)^3)*X*(X-C (v*(d-2)))*(X+C (v*(d-2))) ∧
    zeroResidual b (d*u) =
      C (-4*(2*b+16)^3)*X*(X-C (z*(d+2)))*(X+C (z*(d+2))) := by

    ∃ a : R, a^2 = -(n:R) ∧ (8:R) ∣ (1+2*(a-1)) - (1+2*(b-1)) := by

    {a : R} (ha : a^2 = -(n:R)) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Dyadic.generator_cyclotomic_values

    (a*a)%8 = 1 ∧ z^a = -z ∧ (z^a)^2=z^2 ∧ (z^a)-(z^a)^3=-(z-z^3) ∧ (z-z^3)^2=2 := by

theorem sum_quadraticSign {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    [Fintype (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)] (x : V) :
    ∑ f : Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V, quadraticSign (f x) =

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.sum_character_traces
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_character_traces {V I G : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    [Fintype (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)] [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup G]
    (q : I → V) (z : I → G) :
    ∑ f : Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V, ∑ t : I, quadraticSign (f (q t)) • z t =
      (Fintype.card (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V) : ℤ) •
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun t => q t = 0), z t := by

    [Fintype (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)] [Fintype I] (q : I → V) (z : I → (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] A))
    (P : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] A)
    (evaluations : ∑ f : Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V, ∑ t : I, quadraticSign (f (q t)) • z t =
      (Fintype.card (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V) : ℤ) • P) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.primitive_trace_of_character_values
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_trace_of_character_values {V I : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    [Fintype (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)] [Fintype I] (D : RecursionData)
    (v : ℕ → ℚ ⊗[ℤ] A) (e : ℕ) (q : I → V) (z : I → A)
    (genusTrace : D.trace e = ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun t => q t = 0), z t)
    (evaluations : ∑ f : Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V, ∑ t : I,
        quadraticSign (f (q t)) • ((1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z t) =
      (Fintype.card (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V) : ℤ) •
        (v e + ∑ t ∈ recursionFactors e, (D.L t) • unitVector (D.epsilon (e/t) t) (v (e/t)))) :
    (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D.trace e = v e + ∑ t ∈ recursionFactors e,
      (D.L t) • unitVector (D.epsilon (e/t) t) (v (e/t)) := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_trace_of_factors {V I : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    [Fintype (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)] [Fintype I] (D : RecursionData)
    (v : ℕ → ℚ ⊗[ℤ] A) (e : ℕ) (q : I → V) (z : I → A)
    (genusTrace : D.trace e = ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun t => q t = 0), z t)
    (chi : Option ↥(recursionFactors e) ↪ Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V)
    (trivialValue : ∑ t : I, quadraticSign (chi none (q t)) • ((1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z t) =
      (Fintype.card (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V) : ℤ) • v e)
    (factorValue : ∀ j : ↥(recursionFactors e),
      ∑ t : I, quadraticSign (chi (some j) (q t)) • ((1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z t) =
      (Fintype.card (Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V) : ℤ) •
        ((D.L j.val) • unitVector (D.epsilon (e/j.val) j.val) (v (e/j.val))))
    (others : ∀ f : Module.Dual (ZMod 2) V, f ∉ Set.range chi →
      ∑ t : I, quadraticSign (f (q t)) • ((1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z t) = 0) :
    (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D.trace e = v e + ∑ t ∈ recursionFactors e,
  …

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Specialization.minusSource
declarations.snippet:
def minusSource (n : ℕ) : AddSubgroup A where
  carrier := {P | ∀ σ : Gal, sourceAction σ P = signedSource n σ P}
  zero_mem' := by intro σ; simp [signedSource]
  add_mem' := by
    intro P Q hP hQ σ
    rw [map_add,hP σ,hQ σ]
    unfold signedSource
    split_ifs <;> simp [add_comm]
  neg_mem' := by
    intro P hP σ
    rw [map_neg,hP σ]
    unfold signedSource
    split_ifs <;> rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.twist_discriminant
declarations.snippet:
theorem twist_discriminant (d l : ℚ) :
    (twist d l).Δ = 16*d^6*l^2*(1-l)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.twist_c4
declarations.snippet:
theorem twist_c4 (d l : ℚ) :
    (twist d l).c₄ = 16*d^2*(1-l+l^2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.twist_elliptic
declarations.snippet:
theorem twist_elliptic (d l : ℚ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (h1 : 1-l ≠ 0) :
    (twist d l).IsElliptic := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.twist_j
declarations.snippet:
theorem twist_j (d l : ℚ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (h1 : 1-l ≠ 0) :
    letI := twist_elliptic d l hd hl h1
    (twist d l).j = legendreJ l := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.no_good_legendre_choice
declarations.snippet:
theorem no_good_legendre_choice (bound H : ℕ) :
    ∃ (p : Fin 6 → ℕ) (u : ℕ), H < u ∧ Function.Injective p ∧
      ∀ i, (p i).Prime ∧ max 60 bound < p i ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 6, (u+mark j).factorization (p i) = if j=i then 2 else 0) ∧
        ∀ j k : Fin 6, j ≠ i → j ≠ k → k ≠ i →
          ∀ d : ℚ, d ≠ 0 → ∃ he : (twist d (ratio u i j k)).IsElliptic,
            padicValRat (p i) (@WeierstrassCurve.j _ _ (twist d (ratio u i j k)) he) = -4 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.ratio
ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.val_mark_diff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem val_mark_diff (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 60 < p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.legendre_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem legendre_pole (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 60 < p)
    (l : ℚ) (hl : padicValRat p l = 2) : padicValRat p (legendreJ l) = -4 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.triple_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem triple_pole {p u : ℕ} [hp' : Fact p.Prime] (hp : 60 < p) (hu : 0 < u)
    {i j k : Fin 6} (hji : j ≠ i) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hc : (u+mark i).factorization p = 2) (hk : ¬ p ∣ u+mark k) :
    padicValRat p (legendreJ (ratio u i j k)) = -4 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.all_triples_obstructed
declarations.snippet:
theorem all_triples_obstructed (bound H : ℕ) :
    ∃ (p : Fin 6 → ℕ) (u : ℕ), H < u ∧ Function.Injective p ∧
      ∀ i, (p i).Prime ∧ max 60 bound < p i ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 6, (u+mark j).factorization (p i) = if j=i then 2 else 0) ∧
        ∀ j k : Fin 6, j ≠ i → j ≠ k → k ≠ i →
          padicValRat (p i) (legendreJ (ratio u i j k)) = -4 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.mark_bound
declarations.snippet: theorem mark_bound (i : Fin 6) : mark i ≤ 60 := by fin_cases i <;> decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.mark_injective
declarations.snippet: theorem mark_injective : Function.Injective mark := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.six_congruences
declarations.snippet:
theorem six_congruences (p : Fin 6 → ℕ) (pp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime)
    (inj : Function.Injective p) (hp : ∀ i, 60 < p i) (H : ℕ) :
    ∃ u : ℕ, H < u ∧ ∀ i,
      (u+mark i).factorization (p i) = 2 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 6, j ≠ i → ¬ p i ∣ u+mark j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactDescent.arbitrarily_large_private_contacts
declarations.snippet:
theorem arbitrarily_large_private_contacts (bound H : ℕ) :
    ∃ (p : Fin 6 → ℕ) (u : ℕ), Function.Injective p ∧ H < u ∧
      ∀ i, (p i).Prime ∧ max 60 bound < p i ∧
        (u+mark i).factorization (p i)=2 ∧
        ∀ j : Fin 6, j ≠ i → ¬ p i ∣ u+mark j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.J_homogeneous
declarations.snippet:
theorem J_homogeneous {A B : ℚ} (hB : B ≠ 0) :

declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet: theorem invariant_coefficient_unit (hp : 5 < p) : padicValRat p (3779136:ℚ) = 0 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.J_valuation
declarations.snippet:
theorem J_valuation {A B : ℤ} (hB : B ≠ 0) (hu : (A:ℚ)/B ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hp : 5 < p) :
    padicValRat p (SixContact.J ((A:ℚ)/B)) =

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.reduced_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem reduced_zero {z : ℤ} (h : 0 < padicValRat p z) : (z : ZMod p) = 0 := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem reduced_unit {z : ℤ} (h : (z : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : padicValRat p z = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.disjoint_valuations
declarations.snippet:
theorem disjoint_valuations {A B : ℤ} (hprim : IsCoprime A B) (hp : 5<p) :
    (0 < padicValRat p (contactProduct A B:ℤ) → padicValRat p (poleForm A B:ℤ)=0) ∧
    (0 < padicValRat p (poleForm A B:ℤ) → padicValRat p (contactProduct A B:ℤ)=0) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.primitive_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_orders {A B : ℤ} (hB : B ≠ 0) (hprim : IsCoprime A B)
    (hu : (A:ℚ)/B ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hp : 5 < p) :
    (∀ d : ℤ, 0<d → padicValRat p (contactProduct A B:ℤ)=2*d →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J ((A:ℚ)/B))=4*d) ∧
    (∀ g : ℤ, 0<g → padicValRat p (poleForm A B:ℤ)=g →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J ((A:ℚ)/B))= -6*g) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.rational_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_orders (u : ℚ) (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hp : 5 < p) :
    (∀ d : ℤ, 0<d → padicValRat p (contactProduct u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ)=2*d →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J u)=4*d) ∧
    (∀ g : ℤ, 0<g → padicValRat p (poleForm u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ)=g →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J u)= -6*g) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.J_valuation_rational
declarations.snippet:
theorem J_valuation_rational (u : ℚ) (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hp : 5 < p) :
    padicValRat p (SixContact.J u) = 2*padicValRat p (contactProduct u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ)
      - 6*padicValRat p (poleForm u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.rational_order_of_addVal
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_order_of_addVal {z : ℤ} (k : ℕ)
    (h : addVal ℤ_[p] (z:ℤ_[p])=(k:ℕ∞)) : padicValRat p z=k := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.cluster_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem cluster_orders (u : ℚ) (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hp : 5<p) :
    (∀ d : ℕ, 0<d → addVal ℤ_[p] (RationalClusters.F p u)=((2*d:ℕ):ℕ∞) →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J u)=4*d) ∧
    (∀ g : ℕ, 0<g → addVal ℤ_[p] (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞) →
      padicValRat p (SixContact.J u)= -6*g) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.sumWeights
declarations.snippet:
def sumWeights (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) : weightField r :=
  weights r i / ∑ j, weights r j

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.sumWeights_complex
declarations.snippet:
theorem sumWeights_complex {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (i : Fin 10) :
    ((sumWeights r i : weightField r):ℂ) =
      ThetaPeriod.branchValue (ThetaPeriod.finiteBranches r) (BranchFormula.pairs i) /
        ∑ j : Fin 10, ThetaPeriod.branchValue (ThetaPeriod.finiteBranches r) (BranchFormula.pairs j) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.sumWeights_equations
declarations.snippet:
theorem sumWeights_equations {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ)=0) :
    (∑ i, sumWeights r i)=1 ∧
    (∏ i, sumWeights r i)=((SixContact.J u/3779136:ℚ):weightField r)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.sum_of_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_of_orders (ord : K → ℚ) (hm : ∀ {x y:K}, x≠0 → y≠0 → ord (x*y)=ord x+ord y)
    {x : Fin 10 → K} (hx : ∀ i, x i ≠ 0) {j : K} (hj : j≠0)
    (hprod : ∏ i, x i=j^2) : (∑ i, ord (x i))=2*ord j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.nine_and_one
declarations.snippet:
theorem nine_and_one (a : Fin 10 → ℚ) (i₀ : Fin 10) (m gap total : ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i = m + if i=i₀ then gap else 0) (hs : ∑ i, a i=total) :
    m=(total-gap)/10 ∧ a i₀=(total+9*gap)/10 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.normalized_pattern
declarations.snippet:
theorem normalized_pattern {u δ : ℚ} {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 5<p)
    (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) {r : Fin 6 → ℂ}
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ)=0)
    (ord : weightField r → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ {x y : weightField r}, x≠0 → y≠0 → ord (x*y)=ord x+ord y)
    (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, q≠0 → ord (q:weightField r)=(padicValRat p q:ℚ))
    (i₀ : Fin 10) (m h g : ℚ)
    (hF : (padicValRat p (contactProduct u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ):ℚ)=h)
    (hG : (padicValRat p (poleForm u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ):ℚ)=g)
    (relative : ∀ i, ord (sumWeights r i)=m + if i=i₀ then 4*h+8*g else 0) :
    m= -2*g ∧ ord (sumWeights r i₀)=4*h+6*g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.gap_after_sum_normalization
declarations.snippet:
theorem gap_after_sum_normalization {u δ : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    {r : Fin 6 → ℂ} (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ)=0)
    (ord : weightField r → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ {x y : weightField r}, x≠0 → y≠0 → ord (x*y)=ord x+ord y)
    (i₀ : Fin 10) (l gap : ℚ)
    (raw : ∀ i, ord (weights r i)=l + if i=i₀ then gap else 0) :
    ∃ m : ℚ, ∀ i, ord (sumWeights r i)=m + if i=i₀ then gap else 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ContactInvariant.orders_of_raw_gap
declarations.snippet:
theorem orders_of_raw_gap {u δ : ℚ} {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 5<p)
    (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) {r : Fin 6 → ℂ}
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) (sextic u δ)=0)
    (ord : weightField r → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ {x y : weightField r}, x≠0 → y≠0 → ord (x*y)=ord x+ord y)
    (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, q≠0 → ord (q:weightField r)=(padicValRat p q:ℚ))
    (i₀ : Fin 10) (l h g : ℚ)
    (hF : (padicValRat p (contactProduct u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ):ℚ)=h)
    (hG : (padicValRat p (poleForm u.num (u.den:ℤ):ℤ):ℚ)=g)
    (raw : ∀ i, ord (weights r i)=l + if i=i₀ then 4*h+8*g else 0) :
    ∀ i, ord (sumWeights r i)=if i=i₀ then 4*h+6*g else -2*g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.Rep
declarations.snippet:
@[ext] structure Rep (F : K × K → K) where
  base : K × K
  y : K
  nonzero : base ≠ 0
  equation : y^2 = F base

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.scalings
declarations.snippet:
def scalings (F : K × K → K) : Setoid (Rep F) where
  r a b := ∃ c : Kˣ, b.base = c • a.base ∧ b.y = (c : K)^3*a.y
  iseqv := {
    refl a := ⟨1, by simp⟩
    symm := by
      rintro a b ⟨c,hx,hy⟩
      exact ⟨c⁻¹, by simp [hx,hy]⟩
    trans := by
      rintro a b d ⟨c,hx,hy⟩ ⟨e,kx,ky⟩
      exact ⟨e*c, by simp [kx,ky,hx,hy,mul_smul,mul_pow,mul_assoc]⟩ }

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.Points
declarations.snippet: abbrev Points (F : K × K → K) := Quotient (scalings F)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.move
declarations.snippet:
private def move {F G : K × K → K} (e : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K)) (v : Kˣ)
    (h : ∀ p, G (e p) = (v:K)^2*F p) (a : Rep F) : Rep G where
  base := e a.base
  y := v*a.y
  nonzero := fun hz => a.nonzero (e.injective (hz.trans e.map_zero.symm))
  equation := by rw [mul_pow, a.equation, h]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.movePoints
declarations.snippet:
private def movePoints {F G : K × K → K} (e : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K)) (v : Kˣ)
    (h : ∀ p, G (e p) = (v:K)^2*F p) : Points F → Points G :=
  Quotient.map (move e v h) (by
    rintro a b ⟨c,hx,hy⟩
    exact ⟨c, by simp [move,hx,hy,Units.smul_def,mul_left_comm]⟩)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.coordinateEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def coordinateEquiv {F G : K × K → K} (e : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K)) (v : Kˣ)
    (h : ∀ p, G (e p) = (v:K)^2*F p) : Points F ≃ Points G := by
  have k (p : K × K) : F (e.symm p) = (↑v⁻¹:K)^2*G p := by
    have z := h (e.symm p)
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply] at z
    simp [z]
  exact {
    toFun := movePoints e v h
    invFun := movePoints e.symm v⁻¹ k
    left_inv := by
      intro q
      induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | _ q =>
        apply congrArg (Quotient.mk _)
        apply Rep.ext <;> simp [move]
    right_inv := by
      intro q
      induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | _ q =>
        apply congrArg (Quotient.mk _)
        apply Rep.ext <;> simp [move] }

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.coordinateEquiv_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem coordinateEquiv_coordinates {F G : K × K → K} (e : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K))
    (v : Kˣ) (h : ∀ p, G (e p) = (v:K)^2*F p) (a : Rep F) :
    ∃ b : Rep G, coordinateEquiv e v h (Quotient.mk _ a) = Quotient.mk _ b ∧
      b.base = e a.base ∧ b.y = v*a.y :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.Pol
declarations.snippet: abbrev Pol := MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℚ

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.evalAt
declarations.snippet:
def evalAt (v : K × K) : Pol →+* K :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Rat.castHom K) ![v.1, v.2]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.quadEval
declarations.snippet:
private def quadEval {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : R →+* K) {d : K} (hd : d^2=6) :
    RationalModel.Quad R →+* K where
  toFun a := f a.re + d*f a.im
  map_zero' := by simp
  map_one' := by change f 1 + d*f 0 = 1; simp
  map_add' a b := by simp; ring
  map_mul' a b := by
    simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,map_ofNat]
    linear_combination -(f a.im)*(f b.im)*hd

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.quadEval_omega
declarations.snippet:
private theorem quadEval_omega {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : R →+* K) {d : K} (hd : d^2=6) :
    quadEval f hd (RationalModel.d R) = d := by simp [quadEval, RationalModel.d]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.quadEval_base
declarations.snippet:
private theorem quadEval_base {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : R →+* K) {d : K} (hd : d^2=6) (a : R) :
    quadEval f hd (algebraMap R (RationalModel.Quad R) a) = f a := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.map_equation
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_equation {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (d r h x z : A) :
    f (RationalModel.equation d r h x z) = RationalModel.equation (f d) (f r) (f h) (f x) (f z) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.rationalSextic_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem rationalSextic_eval (u : ℚ) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) (v : K × K) :
    evalAt v (RationalModel.rationalSextic u) =
    RationalModel.equation d (CoarseConic.r u : K) (CoarseConic.h u : K) v.1 v.2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.paperSextic
declarations.snippet: def paperSextic (u : ℚ) : Pol := MvPolynomial.C (-1/512 : ℚ)*RationalModel.rationalSextic u

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.scalar_normalization
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_normalization {d : K} (hd : d^2=6) :
    (-1/512 : K)*(2-d)^3 = ((4*(2+d))⁻¹)^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.paperSextic_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem paperSextic_eval (u : ℚ) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) (v : K × K) :
    evalAt v (paperSextic u) = ((4*(2+d))⁻¹)^3*binary (d*(CoarseConic.r u : K))
      (4*(CoarseConic.h u : K)*(2+d)*(v.1+d*v.2)) (v.1-d*v.2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.descentLinear
declarations.snippet:
def descentLinear (d b : K) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K) where
  toFun v := (b*(v.1+d*v.2),v.1-d*v.2)
  invFun v := ((v.1/b+v.2)/2,(v.1/b-v.2)/(2*d))
  map_add' v w := by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring
  map_smul' c v := by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring
  left_inv v := by ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [hd,hb] <;> ring
  right_inv v := by ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [hd,hb] <;> ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.descentLinear_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem descentLinear_coordinates (d b : K) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (v : K × K) :
    descentLinear d b hd hb v = (b*(v.1+d*v.2), v.1-d*v.2) ∧
      (descentLinear d b hd hb).symm v = ((v.1/b+v.2)/2, (v.1/b-v.2)/(2*d)) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.nonzero_change
declarations.snippet:
private theorem nonzero_change {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) :
    d ≠ 0 ∧ 4*(CoarseConic.h u : K)*(2+d) ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.model
declarations.snippet: def model (s D : K) (v : K × K) := D*binary s v.1 v.2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.rational_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def rational_equiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (δ : ℚ) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) :
    Points (fun v => (δ:K)*evalAt v (RationalModel.rationalSextic u)) ≃
      Points (model (d*(CoarseConic.r u : K)) ((δ:K)*(2-d)^3)) := by
  obtain ⟨hn,hb⟩ := nonzero_change hu d hd
  apply coordinateEquiv (descentLinear d (4*(CoarseConic.h u : K)*(2+d)) hn hb) 1
  intro v
  rw [rationalSextic_eval u d hd]
  simp [model, RationalModel.equation,descentLinear,mul_assoc]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.paper_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def paper_equiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (δ : ℚ) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) :
    Points (fun v => (δ:K)*evalAt v (paperSextic u)) ≃
      Points (model (d*(CoarseConic.r u : K)) ((δ:K)*((4*(2+d))⁻¹)^3)) := by
  obtain ⟨hn,hb⟩ := nonzero_change hu d hd
  apply coordinateEquiv (descentLinear d (4*(CoarseConic.h u : K)*(2+d)) hn hb) 1
  intro v
  rw [paperSextic_eval u d hd]
  simp [model,descentLinear,mul_assoc]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.paper_integral_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def paper_integral_equiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (δ : ℚ) :
    Points (fun v : K × K => (δ:K)*evalAt v (integralPolynomial u)) ≃
    Points (fun v : K × K => (δ:K)*evalAt v (paperSextic u)) := by
  have hn : (yScale u:K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast yScale_ne hu
  apply coordinateEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl K _) (Units.mk0 (yScale u:K) hn)
  intro v
  simp only [LinearEquiv.refl_apply]
  rw [paper_integral_polynomial,map_mul,map_pow]
  change (δ:K)*(evalAt v (MvPolynomial.C (yScale u))^2*_) = (yScale u:K)^2*((δ:K)*_)
  rw [show evalAt v (MvPolynomial.C (yScale u)) = (yScale u:K) by simp [evalAt]]
  ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.diagonal
declarations.snippet:
def diagonal (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (K × K) ≃ₗ[K] (K × K) where
  toFun v := (a*v.1, v.2)
  invFun v := (v.1/a, v.2)
  map_add' v w := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · exact mul_add _ _ _
    · rfl
  map_smul' c v := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · exact mul_left_comm _ _ _
    · rfl
  left_inv v := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · change a*v.1/a = v.1
      field_simp
    · rfl
  right_inv v := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · change a*(v.1/a) = v.1
      field_simp
    · rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.regular_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def regular_equiv (s h D : K) (hh : h ≠ 0) (ht : 9*s^2-32 = -32*h^2) :
    Points (fun v => D*regularBinary s h v.1 v.2) ≃ Points (model s D) := by
  apply coordinateEquiv (diagonal h hh) (Units.mk0 (h^3) (pow_ne_zero _ hh))
  intro v
  change D*binary s (h*v.1) v.2 = (h^3)^2*(D*regularBinary s h v.1 v.2)
  rw [regular_identity ht]
  ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CurveChart.pole_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def pole_equiv (w D : K) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    Points (fun v => (D/w)*(poleBinary w v.1 v.2/729)) ≃ Points (model w⁻¹ D) := by
  have h3 : 3*w⁻¹ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (inv_ne_zero hw)
  apply coordinateEquiv (diagonal (3*w⁻¹) h3) (Units.mk0 ((3*w⁻¹)^3) (pow_ne_zero _ h3))
  intro v
  change D*binary w⁻¹ ((3*w⁻¹)*v.1) v.2 =
    ((3*w⁻¹)^3)^2*((D/w)*(poleBinary w v.1 v.2/729))
  rw [pole_identity w _ _ hw]
  field_simp [hw]
  ring

declarations.snippet:
def paper_pole_equiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (δ : ℚ) (d : K) (hd : d^2=6) :
    let w := (d*(CoarseConic.r u : K))⁻¹
    let D := (δ:K)*((4*(2+d))⁻¹)^3
    Points (fun v => (δ:K)*evalAt v (paperSextic u)) ≃ Points (fun v => (D/w)*(poleBinary w v.1 v.2/729)) := by
  have hr : (CoarseConic.r u : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (CoarseConic.radical_units hu).1
  have hn : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; norm_num at hd
  have e := (pole_equiv (d*(CoarseConic.r u : K))⁻¹ ((δ:K)*((4*(2+d))⁻¹)^3)
    (inv_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hn hr))).symm
  rw [inv_inv] at e
  exact (paper_equiv hu δ d hd).trans e

def affinePicardIso {R A B : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]

    CommGrpCat.of (CommRing.Pic B) ≅ CommGrpCat.of (CommRing.Pic A) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.squareEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def squareEquiv {K R S : Type*} [CommRing K] [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra K R]
    [Algebra K S] {f : R} {g : S} (e : R ≃ₐ[K] S) (u : Sˣ)
    (h : e f = (u : S)^2*g) : Cover f ≃ₐ[K] Cover g where
  toFun z := ⟨e z.re, u*e z.im⟩
  invFun z := ⟨e.symm z.re, e.symm ((↑u⁻¹ : S)*z.im)⟩
  left_inv z := by ext <;> simp [← mul_assoc]
  right_inv z := by ext <;> simp [← mul_assoc]
  map_mul' x y := by ext <;> simp [h] <;> ring
  map_add' x y := by ext <;> simp [mul_add]
  commutes' r := by
    change (⟨e (algebraMap K R r), (u : S)*e 0⟩ : Cover g) = ⟨algebraMap K S r, 0⟩
    simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.specIso
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def specIso {R A B : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) : SpecOver (R := R) B ≅ SpecOver A := by
  refine Over.isoMk (Scheme.Spec.mapIso e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op) ?_
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext r
  exact e.commutes r

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.affineBaseChange
declarations.snippet:
def affineBaseChange (R K : Type) [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] (f : R[X]) :
    SpecOver (R := K) (Cover (f.map (algebraMap R K))) ≅
       (Over.pullback (scalarMap R K)).obj (SpecOver (R := R) (Cover f)) := by
  let D := QuadraticAlgebra K[X] (algebraMap R[X] K[X] f) (algebraMap R[X] K[X] 0)
  have top := algebraSquare R[X] K[X] (Cover f) D
  have bot := algebraSquare R K R[X] K[X]
  have H := top.paste_vert bot
  rw [scalarMap_comp K K[X] D, scalarMap_comp R R[X] (Cover f)] at H
  let e : SpecOver (R := K) D ≅ (Over.pullback (scalarMap R K)).obj (SpecOver (R := R) (Cover f)) :=
    Over.isoMk H.isoPullback H.isoPullback_hom_snd
  have hz : (algebraMap R[X] K[X] 0) = 0 := map_zero _
  exact (eqToIso (congrArg (fun b : K[X] => SpecOver (R := K) (QuadraticAlgebra K[X]
    (algebraMap R[X] K[X] f) b)) hz)).symm ≪≫ e

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.gluedOver
declarations.snippet:
def gluedOver (f g : R[X]) (h : SexticOverlap R f g) : Over (Spec (.of R)) :=
  Over.mk (Y := glued R f g h) (WidePushout.desc (arrows := arrow R f g h)
    (SpecOver (R := R) (Punctured R f)).hom
    (fun i => (SpecOver (R := R) (Cover (if i then g else f))).hom) (by
      intro i
      cases i
      · exact puncture_w R f
      · let e : Spec (.of (Punctured R f)) ⟶ Spec (.of (Punctured R g)) :=
          (specIso (transition R h)).inv.left
        exact (Category.assoc e (puncture R g) (SpecOver (R := R) (Cover g)).hom).trans
          ((congrArg (e ≫ ·) (puncture_w R g)).trans (Over.w (specIso (transition R h)).inv))))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.diagramIso
declarations.snippet:
private def diagramIso : rechartDiagram R f g h U e ≅ diagram R f g h := by
  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun j => match j with
    | none => Iso.refl _
    | some i => (Over.forget _).mapIso (e i)) ?_
  intro j k a
  change WidePushoutShape.Hom j k at a
  cases a with
  | id j =>
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ _ = _ ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  | init i =>
    let b : (U i).left ≅ (chart R f g i).left := (Over.forget _).mapIso (e i)
    exact cancel_change (B := (chart R f g i).left) (arrow R f g h i) b

    [IsProper D.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral D.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom] :
    GroupScheme K := by
  let f := JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.toBase K D.hom
  let G := JacobianVarieties.Picard.Unpointed.groupLaw K D.hom
  let : GrpObj (Over.mk f) := G.grpObjOverMk

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LocalJacobians.TwoTripleGoodReduction
declarations.snippet:
def TwoTripleGoodReduction : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Qp[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6), f.Separable →
    ∀ (g : W[X]) (c : W) (m l : ℕ), 2 < p → 0 < m →
      ∀ T : SexticFibre g ((p : W)^m),
        f.map (algebraMap Qp L) = (C c*g).map (algebraMap W L) →
        g.Monic → addVal W c = (l : ℕ∞) →
        (f.Splits ∨ f.IsSplittingField Qp L) →
        (Module.Finite ℤ_[p] W ∧ Algebra.Etale ℤ_[p] W) → IsIntegralClosure W ℤ_[p] L →
        (∀ s ∈ tree, s ≠ Finset.univ → Odd s.card) →
        (∀ s (hs : principal s), Even (principalOrder (C c*g) T s hs)) →
        let D := sexticCompletion f hd
        ∀ [IsProper D.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral D.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 D.hom],
          HasGoodReduction p (jacobian D)

    (hp : 17 ≤ p) (v a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (t : ℤ_[p])
    (coord : PrimitiveParameters.Coordinates p u t (v : ℤ_[p]) (a : ℤ_[p]))
    {m l : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p : W)^m))
    (h : conditions (equation p u v a t) T l) :
    let D := sexticCompletion (polynomial p u v a t) (ddmm_sextic_regular hu v a t coord).1
    let G := chart_geometry p hu v a t coord
    letI := G.1
    letI := G.2.1
    letI := G.2.2
    HasGoodReduction p (jacobian D) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WittSquareClasses.coordinateEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def coordinateEquiv : (R × R) ≃ₗ[R] W :=
  let t := (coordinates p k).choose
  let f : (R × R) →ₗ[R] W := {
    toFun := fun ab => extend p k ab.1 + extend p k ab.2*t
    map_add' := by
      rintro ⟨a,b⟩ ⟨c,d⟩
      change extend p k (a+c) + extend p k (b+d)*t = _
      simp only [map_add]
      ring
    map_smul' := by
      rintro z ⟨a,b⟩
      change extend p k (z*a) + extend p k (z*b)*t = extend p k z*(extend p k a + extend p k b*t)
      simp only [map_mul]
      ring }
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective f (coordinates p k).choose_spec

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.scalarSigns
declarations.snippet:
def scalarSigns (c : Option F) : Setoid (Fibre c) where
  r x y := x.val = y.val ∨ x.val = -y.val
  iseqv := ⟨fun _ => Or.inl rfl, by
    intro x y h
    rcases h with h|h
    · exact Or.inl h.symm
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [h]; simp)
    , by
    intro x y z h k
    rcases h with h|h <;> rcases k with k|k <;> simp [h,k]⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.signedEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def signedEquiv (c : Option F) : Representatives c ≃ Quotient (scalarSigns c) := by
  let f : Representatives c → Quotient (scalarSigns c) :=
    fun x => Quotient.mk _ ⟨x.val,x.property.1⟩
  refine Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    have hh := Quotient.exact h
    change x.val=y.val ∨ x.val = -y.val at hh
    rcases hh with h|h
    · exact Subtype.ext h
    · have hx := x.property.2
      rw [h] at hx
      exact ((signs_complement _ y.property.1.1).mp y.property.2 hx).elim
  · intro q
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
    intro x
    by_cases h : positive x.val
    · exact ⟨⟨x.val,x.property,h⟩,rfl⟩
    · have hn : positive (-x.val) := by by_contra hn; exact h ((signs_complement _ x.property.1).mpr hn)
      refine ⟨⟨-x.val,(inFibre_neg c x.val).mpr x.property,hn⟩, Quotient.sound (Or.inr rfl)⟩

  invFun x := ((unit_iff _).mpr x.property.1).unit

  invFun x := ⟨((unit_iff _).mpr x.property.1).unit,(mem_normOne _).mpr (by simpa using x.property.2)⟩
  left_inv u := Subtype.ext (Units.ext (IsUnit.unit_spec _))
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext (((unit_iff x.val).mpr x.property.1).unit_spec)

    (h₀ : isInteger (trd q))
    (h₁ : isInteger (trd (q * embed (printed 0 1 0 0))))
    (h₂ : isInteger (trd (q * embed (printed 0 0 1 0))))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.IntegralOrder.actionEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def actionEquiv {E : Type*} [Ring E] (action : O →+* E) (realize : E →+* B)
    (faithful : Function.Injective realize) (compatible : ∀ x, realize (action x) = embed x)
    (trace : ∀ x, isInteger (trd (realize x)))
    (norm : ∀ x, isInteger (reducedNorm (realize x))) : O ≃+* E := by
  apply RingEquiv.ofBijective action
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply embed_injective
    simpa only [compatible] using congrArg realize h
  · intro y
    have pairing (x : O) : isInteger (trd (realize y * embed x)) := by
      simpa only [map_mul, compatible] using trace (y * action x)
    obtain ⟨x,h⟩ := mem_of_traces_norm (realize y) (trace y) (pairing _) (pairing _) (pairing _) (norm y)
    exact ⟨x,faithful ((compatible x).trans h)⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LevelThree.IntegralOrder.fullActionOfDimension
declarations.snippet:
def fullActionOfDimension {E D : Type*} [Ring E] [Module.Finite ℤ E]
    [Ring D] [Nontrivial D] [Algebra ℚ D] [FiniteDimensional ℚ D]
    (a : O →+* E) (incl : E →+* D) (injective : Function.Injective incl)
    (rational : B →ₐ[ℚ] D) (commutes : ∀ x, incl (a x) = rational (embed x))
    (dim : Module.finrank ℚ D ≤ 4) : O ≃+* E := by
  have inj := rational_action_injective rational
  have four : Module.finrank ℚ B = 4 := QuaternionAlgebra.finrank_eq_four _ _ _
  have eq : Module.finrank ℚ B = Module.finrank ℚ D :=
    le_antisymm (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (f := rational.toLinearMap) inj) (four.symm ▸ dim)
  have surj : Function.Surjective rational :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank eq (f:=rational.toLinearMap)).mp inj
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofBijective rational ⟨inj,surj⟩
  exact fullAction a (e.symm.toRingHom.comp incl) (e.symm.injective.comp injective)
    (fun x => (congrArg e.symm (commutes x)).trans (e.symm_apply_apply (embed x)))

    fullActionOfDimension a incl injective rational commutes dim x = a x := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.contact_dvd_kernel
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.TwistBound
ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.ContactBound

def ContactBound (S : Finset ℕ) (A : ℝ) : Prop :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.contact_of_twists

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.twists_of_contact
declarations.snippet:
theorem twists_of_contact (S : Finset ℕ) (small : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∉ S → 5<p)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (bound : ContactBound S A) : TwistBound (A+Real.log 1800) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.publicTwistConstant

def publicTwistConstant : ℝ := (heightH6 (heightD:ℝ) - Real.log 1800) /

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.positivePrimeProduct

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.publicTwistConstant_pos
declarations.snippet: theorem publicTwistConstant_pos : 0 < publicTwistConstant := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.integerValue
declarations.snippet: def integerValue (u : ℚ) : ℤ := binary u.num (u.den:ℤ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.binary_identity
declarations.snippet: theorem binary_identity (u : ℚ) : (integerValue u:ℚ) = contactPoly u * (u.den:ℚ)^6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.IsKernel
declarations.snippet: def IsKernel (u : ℚ) (d e : ℤ) : Prop := Squarefree d ∧ d*e^2=integerValue u

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.exists_kernel
declarations.snippet: theorem exists_kernel (u : ℚ) : ∃ d e : ℤ, IsKernel u d e := by

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.squarefree_odd_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem squarefree_odd_order {d : ℤ} (h : Squarefree d) {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.kernel_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem kernel_order {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ contactSet) {d e : ℤ} (h : IsKernel u d e)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.kernel_prime_inclusion
declarations.snippet:
theorem kernel_prime_inclusion {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ contactSet) {d e : ℤ} (h : IsKernel u d e)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.kernel_prime_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem kernel_prime_iff {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ contactSet) {d e : ℤ} (h : IsKernel u d e)
    (S : Finset ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpS : p ∉ S) (h5 : 5<p) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.kernel_dvd
declarations.snippet:
theorem kernel_dvd {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ contactSet) {d e : ℤ} (h : IsKernel u d e)
    (S : Finset ℕ) : d.natAbs ∣ (∏ p ∈ S, p) * contactSupport S u := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.inverse_parity
declarations.snippet: theorem inverse_parity {x y : ℚ} {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) (ny : y≠0) (nx : x≠5) (point : 30*(d:ℚ)*y^2=quintic x) : let u : ℚ := 120/(x-5) u ∉ contactSet ∧ X u=x ∧ ∀ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∉ S → 5

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OddSupport.inverse_kernel
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.factors
declarations.snippet:
private theorem factors {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {t c : R} (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic t) c) (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    (∏ j, (X-C (point T (e j)))) = monicSextic t := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.fibre_weight_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_weight_sum {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {t c : R} (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic t) c) (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    ∑ i, weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i = -144*t^2*(t^2+27)^2 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.map_order
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_order {t : Zp} {n : ℕ} (ht : addVal Zp t=(n:ℕ∞)) :
    addVal W (fromPadics p t)=(n:ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.small_units
declarations.snippet: private theorem small_units (hp : 17 ≤ p) : IsUnit (144:W) ∧ IsUnit (27:W) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.even_sum_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_sum_order (hp : 17 ≤ p) {t : Zp} (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (ht : addVal Zp t=((2*m:ℕ):ℕ∞))
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^m)) (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    addVal W (∑ i, weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i) = ((4*m:ℕ):ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_sum_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_sum_order (hp : 17 ≤ p) {u : ℚ} {t a : Zpˣ} (g : ℕ)
    (hG : addVal Zp (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞))
    (he : (a:Zp)^2*((t:Zp)^2+27)=RationalClusters.G p u^3)
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p (t:Zp))) ((p:W)^g)) (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    addVal W (∑ i, weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i) = ((6*g:ℕ):ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.invariant
declarations.snippet:
private def invariant (f : R[X]) := quart (f.coeff 0) (f.coeff 1) (f.coeff 2)
  (f.coeff 3) (f.coeff 4) (f.coeff 5) (f.coeff 6)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.linprod
declarations.snippet: private def linprod (r : Fin 6 → R) : R[X] := ∏ i, (X-C (r i))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.map_invariant
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_invariant (φ : R →+* S) (f : R[X]) :
    φ (invariant f) = invariant (f.map φ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.map_linprod
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_linprod (φ : R →+* S) (r : Fin 6 → R) :
    (linprod r).map φ = linprod (φ ∘ r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.map_weights
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_weights (φ : R →+* S) (r : Fin 6 → R) :
    φ (∑ i, weight r i) = ∑ i, weight (φ ∘ r) i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.complex_sum
declarations.snippet:
private theorem complex_sum (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, weight r i = invariant (linprod r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.integral_weight_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem integral_weight_sum (r : Fin 6 → R) :
    ∑ i, weight r i = invariant (linprod r) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.coeff_monic
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coeff_monic (t : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (DirectCharts.monicSextic t).coeff n =
      (if n=6 then 1 else 0) + (if n=5 then 9-t else 0) +
      (if n=4 then 27-9*t else 0) + (if n=3 then t^2-32*t+27 else 0) +
      (if n=2 then 6*t^2-54*t else 0) + (if n=1 then 12*t^2-36*t else 0) +
      (if n=0 then 8*t^2 else 0) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.monic_weight_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_weight_sum (r : Fin 6 → R) (t : R)
    (he : (∏ i, (X-C (r i))) = DirectCharts.monicSextic t) :
    ∑ i, weight r i = -144*t^2*(t^2+27)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.side
declarations.snippet: private def side (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) (j : Fin 6) : Bool := decide ((e j).1 = 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.side_card
declarations.snippet:
private theorem side_card (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => side e j = true)).card = 3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.edge_side
declarations.snippet:
private theorem edge_side (a b : Fin 2) :
    (decide (a = 0) = decide (b = 0)) ↔ a=b := by decide +revert

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.fibre_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_orders {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    {f : S[X]} {π : S} (hπ : Irreducible π) (m : ℕ) (T : SexticFibre f (π^m))
    (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index) :
    ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, addVal S (weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i) =
      if i = k then ((12*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) else ((4*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.even_contact_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_contact_orders (u : ℚ) (hp : 17 ≤ p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hF : addVal Zp (RationalClusters.F p u) = ((2*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^m),
        ∀ e : Fin 6 ≃ Index, ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, addVal W (weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i) =
          if i=k then ((12*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) else ((4*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_orders (u : ℚ) (hp : 17 ≤ p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hG : addVal Zp (RationalClusters.G p u) = (m : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p (t:Zp))) ((p:W)^m),
        ∀ e : Fin 6 ≃ Index, ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, addVal W (weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i) =
          if i=k then ((12*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) else ((4*m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.normalized
declarations.snippet: def normalized {K : Type*} [Field K] (w : Fin 10 → K) (i : Fin 10) := w i / ∑ j, w j

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.normalized_scaling
declarations.snippet:
theorem normalized_scaling {K : Type*} [Field K] (w : Fin 10 → K) {s : K} (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 10) : normalized (fun j => s*w j) i = normalized w i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.normalized_mobius
declarations.snippet:
theorem normalized_mobius {K : Type*} [Field K] (r : Fin 6 → K) (a b c d : K) (h : a*d-b*c≠0)
    (hu : ∀ j, c*r j+d≠0) (i : Fin 10) :
    normalized (weight (fun j => mobius a b c d (r j))) i = normalized (weight r) i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.factor_of_order
declarations.snippet:
private theorem factor_of_order {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    {π x : R} (hπ : Irreducible π) {n : ℕ} (hx : addVal R x=(n:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ e : Rˣ, x=e*π^n := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.quotient_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem quotient_order {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [Field K] (φ : R →+* K) (hi : Function.Injective φ) {π x y : R} (hπ : Irreducible π)
    {m n : ℕ} (hx : addVal R x=(m:ℕ∞)) (hy : addVal R y=(n:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ e : Rˣ, φ x / φ y = φ (e:R) * (φ π)^((m:ℤ)-(n:ℤ)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.normalizedFibre
ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.fibre_profile
declarations.snippet:
private theorem fibre_profile {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : W →+* K) (hi : Function.Injective φ)
    {t : W} {m n : ℕ} (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic t) ((p:W)^m)) (e : Fin 6 ≃ Index)
    (h : addVal W (∑ i, weight (fun j => point T (e j)) i)=(n:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, ∃ b : Wˣ, normalizedFibre p φ T e i =
      φ (b:W) * φ (p:W)^((if i=k then (12*m:ℤ) else 4*m)-(n:ℤ)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.even_normalized
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_normalized {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : W →+* K) (hi : Function.Injective φ)
    (u : ℚ) (hp : 17 ≤ p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hF : addVal Zp (RationalClusters.F p u)=((2*m:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^m), ∀ e : Fin 6 ≃ Index,
        ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, ∃ b : Wˣ, normalizedFibre p φ T e i =
          φ (b:W) * φ (p:W)^(if i=k then (8*m:ℤ) else 0) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_normalized
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_normalized {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : W →+* K) (hi : Function.Injective φ)
    (u : ℚ) (hp : 17 ≤ p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hG : addVal Zp (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p (t:Zp))) ((p:W)^g), ∀ e : Fin 6 ≃ Index,
        ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, ∃ b : Wˣ, normalizedFibre p φ T e i =
          φ (b:W) * φ (p:W)^(if i=k then (6*g:ℤ) else -(2*g)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.triangle
declarations.snippet:
def triangle {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : Fin 6 → R) (a b c : Fin 6) : R :=
  (r a-r b)*(r a-r c)*(r b-r c)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.weight
declarations.snippet:
def weight {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : Fin 6 → R) (i : Fin 10) : R :=
  let t := row i
  (triangle r t.p.castSucc t.q.castSucc 5 *
    triangle r t.a.castSucc t.b.castSucc t.c.castSucc)^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.complex_weight
declarations.snippet: theorem complex_weight (r : Fin 6 → ℂ) (i : Fin 10) : weight r i = rowWeight r i := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.distinct_vertices
declarations.snippet:
private theorem distinct_vertices (i : Fin 10) :
    (row i).p.castSucc ≠ (row i).q.castSucc ∧ (row i).p.castSucc ≠ (5 : Fin 6) ∧
    (row i).q.castSucc ≠ (5 : Fin 6) ∧ (row i).a.castSucc ≠ (row i).b.castSucc ∧
    (row i).a.castSucc ≠ (row i).c.castSucc ∧ (row i).b.castSucc ≠ (row i).c.castSucc := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.sameEdge
declarations.snippet: def sameEdge (side : Fin 6 → Bool) (i j : Fin 6) : ℕ := if side i = side j then 1 else 0

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.inside
declarations.snippet:
def inside (side : Fin 6 → Bool) (a b c : Fin 6) : ℕ :=
  sameEdge side a b + sameEdge side a c + sameEdge side b c

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.withinEdges
ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.three_three_counts
declarations.snippet:
theorem three_three_counts (side : Fin 6 → Bool)
    (hs : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => side j = true)).card = 3) :
    ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, withinEdges side i = if i = k then 6 else 2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.triangle_order
declarations.snippet:
private theorem triangle_order {R Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    (v : AddValuation R Γ) (r : Fin 6 → R) (d : Γ) (s : Fin 6 → Bool)
    (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → v (r i-r j) = sameEdge s i j • d)
    {a b c : Fin 6} (hab : a≠b) (hac : a≠c) (hbc : b≠c) :
    v (triangle r a b c) = inside s a b c • d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.weight_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem weight_order {R Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    (v : AddValuation R Γ) (r : Fin 6 → R) (d : Γ) (s : Fin 6 → Bool)
    (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → v (r i-r j) = sameEdge s i j • d) (i : Fin 10) :
    v (weight r i) = (2*withinEdges s i) • d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem orders {R Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    (v : AddValuation R Γ) (r : Fin 6 → R) (d : Γ) (s : Fin 6 → Bool)
    (hs : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => s j = true)).card = 3)
    (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → v (r i-r j) = sameEdge s i j • d) :
    ∃ k : Fin 10, ∀ i, v (weight r i) = if i = k then 12 • d else 4 • d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.poleNorm
declarations.snippet: def poleNorm (u : ℚ) : ℕ := (poleForm u.num (u.den:ℤ)).natAbs

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.bounds
declarations.snippet:
private theorem bounds (A B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    0 < poleForm A B ∧ poleForm A B ≤ 3907*(max |A| B)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_form_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_form_height (u : ℚ) :
    Real.log (poleNorm u) ≤ Real.log 3907+2*ZInQ.ratHeight u := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_exponent
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_exponent (p : ℕ) [hprime : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℚ) (g : ℕ)
    (hg : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[p] (RationalClusters.G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) :
    (poleNorm u).factorization p = g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.pole_sum_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_sum_height (u : ℚ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : s ⊆ (poleNorm u).primeFactors) :
    (∑ p ∈ s, 2*((poleNorm u).factorization p:ℝ)*Real.log p) ≤
       2*Real.log 3907+4*ZInQ.ratHeight u := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.mobius
declarations.snippet: def mobius (a b c d x : K) := (a*x+b)/(c*x+d)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.difference_mobius
declarations.snippet:
theorem difference_mobius (a b c d x y : K) (hx : c*x+d≠0) (hy : c*y+d≠0) :
    (mobius a b c d x-mobius a b c d y)*(c*x+d)*(c*y+d)=(a*d-b*c)*(x-y) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.clear_triangle
declarations.snippet:
private theorem clear_triangle (r : Fin 6 → K) (a b c d : K) (hu : ∀ i, c*r i+d≠0)
    (i j k : Fin 6) :
    triangle (fun s => mobius a b c d (r s)) i j k *
      ((c*r i+d)*(c*r j+d)*(c*r k+d))^2 = (a*d-b*c)^3 * triangle r i j k := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.row_product
ZInQBlueprint.BranchDepth.clear_weight_mobius

def evaluateChart (c : Fin 7 → K) (j : Fin 5) (a : Fin 4 → S)
    (h : ∀ i, generators (algebraMap K S ∘ c) (j.insertNth 1 a) i = 0) :
    ChartRing c j →ₐ[K] S :=
  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (aeval a) fun p hp => by
    have e : (equationsIdeal c).toIdeal.map (TauCeti.dehomogenize j) ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval a) := by
      apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
      change aeval a (TauCeti.dehomogenize j (quadrics c i)) = 0
      rw [TauCeti.aeval_dehomogenize,eval_quadrics]
      exact h i
    exact e hp
