declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.chartRingEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def chartRingEquiv (c : Fin 7 → K) (b : Bool) : ChartRing c (pivot b) ≃ₐ[K] SquareChart c b :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (chartToSquare c b) (squareToChart c b) (by
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro z
    let F := (chartToSquare c b).comp (squareToChart c b)
    change F z = (AlgHom.id K _ : SquareChart c b →ₐ[K] _) z
    have x : F (squareX c b) = squareX c b := by
      change chartToSquare c b (squareToChart c b (squareX c b)) = _
      rw [squareToChart_X]
      unfold chartToSquare
      rw [evaluateChart_variable]
      cases b <;> rfl
    have y : F (squareY c b) = squareY c b := by
      change chartToSquare c b (squareToChart c b (squareY c b)) = _
      rw [squareToChart_Y]
      unfold chartToSquare
      rw [evaluateChart_variable]
      cases b <;> rfl
    exact (affinePoint_image F z).trans ((congrArg₂
      (fun a d => Polynomial.aeval a z.re + Polynomial.aeval a z.im * d) x y).trans
      (affinePoint_image (AlgHom.id K _) z).symm)) (by
    apply chart_ext
    intro i
    change squareToChart c b (chartToSquare c b (chartVariable c (pivot b) i)) = _
    unfold chartToSquare
    rw [evaluateChart_variable]
    rw [congrFun (chart_xy c b).2 i]
    cases b <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [affineTuple,map_pow,squareToChart_X,squareToChart_Y])

declarations.snippet:
def restrictPoints {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S) (A : CommGrp (Over S)) :
    (Over.map f).op ⋙ points A ≅ points ((Over.pullback f).mapCommGrp.obj A) := by
  let adj := Over.mapPullbackAdj f
  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun U => (MulEquiv.toGrpIso
    (show ((Over.map f).obj U.unop ⟶ A.X) ≃* (U.unop ⟶ (Over.pullback f).obj A.X) from
      { __ := adj.homEquiv U.unop A.X
        map_mul' := fun a b => by
          change adj.homEquiv U.unop A.X (a*b) =
            adj.homEquiv U.unop A.X a * adj.homEquiv U.unop A.X b
          simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, Functor.map_mul]
          exact MonObj.comp_mul _ _ _ }))) ?_
  intro U V h
  ext a
  exact adj.homEquiv_naturality_left h.unop a

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PointedSextic.evaluate
declarations.snippet:
def evaluate {R S : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (f : R)
    (y : S) (h : y^2 = φ f) : Cover f →+* S where
  toFun z := φ z.re + φ z.im * y
  map_one' := by change φ 1 + φ 0 * y = 1; simp
  map_zero' := by change φ 0 + φ 0 * y = 0; simp
  map_add' a b := by change φ (a + b).re + φ (a + b).im * y = _; simp; ring
  map_mul' a b := by change φ (a * b).re + φ (a * b).im * y = _; simp [← h]; ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PointedSextic.point
declarations.snippet:
def point (u : ℚ) : SpecOver (R := ℚ) (SplittingField u) ⟶ SpecOver (Cover (fixed ℚ u true)) := by
  let q := (algebraMap ℚ (SplittingField u)).comp (evalRingHom (0:ℚ))
  let ev := evaluate q (fixed ℚ u true) (ordinate u) (ordinate_sq u)
  refine Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev)) ?_
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℚ _)) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℚ (SplittingField u)))
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change q (C r) + q 0 * ordinate u = algebraMap ℚ _ r
  simp [q]

ZInQBlueprint.PointedSextic.iso_of_pointed_tests
declarations.snippet:
def iso_of_pointed_tests {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet)
    {A B : GroupScheme ℚ} (α : points A ⟶ points B)
    (h : ∀ T : Over S, Nonempty (T ⟶ paperModel ℚ u) → Function.Bijective (α.app (op T))) :
    A ≅ B := by
  let r : pointSheaf A ⟶ pointSheaf B := ⟨Functor.whiskerRight α (forget GrpCat)⟩
  obtain ⟨hI, hS⟩ := locally_bijective α u (infinityChart hu) h
  let : IsIso r := (Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso r).mp
    ⟨(Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_forget_iff Jtop α).mpr hI,
      (Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_whisker_forget Jtop α).mp hS⟩
  have is : IsIso (Functor.whiskerRight α (forget GrpCat)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf Jtop (Type 0)).map r))
  have app := (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app _).mp is
  let : IsIso α := (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app _).mpr (fun T => by
    let : IsIso ((forget GrpCat).map (α.app T)) := app T
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso (α.app T) (forget GrpCat))
  exact groupIso (asIso α)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.ddmm_smooth_completion_iso
declarations.snippet:
theorem ddmm_smooth_completion_iso {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet)
    (v a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (t : ℤ_[p]) (hc : PrimitiveParameters.Coordinates p u t (v : ℤ_[p]) (a : ℤ_[p])) :
    let f := GoodReductionCharts.polynomial p u v a t
    let hd := (ddmm_sextic_regular hu v a t hc).1
    let D := sexticCompletion f hd
    ∃ j : SpecOver (R := ℚ_[p]) (Cover f) ⟶ paperPullback ℚ_[p] u, IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧
      ∃! e : paperPullback ℚ_[p] u ≅ D, j ≫ e.hom = chartInclusion ℚ_[p] f f.reverse (reverse_sextic_overlap hd) false := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.sextic
declarations.snippet:
def sextic (c : Fin 7 → R) (x : R) : R :=
  c 0+c 1*x+c 2*x^2+c 3*x^3+c 4*x^4+c 5*x^5+c 6*x^6

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.quadratic
declarations.snippet:
def quadratic (c : Fin 7 → R) (A B C D : R) : R :=
  c 0*D^2+c 1*C*D+c 2*B*D+c 3*A*D+c 4*A*C+c 5*A*B+c 6*A^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.equations
declarations.snippet:
def equations (c : Fin 7 → R) (A B C D T : R) : Prop :=
  A*C=B^2 ∧ A*D=B*C ∧ B*D=C^2 ∧ T^2=quadratic c A B C D

declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_chart (c : Fin 7 → R) (a b x y : R) :
    equations c a b x 1 y ↔ a=x^3 ∧ b=x^2 ∧ y^2=sextic c x := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem infinity_chart (c : Fin 7 → R) (z b d w : R) :
    equations c 1 z b d w ↔ b=z^2 ∧ d=z^3 ∧ w^2=sextic (fun i => c i.rev) z := by

    (h : equations c 0 b x 0 y) : b=0 ∧ x=0 ∧ y=0 := by

theorem transition {x z y : R} (hxz : x*z=1) :
    z^3*x^3=1 ∧ z^3*x^2=z ∧ z^3*x=z^2 ∧ z^3*1=z^3 ∧ z^3*y=y*z^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.eval_equation
declarations.snippet:
private theorem eval_equation (c : Fin 7 → K) (x : S) :
    aeval x (equationPolynomial c) = sextic (fun i => algebraMap K S (c i)) x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.coverPoints
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def coverPoints (c : Fin 7 → K) :
    (Cover (equationPolynomial c) →ₐ[K] S) ≃
      {p : S × S // p.2^2 = sextic (fun i => algebraMap K S (c i)) p.1} where
  toFun g := ⟨⟨g (algebraMap K[X] _ X),g QuadraticAlgebra.omega⟩,
    (ordinate_square g).trans (eval_equation c _)⟩
  invFun p := affinePoint (equationPolynomial c) p.1.1 p.1.2 (p.2.trans (eval_equation c _).symm)
  left_inv g := AlgHom.ext fun z => (affinePoint_image g z).symm
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · change aeval p.1.1 (X : K[X]) + aeval p.1.1 (0:K[X])*p.1.2 = p.1.1
      simp
    · change aeval p.1.1 (0:K[X]) + aeval p.1.1 (1:K[X])*p.1.2 = p.1.2
      simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.standardDPoints
declarations.snippet:
def standardDPoints (c : Fin 7 → R) :
    {p : R × R // p.2^2 = sextic c p.1} ≃
    {v : R × R × R × R // equations c v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 1 v.2.2.2} where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨p.1.1^3,p.1.1^2,p.1.1,p.1.2⟩,(finite_chart ..).mpr ⟨rfl,rfl,p.2⟩⟩
  invFun v := ⟨⟨v.1.2.2.1,v.1.2.2.2⟩,((finite_chart ..).mp v.2).2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv v := by
    obtain ⟨⟨a,b,x,y⟩,hv⟩ := v
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,-⟩ := (finite_chart ..).mp hv
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext ha.symm (Prod.ext hb.symm rfl)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.standardAPoints
declarations.snippet:
def standardAPoints (c : Fin 7 → R) :
    {p : R × R // p.2^2 = sextic (fun i => c i.rev) p.1} ≃
    {v : R × R × R × R // equations c 1 v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2} where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨p.1.1,p.1.1^2,p.1.1^3,p.1.2⟩,(infinity_chart ..).mpr ⟨rfl,rfl,p.2⟩⟩
  invFun v := ⟨⟨v.1.1,v.1.2.2.2⟩,((infinity_chart ..).mp v.2).2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv v := by
    obtain ⟨⟨z,b,d,w⟩,hv⟩ := v
    obtain ⟨hb,hd,-⟩ := (infinity_chart ..).mp hv
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext hb.symm (Prod.ext hd.symm rfl))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.finiteChartAlgebraPoints
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def finiteChartAlgebraPoints (f : K[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6) :
    (Cover f →ₐ[K] S) ≃ {v : S × S × S × S //
      equations (fun i => algebraMap K S (f.coeff i)) v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 1 v.2.2.2} := by
  let c : Fin 7 → K := fun i => f.coeff i
  let e := (coverPoints (S := S) c).trans (standardDPoints _)
  exact (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun h : K[X] => Cover h →ₐ[K] S) (coefficient_equation f hd.le).symm)).trans e

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticEmbedding.infinityChartAlgebraPoints
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def infinityChartAlgebraPoints (f : K[X]) (hd : f.natDegree = 6) :
    (Cover f.reverse →ₐ[K] S) ≃ {v : S × S × S × S //
      equations (fun i => algebraMap K S (f.coeff i)) 1 v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2} := by
  let c : Fin 7 → K := fun i => f.coeff i
  let e := (coverPoints (S := S) (fun i => c i.rev)).trans (standardAPoints (fun i => algebraMap K S (c i)))
  have he : equationPolynomial (fun i => c i.rev) = f.reverse := by
    rw [← reversed_coefficients f hd]
    exact coefficient_equation _ (f.reverse_natDegree_le.trans hd.le)
  exact (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun h : K[X] => Cover h →ₐ[K] S) he.symm)).trans e

  functor := diagram R f g h
  natTrans := {
    app := component R f g h
    naturality := by
      intro i j a
      change WidePushoutShape.Hom i j at a
      cases a with
      | id i => exact Category.id_comp _ |>.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm
      | init i => exact (chartSquare R f g h i).w }
  equifibered := by
    intro i j a
    change WidePushoutShape.Hom i j at a
    cases a with
    | id i => exact IsPullback.of_id_fst
    | init i => exact chartSquare R f g h i

  WidePushout.desc (arrows := lineArrow R) (scalarMap R (LaurentPolynomial R))
    (fun _ => scalarMap R R[X]) (by
      intro i
      cases i
      · change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
        rw [← Spec.map_comp]
        congr 1
        exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext Polynomial.toLaurent_C)
      · change (Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _) ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
        rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
        congr 1
        apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
        apply RingHom.ext
        intro r
        change LaurentPolynomial.invert.symm (toLaurent (Polynomial.C r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
        rw [Polynomial.toLaurent_C, LaurentPolynomial.invert_symm, LaurentPolynomial.invert_C])

  · exact fun r => (Sheaf.H.map (scalarEnd p r) 1).map_add
  · intro r s x

    rw [scalar_add, Sheaf.H.map_add_apply]

  · intro r s x

    (hφ : (act sqrtThree).asHom ≫ φ.hom = φ.hom ≫ (pull σ).map (act sqrtThree).asHom) :
    let E := underlying (restrictedAction e act QuadraticAlgebra.omega).asHom
    let a := underlying (correctionIso e σ φ).hom

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.QuaternionMarking.marked_of_printed
declarations.snippet:
def marked_of_printed (D : DivisorData hu) (preserves : (J ≅ J) → Prop)
    (T : PolarizedTorelli D preserves) (e : J ≅ P) (act : LevelThree.O →+* End P)
    (hact : Function.Injective act)
    (moduli : IsSquare (-(27*SixContact.J u+16)/SixContact.J u) →
      ∀ σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar, ∃ φ : P ≅ (pull σ).obj P,
        (act sqrtThree).asHom ≫ φ.hom = φ.hom ≫ (pull σ).map (act sqrtThree).asHom ∧
        preserves (correctionIso e σ φ)) :
    JacobianHeight.MarkedAction u A := by
  let i := restrictedAction e act
  let E := (i QuadraticAlgebra.omega).asHom
  apply markedAction_of_divisors D preserves T i (restricted_faithful e hact)
  intro square
  dsimp only
  intro σ
  obtain ⟨φ,ht,hp⟩ := moduli square σ
  let a := correctionIso e σ φ
  have h := corrected_generator e act σ φ ht
  have signs := polarized_signs D.comparison (torelli_on_points D T) (groupMap a) ⟨a,hp,rfl⟩
  change (groupMap a ≫ deck (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X.hom σ) ≫ underlying E = underlying E ≫ groupMap a ≫ deck (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X.hom σ at h
  have commute : underlying E ≫ groupMap a = groupMap a ≫ underlying E := by
    rcases signs with hs|hs
    · simp [hs]
    · rw [hs]
      exact congrArg Over.Hom.left (GrpObj.inv_hom E.hom.hom.hom).symm
  refine ⟨groupMap a, ⟨a,hp,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  exact switch_correction (underlying E) (groupMap a) (underlying a.inv)
    (show (geometricJacobian hu).X.left ⟶ (geometricJacobian hu).X.left from deck (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X.hom σ)
    (congrArg underlying a.inv_hom_id) commute h

  let : IsIso e.hom.left := inferInstanceAs (IsIso (((Over.forget _).mapIso e).hom))
  change IsOpenImmersion ((punctureOver _).left ≫ e.hom.left ≫ (chartInclusion K _ _ _ false).left)
  exact @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ (inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion (puncture K (changed u d))))
    (@IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ (IsOpenImmersion.of_isIso e.hom.left) (chartInclusion_open ..))

declarations.snippet:
instance model_geom [IsAlgClosed K] (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) (hd : d^2=6) :
    GeometricallyIrreducible (model hu hd).hom := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (factor u d) (by decide : 0<2)
  let e := curveIso hu hd v hv
  let : IsIso e.inv.left := inferInstanceAs (IsIso (((Over.forget _).mapIso e).inv))
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (paperModel ℚ u).hom := geometricallyIntegral_paperModel hu
  have h : GeometricallyIrreducible (paperPullback K u).hom :=
    inferInstanceAs (GeometricallyIrreducible (pullback.snd (paperModel ℚ u).hom (scalarMap ℚ K)))
  have sq : IsPullback e.inv.left (model hu hd).hom (paperPullback K u).hom (𝟙 _) :=
    IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso ⟨by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact e.inv.w⟩
  exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @GeometricallyIrreducible) sq h

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelMap.IsPointedAbel
declarations.snippet:
def IsPointedAbel (ε : SchemeHomOver (𝟙 (Spec (.of K))) C.hom)
    (J : RelativePic0Designation K C.hom) (h : RepresentsRelSubPic C.hom ε (algEquivZeroCut C.hom ε) J)
    (aj : SchemeHomOver C.hom J.toBase) : Prop :=
  ε.1 ≫ aj.1 = J.zeroSection ∧
  ∀ (L : Type) [Field L] (t : Spec (.of L) ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (x : SchemeHomOver t C.hom),
    Nonempty ((h.poincare.pullbackAlong
      ⟨x.1 ≫ aj.1, (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (x.1 ≫ ·) aj.2).trans x.2)⟩).L ≅
      (RelEffCartierDiv.ofPoint C.hom x.1 x.2).lineBundle ⊗
        (RelEffCartierDiv.ofPoint C.hom (t ≫ ε.1)
          ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (t ≫ ·) ε.2).trans (Category.comp_id t)))).idealModule)

def RepresentsPointDivisors (b : base K ⟶ C) (m : C ⟶ (groupScheme K C.hom).X) : Prop :=
  let ε : SchemeHomOver (𝟙 (Spec (.of K))) C.hom := ⟨b.left,b.w⟩
  ∃ (J : RelativePic0Designation K C.hom) (h : RepresentsRelSubPic C.hom ε (algEquivZeroCut C.hom ε) J)
    (aj : SchemeHomOver C.hom J.toBase), IsPointedAbel C ε J h aj ∧
    m ≫ ((presentation K C.hom).pointedComparisonOver ε h).hom = Over.homMk aj.1 aj.2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SixAbelMap.rigidDivisors
declarations.snippet:
def rigidDivisors : DivisorData hu := by
  letI := rigid_curve_proper u
  letI := rigid_curve_integral hu
  letI := rigid_curve_dimension hu
  letI := sourceIntegral hu
  letI := (baseToFunctionField (paperCurve u).hom).toAlgebra
  let N := signedModel hu
  letI := N.curve
  let A := rigidPresentation hu
  let c := WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback hu
  refine {abel := fun p => A.abel (c p), generate := ?_, fibres := ?_}
  · apply top_unique
    rw [←A.generate]
    apply AddSubgroup.closure_mono
    rintro _ ⟨⟨p,q⟩,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v,rfl⟩ := c.surjective p
    obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := c.surjective q
    exact ⟨(v,w),rfl⟩
  · intro p q
    let e := geometricDeck hu
    have hp := FibreDivisors.paper_fibre_principal hu (normalizedPlace N (c p)) (normalizedPlace N (c q))
    rw [←normalizedPlace_action N e (c p), ←normalizedPlace_action N e (c q)] at hp
    change A.abel (c p) + A.abel (WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback hu _) =
      A.abel (c q) + A.abel (WeightedCurvePoints.weightedEquiv_pullback hu _)
    rw [weighted_deck hu p, weighted_deck hu q]
    exact A.sum_eq_of_principal (c p) (c p ≫ e.hom) (c q) (c q ≫ e.hom) hp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaClass.signedGalois
declarations.snippet:
def signedGalois (σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar) : JacobianPoints hu ≃+ JacobianPoints hu where
  toEquiv := (Additive.ofMul : _ ≃ _).symm.trans
    ((galoisEquiv (SixJacobian.jacobian hu).X σ).trans Additive.ofMul)
  map_add' p q := by
    let A := SixJacobian.jacobian hu
    let e := pointAddEquiv (L:=Qbar) A
    let c : Additive (fieldTest ℚ Qbar ⟶ A.X) →+ Additive (fieldTest ℚ Qbar ⟶ A.X) :=
      { toFun z := Additive.ofMul (coefficient σ ≫ z.toMul)
        map_zero' := by
          change Additive.ofMul (coefficient σ ≫ (1 : fieldTest ℚ Qbar ⟶ A.X)) =
            Additive.ofMul (1 : fieldTest ℚ Qbar ⟶ A.X)
          exact congrArg Additive.ofMul (MonObj.comp_one _)
        map_add' p q := congrArg Additive.ofMul (MonObj.comp_mul (coefficient σ) p.toMul q.toMul) }
    change e (c (e.symm (p+q))) = e (c (e.symm p)) + e (c (e.symm q))
    rw [map_add,map_add,map_add]

def GlobalHeightFormula (hF : GroupScheme ℚ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Over (Spec (.of ℚ))) [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom], SmoothProperCurve.geometricGenus ℚ C.hom = 2 →
    ∀ (f : ℚ[X]) (_hd : f.natDegree = 6) (_nz : f.discr ≠ 0)
      (i : SpecOver (R:=ℚ) (Cover f) ⟶ C), IsOpenImmersion i.left →
    ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K], OddPointChart f K →
      (∀ v : FinitePlace K, GoodAt (jacobian C) v) →
      ∃ I : Ideal (𝓞 K), I ≠ ⊥ ∧ RepresentedAtPlaces f I ∧
        ∃ Z : (K →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) → ThetaPeriod.SiegelPeriod, (∀ σ, InStrengDomain (Z σ)) ∧
          (Module.finrank ℚ K:ℝ)*(hF (jacobian C)+log π) =
            log (I.absNorm:ℝ)/60 - (∑ σ, log (peterssonFactor (Z σ)))/10

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.IntegralEquation
declarations.snippet:
structure IntegralEquation {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] (v : Valuation F ℤᵐ⁰) (f : ℚ[X]) where
  P : v.integer[X]
  Q : v.integer[X]
  degreeP : P.natDegree ≤ 6
  degreeQ : Q.natDegree ≤ 3
  a : F
  b : F
  c : F
  d : F
  e : F
  det_ne : a*d-b*c ≠ 0
  e_ne : e ≠ 0
  change : ∀ x z : F,
    form (fun i => (((4*P+Q^2).coeff i.val : v.integer) : F)) x z =
      (4/e^2)*form (fun i => (f.coeff i.val : F)) (a*x+b*z) (c*x+d*z)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.coefficientsPolynomial
declarations.snippet:
private def coefficientsPolynomial {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : Coefficients R) : R[X] :=
  ∑ i : Fin 7, monomial i.val (a i)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.ordinary_coeff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem ordinary_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : Coefficients R) (i : Fin 7) :
    (coefficientsPolynomial a).coeff i.val = a i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.ordinary_degree
declarations.snippet:
private theorem ordinary_degree {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : Coefficients R) :
    (coefficientsPolynomial a).natDegree ≤ 6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.form_scalar
declarations.snippet:
private theorem form_scalar {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] (s : F) (a : Coefficients F) (x z : F) :
    form (fun i => s*a i) x z = s*form a x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.scaled_integral
declarations.snippet:
private theorem scaled_integral (f : ℚ[X]) (i : Fin 7) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (z:F) = (commonDenominator f:F)^2*(f.coeff i.val:F) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.integralCoefficient
declarations.snippet:
private def integralCoefficient (f : ℚ[X]) (i : Fin 7) : v.integer :=
  (Classical.choose (scaled_integral (F:=F) f i) : ℤ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.coe_integralCoefficient
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coe_integralCoefficient (f : ℚ[X]) (i : Fin 7) :
    ((integralCoefficient v f i : v.integer) : F) = (commonDenominator f:F)^2*(f.coeff i.val:F) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.integralReference
declarations.snippet:
def integralReference (f : ℚ[X]) : IntegralEquation v f where
  P := coefficientsPolynomial (integralCoefficient v f)
  Q := 0
  degreeP := ordinary_degree _
  degreeQ := by simp
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  e := (commonDenominator f:F)⁻¹
  det_ne := by norm_num
  e_ne := inv_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (denominator_pos f).ne')
  change := by
    intro x z
    have h (i : Fin 7) : (((4*coefficientsPolynomial (integralCoefficient v f)+(0:v.integer[X])^2).coeff i.val : v.integer) : F) =
        (4*(commonDenominator f:F)^2)*(f.coeff i.val:F) := by
      simp only [zero_pow (by decide : 2≠0),add_zero,coeff_ofNat_mul,ordinary_coeff]
      change 4*((integralCoefficient v f i:v.integer):F) = _
      rw [coe_integralCoefficient]
      ring
    simp only [h,form_scalar,one_mul,zero_mul,add_zero,zero_add,inv_pow,div_inv_eq_mul]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.reference_integer

    ∃ I : Ideal (𝓞 K), I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K),

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.Rows
declarations.snippet: abbrev Rows (K : Type*) := Fin 6 → K × K

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.bracket
declarations.snippet: def bracket {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (v w : K × K) : K := v.1*w.2 - v.2*w.1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.bracketProduct
declarations.snippet:
def bracketProduct {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (l : Rows K) : K :=
  ∏ i, ∏ j, if i < j then bracket (l i) (l j) else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.splitDisc
declarations.snippet:
def splitDisc {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (c : K) (l : Rows K) : K :=
  c^10 * (bracketProduct l)^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.changeRows
declarations.snippet:
def changeRows {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (l : Rows K) (a b c d : K) : Rows K :=
  fun i => ((l i).1*a+(l i).2*c,(l i).1*b+(l i).2*d)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.bracket_change
declarations.snippet:
theorem bracket_change {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (l : Rows K) (a b c d : K) (i j : Fin 6) :
    bracket (changeRows l a b c d i) (changeRows l a b c d j) =
    (a*d-b*c)*bracket (l i) (l j) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.fifteen
declarations.snippet:
private theorem fifteen {K : Type*} [CommMonoid K] (s : K) :
    (∏ i : Fin 6, ∏ j : Fin 6, if i < j then s else 1) = s^15 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.splitDisc_change
declarations.snippet:
theorem splitDisc_change {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (l : Rows K) (e s a b c d : K) :
    splitDisc (s*e) (changeRows l a b c d) = s^10*(a*d-b*c)^30*splitDisc e l := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.splitDisc_rational
declarations.snippet:
theorem splitDisc_rational {f : ℚ[X]} (hd : f.natDegree=6) (r : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hz : ∀ i, aeval (r i) f = 0) :
    splitDisc (f.leadingCoeff : ℂ) (fun i => (1,-r i)) = (f.discr : ℂ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.Coefficients
declarations.snippet: abbrev Coefficients (R : Type*) := Fin 7 → R

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.form
declarations.snippet:
def form (f : Coefficients K) (x z : K) : K :=
  ∑ i : Fin 7, f i * x^i.val * z^(6-i.val)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.fourJ2
declarations.snippet:
def fourJ2 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Coefficients R) : R :=
  -120*f 0*f 6 + 20*f 1*f 5 - 8*f 2*f 4 + 3*(f 3)^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.fourJ2_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem fourJ2_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (m : R →+* S)
    (f : Coefficients R) : fourJ2 (fun i => m (f i)) = m (fourJ2 f) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.binomial
declarations.snippet: private def binomial (f : Coefficients K) : Coeff K 6 := fun i => f i / (Nat.choose 6 i.val : K)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.form_binomial
declarations.snippet:
private theorem form_binomial (f : Coefficients K) (x z : K) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.binomial_invariant
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.invariant_word
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MinimalDiscriminant.fourJ2_change
declarations.snippet:
theorem fourJ2_change (f g : Coefficients K) (a b c d s : K) (hM : a*d-b*c ≠ 0)
    (equation : ∀ x z, form g x z = s * form f (a*x+b*z) (c*x+d*z)) :
    fourJ2 g = s^2*(a*d-b*c)^6*fourJ2 f := by

    (C : CoarseInterpretation M) (chart : Line ⟶ M)
    (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ) (hom : HomBaseChange ι) (periods : CanonicalPeriods C chart ι hom)
    (uniquePol : UniqueD6Polarization) (primitive : PrimitivePrincipalExists)
    (genus : OriginalRank.HigherOrderGenusCoefficient) (rank : OriginalRank.ModularSimpleZero) :
    FrozenTarget :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RationalReduction.equation
declarations.snippet:
def equation (u : ℚ) (v a : Zpˣ) (t : Zp) : W[X] :=
  chart (delta u:W) (fromPadics p (G p u)) (fromPadics p (v:Zp)) (fromPadics p (a:Zp)) (fromPadics p t)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RationalReduction.roots
declarations.snippet:
theorem roots {S K : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsLocalRing S] [CommRing K] [IsDomain K]
    {f : S[X]} {c l : S} (T : SexticFibre f c) (hl : l≠0) (ι : S →+* K)
    (hi : Function.Injective ι) (z : K) :
    ((C l*f).map ι).IsRoot z ↔ ∃ i : Index, z=ι (point T i) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RationalReduction.conditions
declarations.snippet:
def conditions {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S] {f : S[X]} {c : S}
    (scaled : S[X]) (T : SexticFibre f c) (l : ℕ) : Prop :=
  addVal S scaled.leadingCoeff=(l:ℕ∞) ∧
  (∀ s∈tree, s≠Finset.univ → Odd s.card) ∧ ∀ s (hs : principal s), Even (principalOrder scaled T s hs)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RationalReduction.even_contact_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_contact_chart (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (hf : addVal Zp (F p u)=((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p t)) ((p:W)^k), conditions (equation p u v a t) T (k%2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RationalReduction.pole_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_chart (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0<g)
    (hG : addVal Zp (G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      ∃ T : SexticFibre (monicSextic (fromPadics p (t:Zp))) ((p:W)^g),
        conditions (equation p u 1 a t) T g ∧
        ∀ s (hs : principal s), principalOrder (equation p u 1 a t) T s hs=4*g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.monicSextic
declarations.snippet: def monicSextic (t : R) : R[X] := form 1 (C t) X 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.monic_eval
declarations.snippet: theorem monic_eval (t x : R) : (monicSextic t).eval x = form 1 t x 1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.monic_coeffs
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_coeffs (t : R) : monicSextic t = X^6+C (9-t)*X^5+C (27-9*t)*X^4+
    C (t^2-32*t+27)*X^3+C (6*t^2-54*t)*X^2+C (12*t^2-36*t)*X+C (8*t^2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.monic_six
declarations.snippet: theorem monic_six [Nontrivial R] (t : R) : (monicSextic t).Monic ∧ (monicSextic t).natDegree=6 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.zeroDivided
ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.zero_divided
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_divided {a : R} (ha : alpha a 1=0) (c U Y : R) :
    form 1 (c^2*U) (a+c*Y) 1 = c^3*zeroDivided a c U Y := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.zero_reduction
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_reduction (U Y : R) :
    zeroDivided 0 0 U Y=27*Y^3-36*U*Y ∧ zeroDivided (-3) 0 U Y= -27*Y^3-9*U*Y := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.slope
declarations.snippet: def slope (e x : R) := 2*x+3+e

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.variation
declarations.snippet: def variation (e x : R) := -alpha x 1*beta x 1*gamma x 1-6*e*(beta x 1)^3

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.pole_cube
declarations.snippet: theorem pole_cube {e : R} (he : e^2 = -3) (x : R) : form 1 (-3*e) x 1 = (q e x)^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.variation_identity
declarations.snippet:
theorem variation_identity (e b x : R) : form 1 (-3*e+b) x 1 =
    form 1 (-3*e) x 1 + b*variation e x+b^2*(beta x 1)^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.poleDivided
ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.pole_divided
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_divided {e a : R} (he : e^2= -3) (ha : q e a=0) (c U Y : R) :
    form 1 (-3*e+c^3*U) (a+c*Y) 1 = c^3*poleDivided a e c U Y := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.pole_reduction
declarations.snippet: theorem pole_reduction (a e U Y : R) : poleDivided a e 0 U Y = (slope e a)^3*Y^3 + U*variation e a := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.parameter_identities
declarations.snippet:
theorem parameter_identities (A B : R) :
    m A B*n A B=30*contactProduct A B ∧
    (poleForm A B)^3=27*(m A B)^2+(n A B)^2 ∧
    hForm A B=27*(m A B)^2-(n A B)^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.alpha
declarations.snippet: def alpha (X Z : R) := X*(X+3*Z)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.beta
declarations.snippet: def beta (X Z : R) := Z*(X+2*Z)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.gamma
declarations.snippet: def gamma (X Z : R) := X^2+4*X*Z+6*Z^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.form
declarations.snippet: def form (a b X Z : R) := a^2*(alpha X Z)^3-a*b*alpha X Z*beta X Z*gamma X Z+b^2*(beta X Z)^3

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.integralEquation
declarations.snippet: def integralEquation (δ A B X Z : R) := -6*δ*poleForm A B*form (m A B) (n A B) X Z

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.reciprocal
declarations.snippet: theorem reciprocal (a b X Z : R) : form a b (6*Z) X = 8*form b (27*a) X Z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem expansion {d r h : R} (hd : d^2=6) (ht : 9*(d*r)^2-32 = -32*h^2) (X Z : R) :
    RationalModel.equation d r h X Z = 2^23*h^6*
      (4*(1+h)*(alpha X Z)^3-27*r*alpha X Z*beta X Z*gamma X Z+108*(1-h)*(beta X Z)^3) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.IntegralSextic.cleared
declarations.snippet:
theorem cleared {d r h A B : R} (hd : d^2=6) (ht : 9*(d*r)^2-32 = -32*h^2)
    (hr : (poleForm A B)^3*r=240*contactProduct A B)
    (hh : (poleForm A B)^3*h=hForm A B) (X Z : R) :
    (poleForm A B)^3*RationalModel.equation d r h X Z =
      2^25*54*h^6*form (m A B) (n A B) X Z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.affine
declarations.snippet: theorem affine {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a t x z : R) : form a (a*t) x z = a^2*form 1 t x z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.reciprocal_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem reciprocal_chart {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b t : R} (ht : 27*a=b*t) (x z : R) :
    form a b (6*z) x=8*b^2*form 1 t x z := by rw [reciprocal,ht,affine]; ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.chart
declarations.snippet:
def chart {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (δ G v a t : R) : R[X] :=
  C (-6*δ*G*v*a^2)*monicSextic t

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.leading
declarations.snippet:
theorem leading {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (δ G v a t : R) :
    (chart δ G v a t).leadingCoeff = -6*δ*G*v*a^2 := by

    IsUnit (m A B) ∨ IsUnit (n A B) := by

ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.even_lead

theorem even_lead (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.pole_lead
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_lead (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0<g)

    (hv : IsUnit v) (ha : IsUnit a) (t : W) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.principalOrder
declarations.snippet:
def principalOrder {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsDiscreteValuationRing S]
    (f : S[X]) {mon : S[X]} {c : S} (T : SexticFibre mon c) (s : Cluster) (hs : principal s) : ℤ :=
  nu (addVal S f.leadingCoeff).toNat (fun i j => addVal S (point T i-point T j)) s hs

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.even_principal
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_principal (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (hf : addVal ℤ_[p] (F p u)=((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞)) {v a t : W} (hv : IsUnit v) (ha : IsUnit a)
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic t) ((p:W)^k)) (s : Cluster) (hs : principal s) :
    Even (principalOrder (chart (delta u:W) (fromPadics p (G p u)) v a t) T s hs) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.LeadingOrders.pole_principal
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_principal (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0<g)
    (hG : addVal ℤ_[p] (G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) {v a t : W} (hv : IsUnit v) (ha : IsUnit a)
    (T : SexticFibre (monicSextic t) ((p:W)^g)) (s : Cluster) (hs : principal s) :
    principalOrder (chart (delta u:W) (fromPadics p (G p u)) v a t) T s hs=4*g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.Coordinates
declarations.snippet:
inductive Coordinates (u : ℚ) (t v a : Zp) : Prop where
  | first (hv : v=1) (ha : a=left p u) (ht : a*t=right p u)
  | second (hv : v=8) (ha : a=right p u) (ht : a*t=27*left p u)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.projective_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem projective_chart {u : ℚ} {t v a : Zp} (H : Coordinates p u t v a) (δ : Zp) :
    (∀ x z, integralEquation δ (u.num:Zp) (u.den:Zp) x z = -6*δ*G p u*v*a^2*form 1 t x z) ∨
    (∀ x z, integralEquation δ (u.num:Zp) (u.den:Zp) (6*z) x = -6*δ*G p u*v*a^2*form 1 t x z) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.product_val
declarations.snippet:
private theorem product_val (hp : 7≤p) (u : ℚ) :
    addVal Zp (left p u) + addVal Zp (right p u)=addVal Zp (F p u) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.positive_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_parameter (u : ℚ) (hp : 7≤p) (s : ℕ) (hs : 0<s)
    (hf : addVal Zp (F p u)=(s:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧ addVal Zp t=(s:ℕ∞) := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem even_parameter (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (hf : addVal Zp (F p u)=((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zp, ∃ v a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u t (v:Zp) (a:Zp) ∧ addVal Zp t=((2*k:ℕ):ℕ∞) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.pole_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_parameter (u : ℚ) (hp : 17≤p) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0<g)
    (hG : addVal Zp (G p u)=(g:ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ t : Zpˣ, ∃ a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      (a:Zp)^2*((t:Zp)^2+27)=(G p u)^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrimitiveParameters.ordinary_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_parameter (u : ℚ) (hp : 7≤p) (hF : IsUnit (F p u)) (hG : IsUnit (G p u)) :
    ∃ t a : Zpˣ, Coordinates p u (t:Zp) 1 (a:Zp) ∧
      (ZInQBlueprint.DirectCharts.monicSextic (IsLocalRing.residue Zp (t:Zp))).Separable := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.Cluster
declarations.snippet: abbrev Cluster := Finset Index

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.row
declarations.snippet: def row (i : Fin 2) : Cluster := Finset.univ.filter fun x => x.1=i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.tree
declarations.snippet: def tree : Finset Cluster := {Finset.univ,row 0,row 1} ∪ Finset.univ.image (fun r : Index => {r})

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.children
declarations.snippet:
def children (s : Cluster) : Finset Cluster :=
  tree.filter fun t => t ⊂ s ∧ ∀ u ∈ tree, ¬(t ⊂ u ∧ u ⊂ s)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.principal
ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.row_children
declarations.snippet:
theorem row_children : ∀ i : Fin 2, children (row i) =
    (row i).image (fun r => ({r}:Cluster)) := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.top_children
declarations.snippet: theorem top_children : children Finset.univ = {row 0,row 1} := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.principal_iff
declarations.snippet: theorem principal_iff (s : Cluster) : principal s ↔ ∃ i, s=row i := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.odd_subcluster
declarations.snippet: theorem odd_subcluster : ∀ s ∈ tree, s ≠ Finset.univ → Odd s.card := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.joinRoot
declarations.snippet:
def joinRoot (s : Cluster) (r : Index) : Cluster :=
  (tree.filter fun t => s ⊆ t ∧ r ∈ t).inf id

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.join_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem join_row : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (r : Index),
    joinRoot (row i) r = if r.1=i then row i else Finset.univ := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.depth
declarations.snippet:
def depth (dist : Index → Index → ℕ∞) (s : Cluster) : ℕ∞ :=
  (s ×ˢ s).inf fun ij => dist ij.1 ij.2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.table
declarations.snippet:
def table (m : ℕ) (i j : Index) : ℕ∞ :=
  if i=j then ⊤ else if i.1=j.1 then m else 0

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.row_depth
declarations.snippet: theorem row_depth (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) : depth (table m) (row i)=m := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.top_depth
declarations.snippet: theorem top_depth (m : ℕ) : depth (table m) Finset.univ=0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.nu
declarations.snippet:
def nu (lead : ℤ) (dist : Index → Index → ℕ∞) (s : Cluster) (_hs : principal s) : ℤ :=
  lead + ∑ r : Index, (((depth dist (joinRoot s r)).toNat : ℕ):ℤ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.principal_nu
declarations.snippet:
theorem principal_nu (lead : ℤ) (m : ℕ) {s : Cluster} (hs : principal s) :
    nu lead (table m) s hs=lead+3*m := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.mem_tree
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_tree : ∀ s : Cluster, s∈tree ↔
    s=Finset.univ ∨ (∃ i, s=row i) ∨ ∃ r : Index, s={r} := by decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.coe_row
declarations.snippet: theorem coe_row (i : Fin 2) : (row i : Set Index)={r | r.1=i} := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.geometric
declarations.snippet:
def geometric (T : SexticFibre f c) (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ) (s : Cluster) : Prop :=
  s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ z t, t<⊤ ∧ (s:Set Index)=disc T ι v z t

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.geometric_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem geometric_iff (T : SexticFibre f c) (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ)
    (hu : ∀ u : Rˣ, v (ι (u:R))=0) (hc : 0<v (ι c)) (hmore : ∃ t, v (ι c)<t ∧ t<⊤)
    (s : Cluster) : geometric T ι v s ↔ s∈tree := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PrincipalClusters.fibre_nu
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_nu (hπ : Irreducible π) (m : ℕ) (T : SexticFibre f (π^m)) (lead : ℤ)
    {s : Cluster} (hs : principal s) :
    nu lead (fun i j => addVal S (point T i-point T j)) s hs=lead+3*m := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ResidueExtension.fromPadics

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ResidueExtension.integralLinearEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def integralLinearEquiv : (ℤ_[p] × ℤ_[p]) ≃ₗ[ℤ_[p]] IntegralField p :=
  let t := (integral_coordinates p).choose
  let lin : (ℤ_[p] × ℤ_[p]) →ₗ[ℤ_[p]] IntegralField p := {
    toFun := fun ab => fromPadics p ab.1 + fromPadics p ab.2*t
    map_add' := by
      rintro ⟨a,b⟩ ⟨c,d⟩
      change fromPadics p (a+c)+fromPadics p (b+d)*t = _
      simp only [map_add]; ring
    map_smul' := by
      rintro z ⟨a,b⟩
      change fromPadics p (z*a)+fromPadics p (z*b)*t = fromPadics p z*(fromPadics p a+fromPadics p b*t)
      simp only [map_mul]; ring }
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective lin (integral_coordinates p).choose_spec

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.admissiblePartitionEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def admissiblePartitionEquiv {d : ℕ} (hd : d % 8 = 5) (hs : Squarefree d) :
    {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃ BracketTerm d := by
  let e : {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃
      ↥(admissibleFactorizations d) := {
    toFun := fun P => ⟨factors P.val,
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨factors_mem hs P.val, (residues_factors P.val).mpr P.property⟩⟩
    invFun := fun F => by
      obtain ⟨hF, hR⟩ := mem_filter.mp F.property
      refine ⟨partitionOf hs F.val hF, (residues_factors _).mp ?_⟩
      rwa [factors_partitionOf]
    left_inv := fun P => Subtype.ext (factors_injective (factors_partitionOf hs (factors_mem hs P.val)))
    right_inv := fun F => Subtype.ext (factors_partitionOf hs (mem_filter.mp F.property).1)
  }
  exact e.trans (bracketEquiv d hd).symm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.affinePoint
declarations.snippet:
def affinePoint (f : K[X]) (x y : B) (h : y^2 = aeval x f) : Cover f →ₐ[K] B where
  toFun z := aeval x z.re + aeval x z.im * y
  map_one' := by change aeval x 1 + aeval x 0*y = 1; simp
  map_zero' := by change aeval x 0 + aeval x 0*y = 0; simp
  map_add' a b := by
    change aeval x (a.re+b.re) + aeval x (a.im+b.im)*y = _
    simp only [map_add]; ring
  map_mul' a b := by
    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
    linear_combination -((aeval x a.im)*(aeval x b.im)) * h
  commutes' k := by
    change aeval x (C k) + aeval x 0*y = _
    simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.ordinate_square

theorem ordinate_square {f : K[X]} (g : Cover f →ₐ[K] B) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BinaryCover.affinePoint_image

declarations.snippet:
theorem unramified_lifts_unique (R B V : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing V]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R V] [EssFiniteType R B] [FormallyUnramified R B]
    [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] (f g : B →ₐ[R] V)
    (same : ∀ b, residue V (f b) = residue V (g b)) : f = g := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.integralValueHom
declarations.snippet:
def integralValueHom (v : ValuationSubring Ω) [Algebra R v] [IsScalarTower R v Ω]
    [Module.Finite R B] (y : B →ₐ[R] Ω) : B →ₐ[R] v where
  toFun b := ⟨y b, by
    have hR : IsIntegral R (y b) := (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) b).map y
    have hV : IsIntegral v (y b) := hR.tower_top
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral hV
    exact hz ▸ z.2⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext y.map_one
  map_mul' _ _ := Subtype.ext (y.map_mul _ _)
  map_zero' := Subtype.ext y.map_zero
  map_add' _ _ := Subtype.ext (y.map_add _ _)
  commutes' r := Subtype.ext ((y.commutes r).trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R v Ω r))

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.integralModel_inertia
declarations.snippet:
theorem integralModel_inertia (v : ValuationSubring Ω) [Algebra R v] [IsScalarTower R v Ω]

declarations.snippet:
theorem finiteEtaleModel_splitting (v : ValuationSubring Ω) [Algebra R v] [IsScalarTower R v Ω]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Etale R B] [IsGalois F Ω] :
    IntermediateField.fixedField (pointAction F Ω (F ⊗[R] B)).ker = pointField F Ω (F ⊗[R] B) ∧
    Module.Finite F (pointField F Ω (F ⊗[R] B)) ∧ IsGalois F (pointField F Ω (F ⊗[R] B)) ∧
    pointField F Ω (F ⊗[R] B) ≤ IntermediateField.fixedField (inertia F v) := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem fieldOfMarkings_transfer (v : ValuationSubring Ω) [Algebra R v] [IsScalarTower R v Ω]

    (mark : ∀ x : Points F Ω A, ∃ y : A →ₐ[F] pointField F Ω (F ⊗[R] B),

declarations.snippet:
theorem valuationRing_model {F Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsGalois F Ω]

    pointField F Ω (F ⊗[↥(v.comap (algebraMap F Ω))] B) ≤ IntermediateField.fixedField (inertia F v) := by

theorem points_generate_own_field (F Ω A : Type*) [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]

    {R B F Ω : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Field F] [Field Ω]

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.Points
declarations.snippet: abbrev Points := A →ₐ[F] Ω

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointAction
declarations.snippet:
def pointAction : (Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω) →* Equiv.Perm (Points F Ω A) where
  toFun g := {
    toFun x := g.toAlgHom.comp x
    invFun x := g.symm.toAlgHom.comp x
    left_inv x := by ext a; exact g.symm_apply_apply _
    right_inv x := by ext a; exact g.apply_symm_apply _ }
  map_one' := by ext x a; rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := by ext x a; rfl

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointField
declarations.snippet:
def pointField : IntermediateField F Ω :=
  adjoin F {z : Ω | ∃ (x : Points F Ω A) (a : A), x a = z}

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointField_le_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointField_le_iff (U : IntermediateField F Ω) :
    pointField F Ω A ≤ U ↔ ∀ (x : Points F Ω A) (a : A), x a ∈ U := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointField_le_iff_lifts
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointField_le_iff_lifts (U : IntermediateField F Ω) :
    pointField F Ω A ≤ U ↔ ∀ x : Points F Ω A, ∃ y : A →ₐ[F] U, U.val.comp y = x := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.mem_fixing_adjoin_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_fixing_adjoin_iff (s : Set Ω) (g : Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω) :
    g ∈ (adjoin F s).fixingSubgroup ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, g x = x := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointAction_kernel
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointAction_kernel :
    (pointAction F Ω A).ker = (pointField F Ω A).fixingSubgroup := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.fixedField_pointAction
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixedField_pointAction [IsGalois F Ω] :
    fixedField (pointAction F Ω A).ker = pointField F Ω A := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointField_field
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointField_field (E : Type*) [Field E] [Algebra F E] :
    pointField F Ω E = normalClosure F E Ω := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.rootAction
MarkedModuli.Splitting.rootAction_apply
declarations.snippet:
theorem rootAction_apply (p : F[X]) (g : Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω) (r : p.rootSet Ω) :
    ((rootAction F Ω p g r : p.rootSet Ω) : Ω) = g r := rfl

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.rootAction_kernel
declarations.snippet:
theorem rootAction_kernel (p : F[X]) :
    (rootAction F Ω p).ker = (adjoin F (p.rootSet Ω)).fixingSubgroup := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.fixedField_rootAction
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixedField_rootAction (p : F[X]) [IsGalois F Ω]
    (hs : (p.map (algebraMap F Ω)).Splits) :
    fixedField (rootAction F Ω p).ker = adjoin F (p.rootSet Ω) ∧
      p.IsSplittingField F (fixedField (rootAction F Ω p).ker) := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointsEquivRoots
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def pointsEquivRoots (p : F[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) : Points F Ω (AdjoinRoot p) ≃ p.rootSet Ω where
  toFun x := ⟨x (AdjoinRoot.root p), (mem_rootSet_of_ne hp).mpr (by
    rw [aeval_algHom_apply x, AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self, map_zero])⟩
  invFun r := AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom p (Algebra.ofId F Ω) r (mem_rootSet'.mp r.2).2
  left_inv x := AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext (by simp)
  right_inv r := Subtype.ext (AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root p (Algebra.ofId F Ω) r _)

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.pointsEquivRoots_equivariant
declarations.snippet:
theorem pointsEquivRoots_equivariant (p : F[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (g : Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω)
    (x : Points F Ω (AdjoinRoot p)) : pointsEquivRoots p hp (pointAction F Ω _ g x) =
      rootAction F Ω p g (pointsEquivRoots p hp x) := rfl

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.polynomialFibre_kernel
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomialFibre_kernel (p : F[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (pointAction F Ω (AdjoinRoot p)).ker = (rootAction F Ω p).ker := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.polynomialFibre_field
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomialFibre_field (p : F[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.inertia
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def inertia (v : ValuationSubring Ω) : Subgroup (Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω) :=
  (v.inertiaSubgroup F).map (v.decompositionSubgroup F).subtype

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.inertia_residue
declarations.snippet:
theorem inertia_residue (v : ValuationSubring Ω) (g : v.decompositionSubgroup F)
    (hg : g ∈ v.inertiaSubgroup F) (z : v) :
    residue v (g • z) = residue v z := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.residue_distinguishes_roots
declarations.snippet:
theorem residue_distinguishes_roots (v : ValuationSubring Ω) (q : v[X]) (hm : q.Monic)
    (hs : (q.map (residue v)).Separable) (a : v) (ha : a ∈ q.roots)
    (b : v) (hb : b ∈ q.roots) (h : residue v a = residue v b) : a = b := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.model_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem model_root (v : ValuationSubring Ω) (p : F[X]) (q : v[X]) (hm : q.Monic)
    (model : p.map (algebraMap F Ω) = q.map (algebraMap v Ω)) (r : p.rootSet Ω) :
    ∃ a : v, (a : Ω) = r ∧ a ∈ q.roots := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.inertia_le_rootFixing
declarations.snippet:
theorem inertia_le_rootFixing (v : ValuationSubring Ω) (p : F[X]) (q : v[X]) (hm : q.Monic)
    (model : p.map (algebraMap F Ω) = q.map (algebraMap v Ω))
    (hs : (q.map (residue v)).Separable) :
    inertia F v ≤ (adjoin F (p.rootSet Ω)).fixingSubgroup := by

declarations.name: MarkedModuli.Splitting.absolute_goodReduction
declarations.snippet:
theorem absolute_goodReduction (p : F[X]) [CharZero F] (v : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure F))
    (q : v[X]) (hm : q.Monic)
    (model : p.map (algebraMap F (AlgebraicClosure F)) = q.map (algebraMap v (AlgebraicClosure F)))
    (hs : (q.map (residue v)).Separable) :
    p.IsSplittingField F (fixedField (rootAction F (AlgebraicClosure F) p).ker) ∧
      fixedField (rootAction F (AlgebraicClosure F) p).ker ≤ fixedField (inertia F v) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.AnalyticPeriodData

structure AnalyticPeriodData (u δ : ℚ) where
  null : Tuple
  algebraic : ∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (chart null i)
  evenProduct : pct null ≠ 0
  period : absInvariant null = ((igusaI4 (sextic u δ)^5/(sextic u δ).discr^2 : ℚ) : ℂ)
  stable : ℝ
  comparison : |max 1 (chartHeight null algebraic) - max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)/2| ≤
    ThetaMetric.pazukiConstant * Real.log (min (max 1 (chartHeight null algebraic))
      (max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)) + 2)
  reduction : stable ≤ HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.SiegelPeriod
declarations.snippet:
structure SiegelPeriod where
  z11 : ℂ
  z12 : ℂ
  z22 : ℂ
  im11 : 0 < z11.im
  imdet : 0 < z11.im*z22.im-z12.im^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.halfBit
declarations.snippet: def halfBit (j : Fin 16) (k : ℕ) : ℂ := ((j.val / 2^k % 2 : ℕ):ℂ)/2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.term
declarations.snippet:
def term (Z : SiegelPeriod) (j : Fin 16) (n : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let p := (n.1:ℂ) + halfBit j 2
  let q := (n.2:ℂ) + halfBit j 3
  Complex.exp (2*Real.pi*Complex.I * ((p^2*Z.z11 + 2*p*q*Z.z12 + q^2*Z.z22)/2 +
    p*halfBit j 0 + q*halfBit j 1))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.thetaNull
declarations.snippet: def thetaNull (Z : SiegelPeriod) : Tuple := fun j => ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, term Z j n

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.SiegelPeriodData
declarations.snippet:
structure SiegelPeriodData (u δ : ℚ) where
  matrix : SiegelPeriod
  algebraic : ∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (chart (thetaNull matrix) i)
  evenProduct : pct (thetaNull matrix) ≠ 0
  streng : absInvariant (thetaNull matrix) =
    ((igusaI4 (sextic u δ)^5/(sextic u δ).discr^2 : ℚ) : ℂ)
  stable : ℝ
  comparison : |max 1 (chartHeight (thetaNull matrix) algebraic) -
      max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)/2| ≤ ThetaMetric.pazukiConstant *
      Real.log (min (max 1 (chartHeight (thetaNull matrix) algebraic))
        (max 1 (stable + Real.log Real.pi)) + 2)
  reduction : stable ≤ HeightBudget.vonKaenelBudget u

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.ThetaPeriod.toAnalytic
declarations.snippet:
def toAnalytic {u δ : ℚ} (p : SiegelPeriodData u δ) : AnalyticPeriodData u δ where
  null := thetaNull p.matrix
  algebraic := p.algebraic

declarations.snippet:
def splitQuadratic {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] {a d : K}
    (hd : d^2 = a) (hn : d ≠ 0) : QuadraticAlgebra K a 0 ≃ₐ[K] K × K where
  toFun z := (z.re + z.im*d, z.re - z.im*d)
  invFun z := ⟨(z.1+z.2)/2, (z.1-z.2)/(2*d)⟩
  left_inv z := by ext <;> simp; field_simp; ring
  right_inv z := by ext <;> simp <;> field_simp <;> ring
  map_add' x y := by ext <;> simp <;> ring
  map_mul' x y := by ext <;> simp [← hd] <;> ring
  commutes' x := by ext <;> simp

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.CoarseConic.coarseFibreEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def coarseFibreEquiv {u : ℚ} (hu : u ∉ ZInQ.contactSet) :
    FibreAlgebra u ≃ₐ[ℚ] Gaussian × Gaussian := by
  letI : Fact (¬ IsSquare (9*J u)) := ⟨by
    rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    rw [first_square] at ha
    have hr := (radical_units hu).1
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hr, sq_nonneg a]⟩
  let e := firstEquiv hu
  let z : Gaussian := ⟨0,4*h u⟩
  have hz : z^2 = algebraMap ℚ Gaussian (-27*J u-16) := by
    rw [second_square, sq]
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change 0*0 + (-1:ℚ)*(4*h u)*(4*h u) = -(4*h u)^2
      ring
    · change 0*(4*h u) + 4*h u*0 + 0*(4*h u)*(4*h u) = (0:ℚ)
      ring
  have hn : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz0
    have him := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im hz0
    have hh := (radical_units hu).2
    change 4*h u = 0 at him
    exact hh (by linarith)
  have hs : (e.symm z)^2 = algebraMap ℚ (First u) (-27*J u-16) := by
    rw [← map_pow, hz, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  have hne : e.symm z ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff e.symm e.symm.injective).2 hn
  exact ((splitQuadratic hs hne).restrictScalars ℚ).trans (AlgEquiv.prodCongr e e)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkingTransport.orbit
declarations.snippet:
def orbit (A : C) : Setoid (M.obj A) where
  r x y := ∃ e : A ≅ A, M.map e.hom x = y
  iseqv := {
    refl x := ⟨Iso.refl A, by simp⟩
    symm := by
      rintro x y ⟨e, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.symm, Functor.map_hom_inv'_apply M e x⟩
    trans := by
      rintro x y z ⟨e, rfl⟩ ⟨f, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.trans f, by simp⟩ }

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkingTransport.orbitEquivFibre
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def orbitEquivFibre (A : C) : Quotient (orbit M A) ≃ fibre M A :=
  Equiv.ofBijective
    (Quotient.lift (mark M A) (fun x y => (mark_eq_iff M A x y).2)) (by
      constructor
      · intro x y
        induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
        | _ a =>
          induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
          | _ b => exact fun h => Quotient.sound ((mark_eq_iff M A a b).1 h)
      · intro x
        obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := mark_surjective M A x
        exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ a,rfl⟩)

def onElements : M.Elements ⥤ M.Elements where
  obj X := M.elementsMk (g.obj X.obj) (a.app X.obj X.val)
  map f := Functor.Elements.homMk (g.map f.hom)
    (by rw [← f.map_val]; exact (a.naturality_apply f.hom _).symm)
  map_id X := Functor.Elements.hom_ext (g.map_id _)
  map_comp f h := Functor.Elements.hom_ext (g.map_comp _ _)

  adjoint (X : C) : E.obj X → E.obj X
  action (X : C) : E.obj X →+* Module.End k (T.obj X)
  form (X : C) : T.obj X → T.obj X → k
  adjoint_map {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : E.obj X) :
    adjoint Y (E.map f d) = E.map f (adjoint X d)
  action_map {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : E.obj X) (t : T.obj X) :
    action Y (E.map f d) (T.map f t) = T.map f (action X d t)
  form_map {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : ∃ m : kˣ, ∀ x y : T.obj X,
    form Y (T.map f x) (T.map f y) = (m : k) * form X x y

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PolarizedMarkings.Marking
declarations.snippet:
structure Marking (X : C) where
  embedding : O →+* E.obj X
  faithful : Function.Injective embedding
  rosati (o : O) : P.adjoint X (embedding o) = embedding (R.adjoint o)
  level : V ≃ₗ[k] T.obj X
  linearity (o : O) (x : V) : P.action X (embedding o) (level x) = level (R.action o x)
  weil : ∃ m : kˣ, ∀ x y : V, P.form X (level x) (level y) = (m : k) * R.form x y

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PolarizedMarkings.transport
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def transport {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : Marking R P X) : Marking R P Y where
  embedding := (E.map f).hom.comp m.embedding
  faithful := (by
    intro x y eqn
    apply m.faithful
    have t := congrArg (fun d => E.map (Groupoid.inv f) d) eqn
    change E.map (Groupoid.inv f) (E.map f _) = E.map (Groupoid.inv f) (E.map f _) at t
    simpa only [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← E.map_comp, Groupoid.comp_inv, E.map_id, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using t)
  rosati o := (P.adjoint_map f _).trans (congrArg (E.map f) (m.rosati o))
  level := m.level.trans ((T.mapIso (asIso f)).toLinearEquiv)
  linearity o x := (P.action_map f _ _).trans (congrArg (T.map f) (m.linearity o x))
  weil := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := P.form_map f
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := m.weil
    refine ⟨a*b, fun x y => ?_⟩
    change P.form _ (T.map f (m.level x)) (T.map f (m.level y)) = _ 
    rw [ha,hb, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.PolarizedMarkings.functor
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def functor (R : Reference O V) (P : Realization E T) : C ⥤ Type _ where
  obj := Marking R P
  map f := ↾(fun m => transport (R:=R) (P:=P) f m)
  map_id X := by
    apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
    intro m
    apply Marking.ext
    · ext o
      change E.map (𝟙 X) _ = _
      simp
    · ext x
      change T.map (𝟙 X) _ = _
      simp
  map_comp f g := by
    apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
    intro m
    apply Marking.ext
    · ext o
      change E.map (f ≫ g) _ = E.map g (E.map f _)
      simp
    · ext x
      change T.map (f ≫ g) _ = T.map g (T.map f _)
      simp

structure Triple (s D : K) where
  x : K
  z : K
  y : K
  nonzero : x ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0
  equation : y^2 = D*binary s x z

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticConjugation.scalings
declarations.snippet:
def scalings (s D : K) : Setoid (Triple s D) where
  r a b := ∃ c : Kˣ, b.x = (c:K)*a.x ∧ b.z = (c:K)*a.z ∧ b.y = (c:K)^3*a.y
  iseqv := {
    refl a := ⟨1,by simp⟩
    symm := by
      rintro a b ⟨c,hx,hz,hy⟩
      exact ⟨c⁻¹, by simp [hx,hz,hy]⟩
    trans := by
      rintro a b d ⟨c,hx,hz,hy⟩ ⟨e,kx,kz,ky⟩
      exact ⟨e*c, by simp [kx,kz,ky,hx,hz,hy,mul_pow,mul_assoc]⟩ }

declarations.snippet: abbrev Points (s D : K) := Quotient (scalings s D)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticConjugation.reverseTriple
declarations.snippet:
def reverseTriple {s D v : K} (hv : v^2=9*s^2-32) (hn : v ≠ 0) (a : Triple s D) :
    Triple (-s) D where
  x := (9*s^2-32)*a.z
  z := a.x
  y := v^3*a.y
  nonzero := a.nonzero.elim Or.inr (fun hz => Or.inl (mul_ne_zero (hv ▸ pow_ne_zero 2 hn) hz))
  equation := by rw [mul_pow,a.equation,reversal,← hv]; ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticConjugation.reversePoints
declarations.snippet:
def reversePoints {s D v : K} (hv : v^2=9*s^2-32) (hn : v ≠ 0) :
    Points s D → Points (-s) D :=
  Quotient.map (reverseTriple hv hn) (by
    rintro a b ⟨c,hx,hz,hy⟩
    exact ⟨c,by simp [reverseTriple,hx,hz,hy,mul_left_comm]⟩)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SexticConjugation.conjugateEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def conjugateEquiv {s D v : K} (hv : v^2=9*s^2-32) (hn : v ≠ 0) :
    Points s D ≃ Points (-s) D where
  toFun := reversePoints hv hn
  invFun := Quotient.map (fun a : Triple (-s) D => ({
    x := (9*s^2-32)*a.z, z := a.x, y := v^3*a.y,
    nonzero := a.nonzero.elim Or.inr (fun h => Or.inl (mul_ne_zero (hv ▸ pow_ne_zero 2 hn) h)),
    equation := by
      have h := reversal (-s) a.x a.z
      rw [neg_neg,neg_sq] at h
      rw [mul_pow,a.equation,h,← hv]; ring } : Triple s D)) (by
        rintro a b ⟨c,hx,hz,hy⟩
        exact ⟨c,by simp [hx,hz,hy,mul_left_comm]⟩)
  left_inv := by
    intro a
    induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | _ a =>
      apply Quotient.sound
      -- Relation points from the twice-reversed representative back to a.
      apply (scalings _ _).symm
      refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ (hv ▸ pow_ne_zero 2 hn),rfl,rfl,?_⟩
      change v^3*(v^3*a.y)=(9*s^2-32)^3*a.y
      rw [← hv]; ring
  right_inv := by
    intro a
    induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | _ a =>
      apply Quotient.sound
      apply (scalings _ _).symm
      refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ (hv ▸ pow_ne_zero 2 hn),rfl,rfl,?_⟩
      change v^3*(v^3*a.y)=(9*s^2-32)^3*a.y
      rw [← hv]; ring

    (point : 30*(d:ℚ)*y^2=quintic x) :
    ∃ k r s m n T : ℤ, (k=1 ∨ k=2) ∧ Squarefree r ∧ Squarefree s ∧
      r.natAbs.Coprime s.natAbs ∧ m≠0 ∧ n≠0 ∧ m.natAbs.Coprime n.natAbs ∧
      r.natAbs*s.natAbs ∣ 30*d.natAbs ∧
      r^2*m^4+27*s^2*n^4=T^3 ∧
      (k^2)*T=quadraticNorm x.num x.den ∧
      k^3*(r*m^2)=realCubic x.num x.den ∧ k^3*(s*n^2)=imaginaryCubic x.num x.den := by

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower
declarations.snippet:
structure Tower (p : Nat) where
  level : Nat → Int
  compat : ∀ n, (p:Int)^(n+1) ∣ level (n+1)-level n

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.con
declarations.snippet: def con (p : Nat) (a : Int) : Tower p := ⟨fun _ => a,by intro n; simp⟩

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.plus
declarations.snippet:
def plus {p} (a b : Tower p) : Tower p :=
  ⟨fun n => a.level n+b.level n,by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := a.compat n
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := b.compat n
    exact ⟨x+y,by grobner⟩⟩

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.times
declarations.snippet:
def times {p} (a b : Tower p) : Tower p :=
  ⟨fun n => a.level n*b.level n,by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := a.compat n
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := b.compat n
    exact ⟨x*b.level (n+1)+a.level n*y,by grobner⟩⟩

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.opposite
declarations.snippet:
def opposite {p} (a : Tower p) : Tower p :=
  ⟨fun n => -a.level n,by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨x,h⟩ := a.compat n
    exact ⟨-x,by grobner⟩⟩

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.sq
declarations.snippet: def sq {p} (a : Tower p) := times a a

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.Equal

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.Vanishes

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.res
declarations.snippet: def res {p} [NeZero p] (a : Tower p) : Fin p := (a.level 0 : Fin p)

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Tower.red_rep

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.approximations
declarations.snippet:
private noncomputable def approximations {p} [NeZero p] (prime : Prime p)
    (a b : Tower p) (x0 : Fin p) (root : a.res*x0^2+b.res=0) (simple : 2*a.res*x0 ≠ 0) :
    (n : Nat) → {x : Int // Good a b x0 n x}
  | 0 => ⟨(x0.val:Int),base_root a b x0 root⟩
  | n+1 =>
    let prev := approximations prime a b x0 root simple n
    let step := next_root prime a b x0 simple prev.property
    ⟨Classical.choose step,(Classical.choose_spec step).1⟩

    ∃ x : Tower p, x.res=x0 ∧ ∀ n, (p:Int)^(n+1) ∣ a.level n*(x.level n)^2+b.level n := by

declarations.snippet: def Quad {p} (a b u v : Tower p) := plus (times a (sq u)) (times b (sq v))

def SquareValue {p} [NeZero p] (e : Int) (r : Tower p) : Prop :=

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Soluble

declarations.name: AdicQuartic.Affine

  digits : (n : Nat) → Fin (p^(n+1))
  compat : ∀ n, (p:Int)^(n+1) ∣ ((digits (n+1)).val:Int)-(digits n).val

declarations.name: LocalCoordinates.representative
declarations.snippet: def representative {p} (x : InverseLimit p) : Tower p := ⟨fun n => (x.digits n).val,x.compat⟩

declarations.name: LocalCoordinates.represent_mod
declarations.snippet: private theorem represent_mod (q : Nat) [NeZero q] (a : Int) : (q:Int) ∣ ((a:Fin q).val:Int)-a :=

declarations.name: LocalCoordinates.canonical
declarations.snippet:
def canonical {p} [NeZero p] (x : Tower p) : InverseLimit p where
  digits n := (x.level n : Fin (p^(n+1)))
  compat n := by
    have upper := represent_mod (p^(n+2)) (x.level (n+1))
    have lower := represent_mod (p^(n+1)) (x.level n)
    rw [Int.natCast_pow, Int.pow_succ _ (n+1)] at upper
    rw [Int.natCast_pow] at lower
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := upper
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := lower
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := x.compat n
    exact ⟨(p:Int)*u-v+w,by grobner⟩

declarations.name: LocalCoordinates.lim_ext
declarations.snippet: private theorem lim_ext {p} {x y : InverseLimit p} (eq : ∀ n, x.digits n=y.digits n) : x=y := by

      (u.res≠0 ∨ v.res≠0) := by

declarations.name: LocalCoordinates.inverse_limit_criterion
declarations.snippet:
theorem inverse_limit_criterion {p} [NeZero p] (prime : BinaryQuartic.Prime p) (odd : p%2=1)
    (e : Int) (k a b c d : InverseLimit p)
    (hk : (representative k).res≠0) (ha : (representative a).res≠0)
    (hb : (representative b).res≠0) (hc : (representative c).res≠0)
    (hd : (representative d).res≠0)
    (det : (representative a).res*(representative d).res -
      (representative b).res*(representative c).res≠0) :
    Affine e (representative k) (representative a) (representative b)
      (representative c) (representative d) ↔ (∃ h : Int, e=2*h) ∨
      Root (representative a).res (representative b).res (representative c).res (representative d).res :=

def Weak (B d : Rat) : Prop :=

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.base
declarations.snippet: def base (D c r : R) := c + D*r^2

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.chart
declarations.snippet: def chart (D c b r g : R) := c*(r^2+g^2)+D*r^2*g^2+2*b*r*g-1

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.first
declarations.snippet: def first (D c b r g : R) := base D c r * g+b*r

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.second
declarations.snippet: def second (D c b r g : R) := -(base D c g * r)-b*g

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.chord
declarations.snippet:
def chord (c b r g I K : R) :=
  r*(-(c*b)*g^3+K)-I*(c*g^3-g)+r^3*(-(c*K)+c*b*g)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.square_completions
declarations.snippet:
theorem square_completions (D c b r g : R) (root : b^2=c^2-D) :
    (first D c b r g)^2-c*(1-D*r^4)=base D c r * chart D c b r g ∧
    (second D c b r g)^2-c*(1-D*g^4)=base D c g * chart D c b r g := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.chord_factor
declarations.snippet:
theorem chord_factor (D c b r g : R) :
    chord c b r g (first D c b r g) (second D c b r g)=c*(r^2-g^2)*chart D c b r g := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.reciprocal_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem reciprocal_row (D c b r g : R) (root : b^2=c^2-D) :
    base D c r*second D c b r g-b*first D c b r g+2*c*(c*r+b*g)=
    -(D*r*chart D c b r g) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.scalar_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_row (D c b r g : R) (root : b^2=c^2-D) :
    base D c r*second D c b r g+2*D*r+b*first D c b r g-2*D*b*g*r^2=
    -(D*r*chart D c b r g) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.zero_fibres
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_fibres (D c b r g : R) :
    (chart D c b 0 g=c*g^2-1 ∧ first D c b 0 g=c*g ∧ second D c b 0 g= -(b*g)) ∧
    (chart D c b r 0=c*r^2-1 ∧ first D c b r 0=b*r ∧ second D c b r 0= -(c*r)) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.Cancellable
declarations.snippet: def Cancellable (x : R) := ∀ y z : R, x*y=x*z → y=z

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.chart_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_iff {D c b a r g J k : R} (hc : c=a^2) (root : b^2=c^2-D)
    (ha : Cancellable a) (hd : Cancellable (base D c r)) :
    (J^2+D*r^4=1 ∧ a*J=first D c b r g ∧ base D c r*k=b*J-2*a*(c*r+b*g)) ↔
    (chart D c b r g=0 ∧ a*J=first D c b r g ∧ a*k=second D c b r g) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.Comparison.difference_conic
declarations.snippet:
theorem difference_conic {D c b a r g k : R} (hc : c=a^2) (root : b^2=c^2-D)
    (ha : Cancellable a) (tc : chart D c b r g=0) (output : a*k=second D c b r g) :
    k^2+D*g^4=1 := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.bval
PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.L
PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.coreFormula
declarations.snippet:
def coreFormula (g : Bool) (k : Block) (r : Relation) (z : Assignment) (a b : Q2) : Q2 :=
  let i:=k.number; let c:=sq a
  let V:=field z (16+4*i); let I:=field z (18+4*i)
  let W:=field z (48+4*i); let K:=field z (50+4*i)
  let q:=scale (-1) (times K (field z (68+2*i)))
  match r with
  | .root => minus (plus (sq b) D2) (sq c)
  | .first => minus (minus (minus (times a I) (times b V)) (times c q)) (times D2 (times V W))
  | .second => plus (plus (plus (times a K) (times b q)) (times c V)) (times D2 (times q W))
  | .product => minus (times V q) (times c W)
  | .quartic => minus (plus (plus (plus (sq V) (sq q)) (times D2 (sq W))) (scale 2 (times b W))) one
  | .output => minus (times I (L g k z)) (times V (scale 3 (field z 66)))
  | .iSquare => let t:=field z (122+2*i); minus (plus (times (times D2 c) (t.1,2*t.2)) (sq I)) c
  | .kSquare => let t:=field z k.squareSlot; minus (plus (times (times D2 c) (t.1,2*t.2)) (sq K)) c

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.FP
declarations.snippet: abbrev FP := Polynomial × Polynomial

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.vars
declarations.snippet: def vars (i : Nat) : FP := (vp i,vp (i+1))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.addF
declarations.snippet: def addF (a b : FP) : FP := (ap a.1 b.1,ap a.2 b.2)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.scaleF
declarations.snippet: def scaleF (n : Int) (a : FP) : FP := (sp n a.1,sp n a.2)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.mulF
declarations.snippet: def mulF (a b : FP) : FP := (ap (mp a.1 b.1) (sp 2 (mp a.2 b.2)),ap (mp a.1 b.2) (mp a.2 b.1))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.FVal
declarations.snippet: def FVal (z : Assignment) (a : FP) : Q2 := (value z a.1,value z a.2)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.DA
declarations.snippet: def DA : FP := (cp 11,cp (-6))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.BS
declarations.snippet: def BS : FP := (b0n,b1n)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.CS
declarations.snippet: def CS := mulF (vars 6) (vars 6)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.QS
declarations.snippet: def QS := scaleF (-1) (mulF (vars 54) (vars 70))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.RF
declarations.snippet: def RF := addF (mulF BS BS) (scaleF (164^2) (addF DA (scaleF (-1) (mulF CS CS))))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.SF
declarations.snippet: def SF := addF (mulF BS QS) (scaleF 164 (addF (mulF (vars 6) (vars 54)) (addF (mulF CS (vars 20)) (mulF DA (mulF QS (vars 52))))))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.r_sem
declarations.snippet: theorem r_sem (x : Assignment) : FVal x RF=scale (164^2) (plain false .S .root x) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.s_sem
declarations.snippet: theorem s_sem (x : Assignment) : FVal x SF=scale 164 (plain false .S .second x) := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.insertSlot
declarations.snippet:
private def insertSlot (i : Nat) : List Nat→List Nat
  | []=>[i] | j::js=>if i≤j then i::j::js else j::insertSlot i js

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.sortSlots
declarations.snippet: private def sortSlots : List Nat→List Nat | []=>[] | i::is=>insertSlot i (sortSlots is)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.slot_insert
declarations.snippet: private theorem slot_insert (z : Assignment) (i : Nat) (m : List Nat) : monomialValue z (insertSlot i m)=z i*monomialValue z m := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.slot_sort
declarations.snippet: private theorem slot_sort (z : Assignment) (m : List Nat) : monomialValue z (sortSlots m)=monomialValue z m := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.slot_append
declarations.snippet: private theorem slot_append (z : Assignment) (a b : List Nat) : monomialValue z (a++b)=monomialValue z a*monomialValue z b := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.cp
declarations.snippet: def cp (n : Int) : Polynomial := [⟨n,[]⟩]

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.vp
declarations.snippet: def vp (i : Nat) : Polynomial := [⟨1,[i]⟩]

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.ap
declarations.snippet: def ap (a b : Polynomial) := a++b

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.sp
declarations.snippet: abbrev sp := ProjectionDescent.scale

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.pt
declarations.snippet: private def pt (a b : Term) : Term := ⟨a.coefficient*b.coefficient,a.monomial++b.monomial⟩

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.mp
declarations.snippet: def mp (a b : Polynomial) := a.flatMap (fun t => b.map (pt t))

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.at_c
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem at_c (x : Assignment) (n : Int) : value x (cp n)=(n:Rat) := by simp [cp,value,termValue,monomialValue,Rat.add_zero]

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.at_v
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem at_v (x : Assignment) (i : Nat) : value x (vp i)=x i := by simp [vp,value,termValue,monomialValue,Rat.add_zero]

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.at_a
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem at_a (x : Assignment) (a b : Polynomial) : value x (ap a b)=value x a+value x b := value_append ..

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.at_s
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem at_s (x : Assignment) (n : Int) (a : Polynomial) : value x (sp n a)=(n:Rat)*value x a := scale_value ..

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.at_m
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem at_m (x : Assignment) (a b : Polynomial) : value x (mp a b)=value x a*value x b := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.push
declarations.snippet:
private def push (t : Term) : Polynomial→Polynomial
  | []=>[t] | h::hs=>if t.monomial=h.monomial then ⟨t.coefficient+h.coefficient,h.monomial⟩::hs else h::push t hs

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.reduce
declarations.snippet: private def reduce : Polynomial→Polynomial | []=>[] | t::ts=>push ⟨t.coefficient,sortSlots t.monomial⟩ (reduce ts)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.push_value
declarations.snippet: private theorem push_value (x : Assignment) (t : Term) (p : Polynomial) : value x (push t p)=termValue x t+value x p := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.reduce_value
declarations.snippet: private theorem reduce_value (x : Assignment) (p : Polynomial) : value x (reduce p)=value x p := by

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.cert
declarations.snippet: def cert (a b : Polynomial) := (reduce (ap a (sp (-1) b))).all (fun t=>t.coefficient==0)

declarations.name: PhysicalProjection.FieldRows.Sparse.sound
declarations.snippet: theorem sound {a b : Polynomial} (h : cert a b=true) (x : Assignment) : value x a=value x b := by

declarations.name: Physical130.Column
declarations.snippet: inductive Column | c | u | v deriving DecidableEq

declarations.name: Physical130.extract
declarations.snippet:
def extract (j : Nat) : List Nat → Column × List Nat
  | [] => (.c,[])
  | i::m => if i=j then (.u,m) else if i=j+1 then (.v,m) else
      let a := extract j m
      (a.1,i::a.2)

declarations.name: Physical130.factor
declarations.snippet: def factor (z : ProjectionDescent.Assignment) (j : Nat) : Column → Rat | .c => 1 | .u => z j | .v => z (j+1)

declarations.name: Physical130.extract_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem extract_value (z : ProjectionDescent.Assignment) (j : Nat) (m : List Nat) :
    monomialValue z m=factor z j (extract j m).1*monomialValue z (extract j m).2 := by

declarations.name: Physical130.column
declarations.snippet:
def column (j : Nat) (k : Column) : Polynomial→Polynomial
  | [] => []
  | t::ts => let e:=extract j t.monomial
             if e.1=k then ⟨t.coefficient,e.2⟩::column j k ts else column j k ts

declarations.name: Physical130.split_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_value (z : ProjectionDescent.Assignment) (j : Nat) (p : Polynomial) :
    value z p=value z (column j .c p)+z j*value z (column j .u p)+z (j+1)*value z (column j .v p) := by

declarations.name: Physical130.Aff
declarations.snippet:
structure Aff where
  c : Word
  u : Word

declarations.name: Physical130.Audit.dump
declarations.snippet:
private def dump (g : Bool) : IO Unit := do
  let ns:=Seeds.nodes g
  IO.println s!"SEED {ns.size}"
  for op in ns do IO.println (opText op)
  let p:=program g
  IO.println s!"PROGRAM {p.nodes.length} {p.ordinary} {p.marked}"
  for op in p.nodes do IO.println (opText op)
  for i in parentSlots do IO.println s!"SLOT {i} {compactSlot i} {finiteLift designated (compactSlot i)}"
  for r in parentRows g do
    IO.println s!"SOURCE {r.1}"
    for t in r.2 do IO.println (toString t.coefficient ++ "|" ++ String.intercalate "," (t.monomial.map toString))
  let b:=Book.make ns
  let early:=cells b (ps g) (base b)
  let ds:=makeDet b early
  for k in detectors do
    let c:=clearRow b (select (base b) early) (timeRow k)
    let d:=ds.atBlock k
    IO.println s!"GUARD {k.e} {ref c.num} {c.den} {ref d.a} {ref d.q} {ref d.bigQ} {ref d.guard}"
  let a:=cells b (ps g) (middleBase b ds)
  let env:=select (middleBase b ds) a
  let cs:=makeCram b ds a
  for pivot in ps g do
    let c:=env pivot.slot
    IO.println s!"PIVOT {pivot.id} {pivot.slot} {ref c.num} {c.den}"
  for k in pairs do
    let f:=line b env k.slot k.f
    let h:=line b env k.slot k.g
    let t:=cs.atPair k
    IO.println s!"PAIR {k.rid} {k.slot} {f.den} {ref f.c} {ref f.u} {ref f.v} {h.den} {ref h.c} {ref h.u} {ref h.v} {ref t.d} {ref t.u} {ref t.v}"
  for r in peakRows g ++ lowRows g do
    let n:=numerator b env cs r
    match occurrence r.1 with
    | none => IO.println s!"ROW {r.1} {ref n} {common env r.2} -"
    | some k => IO.println s!"ROW {r.1} {ref n} {(line b env k.slot r.2).den} {ref (cs.atPair k).d}"
  IO.println s!"MARK {p.eval true (finiteLift designated)}"
  IO.println "END"
