@[noinline] def makeCram (b : Book) (ds : DetTable) (a : Array (Option Cell)) : CramTable :=
  let env := select (middleBase b ds) a
  ⟨cramer b env .one,cramer b env .two,cramer b env .three,cramer b env .four⟩

declarations.name: Physical130.makeCram_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem makeCram_at (b : Book) (ds : DetTable) (a : Array (Option Cell)) (k : PPair) :
    (makeCram b ds a).atPair k=cramer b (select (middleBase b ds) a) k := by cases k <;> rfl

declarations.name: Physical130.occurrence
declarations.snippet:
def occurrence : Nat→Option PPair
  | 140 | 141 => some .one
  | 158 | 159 => some .two
  | 170 | 171 => some .three
  | 182 | 183 => some .four
  | _ => none

declarations.name: Physical130.admissible
declarations.snippet:
def admissible (r : Nat×Polynomial) : Bool := match occurrence r.1 with
  | none => reads (apart padeSlots) r.2
  | some k => blindLine k.slot r.2

declarations.name: Physical130.active_admissible
declarations.snippet: theorem active_admissible (g : Bool) : ∀r∈activeRows g, admissible r=true := by

declarations.name: Physical130.dressed
declarations.snippet:
def dressed (b : Book) (l : Aff) (t : Triple) :=
  plus b (times b t.d l.c) (plus b (times b l.u t.u) (times b l.v t.v))

declarations.name: Physical130.numerator
declarations.snippet:
def numerator (b : Book) (env : Coords) (cs : CramTable) (r : Nat×Polynomial) : Word :=
  match occurrence r.1 with
  | none => (clearRow b env r.2).num
  | some k => dressed b (line b env k.slot r.2) (cs.atPair k)

declarations.name: Physical130.rowFactor
declarations.snippet:
def rowFactor (b : Book) (x : ProjectionDescent.Assignment) (env : Coords) (cs : CramTable) (r : Nat×Polynomial) : Rat :=
  match occurrence r.1 with
  | none => (common env r.2:Rat)
  | some k => (cs.atPair k).d.value b x*(line b env k.slot r.2).den

declarations.name: Physical130.every_residual
declarations.snippet:
theorem every_residual {b env g} (y : Fin 130→Rat) (al : Along b (finiteLift y) env (middle g y))
    (cs : CramTable) (hc : ∀k,CramerCorrect b (finiteLift y) (chartPoint g y) k (cs.atPair k))
    (r : Nat×Polynomial) (hr : r∈activeRows g) :
    rowFactor b (finiteLift y) env cs r≠0 ∧
    (numerator b env cs r).value b (finiteLift y)=rowFactor b (finiteLift y) env cs r*value (chartPoint g y) r.2 := by

declarations.name: Physical130.lowRows
declarations.snippet:
def lowRows (g : Bool) : Rows :=
  ((activeRows g).filter (fun r => !peakIds.contains r.1)).mergeSort (fun a b=>decide (a.1≤b.1))

declarations.name: Physical130.highWords
declarations.snippet:
def highWords (b : Book) (g : Bool) (env : Coords) (cs : CramTable) :=
  (peakRows g).map (numerator b env cs)

declarations.name: Physical130.lowWords
declarations.snippet:
def lowWords (b : Book) (g : Bool) (env : Coords) (ds : DetTable) (cs : CramTable) :=
  (lowRows g).map (numerator b env cs) ++ detectors.map (fun k=>(ds.atBlock k).guard)

declarations.name: Physical130.combineSums
declarations.snippet:
def combineSums (b : Book) (high low : List Word) : Outputs :=
  let h:=squares b (integer b 0) high
  let l:=squares b (integer b 0) low
  let X:=varWord b 1
  ⟨plus b h l,plus b h (times b (times b X X) l)⟩

declarations.name: Physical130.finishTable
declarations.snippet:
@[noinline] def finishTable (b : Book) (g : Bool) (ds : DetTable) (a : Array (Option Cell)) (cs : CramTable) : Outputs :=
  let env:=select (middleBase b ds) a
  combineSums b (highWords b g env cs) (lowWords b g env ds cs)

declarations.name: Physical130.finishMiddle
declarations.snippet:
@[noinline] def finishMiddle (b : Book) (g : Bool) (ds : DetTable) (a : Array (Option Cell)) : Outputs :=
  finishTable b g ds a (makeCram b ds a)

declarations.name: Physical130.finishDetector
declarations.snippet:
@[noinline] def finishDetector (b : Book) (g : Bool) (ds : DetTable) : Outputs :=
  finishMiddle b g ds (cells b (ps g) (middleBase b ds))

declarations.name: Physical130.outputs130
declarations.snippet: def outputs130 (b : Book) (g : Bool) : Outputs := finishDetector b g (detTable b g)

    (hc : ∀k,CramerCorrect b (finiteLift y) (chartPoint g y) k (cs.atPair k)) :

  if i=152 then DBlock.two.q base else
  if i=153 then DBlock.two.bigQ pre base else
  if i=160 then DBlock.three.a base else

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.RationalOrder
declarations.snippet:
structure RationalOrder where
  ord : Rat → Int
  one : ord 1 = 0
  neg : ∀ x : Rat, x ≠ 0 → ord (-x) = ord x
  mul : ∀ a b : Rat, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ord (a*b) = ord a + ord b
  div : ∀ a b : Rat, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ord (a/b) = ord a - ord b
  addUnequal : ∀ a b : Rat, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ord a ≠ ord b →
    a+b ≠ 0 ∧ ord (a+b) = min (ord a) (ord b)

theorem ratio_unit (v : RationalOrder) (R k : Rat) (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (odd : OddOrder (v.ord R)) :
    1-R*k^2 ≠ 0 ∧ 1+R*k^2 ≠ 0 ∧ v.ord ((1-R*k^2)/(1+R*k^2)) = 0 := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.cleared_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem cleared_pole (v : RationalOrder) {R U V T b : Rat} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (hU : U ≠ 0) (hV : V ≠ 0) (unitRatio : v.ord U = v.ord V)
    (cleared : b*T^2*U = R*V) :
    b ≠ 0 ∧ T ≠ 0 ∧ v.ord b = v.ord R - 2*v.ord T := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.corrected_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem corrected_pole (v : RationalOrder) {R k T b : Rat} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (odd : OddOrder (v.ord R)) (cleared : b*T^2*(1+R*k^2) = R*(1-R*k^2)) :
    b ≠ 0 ∧ T ≠ 0 ∧ v.ord b = v.ord R - 2*v.ord T := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.corrected_pole_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem corrected_pole_square (v : RationalOrder) {R k T b : Rat} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (odd : OddOrder (v.ord R)) (cleared : b*T^2*(1+R*k^2)^2 = R*(1-R*k^2)^2) :
    b ≠ 0 ∧ T ≠ 0 ∧ v.ord b = v.ord R - 2*v.ord T := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.positive_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_pole {α wMax tr b : Int} (odd : OddOrder α) (nonpos : wMax ≤ 0)
    (traceBound : -wMax ≤ tr) (pole : b = α - 2*tr) (integral : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 < α ∧ 0 < α+2*wMax := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.sharp_depth
declarations.snippet:
theorem sharp_depth {α wMax tr b m y : Int} (odd : OddOrder α) (nonpos : wMax ≤ 0)
    (traceBound : -wMax ≤ tr) (pole : b = α - 2*tr) (integral : 0 ≤ b)
    (factor : wMax ≤ min 0 ((1-2*m)*α+2*y)) : (4*m-3)*α < 4*y := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.depth
declarations.snippet:
theorem depth {α wMax tr b m y : Int} (odd : OddOrder α) (nonpos : wMax ≤ 0)
    (traceBound : -wMax ≤ tr) (pole : b = α - 2*tr) (integral : 0 ≤ b)
    (order : 1 ≤ m) (factor : wMax ≤ min 0 ((1-2*m)*α+2*y)) : m ≤ y := by

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.DepthAtLeast
declarations.snippet:
def DepthAtLeast (m : Int) : Option Int → Prop
  | none => True
  | some y => m ≤ y

declarations.name: ProgressionWitnesses.SingleContact.one_place
declarations.snippet:
theorem one_place {Place Test : Type} (places : List Place) (w : Place → Int)
    (Y : Place → Test → Option Int) (order : Test → Int) {α wMax tr b : Int}
    (maximum : (places.map w).max? = some wMax)
    (nonpos : ∀ v ∈ places, w v ≤ 0) (odd : OddOrder α)
    (traceBound : -wMax ≤ tr) (pole : b = α - 2*tr) (integral : 0 ≤ b)
    (positiveOrders : ∀ i, 1 ≤ order i)
    (factors : ∀ v ∈ places, ∀ i y, Y v i = some y →
      w v ≤ min 0 ((1-2*order i)*α+2*y)) :
    0 < α ∧ ∃ v ∈ places, w v = wMax ∧ ∀ i, DepthAtLeast (order i) (Y v i) := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.monomial_perm
declarations.snippet:
private theorem monomial_perm (x : Nat → Rat) {a b : List Nat} (h : a.Perm b) :
    monomialValue x a = monomialValue x b := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.value_perm
declarations.snippet:
private theorem value_perm (x : Nat → Rat) {a b : List Term} (h : a.Perm b) :
    value x a = value x b := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.monomial_append
declarations.snippet:
private theorem monomial_append (x : Nat → Rat) (a b : List Nat) :
    monomialValue x (a ++ b) = monomialValue x a * monomialValue x b := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.productTerm
declarations.snippet:
def productTerm (a b : Term) : Term :=
  ⟨a.coefficient * b.coefficient, (a.monomial ++ b.monomial).mergeSort⟩

declarations.name: RowSquares.term_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem term_product (x : Nat → Rat) (a b : Term) :
    termValue x (productTerm a b) = termValue x a * termValue x b := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.store
declarations.snippet:
private def store (t : Term) (rev : List Term) : List Term :=
  if t.coefficient = 0 then rev else t :: rev

declarations.name: RowSquares.store_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem store_value (x : Nat → Rat) (t : Term) (rev : List Term) :
    value x (store t rev) = termValue x t + value x rev := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.collectRuns
declarations.snippet:
private def collectRuns : List Term → Term → List Term → List Term
  | [], pending, rev => (store pending rev).reverse
  | t :: rest, pending, rev =>
      if t.monomial = pending.monomial then
        collectRuns rest ⟨pending.coefficient + t.coefficient, pending.monomial⟩ rev
      else collectRuns rest t (store pending rev)

declarations.name: RowSquares.runs_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem runs_value (x : Nat → Rat) (rest : List Term) (t : Term) (rev : List Term) :
    value x (collectRuns rest t rev) = value x rev + termValue x t + value x rest := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.termOrder
RowSquares.collect
declarations.snippet:
def collect (l : List Term) : List Term :=
  match l.mergeSort termOrder with
  | [] => []
  | t :: rest => collectRuns rest t []

declarations.name: RowSquares.collect_value
declarations.snippet: theorem collect_value (x : Nat → Rat) (l : List Term) : value x (collect l) = value x l := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.product
declarations.snippet:
def product (a b : List Term) : List Term :=
  a.flatMap fun t => b.map (productTerm t)

declarations.name: RowSquares.times_row
declarations.snippet:
private theorem times_row (x : Nat → Rat) (t : Term) (row : List Term) :
    value x (row.map (productTerm t)) = termValue x t * value x row := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.product_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_value (x : Nat → Rat) (a b : List Term) :
    value x (product a b) = value x a * value x b := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.Rows
declarations.snippet: abbrev Rows := List (Nat × List Term)

declarations.name: RowSquares.expansion
declarations.snippet:
def expansion (rows : Rows) : List Term :=
  collect (rows.flatMap fun row => collect (product row.2 row.2))

declarations.name: RowSquares.sumSquares
declarations.snippet:
def sumSquares (x : Nat → Rat) : Rows → Rat
  | [] => 0
  | r :: rows => value x r.2 * value x r.2 + sumSquares x rows

declarations.name: RowSquares.expansion_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem expansion_value (x : Nat → Rat) (rows : Rows) :
    value x (expansion rows) = sumSquares x rows := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.square_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem square_nonneg (a : Rat) : 0 ≤ a * a := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.sum_nonneg
declarations.snippet: private theorem sum_nonneg (x : Nat → Rat) (rows : Rows) : 0 ≤ sumSquares x rows := by

declarations.name: RowSquares.zero_iff_rows
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_iff_rows (x : Nat → Rat) (rows : Rows) :
    value x (expansion rows) = 0 ↔ ∀ r ∈ rows, value x r.2 = 0 := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.join_checks
declarations.snippet:
theorem join_checks (left right : List Nat) (f : Family) (live : Nat → Bool)
    (hl : checkRows left f live=true) (hr : checkRows right f live=true) :
    checkRows (left++right) f live=true := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.Polynomial
declarations.snippet: abbrev Polynomial := List Term

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.Rows
declarations.snippet: abbrev Rows := List (Nat × Polynomial)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.Assignment
declarations.snippet: abbrev Assignment := Nat → Rat

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.Family
declarations.snippet: abbrev Family := Nat → Polynomial

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.RowsProject
declarations.snippet:
def RowsProject (n : Nat) (rows : Rows) (a : Rat) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : Fin n → Rat, finiteLift x 1=a ∧ ∀ r ∈ rows, value (finiteLift x) r.2=0

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.holds
declarations.snippet: def holds (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (x : Assignment) : Prop := ∀ i ∈ I, value x (f i)=0

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.project
declarations.snippet: def project (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (a : Rat) : Prop := ∃ x : Assignment, x 1=a ∧ holds I f x

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.put
declarations.snippet: def put (x : Assignment) (j : Nat) (v : Rat) : Assignment := fun i => if i=j then v else x i

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.scale
declarations.snippet: def scale (c : Int) (p : Polynomial) : Polynomial := p.map fun t => ⟨c*t.coefficient,t.monomial⟩

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.scale_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem scale_value (x : Assignment) (c : Int) (p : Polynomial) :
    value x (scale c p) = (c:Rat)*value x p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.content
declarations.snippet: def content (p : Polynomial) : Nat := p.foldl (fun g t => g.gcd t.coefficient.natAbs) 0

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.primitive
declarations.snippet:
def primitive (p : Polynomial) : Polynomial :=
  let t := RowSquares.collect p
  let g : Int := content t
  let q : Polynomial := t.map fun u => ⟨u.coefficient / g,u.monomial⟩
  if g≠0 ∧ scale g q=t then q else t

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.primitive_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_value (p : Polynomial) :
    ∃ g : Rat, g≠0 ∧ ∀ x, g*value x (primitive p)=value x p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.countSlot
declarations.snippet:
def countSlot (j : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | i::rest => if i=j then countSlot j rest+1 else countSlot j rest

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.width
declarations.snippet:
def width (j : Nat) : Polynomial → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | t::r => max (countSlot j t.monomial) (width j r)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.imageMonomial
declarations.snippet:
def imageMonomial (j : Nat) (num : Polynomial) : List Nat → Polynomial
  | [] => [⟨1,[]⟩]
  | i::rest => RowSquares.product (if i=j then num else [⟨1,[i]⟩]) (imageMonomial j num rest)

ProjectionDescent.substituteAt
ProjectionDescent.substituteAt_value
ProjectionDescent.monomial_unchanged
declarations.snippet:
private theorem monomial_unchanged (x : Assignment) (j : Nat) (v : Rat) (m : List Nat)
    (zero : countSlot j m=0) : monomialValue (put x j v) m=monomialValue x m := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.unchanged
declarations.snippet:
theorem unchanged (x : Assignment) (j : Nat) (v : Rat) (r : Polynomial)
    (zero : width j r=0) : value (put x j v) r = value x r := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.substitute
ProjectionDescent.substitute_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem substitute_value (j : Nat) (c : Int) (hc : c≠0) (num p : Polynomial) :
    ∃ k : Rat, k≠0 ∧ ∀ x : Assignment, value x (substitute j c num p) =
      k*value (put x j (value x num/(c:Rat))) p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.reads
declarations.snippet: def reads (live : Nat → Bool) (p : Polynomial) : Bool := p.all fun t => t.monomial.all live

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.supported
declarations.snippet:
def supported (live : Nat → Bool) (p : Polynomial) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y : Assignment, (∀ i, live i=true → x i=y i) → value x p=value y p

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.reads_supported
declarations.snippet: theorem reads_supported {live p} (ok : reads live p=true) : supported live p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.dropSlot
declarations.snippet: def dropSlot (live : Nat → Bool) (j i : Nat) := live i && decide (i≠j)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.removeId
declarations.snippet: def removeId (p : Nat) (I : List Nat) := I.filter (· != p)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.subst_supported
ProjectionDescent.subst_family
declarations.snippet:
theorem subst_family {I : List Nat} {f : Family} {live : Nat → Bool} {j i : Nat} {c : Int}
    {num : Polynomial} (hc : c≠0) (hn : supported (dropSlot live j) num)
    (old : ∀ k∈I, supported live (f k)) :
    ∀ k∈removeId i I, supported (dropSlot live j) (substitute j c num (f k)) := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.pivot_cell
declarations.snippet:
theorem pivot_cell (pre post : Polynomial) (j : Nat) (c : Int) (x : Assignment) :
    value x (pre ++ [⟨c,[j]⟩] ++ post)=0 ↔ (c:Rat)*x j=value x (scale (-1) (pre++post)) := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.pivot_project
declarations.snippet:
theorem pivot_project (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (rid j : Nat) (c : Int) (num : Polynomial)
    (hc : c≠0) (input : (1:Nat)≠j) (present : rid∈I) (free : width j num=0)
    (pivot : ∀ x : Assignment, value x (f rid)=0 ↔ (c:Rat)*x j=value x num) (a : Rat) :
    project I f a ↔ project (removeId rid I) (fun r => substitute j c num (f r)) a := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.renumber
declarations.snippet:
def renumber (code : Nat → Nat) (r : Polynomial) : Polynomial :=
  r.map fun t => ⟨t.coefficient,t.monomial.map code⟩

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.renumber_value
declarations.snippet:
theorem renumber_value (code : Nat → Nat) (x : Assignment) (p : Polynomial) :
    value x (renumber code p)=value (fun i => x (code i)) p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.table
declarations.snippet: def table (I : List Nat) (f : Family) : Rows := I.map fun i => (i,f i)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.table_holds
declarations.snippet:
theorem table_holds (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (x : Assignment) :
    (∀ r∈table I f, value x r.2=0) ↔ holds I f x := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.compact_project
declarations.snippet:
theorem compact_project (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (live : Nat→Bool) (code back : Nat→Nat)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 1≤n) (hcode : code 1=1) (hback : back 1=1)
    (bounds : ∀ i, live i=true → 1≤code i ∧ code i≤n ∧ back (code i)=i)
    (supp : ∀ r∈I, supported live (f r)) (a : Rat) :
    project I f a ↔ RowsProject n (table I (fun i => renumber code (f i))) a := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.substitute_absent
declarations.snippet:
theorem substitute_absent (j : Nat) (c : Int) (num p : Polynomial) (h : width j p=0) :
    substitute j c num p=p := by simp [substitute,h]

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.checkRows
declarations.snippet: def checkRows (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (live : Nat→Bool) : Bool := I.all fun i => reads live (f i)

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.checked_support
declarations.snippet: theorem checked_support {I f live} (h : checkRows I f live=true) : ∀ i∈I, supported live (f i) := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.overlay
declarations.snippet:

  | hd::rest => put (overlay x rest) hd.1 hd.2

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.off

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.overlay_off
declarations.snippet:

    off (entries.map Prod.fst) x (overlay x entries) := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.apart
declarations.snippet: def apart (priv : List Nat) (i : Nat) : Bool := !priv.contains i

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.agree_off
declarations.snippet:
theorem agree_off {priv x y} (away : off priv x y) (p : Polynomial) (sf : supported (apart priv) p) :
    value y p=value x p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.remove_mem
declarations.snippet: theorem remove_mem {i k : Nat} {I : List Nat} : k∈removeId i I ↔ k∈I ∧ k≠i := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.pole_project
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_project (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (a m z : Nat) (p : Polynomial) (priv : List Nat)
    (pres : a∈I ∧ m∈I ∧ z∈I) (am : a≠m) (az : a≠z) (input : (1:Nat)∉priv)
    (common : ∀ i∈removeId a (removeId z (removeId m I)), supported (apart priv) (f i))
    (toNew : ∀ x : Assignment, value x (f a)=0 → value x (f m)=0 → value x (f z)=0 →
      ∃ y, off priv x y ∧ value y p=0)
    (toOld : ∀ x : Assignment, value x p=0 → ∃ y, off priv x y ∧
      value y (f a)=0 ∧ value y (f m)=0 ∧ value y (f z)=0) (X : Rat) :
    project I f X ↔ project (removeId z (removeId m I)) (fun i => if i=a then p else f i) X := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.identity_numbering
declarations.snippet: theorem identity_numbering (p : Polynomial) : renumber id p=p := by

declarations.name: ProjectionDescent.parent_project
declarations.snippet:
theorem parent_project (I : List Nat) (f : Family) (n : Nat) (hn : 1≤n)
    (supp : ∀ r∈I, supported (fun i => decide (1≤i ∧ i≤n)) (f r)) (a : Rat) :
    project I f a ↔ RowsProject n (table I f) a := by

declarations.name: dump
declarations.snippet:
private def dump (s : String) (rows : Rows) : IO Unit := do
  IO.println s
  for r in rows do
    IO.println s!"ROW {r.1}"
    for t in r.2 do
      IO.println (toString t.coefficient ++ "|" ++ String.intercalate "," (t.monomial.map toString))

declarations.name: Triangular.Pivot
declarations.snippet:
structure Pivot where
  id : Nat
  slot : Nat
  lead : Int
  pre : Polynomial
  post : Polynomial

declarations.name: Triangular.Pivot.row
declarations.snippet: def Pivot.row (p : Pivot) : Polynomial := p.pre ++ [⟨p.lead,[p.slot]⟩] ++ p.post

declarations.name: Triangular.Pivot.num
declarations.snippet: def Pivot.num (p : Pivot) := scale (-1) (p.pre++p.post)

declarations.name: Triangular.Pivot.sol
declarations.snippet: def Pivot.sol (p : Pivot) (x : Assignment) := value x p.num / (p.lead:Rat)

declarations.name: Triangular.Pivot.ok
declarations.snippet: def Pivot.ok (p : Pivot) (x : Assignment) : Prop := (p.lead:Rat)*x p.slot=value x p.num

declarations.name: Triangular.slots
declarations.snippet: def slots (ps : List Pivot) := ps.map Pivot.slot

declarations.name: Triangular.recov
declarations.snippet:
def recov : List Pivot → Assignment → Assignment
  | [], x => x
  | p::ps, x => recov ps (put x p.slot (p.sol x))

declarations.name: Triangular.valid
declarations.snippet:
def valid : List Pivot → Bool
  | [] => true
  | p::ps => decide (p.lead≠0 ∧ p.slot∉slots ps) && reads (apart (p.slot::slots ps)) p.num && valid ps

declarations.name: Triangular.keeps
declarations.snippet: theorem keeps (ps : List Pivot) (x : Assignment) : off (slots ps) x (recov ps x) := by

declarations.name: Triangular.splitValid
declarations.snippet:
private theorem splitValid {p : Pivot} {ps : List Pivot} (hv : valid (p::ps)=true) :
    (p.lead≠0 ∧ p.slot∉slots ps) ∧ reads (apart (p.slot::slots ps)) p.num=true ∧ valid ps=true := by

declarations.name: Triangular.all_solved
declarations.snippet:
theorem all_solved (ps : List Pivot) (hv : valid ps=true) (x : Assignment) :
    ∀ p∈ps, p.ok (recov ps x) := by

declarations.name: Triangular.recov_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem recov_eq (ps : List Pivot) (hv : valid ps=true) (x y : Assignment)
    (eq : off (slots ps) x y) : recov ps x=recov ps y := by

declarations.name: Triangular.fixed
declarations.snippet: theorem fixed (ps : List Pivot) (hv : valid ps=true) (x : Assignment) (ok : ∀ p∈ps,p.ok x) : recov ps x=x := by

declarations.name: Triangular.parent
declarations.snippet:
def parent (ps : List Pivot) (remain : Rows) : Rows :=
  ((ps.map (fun p => (p.id,p.row)))++remain).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.1≤b.1))

declarations.name: Triangular.parent_clause
declarations.snippet:
theorem parent_clause (ps : List Pivot) (rs : Rows) (x : Assignment) :
    (∀ r∈parent ps rs, value x r.2=0) ↔ (∀ p∈ps,p.ok x) ∧ (∀ r∈rs,value x r.2=0) := by

declarations.name: Triangular.inside
declarations.snippet: def inside (i : Nat) := decide (1≤i ∧ i≤226)

declarations.name: Triangular.seed
declarations.snippet: def seed (code : Nat→Nat) (y : Fin 153→Rat) (i : Nat) : Rat := if inside i then finiteLift y (code i) else 0

declarations.name: Triangular.finite_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_at {n} (y : Fin n→Rat) {i} (lo : 1≤i) (hi : i≤n) :
    finiteLift y i=y ⟨i-1,by omega⟩ := by cases i with | zero => omega | succ i => simp [finiteLift,show i<n by omega]

declarations.name: Triangular.finite_out
declarations.snippet: theorem finite_out {n} (y : Fin n→Rat) {i} (bad : ¬(1≤i ∧ i≤n)) : finiteLift y i=0 := by

declarations.name: Triangular.trunc
declarations.snippet: theorem trunc (x : Assignment) (outside : ∀ i,inside i=false→x i=0) : ∃ a : Fin 226→Rat, finiteLift a=x := by

declarations.name: Triangular.ordinary
declarations.snippet:
def ordinary (ps : List Pivot) (rs : Rows) (code : Nat→Nat) (y : Fin 153→Rat) :=
  RowSquares.sumSquares (recov ps (seed code y)) rs

declarations.name: Triangular.ordinary_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_iff (ps : List Pivot) (rs : Rows) (code back : Nat→Nat) (a : Rat)
    (hv : valid ps=true) (input : 1∉slots ps) (c1 : code 1=1) (b1 : back 1=1)
    (inRange : ∀ i∈slots ps, inside i=true)
    (ranks : ∀ i, inside i=true → i∉slots ps → 1≤code i ∧ code i≤153 ∧ back (code i)=i) :
    RowsProject 226 (parent ps rs) a ↔ ∃ y : Fin 153→Rat, finiteLift y 1=a ∧ ordinary ps rs code y=0 := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem sum_nonneg (x : Assignment) (r : Rows) : 0≤RowSquares.sumSquares x r := by

declarations.name: Triangular.nz_iff
Triangular.marked_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem marked_iff (ps : List Pivot) (top : Nat×Polynomial) (rs : Rows) (code : Nat→Nat) (a : Rat)
    (ord : RowsProject 226 (parent ps (top::rs)) a ↔ ∃ y,finiteLift y 1=a ∧ ordinary ps (top::rs) code y=0)
    (zero : ∃ y,finiteLift y 1=0 ∧ ordinary ps [top] code y=0) :
    (∃ y,finiteLift y 1=a ∧ marked ps top rs code y=0) ↔ RowsProject 226 (parent ps (top::rs)) a ∨ a=0 := by

declarations.name: Triangular.intMon
declarations.snippet:
def intMon (v : Nat→Int) : List Nat → Int
  | [] => 1 | i::m => v i*intMon v m

declarations.name: Triangular.intVal
declarations.snippet:
def intVal (v : Nat→Int) : Polynomial → Int
  | [] => 0 | t::ts => t.coefficient*intMon v t.monomial+intVal v ts

declarations.name: Triangular.int_value
declarations.snippet: theorem int_value (v : Nat→Int) (p : Polynomial) : (intVal v p : Rat)=value (fun i => (v i : Rat)) p := by

declarations.name: Triangular.zero_parent
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_parent (ps : List Pivot) (top : Nat×Polynomial) (v : Nat→Int)
    (small : ∀ i,inside i=false → v i=0) (inp : v 1=0)
    (piv : ps.all (fun p => decide (intVal v p.row=0))=true) (endRow : intVal v top.2=0) :
    RowsProject 226 (parent ps [top]) 0 := by

declarations.snippet:
private def dump (g : Bool) : IO Unit := do
  for r in parent (ps g) (top::rest g) do
    IO.println s!"ROW {r.1}"
    for t in r.2 do IO.println (toString t.coefficient ++ "|" ++ String.intercalate "," (t.monomial.map toString))

def binaryOK (op : Nat→Nat→Op) (level address : Nat→Nat) (i j k : Nat) (dst : Op) : Bool :=
  decide (j<i ∧ k<i ∧ level j≤level i ∧ level k≤level i ∧
    address j<address i ∧ address k<address i ∧
    (dst=op (address j) (address k) ∨ dst=op (address k) (address j)))

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.Binding.checked
declarations.snippet:
def checked (src dst : Nat→Op) (level address leaf : Nat→Nat) (limit i : Nat) : Bool :=
  if level i>1 then true else decide (address i<limit) && match src i with
  | .var k => retainedSlot k && decide (slotLevel k≤level i ∧ address i=leaf k)
  | .int c => decide (dst (address i)=.int c)
  | .add j k => binaryOK .add level address i j k (dst (address i))
  | .mul j k => binaryOK .mul level address i j k (dst (address i))

    (right : ∀ i<size,new[i]?=some (dst i))
    (ok : ∀ i<bound,checked src dst level address leaf size i=true)
    (x y : Assignment) {mode : Nat} (small : mode≤1)
    (vars : ∀k,retainedSlot k=true → slotLevel k≤mode → x k=valueAt new y (leaf k))
    (i : Nat) (inside : i<bound) (keep : level i≤mode) :
    valueAt old x i=valueAt new y (address i) := by

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.Comparison.RowGeometry.recover
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def RowGeometry.recover (s : RowGeometry o short m n r L A fn fr an ar) (hp : Prime p) (large : 5≤p) (root : r^2=2)
    (vfr : w.deep 40 fr) (var' : w.deep 1 ar) (cross : w.deep ((precision short:Int)) (L-A)) :
    PhysicalRow o.incl p short m n := by
  have D:=(curve_coeffs w hp large root).2.2
  have D':=(curve_coeffs w hp large (show (-r)^2=2 by grobner)).2.2
  have depth1:=parameterDepth hp D s.firstChart.reference (s.firstChart.refValue ▸ vfr) (by decide) (e:=20) (by decide)
  have depth2:=parameterDepth hp D' s.secondChart.reference (s.secondChart.refValue ▸ var') (by decide) (e:=1) (by decide)
  let d:=o.lifts (precision short) (L-A) cross
  let g:=Classical.choose d
  have eq : L-A=(p:K)^precision short*o.incl.map g := Classical.choose_spec d
  refine ⟨s.primary,s.alternate,s.u,s.firstPair,s.secondPair,s.firstPoint,s.secondPoint,
    o.splitValue 20 _ depth1,o.splitValue 1 _ depth2,g,?_⟩
  apply o.injective
  have f:=s.firstRatio
  have a:=s.secondRatio
  simp only [o.incl.mul] at f a
  simp only [o.incl.sub,o.incl.mul,o.incl.pow,mappedNat]
  rw [←eq]
  grobner

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.Actual.ScalarGeometry.forces
declarations.snippet:
def ScalarGeometry.forces {x : Fin 84→Rat} {n : Int}
    (s : ScalarGeometry x n) (zero : output false x=0) : ScalarContacts (cell x 1) n := by
  refine ⟨s.primes,?_,?_,s.fiveMark⟩
  · intro p member
    obtain ⟨hp,good,_⟩:=s.contact p member
    rcases hp.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right 6 p) with h|h
    · exact h
    · have dvd : p∣6 := h ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_left 6 p
      exact False.elim (good (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.dvd_trans dvd (by decide : 6∣210))))
  · intro p member
    obtain ⟨hp,good,hit,⟨g⟩⟩:=s.contact p member
    letI:=g.ground
    letI:=g.group
    letI:=g.group'
    obtain ⟨hr,pos,odd⟩:=physical_contact_order hp good _ hit
    have away : p≠17 := by
      intro eq
      subst p
      exact StructuralHeights.no_contact_17 _ hit
    have large : 5≤p := by
      by_cases h : p=2 ∨ p=3
      · rcases h with rfl|rfl <;> exact False.elim (good (by decide))
      · have four : p≠4 := by
          rintro rfl
          have bad:=hp.2 2 (by decide)
          omega
        have min:=hp.1;omega
    exact source_scalar_divisor84 false x (by simp) zero g.C g.N hp large away hr pos odd
      g.left g.right g.leftF g.rightF

noncomputable def FullArithmetic.realize {x : Fin 84→Rat} (g : FullArithmetic x) (zero : output false x=0) :
    ArithmeticData x := by
  have dom:=fromZero_domain x false (by simp) zero
  let B:=SquareGate.label (cell x 1)
  have contacts : ∀ p∈scalarFullPrimes B, StructuralHeights.Prime p ∧ ¬(p:Int)∣210 ∧
      StructuralHeights.Contact p (StructuralHeights.coordinates B) ∧
      Nonempty (CubicAt p x g.scalarMultiplier g.labels.n₂) := by
    intro p member
    obtain ⟨prime,good,_,hit⟩:=(mem_scalarFullPrimes B p).mp member
    exact ⟨prime,good,hit,g.scalarCharts p member⟩
  exact ⟨g.labels,g.first.geometry dom,g.second.geometry dom,g.third.geometry dom,
    ⟨g.scalarMultiplier,scalarFullPrimes B,contacts,g.scalarHeight⟩,
    g.oddFirst,g.lastNonzero,g.anchorNonzero,g.anchor,g.abscissas⟩

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.chord
declarations.snippet:
def chord {D u v a b : K} {d : Int} (hd : 0<d) (hD : w.deep 0 D)
    (hu : OnCurve D u a) (hv : OnCurve D v b) (P : Layer w d u a) (Q : Layer w d v b) :
    ChordResult w D u v a b d := by
  let l:=slope D u v a b
  let k:=a-l*u
  let E:=2*D*l*k/leading D l
  let h:=u+v-E
  have dsum:=w.deep_add P.2 Q.2
  have ds:=deep_mul w (deep_mul w hD Q.1) dsum
  obtain ⟨d1,vd1⟩:=one_plus w (deep_lower w (by omega) ds)
  change slopeDen D v a b≠0 at d1
  change w.val (slopeDen D v a b)=0 at vd1
  have numerator : w.deep (2*d) (slopeNum D u v a) := by
    unfold slopeNum
    have cross:=deep_mul w P.1 Q.1
    have tail:=deep_mul w hD (deep_sq w P.2)
    exact deep_sub w (w.deep_add (w.deep_add (deep_sq w Q.1) (deep_lower w (by omega) cross)) (deep_sq w P.1))
      (deep_lower w (by omega) tail)
  have dl : w.deep (2*d) l := unit_div w numerator d1 vd1
  have dk : w.deep (3*d) k := deep_sub w P.2 (deep_lower w (by omega) (deep_mul w dl P.1))
  have sq:=deep_neg w (deep_mul w hD (deep_sq w dl))
  have ⟨d2,vd2⟩:=one_plus w (deep_lower w (by omega) sq)
  rw [show 1+ -(D*l^2)=leading D l by unfold leading;grobner] at d2 vd2
  have dlk:=deep_mul w (deep_mul w hD dl) dk
  have twice : w.deep (5*d) (2*D*l*k) := by
    rw [show 2*D*l*k=D*l*k+D*l*k by grobner]
    exact deep_lower w (by omega) (w.deep_add dlk dlk)
  have de : w.deep (5*d) E := unit_div w twice d2 vd2
  have dh : w.deep d h := deep_sub w (w.deep_add P.1 Q.1) (deep_lower w (by omega) de)
  have dhs : w.deep (3*d) (l*h-k) := deep_sub w (deep_lower w (by omega) (deep_mul w dl dh)) dk
  have cert : Intersections D l k u v h := chord_factor hu hv d1 rfl rfl d2 rfl
  refine ⟨l,k,h,by dsimp [k];grobner,line_through hu hv d1,cert,third_on_curve cert,⟨dh,dhs⟩,?_⟩
  rw [show h-u-v= -E by dsimp [h];grobner]
  exact deep_neg w de

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.ProjectiveGroup.multiplicationChart
declarations.snippet:
def ProjectiveGroup.multiplicationChart (hD : w.deep 0 D) : MultiplicationChart p w G where
  formal:=M.formal w
  z:=M.t
  origin:=M.origin.2.1
  tangent:=by
    intro n Q _ domain nz hd
    have lay:=layer_of_reduction w (d:=w.val (M.t Q)) (by omega) hD (M.equation Q domain.1)
      (fun _=>Int.le_refl _) domain.2.2
    obtain ⟨op,layer,est⟩:=M.signed w hD (by omega) domain.1 lay n
    let r:=M.t (n • Q)-(n:K)*M.t Q
    let t:=M.t Q
    have t2:=w.product nz nz
    let e:=r/(t*t)
    have clear : e*(t*t)=r := Field.div_mul_cancel t2.1
    refine ⟨formal_of_layer M w op (by omega) layer,e,?_,?_⟩
    · intro en
      obtain ⟨er,ve⟩:=w.product en t2.1
      change e*(t*t)≠0 at er
      change w.val (e*(t*t))=w.val e+w.val (t*t) at ve
      rw [clear] at er ve
      have := est er
      change 5*w.val t≤w.val r at this
      have vt : w.val (t*t)=w.val t+w.val t := t2.2
      change 2≤w.val t at hd
      omega

           _=t*((n:K)+t*e) := by rw [←clear];grobner

    (i≠0 ∨ j≠0) → (k≠0 ∨ l≠0) → (m≠0 ∨ n≠0) →

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.CubicGeometry.model
declarations.snippet:
def CubicGeometry.model : ProjectiveGroup D G where
  t:=C.t
  s:=C.s
  defined:=C.defined
  origin:=represented C (by unfold OnCurve;grobner) C.origin
  equation:=fun _ h=>h.1
  atInfinity:=by
    intro Q h t s
    have e:=h.2
    rw [t,s,C.origin] at e
    exact e.symm
  reflect:=by
    intro Q q
    apply represented C
    · have h:=q.1;unfold OnCurve at h ⊢;grobner
    · rw [reflected C q.1,q.2]
  sum:=by
    intro P Q l k h pd qd pa qb cert
    let a : Triple K:=⟨1,0,l⟩
    let b : Triple K:=⟨0,-1,k⟩
    have independent : ProperLine a b := by
      intro T U eq
      rw [regular_line] at eq
      have t:=congrArg Triple.x eq;have u:=congrArg Triple.y eq
      exact ⟨t,by change -U=0 at u;grobner⟩
    have h1 : (1:K)≠0 := fun e=>Field.zero_ne_one e.symm
    have roots:=C.three a b (C.t P) 1 (C.t Q) 1 (-h) 1 (leading D l) independent cert.1
      (Or.inr h1) (Or.inr h1) (Or.inr h1) (by
        intro T U
        rw [regular_line]
        dsimp [form]
        have e:=cert.2 T U
        grobner)
    have param (u : K) : line a b u 1=normal u (l*u+k) := by rw [regular_line];dsimp [normal];congr 1;grobner
    rw [param,param,param,←pa,←qb,pd.2,qd.2] at roots
    have h3:=third_on_curve cert
    have hneg : OnCurve D (-h) (l*(-h)+k) := by unfold OnCurve at h3 ⊢;grobner
    have re:=reflected C hneg
    rw [show - -h=h by grobner,show -(l*(-h)+k)=l*h-k by grobner] at re
    exact represented C h3 (re.trans (third roots).symm)

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.CubicGeometry.zeroAnchor
declarations.snippet:
def CubicGeometry.zeroAnchor : ZeroAnchor C.model where
  T:=C.point anchor
  twice:=by
    have h:=C.inverse anchor (by dsimp [anchor,form];grobner)
    have flip0 : flip (anchor (K:=K))=anchor := by dsimp [flip,anchor];congr 1;grobner
    rw [flip0] at h
    rw [show (2:Int)=1+1 by decide,IntModule.add_zsmul,IntModule.one_zsmul,←AddCommGroup.sub_self (C.point anchor)]
    rw [AddCommGroup.sub_eq_add_neg,←h]
  line:=by
    intro Q v q cert
    let t:=C.t Q
    let s:=C.s Q
    let a : Triple K:=⟨t,-1,0⟩
    let b : Triple K:=⟨0,0,1⟩
    have independent : ProperLine a b := by
      intro T U eq
      rw [anchor_line] at eq
      have e:=congrArg Triple.y eq
      exact ⟨by change -T=0 at e;grobner,congrArg Triple.z eq⟩
    have live : -(D*t)≠0 := by intro z;apply cert.1;change D*t=0;grobner
    have h1 : (1:K)≠0 := fun e=>Field.zero_ne_one e.symm
    have roots:=C.three a b 1 s 0 1 1 v (-(D*t)) independent live
      (Or.inl h1) (Or.inr h1) (Or.inl h1) (by
        intro T U
        rw [anchor_line]
        dsimp [form]
        have e:=cert.2 T U
        change T^2*U-t^3*T^3+D*t*T*U^2 =D*t*T*(U-s*T)*(U-v*T) at e
        grobner)
    have finite (u : K) : line a b 1 u=normal t u := by rw [anchor_line];dsimp [normal];congr 1;grobner
    have atT : line a b 0 1=anchor := by rw [anchor_line];dsimp [anchor];congr 1 <;> grobner
    rw [finite,atT,finite,q.2] at roots
    have e:=cert.2 1 v
    have vcurve : OnCurve D t v := by
      change (1:K)^2*v-t^3*1^3+D*t*1*v^2=D*t*1*(v-s*1)*(v-v*1) at e
      unfold OnCurve;grobner
    have target : OnCurve D (-t) (-v) := by unfold OnCurve at vcurve ⊢;grobner
    exact represented C target ((reflected C vcurve).trans (third roots).symm)

declarations.snippet: def OnCurve (D t s : K) : Prop := s=t^3-D*t*s^2

declarations.snippet: def slopeDen (D v a b : K) := 1+D*v*(a+b)

declarations.snippet: def slopeNum (D u v a : K) := v^2+u*v+u^2-D*a^2

  leading D l≠0 ∧ ∀ T U : K,

      leading D l*(T-u*U)*(T-v*U)*(T+h*U)

    let t : Rat:=5
    let s : Rat:=t^3*(1-t^4)
    let D : Rat:=1/(1-t^4)^2

    let k:=s-l*t
    let h:=t+t-2*D*l*k/leading D l

      order 5 (slopeDen D t s s)=0 ∧ order 5 (leading D l)=0 ∧ order 5 (h-t-t)=5 := by

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.ProjectiveBranch
declarations.snippet:
structure ProjectiveBranch (w : ExtensionPlace p K) {rho : K} (M : ProjectiveGroup ((3-rho)^2) G)
    (m n : Int) (u v : Rat) where
  root : rho^2=2
  P₀ : G
  torsion : G
  twoTorsion : (2:Int) • torsion=0
  shared : AffineAt M (m • P₀+torsion)
  original : AffineAt M ((n-1) • ((2:Int) • P₀))
  doubled : AffineAt M ((2:Int) • ((n-1) • ((2:Int) • P₀)))
  slope : K
  tangent : 2*original.y*slope=3*original.x^2-(3-rho)^2
  abscissa : doubled.x=slope^2-2*original.x
  ratio : M.t ((n-1) • ((2:Int) • P₀))=
    M.t (m • P₀+torsion)*(w.incl.map u+w.incl.map v*rho)

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.ProjectiveBranch.toScalar
declarations.snippet:
def ProjectiveBranch.toScalar {rho : K} {M : ProjectiveGroup ((3-rho)^2) G}
    {m n : Int} {u v : Rat} (b : ProjectiveBranch w M m n u v)
    (hp : Prime p) (hD : w.deep 0 ((3-rho)^2)) :
    ScalarBranch (M.multiplicationChart w hD) m n u v rho where
  root:=b.root
  P₀:=b.P₀
  torsion:=b.torsion
  twoTorsion:=b.twoTorsion
  shared:=b.shared.toAffineValue
  original:=b.original.toAffineValue
  doubled:=b.doubled.toAffineValue
  slope:=b.slope
  tangent:=b.tangent
  abscissa:=b.abscissa
  ratio:=b.ratio
  sharedDomain:=b.shared.formal_of_reciprocal hp hD
  doubleDomain:=b.doubled.formal_of_reciprocal hp hD

theorem projective_scalar_divisor {H : Type} [IntModule H] {rho : K}
    (M : ProjectiveGroup ((3-rho)^2) G) (N : ProjectiveGroup ((3-(-rho))^2) H)
    {m n : Int} {r u v q U W b : Rat} (hp : Prime p) (large : 5≤p) (away : p≠17)
    (contact : 0<order p r) (odd : OddOrder (order p r)) (hr : r≠0)
    (values : ScalarValues r u v q U W b) (point : ThreeCoordinates.Sextic (17*b) (289-17*b))
    (left : ProjectiveBranch w M m n u v) (right : ProjectiveBranch w N m n u v)
    (norm : w.incl.map q=left.shared.f*right.shared.f) : ((p^17:Nat):Int)∣n-1 := by

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.Actual.decode
declarations.snippet:
def decode (i : Fin 84) : Index :=
  match i.val with
  | 20 => .inr 0 | 21 => .inr 1 | 28 => .inr 2 | 26 => .inr 3
  | 27 => .inr 4 | 83 => .inr 5
  | n => .inl ⟨(if n<20 then n else if n<26 then n-2 else n-5)%78,by omega⟩

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.Actual.encode
declarations.snippet:
def encode : Index→Fin 84
  | .inl j => ⟨if j.val<20 then j.val else if j.val<24 then j.val+2 else j.val+5,by split <;> first | omega | split <;> omega⟩
  | .inr j => match j.val with
    | 0=>20 | 1=>21 | 2=>28 | 3=>26 | 4=>27 | _=>83

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.allowed
declarations.snippet:
def allowed (slots wires : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) : Op → Bool
  | .var k => decide (slots k ≤ wires i)
  | .int _ => true
  | .add a b | .mul a b => decide (a<i ∧ b<i ∧ wires a≤wires i ∧ wires b≤wires i)

  if i=21 ∨ i=22 then 1 else if i=27 ∨ i=28 ∨ i=29 ∨ i=84 then 2 else 0

declarations.name: ProjectionFibres.unchanged

theorem unchanged {ops : List Op} {limit : Nat} (select : Nat → Op) (slots wires : Nat → Nat) (cut : Nat→Bool)
    (entry : ∀ i<limit,ops[i]?=some (select i))
    (verified : ∀ i<limit,cut i=false → allowed slots wires i (select i)=true)
    (level : Nat) {x y : Assignment} (agree : ∀ k,slots k≤level → x k=y k)
    (known : ∀i<limit, cut i=true → valueAt ops x i=valueAt ops y i)
    (i : Nat) (bound : i<limit) (live : wires i≤level) :
    valueAt ops x i=valueAt ops y i := by

structure Place (K : Type) [Field K] where
  v : K → Int

  add : ∀ {x y : K}, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → x+y ≠ 0 → min (v x) (v y) ≤ v (x+y)
  unequal : ∀ {x y : K}, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → v x ≠ v y →

theorem common_place {P I : Type} (ps : List P) (val : P→Place K) (w d : P→Int)
    (Y : I→K) (m : I→Int) {c : K} (hc : c≠0)
    (unit : ∀ v∈ps,(val v).v c=0) (delta : ∀ v∈ps,0≤d v)
    (regular : ∀ i,1+scaled c (Y i)≠0) (pos : ∀ i,1≤m i)
    {a wm tr b : Int} (maximum : (ps.map w).max?=some wm) (nonpos : ∀ v∈ps,w v≤0)
    (odd : OddOrder a) (trace : -wm≤tr) (pole : b=a-2*tr) (integral : 0≤b)
    (factor : ∀ v∈ps, ∀ i z, extended (val v) (bounded c (Y i))=some z →
       w v ≤ min 0 ((1-2*(2*m i-1))*a+2*(z-2*m i*d v))) :
    0<a ∧ ∃ v∈ps, w v=wm ∧ ∀ i,deep (val v) (m i) (Y i) := by

  incl : RingMap Rat K
  val : K → Int

  neg : ∀ a : K, a≠0 → val (-a)=val a
  mul : ∀ a b : K, a≠0 → b≠0 → val (a*b)=val a+val b
  addUnequal : ∀ a b : K, a≠0 → b≠0 → val a≠val b →
    a+b≠0 ∧ val (a+b)=min (val a) (val b)

  val := order p
  agrees := fun _ h=>⟨h,rfl⟩
  neg := (primeOrder p hp).neg

  addUnequal := (primeOrder p hp).addUnequal

declarations.name: StructuralReduction.primeOrder
declarations.snippet:
def primeOrder (p : Nat) (hp : Prime p) : RationalOrder where
  ord := order p
  one := by unfold order intOrder;change (natOrder p 1:Int)-natOrder p 1=0;omega
  neg := by intro x _;simp only [order,intOrder,Rat.neg_num,Rat.neg_den,Int.natAbs_neg]
  mul := fun _ _ => order_mul hp
  div := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have nz : a/b ≠ 0 := fun eq => ha (by rw [←Rat.div_mul_cancel (a:=a) hb,eq,Rat.zero_mul])
    have e:=order_mul hp nz hb
    rw [Rat.div_mul_cancel hb] at e;omega
  addUnequal := by
    intro a b ha hb ne
    by_cases lt : order p a<order p b
    · obtain ⟨z,h⟩:=order_add_lt hp ha hb lt
      exact ⟨z,by rw [h,Int.min_eq_left (by omega)]⟩
    · obtain ⟨z,h⟩:=order_add_lt hp hb ha (by omega)
      rw [Rat.add_comm]

def read (op : Nat→Op) (x : Nat→Rat) (i : Nat) : Rat :=
  match op i with
  | .var k => x k
  | .int c => (c:Rat)
  | .add a b => if _h : a<i ∧ b<i then read op x a + read op x b else 0
  | .mul a b => if _h : a<i ∧ b<i then read op x a * read op x b else 0
termination_by i

    β*u^2-l=w^2 ∧ β*u^2+3*l=β*v^2 ∧

theorem centered_of_cells (X : Finset Ω) (weight : Ω → ℝ) (f : α → Ω → ℝ)
    (V : Finset α) (hv : V.Nonempty) (μ ε η : ℝ) (mu : 0≤μ) (cap : μ≤1) (en : 0≤ε)
    (cells : ∀ I ∈ V.powerset, ∃ (C : Finset ι) (vol fac : ι → ℝ),
      (∑ c ∈ C,vol c)=1 ∧ (∀ c ∈ C,0 ≤ vol c) ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, |fac c-1| ≤ ε) ∧
      |moment X weight f I - ∑ c ∈ C,vol c*μ^I.card*fac c| ≤ η) :
    |moment X weight (fun i x => f i x - μ) V| ≤ (1+μ)^V.card * (η+ε) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ArtinCube.localFactor
declarations.snippet:
def localFactor {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset (Finset ι))
    (q : ℕ) (b : (p : ℕ) → Finset ι → ZMod p) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if h : p.Prime then
    let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨h⟩
    factor S (q:ZMod p) (b p)
  else 1

declarations.name: Sun28.ArtinCube.local_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset (Finset ι))
    (v R q : ℕ) (b : (p : ℕ) → Finset ι → ZMod p) (large : 2≤v)
    (cap : 2*S.card ≤ v) (qn : 0<q) :
    (∑ p ∈ places v R, |localFactor S q b p - 1|) ≤
      (2*(S.card:ℝ)^2*(4*Real.log 4)+2*S.card*Real.log q)/((v:ℝ)*Real.log v) := by

    (cap : 2*S.card ≤ v) (qn : 0<q) :
    |(∏ p ∈ places v R,localFactor S q b p)-1| ≤
      Real.exp ((2*(S.card:ℝ)^2*(4*Real.log 4)+2*S.card*Real.log q)/((v:ℝ)*Real.log v))-1 := by

theorem product_tends_to_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset (Finset ι))

    (qn : ∀ᶠ v : ℕ in atTop,0<q v) (bounded : ∀ᶠ v : ℕ in atTop,Real.log (q v:ℝ) ≤ C*v) :

declarations.name: Sun28.CutoffCount.traceCount
declarations.snippet:
def traceCount (A : Fin 3 → ℚ) (d L N W : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (((Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => d ∣ z.2)).filter
    fun z => ∀ i : ↥(shifts A),
      0≤form A z i ∧ (form A z i).toNat.Prime ∧
        coefficientClass L (form A z i).toNat (traceAt (form A z i).toNat)).card

def TraceInputs : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ), Sun28.ContactSieve.AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ d : ℕ, 0<d → ∃ α : ℝ,0<α ∧ ∀ B : ℕ,∃ L ≥ B, ∀ J : ℕ,∃ j ≥ J,∃ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      let A := Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n
      let N := lengthAt t
      let W := rowWidth j N
      α/(L:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)*W)/(Real.log (N:ℝ))^(shifts A).card ≤ traceCount A d L N W

declarations.name: Sun28.CutoffCount.frequent_of_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem frequent_of_count {A : Fin 3 → ℚ} {d L : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (h : rows A d L δ) :
    frequentRows A d L L (δ/(2:ℝ)^(shifts A).card) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ArtinCube.shift
declarations.snippet:
def shift (q : ZMod p) (b : Finset ι → ZMod p) (v : Finset ι) (h : ι → ZMod p) :=
  q * (∑ i ∈ v, h i) + b v

declarations.name: Sun28.ArtinCube.equal_slices
declarations.snippet:
theorem equal_slices (q : ZMod p) (hq : q ≠ 0) (b : Finset ι → ZMod p)
    {v w : Finset ι} (vw : v ≠ w) :
    p * (univ.filter (fun h : ι → ZMod p => shift q b v h = shift q b w h)).card
      ≤ Fintype.card (ι → ZMod p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.horner_from
Sun28.Branches.lower
declarations.snippet:
def lower {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) (n : ℕ) : List (Poly m) :=
  (List.range n).map p.coeff

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.degreeChart
declarations.snippet:
def degreeChart {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) (n : ℕ) : Chart m where
  eqs := ((List.range (p.natDegree+1)).filter (n < ·)).map p.coeff
  guard := 1
  den := p.coeff n
  nums := lower p n

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.monic_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_eval {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) (x : Fin m → ℚ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (p.map (value x)).natDegree = n) (hn : p.map (value x) ≠ 0) (t : ℚ) :
    value x (p.coeff n) * Projection.monicValue (value x (p.coeff n)) t
      ((lower p n).map (value x)) = (p.map (value x)).eval t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.degreeChart_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem degreeChart_spec {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) (x : Fin m → ℚ) (n : ℕ)
    :
    (degreeChart p n).accepts x ↔
      p.map (value x) ≠ 0 ∧ (p.map (value x)).natDegree = n ∧ ∃ t : ℚ, (p.map (value x)).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.blank
declarations.snippet:
private def blank {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) : List (Poly m) :=
  (List.range (p.natDegree+1)).map p.coeff

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.blank_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem blank_spec {m} (p : Polynomial (Poly m)) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∀ q ∈ blank p, value x q = 0) ↔ p.map (value x) = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.addEqs
declarations.snippet:
private def Chart.addEqs {m} (a : Chart m) (eqs : List (Poly m)) : Chart m :=
  {a with eqs := eqs ++ a.eqs}

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.addEqs_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem addEqs_spec {m} (a : Chart m) (e : List (Poly m)) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (a.addEqs e).accepts x ↔ (∀ p ∈ e, value x p = 0) ∧ a.accepts x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.filteredAtlas
Sun28.Branches.earlier_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem earlier_zero {m} (B : Polynomial (Polynomial (Poly m))) (e : ℕ) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∀ p ∈ (List.range e).flatMap (fun i => blank (B.coeff i)), value x p = 0) ↔
      ∀ i < e, (B.coeff i).map (value x) = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.filteredAtlas_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem filteredAtlas_spec {m} (P G : Polynomial (Poly m)) (hp : P.Monic) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ filteredAtlas P G, a.accepts x) ↔
      ∃ t : ℚ, (P.map (value x)).IsRoot t ∧ ¬(G.map (value x)).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.guarded_polynomial
declarations.snippet:
theorem guarded_polynomial {m} (P G : Polynomial (Poly m)) (hp : P.Monic) :
    ∃ F : Poly (m+1), ∀ x : Fin m → ℚ,
      (∃ w : ℚ, value (Fin.cases w x) F = 0) ↔
        ∃ t : ℚ, (P.map (value x)).IsRoot t ∧ ¬(G.map (value x)).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.embed
declarations.snippet: def embed : R →+* (R[X])[X] := C.comp C

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.expression
declarations.snippet:
def expression (G : R[X]) : ((R[X])[X])[X] :=
  C X + G.map embed * (C (C X) - X)

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.determinant
declarations.snippet:
def determinant (P G : R[X]) : (R[X])[X] :=
  resultant (P.map embed) (expression G) P.natDegree (G.natDegree + 1)

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.expression_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem expression_bound (G : R[X]) :
    (expression G).natDegree ≤ G.natDegree + 1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.expression_eval
declarations.snippet:
private theorem expression_eval {L : Type*} [Field L] (g : L[X]) (r : L) :
    (expression g).eval (embed r) = factor r (g.eval r) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.determinant_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem determinant_product {L : Type*} [Field L] (P G : L[X]) (hp : P.Monic)
    (hs : P.Splits) : determinant P G = product P.roots G.eval := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.mapTU
declarations.snippet:
def mapTU {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) : (R[X])[X] →+* (S[X])[X] :=
  mapRingHom (mapRingHom φ)

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.embed_natural
declarations.snippet:
private theorem embed_natural {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) :
    (mapTU φ).comp embed = embed.comp φ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.expression_map
declarations.snippet:
private theorem expression_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (G : R[X]) :
    (expression G).map (mapTU φ) = expression (G.map φ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.specialize_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem specialize_product {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : R →+* L) (P G : R[X])
    (hp : P.Monic) (hs : (P.map φ).Splits) :
    mapTU φ (determinant P G) = product (P.map φ).roots (G.map φ).eval := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.rational_specialization
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_specialization (φ : R →+* ℚ) (P G : R[X]) (hp : P.Monic) :
    ∃ e ≤ P.natDegree,
      (∀ j < e, ((determinant P G).coeff j).map φ = 0) ∧
      ((determinant P G).coeff e).map φ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ t : ℚ, (((determinant P G).coeff e).map φ).IsRoot t ↔
        (P.map φ).IsRoot t ∧ ¬(G.map φ).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.K
declarations.snippet: abbrev K := QuadraticAlgebra ℚ 2 0

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.pair
declarations.snippet: def pair (a b : ℚ) : K := ⟨a,b⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.square_coordinates
declarations.snippet: theorem square_coordinates (u v : ℚ) : (pair u v)^2 = pair (u^2+2*v^2) (2*u*v) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.quartic
declarations.snippet: def quartic (a b t : ℚ) := t^4-a*t^2+b^2/2

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.Branch
declarations.snippet:
inductive Branch where
  | mixed | realPart | radicalPart | zero
  deriving DecidableEq

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.Branch.condition
declarations.snippet:
def Branch.condition (a b t : ℚ) : Branch → Prop
  | .mixed => b ≠ 0 ∧ quartic a b t = 0
  | .realPart => b = 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧ t^2=a
  | .radicalPart => b = 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧ 2*t^2=a
  | .zero => a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ t=0

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.Branch.point
declarations.snippet:
def Branch.point (b t : ℚ) : Branch → K
  | .mixed => pair t (b/(2*t))
  | .realPart => pair t 0
  | .radicalPart => pair 0 t
  | .zero => 0

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.pair_eq
declarations.snippet: private theorem pair_eq {u v a b : ℚ} : pair u v = pair a b ↔ u=a ∧ v=b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.four_charts
declarations.snippet:
theorem four_charts (a b : ℚ) (y : K) :
    y^2 = pair a b ↔ ∃ (k : Branch) (t : ℚ), k.condition a b t ∧ y = k.point b t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.ordinateReal
declarations.snippet: def ordinateReal (u v : ℚ) := u^3+6*u*v^2-11*u+12*v

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.ordinateRadical
declarations.snippet: def ordinateRadical (u v : ℚ) := 3*u^2*v+2*v^3-11*v+6*u

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.curve_rhs
declarations.snippet:
theorem curve_rhs (u v : ℚ) : (pair u v)^3 - pair 11 (-6) * pair u v =
    pair (ordinateReal u v) (ordinateRadical u v) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinates.ordinate_charts
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinate_charts (u v : ℚ) (y : K) :
    y^2 = (pair u v)^3 - pair 11 (-6) * pair u v ↔ ∃ (k : Branch) (t : ℚ),
      k.condition (ordinateReal u v) (ordinateRadical u v) t ∧
      y=k.point (ordinateRadical u v) t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Poly
declarations.snippet: abbrev Poly (m : ℕ) := MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℤ

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.value
declarations.snippet: def value {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℚ) : Poly m →+* ℚ := eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom ℚ) x

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.liftP
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def liftP {m : ℕ} (p : Poly m) : Poly (m+1) := rename Fin.succ p

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.value_lift
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem value_lift {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (w : ℚ) (p : Poly m) :
    value (Fin.cases w x) (liftP p) = value x p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.value_head
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem value_head {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (w : ℚ) :
    value (Fin.cases w x) (X 0) = w := by simp [value]

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.equations
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def equations {m} : List (Poly m) → Poly m
  | [] => 0
  | p :: tail => p^2 + equations tail

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.equations_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem equations_spec {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (e : List (Poly m)) :
    value x (equations e) = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ e, value x p = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.shifted
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def shifted {m} (D G C : Poly (m+1)) : List (Poly m) → Poly (m+1)
  | [] => 1
  | p :: tail =>
    (1-C*(D^2*G*X 0)) * shifted D G C tail +
       liftP p * D * G * X 0 * (D^2 * G * X 0)^tail.length

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.shifted_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem shifted_zero {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (w : ℚ) (D G C : Poly m) (A : List (Poly m))
    (h : value x D = 0 ∨ value x G = 0 ∨ w = 0) :
    value (Fin.cases w x) (shifted (liftP D) (liftP G) (liftP C) A) = 1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.shifted_eval
declarations.snippet:
theorem shifted_eval {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (w : ℚ) (D G C : Poly m) (A : List (Poly m))
    (hD : value x D ≠ 0) (hG : value x G ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    let v := value x D ^ 2 * value x G * w
    value (Fin.cases w x) (shifted (liftP D) (liftP G) (liftP C) A) =
      v^A.length * Projection.monicValue (value x D) (v⁻¹-value x C) (A.map (value x)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart
declarations.snippet:
structure Chart (m : ℕ) where
  /-- Equations cutting out the stratum. -/
  eqs : List (Poly m)
  /-- Product of the required nonzero factors. -/
  guard : Poly m
  /-- The common denominator of the non-leading coefficients. -/
  den : Poly m
  /-- Numerators, in order of ascending degree. -/
  nums : List (Poly m)

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.accepts
Sun28.Branches.Chart.withShift
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def Chart.withShift {m} (a : Chart m) (c : Poly m) : Poly (m+1) :=
  liftP (equations a.eqs) ^ 2 + (shifted (liftP a.den) (liftP a.guard) (liftP c) a.nums)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.poly
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def Chart.poly {m} (a : Chart m) : Poly (m+1) :=
  a.withShift 0 * a.withShift 1

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.withShift_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem Chart.withShift_spec {m} (a : Chart m) (x : Fin m → ℚ) (c : Poly m) :
    (∃ w, value (Fin.cases w x) (a.withShift c) = 0) ↔
      (∀ p ∈ a.eqs, value x p = 0) ∧ value x a.guard ≠ 0 ∧ value x a.den ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ t, t + value x c ≠ 0 ∧ Projection.monicValue (value x a.den) t (a.nums.map (value x)) = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.poly_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem Chart.poly_spec {m} (a : Chart m) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ w, value (Fin.cases w x) a.poly = 0) ↔ a.accepts x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.atlasPolynomial
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def atlasPolynomial {m} (charts : List (Chart m)) : Poly (m+1) :=
  (charts.map Chart.poly).prod

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.atlas_projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem atlas_projection {m} (charts : List (Chart m)) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ w, value (Fin.cases w x) (atlasPolynomial charts) = 0) ↔
      ∃ a ∈ charts, a.accepts x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.eqs
declarations.snippet:
structure Chart where
  …
  eqs : List (Poly m)

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.guard
declarations.snippet:
structure Chart where
  …
  guard : Poly m

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.den
declarations.snippet:
structure Chart where
  …
  den : Poly m

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.Chart.nums
declarations.snippet:
structure Chart where
  …
  nums : List (Poly m)

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.reorder
declarations.snippet:
private def reorder : Fin 29 → Fin 29 :=
  Fin.cases 1 (Fin.cases 0 (fun i : Fin 27 => i.succ.succ))

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.polynomial28
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def polynomial28 (atlas : List (Chart 28)) : Poly 29 :=
  rename reorder (atlasPolynomial atlas)

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.eval28_polynomial28
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval28_polynomial28 (atlas : List (Chart 28)) (x w : ℚ) (z : Fin 27 → ℚ) :
    Sun28.eval28 (polynomial28 atlas) x (Fin.cases w z) =
      value (Fin.cases w (Fin.cases x z)) (atlasPolynomial atlas) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.polynomial28_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomial28_spec (atlas : List (Chart 28)) (x : ℚ) :
    (∃ y : Fin 28 → ℚ, Sun28.eval28 (polynomial28 atlas) x y = 0) ↔
      ∃ z : Fin 27 → ℚ, ∃ a ∈ atlas, a.accepts (Fin.cases x z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.integerDefinition28_of_charts
declarations.snippet:
theorem integerDefinition28_of_charts (atlas : List (Chart 28))
    {C K S : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (complete : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ z : Fin 27 → ℚ, ∃ a ∈ atlas, a.accepts (Fin.cases (m:ℚ) z))
    (sound : ∀ x : ℚ, (∃ z : Fin 27 → ℚ, ∃ a ∈ atlas, a.accepts (Fin.cases x z)) →
      ∃ (n Δ : ℤ) (B c hβ : ℝ),
        (Sun28.multiplier C K S : ℝ) ≤ c ∧ c-1 ≤ B ∧ |(Δ:ℝ)| ≤ 10*B^4 ∧
        (Δ ≠ 0 → B^2 ≤ C*(1 + |(Δ:ℝ)| ^ (3/8:ℝ))) ∧
        (Δ = 0 → c-4 < Real.log B) ∧
        (2*x^2+3 ≠ (n:ℚ) → Real.log B ≤ K+3*hβ) ∧ hβ ≤ S*Real.sqrt c) :
    Sun28.IntegerDefinition28 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.factor
declarations.snippet: def factor (r a : L) : (L[X])[X] := X + C (C a * (X - C r))

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.product
declarations.snippet:
def product (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) : (L[X])[X] :=
  (s.map fun r => factor r (g r)).prod

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.survivors
declarations.snippet:
def survivors (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) : L[X] :=
  (s.map fun r => if g r = 0 then 1 else C (g r) * (X - C r)).prod

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.rejected
declarations.snippet:
def rejected (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) : ℕ :=
  (s.filter fun r => g r = 0).card

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.survivors_ne
declarations.snippet: theorem survivors_ne (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) : survivors s g ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.survivors_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem survivors_root (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) (t : L) :
    (survivors s g).IsRoot t ↔ t ∈ s ∧ g t ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.factorization
declarations.snippet:
theorem factorization (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) :
    ∃ q : (L[X])[X], product s g = X^(rejected s g) * q ∧ q.coeff 0 = survivors s g := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Mask.first_coefficient
declarations.snippet:
theorem first_coefficient (s : Multiset L) (g : L → L) :
    let e := rejected s g
    e ≤ s.card ∧ (∀ j < e, (product s g).coeff j = 0) ∧
      (product s g).coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ t : L, ((product s g).coeff e).IsRoot t ↔ t ∈ s ∧ g t ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.squares
Sun28.Branches.ev
declarations.snippet:
private def ev {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) : Polynomial (Poly m) →+* ℚ :=
  Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (value x) t

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.squares_nonneg
declarations.snippet:
private theorem squares_nonneg {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) (fs : List (Polynomial (Poly m))) :
    0 ≤ ev x t (squares fs) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.squares_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem squares_spec {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) (fs : List (Polynomial (Poly m))) :
    ev x t (squares fs) = 0 ↔ ∀ f ∈ fs, ev x t f = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.prod_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem prod_spec {m} (x : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) (gs : List (Polynomial (Poly m))) :
    ev x t gs.prod ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ g ∈ gs, ev x t g ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.testsAtlas
Sun28.Branches.attach_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem attach_spec {m} (F : Polynomial (Poly m)) (d : ℕ) (zeros : List (Poly m))
    (g : Poly m) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    ({degreeChart F d with eqs := zeros ++ (degreeChart F d).eqs, guard := g} : Chart m).accepts x ↔
      (∀ p ∈ zeros, value x p = 0) ∧ value x g ≠ 0 ∧ (degreeChart F d).accepts x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.earlier
Sun28.Branches.testsAtlas_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem testsAtlas_spec {m} (P : Polynomial (Poly m)) (hp : P.Monic)
    (eqs guards : List (Polynomial (Poly m))) (x : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ testsAtlas P eqs guards, a.accepts x) ↔
      ∃ t : ℚ, (P.map (value x)).IsRoot t ∧ (∀ f ∈ eqs, (f.map (value x)).IsRoot t) ∧
        (∀ g ∈ guards, ¬(g.map (value x)).IsRoot t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Branches.polynomial_for_tests
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomial_for_tests {m} (P : Polynomial (Poly m)) (hp : P.Monic)
    (eqs guards : List (Polynomial (Poly m))) :
    ∃ F : Poly (m+1), ∀ x : Fin m → ℚ,
      (∃ w : ℚ, value (Fin.cases w x) F = 0) ↔
        ∃ t : ℚ, (P.map (value x)).IsRoot t ∧ (∀ f ∈ eqs, (f.map (value x)).IsRoot t) ∧
          (∀ g ∈ guards, ¬(g.map (value x)).IsRoot t) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.CMReduction.selected_class
declarations.snippet:
theorem selected_class {p : ℕ} {z : Gaussian} (norm : gaussianNorm z=p)
    (r16 : gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0)) (r7 : gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3)) :
    InClass p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CMReduction.adj_norms
declarations.snippet:
private theorem adj_norms (z : Gaussian) (p : ℕ) (norm : gaussianNorm z=p) :
    (adjacentNorm z true:ℤ)=p+1+2*z.1 ∧ (adjacentNorm z false:ℤ)=p+1-2*z.1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CMReduction.unordered_counts
declarations.snippet:
theorem unordered_counts {p : ℕ} [pp : Fact p.Prime] {z : Gaussian}
    (norm : gaussianNorm z=p) (r16 : gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0)) (r7 : gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3))
    {r : ZMod p} (hr : r^2=2) :
    (pointCount p (-(3-r)^2)=adjacentNorm z true ∧ pointCount p (-(3+r)^2)=adjacentNorm z false) ∨
    (pointCount p (-(3-r)^2)=adjacentNorm z false ∧ pointCount p (-(3+r)^2)=adjacentNorm z true) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CMReduction.exists_oriented_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_oriented_root {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {z : Gaussian} (norm : gaussianNorm z=p)
    (r16 : gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0)) (r7 : gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3)) :
    ∃ r : ZMod p, r^2=2 ∧ pointCount p (-(3-r)^2)=adjacentNorm z true ∧
      pointCount p (-(3+r)^2)=adjacentNorm z false := by

Sun28.ComparisonCRT.Congruences
declarations.snippet:
structure Congruences (Lplus Lminus κ anchor : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) (h : ℤ) : Prop where
  plus : h ≡ 0 [ZMOD (Lplus:ℤ)]
  minus : h ≡ (anchor:ℤ) [ZMOD (Lminus:ℤ)]
  preparation : h ≡ 0 [ZMOD (κ:ℤ)]
  localResidue : ∀ p ∈ T, h ≡ (p:ℤ)^(a p) [ZMOD (p:ℤ)^(a p+1)]

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.exponent
declarations.snippet:
private def exponent (plus minus κ : ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) (p : ℕ) :=
  max (a p+1) (max (plus.factorization p) (max (minus.factorization p) (κ.factorization p)))

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.schedule
declarations.snippet:
private def schedule (plus minus κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) (p : ℕ) :=
  exponent plus minus κ (fun q=>if q∈T then a q else 0) p

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.residue
declarations.snippet:
private def residue (minus anchor : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) (p : ℕ) :=
  if p ∈ T then p^(a p) else if p∣minus then anchor else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.comparison_progression
declarations.snippet:
theorem comparison_progression (plus minus κ anchor : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ)
    (hp : 0<plus) (hm : 0<minus) (hk : 0<κ)
    (prime : ∀ p∈T, Nat.Prime p) (two : 2∈T)
    (gcd : plus.gcd minus=4) (v2p : padicValNat 2 plus=2) (v2m : padicValNat 2 minus=6)
    (localAvoid : ∀ p∈T, p≠2 → ¬p∣plus*minus)
    (kAvoid : ∀ p∈κ.primeFactors, p≠2 → ¬p∣minus)
    (depth : ∀ p∈T,padicValNat p κ≤a p) (dyadic : 6≤a 2) (anchor64 : 64∣anchor) :
    ∃ (h₀ : ℤ) (period : ℕ), 0<period ∧ ∀ k : ℤ,
      Congruences plus minus κ anchor T a (h₀+(period:ℤ)*k) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.Congruences.plus
declarations.snippet:
structure Congruences where
  …

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.Congruences.minus
declarations.snippet:
structure Congruences where
  …

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.Congruences.preparation
declarations.snippet:
structure Congruences where

declarations.snippet:
structure Congruences where
  …

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.comparisonPeriod
declarations.snippet:
def comparisonPeriod (plus minus κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.lcm plus (Nat.lcm minus (Nat.lcm κ (T.lcm (fun p=>p^(a p+1)))))

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.period_positive
declarations.snippet:
theorem period_positive {plus minus κ : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (a : ℕ→ℕ)
    (hp : 0<plus) (hm : 0<minus) (hk : 0<κ) (prime : ∀ p∈T, Nat.Prime p) :
    0<comparisonPeriod plus minus κ T a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.modulus_iff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem modulus_iff {h y : ℤ} {m : ℕ} :
    h ≡ y [ZMOD (m:ℤ)] ↔ m∣(y-h).natAbs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.transfer
declarations.snippet:
private theorem transfer {m : ℕ} {h y r : ℤ} (base : y ≡ r [ZMOD (m:ℤ)]) :
    h ≡ r [ZMOD (m:ℤ)] ↔ m∣(y-h).natAbs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.class_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem class_iff {plus minus κ anchor : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} {a : ℕ→ℕ} {y h : ℤ}
    (base : Congruences plus minus κ anchor T a y) :
    Congruences plus minus κ anchor T a h ↔
    h ≡ y [ZMOD (comparisonPeriod plus minus κ T a:ℤ)] := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ComparisonCRT.exact_progression
declarations.snippet:
theorem exact_progression (plus minus κ anchor : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ)
    (hp : 0<plus) (hm : 0<minus) (hk : 0<κ)
    (prime : ∀ p∈T, Nat.Prime p) (two : 2∈T)
    (gcd : plus.gcd minus=4) (v2p : padicValNat 2 plus=2) (v2m : padicValNat 2 minus=6)
    (localAvoid : ∀ p∈T, p≠2 → ¬p∣plus*minus)
    (kAvoid : ∀ p∈κ.primeFactors, p≠2 → ¬p∣minus)
    (depth : ∀ p∈T,padicValNat p κ≤a p) (dyadic : 6≤a 2) (anchor64 : 64∣anchor) :
    0<comparisonPeriod plus minus κ T a ∧ ∃ offset : ℤ, ∀ h : ℤ,
    Congruences plus minus κ anchor T a h ↔ ∃ k : ℤ,h=offset+(comparisonPeriod plus minus κ T a:ℤ)*k := by

Sun28.ComparisonCRT.prime_progression
declarations.snippet:
theorem prime_progression (S : Finset ℕ) (exponent residue : ℕ→ℕ)
    (primes : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) :
    ∃ offset : ℤ, let period := ∏ p ∈ S, p^(exponent p)
      0<period ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ p ∈ S,
        offset+(period:ℤ)*k ≡ (residue p:ℤ) [ZMOD (p:ℤ)^(exponent p)] := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.Branch
declarations.snippet:
structure Branch (m : ℕ) where
  length : ℕ
  tower : ParamTower (Poly m) length
  equations : List (Test m length)
  guards : List (Test m length)

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.branchAtlas
declarations.snippet:
def branchAtlas {m : ℕ} (branches : List (Branch m)) : List (Chart m) :=
  branches.flatMap fun a => atlas a.tower a.equations a.guards

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.branchAtlas_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem branchAtlas_spec {m : ℕ} (branches : List (Branch m)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ branchAtlas branches, a.accepts p) ↔
    ∃ B ∈ branches, Solutions B.tower B.equations B.guards p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.branchAtlas_explicit
declarations.snippet:
private theorem branchAtlas_explicit {m : ℕ} (bs : List (Branch m)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ branchAtlas bs, a.accepts p) ↔
    ∃ B ∈ bs, ∃ y : Fin B.length → ℚ,
        Satisfies (value p) B.tower y ∧
        (∀ f ∈ B.equations, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y f = 0) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ B.guards, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y g ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.branchRelation
declarations.snippet:
def branchRelation (branches : List (Branch 28)) (x : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ z : Fin 27 → ℚ, ∃ B ∈ branches, Solutions B.tower B.equations B.guards (Fin.cases x z)

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.eval28_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval28_iff (branches : List (Branch 28)) (x : ℚ) :
    (∃ w : Fin 28 → ℚ, Sun28.eval28 (polynomial28 (branchAtlas branches)) x w = 0) ↔
    ∃ z : Fin 27 → ℚ, ∃ B ∈ branches, ∃ y : Fin B.length → ℚ,
        Satisfies (value (Fin.cases x z)) B.tower y ∧
        (∀ f ∈ B.equations, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value (Fin.cases x z)) y f = 0) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ B.guards, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value (Fin.cases x z)) y g ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.integerDefinition28_of_branches
declarations.snippet:
theorem integerDefinition28_of_branches (branches : List (Branch 28))
    {C K S : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (complete : ∀ m : ℤ, branchRelation branches (m:ℚ))
    (sound : ∀ x : ℚ, branchRelation branches x →
      ∃ (n Δ : ℤ) (B c hβ : ℝ),
        (Sun28.multiplier C K S : ℝ) ≤ c ∧ c-1 ≤ B ∧ |(Δ:ℝ)| ≤ 10*B^4 ∧
        (Δ ≠ 0 → B^2 ≤ C*(1 + |(Δ:ℝ)| ^ (3/8:ℝ))) ∧
        (Δ = 0 → c-4 < Real.log B) ∧
        (2*x^2+3 ≠ (n:ℚ) → Real.log B ≤ K+3*hβ) ∧ hβ ≤ S*Real.sqrt c) :
    Sun28.IntegerDefinition28 := by

Sun28.Compiler.row
declarations.snippet:
def row (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) (b d ℓ : ℕ) :
    List (Chart m) :=
  testsAtlas (imagePolynomial T (linearForm (Poly m) n b))
    (lowerTests T d ++ equationTests T b E)
    [C ((collision T b).coeff d), sample T b ℓ G.prod]

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.constant_root
declarations.snippet:
private theorem constant_root (a : Poly m) (p : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) :
    ((C a).map (value p)).IsRoot t ↔ value p a=0 := by simp [IsRoot.def]

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.lowerTests_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem lowerTests_spec (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (d : ℕ)
    (p : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) :
    (∀ f ∈ lowerTests T d, (f.map (value p)).IsRoot t) ↔
    ∀ j ≤ bound T, ∀ k<d, value p ((collision T j).coeff k)=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.equationTests_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem equationTests_spec (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (b : ℕ)
    (E : List (Test m n)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) (t : ℚ) :
    (∀ f ∈ equationTests T b E, (f.map (value p)).IsRoot t) ↔
    ∀ f ∈ E, ∀ j ≤ T.degreeProduct, ((sample T b j f).map (value p)).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.row_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem row_spec (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) (b d ℓ : ℕ)
    (p : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ row T E G b d ℓ, a.accepts p) ↔ Selected T (value p) b d ∧
      ∃ t : ℚ, ((imagePolynomial T (linearForm (Poly m) n b)).map (value p)).IsRoot t ∧
        (∀ f ∈ E, ∀ j ≤ T.degreeProduct, ((sample T b j f).map (value p)).IsRoot t) ∧
        ¬ ((sample T b ℓ G.prod).map (value p)).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.product_nonzero
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_nonzero (φ : Poly m →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (G : List (Test m n)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x G.prod ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ g ∈ G, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g ≠ 0 := by

Sun28.Compiler.fixedCollision_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixedCollision_map (P : R[X]) (D : ℕ) (φ : R →+* L)
    (hd : (P.map φ).natDegree = D) :
    (fixedCollision P D).map φ = Collision.shiftedResultant (P.map φ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.bound
declarations.snippet: def bound (T : ParamTower R n) : ℕ := T.degreeProduct.choose 2 * (n-1)

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.collision
declarations.snippet:
def collision (T : ParamTower R n) (b : ℕ) : R[X] :=
  fixedCollision (imagePolynomial T (linearForm R n b)) T.degreeProduct

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.Selected
declarations.snippet:
def Selected (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L) (b d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  φ ((collision T b).coeff d) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ j ≤ bound T, ∀ k < d, φ ((collision T j).coeff k) = 0

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.collision_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem collision_map [IsAlgClosed L] [CharZero L] [DecidableEq L]
    (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L) (b : ℕ) :
    (collision T b).map φ = Collision.shiftedResultant
      (Collision.projected (rootTuples φ T).toFinset (separator (b:L)) (rootTuples φ T).count) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.fibre_card_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_card_bound [IsAlgClosed L] [DecidableEq L] (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L) :
    (rootTuples φ T).toFinset.card.choose 2 * (n-1) ≤ bound T := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.selects_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem selects_iff [IsAlgClosed L] [CharZero L] [DecidableEq L]
    (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L) (b : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (separator (b:L)) ((rootTuples φ T).toFinset : Set (Fin n → L)) ↔
      ∃ d ≤ T.degreeProduct^2, Selected T φ b d := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.Separates
declarations.snippet:
def Separates (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (b : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Set.InjOn (separator (b:Ω)) ((rootTuples ((algebraMap ℚ Ω).comp φ) T).toFinset : Set (Fin n → Ω))

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.rational_selects_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_selects_iff (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (b : ℕ) :
    Separates T φ b ↔ ∃ d ≤ T.degreeProduct^2, Selected T φ b d := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.exists_selection
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_selection (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) :
    ∃ b ≤ bound T, ∃ d ≤ T.degreeProduct^2, Selected T φ b d := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.rational_samples
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_samples (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) {b : ℕ} (hi : Separates T φ b)
    (x : Fin n → ℚ) (hx : Satisfies φ T x) :
    (∀ j ≤ T.degreeProduct, ((sample T b j f).map φ).IsRoot (separator (b:ℚ) x)) ↔
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x f = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.indexed
declarations.snippet:
def indexed {α : Type*} (B : ℕ) (family : ℕ → List α) : List α :=
  (List.range (B+1)).flatMap family

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.indexed_spec
declarations.snippet:
private theorem indexed_spec {α : Type*} (B : ℕ) (family : ℕ → List α) (P : α → Prop) :
    (∃ a ∈ indexed B family, P a) ↔ ∃ j ≤ B, ∃ a ∈ family j, P a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.atlas
declarations.snippet:
def atlas (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) : List (Chart m) :=
  indexed (bound T) fun b =>
    indexed (T.degreeProduct^2) fun d =>
      indexed T.degreeProduct fun ℓ => row T E G b d ℓ

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.Solutions
declarations.snippet:
def Solutions (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ y : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies (value p) T y ∧
    (∀ f ∈ E, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y f = 0) ∧
    ∀ g ∈ G, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y g ≠ 0

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.atlas_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem atlas_spec (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ a ∈ atlas T E G, a.accepts p) ↔ Solutions T E G p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.polynomial
declarations.snippet:
def polynomial (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin (m+1)) ℤ := atlasPolynomial (atlas T E G)

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.polynomial_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomial_spec (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) (p : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ w : ℚ, value (Fin.cases w p) (polynomial T E G) = 0) ↔ Solutions T E G p :=

declarations.name: Sun28.Compiler.polynomial_for_tower
declarations.snippet:
theorem polynomial_for_tower (T : ParamTower (Poly m) n) (E G : List (Test m n)) :
    ∃ F : MvPolynomial (Fin (m+1)) ℤ, ∀ p : Fin m → ℚ,
      (∃ w : ℚ, value (Fin.cases w p) F = 0) ↔
        ∃ y : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies (value p) T y ∧
          (∀ f ∈ E, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y f = 0) ∧
          ∀ g ∈ G, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (value p) y g ≠ 0 :=

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.curveTest
declarations.snippet:
def curveTest (u v : R) (y : K) (φ : R →+* ℚ) : Prop :=
  y^2 = (pair (φ u) (φ v))^3 - pair 11 (-6) * pair (φ u) (φ v)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.curve_step
declarations.snippet:
private theorem curve_step (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (u v : R) (y : K) :
    (r.Holds φ x ∧ curveTest u v y φ) ↔
      ∃ (k : Branch) (w : ℚ),
        (r.signed k (MvPolynomial.C (realNumerator u v))
          (MvPolynomial.C (radicalNumerator u v)) 1).Holds φ (Fin.cons w x) ∧
        reads φ (Fin.cons w x) (signedOutput k (MvPolynomial.C (radicalNumerator u v)) 1) y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.sheet
declarations.snippet:
def sheet : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Branch) → (Fin n → R) → (Fin n → R) → Row R n
  | 0, _,_,_ => Row.base
  | n+1,k,u,v => (sheet (n:=n) (Fin.tail k) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail v)).signed (k 0)
      (MvPolynomial.C (realNumerator (u 0) (v 0))) (MvPolynomial.C (radicalNumerator (u 0) (v 0))) 1

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.Triple
declarations.snippet: abbrev Triple (R : Type*) := R × R × R

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.liftOutput
declarations.snippet:
def liftOutput (q : Triple (Test R n)) : Triple (Test R (n+1)) :=
  (liftTest q.1,liftTest q.2.1,liftTest q.2.2)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.reads_lift
declarations.snippet:
theorem reads_lift (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (w : ℚ) (q : Triple (Test R n)) (y : K) :
    reads φ (Fin.cons w x) (liftOutput q) y ↔ reads φ x q y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.ordinateOutputs
declarations.snippet:
def ordinateOutputs : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Branch) → (Fin n → R) → (Fin n → R) →
    Fin n → Triple (Test R n)
  | 0,_,_,_ => Fin.elim0
  | n+1,k,u,v => Fin.cons
      (signedOutput (k 0) (MvPolynomial.C (radicalNumerator (u 0) (v 0))) 1)
      (fun i => liftOutput (ordinateOutputs (n:=n) (Fin.tail k) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail v) i))

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.sheet_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem sheet_spec (φ : R →+* ℚ) (u v : Fin n → R) (y : Fin n → K) :
    (∀ i, curveTest (u i) (v i) (y i) φ) ↔
      ∃ (k : Fin n → Branch) (x : Fin n → ℚ), (sheet k u v).Holds φ x ∧
        ∀ i, reads φ x (ordinateOutputs k u v i) (y i) := by
