theorem signed_iff (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (w : ℚ)

      r.Holds φ x ∧ guard k (ev φ x A) (ev φ x B) (ev φ x D) w ∧

def reads (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (q : Test R n × Test R n × Test R n) (y : K) : Prop :=

    reads φ (Fin.cons w x) (signedOutput k B D) y ↔ y=reconstruct k (ev φ x B) (ev φ x D) w := by

      ∃ (k : Branch) (w : ℚ), (r.signed k A B D).Holds φ (Fin.cons w x) ∧
        reads φ (Fin.cons w x) (signedOutput k B D) y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.TestBlock.map
declarations.snippet:
def TestBlock.map (f : R →+* S) : TestBlock R → TestBlock S
  | .tests E G => .tests (E.map f) (G.map f)
  | .odd x y => .odd (x.map f) (y.map f)
  | .pole p => .pole ⟨f p.num,f p.den,f p.e,f p.z⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.TestBlock.Valid
declarations.snippet:
def TestBlock.Valid (f : R →+* ℚ) : TestBlock R → Prop
  | .tests E G => (∀ e∈E,f e=0) ∧ ∀ g∈G,f g≠0
  | .odd x y => x.Good f ∧ y.Good f ∧ oddRelation (x.eval f) (y.eval f)
  | .pole p => f p.den≠0 ∧ Sun28.Forward.poleAt Sun28.ScalarHeight.smallMultipliers (f p.num/f p.den) (f p.e) (f p.z)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.up3
declarations.snippet: def up3 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) := (liftRoot (R:=R) (n+2)).comp (up2 n)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.Base
declarations.snippet: abbrev Base (m : ℕ) := Sun28.Branches.Poly m

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.jointRows
declarations.snippet:
def jointRows : (k : ℕ) → {n : ℕ} → (Fin k → TestBlock (Test (Base m) n)) →
    Concrete.Row (Base m) n → List (Sun28.Compiler.Branch m)
  | 0,_,_,r => [r.branch]
  | k+1,n,f,r =>
    let rest := Fin.tail f
    match f 0 with
    | .tests E G => jointRows k rest (r.tested E G)
    | .pole p => jointRows k rest (zeroPole r p) ++ poleMultipliers.flatMap fun j =>
        jointRows k (fun i => (rest i).map (up2 n)) (nonzeroPole r p j)
    | .odd x y =>
        let start := r.tested [] [x.den,y.den]
        triples.flatMap fun (b,c,d) =>
          jointRows k (fun i => (rest i).map (up3 n)) (oddRows start x y b c d)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.block_two
declarations.snippet:
private theorem block_two (φ : R →+* ℚ) (t : Fin n → ℚ) (u w : ℚ) (b : TestBlock (Test R n)) :
    (b.map (up2 n)).Valid (ev φ (Fin.cons w (Fin.cons u t))) ↔ b.Valid (ev φ t) := by

    (b.map (up3 n)).Valid (ev φ (Fin.cons z (Fin.cons w (Fin.cons u t)))) ↔ b.Valid (ev φ t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.odds_start
declarations.snippet:
private theorem odds_start (r : Concrete.Row R n) (x y : QuadAt R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (t : Fin n → ℚ) :
    (r.tested [] [x.den,y.den]).Holds φ t ↔ r.Holds φ t ∧ x.Good (ev φ t) ∧ y.Good (ev φ t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.odd_block
declarations.snippet:
private theorem odd_block (r : Concrete.Row R n) (x y : QuadAt R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (t : Fin n → ℚ) :
    (r.Holds φ t ∧ (TestBlock.odd x y).Valid (ev φ t)) ↔
    ∃ (b c d : Branch) (s w z : ℚ), (oddRows (r.tested [] [x.den,y.den]) x y b c d).Holds φ
      (Fin.cons z (Fin.cons w (Fin.cons s t))) := by

    (r.Holds φ t ∧ y^2=a) ↔ ∃ k w, (squareRow r k q).Holds φ (Fin.cons w t) ∧
        Quad.Value (ev φ (Fin.cons w t)) (squareOut k q) y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.oddRows
declarations.snippet:
def oddRows (r : Concrete.Row R n) (x y : QuadAt R n) (b c d : Branch) : Concrete.Row R (n+3) :=
  let r₁ := squareRow r b x
  let h := squareOut b x
  let g := r₁.tested [] [h.normNum]
  let q := middleArg (up x) (up y) h
  let r₂ := squareRow g c q
  let u := squareOut c q
  squareRow r₂ d (lastArg (up (up x)) (up (up y)) (up h) u)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.oddRelation
declarations.snippet:
def oddRelation (x y : K0) : Prop :=
  ∃ h u v : K0, h≠0 ∧ h^2=x ∧ u^2=2*(x+y/h) ∧ v^2=(u*h+x+y/h)/epsilon

declarations.snippet: def doublesCode (v : Fin 9 → PointCode R) := sequence fun i => PointCode.mulProgram 2 (v i)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.doubles_inputs
declarations.snippet:
theorem doubles_inputs (φ : R →+* ℚ) (v : Fin 9 → PointCode R) (a : Fin 9 → AffineInput)
    (hp : ∀ i, GroupCharts.Represents φ (v i) (a i).point) :
    Inputs φ (fromNine (Program.eval φ (doublesCode v))) (nineAffine a).doubles := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.inputPoly
declarations.snippet: def inputPoly (i : Fin 28) : NineRing := MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.inputExpr
declarations.snippet: def inputExpr (i : Fin 28) : E NineRing := .pure (.ofPair (inputPoly i) 0)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.input_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem input_spec (p : Fin 28 → ℚ) (t : Fin 9 → ℚ) (i : Fin 28) :
    RatValue (ev (Sun28.Branches.value p) t) (inputExpr i) (p i) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.pointBlocks
declarations.snippet:
def pointBlocks (c : ℤ) (v : Codes R) : Program R (Fin 4 → TestBlock R) :=
  Program.bind (fun z => .pure
    ![TestBlock.tests [] [PointCode.equalTest v.q .infinity,PointCode.equalTest v.h .infinity,
        PointCode.equalTest z .infinity],pointOdd v.n,pointOdd v.t,pointOdd v.z])
    (PointCode.translate c v.h PointCode.generator)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.point_blocks_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem point_blocks_spec (φ : R →+* ℚ) {v : Codes R} {w : NinePoints} (hv : Inputs φ v w) (c : ℤ) :
    (∀ i, ((Program.eval φ (pointBlocks c v)) i).Valid φ) ↔
      w.Q≠0 ∧ w.H≠0 ∧ translatedBase w c≠0 ∧ RationalOddChart w.N ∧ RationalOddChart w.T ∧ RationalOddChart w.Z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.Row.tested
declarations.snippet:
def Row.tested (r : Row R n) (E G : List (Test R n)) : Row R n :=
  ⟨r.tower,r.equations++E,r.guards++G⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.tested_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem tested_iff (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (E G : List (Test R n)) :
    (r.tested E G).Holds φ x ↔ r.Holds φ x ∧ (∀ f∈E,ev φ x f=0) ∧ ∀ g∈G,ev φ x g≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.Row.square
declarations.snippet:
def Row.square (r : Row R n) (q : Test R n) : Row R (n+1) :=
  ⟨r.tower.adjoin (X^2-C q) (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ (by decide)),r.equations.map liftTest,r.guards.map liftTest⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.square_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem square_iff (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (q : Test R n) (w : ℚ) :
    (r.square q).Holds φ (Fin.cons w x) ↔ r.Holds φ x ∧ w^2=ev φ x q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.PoleData
declarations.snippet:
structure PoleData (R : Type*) where
  num : R
  den : R
  e : R
  z : R

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.PoleData.a
declarations.snippet: def PoleData.a (p : PoleData R) (m : ℤ) := (m:R)*p.num

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.PoleData.h
declarations.snippet: def PoleData.h (p : PoleData R) (m : ℤ) := p.a m*(p.a m*p.den-p.num^2)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.PoleData.nz
declarations.snippet: def PoleData.nz (p : PoleData R) (m : ℤ) := p.a m*p.e*p.h m*p.z

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.PoleData.first
Sun28.Concrete.PoleData.second
declarations.snippet:
def PoleData.second (p : PoleData R) (m : ℤ) :=
  let a := p.a m
  let h := p.h m
  let t := a*p.z^2*p.den^2
  p.den*a*(t-p.e*h)*(t+3*p.e*h)

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.clear_pole
declarations.snippet:
theorem clear_pole (p : PoleData R) (f : R →+* ℚ) (m : ℤ) (hd : f p.den≠0) :
    poleBranch (m:ℚ) (f p.num/f p.den) (f p.e) (f p.z) ↔
      f (p.nz m) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ w₁ w₂ : ℚ, w₁^2=f (p.first m) ∧ w₂^2=f (p.second m) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.zeroPole
declarations.snippet: def zeroPole (r : Row R n) (p : PoleData (Test R n)) := r.tested [p.num] [p.den]

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.nonzeroPole
declarations.snippet:
def nonzeroPole (r : Row R n) (p : PoleData (Test R n)) (m : ℤ) : Row R (n+2) :=
  (((r.tested [] [p.den,p.nz m]).square (p.first m)).square (liftTest (p.second m)))

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.zero_pole_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_pole_iff (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (p : PoleData (Test R n)) :
    (zeroPole r p).Holds φ x ↔ r.Holds φ x ∧ ev φ x p.den≠0 ∧ ev φ x p.num / ev φ x p.den=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.nonzero_pole_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem nonzero_pole_iff (r : Row R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (p : PoleData (Test R n)) (m : ℤ) :
    (∃ w t : ℚ, (nonzeroPole r p m).Holds φ (Fin.cons t (Fin.cons w x))) ↔
      r.Holds φ x ∧ ev φ x p.den≠0 ∧
        poleBranch (m:ℚ) (ev φ x p.num/ev φ x p.den) (ev φ x p.e) (ev φ x p.z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.poleMultipliers
Sun28.Concrete.multiplier_mem
declarations.snippet:
theorem multiplier_mem (q : ℚ) :
    q ∈ Sun28.ScalarHeight.smallMultipliers ↔ ∃ j∈poleMultipliers, (j:ℚ)=q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Concrete.poleRows
Sun28.Concrete.pole_rows_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_rows_spec {m : ℕ} (r : Row (Sun28.Branches.Poly m) n)
    (p : PoleData (Test (Sun28.Branches.Poly m) n)) (u : Fin m → ℚ) :
    (∃ b∈poleRows r p, Sun28.Compiler.Solutions b.tower b.equations b.guards u) ↔
      ∃ x, r.Holds (Sun28.Branches.value u) x ∧
        let f := ev (Sun28.Branches.value u) x
        f p.den≠0 ∧ poleAt Sun28.ScalarHeight.smallMultipliers (f p.num / f p.den) (f p.e) (f p.z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.sieve_primes
declarations.snippet:
theorem sieve_primes (mertens : PublishedMertensFour) (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {B k : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hb : 64≤B) (error : C≤B) (hc : 0≤C) (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (p : ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ), LocalApproximation B k C g →
      let P:=auxPrimes B (smallLevel t) p
      (∀ q∈P,q.Prime ∧ q≠p ∧ q≤level t ∧ 0≤g q ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q) ∧
      (2*∑ q∈P,g q*Real.log q≤Real.log (level t)) ∧
      c*(growthBound A t:ℝ)^k ≤ ∏ q∈P,(1+odds g q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.logarithmic_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem logarithmic_lower {B k n p : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {g : ℕ→ℝ} (hc : 0≤C)
    (approx : LocalApproximation B k C g) (hb : 64≤B) (error : C≤B) (dim : k≤13) :
    (∑ q∈auxPrimes B n p,dimension k q/q) - C*squareSum ≤
      Real.log (∏ q∈auxPrimes B n p,(1+odds g q)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.product_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_lower {B k : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (mertens : PublishedMertensFour)
    (hb : 64≤B) (error : C≤B) (hc : 0≤C) (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (p : ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ), LocalApproximation B k C g →
      c*(Real.log n)^k ≤ ∏ q∈auxPrimes B n p,(1+odds g q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.dimension
declarations.snippet: def dimension (k q : ℕ) : ℝ := if q%4=1 then (k:ℝ)+2 else (k:ℝ)-2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.LocalApproximation
Sun28.ConeEuler.local_size
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_size {B k q : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {g : ℕ→ℝ} (high : 64≤B)
    (error : C≤B) (dim : k≤13) (approx : LocalApproximation B k C g)
    (prime : q.Prime) (large : B<q) :
    0≤g q ∧ g q≤16/(q:ℝ) ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.sum_dimensions
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_dimensions {B k n p : ℕ} (hb : 2≤B) :
    (∑ q∈auxPrimes B n p,dimension k q/q) =
    ((k:ℝ)+2)*classSum 1 (auxPrimes B n p) + ((k:ℝ)-2)*classSum 3 (auxPrimes B n p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.squareSum
declarations.snippet: def squareSum : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, 1/(n:ℝ)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.error_budget
declarations.snippet:
theorem error_budget (P : Finset ℕ) {C : ℝ} (hc : 0≤C) :
    (∑ q∈P,C/(q:ℝ)^2)≤C*squareSum := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.local_log
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_log {x : ℝ} (hx : x<1) :
    x≤Real.log (1+x/(1-x)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.smallLevel
declarations.snippet: def smallLevel (t : ℕ) : ℕ := 2^(t/128)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.smallLevel_tendsto
declarations.snippet: theorem smallLevel_tendsto : Tendsto smallLevel atTop atTop := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.smallLevel_le
declarations.snippet: theorem smallLevel_le (t : ℕ) : smallLevel t≤level t :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.log_smallLevel
declarations.snippet: theorem log_smallLevel (t : ℕ) : Real.log (smallLevel t)=(t/128:ℕ)*Real.log 2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.scale_comparison
declarations.snippet:
theorem scale_comparison (A : Fin 3→ℚ) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      (Real.log 2/131072)*(growthBound A t:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (smallLevel t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.auxiliary_mean
declarations.snippet:
theorem auxiliary_mean {B k t p : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {g : ℕ→ℝ} (hb : 64≤B)
    (error : C≤B) (hi : k≤13) (approx : LocalApproximation B k C g) :
    2*(∑ q∈auxPrimes B (smallLevel t) p, g q*Real.log q)≤Real.log (level t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.primesUpTo
declarations.snippet: def primesUpTo (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (range (n+1)).filter Nat.Prime

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.auxPrimes
declarations.snippet: def auxPrimes (B n p : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := ((primesUpTo n).filter (B<·)).erase p

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.mem_primesUpTo
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem mem_primesUpTo {q n : ℕ} : q∈primesUpTo n ↔ q.Prime ∧ q≤n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.mem_auxPrimes
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem mem_auxPrimes {q B n p : ℕ} : q∈auxPrimes B n p ↔
    q.Prime ∧ B<q ∧ q≤n ∧ q≠p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.classWeight
declarations.snippet: def classWeight (a q : ℕ) : ℝ := if q%4=a then 1/(q:ℝ) else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.classSum
declarations.snippet: def classSum (a : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ q∈P, classWeight a q

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.PublishedMertensFour
Sun28.ConeEuler.trimmed_class_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem trimmed_class_sum (a B n p : ℕ) :
    classSum a (primesUpTo n) ≤ classSum a (auxPrimes B n p) + B + 2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.mertens_trimmed
declarations.snippet:
theorem mertens_trimmed (mertens : PublishedMertensFour) (B a : ℕ) (ha : a=1 ∨ a=3) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p : ℕ,
      Real.log (Real.log n)/2 - D ≤ classSum a (auxPrimes B n p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.invPrime
declarations.snippet: def invPrime (q : ℕ) : ℝ := 1/(q:ℝ)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.bothWeight
declarations.snippet: def bothWeight (q : ℕ) : ℝ := (1+chi q)/q

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.trim_weight
declarations.snippet:
theorem trim_weight (f : ℕ→ℝ) {K : ℝ} (non : 0≤K)
    (bound : ∀ q : ℕ,q.Prime → f q≤K) (B n p : ℕ) :
    (∑ q∈primesUpTo n,f q)≤(∑ q∈auxPrimes B n p,f q)+K*(B+2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian_prime
declarations.snippet: theorem gaussian_prime (q : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) : gaussian q = 1+chi q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.harmonic_to_logs
declarations.snippet:
theorem harmonic_to_logs {n : ℕ} (hn : 2≤n) :
    Real.log (Real.log n)≤(∑ q∈primesUpTo n,invPrime q)+8*squareSum ∧
    Real.log (Real.log n)≤(∑ q∈primesUpTo n,bothWeight q)+8*squareSum+Real.log (3/2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.first_order_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem first_order_lower {B k n p : ℕ} (hb : 2≤B) (lo : 2≤k) (hn : 2≤n) :
    (k:ℝ)*Real.log (Real.log n) - (((k:ℝ)-2)*((B:ℝ)+2+8*squareSum)
       +2*(2*((B:ℝ)+2)+8*squareSum+Real.log (3/2))) ≤
    ∑ q∈auxPrimes B n p,dimension k q/q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.signedInv
declarations.snippet: def signedInv (d : ℕ) : ℝ := (chi d)/d

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.inv_even
declarations.snippet: private theorem inv_even {n : ℕ} (h : n%2=0) : signedInv n=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.inv_one
declarations.snippet: private theorem inv_one {n : ℕ} (h : n%4=1) : signedInv n=1/(n:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.inv_three
declarations.snippet: private theorem inv_three {n : ℕ} (h : n%4=3) : signedInv n= -1/(n:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.reciprocal_character
declarations.snippet:
theorem reciprocal_character (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) :
    2/3≤∑ d∈range (n+1),signedInv d := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.multiples
declarations.snippet:
theorem multiples (n e : ℕ) (he : 0<e) :
    ((Icc 1 n).filter (e∣·))=(Icc 1 (n/e)).image (fun d=>e*d) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.convolution_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem convolution_row (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ m∈Icc 1 n,gaussian m/m) =
    ∑ e∈Icc 1 n, (∑ d∈range (n/e+1),signedInv d)/(e:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.harmonic_gaussian
declarations.snippet:
theorem harmonic_gaussian (n : ℕ) :
    (2/3:ℝ)*(harmonic n:ℝ)≤∑ m∈Icc 1 n,gaussian m/m := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.elementaryLoss
declarations.snippet:
def elementaryLoss (B k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((k:ℝ)-2)*((B:ℝ)+2+8*squareSum)+2*(2*((B:ℝ)+2)+8*squareSum+Real.log (3/2))+C*squareSum

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.elementary_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem elementary_product {B k : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hb : 64≤B) (error : C≤B) (hc : 0≤C)
    (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ), 2≤n → ∀ (p : ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ), LocalApproximation B k C g →
      Real.exp (-elementaryLoss B k C)*(Real.log n)^k ≤ ∏ q∈auxPrimes B n p,(1+odds g q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.sieve_primes
declarations.snippet:
theorem sieve_primes (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {B k : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hb : 64≤B) (error : C≤B) (hc : 0≤C) (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (p : ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ), LocalApproximation B k C g →
      let P:=auxPrimes B (smallLevel t) p
      (∀ q∈P,q.Prime ∧ q≠p ∧ q≤level t ∧ 0≤g q ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q) ∧
      (2*∑ q∈P,g q*Real.log q≤Real.log (level t)) ∧
      c*(growthBound A t:ℝ)^k ≤ ∏ q∈P,(1+odds g q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.chi
declarations.snippet: def chi : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ⟨fun n => (ZMod.χ₄ (n:ZMod 4):ℤ), by norm_num⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian
declarations.snippet: def gaussian : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := (zeta:ArithmeticFunction ℝ)*chi

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.oneFun
declarations.snippet: def oneFun : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := (zeta:ArithmeticFunction ℝ)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.chi_mult
declarations.snippet: theorem chi_mult : chi.IsMultiplicative := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian_mult
declarations.snippet: theorem gaussian_mult : gaussian.IsMultiplicative := isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast.mul chi_mult

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian_pow
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussian_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (e : ℕ) :
    gaussian (p^e)=∑ i∈range (e+1), (chi p)^i := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian_bounds
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussian_bounds {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (e : ℕ) :
    0≤gaussian (p^e) ∧ gaussian (p^e)≤e+1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.gaussian_nonneg
declarations.snippet: theorem gaussian_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0≤gaussian n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.weight
declarations.snippet:
def weight (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun n=>f n/n,by simp⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.weight_mult
declarations.snippet: theorem weight_mult {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) : (weight f).IsMultiplicative := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.tail_geometric
declarations.snippet:
theorem tail_geometric (e : ℕ) :
    (∑ j∈range e,((j:ℝ)+3)/(2:ℝ)^j)+(2*e+8)/(2:ℝ)^e=8 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.local_majorant
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_majorant (v : ℕ→ℝ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (v0 : v 0=1)
    (nn : ∀ j,0≤v j) (bd : ∀ j,v j≤((j:ℝ)+1)/(p:ℝ)^j) (e : ℕ) :
    (∑ j∈range (e+1),v j) ≤ 1 + v 1 + 8/(p:ℝ)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.factorial_primes
declarations.snippet: theorem factorial_primes (n : ℕ) : n.factorial.primeFactors=primesUpTo n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.finite_euler
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_euler (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hm : f.IsMultiplicative)
    (non : ∀ m,0≤f m) (cap : ∀ p:ℕ,p.Prime → ∀ e:ℕ, f (p^e)≤e+1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ m∈Icc 1 n,f m/m) ≤ Real.exp ((∑ p∈primesUpTo n,f p/p) + 8*squareSum) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.squareSum_le_two
declarations.snippet: theorem squareSum_le_two : squareSum≤2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.numerical_loss
declarations.snippet:
theorem numerical_loss {B k : ℕ} (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) :
    elementaryLoss B k 50 ≤ 15*(B:ℝ)+339 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeEuler.Elementary.numerical_sieve
declarations.snippet:
theorem numerical_sieve (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {B k t p : ℕ} {g : ℕ→ℝ} (hb : 64≤B)
    (lo : 2≤k) (hi : k≤13) (ht : max 256 (envelope A+3)≤t)
    (approx : LocalApproximation B k 50 g) :
    let P:=auxPrimes B (smallLevel t) p
    (∀ q∈P,q.Prime ∧ q≠p ∧ q≤level t ∧ 0≤g q ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q) ∧
    (2*∑ q∈P,g q*Real.log q ≤ Real.log (level t)) ∧
    Real.exp (-(15*(B:ℝ)+339))*(Real.log 2/131072)^k*(growthBound A t:ℝ)^k ≤
      ∏ q∈P,(1+odds g q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.norm
declarations.snippet: def norm (z : ZMod p × ZMod p) : ZMod p := z.1^2 + z.2^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.normWindow
declarations.snippet:
def normWindow (κ : ZMod p) (T : ZMod p → Finset (ZMod p)) : Finset (Coordinates (ZMod p)) :=
  univ.filter fun x => onCone κ x ∧ norm x.1 ∈ T x.2.2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.splitWindow
declarations.snippet:
private def splitWindow (κ : ZMod p) (T : ZMod p → Finset (ZMod p)) :
    ↥(normWindow κ T) ≃ (Σ w : ZMod p, Σ t : ↥(T w), Circle p t.val × Circle p (t.val-κ*w^2)) := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨x,hx⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨w,⟨t,ht⟩,⟨u,hu⟩,⟨v,hv⟩⟩ => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨eq,inc⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
    refine ⟨x.2.2,⟨norm x.1,inc⟩,⟨x.1,rfl⟩,⟨x.2.1,?_⟩⟩
    dsimp [onCone] at eq
    dsimp [norm]
    linear_combination -eq
  · refine ⟨(u,v,w),mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,?_,?_⟩⟩
    · dsimp [onCone]
      linear_combination hu-hv
    · change norm u∈T w
      change norm u=t at hu
      rwa [hu]
  · intro x
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨w,⟨t,ht⟩,⟨u,hu⟩,⟨v,hv⟩⟩
    change norm u = t at hu
    subst t
    rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.norm_window_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem norm_window_card (κ : ZMod p) (T : ZMod p → Finset (ZMod p)) :
    ((normWindow κ T).card:ℤ) = ∑ w : ZMod p, ∑ t ∈ T w, circleCount t * circleCount (t-κ*w^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.nonzeroCone
declarations.snippet: def nonzeroCone (κ : ZMod p) := (normWindow κ (fun _ => univ)).erase 0

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.nonzero_cone_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem nonzero_cone_card (odd : p≠2) {κ : ZMod p} (nz : κ≠0) :
    ((nonzeroCone κ).card:ℤ) = (p:ℤ)^4-1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.targets
declarations.snippet: def targets (C : Finset (ZMod p)) (w : ZMod p) := C.image fun c => -c*w^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.flagClasses
declarations.snippet:
def flagClasses (κ : ZMod p) (C : Finset (ZMod p)) :=
  (normWindow κ (targets C)).erase 0

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.zeroNorm
declarations.snippet: def zeroNorm (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : ℤ := (p:ℤ)+((p:ℤ)-1)*chi p

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.flagPolynomial
declarations.snippet:
def flagPolynomial (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ((p:ℤ)-1)*((p:ℤ)-chi p)*(2*zeroNorm p+((k:ℤ)-2)*((p:ℤ)-chi p)) + (zeroNorm p)^2-1

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.flag_classes_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem flag_classes_card (odd : p≠2) {κ : ZMod p} (nz : κ≠0) (C : Finset (ZMod p))
    (cz : 0∈C) (ck : -κ∈C) : ((flagClasses κ C).card:ℤ) = flagPolynomial p C.card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.actualFlag
Sun28.ConeFibres.mem_actualFlag
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem mem_actualFlag {i j : ↥(shifts A)} {x : Coordinates (ZMod p)} :
    x∈actualFlag p i j ↔ onCone (gap i j:ZMod p) x ∧ x≠0 ∧
      ∃ k : ↥(shifts A), x.1.1^2+x.1.2^2+(gap k i:ZMod p)*x.2.2^2=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.mem_badFactors_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_badFactors_iff (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (P : Finset ℕ) (x : Coordinates ℤ)
    (eq : onCone (gap i j) x) :
    p ∈ badFactors i P x ↔ p∈P ∧ reduction p x∈actualFlag p i j := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.coefficients
declarations.snippet:
def coefficients (p : ℕ) (i : ↥(shifts A)) : Finset (ZMod p) :=
  univ.image fun k : ↥(shifts A) => (gap k i:ZMod p)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.aligned
declarations.snippet:
private theorem aligned (i j : ↥(shifts A)) :
    actualFlag p i j=flagClasses (gap i j:ZMod p) (coefficients p i) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.actual_flag_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem actual_flag_card (odd : p≠2) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (distinct : (gap i j:ZMod p)≠0) :
    ((actualFlag p i j).card:ℤ)=flagPolynomial p (coefficients p i).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.reduced_gap_ne_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem reduced_gap_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (pos : 0<d) (large : exceptionalBound A d<p)
    {i j : ↥(shifts A)} (diff : i≠j) : (gap i j:ZMod p)≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.actual_flag_card_above
declarations.snippet:
theorem actual_flag_card_above {d : ℕ} (pos : 0<d) (large : exceptionalBound A d<p)
    (odd : p≠2) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (diff : i≠j) :
    ((actualFlag p i j).card:ℤ)=flagPolynomial p (shifts A).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.num
declarations.snippet:
private def num (s : Bool) (q k : ℝ) := if s then
    3*k*q^4+2*k*q^2-2*k*q+k+2*q^3+4*q^2+2*q
  else k*q^3-k*q^2-k*q-k+2*q^2+2*q

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.den
declarations.snippet:
private def den (s : Bool) (q : ℝ) :=
  if s then q*(q+1)*(q^2+1) else q*(q^2+1)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.numerator_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem numerator_bound (s : Bool) (q k : ℝ) (hq : 3≤q) (hk : 0≤k) (cap : k≤13) :
    |num s q k| ≤ 50*den s q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.model_error
Sun28.ConeFibres.fullDensity
declarations.snippet:
def fullDensity {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (i j : ↥(shifts A)) : ℝ :=
  (1-1/(p:ℝ)^3)*((actualFlag p i j).card:ℝ)/((p:ℝ)^4-1)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.chi_mod_four
declarations.snippet:
theorem chi_mod_four {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (odd : p≠2) :
    chi p = if p%4=1 then 1 else -1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.full_density_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem full_density_error {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {p d : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (pos : 0<d)
    (large : exceptionalBound A d<p) (odd : p≠2) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (diff : i≠j) :
    |fullDensity p i j - (((shifts A).card:ℝ)+2*(chi p:ℝ))/p| ≤ 50/(p:ℝ)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.full_density_error_mod_four
declarations.snippet:
theorem full_density_error_mod_four {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {p d : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (pos : 0<d)
    (large : exceptionalBound A d<p) (odd : p≠2) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (diff : i≠j) :
    |fullDensity p i j - (if p%4=1 then ((shifts A).card:ℝ)+2 else ((shifts A).card:ℝ)-2)/p|
    ≤ 50/(p:ℝ)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.chi
declarations.snippet: def chi (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : ℤ := legendreSym p (-1)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.circleCount
declarations.snippet: def circleCount (t : ZMod p) : ℤ := Fintype.card (Circle p t)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.circle_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem circle_count (odd : p ≠ 2) (t : ZMod p) :
    circleCount t = ((p:ℤ)-chi p) + if t=0 then (p:ℤ)*chi p else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeFibres.restricted_moment
declarations.snippet:
theorem restricted_moment (odd : p ≠ 2) (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (c : ZMod p)
    (zS : 0∈S) (cS : c∈S) :
    ∑ t ∈ S, circleCount t * circleCount (t-c) =
      (S.card:ℤ)*((p:ℤ)-chi p)^2 + 2*((p:ℤ)-chi p)*((p:ℤ)*chi p)
        + if c=0 then ((p:ℤ)*chi p)^2 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.cube
Sun28.ConeReal.mem_cube_of_weight
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_cube_of_weight {j B : ℕ} (hB:0<B) {x:Coordinates ℤ} (hx:weight j (scaled B x)≠0) :
    x∈cube B := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.sample
declarations.snippet:
def sample (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (κ : ℤ) (B : ℕ) : Finset (Coordinates ℤ) :=
  (cube B).filter fun x=>onCone κ x ∧ reduction p x∈residues p κ

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.majorant
declarations.snippet:
def majorant {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (j t p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (i k : ↥(shifts A))
    (narrow : 8*(maxCoefficient A+1)≤j+1) :
    Majorant p i k (lengthAt t) (rowWidth j (lengthAt t)) where
  support := sample p (gap i k) (side t)
  weight x := weight j (scaled (side t) x)
  nonneg x _ := (weight_bounds _ _).1
  contains x hx := by
    have one:=lattice_weight j t p i k narrow hx
    have cube':x∈cube (side t):=mem_cube_of_weight (by unfold side;positivity) (by rw [one];norm_num)
    obtain ⟨reg,_,mod⟩:=mem_filter.mp hx
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨cube',(mem_filter.mp reg).2.1,mod⟩
  majorizes x hx := (lattice_weight j t p i k narrow hx).ge

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.off_cube
declarations.snippet:
theorem off_cube {j B : ℕ} (hB:0<B) {x:Coordinates ℤ} (hx:x∉cube B) :
    weight j (scaled B x)=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.along_line

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.area_open

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.shell_area
declarations.snippet:
theorem shell_area (t : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (he : 0≤ε) :

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tube
declarations.snippet: def tube (κ ε : ℝ) : Set (Coordinates ℝ) := {x | |form κ x|≤ε}

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tube_measurable

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tubeMass
declarations.snippet:
def tubeMass (κ ε : ℝ) (ψ : Coordinates ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.rowConstant
declarations.snippet: def rowConstant : ℝ := 8*π^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tube_integral
declarations.snippet:
theorem tube_integral (κ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {ε:ℝ} (he:0<ε) :
    (∫⁻ x in tube κ ε, ENNReal.ofReal (weight j x)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (rowConstant*width j*(2*ε)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tube_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem tube_bound (κ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {ε:ℝ} (he:0<ε) :
    tubeMass κ ε (weight j) ≤ rowConstant*width j := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.tubeMass_eq_real
declarations.snippet:
theorem tubeMass_eq_real (κ ε : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :

Sun28.ConeReal.radial_window

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.form

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.width
declarations.snippet: def width (j : ℕ) : ℝ := ((j:ℝ)+1)⁻¹

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.width_pos
declarations.snippet: theorem width_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < width j := by unfold width; positivity

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.width_le
declarations.snippet: theorem width_le (j : ℕ) : width j ≤ 1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.axial

def weight (j : ℕ) (x : Coordinates ℝ) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeReal.weight_bounds

    (h₂ : rad x.2.1 ∈ Icc (1/4:ℝ) (5/4)) (hv : |x.2.2| ≤ width j) : weight j x = 1 := by

theorem record_cover {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (one : A 0=1) {d N W p κ : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (odd : p≠2) (T : Finset ℕ) (out : p∉T) (aux : p∉κ.primeFactors)
    {a : Candidate A d H Y} (ha : a∈box N W) (bad : ¬atPrime a.gaussian T κ p) :
    ∃ i j : ↥(shifts A), integerPoint a i j ∈ lattice p i j N W := by

  support : Finset (Coordinates ℤ)

  majorizes : ∀ x∈lattice p i j N W,1≤weight x

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.one_count_le

theorem one_count_le {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (one : A 0=1) {d N W p κ : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (odd : p≠2) (T : Finset ℕ) (out : p∉T) (aux : p∉κ.primeFactors)
    (P : ↥(shifts A) → ↥(shifts A) → Finset ℕ)
    (pr : ∀ i j q, q∈P i j → q.Prime)
    (large : ∀ a∈box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N W, ∀ i j q, q∈P i j → ∀ k : ↥(shifts A),q<a.values.value k.val)
    (F : ∀ i j : ↥(shifts A), Majorant p i j N W) :
    (oneCount T κ p (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N W):ℝ) ≤
    ∑ i,∑ j,mass (F i j).support (F i j).weight (badFactors i (P i j)) (fun U=>indicator (U=∅)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.coefficient_budget
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficient_budget (P : Finset ℕ) (z : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (non : ∀ p∈P,0≤odds g p)
    (small : ∀ p∈P,1+2*odds g p≤p) {r : Finset ℕ} (hr : r∈index P z) :
    (∑ b∈r.powerset, |coefficient g r b|)≤z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.upper_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem upper_bound {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (flags : α → Finset ℕ)
    (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (X E : ℝ) (z : ℕ) (positive : 0<z)
    (wn : ∀ x∈S,0≤w x) (pr : ∀ p∈P,p.Prime) (bounds : ∀ p∈P,0≤g p ∧ g p<1)
    (small : ∀ p∈P,1+2*odds g p≤p) (en : 0≤E)
    (remainder : ∀ u⊆P, (∏ p∈u,p)≤z^2 →
      |intersections S w flags u - X * ∏ p∈u,g p| ≤ E) :
    mass S w flags (fun U=>indicator (U=∅)) ≤ X/denominator g (index P z) + (z:ℝ)^4*E := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.logSize
declarations.snippet: def logSize (r : Finset ℕ) := ∑ p∈r, Real.log p

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.mean_log
declarations.snippet:
theorem mean_log (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (lt : ∀ p∈P,g p<1) :
    (∑ r ∈ P.powerset, (∏ p∈r,odds g p)*logSize r) =
    (∏ p∈P,(1+odds g p))*(∑ p∈P,g p*Real.log p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.half_euler_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem half_euler_product (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (z : ℕ) (hz : 1<z)
    (pr : ∀ p∈P,p.Prime) (bd : ∀ p∈P,0≤g p ∧ g p<1)
    (mean : 2*∑ p∈P,g p*Real.log p ≤ Real.log z) :
    (∏ p∈P,(1+odds g p))≤2*denominator g (index P z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.probability
declarations.snippet:
def probability (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Finset ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∏ p ∈ U, g p) * ∏ p ∈ P \ U, (1 - g p)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.odds
declarations.snippet: def odds (g : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ) := g p / (1-g p)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.indicator
declarations.snippet: def indicator (h : Prop) : ℝ := if h then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.factor_average
declarations.snippet:
theorem factor_average (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ U ∈ P.powerset, probability P g U *
       ∏ p ∈ P, (if p∈U then a p else b p)) =
    ∏ p ∈ P, (g p * a p + (1-g p) * b p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.model_flag
declarations.snippet:
theorem model_flag (P r : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (sub : r⊆P) :
    (∑ U ∈ P.powerset, probability P g U * indicator (r⊆U)) = ∏ p ∈ r, g p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.basis
declarations.snippet:
def basis (g : ℕ → ℝ) (r U : Finset ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ p ∈ r, (if p∈U then (-1:ℝ) else odds g p)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.coefficient
declarations.snippet:
def coefficient (g : ℕ → ℝ) (r b : Finset ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∏ p ∈ b, (-1-odds g p)) * ∏ p ∈ r \ b, odds g p

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.basis_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem basis_expansion (g : ℕ → ℝ) (r U : Finset ℕ) :
    basis g r U = ∑ b ∈ r.powerset, coefficient g r b * indicator (b⊆U) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.extend_product
declarations.snippet:
private theorem extend_product (P r : Finset ℕ) (sub : r⊆P) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∏ p ∈ P, (if p∈r then f p else 1)) = ∏ p ∈ r, f p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.orthogonal
declarations.snippet:
theorem orthogonal (P r s : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hr : r⊆P) (hs : s⊆P)
    (lt : ∀ p∈P, g p < 1) :
    (∑ U ∈ P.powerset, probability P g U * (basis g r U * basis g s U)) =
    if r=s then ∏ p ∈ r, odds g p else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.denominator
declarations.snippet: def denominator (g : ℕ → ℝ) (I : Finset (Finset ℕ)) := ∑ r ∈ I, ∏ p ∈ r, odds g p

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.testSum
declarations.snippet: def testSum (g : ℕ → ℝ) (I : Finset (Finset ℕ)) (U : Finset ℕ) := ∑ r ∈ I, basis g r U

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.model_second
declarations.snippet:
theorem model_second (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (I : Finset (Finset ℕ))
    (sub : ∀ r∈I,r⊆P) (lt : ∀ p∈P,g p<1) :
    (∑ U∈P.powerset,probability P g U*(testSum g I U)^2) = denominator g I := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.test_empty
declarations.snippet:
theorem test_empty (g : ℕ → ℝ) (I : Finset (Finset ℕ)) :
    testSum g I ∅=denominator g I := by simp [testSum,denominator,basis]

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.norm1
declarations.snippet: def norm1 (x : Coordinates ℤ) := x.1.1^2+x.1.2^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.value
declarations.snippet:
def value {A : Fin 3 → ℚ} (i k : ↥(shifts A)) (x : Coordinates ℤ) :=
  norm1 x + gap k i * x.2.2^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.interval
declarations.snippet: def interval (b : ℕ) := Icc (-(b:ℤ)) (b:ℤ)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.badFactors

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.level
declarations.snippet: def level (t : ℕ) := 2^t

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.level_pos
declarations.snippet: theorem level_pos (t : ℕ) : 0<level t := by unfold level;positivity

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.values_above_level
declarations.snippet:
theorem values_above_level {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d j t : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ}
    (narrow : 8*(maxCoefficient A+1)≤j+1) (ht : 1≤t)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.power_budget
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.congruence_power

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.error_on_row
Sun28.ConeSieve.mass
declarations.snippet:
def mass {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (flags : α → Finset ℕ)
    (f : Finset ℕ → ℝ) := ∑ x ∈ S, w x * f (flags x)

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.intersections
declarations.snippet:
def intersections {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (flags : α → Finset ℕ) (r : Finset ℕ) := mass S w flags (fun U => indicator (r⊆U))

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.intersection_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem intersection_expansion {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (flags : α → Finset ℕ)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (r s : Finset ℕ) :
    mass S w flags (fun U => basis g r U * basis g s U) =
    ∑ b ∈ r.powerset, ∑ c ∈ s.powerset,
      (coefficient g r b * coefficient g s c) * intersections S w flags (b∪c) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.gram_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem gram_error {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (flags : α → Finset ℕ)
    (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (X E : ℝ) (r s : Finset ℕ) (hr : r⊆P) (hs : s⊆P)
    (lt : ∀ p∈P,g p<1)
    (remainder : ∀ b⊆r, ∀ c⊆s,
      |intersections S w flags (b∪c) - X * ∏ p ∈ b∪c, g p| ≤ E) :
    |mass S w flags (fun U => basis g r U * basis g s U) -
        X*(if r=s then ∏ p ∈ r, odds g p else 0)| ≤
    ((∑ b∈r.powerset, |coefficient g r b|)*(∑ c∈s.powerset, |coefficient g s c|))*E := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.coefficient_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficient_sum (g : ℕ → ℝ) (r : Finset ℕ) (non : ∀ p∈r,0≤odds g p) :
    (∑ b∈r.powerset, |coefficient g r b|) = ∏ p∈r,(1+2*odds g p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.LocalEstimate
declarations.snippet:
def LocalEstimate {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (i j : ↥(shifts A))
    (t W : ℕ) (C D : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (F : Majorant p i j (lengthAt t) W) (P : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ) (X E : ℝ),
    (∀ q∈P,q.Prime ∧ q≠p ∧ q≤level t ∧ 0≤g q ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q) ∧
    0≤E ∧
    (2*∑ q∈P,g q*Real.log q≤Real.log (level t)) ∧
    (∀ u⊆P,(∏ q∈u,q)≤(level t)^2 →
      |intersections F.support F.weight (badFactors i P) u-X*(∏ q∈u,g q)|≤E) ∧
    0≤X ∧ 2*X/ (∏ q∈P,(1+odds g q)) ≤
      C*(((lengthAt t):ℝ)*W)/((p:ℝ)^2*(growthBound A t:ℝ)^(shifts A).card) ∧
    (level t:ℝ)^4*E ≤ D*(((lengthAt t):ℝ)*W)/(2:ℝ)^t

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeSieve.diagonal_estimate

  minus_pos : 0 < (minusOrder : ℕ)
  kernel_pos : 0 < (kernelModulus : ℕ)
  prime : ∀ p∈T, Nat.Prime p
  two : 2∈T
  common : plusOrder.gcd minusOrder=4
  dyadic_plus : padicValNat 2 plusOrder=2
  dyadic_minus : padicValNat 2 minusOrder=6
  local_avoid : ∀ p∈T,p≠2 → ¬p∣plusOrder*minusOrder
  kernel_avoid : ∀ p∈kernelModulus.primeFactors,p≠2 → ¬p∣minusOrder

declarations.snippet:
structure LocalEstimates (X : ℤ) (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (u v : ℕ) (values : PrimeValues A u v) (w : NinePoints) : Prop where
  trace_orders : ∀ j, let t:=argument A u v j
    let T:=ordinaryTraceAt w fixedMultiplier anchor (beta X) (A j) t
    ∀ p∈selected values j, padicValRat p T≤0
  trace_depths : ∀ j, let t:=argument A u v j
    let T:=ordinaryTraceAt w fixedMultiplier anchor (beta X) (A j) t
    ∀ p∈primes, 4≤padicValRat p (detector (A j) t/T^2)
  scalar_units : ∀ p : ℕ,p.Prime → p∈primes ∨ p∣(integerRadicand X).natAbs →
    let W:=scalarTree (scalarRadicand (beta X)) (scalarEntries w fixedMultiplier)
    W≠0 ∧ padicValRat p W=0

declarations.name: Sun28.ContactFactors.FiniteSelection
declarations.snippet:
def FiniteSelection : Prop :=
  ∀ X : ℤ, ∃ (D : ℕ) (cmin : ℤ), 0<D ∧ fixedMultiplier∣D ∧
    ∀ (c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ) (C : ℝ), (D:ℤ)∣c → max cmin 0<c → c=(fixedMultiplier:ℤ)*q →
      n 0=2*X^2+3 → n 1=c+1 → (∀ i,0<n i ∧ Odd (n i)) → lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3)=0 → 1≤C →
      let A:=fixedScale n
      ∃ (u v : ℕ) (values : PrimeValues A u v) (o : Orders), 0<v ∧
        slopeThreshold A C (1/2)<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧
        (∀ j,∀ p∈selected values j, ¬p∣dilation A ∧ ¬p∣separation ∧ padicValRat p (A j)=0) ∧
        ∃ (bad : Set ℤ) (hmin : ℤ), bad.Finite ∧ ∀ (h : ℤ) (B : Fin 9→AffineInput),
          o.accepts h → h∉bad → max (max anchor hmin) 0<h →
          Consequences (nineAffine B).doubles fixedMultiplier anchor ⟨q,h,n,fun i=>h*n i⟩ →
          LocalEstimates X A u v values (nineAffine B).doubles

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.forbidden
declarations.snippet:
def forbidden (l : ℕ) (z : Gaussian) (sign : Bool) : Prop :=
  if l%4=3 then
    realResidue l z=(if sign then -1 else 1) ∧ imagResidue l z=0
  else 2*realResidue l z = if sign then -((gaussianNorm z:ZMod l)+1) else (gaussianNorm z:ZMod l)+1

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.forbidden_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem forbidden_iff {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] (odd : l≠2) (z : Gaussian) (sign : Bool) :
    forbidden l z sign ↔ l∣adjacentNorm z sign := by

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.ResidueTests
declarations.snippet:
def ResidueTests {ι : Type*} (π : ι→Gaussian) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r s, r≠s → ∀ l : ℕ,l.Prime → l≠2 → l≠7 →
    ¬(forbidden l (π r) true ∧ forbidden l (π s) false)) ∧
  (∀ r, ∀ l : ℕ,l.Prime → l%4=1 → (gaussianNorm (π r):ZMod l) = -1 →
    ¬(realResidue l (π r)=0 ∧ (imagResidue l (π r))^2 = -1)) ∧
  (∀ l∈T,l≠2 → l≠7 → ∀ r e,¬forbidden l (π r) e) ∧
  (∀ l∈κ.primeFactors,l∉T → l≠2 → l≠7 → ∀ r,¬forbidden l (π r) false)

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.local_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_iff {ι : Type*} (π : ι→Gaussian) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ)
    (primes : ∀ l∈T,l.Prime) : MixedAndLocal π T κ ↔ ResidueTests π T κ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.PrimeValuesWithResidues
declarations.snippet:
def PrimeValuesWithResidues : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ (d κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ), 0<d → 0<κ → (∀ l∈T,l.Prime) → 2∈T →
    ∀ H Y : ℝ, let A:=Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n
      ∃ (u v : ℕ) (h : PrimeValues A u v) (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian),
        0<v ∧ d∣v ∧ H<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧ (∀ r∈shifts A,Y<(h.value r:ℝ)) ∧
        NormRays A h π ∧ ResidueTests π T κ

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.realResidue
declarations.snippet: def realResidue (p : ℕ) (z : Gaussian) : ZMod p := z.1

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.imagResidue
declarations.snippet: def imagResidue (p : ℕ) (z : Gaussian) : ZMod p := z.2

declarations.name: Sun28.NormSieve.gaussian_residue
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussian_residue (z : Gaussian) : (gaussianNorm z : ZMod p) =
    (realResidue p z)^2+(imagResidue p z)^2 := by

    (p∣adjacentNorm z true ∧ p∣adjacentNorm z false) ↔
      realResidue p z=0 ∧ (imagResidue p z)^2 = -1 := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_iff (inert : p%4=3) (z : Gaussian) (sign : Bool) :
    p ∣ adjacentNorm z sign ↔
      realResidue p z = (if sign then -1 else 1) ∧ imagResidue p z=0 := by

def signedCoordinate (t : ZMod p) (plus : Bool) : ZMod p :=

declarations.snippet:
theorem fixed_real (odd : p≠2) (x y t : ZMod p) (fibre : x^2+y^2=t)

declarations.snippet:

  Finset.univ.filter fun u => u.1^2+u.2^2=t ∧ (u.1+(if plus then 1 else -1))^2+u.2^2=0

declarations.name: Sun28.ContactSieve.MixedAndLocal

def MixedAndLocal {ι : Type*} (π : ι→Gaussian) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r s,∀ l : ℕ,l.Prime → l≠2 → l≠7 →
    ¬(l∣adjacentNorm (π r) true ∧ l∣adjacentNorm (π s) false)) ∧
  (∀ l∈T,l≠2 → l≠7 → ∀ r e,¬l∣adjacentNorm (π r) e) ∧
  (∀ l∈κ.primeFactors,l∉T → l≠2 → l≠7 → ∀ r,¬l∣adjacentNorm (π r) false)

declarations.name: Sun28.ContactSieve.PrimePatterns

    ∀ (d κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ), 0<d → 0<κ → (∀ l∈T,l.Prime) → 2∈T →
    ∀ H Y : ℝ, let A:=fixedScale n
      ∃ (u v : ℕ) (h : PrimeValues A u v) (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian),
        0<v ∧ d∣v ∧ H<(Sun28.ContactFactors.slope A u v:ℝ) ∧ (∀ r∈shifts A,Y<(h.value r:ℝ)) ∧
        NormRays A h π ∧ MixedAndLocal π T κ

declarations.name: Sun28.CyclicOrbit.of_open_component
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def of_open_component [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] (g : G)
    (op : IsOpen (connectedComponent (0 : orbitClosure g))) : RealRatio.Orbit (orbitClosure g) := by
  classical
  let G₀ := AddSubgroup.connectedComponentOfZero (orbitClosure g)
  have ret := positive_return (generator g) (op.mem_nhds mem_connectedComponent)
  exact { generator := generator g
          dense := dense_generator g
          H := G₀
          q := ret.choose
          positive := ret.choose_spec.1
          step := by
            change (ret.choose : ℤ) • generator g ∈ connectedComponent (0 : orbitClosure g)
            simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using ret.choose_spec.2
          divide := fun L l x hx => component_root (generator g) (dense_generator g) l hx }

    {R h : ℚ} (D : OrdinaryTest → K0) {e α ν : ℤ} (ep : 0<e)
    (base : ∀ a : ℚ,a≠0 → v (algebraMap ℚ K0 a)=((e*padicValRat p a:ℤ):WithTop ℤ))
    (rorder : v (algebraMap ℚ K0 R)=((e*(ν-6*α):ℤ):WithTop ℤ))
    (horder : v (algebraMap ℚ K0 h)=((e*(α-ν):ℤ):WithTop ℤ))
    (integer : ∀ i,Vge v 0 (D i) ∧ Vge v 0 (conjugation (D i))) (large : 6+211*|α|≤ν) :
    let T:=ordinaryTrace R (normalizedLeaves (algebraMap ℚ K0 h) D) orderRequired
    leafWeight R h D≠0 ∧ T≠0 ∧ padicValRat p T=padicValRat p 2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Exceptional.ordinary_depth_at_prime
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_depth_at_prime {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (fixed : p∈primes)
    (place : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K0))
    [place.asIdeal.LiesOver ((Rat.HeightOneSpectrum.primesEquiv (R:=𝓞 ℚ)).symm ⟨p,hp.out⟩).asIdeal]
    (points : NinePoints) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (β A u w t : ℚ)
    (an : A≠0) (un : u≠0) (wn : w≠0) (slope : t=A*u/w^2) (unit : padicValRat p u=0)
    (large : 6+211*|padicValRat p A|≤padicValRat p (w^2))
    (integer : IntegralAtBoth place (ordinaryAt points M c β)) :
    let R:=detector A t
    let T:=ordinaryTraceAt points M c β A t
    t∉marks ∧ t≠3 ∧ R≠0 ∧ leafWeight R (t-3) (ordinaryAt points M c β)≠0 ∧ T≠0 ∧
    padicValRat p (t-3)=padicValRat p A-padicValRat p (w^2) ∧
    padicValRat p R=padicValRat p (w^2)-6*padicValRat p A ∧ padicValRat p T=padicValRat p 2 ∧
    padicValRat p (R/T^2)=padicValRat p (w^2)-6*padicValRat p A-2*padicValRat p 2 ∧
    4≤padicValRat p (R/T^2) := by

  ∃ ω : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j, ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop, ω b ≤ rowWidth j b) ∧

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.filteredLogarithm_of_formal_chart
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def filteredLogarithm_of_formal_chart (v : AddValuation L (WithTop ℤ))
    {b : L} (T : EllipticKernelChart v b) (A : LogarithmOnLayers v T) : FilteredLogarithm v v b where
  kernel := T.kernel
  formal := T.membership
  log := A.log.comp T.chart.toAddMonoidHom
  level Q r hr := by
    change _ ≤ v (A.log (T.chart Q)) ↔ _ ≤ v (parameter Q.1)
    rw [←T.chart_parameter]
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨X,hX,e⟩ := (A.bijOn r hr).surjOn h
      have eq : X=T.chart Q := (A.bijOn 1 (by decide)).injOn
        (by simpa using T.integral X) (by simpa using T.integral (T.chart Q)) e
      exact eq ▸ hX
    · intro h
      exact (A.bijOn r hr).mapsTo h

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.pointMap
declarations.snippet:
private noncomputable def pointMap (f : K →+* L) (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine K) :
    W.Point →+ (W.map f).Point where
  toFun Q := match Q with
    | .zero => 0
    | .some x y h => .some (f x) (f y) ((W.map_nonsingular f.injective x y).mpr h)
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := by
    rintro (_ | ⟨x₁,y₁,h₁⟩) (_ | ⟨x₂,y₂,h₂⟩)
    any_goals rfl
    by_cases hxy : x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=W.negY x₂ y₂
    · rw [add_of_Y_eq hxy.1 hxy.2,add_of_Y_eq (congrArg f hxy.1) (by rw [hxy.2,WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_negY])]
    · simpa only [add_some hxy,←WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_addX,←WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_addY,
        ←WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_slope] using!
        (add_some (W:=W.map f) (h₁:=(W.map_nonsingular f.injective x₁ y₁).mpr h₁)
           (h₂:=(W.map_nonsingular f.injective x₂ y₂).mpr h₂)
           fun h => hxy ⟨f.injective h.1,f.injective ((W.map_negY f ..) ▸ h.2)⟩).symm

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.pullback_filteredLog
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def pullback_filteredLog {w : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ)}
    {v : AddValuation L (WithTop ℤ)} {b : K}
    (f : K →+* L) (agrees : ∀ x, v (f x)=w x) (C : FilteredLogarithm v v (f b)) :
    FilteredLogarithm w v b where
  kernel := C.kernel.comap (mapShortPoint f b)
  formal {Q} h nz := by
    apply C.formal
    · rw [(mapShortPoint_coordinates f Q).2,agrees]
      exact h
    · rw [(mapShortPoint_coordinates f Q).1]
      exact (map_ne_zero f).mpr nz
  log := C.log.comp {
    toFun := fun Q => ⟨mapShortPoint f b Q.1,Q.2⟩
    map_zero' := Subtype.ext (map_zero _)
    map_add' := fun _ _ => Subtype.ext (map_add _ _ _) }
  level Q r hr := by
    change _ ≤ v (C.log ⟨mapShortPoint f b Q.1,Q.2⟩) ↔ _
    rw [C.level ⟨mapShortPoint f b Q.1,Q.2⟩ r hr,(mapShortPoint_coordinates f Q.1).1,agrees]

def ordinaryAt (w : NinePoints) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (β : ℚ) : OrdinaryTest → K0 :=
  let L := fun i => pointRatio (w.U i) w.H
  let V := translated w M c
  let V₀ := translatedBase w c
  let L' := fun i => conjugation (pointRatio (V i) V₀)
  fun i => match i with
  | .h => reciprocal (scalarEquiv w.H)
  | .u j => reciprocal (scalarEquiv (w.U j))
  | .v₀ => conjugation (reciprocal (scalarEquiv V₀))
  | .v j => conjugation (reciprocal (scalarEquiv (V j)))
  | .difference j => L j-L' j
  | .delta => lucas (L 1) (L 2) (L 3)
  | .beta => L 0-algebraMap ℚ K0 β

  trace≠0 ∧ polePredicate U (r/trace^2)

      polePredicate U (poleArgument sqrt2_sq conjugation c a.h a.n a.m β A t) := by

declarations.snippet:
def FreeTests (u : Fin 27 → ℚ) (A : Fin 9 → AffineInput) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ)
    (x Γ : ℚ) (D : ℕ) (Uo Us : Finset ℚ) : Prop :=
  let w := (nineAffine A).doubles
  (∀ i, (A i).re=u ⟨2*i.val,by omega⟩ ∧ (A i).im=u ⟨2*i.val+1,by omega⟩) ∧
  w.Q≠0 ∧ w.H≠0 ∧ translatedBase w c≠0 ∧
  RationalOddChart w.N ∧ RationalOddChart w.T ∧ RationalOddChart w.Z ∧
  (∀ j, (pointScale w M j)^2*u 18 ∉ marks ∧ (pointScale w M j)^2*u 18≠3 ∧ pointScale w M j≠0) ∧
  (∀ j, let s:=pointScale w M j
    ordinaryAtPair w M c (beta x) (s^2) (s^2*u 18) Uo
      (u ⟨19+2*j.val,by omega⟩) (u ⟨20+2*j.val,by omega⟩)) ∧
  scalarAtPair w M (scalarRadicand (beta x)) Γ D Us (u 25) (u 26)

declarations.name: Sun28.Forward.pack
declarations.snippet:
private def pack (A : Fin 9 → AffineInput) (η : ℚ) (e z : Fin 3 → ℚ) (s t : ℚ) (i : Fin 27) : ℚ :=
  if left : i.val < 18 then
    let a := A ⟨i.val/2,by omega⟩
    if i.val%2=0 then a.re else a.im
  else if i.val=18 then η
  else if middle : i.val <25 then
    let j : Fin 3 := ⟨(i.val-19)/2,by omega⟩
    if i.val%2=1 then e j else z j
  else if i.val=25 then s else t

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.Gaussian
declarations.snippet: abbrev Gaussian := ℤ × ℤ

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianNorm
declarations.snippet: def gaussianNorm (z : Gaussian) : ℕ := (z.1^2 + z.2^2).natAbs

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianMul
declarations.snippet: def gaussianMul (z w : Gaussian) : Gaussian := (z.1*w.1-z.2*w.2,z.1*w.2+z.2*w.1)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianPrime
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianPrime (z : Gaussian) : Prop := gaussianNorm z > 1 ∧
  ∀ a b : Gaussian, gaussianMul a b = z → gaussianNorm a = 1 ∨ gaussianNorm b = 1

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.adjacentNorm
declarations.snippet:
def adjacentNorm (z : Gaussian) (plus : Bool) : ℕ :=
  gaussianNorm (z.1 + (if plus then 1 else -1), z.2)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianCongruent
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianCongruent (m : ℕ) (z w : Gaussian) : Prop :=
  Int.ModEq m z.1 w.1 ∧ Int.ModEq m z.2 w.2

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianPattern
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianPattern {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℤ) (q M u w : ℕ) (p : Fin k → ℕ) : Prop :=
  q ∣ w ∧ ∃ π : Fin k → Gaussian,
    (∀ j, (p j:ℤ) = u + c j * (w:ℤ)^2 ∧ (p j).Prime ∧
      gaussianPrime (π j) ∧ gaussianNorm (π j) = p j ∧
      gaussianCongruent 16 (π j) (9,0) ∧ gaussianCongruent 7 (π j) (1,3) ∧
      gaussianCongruent M (π j) (0,1)) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → Odd l → ¬ (l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) false ∧ l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) true)) ∧
    (∀ j h, j ≠ h → ∀ e f : Bool, ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → Odd l →
      ¬ (l ∣ adjacentNorm (π j) e ∧ l ∣ adjacentNorm (π h) f)) ∧
    (∀ j, padicValNat 2 (adjacentNorm (π j) false) = 6 ∧ padicValNat 2 (adjacentNorm (π j) true) = 2) ∧
    (∀ j h, Nat.gcd (adjacentNorm (π j) false) (adjacentNorm (π h) true) = 4) ∧
    (∀ j e, (adjacentNorm (π j) e).Coprime (7*M))

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.GaussianTuples
declarations.snippet:
def GaussianTuples : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ c : Fin k → ℤ, Function.Injective c →
  ∀ q M : ℕ, 0 < q → 0 < M → Odd M → squarefree M → ¬ 7 ∣ M →
  ∀ H Y : ℝ, 0 < H → 0 < Y → ∃ u w : ℕ, 0 < u ∧ 0 < w ∧ H < (u:ℝ)/w^2 ∧
  ∃ p : Fin k → ℕ, gaussianPattern c q M u w p ∧ ∀ j, Y < (p j:ℝ)

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.orders_of_generators
declarations.snippet:
theorem orders_of_generators {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (π : ι→Gaussian)
    (κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ)
    (κpos : 0<κ) (primes : ∀ p∈T,p.Prime) (two : 2∈T)
    (depth : ∀ p∈T,padicValNat p κ≤a p) (a2 : 6≤a 2)
    (ray : ∀ i,gaussianCongruent 16 (π i) (9,0))
    (cross : ∀ i j,(adjacentNorm (π i) false).gcd (adjacentNorm (π j) true)=4)
    (cop : ∀ i e,(adjacentNorm (π i) e).Coprime (7*avoidModulus T κ)) :
    ∃ o : Orders, o.plusOrder=orderLcm π true ∧ o.minusOrder=orderLcm π false ∧
      o.kernelModulus=κ ∧ o.T=T ∧ o.a=a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.OrientedAt
declarations.snippet:
structure OrientedAt (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {u v : ℕ} (h : PrimeValues A u v)
    (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian) (M : ℕ) : Prop where
  norm : ∀ r,gaussianPrime (π r) ∧ gaussianNorm (π r) = h.value r
  ray16 : ∀ r,gaussianCongruent 16 (π r) (9,0)
  ray7 : ∀ r,gaussianCongruent 7 (π r) (1,3)
  rayM : ∀ r,gaussianCongruent M (π r) (0,1)
  cross : ∀ r s,(adjacentNorm (π r) false).gcd (adjacentNorm (π s) true)=4
  avoid : ∀ r e,(adjacentNorm (π r) e).Coprime (7*M)

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.oriented_tuple
declarations.snippet:
private theorem oriented_tuple (gauss : GaussianTuples) (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (one : A 0=1)
    (d M : ℕ) (dp : 0<d) (mp : 0<M) (mo : Odd M) (ms : squarefree M) (m7 : ¬7∣M)
    (H Y : ℝ) : ∃ (u v : ℕ) (h : PrimeValues A u v) (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian),
      0<u ∧ 0<v ∧ d∣v ∧ H<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧
      (∀ r∈shifts A,primeSize A Y<(h.value r:ℝ)) ∧ OrientedAt A h π M := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.select_with_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem select_with_orders (gauss : GaussianTuples) (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (one : A 0=1) (alive : ∀ j,A j≠0)
    (d κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℕ) (dp : 0<d) (κp : 0<κ)
    (primes : ∀ p∈T,p.Prime) (two : 2∈T) (depth : ∀ p∈T,padicValNat p κ≤a p) (a2 : 6≤a 2)
    (H Y : ℝ) :
    ∃ (u v : ℕ) (h : PrimeValues A u v) (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian) (o : Orders),
      0<u ∧ 0<v ∧ d∣v ∧ H<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧ (∀ r∈shifts A,Y<(h.value r:ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j,∀ p∈selected h j,¬p∣dilation A ∧ ¬p∣separation ∧ padicValRat p (A j)=0) ∧
      OrientedAt A h π (avoidModulus T κ) ∧
      o.plusOrder=orderLcm π true ∧ o.minusOrder=orderLcm π false ∧
      o.kernelModulus=κ ∧ o.T=T ∧ o.a=a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.OrientedAt.avoid
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.avoidPrimes
declarations.snippet:
def avoidPrimes (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (T∪κ.primeFactors).filter fun p=>p≠2 ∧ p≠7

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.avoidModulus
declarations.snippet: def avoidModulus (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p∈avoidPrimes T κ,p

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.avoid_modulus_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem avoid_modulus_spec (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) (hp : ∀ p∈T,p.Prime) :
    0<avoidModulus T κ ∧ Odd (avoidModulus T κ) ∧ squarefree (avoidModulus T κ) ∧
    ¬7∣avoidModulus T κ ∧ ∀ p∈T∪κ.primeFactors,p≠2 → p∣7*avoidModulus T κ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GaussianSelection.orderLcm
declarations.snippet:
def orderLcm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (π : ι → Gaussian) (sign : Bool) : ℕ :=

    (cross : ∀ i∈s,∀ j∈s,(f i).gcd (g j)=4) : (s.lcm f).gcd (s.lcm g)=4 := by

  ∃ s:ℚ, 0<s ∧ s^2<θ ∧ AllowedRatio b θ s ∧ padicValRat 3 s=0 ∧

    let abx := a*b*x

    squares.all (fun y=> if b*y=byv then squares.all

structure PrimaryData (A : Type) [AddCommGroup A] where
  sel : ℕ → Type
  [groupSel : ∀ j, AddCommGroup (sel j)]
  reduced : Type
  [groupReduced : AddCommGroup reduced]
  [finiteReduced : Finite reduced]
  d : ℕ
  bounded : ∃ j : ℕ, ∀ x : reduced, (2^j : ℕ) • x=0
  values : Type
  [groupValues : AddCommGroup values]
  pair : reduced →+ reduced →+ values
  alternating : ∀ x, pair x x=0
  nondegenerate : ∀ x, (∀ y, pair x y=0) → x=0
  kummer : ∀ j, quotientAt A (2^j) →+ sel j
  boundary : ∀ j, sel j →+ (Fin d → ZMod (2^j)) × torsionAt reduced (2^j)

    (v.getLsbD 10 ^^ v.getLsbD 11 ^^ v.getLsbD 13 ^^ v.getLsbD 14 ^^ v.getLsbD 15 ^^ v.getLsbD 16 ^^ v.getLsbD 18) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 1 ^^ v.getLsbD 3 ^^ v.getLsbD 4 ^^ v.getLsbD 6 ^^ v.getLsbD 8) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 11 ^^ v.getLsbD 13 ^^ v.getLsbD 14 ^^ v.getLsbD 16 ^^ v.getLsbD 18) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 0 ^^ v.getLsbD 2 ^^ v.getLsbD 15) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 10 ^^ v.getLsbD 12 ^^ v.getLsbD 15) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 0 ^^ v.getLsbD 1 ^^ v.getLsbD 2 ^^ v.getLsbD 4 ^^ v.getLsbD 5 ^^ v.getLsbD 6 ^^ v.getLsbD 7 ^^ v.getLsbD 8 ^^ v.getLsbD 9 ^^ v.getLsbD 16) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 10 ^^ v.getLsbD 11 ^^ v.getLsbD 12 ^^ v.getLsbD 14 ^^ v.getLsbD 15 ^^ v.getLsbD 17 ^^ v.getLsbD 18 ^^ v.getLsbD 19) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 2 ^^ v.getLsbD 6 ^^ v.getLsbD 7 ^^ v.getLsbD 17) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 12 ^^ v.getLsbD 16 ^^ v.getLsbD 17) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 1 ^^ v.getLsbD 2 ^^ v.getLsbD 3 ^^ v.getLsbD 4 ^^ v.getLsbD 6 ^^ v.getLsbD 9 ^^ v.getLsbD 18) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 11 ^^ v.getLsbD 12 ^^ v.getLsbD 13 ^^ v.getLsbD 14 ^^ v.getLsbD 16 ^^ v.getLsbD 19) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 1 ^^ v.getLsbD 6 ^^ v.getLsbD 8) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 11 ^^ v.getLsbD 16 ^^ v.getLsbD 18) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 0) = false ∧
    (v.getLsbD 11) = false ∧

theorem reduced (v : Word) (h : localEquations v) :
    v.getLsbD 0 = false ∧
    v.getLsbD 1 = false ∧
    v.getLsbD 4 = (v.getLsbD 3) ∧
    v.getLsbD 5 = (v.getLsbD 3) ∧
    v.getLsbD 7 = (v.getLsbD 6) ∧
    v.getLsbD 8 = (v.getLsbD 6) ∧
    v.getLsbD 9 = (v.getLsbD 6) ∧
    v.getLsbD 10 = (v.getLsbD 2) ∧
    v.getLsbD 11 = false ∧
    v.getLsbD 12 = false ∧

theorem singleton_order {p : ℕ} (hp : p∈3::badPrimes) (v : Word) (i : Nat) :
    ∃ j : Nat, generators[j]?=some (p:ℤ) ∧
      orderBit p i v = parity (v.getLsbD (i+j)) ∧
      generators.map (unitFactor p)=generators.map (fun a => if a=(p:ℤ) then 1 else a) := by

    ∃ x : Nat, x<2 ∧ generatorProduct generators i v =
    (p:ℤ)^x * unitPart p i v ∧ (x:ZMod 2) = orderBit p i v := by

    total (generators.map (fun a=>legBit p (unitFactor p a))) i v = legBit p (unitPart p i v) := by

    legBit p (unitPart p 0 v) + orderBit p 0 v * legBit p (fixedN/p) +

         generatorProduct (s.map (fun a => if a=p then 1 else a)) i v := by

  if a.val%4=0 ∨ b.val%4=0 ∨ (a.val%2=1 ∧ b.val%2=1) then true else
  squares.all (fun x=>squares.all (fun t=>
    let abx := a*b*x
    let byv := abx-11*t
    let azv := abx+1*t
    squares.all (fun y=> if b*y=byv then squares.all
      (fun z=>decide (a*z≠azv ∨ ¬(x=1 ∨ y=1 ∨ z=1 ∨ t=1))) else true)))

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Program.bind

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Program.eval

def eval [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) : Program R α → α

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Program.eval_bind

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Program.runs_map

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Program.runs_append

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad
declarations.snippet:
structure Quad (R : Type u) where
  re : R
  im : R
  den : R

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.ofPair
declarations.snippet: def ofPair (a b : R) : Quad R := ⟨a,b,1⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.neg
declarations.snippet: def neg (x : Quad R) : Quad R := ⟨-x.re,-x.im,x.den⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.conj
declarations.snippet: def conj (x : Quad R) : Quad R := ⟨x.re,-x.im,x.den⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.add
declarations.snippet:
def add (x y : Quad R) : Quad R :=
  ⟨x.re*y.den+y.re*x.den,x.im*y.den+y.im*x.den,x.den*y.den⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.sub
declarations.snippet: def sub (x y : Quad R) : Quad R := add x (neg y)

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.mul
declarations.snippet:
def mul (x y : Quad R) : Quad R :=
  ⟨x.re*y.re+2*x.im*y.im,x.re*y.im+x.im*y.re,x.den*y.den⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.normNum
declarations.snippet: def normNum (x : Quad R) : R := x.re^2-2*x.im^2

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.inv
declarations.snippet: def inv (x : Quad R) : Quad R := ⟨x.re*x.den,-x.im*x.den,normNum x⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.div
declarations.snippet: def div (x y : Quad R) : Quad R := mul x (inv y)

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.Good
declarations.snippet: def Good (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Quad R) : Prop := φ x.den≠0

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval
declarations.snippet: def eval (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Quad R) : K0 := ⟨φ x.re / φ x.den,φ x.im / φ x.den⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.map_two
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem map_two : φ (2:R)=2 := by simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two] using φ.map_add 1 1 |>.trans (by rw [map_one]; norm_num)

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_pair
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_pair (a b : R) : Good φ (ofPair a b) := by simp [Good,ofPair]

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_pair
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem eval_pair (a b : R) : eval φ (ofPair a b) = ⟨φ a,φ b⟩ := by simp [eval,ofPair]

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_neg
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_neg (x : Quad R) : Good φ (neg x) ↔ Good φ x := Iff.rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_neg
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem eval_neg (x : Quad R) : eval φ (neg x) = -eval φ x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_conj
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_conj (x : Quad R) : Good φ (conj x) ↔ Good φ x := Iff.rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_conj
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem eval_conj (x : Quad R) : eval φ (conj x)=star (eval φ x) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_add
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_add (x y : Quad R) : Good φ (add x y) ↔ Good φ x ∧ Good φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_add
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_add {x y : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) (hy : Good φ y) :
    eval φ (add x y) = eval φ x + eval φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_sub
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_sub (x y : Quad R) : Good φ (sub x y) ↔ Good φ x ∧ Good φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_sub
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_sub {x y : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) (hy : Good φ y) :
    eval φ (sub x y) = eval φ x - eval φ y := by rw [sub,eval_add φ hx ((good_neg φ y).2 hy),eval_neg,sub_eq_add_neg]

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_mul
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_mul (x y : Quad R) : Good φ (mul x y) ↔ Good φ x ∧ Good φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_mul
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_mul {x y : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) (hy : Good φ y) :
    eval φ (mul x y) = eval φ x * eval φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.normNum_zero_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem normNum_zero_iff {x : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) :
    φ (normNum x)=0 ↔ eval φ x=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_inv
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem good_inv {x : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) : Good φ (inv x) ↔ eval φ x≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_inv
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_inv {x : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) (hn : eval φ x≠0) :
    eval φ (inv x)=(eval φ x)⁻¹ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.good_div
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem good_div {x y : Quad R} (hy : Good φ y) :
    Good φ (div x y) ↔ Good φ x ∧ eval φ y≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Quad.eval_div
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_div {x y : Quad R} (hx : Good φ x) (hy : Good φ y) (hn : eval φ y≠0) :
    eval φ (div x y) = eval φ x / eval φ y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row
declarations.snippet:
structure Row (R α : Type*) where
  equations : List R
  guards : List R
  output : α

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.pure
declarations.snippet: def pure (a : α) : Row R α := ⟨[],[],a⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.join
declarations.snippet:
def join (x : Row R α) (y : Row R β) : Row R β :=
  ⟨x.equations++y.equations,x.guards++y.guards,y.output⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.Live
declarations.snippet:
def Live [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Row R α) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ x.equations,φ e=0) ∧ ∀ g ∈ x.guards,φ g≠0

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.live_pure
declarations.snippet: @[simp] theorem live_pure [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) (a : α) : (pure (R:=R) a).Live φ := by simp [Live,pure]

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.live_join
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem live_join [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) (x : Row R α) (y : Row R β) :
    (join x y).Live φ ↔ x.Live φ ∧ y.Live φ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.bind
declarations.snippet:
def bind (xs : List (Row R α)) (f : α → List (Row R β)) : List (Row R β) :=
  xs.flatMap fun x => (f x.output).map (join x)

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.Runs
declarations.snippet:
def Runs [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) (xs : List (Row R α)) (a : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ r ∈ xs, r.Live φ ∧ r.output=a

declarations.name: Sun28.GroupCharts.Row.runs_bind
declarations.snippet:
theorem runs_bind [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* ℚ) (xs : List (Row R α)) (f : α → List (Row R β)) (y : β) :
    Runs φ (bind xs f) y ↔ ∃ x, Runs φ xs x ∧ Runs φ (f x) y := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.twistFactor
declarations.snippet: def twistFactor (i : Fin 5) : ℤ := ![343,1,1,1,2] i

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.signedTwist
declarations.snippet: def signedTwist (i : Fin 5) : ℤ := twistFactor i*seed (rootA i) (rootB i)

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.parameter
declarations.snippet:
def parameter (i : Fin 5) (x : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  if i=0 then 2401/(x+1) else if i=1 then (x+32)/32 else x/32

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.affineForm
declarations.snippet:
def affineForm (i : Fin 5) (s : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ![1,s,s-1,s-2401,32*s+343] i

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.retainedProduct
declarations.snippet:
def retainedProduct (i : Fin 5) (s : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, affineForm j s

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.delete_values
declarations.snippet:
private theorem delete_values (i : Fin 5) (f : Fin 5 → ℚ) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,f j) =
      ![f 1*f 2*f 3*f 4, f 0*f 2*f 3*f 4, f 0*f 1*f 3*f 4,
        f 0*f 1*f 2*f 4, f 0*f 1*f 2*f 3] i := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.chart_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_square (i : Fin 5) (x : ℚ) (nx : x+1≠0) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, retainedProduct i (parameter i x)=
      (twistFactor i:ℚ)*cubic (rootA i) (rootB i) x*c^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.slope
declarations.snippet: def slope (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) : ℚ := parameter i (orbit (rootA i) (rootB i) n)

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.denominator_ne
declarations.snippet:
private theorem denominator_ne (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
    orbit (rootA i) (rootB i) n+1≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.slope_injective
declarations.snippet: theorem slope_injective (i : Fin 5) : Function.Injective (slope i) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.literal_product_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem literal_product_square (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ v : ℚ, retainedProduct i (slope i n)=(signedTwist i:ℚ)*v^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.twist_nonzero
declarations.snippet: theorem twist_nonzero (i : Fin 5) : signedTwist i≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.twist_unit
declarations.snippet:
theorem twist_unit {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (large : 76176<p) (i : Fin 5) :
    ¬ p∣(signedTwist i).natAbs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.primitive_form
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_form (j : Fin 5) (s : ℚ) :
    (oldForm j s.num s.den : ℚ)=(s.den:ℚ)*affineForm j s := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.homogeneous_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem homogeneous_square (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
    let s:=slope i n
    ∃ v : ℚ, (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,(oldForm j s.num s.den:ℚ))=
      (signedTwist i:ℚ)*v^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.cubic
declarations.snippet: def cubic (a b : ℤ) (x : ℚ) : ℚ := x*(x-a)*(x-b)

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.duplicate
declarations.snippet:
def duplicate (a b : ℤ) (x : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (x^2-(a:ℚ)*b)^2/(4*cubic a b x)

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.orbit
declarations.snippet:
def orbit (a b : ℤ) : ℕ → ℚ
  | 0 => 1/4
  | n+1 => duplicate a b (orbit a b n)

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.sub_integral
declarations.snippet:
private theorem sub_integral {x : ℚ} (c : ℤ) (hx : padicValRat 2 x < 0) :
    x-c≠0 ∧ padicValRat 2 (x-c)=padicValRat 2 x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.duplicate_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem duplicate_order (a b : ℤ) {x : ℚ} (hx : padicValRat 2 x<0) :
    padicValRat 2 (duplicate a b x)=padicValRat 2 x-2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.FourContact.orbit_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem orbit_order (a b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :

      a.primeNorm≤(primeProduct P:ℝ)^4 ∧ 0≤a.logarithmQ ∧ a.logarithmQ≤4*Real.log (primeProduct P:ℝ) ∧
      (P=∅ → a.regulator=NumberField.Units.regulator L) ∧
      a.regulator≤(NumberField.classNumber L:ℝ)*NumberField.Units.regulator L*(primeProduct P:ℝ)^2 ∧
      a.regulator≤(NumberField.classNumber L:ℝ)*NumberField.Units.regulator L*
        (max 1 (4*Real.log (primeProduct P:ℝ)))^(4*P.card) ∧
    ∀ (g h k I J : ℤ) (x y z : ℚ), g≠0 → h≠0 → k≠0 → I≠0 → J≠0 → I≠J →
      (∃ r:L,r^2=(g:L)/(h:L)) → (∃ w:L,w^2=(g:L)/(k:L)) →
      x.den.primeFactors⊆P → y.den.primeFactors⊆P → z.den.primeFactors⊆P →
      (g:ℚ)*x^2-(h:ℚ)*y^2=(I:ℚ) → (g:ℚ)*x^2-(k:ℚ)*z^2=(J:ℚ) →
      ∀ H B:ℝ, numberLog g≤H → numberLog h≤H → numberLog k≤H → numberLog I≤B → numberLog J≤B →
      logHeight₁ x ≤ (pellConstant (4*(P.card+1)):ℝ)*a.primeNorm*a.regulator*(1+logStar a.regulator)*

declarations.name: Sun28.HeightExtension.PublishedClassRegulator
declarations.snippet:
def PublishedClassRegulator : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : IntermediateField ℚ Omega) [FiniteDimensional ℚ L], Module.finrank ℚ L≤4 →
    let D:ℝ:=(NumberField.discr L).natAbs
    (1/5:ℝ)≤NumberField.Units.regulator L ∧
      (NumberField.classNumber L:ℝ)*NumberField.Units.regulator L≤Real.sqrt D*(logStar D)^3

declarations.name: Sun28.HeightExtension.PublishedFinitePell
declarations.snippet:
def PublishedFinitePell : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : IntermediateField ℚ Omega) [FiniteDimensional ℚ L], Module.finrank ℚ L≤4 →
    ∀ (P : Finset ℕ), (∀ p∈P,p.Prime) → P.card≤4 →
    ∃ a : PlacesData,
      a.primeNorm≤(primeProduct P:ℝ)^4 ∧ 0≤a.logarithmQ ∧ a.logarithmQ≤4*Real.log (primeProduct P:ℝ) ∧
      a.regulator≤(NumberField.classNumber L:ℝ)*NumberField.Units.regulator L*
        (max 1 (4*Real.log (primeProduct P:ℝ)))^16 ∧
    ∀ (g h k I J : ℤ) (x y z : ℚ), g≠0 → h≠0 → k≠0 → I≠0 → J≠0 → I≠J →
      (∃ r:L,r^2=(g:L)/(h:L)) → (∃ w:L,w^2=(g:L)/(k:L)) →
      x.den.primeFactors⊆P → y.den.primeFactors⊆P → z.den.primeFactors⊆P →
      (g:ℚ)*x^2-(h:ℚ)*y^2=(I:ℚ) → (g:ℚ)*x^2-(k:ℚ)*z^2=(J:ℚ) →
      ∀ H B:ℝ, numberLog g≤H → numberLog h≤H → numberLog k≤H → numberLog I≤B → numberLog J≤B →
      logHeight₁ x ≤ 2^512*a.primeNorm*a.regulator*(1+logStar a.regulator)*
        (NumberField.Units.regulator L+(NumberField.classNumber L:ℝ)*a.logarithmQ+4*H+B)

theorem rational_pencil {A B : ℤ} (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) (i : Fin 5) :
    ∃ (g h k I J : ℤ) (x y z : ℚ),
      g≠0 ∧ h≠0 ∧ k≠0 ∧ I≠0 ∧ J≠0 ∧ I≠J ∧
      g.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧ h.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧ k.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧
      (∀ c∈([g,h,k,I,J]:List ℤ),c.natAbs≤2^32*heightRadical A B) ∧
      x.den.primeFactors⊆rowPrimes i A B ∧ y.den.primeFactors⊆rowPrimes i A B ∧ z.den.primeFactors⊆rowPrimes i A B ∧
      (g:ℚ)*x^2-(h:ℚ)*y^2=(I:ℚ) ∧ (g:ℚ)*x^2-(k:ℚ)*z^2=(J:ℚ) ∧
      (oldForm (leftRow i) A B:ℚ)/(oldForm i A B:ℚ)=
        (kernel (leftRow i) A B:ℚ)/(kernel i A B:ℚ)*x^2 := by

private theorem rational_pencil {A B : ℤ} (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) (i : Fin 5) :
    ∃ (g h k I J : ℤ) (x y z : ℚ),
      g≠0 ∧ h≠0 ∧ k≠0 ∧ I≠0 ∧ J≠0 ∧ I≠J ∧
      g.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧ h.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧ k.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧
      (∀ c∈([g,h,k,I,J]:List ℤ),c.natAbs≤2^32*heightRadical A B) ∧
      x.den.primeFactors⊆repeatedPrimes i A B ∧ y.den.primeFactors⊆repeatedPrimes i A B ∧ z.den.primeFactors⊆repeatedPrimes i A B ∧
      (g:ℚ)*x^2-(h:ℚ)*y^2=(I:ℚ) ∧ (g:ℚ)*x^2-(k:ℚ)*z^2=(J:ℚ) ∧
      (oldForm (leftRow i) A B:ℚ)/(oldForm i A B:ℚ)=
        (kernel (leftRow i) A B:ℚ)/(kernel i A B:ℚ)*x^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.HeightFibres.PublishedPell312
declarations.snippet:
def PublishedPell312 : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : IntermediateField ℚ Omega) [FiniteDimensional ℚ L], Module.finrank ℚ L≤4 →
    ∀ (g h k a b c D₁ D₂ : ℤ), g≠0 → h≠0 → k≠0 → D₁≠0 → D₂≠0 → D₁≠D₂ →
    (∃ r : L, r^2=(g:L)/(h:L)) → (∃ w : L,w^2=(g:L)/(k:L)) →
    g*a^2-h*b^2=D₁ → g*a^2-k*c^2=D₂ →
    ∀ H J : ℝ, numberLog g≤H → numberLog h≤H → numberLog k≤H →
    numberLog D₁≤J → numberLog D₂≤J →
    let reg:=NumberField.Units.regulator L
    numberLog a≤(2:ℝ)^140*reg*(1+logStar reg)*(reg+4*H+J)

  ∀ j : ℕ,J≤j → ∃ D : ℝ,0≤D ∧ ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.boxMass

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.box_product

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.pairMass
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def pairMass (t : ι→F p) (i j : ι) : ℝ := boxMass t (pairSets t i j)

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.offdiag

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.unitRate
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def unitRate (c : ι→F p) : ℝ :=
  (∑ w : F p, ∑ u : F p, if ∀ i,norms c u w i≠0 then (1:ℝ) else 0)/(p:ℝ)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.units_lower
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.relativeLoss
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def relativeLoss (c : ι→F p) : ℝ := averageLoss c / unitRate c

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.relative_nonneg
declarations.snippet: theorem relative_nonneg (c : ι→F p) : 0≤relativeLoss c := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.obstructed

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.loss
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def loss (c : ι→F p) (u w : F p) : ℝ := by
  classical
  let t:=norms c u w
  exact if ∀ i,t i≠0 then ((obstructed t).card:ℝ)/Fintype.card ((i : ι)→Circle p (t i)) else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.sum_cap
declarations.snippet:

    ∑ ij : ι×ι,pairMass t ij.1 ij.2 := by

Sun28.MixedSieve.exceptional_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem exceptional_sum (c : ι→F p) (w : F p) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ u : F p,∑ ij : ι×ι, if ij.1=ij.2 ∧ norms c u w ij.1= -1 then a else 0)

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.averageLoss
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.average_bound

Sun28.MixedSieve.F
declarations.snippet: abbrev F (p : ℕ) := ZMod p

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.Circle
declarations.snippet: abbrev Circle (p : ℕ) (t : ZMod p) := {z : ZMod p × ZMod p // z.1^2+z.2^2=t}

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.parameters
declarations.snippet: abbrev parameters (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] := {s : ZMod p // 1+s^2≠0}

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.parametrization
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def parametrization (odd : p≠2) : Option (parameters p) ≃ Circle p 1 := by
  classical
  have two : (2:F p)≠0 := by
    rw [←Nat.cast_ofNat,Ne,ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact fun d => odd ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (Fact.out : p.Prime) Nat.prime_two).mp d)
  let point (s : parameters p) : Circle p 1 :=
    ⟨((1-s.val^2)/(1+s.val^2),2*s.val/(1+s.val^2)),by
      dsimp
      field_simp [s.property] <;> ring⟩
  let slope (z : Circle p 1) (h : 1+z.val.1≠0) : parameters p :=
    ⟨z.val.2/(1+z.val.1),by
      intro eq
      have rel:=z.property
      field_simp [h] at eq
      apply h
      apply (mul_eq_zero.mp (show (2:F p)*(1+z.val.1)=0 by linear_combination eq-rel)).resolve_left two⟩
  refine ⟨(fun s => match s with | none => ⟨(-1,0),by simp⟩ | some r => point r),
     (fun z => if h : 1+z.val.1=0 then none else some (slope z h)),?_,?_⟩
  · rintro (_|s)
    · simp
    · have hx : 1+(point s).val.1≠0 := by
        dsimp [point]
        intro e
        field_simp [s.property] at e
        apply two
        linear_combination e
      simp only [hx,reduceDIte,Option.some.injEq]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (2*s.val/(1+s.val^2))/(1+(point s).val.1) = s.val
      apply (div_eq_iff hx).mpr
      dsimp [point]
      field_simp [s.property] <;> ring
  · intro z
    rcases z with ⟨⟨x,y⟩,hxy⟩
    change x^2+y^2=1 at hxy
    dsimp only
    by_cases hx : 1+x=0
    · simp only [hx,reduceDIte]

      change 1+x=0 at hx
      have eq : x= -1 := by linear_combination hx
      subst x
      have ys : y^2=0 := by linear_combination hxy
      have yz := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by decide : 2≠0)).mp ys
      subst y
      rfl
    · simp only [hx,reduceDIte]
      apply Subtype.ext
      have denom := (slope ⟨(x,y),hxy⟩ hx).property
      change 1+(y/(1+x))^2≠0 at denom
      apply Prod.ext
      · dsimp [point,slope]
        apply (div_eq_iff denom).mpr
        field_simp [hx]
        <;> linear_combination -(1+x)*hxy
      · dsimp [point,slope]
        apply (div_eq_iff denom).mpr
        field_simp [hx]
        <;> linear_combination -y*hxy

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.rotate
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def rotate {t : F p} (ht : t≠0) : Circle p 1 ≃ Circle p t := by
  classical
  let a : F p := (ZMod.sq_add_sq p t).choose
  let b : F p := (ZMod.sq_add_sq p t).choose_spec.choose
  have hab : a^2+b^2=t := (ZMod.sq_add_sq p t).choose_spec.choose_spec
  refine ⟨fun z => ⟨(a*z.val.1-b*z.val.2,b*z.val.1+a*z.val.2),?_⟩,
    fun z => ⟨((a*z.val.1+b*z.val.2)/t,(a*z.val.2-b*z.val.1)/t),?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · dsimp
    linear_combination (z.val.1^2+z.val.2^2)*hab+t*z.property
  · dsimp
    field_simp [ht]
    <;> linear_combination (z.val.1^2+z.val.2^2)*hab+t*z.property
  · intro z
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [ht]
    · linear_combination z.val.1*hab
    · linear_combination z.val.2*hab
  · intro z
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> field_simp [ht]
    · linear_combination z.val.1*hab
    · linear_combination z.val.2*hab
