declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.primeFibre
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def primeFibre (a : Candidate A d H Y) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (r : ↥(shifts A)) :
    Circle p (norms (coefficients A p) (a.u:ZMod p) (a.v:ZMod p) r) :=
  ⟨(realResidue p (a.gaussian r),imagResidue p (a.gaussian r)),by
    rw [←gaussian_residue,a.rays.norm,prime_value_residue a.values r p]⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.fibre_bad_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_bad_iff (a : Candidate A d H Y) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (r : ↥(shifts A)) (e : Bool) :
    primeFibre a p r∈bad p _ e ↔ p∣adjacentNorm (a.gaussian r) e := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.fibre_obstructed_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_obstructed_iff (a : Candidate A d H Y) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    primeFibre a p∈obstructed _ ↔
      ∃ i j,p∣adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true ∧ p∣adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.atPrime_iff_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem atPrime_iff_fibre (a : Candidate A d H Y) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ p : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (odd : p≠2) (outside : p∉T) (aux : p∉κ.primeFactors) :
    atPrime a.gaussian T κ p ↔ primeFibre a p∉obstructed _ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.safeBox
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def safeBox (t : ι→F p) (e : Bool) : Finset ((i : ι)→Circle p (t i)) :=

declarations.snippet:
theorem good_iff_union (t : ι→F p) (z : (i : ι)→Circle p (t i)) :

Sun28.MixedSieve.sign

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.one_prime_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem one_prime_expansion (safe : Bool→ι→Prop) [∀ e i,Decidable (safe e i)] :
    (if (∀i,safe true i) ∨ (∀i,safe false i) then (1:ℤ) else 0)=
       ∑ j : Fin 3,sign j * ∏ i,signedBox safe j i := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.finite_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_expansion {P : Type*} [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (safe : P→Bool→ι→Prop)
    [∀ l e i,Decidable (safe l e i)] :
    (∏ l, if (∀i,safe l true i) ∨ (∀i,safe l false i) then (1:ℤ) else 0)=
    ∑ j : P→Fin 3,(∏ l,sign (j l)) * ∏ i, ∏ l,signedBox (safe l) (j l) i := by

declarations.name: Sun28.MixedSieve.surviving_mass
declarations.snippet:
theorem surviving_mass {P B : Type*} (places : Finset P) (box : Finset B)
    (bad : P→B→Prop) (w : B→ℝ) (non : ∀ b∈box,0≤w b) :
    (∑ b∈box,w b) - (∑ p∈places,∑ b∈box,if bad p b then w b else 0) ≤
      ∑ b∈box,if ∀ p∈places,¬bad p b then w b else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.weight
declarations.snippet:
def weight {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} (a : Candidate A d H Y) : ℝ :=
  ∏ r : ↥(shifts A),Real.log (a.values.value r.val)

declarations.snippet: theorem weight_pos {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} (a : Candidate A d H Y) : 0<weight a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.atPrime
declarations.snippet:
def atPrime {ι : Type*} (π : ι→ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.Gaussian) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ l : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r s,r≠s → ¬(forbidden l (π r) true ∧ forbidden l (π s) false)) ∧
  (l%4=1 → ∀ r,(ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.gaussianNorm (π r):ZMod l)= -1 →
    ¬(realResidue l (π r)=0 ∧ imagResidue l (π r)^2= -1)) ∧
  (l∈T → ∀ r e,¬forbidden l (π r) e) ∧
  (l∈κ.primeFactors → l∉T → ∀ r,¬forbidden l (π r) false)

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.residues_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem residues_iff {ι : Type*} (π : ι→ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.Gaussian)
    (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ) (primes : ∀ l∈T,l.Prime) :
    ResidueTests π T κ ↔ ∀ l : ℕ,l.Prime → l≠2 → l≠7 → atPrime π T κ l := by

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.below
declarations.snippet:
def below {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} (a : Candidate A d H Y) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ L : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ l : ℕ,l.Prime → l≠2 → l≠7 → l≤L → atPrime a.gaussian T κ l

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.tail
declarations.snippet:
def tail {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} (a : Candidate A d H Y) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ L : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ l : ℕ,l.Prime ∧ l≠2 ∧ l≠7 ∧ L<l ∧ ¬atPrime a.gaussian T κ l

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.surplus
declarations.snippet:
def surplus {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} (T : Finset ℕ) (κ L : ℕ)
    (S : Finset (Candidate A d H Y)) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact (∑ a∈S.filter (fun a => below a T κ L ∧ tail a T κ L),weight a) <
    ∑ a∈S.filter (fun a => below a T κ L),weight a

declarations.name: Sun28.WeightedSelection.survives
Sun28.WeightedSelection.PositiveSurplus
declarations.snippet:
def PositiveSurplus : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ),AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ (d κ : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ),0<d → 0<κ → (∀ l∈T,l.Prime) → 2∈T →
      ∀ H Y : ℝ, ∃ (L : ℕ) (S : Finset (Candidate (Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n) d H Y)),
        surplus T κ L S

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.ordinaryTests
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def ordinaryTests {ρ : K} (root : ρ^2=2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K)
    (c h : ℤ) (n m : Fin 4 → ℤ) (β : ℚ) : OrdinaryTest → K :=
  let P := paperGenerator root
  let L := fun i => ordinaryRatio P (m i) h
  let L' := fun i => σ (ordinaryRatio P (m i-c*n i) (h-c))
  fun test => match test with
  | .h => reciprocal (h • P)
  | .u i => reciprocal (m i • P)
  | .v₀ => σ (reciprocal ((h-c) • P))
  | .v i => σ (reciprocal ((m i-c*n i) • P))
  | .difference i => L i-L' i
  | .delta => lucas (L 1) (L 2) (L 3)
  | .beta => L 0-algebraMap ℚ K β

      discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (τ (ordinaryTests root σ c h n m β i))) :
    (p:ℤ)^64 ∣ lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3) ∧ (p:ℤ)^16 ∣ (β-n 0).num := by

    (D : I → K) (k : I → ℕ) {α : ℤ} (hr : v r=(α:WithTop ℤ)) (odd : Odd α)

    (θ : K) (live : θ≠0) (trace_eq : θ=(weightProduct r D k)⁻¹+(weightProduct r D' k)⁻¹)
    (pole : 0 ≤ v (r/θ^2)) :
    0 < α ∧ ((∀ i, D i=0 ∨ ∃ d : ℤ, v (D i)=(d:WithTop ℤ) ∧ (4*(k i:ℤ)-3)*α+1 ≤ 4*d) ∨
      (∀ i, D' i=0 ∨ ∃ d : ℤ, v (D' i)=(d:WithTop ℤ) ∧ (4*(k i:ℤ)-3)*α+1 ≤ 4*d)) := by

    (hC : 1≤C) (hc : 0≤c₁) (hc' : 0≤c₂)
    (five : ∀ j, logHeight₁ (t j) ≤ C*(∏ p ∈ contactPrimes S (t j), (p:ℝ))^24)
    (scale : ∀ H : ℝ, 1≤H → (∀ j, logHeight₁ (t j)≤H) → B^2≤c₁*H+c₂)
    (divides : ∀ j, (∏ p ∈ contactPrimes S (t j), p)^k ∣ N) :

    (five : ∀ j, logHeight₁ (t j) ≤ C*(∏ p ∈ contactPrimes S (t j), (p:ℝ))^24)
    (scale : ∀ H : ℝ, 1≤H → (∀ j, logHeight₁ (t j)≤H) → (indexSize n)^2≤c₁*H+c₂)
    (products : ∀ j, (∏ p ∈ contactPrimes S (t j), (p:ℤ))^64 ∣ lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3) ∧
      (∏ p ∈ contactPrimes S (t j), p)^16 ∣ (β-n 0).num.natAbs) :
    (lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3)≠0 → (indexSize n)^2≤ordinaryConstant C c₁ c₂*
      (1+|((lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3) : ℤ) : ℝ)|^(3/8:ℝ))) ∧

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.SimultaneousTwists

def SimultaneousTwists : Prop := ∀ β θ : ℕ, 0 < β → 0 < θ → squarefree β → squarefree θ →
  β.Coprime θ → β.Coprime 6 → θ.Coprime 6 → β % 24 = 17 → θ % 24 = 1 →
  (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ θ → localSquareAt p β) →
  (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ β → localSquareAt p θ) →
  ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ squarefree n ∧ n.Coprime (6*θ) ∧ twistPointInClass β n ∧ twistPointInClass β (n*θ)

    (pointScale w fixedMultiplier j)^2*η≠3 ∧ pointScale w fixedMultiplier j≠0
  ordinary : ∀ j : Fin 3,

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.twentySeven

    (eq : ((s:ℤ)^2-θ)*(9*(s:ℤ)^2-θ)=(b:ℤ)*h^2) : b%24=17 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.seed

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.OneQuartic
declarations.snippet:
def OneQuartic (b θ : ℚ) : Prop := ∃ u v z : ℚ,
  θ = quartic b u v*z^2 ∨ -3*θ = quartic b u v*z^2

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.NonzeroPair
declarations.snippet:
def NonzeroPair (b θ : ℚ) : Prop := ∃ l u v y z : ℚ,
  l≠0 ∧ u≠0 ∧ v≠0 ∧ y≠0 ∧ z≠0 ∧
  y^2=(b*u^2)*(b*u^2-l)*(b*u^2+3*l) ∧
  z^2=(b*v^2)*(b*v^2-l*θ)*(b*v^2+3*(l*θ))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.one_quartic_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem one_quartic_iff {b θ : ℚ} (bp : 0<b) (tn : θ≠0) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.surface_of_one_quartic
declarations.snippet:
theorem surface_of_one_quartic {b θ : ℚ} (bp : 0<b) (tn : θ≠0) (test : OneQuartic b θ) :

Sun28.PrescribedPoints.restore

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.surface_iff_one_or_nonzero
declarations.snippet:
theorem surface_iff_one_or_nonzero {b θ : ℚ} (bp : 0<b) (tn : θ≠0) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.negative_section
declarations.snippet:
theorem negative_section {b θ k h : ℚ} (hn : h≠0)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.zero_pair_iff_one
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_pair_iff_one {b θ : ℚ} (bp : 0<b) (tn : θ≠0) :
    ZeroPair b θ ↔ OneQuartic b θ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.CoreResidual
declarations.snippet:
def CoreResidual : Prop := ∀ b θ : ℕ, AdmissiblePair b θ → InputClass b → FixedSquares θ →
  NormConic b θ → ¬FactorPair b θ → ¬OneQuartic (b:ℚ) (θ:ℚ) → NonzeroPair (b:ℚ) (θ:ℚ)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.one_of_factor
declarations.snippet:
theorem one_of_factor {b θ : ℕ} (bp : 0<b) (tp : 0<θ) (f : Factor b θ) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrescribedPoints.core_iff_residual
declarations.snippet: theorem core_iff_residual : CoreResidual ↔ TwistExtension.Residual := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem pole_of_core (core : CoreResidual) {B : ℚ} (ready : ClassPrepared B) :
    Ordinary.polePredicate ScalarHeight.smallMultipliers B := TwistExtension.pole (core_iff_residual.mp core) ready

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.traceAt
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def traceAt (p : ℕ) : ℤ := (p : ℤ)+1-(pointCount p (-1) : ℤ)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.root
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def root (p : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if (traceAt p/2)%4=1 then traceAt p/2 else -(traceAt p/2)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.trace_alternatives
declarations.snippet:
theorem trace_alternatives {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (h : InClass p) :
    traceAt p=2*cp p ∨ traceAt p= -(2*cp p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.root_representation
declarations.snippet:
theorem root_representation {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (h : InClass p) :
    (root p)%4=1 ∧ ∃ b : ℤ, (p:ℤ)=(root p)^2+b^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.root_of_ray
Sun28.PrimeClasses.ray_norms
declarations.snippet:
theorem ray_norms {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) {z : Gaussian} (hz : gaussianNorm z=p)
    (h16 : gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0)) (h7 : gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3)) (sign : Bool) :
    (adjacentNorm z sign : ℤ)=(p:ℤ)+1+(if sign then 2*root p else -(2*root p)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.primeLog
declarations.snippet:
def primeLog (K L : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  if 0≤n ∧ rationalPrime K L n.toNat then Real.log (n.toNat : ℝ) else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.crossing
Sun28.PrimeClasses.rationalWeight
declarations.snippet:
def rationalWeight (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (K L : ℕ) (x : ℕ×ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if crossing A K L x then ∏ i : ↥(shifts A),primeLog K K (form A x i) else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.rationalMass
declarations.snippet:
def rationalMass (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L N W : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x∈((Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun x : ℕ×ℕ => d∣x.2)),rationalWeight A K L x

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.prime_log_eq
declarations.snippet: theorem prime_log_eq (K L : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : primeLog K L n=primeWeight K L n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.crossing_iff
Sun28.PrimeClasses.rational_weight_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_weight_eq (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (K L : ℕ) (x : ℕ×ℕ) :
    rationalWeight A K L x=hybridWeight A K L x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.rational_mass_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_mass_eq (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L N W : ℕ) :
    rationalMass A d K L N W=hybridMass A d K L N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.orient
declarations.snippet: def orient (t : ℤ) : ℤ := if t%8=2 then t else -t

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.oriented_trace
declarations.snippet:
theorem oriented_trace {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (h : InClass p) :
    orient (traceAt p)=2*root p ∧ (orient (traceAt p))^2=(traceAt p)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficientBase
Sun28.PrimeClasses.scaled
declarations.snippet:
private theorem scaled (n : ℤ) {a b : ℤ} {s : ℤ} (nz : s≠0) :
    s*a ≡ s*b [ZMOD s*n] ↔ a≡b [ZMOD n] :=

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficient_base_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficient_base_iff {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficientClass
declarations.snippet:
def coefficientClass (L : ℕ) (n t : ℤ) : Prop :=
  coefficientBase n t ∧ ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q≠2 → q≠7 → q≤L → ¬(q:ℤ)∣(n+1)^2-t^2

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.common_both_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem common_both_iff (L p : ℕ) :
    commonPrime L L p ↔ p.Prime ∧ coefficientClass L p (traceAt p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.modulus
declarations.snippet: def modulus (L : ℕ) : ℕ := 7168*L.factorial

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficient_periodic
Sun28.PrimeClasses.Mat
declarations.snippet: abbrev Mat (L : ℕ) := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod (modulus L))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.matrixClass
declarations.snippet:
def matrixClass (L : ℕ) (g : Mat L) : Prop :=
  coefficientClass L (g.det.cast : ℤ) (g.trace.cast : ℤ)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.matrix_class_conjugation
declarations.snippet:
theorem matrix_class_conjugation (L : ℕ) (g u v : Mat L) (inverse : v*u=1) :
    matrixClass L (u*g*v) ↔ matrixClass L g := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.class_of_coefficients
declarations.snippet:
theorem class_of_coefficients (L p : ℕ) (g : Mat L) (det : g.det=(p:ZMod (modulus L)))
    (tr : g.trace=(traceAt p:ZMod (modulus L))) :
    commonPrime L L p ↔ p.Prime ∧ matrixClass L g := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficientOrder
declarations.snippet: def coefficientOrder (n t : ℤ) (s : Bool) : ℤ := n+1+(if s then orient t else -(orient t))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.coefficient_order_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficient_order_eq {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (base : baseRay p) (s : Bool) :
    coefficientOrder p (traceAt p) s=signedOrder p s := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.order_periodic
Sun28.PrimeClasses.matrixOrder
declarations.snippet:
def matrixOrder (L q : ℕ) (g : Mat L) (s : Bool) : Prop :=
  ¬(q:ℤ)∣coefficientOrder (g.det.cast : ℤ) (g.trace.cast : ℤ) s

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.order_of_coefficients
declarations.snippet:
theorem order_of_coefficients {L q p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (base : baseRay p)
    (qp : q.Prime) (small : q≤L) (g : Mat L) (det : g.det=(p:ZMod (modulus L)))
    (tr : g.trace=(traceAt p:ZMod (modulus L))) (s : Bool) :
    (¬(q:ℤ)∣signedOrder p s) ↔ matrixOrder L q g s := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.row_of_matrices
declarations.snippet:
theorem row_of_matrices {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {K L : ℕ} {x : ℕ×ℕ}
    (base : ∀ i : ↥(shifts A), commonPrime K K (form A x i).toNat)
    (g : ↥(shifts A)→Mat L)
    (det : ∀ i,(g i).det=((form A x i).toNat:ZMod (modulus L)))
    (tr : ∀ i,(g i).trace=(traceAt (form A x i).toNat:ZMod (modulus L))) :
    extraTest A K L x ↔ ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → K<q → q≤L →
      if q%4=3 then ¬((x.1:ZMod q)=1 ∧ (x.2:ZMod q)=0)
      else (∀ i, matrixOrder L q (g i) true) ∨ (∀ i,matrixOrder L q (g i) false) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.rectangle
declarations.snippet:
def rectangle (safe : Bool→ι→Prop) (r : Option ι) (i : ι) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | none => safe true i
  | some j => safe false i ∧ (i<j → safe true i) ∧ (i=j → ¬safe true i)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.unique_rectangle
declarations.snippet:
theorem unique_rectangle (safe : Bool→ι→Prop) :
    ( (∀ i,safe true i) ∨ (∀ i,safe false i) ) ↔ ∃! r,∀ i,rectangle safe r i := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.bool_product
declarations.snippet: private theorem bool_product (P : ι→Prop) : (∏ i, if P i then (1:ℕ) else 0)=if ∀ i,P i then 1 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.positive_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem positive_expansion (safe : Bool→ι→Prop) :
    (if (∀ i,safe true i) ∨ (∀ i,safe false i) then (1:ℕ) else 0)=
    ∑ r : Option ι, ∏ i, if rectangle safe r i then 1 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.expansion
Sun28.PrimeClasses.cutoff_expansion
declarations.snippet: theorem cutoff_expansion {P : Type*} [Fintype P] (safe : P→Bool→ι→Prop) : expansion safe := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.splitSafe
declarations.snippet:
def splitSafe (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (x : ℕ×ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (q : ↥T) (s : Bool) (i : ↥(shifts A)) : Prop :=
  ¬(q.val:ℤ)∣signedOrder (form A x i).toNat s

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.split_class_expansion
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_class_expansion (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (x : ℕ×ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) :
    expansion (splitSafe A x T) := cutoff_expansion _

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.baseRay
Sun28.PrimeClasses.zero_mod_sixteen
declarations.snippet: private theorem zero_mod_sixteen {y : ℤ} (h : y^2 ≡ 0 [ZMOD 256]) : y≡0 [ZMOD 16] := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.sign_seven
declarations.snippet:
private theorem sign_seven {b : ℤ} (hb : b^2 ≡ 2 [ZMOD 7]) :
    b ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] ∨ -b ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.base_ray_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_ray_iff {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) : baseRay p ↔
    ∃ z : Gaussian, gaussianNorm z=p ∧ gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0) ∧
      gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.signedOrder
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def signedOrder (p : ℕ) (s : Bool) : ℤ :=
  (p:ℤ)+1+(if s then 2*root p else -(2*root p))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.order_dvd_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem order_dvd_iff {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) {z : Gaussian} (hz : gaussianNorm z=p)
    (h16 : gaussianCongruent 16 z (9,0)) (h7 : gaussianCongruent 7 z (1,3)) (s : Bool) (q : ℕ) :
    q ∣ adjacentNorm z s ↔ (q:ℤ) ∣ signedOrder p s := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.rationalPrime
declarations.snippet:
def rationalPrime (K L p : ℕ) : Prop := p.Prime ∧ baseRay p ∧
  ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q≠2 → q≠7 → q≤L →
    (¬(q:ℤ)∣signedOrder p true) ∧ (q≤K → ¬(q:ℤ)∣signedOrder p false)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeClasses.common_prime_iff
declarations.snippet: theorem common_prime_iff (K L p : ℕ) : commonPrime K L p ↔ rationalPrime K L p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.inertRate
Sun28.PrimeLower.inert_rate_exact
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_rate_exact (c : ι → ZMod p) :
    inertRate c = unitRate c - 1/(p:ℝ)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.inert_relative_loss_le
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_relative_loss_le (c : ι → ZMod p) (big : 2 * Fintype.card ι ≤ p) :
    1/2 ≤ unitRate c ∧ 1 - 2/(p:ℝ)^2 ≤ inertRate c / unitRate c := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.rational_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_factors (S : Finset ℕ) (big : ∀ p∈S,5≤p) :
    (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∏ p∈S, (1 - 2/(p:ℝ)^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.inert_projection_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_projection_iff (c : ι → ZMod p) (inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hi : p%4=3) (u w : ZMod p) :
    (∃ z : (i : ι) → Circle p (norms c u w i), z∈obstructed _) ↔ u=1 ∧ w=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.extraTest
Sun28.PrimeLower.hybridWeight
declarations.snippet:
def hybridWeight (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (K L : ℕ) (q : ℕ×ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if extraTest A K L q then patternWeight A K K q else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.hybridMass
declarations.snippet:
def hybridMass (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L N W : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   ∑ q ∈ ((Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => d ∣ q.2)), hybridWeight A K L q

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.test_of_record
declarations.snippet:
private theorem test_of_record {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d K L κ : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (a : Record A d H Y) (pos : 0<d) (two : 2≤K) (base : exceptionalBound A d ≤ K)
    (fixed : ∀ q∈T,q≤K) (aux : ∀ q∈κ.primeFactors,q≤K)
    (good : ∀ i : ↥(shifts A),commonPrime K K (a.values.value i))
    (test : extraTest A K L (pair a)) : below a T κ L := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.hybrid_le_main_of_guards
declarations.snippet:
theorem hybrid_le_main_of_guards {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d K L κ N W : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (pos : 0<d) (two : 2≤K) (base : exceptionalBound A d ≤ K)
    (fixed : ∀ q∈T,q≤K) (aux : ∀ q∈κ.primeFactors,q≤K)
    (guards : ∀ q∈Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W,
      H < (slope A q.1 q.2 : ℝ) ∧ ∀ i : ↥(shifts A), Y < (form A q i : ℝ)) :
    hybridMass A d K L N W ≤ mainMass T κ L (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N W) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.eventually_hybrid_le_main
declarations.snippet:
theorem eventually_hybrid_le_main {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d K L κ : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (pos : 0<d) (two : 2≤K) (base : exceptionalBound A d ≤ K)
    (fixed : ∀ q∈T,q≤K) (aux : ∀ q∈κ.primeFactors,q≤K) (w : ℕ → ℕ)
    (short : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, (w N : ℝ)^2 ≤ ε*N) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, hybridMass A d K L N (w N) ≤
      mainMass T κ L (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N (w N)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.two_values_one
declarations.snippet:
theorem two_values_one {i j : ι} {c : ι → ZMod p} (ij : c i ≠ c j) (u w : ZMod p) :
    (norms c u w i=1 ∧ norms c u w j=1) ↔ (u=1 ∧ w=0) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.hybrid
Sun28.PrimeLower.hybrid_below
declarations.snippet:
theorem hybrid_below {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d κ K L : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ}
    (a : Candidate A d H Y) (T : Finset ℕ) (pos : 0<d)
    (base : exceptionalBound A d ≤ K) (fixed : ∀ q∈T,q≤K)
    (aux : ∀ q∈κ.primeFactors,q≤K) (good : hybrid a T κ K L) : below a T κ L := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.hybridLoss
Sun28.PrimeLower.hybrid_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem hybrid_product (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (S : Finset ℕ) (large : ∀ p∈S,2810≤p) :
    1/2 ≤ ∏ p∈S, (1-hybridLoss A p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.inert_collision
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_collision {u w : ZMod p} {c : ι → ZMod p}
    (inert : p % 4 = 3) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (z : (i : ι) → Circle p (norms c u w i)) (hit : z ∈ obstructed _) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.inert_atPrime
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_atPrime {A : Fin 3 → ℚ} {d κ : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H Y : ℝ}
    (a : Candidate A d H Y) (pos : 0<d) (large : exceptionalBound A d < p)
    (inert : p%4=3) (outside : p∉T) (aux : p∉κ.primeFactors)
    (avoid : ¬((a.u : ZMod p)=1 ∧ (a.v : ZMod p)=0)) : atPrime a.gaussian T κ p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.rayProportion
declarations.snippet:
def rayProportion {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (q : I → ℕ) [∀ i, Fact (q i).Prime]
    (t : (i:I) → ZMod (q i)) (G C : Type*) [Fintype G] [Fintype C] : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (C × ((i : I) → {z : Circle (q i) (t i) // z ∉ bad (q i) (t i) true})) : ℝ) /
  Fintype.card (G × ((i : I) → Circle (q i) 1))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.ray_fraction
declarations.snippet:
theorem ray_fraction {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (q : I → ℕ) [∀ i, Fact (q i).Prime]
    (t : (i:I) → ZMod (q i)) (nz : ∀ i,t i ≠ 0)
    (G C : Type*) [Fintype G] [Fintype C] :
    rayProportion q t G C = (Fintype.card C : ℝ)/Fintype.card G *
      ∏ i, ((bad (q i) (t i) true)ᶜ.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card (Circle (q i) (t i)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeLower.ray_fraction_lower

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.frequentRows
declarations.snippet:
def frequentRows (A : Fin 3 → ℚ) (d K L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=

theorem surplus_of_mass {A : Fin 3 → ℚ} {K L d κ J : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H Y C δ : ℝ}

    (success : ∀ J : ℕ, ∃ j ≥ J, ∃ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,

    (fits : ∃ I : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ I, ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      mass (lengthAt t) (rowWidth j (lengthAt t)) ≤
        mainMass T κ L (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) (lengthAt t) (rowWidth j (lengthAt t)))) (middle : LogRow A d H Y T κ L J C)
    (big : 2 ≤ K) (kl : K ≤ L) (tin : ∀ p ∈ T,p ≤ K) (ain : ∀ p ∈ κ.primeFactors,p ≤ K)
    (dp : 0 < δ) (gap : C/(L:ℝ) < δ/2) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Record A d H Y), surplus T κ L S := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.fixed_pattern
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixed_pattern {A : Fin 3 → ℚ} {K L d κ : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ} {T : Finset ℕ}

declarations.snippet:
def LocalProductInputs : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ d : ℕ, 0 < d → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ (K : ℕ) (α : ℝ), B ≤ K ∧ 0 < α ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ L ≥ max K m,
        let A := Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.permitted
declarations.snippet:
def permitted (c : ι → ZMod p) (v : ZMod p) : Finset (ZMod p) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.mem_permitted
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_permitted {c : ι → ZMod p} {u v : ZMod p} :
    u ∈ permitted c v ↔ ∀ i, u+c i*v^2 ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.permitted_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem permitted_card (c : ι → ZMod p) (v : ZMod p) :
    (permitted c v).card = if v=0 then p-1 else p-(univ.image c).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.ordinary_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordinary_count (c : ι → ZMod p) :

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeMass.beta
declarations.snippet:
def beta (c : ι → ZMod p) : ℝ :=
  (∑ v : ZMod p,(permitted c v).card : ℕ) / (p:ℝ)^2 / (1-1/(p:ℝ))^(Fintype.card ι)

declarations.snippet:
private theorem power_bound (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (x0 : 0 ≤ x) (x1 : x ≤ 1) :

declarations.name: Sun28.AuxiliaryPrimes.value
declarations.snippet: def value (bit : Bool) : ℤ := if bit then -1 else 1

declarations.name: Sun28.AuxiliaryPrimes.fresh_prime
declarations.snippet:
theorem fresh_prime (S : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime ∧ 3<p)
    (bits : ℕ → Bool) (special : Bool) (bound : ℕ) :
    ∃ q > bound, q.Prime ∧ 3 < q ∧ q ∉ S ∧ q % 12 = (if special then 7 else 1) ∧
      jacobiSym (-1) q = value special ∧ jacobiSym 3 q = value special ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, jacobiSym q p = value (bits p) ∧
        jacobiSym p q = (if special && decide (p % 4 = 3) then -value (bits p) else value (bits p)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AuxiliaryPrimes.extend_support
declarations.snippet:
theorem extend_support (S : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime ∧ 3<p)
    (k : ℕ) (kind : ℕ → Bool) (row : ℕ → List ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (bound : ℕ) :
    ∃ primes : List ℕ, primes.length=k ∧ primes.Nodup ∧
      (∀ q ∈ primes, bound < q ∧ q.Prime ∧ 3 < q ∧ q ∉ S) ∧
      ∀ i (hi : i < primes.length),
        let q := primes[i]
        let prev := primes.take i
        q % 12 = (if kind i then 7 else 1) ∧
        jacobiSym (-1) q = value (kind i) ∧ jacobiSym 3 q = value (kind i) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ S ∪ prev.toFinset, jacobiSym q p = value (row i prev p) ∧
          jacobiSym p q = (if kind i && decide (p%4=3) then -value (row i prev p) else value (row i prev p)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PointLifts.rightForm

declarations.name: Sun28.PointLifts.PositiveFibre

def PositiveFibre (b θ n m : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∃ U V : ℤ, U.natAbs.Coprime V.natAbs ∧ U^2-b*V^2≠0 ∧
    let F := leftForm b (n^2) (θ*m^2) U V
    let G := b*rightForm b (n^2) (θ*m^2) U V
    F=0 ∨ G=0 ∨ ∃ D u v : ℤ, 0<D ∧ Squarefree D ∧ D ∣ 2*b*θ*n*m ∧ F=D*u^2 ∧ G=D*v^2

declarations.name: Sun28.PointLifts.DivisorFibre
declarations.snippet:
def DivisorFibre (b θ n m : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∃ U V : ℤ, U.natAbs.Coprime V.natAbs ∧ U^2-b*V^2≠0 ∧
    let a := n^2
    let d := θ*m^2
    let F := leftForm b a d U V
    let G := b*rightForm b a d U V
    F=0 ∨ G=0 ∨ ∃ D u v : ℤ, Squarefree D ∧ D ∣ b*determinant b a d ∧ F=D*u^2 ∧ G=D*v^2

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.PublishedQuadricCount
declarations.snippet:
def PublishedQuadricCount : Prop :=
  ∀ κ : ℤ, κ≠0 → ∃ (H : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ→ℝ),0≤H ∧ (∀ q,good κ q→0≤ρ q) ∧
    ∀ (R : ℕ) (ψ : Point ℝ→ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      (∀ x,0≤ψ x) → (∀ x∈tsupport ψ, ‖x‖≤(R:ℝ)) →
      (∀ x∈tsupport ψ, (1:ℝ)≤gradSq (κ:ℝ) x) →
      ∃ σ : ℝ,0≤σ ∧ Tendsto (fun ε=>tubeMass (κ:ℝ) ε ψ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 σ) ∧
        ∃ D : ℝ,0≤D ∧ Estimate κ R ψ (H*σ) D ρ

      ∃ (σ : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ→ℝ),0≤σ ∧ σ≤ConeReal.rowConstant*ConeReal.width j ∧
        Estimate (gap pair.1 pair.2) 2 (ConeReal.weight j) (H*σ) D ρ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.UniformProducts
declarations.snippet:
def UniformProducts (A : Fin 3→ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ,0<c ∧ ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,∀ (p : ℕ) (g : ℕ→ℝ),
    LocalApproximation (threshold A) (shifts A).card 50 g →
    let P:=auxPrimes (threshold A) (smallLevel t) p
    (∀ q∈P,q.Prime ∧ q≠p ∧ q≤level t ∧ 0≤g q ∧ g q<1 ∧ 1+2*odds g q≤q) ∧
    (2*∑ q∈P,g q*Real.log q≤Real.log (level t)) ∧
    c*(growthBound A t:ℝ)^(shifts A).card≤∏ q∈P,(1+odds g q)

    (B : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (V : Classes) (good' : ∀ q∈s,good κ q) :
    S*(B:ℝ)^3*main ρ s V = S*(B:ℝ)^3*main localWeight s V := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.intersection_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem intersection_error {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (j t p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (i k : ↥(shifts A))
    (diff : i≠k) (large : threshold A<p) (hp : p≤level t) (narrow : 8*(maxCoefficient A+1)≤j+1)
    {S D ρ} (sn : 0≤S) (dn : 0≤D) (est : Estimate (gap i k) 2 (ConeReal.weight j) S D ρ)
    (u : Finset ℕ) (sub : u⊆auxPrimes (threshold A) (smallLevel t) p) (hm : modulus u≤(level t)^2) :
    let P:=auxPrimes (threshold A) (smallLevel t) p
    let F:=ConeReal.majorant j t p i k narrow
    |intersections F.support F.weight (badFactors i P) u -
      (S*(side t:ℝ)^3*factor localWeight p (residues p (gap i k)))*(∏ q∈u,density i k q)| ≤
        D*(2:ℝ)^(559*t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.leading_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem leading_bound {H Z σ c τ R B N a d g Q : ℝ}
    (hn : 0≤H) (hz : H≤Z) (sn : 0≤σ) (sb : σ≤R*τ) (rn : 0≤R)
    (bn : 0≤B) (vol : τ*B^3≤2*N) (an : 0≤a) (dp : 0<d) (ab : a≤16/d)
    (cp : 0<c) (gp : 0<g) (prod : c*g≤Q) :
    2*(H*σ*B^3*a)/Q≤(64*Z*R/c)*N/(d*g) := by

declarations.snippet:
def flagAt {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (i j : ↥(shifts A)) : Classes :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.density
declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet:
def classes {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Classes :=

    (q : ℕ) (hp:q.Prime) {x : Point (ZMod q)} (hx:x∈classes i j p q) :
    onCone (gap i j:ZMod q) x ∧ x≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.main_factors
declarations.snippet:
theorem main_factors {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (u : Finset ℕ) (out : p∉u) :
    main localWeight (insert p u) (classes i j p) =
    factor localWeight p (residues p (gap i j)) * ∏ q∈u,density i j q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.counted_flags
declarations.snippet:
theorem counted_flags {A : Fin 3→ℚ} (j t p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (i k : ↥(shifts A))
    (narrow : 8*(maxCoefficient A+1)≤j+1) (P u : Finset ℕ)
    (pr : ∀ q∈P,q.Prime) (out : p∉P) (sub : u⊆P) :
    let F:=ConeReal.majorant j t p i k narrow
    intersections F.support F.weight (badFactors i P) u =
      count (gap i k) 2 (side t) (ConeReal.weight j) (insert p u) (classes i k p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ConeCount.Estimate
declarations.snippet:
def Estimate (κ : ℤ) (R : ℕ) (ψ : Point ℝ→ℝ) (S D : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ→ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ B : ℕ, 0<B → ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ q∈s,good κ q) →
    ∀ V : Classes, (∀ q∈s,∀ x∈V q,Sun28.QuadricSieve.onCone (κ:ZMod q) x ∧ x≠0) →
    |count κ R B ψ s V - S*(B:ℝ)^3*main ρ s V| ≤ D*((B:ℝ)*modulus s)^(13/5:ℝ)

      ∑ w ∈ Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 (W/d),
        ∏ i : ↥(shifts A),primeWeight L L
          ((w.1:ℤ)+(offset (dilation A) i*(d:ℤ)^2)*(w.2:ℤ)^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Pair
declarations.snippet: abbrev Pair (m : ℕ) := ZMod m × ZMod m

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.primary
declarations.snippet:
def primary (z : Pair 16) : Bool :=
  z.1.val % 2 = 1 && z.2.val % 2 = 0 && (z.1.val+z.2.val)%4=1

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.turn
declarations.snippet:
def turn (j : Fin 4) (z : Pair 16) : Pair 16 :=
  match j.val with
  | 0 => z
  | 1 => (-z.2,z.1)
  | 2 => (-z.1,-z.2)
  | _ => (z.2,-z.1)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.conjPair
declarations.snippet: def conjPair {m : ℕ} (z : Pair m) : Pair m := (z.1,-z.2)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.pairNorm
declarations.snippet: def pairNorm {m : ℕ} (z : Pair m) := z.1^2+z.2^2

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.ratioPair
declarations.snippet:
def ratioPair {m : ℕ} (e : ℕ) (z : Pair m) : Pair m :=
  ((z.1^2-z.2^2)*(pairNorm z)^e,(2*z.1*z.2)*(pairNorm z)^e)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.primarySet
declarations.snippet: def primarySet : Finset (Pair 16) := univ.filter fun z => primary z

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.sevenUnits
declarations.snippet: def sevenUnits : Finset (Pair 7) := univ.filter fun z => pairNorm z ≠ 0

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.primary_normalization
declarations.snippet:
theorem primary_normalization : ∀ z : Pair 16, (pairNorm z).val%2=1 →
    ((univ : Finset (Fin 4)).filter fun j => primary (turn j z)).card=1 := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.base_inverse_powers
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_inverse_powers :
    (∀ z ∈ primarySet, (pairNorm z)^3 * pairNorm z=1) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ sevenUnits, (pairNorm z)^5 * pairNorm z=1) := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.base_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_orders :
    primarySet.card=32 ∧ sevenUnits.card=48 ∧
    (primarySet.image (ratioPair 3)).card=4 ∧ (sevenUnits.image (ratioPair 5)).card=8 := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.cmCoset
declarations.snippet:
def cmCoset {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (e : ℕ) (S : Finset (Pair m)) (w : Pair m) : Finset (Pair m) :=
  (S.image (ratioPair e)).image fun z => (z.1*w.1-z.2*w.2,z.1*w.2+z.2*w.1)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.baseCoset
declarations.snippet: def baseCoset := (cmCoset 3 primarySet (9,0)).product (cmCoset 5 sevenUnits (1,3))

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.base_coset_fraction
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_coset_fraction :
    baseRays ⊆ baseCoset ∧ baseRays.card=2 ∧ baseCoset.card=32 := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.squarefree_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem squarefree_product {L : ℕ} (large : 2≤L) (P : Finset ℕ)
    (primes : ∀ p∈P,p.Prime ∧ p≤L) :
    (∏ p∈P,(1+(p:ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ 2*(1+4*Real.log L) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.GR
declarations.snippet: abbrev GR (p : ℕ) := QuadraticAlgebra (ZMod p) (-1) 0

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.GU
declarations.snippet: abbrev GU (p : ℕ) := (GR p)ˣ

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.unitNorm
declarations.snippet: def unitNorm (p : ℕ) : GU p →* (ZMod p)ˣ := Units.map QuadraticAlgebra.norm

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.conjugate
declarations.snippet:
def conjugate (p : ℕ) : GU p →* GU p := Units.map
  (show GR p →* GR p from { toFun := star, map_one' := star_one _, map_mul' := fun x y => by simp })

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.norm_coordinates
declarations.snippet: theorem norm_coordinates {p : ℕ} (z : GR p) : z.norm=z.re^2+z.im^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.coords
declarations.snippet: def coords {p : ℕ} (z : GU p) : ZMod p × ZMod p := ((z:GR p).re,(z:GR p).im)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.unitOf
Sun28.RayDensity.val_unitOf
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem val_unitOf {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (x y : ZMod p) (nz : x^2+y^2≠0) :
    (unitOf x y nz : GR p)=⟨x,y⟩ := IsUnit.unit_spec _

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.normFibre
declarations.snippet: def normFibre (p : ℕ) (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) := {z : GU p // unitNorm p z = t}

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.fibreCoords
declarations.snippet:
def fibreCoords {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) : normFibre p t ≃ Circle p (t:ZMod p) where
  toFun z := ⟨coords z.1, by
    have h := congrArg Units.val z.2
    change (z.1 : GR p).norm = (t:ZMod p) at h
    exact (norm_coordinates _).symm.trans h⟩
  invFun z := ⟨unitOf z.1.1 z.1.2 (z.2.trans_ne t.ne_zero), by
    apply Units.ext
    change _root_.QuadraticAlgebra.norm (unitOf z.1.1 z.1.2 _ : GR p) = _
    simp only [val_unitOf,norm_coordinates]
    exact z.2⟩
  left_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    simp [coords]
  right_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [coords]

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.norm_surjective
declarations.snippet: theorem norm_surjective (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Function.Surjective (unitNorm p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.coboundary
declarations.snippet: def coboundary (p : ℕ) : GU p →* GU p := (MonoidHom.id _)/(conjugate p)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.range_coboundary
declarations.snippet:
theorem range_coboundary {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (odd : p≠2) :
    (coboundary p).range=(unitNorm p).ker := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.both
declarations.snippet: def both (q : ℕ) : ℝ := 1-4/((q:ℝ)-1)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.plusInv
declarations.snippet: def plusInv (q : ℕ) : ℝ := 1+(q:ℝ)⁻¹

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.local_logs
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_logs {p : ℕ} (big : 11≤p) : 0<both p ∧
    -(48/(p:ℝ)^2) ≤ Real.log (both p)+4*Real.log (plusInv p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.two_sign_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem two_sign_product {L : ℕ} (large : 2≤L) (P : Finset ℕ)
    (primes : ∀ p∈P,p.Prime ∧ 11≤p ∧ p≤L) :
    Real.exp (-48)/(2*(1+4*Real.log L))^4 ≤ ∏ p∈P,both p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.NormRow
declarations.snippet: abbrev NormRow (P : Finset ℕ) := (p:↥P)→(ZMod p.val)ˣ

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.eligible
declarations.snippet:
def eligible (P : Finset ℕ) (t : NormRow P) :=
  ↥baseRays × allowedFibre 3 1 × allowedFibre 5 1 × ((p:↥P)→allowedFibre p.val (t p))

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.total
declarations.snippet:
def total (P : Finset ℕ) (t : NormRow P) :=
  ↥baseCoset × normFibre 3 1 × normFibre 5 1 × ((p:↥P)→normFibre p.val (t p))

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.fraction
declarations.snippet:
def fraction (P : Finset ℕ) (t : NormRow P) : ℝ :=
    (Nat.card (eligible P t):ℝ)/Nat.card (total P t)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.exact_fraction
declarations.snippet:
theorem exact_fraction (t : NormRow P) :
    fraction P t=(1/64)*∏ p:↥P,survival p.val (t p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.k_row_fibres
declarations.snippet:
theorem k_row_fibres {L k : ℕ} (large : 2≤L)
    (primes : ∀ p∈P,p.Prime ∧ 11≤p ∧ p≤L) (t : Fin k → NormRow P) :
    (Real.exp (-48)/(64*(2*(1+4*Real.log L))^4))^k ≤ ∏ j:Fin k, fraction P (t j) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.admissible
declarations.snippet:
def admissible {p : ℕ} (z : GU p) : Prop :=
    ((1 : GR p)+(z:GR p)).norm ≠ 0 ∧ ((1 : GR p)-(z:GR p)).norm ≠ 0

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.allowedFibre
declarations.snippet: def allowedFibre (p : ℕ) (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) := {z : normFibre p t // admissible z.1}

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.safeCircle
declarations.snippet:
abbrev safeCircle (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) :=
    {z : Circle p t // z∉bad p t true ∪ bad p t false}

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.adjacent_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem adjacent_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) (z : normFibre p t) :
    admissible z.1 ↔ (fibreCoords t z)∉bad p _ true ∪ bad p _ false := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.allowedCoords
declarations.snippet:
def allowedCoords {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) : allowedFibre p t ≃ safeCircle p (t:ZMod p) :=
  Equiv.subtypeEquiv (fibreCoords t) (adjacent_iff t)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.survival
declarations.snippet: def survival (p : ℕ) (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) : ℝ := (Nat.card (allowedFibre p t):ℝ)/Nat.card (normFibre p t)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.survival_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem survival_eq {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    survival p t = (((bad p (t:ZMod p) true ∪ bad p (t:ZMod p) false)ᶜ.card : ℝ) /
        Fintype.card (Circle p (t:ZMod p))) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.survival_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem survival_lower {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 7≤p) (t : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    both p ≤ survival p t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.small_fibres
declarations.snippet:
theorem small_fibres :
    survival 3 1=1/2 ∧ survival 5 1=1/2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.primeTuple
Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.representative_character
declarations.snippet:
theorem representative_character {a b:ℤ} {p:ℕ} (N:a^2+b^2=(p:ℤ))
    (h:((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
    (unit:∀ i, (a:ZMod (q i))^2+(b:ZMod (q i))^2≠0)
    (cop32:p.Coprime 32) (cop:∀ i,p.Coprime (q i)) :
    rationalCharacter q (inl (primeTuple q a b h unit)) =
      (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p cop32,fun i=>ZMod.unitOfCoprime p (cop i)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.dyadic_frobenius
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_frobenius {a b:ℤ} {p:ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (N:a^2+b^2=(p:ℤ))
    (h:((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
    (K:Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {32} ℚ K]
    (Q:Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsMaximal] [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p:ℤ)})]
    (cop:p.Coprime 32) {σ:Gal(K/ℚ)} (fr:IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) :
    galEquivZMod 32 K σ=dyadicNorm ⟨((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16)),h⟩ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.odd_frobenius
declarations.snippet:
theorem odd_frobenius {a b:ℤ} {p:ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (N:a^2+b^2=(p:ℤ))
    (h:((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
    (cop32:p.Coprime 32) (cop:∀ i,p.Coprime (q i))
    (i:I) (K:Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {q i} ℚ K]
    (Q:Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsMaximal] [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p:ℤ)})]
    {σ:Gal(K/ℚ)} (fr:IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) :
    ∃ unit:∀ j, (a:ZMod (q j))^2+(b:ZMod (q j))^2≠0,
      (rationalCharacter q (inl (primeTuple q a b h unit))).2 i=galEquivZMod (q i) K σ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.Residues
declarations.snippet: abbrev Residues := (ZMod 32)ˣ × ((i:I)→(ZMod (q i))ˣ)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.RayUnits
declarations.snippet: abbrev RayUnits := Primary × ((i:I)→GU (q i))

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.rayAction
declarations.snippet: abbrev rayAction := act (joinedAut q dyadicConj) (joined_involution q dyadicConj dyadic_involution)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.RayGroup
declarations.snippet: abbrev RayGroup := SemidirectProduct (RayUnits q) C₂ (rayAction q)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.residueNorm
declarations.snippet:
def residueNorm : RayUnits q →* Residues q where
  toFun a := (dyadicNorm a.1,fun i=>unitNorm (q i) (a.2 i))
  map_one' := by ext <;> simp
  map_mul' x y := by apply Prod.ext; exact map_mul _ _ _; exact funext (fun _=>map_mul _ _ _)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.residueNorm_fixed
declarations.snippet:
theorem residueNorm_fixed (c : C₂) (a:RayUnits q) :
    residueNorm q (rayAction q c a)=residueNorm q a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.signUnit
declarations.snippet:
def signUnit (m:ℕ) : C₂→* (ZMod m)ˣ where
  toFun c := if c=1 then 1 else -1
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' a b := by
    have n : flip≠1 := by decide
    have e : flip*flip=1 := by decide
    rcases two_cases a with rfl|rfl <;> rcases two_cases b with rfl|rfl <;> simp [n,e]

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.signTuple
declarations.snippet:
def signTuple : C₂→* Residues q where
  toFun c := (signUnit 32 c, fun i=>signUnit (q i) c)
  map_one' := by apply Prod.ext; exact map_one _; exact funext (fun _=>map_one _)
  map_mul' a b := by apply Prod.ext; exact map_mul _ _ _; exact funext (fun _=>map_mul _ _ _)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.rationalCharacter
declarations.snippet:
def rationalCharacter : RayGroup q →* Residues q where
  toFun g := residueNorm q g.left * signTuple q g.right
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' a b := by
    change residueNorm q (a.left*(rayAction q a.right) b.left) *
       signTuple q (a.right*b.right) = _ * _
    rw [map_mul,map_mul,residueNorm_fixed]
    ac_rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.character_on_even
declarations.snippet: theorem character_on_even (a:RayUnits q) : rationalCharacter q (inl a)=residueNorm q a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.character_on_conjugation
declarations.snippet:
theorem character_on_conjugation : rationalCharacter q (inr flip)=
    ((-1:(ZMod 32)ˣ),fun i=>(-1:(ZMod (q i))ˣ)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.orientation
declarations.snippet: theorem orientation (u:(ZMod 32)ˣ) : (u:ZMod 32).val%4=1 ∨ (-(u:ZMod 32)).val%4=1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.rational_surjective
declarations.snippet: theorem rational_surjective : Function.Surjective (rationalCharacter q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.rational_kernel
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_kernel (odd:∀i,q i≠2) :
    (rationalCharacter q).ker=commutator (RayGroup q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.rationalAbelianization
Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.galois_frobenius
declarations.snippet:
theorem galois_frobenius {n p:ℕ} [NeZero n] [Fact p.Prime]
    (K:Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K]
    (Q:Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsMaximal] [overP:Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p:ℤ)})]
    (cop:p.Coprime n) {σ:Gal(K/ℚ)} (fr:IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) :
    galEquivZMod n K σ = ZMod.unitOfCoprime p cop := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.explicit_frobenius
declarations.snippet:
theorem explicit_frobenius {n p:ℕ} [NeZero n] [Fact p.Prime]
    (K:Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K]
    (Q:Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsMaximal] [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p:ℤ)})]
    (cop:p.Coprime n) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(K/ℚ), IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q ∧ galEquivZMod n K σ = ZMod.unitOfCoprime p cop := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.times
declarations.snippet:
def times {m : ℕ} (z w : Pair m) : Pair m :=
  (z.1*w.1-z.2*w.2,z.1*w.2+z.2*w.1)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.norm32
declarations.snippet: def norm32 (z : Pair 16) : ZMod 32 := (z.1.val:ZMod 32)^2+(z.2.val:ZMod 32)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.inverse16
declarations.snippet:
def inverse16 (z : Pair 16) : Pair 16 :=
  (z.1*(pairNorm z)^3,-z.2*(pairNorm z)^3)

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.primary_operations
declarations.snippet:
theorem primary_operations :
    (1,0) ∈ primarySet ∧ (∀ a∈primarySet, conjPair a ∈ primarySet) ∧
    (∀ a∈primarySet, inverse16 a ∈ primarySet ∧ times (inverse16 a) a = (1,0)) ∧
    (∀ a∈primarySet, ∀ b∈primarySet, times a b ∈ primarySet) := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.dyadic_tables
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_tables :
    primarySet.image norm32 = univ.filter (fun r:ZMod 32=>r.val % 4=1) ∧
    primarySet.image (ratioPair 3) = primarySet.filter (fun z=>norm32 z=1) ∧
    (∀ a∈primarySet, norm32 (conjPair a)=norm32 a ∧ (norm32 a)^8=1) ∧
    (∀ a∈primarySet, times a (inverse16 (conjPair a))=ratioPair 3 a) := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.even_square_lift
declarations.snippet:
theorem even_square_lift : ∀ s:ZMod 32,
    (((ZMod.castHom (by decide : 16∣32) (ZMod 16) s).val:ℕ):ZMod 32)^2=s^2 := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.norm32_integer
declarations.snippet:
theorem norm32_integer (a b:ℤ) :
    norm32 ((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16))=((a^2+b^2:ℤ):ZMod 32) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.norm32_times
declarations.snippet: theorem norm32_times (a b:Pair 16) : norm32 (times a b) = norm32 a * norm32 b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.base_coset_is_norm_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem base_coset_is_norm_fibre :
    cmCoset 3 primarySet (9,0) = primarySet.filter (fun z=>norm32 z=17) ∧
    cmCoset 5 sevenUnits (1,3) = sevenUnits.filter (fun z=>pairNorm z=3) := by decide

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.gaussian_prime_of_norm
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussian_prime_of_norm {z:GaussianInt} {p:ℕ} (hp:p.Prime)
    (N:z.norm.natAbs=p) : Prime z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RayDensity.Artin.gaussianResidue
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def gaussianResidue {z:GaussianInt} {p:ℕ} (hp:p.Prime) (N:z.norm.natAbs=p) :
    GaussianInt ⧸ Ideal.span {z} ≃+* ZMod p := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have norm : z.re^2+z.im^2=(p:ℤ) := by
    have e:=congrArg ((↑):ℕ→ℤ) N
    rw [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (GaussianInt.norm_nonneg _)] at e
    simpa [Zsqrtd.norm,sq] using e
  have znorm : (z.re:ZMod p)^2+(z.im:ZMod p)^2=0 := by
    have e:=congrArg (fun x:ℤ=>(x:ZMod p)) norm
    simpa only [Int.cast_add,Int.cast_pow,Int.cast_natCast,ZMod.natCast_self] using e
  have nonzero : (z.im:ZMod p)≠0 := by
    intro hy
    have hx : (z.re:ZMod p)=0 := by simpa [hy] using znorm
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩:=(ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).1 hx
    obtain ⟨t,ht⟩:=(ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).1 hy
    have factor : (p:ℤ)*((p:ℤ)*(s^2+t^2))=(p:ℤ)*1 := by
      rw [hs,ht] at norm
      linear_combination norm
    have pp : (p:ℤ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
    have dvd : (p:ℤ)∣1 := ⟨s^2+t^2,mul_left_cancel₀ pp factor |>.symm⟩
    exact hp.not_dvd_one (by exact_mod_cast dvd)
  let r : ZMod p := -(z.re:ZMod p)/(z.im:ZMod p)
  have root : r*r=(-1:ℤ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp
    linear_combination znorm
  let ev : GaussianInt →+* ZMod p := Zsqrtd.lift ⟨r,root⟩
  have ez : ev z=0 := by
    change (z.re:ZMod p)+(z.im:ZMod p)*r=0
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp
    ring
  have maximal : (Ideal.span {z}).IsMaximal := PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible (gaussian_prime_of_norm hp N).irreducible
  have hle : Ideal.span {z} ≤ RingHom.ker ev :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 ez
  have eq : Ideal.span {z} = RingHom.ker ev := by
    exact maximal.eq_of_le (RingHom.ker_ne_top ev) hle
  have surjective : Function.Surjective ev := fun a=>⟨(a.val:GaussianInt),by
    rw [map_natCast,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]⟩

def PairCorrectedInputs : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q:ℤ) (n:Fin 4→ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀d:ℕ,0<d → ∀B:ℕ,∃K≥B,∀(m:ℕ)(D:ℝ),∃(L:ℕ)(δ:ℝ),
      max K m≤L ∧ 0<δ ∧ D<δ*((L:ℝ)*Real.log L) ∧
      ∀J:ℕ,∃j≥J,∃ᶠ t:ℕ in atTop,
        let A:=Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n
        let N:=lengthAt t
        let W:=rowWidth j N
        let Z:=(N:ℝ)*W
        let M:=patternMass A d K K N W-∑p∈places K L,onePlaceMass A d K N W p
        δ*Z≤M ∨ ∃p∈places K L,∃q∈places K L,p≠q ∧
            δ*Z≤M+moment A d K N W (fun z=>signedHit A p z ∧ signedHit A q z)

def InteriorModel : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Finset ℤ) (d : ℕ), 0<d → 0∈c → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧
    ∀ (η : ℝ), 0<η → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0<ε → ∃ V : ℕ, 0<V ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      let N:=lengthAt t
      let W:=rowWidth j N
      let n:=N/V
      let M:=W/(V*d)
      ∃ hn : 0<n, letI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
        ∀ b∈units V, ∀ f : ZMod n→ℝ,
        (∀ x, 0≤f x ∧ f x ≤ (V.totient:ℝ)/V*(if (b+V*x.val).Prime then Real.log (b+V*x.val:ℕ) else 0)) →
        η*n ≤ ∑ x,f x → ∃ g : ZMod n→ℝ, (∀ x,0≤g x ∧ g x≤C) ∧ (η/2)*n ≤ ∑ x,g x ∧
        ∀ D⊆c, ∀ h∈c, h∉D →
          singleError c D h f g ((V*d^2:ℕ):ZMod n) M ≤ ε*((n:ℝ)*M)

def singleError (c D : Finset ℤ) (h : ℤ) (f g : ZMod n → ℝ) (H : ZMod n) (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ (Icc 1 M ×ˢ (univ : Finset (ZMod n))),

      ∏ i ∈ c.erase h,(if i∈D then g else f) (atShift i)

    ∃ V : ℕ, 0<V ∧ ∃ I : ℕ, ∀ j≥I, ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      let N:=lengthAt t

        N*W ≤ 4*V^2*d*(n*M) ∧ ∀ b∈units V, ∀ f : ZMod n→ℝ,

          η*n ≤ ∑ x,f x → ∃ g : ZMod n→ℝ, (∀ x,0≤g x ∧ g x≤C) ∧ (η/2)*n ≤ ∑ x,g x ∧
          ∀ D ⊆ c, ∀ h∈c, h∉D →
