    (K Y H d : ℕ) (dp : 0 < d) :
    ∃ u w : ℕ, 0 < w ∧ d∣w ∧ H*((dilation A)*w)^2 < u ∧
      ∀ i : ↥(shifts A), ∃ p > Y, (p:ℤ)=form A (u,w) i ∧ commonPrime K K p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.freeze_with_row_threshold
declarations.snippet:
theorem freeze_with_row_threshold (P : ℕ→ℕ→ℕ→Prop) (V : ℕ→ℕ) (vp : ∀ w,0<V w)
    (along : ∃ H : ℕ→ℕ→ℕ, ∀ j : ℕ→ℕ, ∀ T : ℕ→ℕ, Tendsto T atTop atTop →
      (∀ w,H w (j w) ≤ T w) → ∃ w,P (V w) (j w) (T w)) :
    ∃ v,0<v ∧ ∀j,∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,P v j t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.PublishedRecurrence
declarations.snippet:
def PublishedRecurrence : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Finset ℤ) (s : ℕ), 0 < s → 0∈c → ∃ B : ℕ, 0 < B ∧ Recurrent c s B

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.hasWindow
declarations.snippet:
def hasWindow (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K N W V s B : ℕ) (a ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (b M : ℕ) (f g : ZMod n → ℝ),
    0 < V ∧ V*d*M ≤ W ∧ 2*B ≤ M ∧
    (∀ h∈coefficients A, 4*(V*d^2*h.natAbs*M^2) ≤ n) ∧
    N*W ≤ 4*V^2*d*(n*M) ∧
    (∀ x, 0≤f x ∧ f x ≤ window K b V N x) ∧
    (∀ x, 0≤g x ∧ g x ≤ a*s) ∧ 2*a*n ≤ ∑ x, g x ∧
    ∀ D ⊆ coefficients A, ∀ h∈coefficients A, h∉D →
      singleError (coefficients A) D h f g ((V*d^2:ℕ):ZMod n) M ≤ ε*((n:ℝ)*M)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.FixedClassModelInputs
declarations.snippet:
def FixedClassModelInputs : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K : ℕ), 0<d → ∃ (a : ℝ) (s : ℕ), 0<a ∧ 0<s ∧
    ∀ (B : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0<ε → ∃ V : ℕ, ∃ I : ℕ, ∀ j≥I, ∃ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      hasWindow A d K (lengthAt t) (rowWidth j (lengthAt t)) V s B a ε

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.RelativeUpperInputs
declarations.snippet: def RelativeUpperInputs : Prop := ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n → ∀ d : ℕ, 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.gain
declarations.snippet: def gain (c : Finset ℤ) (s B : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ℝ := a^c.card/(4*s*B^3)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.window_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem window_lower (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {d K N W V s B : ℕ} {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0<a)
    (hs : 0<s) (hb : 0<B) (dp : 0<d) (grid : Recurrent (coefficients A) s B)
    (err : (coefficients A).card*ε ≤ gain (coefficients A) s B a/2)
    (win : hasWindow A d K N W V s B a ε) :
    gain (coefficients A) s B a/(2*(4*(V:ℝ)^2*d))*((N:ℝ)*W) ≤ patternMass A d K K N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.hybrid_inputs_of_transfer
declarations.snippet:
theorem hybrid_inputs_of_transfer (grid : PublishedRecurrence) (transfer : FixedClassModelInputs)
    (upper : RelativeUpperInputs) : HybridInputs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.circleMass
Sun28.PrimeTransfer.denseLevel
declarations.snippet: def denseLevel (g : ZMod n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) := univ.filter fun x => a ≤ g x

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.level_density
declarations.snippet:
theorem level_density (g : ZMod n → ℝ) {a C : ℝ} {s : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (bound : ∀ x, g x ≤ C) (density : 2*a*n ≤ ∑ x, g x) (hs : C ≤ a*s) :
    n ≤ s * (denseLevel g a).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.bounded_grid_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem bounded_grid_lower (c : Finset ℤ) (g : ZMod n → ℝ) (H : ZMod n)
    {a C : ℝ} {s B W : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (gpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (bound : ∀ x, g x ≤ C) (density : 2*a*n ≤ ∑ x, g x) (hs : C ≤ a*s)
    (hB : 0 < B) (recurs : Recurrent c s B) (width : 2*B ≤ W) :
    a^c.card * (n:ℝ)*W ≤ (4*s*B^3 : ℕ) * circleMass c g H W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeTransfer.window_geometry
declarations.snippet:
theorem window_geometry (c : Finset ℤ) {N W V d B : ℕ} (vp : 0<V) (dp : 0<d)
    (space : 2*V ≤ N) (steps : (2*B+2)*(V*d) ≤ W)
    (narrow : ∀ h∈c, 8*h.natAbs*W^2 ≤ N) :
    let n:=N/V
    let M:=W/(V*d)
    0<n ∧ V*d*M ≤ W ∧ 2*B ≤ M ∧
      (∀ h∈c,4*(V*d^2*h.natAbs*M^2) ≤ n) ∧ N*W ≤ 4*V^2*d*(n*M) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.split_diagonal
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_diagonal {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (split : p%4=1) :
    (bad p (-1) true ∩ bad p (-1) false).card=2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.split_diagonal_rate
declarations.snippet:
theorem split_diagonal_rate {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (split : p%4=1) :
    (((bad p (-1) true ∩ bad p (-1) false).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card (Circle p (-1))) =
      2/((p:ℝ)-1) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.exceeds_square_rate
declarations.snippet:
theorem exceeds_square_rate {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (split : p%4=1) (large : 703≤p) :
    1404/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 <
      (((bad p (-1) true ∩ bad p (-1) false).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card (Circle p (-1))) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.fromOrientation
declarations.snippet:
private def fromOrientation {L p : ℕ} (h : Bool × Oriented L p) : Unoriented L p :=
  match h with
  | (false,⟨J,n,a⟩) => ⟨J,n,(class_of_opposite J).2 (Or.inl a)⟩
  | (true,⟨J,n,a⟩) => ⟨opposite J,(opposite_data J).2.1.trans n,
      (class_of_opposite _).2 (Or.inr ((opposite_twice J).symm ▸ a))⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.opposite_distinct
declarations.snippet:
private theorem opposite_distinct {L : ℕ} {J K:Ideals L}
    (a:admissible L (word J)) (b:admissible L (word K)) : J≠opposite K := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.conjugatePair
declarations.snippet:
def conjugatePair (L p : ℕ) : Bool × Oriented L p ≃ Unoriented L p := by
  apply Equiv.ofBijective fromOrientation
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u,⟨J,n,a⟩⟩ ⟨v,⟨K,m,b⟩⟩
    cases u <;> cases v <;> intro e
    · have h : J=K := congrArg Subtype.val e
      cases h
      rfl
    · exact False.elim (opposite_distinct a b (congrArg Subtype.val e))
    · exact False.elim (opposite_distinct b a (congrArg Subtype.val e.symm))
    · have h : opposite J=opposite K := congrArg Subtype.val e
      have j : J=K := by simpa only [opposite_twice] using congrArg opposite h
      cases j
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨J,n,c⟩
    rcases (class_of_opposite J).1 c with a|b
    · exact ⟨(false,⟨J,n,a⟩),rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨(true,⟨opposite J,(opposite_data J).2.1.trans n,b⟩),Subtype.ext (opposite_twice _)⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.oriented_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem oriented_card {L p : ℕ} (hp:p.Prime) (above:L<p) (away:p≠7) :
    Nat.card (Oriented L p) = if commonPrime L L p then 1 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.unoriented_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem unoriented_card {L p : ℕ} (hp:p.Prime) (above:L<p) (away:p≠7) :
    Nat.card (Unoriented L p) = if commonPrime L L p then 2 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.idealTuples
declarations.snippet:
def idealTuples (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (L : ℕ) (q : ℕ×ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i : ↥(shifts A), if (form A q i).toNat.Prime then Nat.card (Unoriented L (form A q i).toNat) else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.tuple_multiplicity
declarations.snippet:
theorem tuple_multiplicity {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {L : ℕ} {q : ℕ×ℕ}
    (large : ∀ i : ↥(shifts A),max L 7 < (form A q i).toNat) :
    idealTuples A L q = if ∀ i : ↥(shifts A),0 ≤ form A q i ∧ commonPrime L L (form A q i).toNat
      then 2^(shifts A).card else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.integer_box_multiplicity
declarations.snippet:
theorem integer_box_multiplicity {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d L N W : ℕ}
    (large : ∀ q ∈ Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W,∀ i : ↥(shifts A),max L 7 < (form A q i).toNat) :
    (∑ q ∈ (Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun q : ℕ×ℕ=>d∣q.2),idealTuples A L q)
      = 2^(shifts A).card * count A d L N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.Ideals
declarations.snippet: abbrev Ideals (L : ℕ) := coprimeIdeals (M (moduli L))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.word
declarations.snippet:
abbrev word {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) :=
  idealCoordinates (moduli L) (level_coprime L) (J : idealRay (moduli L))

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.norm
declarations.snippet: abbrev norm {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) := Nat.card (GaussianInt ⧸ J.val)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.opposite
declarations.snippet:
def opposite {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) : Ideals L :=
  (conjugate_data (moduli L) (level_coprime L) J).choose

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.opposite_data
declarations.snippet:
theorem opposite_data {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) :
    (opposite J).val = J.val.map conjugateRing ∧ norm (opposite J) = norm J ∧
      word (opposite J) = conjugateCoordinate L (word J) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.opposite_twice
declarations.snippet: theorem opposite_twice {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) : opposite (opposite J) = J := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.Oriented
declarations.snippet: def Oriented (L p : ℕ) := {J : Ideals L // norm J=p ∧ admissible L (word J)}

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.Unoriented
declarations.snippet: def Unoriented (L p : ℕ) := {J : Ideals L // norm J=p ∧ acceptedClass L (word J)}

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.oriented_subsingleton
declarations.snippet: theorem oriented_subsingleton {L p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Subsingleton (Oriented L p) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.disjoint_conjugates
declarations.snippet:
theorem disjoint_conjugates {L : ℕ} {w : RayUnits (moduli L)} (h : admissible L w) :
    ¬admissible L (conjugateCoordinate L w) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.class_of_opposite
declarations.snippet:
theorem class_of_opposite {L : ℕ} (J : Ideals L) :
    acceptedClass L (word J) ↔ admissible L (word J) ∨ admissible L (word (opposite J)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.classCount
declarations.snippet:
def classCount (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d L N W : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ z ∈ (Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun z : ℕ×ℕ=>d∣z.2),idealTuples A L z

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.eventual_class_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem eventual_class_count (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d L : ℕ) :
    ∃ I : ℕ, ∀ j≥I, ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      let N:=lengthAt t
      let W:=rowWidth j N
      classCount A d L N W=2^(shifts A).card*count A d L N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.classRows
declarations.snippet:
def classRows (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ J:ℕ, ∃j≥J, ∃ᶠ t:ℕ in atTop,
    let N:=lengthAt t
    let W:=rowWidth j N
    (2:ℝ)^(shifts A).card*(δ*((N:ℝ)*W)/(Real.log N)^(shifts A).card) ≤
      (classCount A d L N W:ℝ)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.rows_iff_classes
declarations.snippet:
theorem rows_iff_classes (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    rows A d L δ ↔ classRows A d L δ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.localPairRate
Sun28.PrimeValues.local_rate_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_rate_bound (A : Fin 3→ℚ) {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (big : 26≤p) :
    localPairRate A p ≤ 1404/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.calibratedUpper
declarations.snippet:
def calibratedUpper (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K j p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ,0<ε → ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
    let N:=lengthAt t
    let W:=rowWidth j N
    upperMoment A d K p N W ≤ localPairRate A p * patternMass A d K K N W + ε*((N:ℝ)*W)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.relative_of_calibrated
declarations.snippet:
theorem relative_of_calibrated {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d K j p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (big : 26≤p)
    (H:calibratedUpper A d K j p) : relativeUpper A d K j p := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.relativeUpper
declarations.snippet:
def relativeUpper (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K j p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
    let N := lengthAt t
    let W := rowWidth j N
    upperMoment A d K p N W ≤
      (1404/((p:ℝ)-1)^2)*patternMass A d K K N W + ε*((N:ℝ)*W)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.firstMomentRows
declarations.snippet: def firstMomentRows (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ J : ℕ, ∃ j ≥ J, (∃ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, let N:=lengthAt t; let W:=rowWidth j N α*((N:ℝ)*W) ≤ patternMass A d K K N W) ∧ ∀p : ℕ,p.Prime → K

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.hybrid_rows_of_moments
Sun28.PrimeValues.FirstMomentInputs
declarations.snippet:
def FirstMomentInputs : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ d : ℕ, 0<d → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ (K : ℕ) (α : ℝ),B≤K ∧ 0<α ∧
      firstMomentRows (Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n) d K α

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.hybrid_inputs_of_moments
declarations.snippet: theorem hybrid_inputs_of_moments (inps:FirstMomentInputs) : HybridInputs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.surplus_of_moments
declarations.snippet: theorem surplus_of_moments (inps:FirstMomentInputs) (upper:PrimeUpperInputs) : PositiveSurplus :=

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.fibrePairs
declarations.snippet:
def fibrePairs (c : ι→F p) (u w:F p) : ℝ :=
  if ∀i,norms c u w i≠0 then ∑ij : ι×ι,pairMass (norms c u w) ij.1 ij.2 else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.averagePairs
declarations.snippet:
def averagePairs (c:ι→F p) : ℝ :=
  (∑ w : F p,∑ u : F p,fibrePairs c u w)/((p:ℝ)^2)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.fibre_point_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_point_bound (hp : 2<p) (c : ι→F p) (u w : F p) :
    fibrePairs c u w ≤ ∑ ij : ι×ι,
      ((2/((p:ℝ)-1))^2 + (if ij.1=ij.2 ∧ norms c u w ij.1= -1 then 2/((p:ℝ)-1) else 0)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.averaged_pairs
declarations.snippet:
theorem averaged_pairs (hp : 2<p) (c : ι→F p) :
    averagePairs c ≤ (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)^2*(2/((p:ℝ)-1))^2
      + (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(2/((p:ℝ)-1))/(p:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.relative_pair_rate
declarations.snippet:
theorem relative_pair_rate (hp : 26≤p) (hk : Fintype.card ι≤13) (c : ι→F p) :
    averagePairs c/unitRate c ≤ 1404/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.parameterBox
declarations.snippet:
abbrev parameterBox (d N W : ℕ) :=
  (Ioc (N/2) N ×ˢ Icc 1 W).filter (fun z : ℕ×ℕ => d∣z.2)

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.splitEvent
declarations.snippet:
def splitEvent (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (p : ℕ) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (z : ℕ×ℕ) : Prop :=
  (p:ℤ) ∣ signedOrder (form A z i).toNat true ∧ (p:ℤ) ∣ signedOrder (form A z j).toNat false

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.inertEvent
declarations.snippet: def inertEvent (p : ℕ) (z : ℕ×ℕ) : Prop := (z.1 : ZMod p)=1 ∧ (z.2 : ZMod p)=0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.obstruction
declarations.snippet:
def obstruction (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (p : ℕ) (z : ℕ×ℕ) : Prop :=
  if p%4=3 then inertEvent p z else ∃ i j : ↥(shifts A),splitEvent A p i j z

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.live_test
declarations.snippet:
theorem live_test {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {K L : ℕ} {z : ℕ×ℕ} (live:patternWeight A K K z≠0) :
    extraTest A K L z ↔ ∀p∈places K L,¬obstruction A p z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.moment
declarations.snippet:
def moment (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K N W : ℕ) (P : ℕ×ℕ → Prop) : ℝ :=
  ∑ z ∈ parameterBox d N W, if P z then patternWeight A K K z else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.base_nonneg
declarations.snippet: theorem base_nonneg (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (K : ℕ) (z : ℕ×ℕ) : 0 ≤ patternWeight A K K z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.hybrid_filter
declarations.snippet:
theorem hybrid_filter (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L N W : ℕ) :
    hybridMass A d K L N W = moment A d K N W (fun z=>∀p∈places K L,¬obstruction A p z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.upperMoment
Sun28.PrimeValues.moment_nonneg
declarations.snippet:
theorem moment_nonneg (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K N W : ℕ) (P : ℕ×ℕ→Prop) :
    0 ≤ moment A d K N W P := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.union_moment
Sun28.PrimeValues.single_le_upper
declarations.snippet:
theorem single_le_upper (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K p N W : ℕ) :
    moment A d K N W (obstruction A p) ≤ upperMoment A d K p N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.finite_moments
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_moments (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L N W : ℕ) :
    patternMass A d K K N W - ∑ p∈places K L, upperMoment A d K p N W ≤ hybridMass A d K L N W := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeValues.finite_retention
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_retention {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d K L N W : ℕ} (large : 2810≤K)
    {α ε : ℝ} (low : α*((N:ℝ)*W) ≤ patternMass A d K K N W)
    (bounds : ∀p∈places K L, upperMoment A d K p N W ≤
      (1404/((p:ℝ)-1)^2)*patternMass A d K K N W + ε*((N:ℝ)*W))
    (slack : ((places K L).card:ℝ)*ε≤α/4) :
    (α/4)*((N:ℝ)*W) ≤ hybridMass A d K L N W := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AffineIntervals.interval_mass_gap
declarations.snippet:
theorem interval_mass_gap {h k b J : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (small : b < h) (whole : b<1 → b=0) (length : J=h*k+b) :
    let A := h*k^2/J^2
    let S := (h*k^2+(2*k+1)*b)/J^2
    0 ≤ A ∧ A≤S ∧ S≤1 ∧ A≤1/h ∧ 1/h≤1 ∧ S-A≤2/J ∧ 1/h-A≤2/J := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AffineIntervals.power_mass_gap
declarations.snippet:
theorem power_mass_gap {A S d : ℝ} (ha : 0≤A) (hs : S≤1) (as' : A≤S) (delta : S-A≤d) (a : ℕ) :
    S^a-A^a≤a*d := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AffineIntervals.normalized_cube_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem normalized_cube_error {A S H J E M B T Z : ℝ} (a:ℕ) (ep:0<E) (jp:0<J)
    (ha:0≤A) (s:S≤1) (as':A≤S) (h:H≤1) (ah:A≤H) (ds:S-A≤2/J) (dh:H-A≤2/J)
    (mn:0≤M) (box:|B|≤M) (truncated:|T|≤(S^a-A^a)*M)
    (split:E*Z=A^a*B+T) : |Z-H^a*B/E| ≤ 4*a*M/(E*J) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AffineIntervals.uneven_intervals
declarations.snippet:
theorem uneven_intervals {h k b J : ℕ} (hp : 0<h) (kp : 0<k) (small : b<h)
    (length : J=h*k+b) {E M B T Z : ℝ} (a : ℕ) (ep:0<E) (mn:0≤M) (box:|B|≤M)
    (truncated : |T| ≤ (((h:ℝ)*k^2+(2*k+1)*b)/J^2)^a*M - (((h:ℝ)*k^2/J^2)^a)*M)
    (split : E*Z=(((h:ℝ)*k^2/J^2)^a)*B+T) :
    |Z-(1/(h:ℝ))^a*B/E| ≤ 4*a*M/(E*J) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.AffineIntervals.aligned_localized_average
declarations.snippet:
theorem aligned_localized_average {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)] (hE : 0<E)
    (q k a : ℕ) (hk : 0<k) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    let h := E/E.gcd q
    boxAverage (E*n) q (List.replicate a (h*k)) (extend E n t F) =
      (1/(E:ℝ))*(1/(h:ℝ))^a*boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) (List.replicate a k) F := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.boxSum
declarations.snippet:
def boxSum (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q : ℕ) : List ℕ → (ZMod n → ℝ) → ℝ
  | [], F => ∑ x : ZMod n, F x
  | J::Js, F => ∑ i ∈ range J, ∑ j ∈ range J, boxSum n q Js
      (fun x => F x * F (x+((q:ℤ)*((i:ℤ)-j):ℤ)))

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.boxSum_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem boxSum_zero (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q : ℕ) (Js : List ℕ) :
    boxSum n q Js 0 = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.sum_extend
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_extend {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)] (hE : 0<E)
    (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    ∑ y : ZMod (E*n), extend E n t F y = ∑ x : ZMod n, F x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.branches
declarations.snippet:
def branches (h : ℕ) : (a : ℕ) → ((Fin a → Fin h) → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, K => K Fin.elim0
  | a+1, K => ∑ r : Fin h, branches h a (fun rs => K (Fin.cons r rs))

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.branches_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem branches_sum (h a : ℕ) (K : (Fin a → Fin h) → ℝ) :
    branches h a K = ∑ rs : Fin a → Fin h, K rs := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.branches_comm
declarations.snippet:
theorem branches_comm (h a J : ℕ) (K : ℕ → (Fin a → Fin h) → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ range J, branches h a (K i)) =
      branches h a (fun rs => ∑ i ∈ range J, K i rs) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.localized_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem localized_sum {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)]
    (hE : 0<E) (q J a : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    boxSum (E*n) q (List.replicate a J) (extend E n t F) =
      branches (E/E.gcd q) a (fun rs => boxSum n (q/E.gcd q)
        (List.ofFn (fun i => lengthAt J (E/E.gcd q) (rs i))) F) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.dilation
declarations.snippet:
def dilation (E n : ℕ) : ZMod n →+ ZMod (E*n) :=
  ZMod.lift n ⟨(E : ℕ) • Int.castAddHom (ZMod (E*n)), by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, Int.coe_castAddHom, Int.cast_natCast, nsmul_eq_mul]
    simpa only [← Nat.cast_mul] using ZMod.natCast_self (E*n)⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.dilation_int
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem dilation_int (E n : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    dilation E n (x : ZMod n) = (E*x : ℤ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.dilation_injective
declarations.snippet:
theorem dilation_injective {E : ℕ} (hE : 0 < E) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (dilation E n) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.affine
declarations.snippet: def affine (E n : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (x : ZMod n) : ZMod (E*n) := t + dilation E n x

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.affine_injective
declarations.snippet:
theorem affine_injective {E : ℕ} (hE : 0 < E) (n : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) :
    Function.Injective (affine E n t) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.extend
declarations.snippet:
def extend (E n : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) : ZMod (E*n) → ℝ :=
  Function.extend (affine E n t) F 0

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.extend_affine
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem extend_affine {E : ℕ} (hE : 0 < E) (n : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n))
    (F : ZMod n → ℝ) (x : ZMod n) : extend E n t F (affine E n t x) = F x :=

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.extend_eq_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem extend_eq_zero {E n : ℕ} {t : ZMod (E*n)} {F : ZMod n → ℝ} {y : ZMod (E*n)}
    (out : y ∉ Set.range (affine E n t)) : extend E n t F y = 0 :=

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.same_residue
declarations.snippet:
theorem same_residue {E : ℕ} (hE : 0<E) (q i j : ℕ) :
    q*i ≡ q*j [MOD E] ↔ i % (E/E.gcd q) = j % (E/E.gcd q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.cast_zero_step
declarations.snippet:
theorem cast_zero_step {E : ℕ} (hE : 0<E) (q i j : ℕ) :
    ((q:ZMod E)*((i:ZMod E)-j) = 0) ↔ i%(E/E.gcd q) = j%(E/E.gcd q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.step_formula
declarations.snippet:
theorem step_formula (E : ℕ) (q i j : ℕ)
    (same : i%(E/E.gcd q)=j%(E/E.gcd q)) :
    (q : ℤ)*((i:ℤ)-j) = E*((q/E.gcd q:ℕ)*((i/(E/E.gcd q):ℕ)-(j/(E/E.gcd q):ℕ):ℤ)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.residue_affine
declarations.snippet:
theorem residue_affine (E n : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (x : ZMod n) :
    ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right E n) (ZMod E) (affine E n t x) =
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right E n) (ZMod E) t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.shifted_mem_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem shifted_mem_iff {E : ℕ} (hE : 0<E) (n q i j : ℕ)
    (t : ZMod (E*n)) (x : ZMod n) :
    affine E n t x + ((q:ℤ)*((i:ℤ)-j) : ℤ) ∈ Set.range (affine E n t) ↔
      i%(E/E.gcd q) = j%(E/E.gcd q) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.derivative
declarations.snippet:
theorem derivative {E : ℕ} (hE : 0<E) (n q i j : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n))
    (F : ZMod n → ℝ) (y : ZMod (E*n)) :
    extend E n t F y * extend E n t F (y+((q:ℤ)*((i:ℤ)-j):ℤ)) =
      if i%(E/E.gcd q) = j%(E/E.gcd q) then
        extend E n t (fun x => F x * F (x + ((q/E.gcd q:ℕ)*((i/(E/E.gcd q):ℕ)-(j/(E/E.gcd q):ℕ):ℤ):ℤ))) y
      else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.lengthAt
declarations.snippet: def lengthAt (J h r : ℕ) := J/h + if r<J%h then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.quotient_lt_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem quotient_lt_iff (J h r u : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (hr : r<h) :
    u < lengthAt J h r ↔ h*u+r < J := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.fibre_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_sum (J h r : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (hr : r<h) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ (range J).filter (fun i => i%h=r), F (i/h) =
      ∑ u ∈ range (lengthAt J h r), F u := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.pair_fibre_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem pair_fibre_sum (J h : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range J, ∑ j ∈ range J, (if i%h=j%h then K (i/h) (j/h) else 0) =
      ∑ r ∈ range h, ∑ u ∈ range (lengthAt J h r), ∑ v ∈ range (lengthAt J h r), K u v := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.lengthAt_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem lengthAt_card (J h r : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) (hr : r<h) :
    lengthAt J h r = ((range J).filter (fun i => i%h=r)).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.intervalMass
declarations.snippet: def intervalMass (Js : List ℕ) : ℝ := (Js.prod:ℝ)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.boxAverage
declarations.snippet:
def boxAverage (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q : ℕ) (Js : List ℕ) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  boxSum n q Js F / ((n:ℝ)*intervalMass Js)

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.zero_interval
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_interval {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (q : ℕ) (Js : List ℕ) (F : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hz : Js.prod = 0) : boxSum n q Js F = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.recover_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem recover_sum {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (q : ℕ) (Js : List ℕ) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    boxSum n q Js F = (n:ℝ)*intervalMass Js*boxAverage n q Js F := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.branch_factor
declarations.snippet:
theorem branch_factor (E n J a : ℕ) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hn : n≠0) (hJ : J ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin a→ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ((n:ℝ)*intervalMass (List.ofFn k)*x)/(((E*n:ℕ):ℝ)*intervalMass (List.replicate a J)) =
      (1/(E:ℝ)) * (∏ i : Fin a, ((k i:ℝ)/J)^2) * x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.AffinePullback.localized_average
declarations.snippet:
theorem localized_average {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)] (hE : 0<E)
    (q J a : ℕ) (hJ : 0<J) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    boxAverage (E*n) q (List.replicate a J) (extend E n t F) =
      (1/(E:ℝ))*∑ rs : Fin a → Fin (E/E.gcd q),
        (∏ i : Fin a, ((lengthAt J (E/E.gcd q) (rs i):ℝ)/J)^2) *
          boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) (List.ofFn (fun i => lengthAt J (E/E.gcd q) (rs i))) F := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.cubeKernel
declarations.snippet:
def cubeKernel (n q : ℕ) : (a : ℕ) → (ZMod n → ℝ) → (Fin a→ℕ×ℕ) → ZMod n → ℝ
  | 0, F, _, x => F x
  | a+1, F, s, x => cubeKernel n q a
      (fun y => F y * F (y+((q:ℤ)*(((s 0).1:ℤ)-(s 0).2):ℤ)))
      (fun i => s i.succ) x

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.kernel_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem kernel_bound (n q a : ℕ) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (pos:0≤M)
    (bound : ∀x, |F x| ≤ M) (s : Fin a→ℕ×ℕ) (x : ZMod n) :
    |cubeKernel n q a F s x| ≤ M^(2^a) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_eq_box
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_eq_box (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q a : ℕ) (m : Fin a→ℕ) (F : ZMod n→ℝ) :
    sampleSum n a m (cubeKernel n q a F) = boxSum n q (List.ofFn m) F := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.box_discard
declarations.snippet:
theorem box_discard (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q a : ℕ) (k m : Fin a→ℕ) (inc : ∀i,k i≤m i)
    (F : ZMod n→ℝ) (M : ℝ) (pos : 0≤M) (bound : ∀ x, |F x|≤M) :
    |boxSum n q (List.ofFn m) F-boxSum n q (List.ofFn k) F| ≤
      ((n:ℝ)*(∏ i :Fin a,(m i:ℝ)^2)-n*(∏ i :Fin a,(k i:ℝ)^2))*M^(2^a) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.box_abs
declarations.snippet:
theorem box_abs (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q a : ℕ) (k : Fin a→ℕ) (F : ZMod n→ℝ)
    (M : ℝ) (pos : 0≤M) (bound : ∀ x, |F x|≤M) :
    |boxSum n q (List.ofFn k) F| ≤ (n:ℝ)*(∏ i :Fin a,(k i:ℝ)^2)*M^(2^a) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.total_discard
declarations.snippet:
theorem total_discard (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q J h a : ℕ) (hh:0<h)
    (F : ZMod n→ℝ) (M:ℝ) (pos:0≤M) (bound:∀x, |F x|≤M) :
    let k:=J/h
    let X:=∑ rs : Fin a→Fin h, boxSum n q (List.ofFn (fun i=>lengthAt J h (rs i))) F
    let Y:=boxSum n q (List.replicate a k) F
    |X-(h:ℝ)^a*Y| ≤
      n * ((((h:ℝ)*k^2+(2*k+1)*(J%h:ℕ))^a)-((h:ℝ)*k^2)^a)*M^(2^a) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.short_abs_average
declarations.snippet:
theorem short_abs_average (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (q k a : ℕ) (hk : 0<k) (F : ZMod n→ℝ)
    (M:ℝ) (pos:0≤M) (bound:∀x, |F x|≤M) :
    |boxAverage n q (List.replicate a k) F| ≤ M^(2^a) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.window_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem window_zero (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (K b V N : ℕ) :
    window K b V N (0 : ZMod n) = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.centeredWindow
declarations.snippet:
def centeredWindow {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (μ : ℝ) (K b V N : ℕ) (x : ZMod n) :=
 (V.totient:ℝ)/V * window K b V N x - μ

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.window_bounds
declarations.snippet:
theorem window_bounds {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (K b V N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (x : ZMod n) :
    0≤window K b V N x ∧ window K b V N x ≤ Real.log N := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.centered_mean_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem centered_mean_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (μ : ℝ) (K b V N : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : ZMod n, centeredWindow μ K b V N x) = 0 ↔
      (V.totient:ℝ)/V * (∑ x : ZMod n, window K b V N x) = (n:ℝ)*μ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.centered_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem centered_bound {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (μ : ℝ) (mu : μ∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (K b V N : ℕ) (vp : 0<V) (hN : 0<N) (x : ZMod n) :
    |centeredWindow μ K b V N x| ≤ max 1 (Real.log N) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.centered_window_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem centered_window_error {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)]
    (hE:0<E) (q J a:ℕ) (large:E/E.gcd q≤J) (t:ZMod (E*n))
    (μ:ℝ) (mu:μ∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (K b V N:ℕ) (vp:0<V) (hN:0<N) :
    let h:=E/E.gcd q
    let f:=centeredWindow (n:=n) μ K b V N
    |boxAverage (E*n) q (List.replicate a J) (extend E n t f) -
      (1/(h:ℝ))^a*boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) (List.replicate a (J/h)) f/E|
      ≤ 4*a*(max 1 (Real.log N))^(2^a)/(E*J) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.centered_window_transfer
declarations.snippet:
theorem centered_window_transfer {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)]
    (hE:0<E) (q J a:ℕ) (large:E/E.gcd q≤J) (t:ZMod (E*n))
    (μ:ℝ) (mu:μ∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (K b V N:ℕ) (vp:0<V) (hN:0<N) (δ:ℝ)
    (downstairs: |boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) (List.replicate a (J/(E/E.gcd q)))
      (centeredWindow μ K b V N)| ≤ δ) :
    |boxAverage (E*n) q (List.replicate a J) (extend E n t (centeredWindow μ K b V N))| ≤
      (1/(E:ℝ))*(1/(E/E.gcd q:ℕ):ℝ)^a*δ+4*a*(max 1 (Real.log N))^(2^a)/(E*J) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.localized_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem localized_error {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)] (hE:0<E) (q J a : ℕ)
    (large : E/E.gcd q ≤ J) (t:ZMod (E*n)) (F:ZMod n→ℝ) (M:ℝ) (pos:0≤M)
    (bound:∀x, |F x|≤M) :
    let h:=E/E.gcd q
    let k:=J/h
    |boxAverage (E*n) q (List.replicate a J) (extend E n t F) -
       (1/(h:ℝ))^a*boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) (List.replicate a k) F / E|
      ≤ 4*a*M^(2^a)/(E*J) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.zero_dimensional
declarations.snippet:
theorem zero_dimensional {E n : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero (E*n)] (hE : 0<E)
    (q : ℕ) (t : ZMod (E*n)) (F : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    boxAverage (E*n) q [] (extend E n t F)=boxAverage n (q/E.gcd q) [] F/E := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.squares_by_residue
declarations.snippet:
theorem squares_by_residue (h J : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) :
    ∑ r : Fin h, (lengthAt J h r : ℝ)^2 =
      (h:ℝ)*(J/h:ℕ)^2+(2*(J/h:ℕ)+1)*(J%h:ℕ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.product_branch_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_branch_count (a h : ℕ) (G : Fin h → ℝ) :
    ∑ rs : Fin a→Fin h, ∏ i : Fin a, G (rs i) = (∑ r : Fin h, G r)^a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.interval_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem interval_sum (J h a : ℕ) (hh : 0<h) :
    (∑ rs : Fin a→Fin h, ∏ i:Fin a, (lengthAt J h (rs i):ℝ)^2) =
      ((h:ℝ)*(J/h:ℕ)^2+(2*(J/h:ℕ)+1)*(J%h:ℕ))^a :=

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.interval_ge
declarations.snippet: theorem interval_ge (J h : ℕ) (r : Fin h) : J/h≤lengthAt J h r := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.pairs
declarations.snippet: def pairs (m : ℕ) := (range m) ×ˢ (range m)

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.rect_mono
Sun28.CubeTruncation.sampleSum
declarations.snippet:
def sampleSum (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : (a:ℕ) → (Fin a→ℕ) →
    ((Fin a→ℕ×ℕ)→ZMod n→ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, _, K => ∑ x : ZMod n, K Fin.elim0 x
  | a+1, m, K => ∑ i∈range (m 0), ∑ j∈range (m 0),
      sampleSum n a (fun k => m k.succ) (fun s => K (Fin.cons (i,j) s))

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_add
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_add (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ℕ) (m : Fin a→ℕ)
    (K L : (Fin a→ℕ×ℕ)→ZMod n→ℝ) :
    sampleSum n a m (fun s x => K s x+L s x) = sampleSum n a m K + sampleSum n a m L := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_const
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_const (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ℕ) (m : Fin a→ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    sampleSum n a m (fun _ _ => c)=n*(∏ i : Fin a,(m i:ℝ)^2)*c := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_nonneg
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_nonneg (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ℕ) (m : Fin a→ℕ)
    (K : (Fin a→ℕ×ℕ)→ZMod n→ℝ) (pos : ∀ s x, 0≤K s x) :
    0≤ sampleSum n a m K := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_mono
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_mono (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ℕ) (k m : Fin a→ℕ)
    (inc : ∀ i, k i≤m i) (K : (Fin a→ℕ×ℕ)→ZMod n→ℝ) (pos : ∀ s x, 0≤K s x) :
    sampleSum n a k K ≤ sampleSum n a m K := by

declarations.name: Sun28.CubeTruncation.sample_discard
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_discard (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ℕ) (k m : Fin a→ℕ)
    (inc : ∀ i,k i≤m i) (K : (Fin a→ℕ×ℕ)→ZMod n→ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (bound : ∀ s x, |K s x|≤C) :
    |sampleSum n a m K-sampleSum n a k K| ≤
      (n*(∏ i :Fin a,(m i:ℝ)^2)-n*(∏ i :Fin a,(k i:ℝ)^2))*C := by

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeModel.bonferroniRows
declarations.snippet:
def bonferroniRows (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (d K L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ J : ℕ, ∃ j ≥ J, ∃ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
    let N:=lengthAt t
    let W:=rowWidth j N
    δ*((N:ℝ)*W) ≤ patternMass A d K K N W - ∑ p∈places K L, upperMoment A d K p N W

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeModel.CofinalBonferroni
declarations.snippet:
def CofinalBonferroni : Prop :=
  ∀ (X c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ), AdmissibleRoots X c q n →
    ∀ d : ℕ, 0 < d → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ K ≥ B,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : ℝ), ∃ (L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), max K m ≤ L ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        D < δ*((L:ℝ)*Real.log L) ∧ bonferroniRows (Sun28.RealPoleBounds.fixedScale n) d K L δ

declarations.name: Sun28.PrimeModel.fixed_prime_equiv
declarations.snippet:
def fixed_prime_equiv (K : ℕ) : FixedIdeal K ≃ {p : ℕ // oneClass K p} := by
  let normMap (J : FixedIdeal K) : {p : ℕ // oneClass K p} :=
    ⟨norm J.val,fixed_ideal_prime_norm _ J.2.1 J.2.2,J.val,rfl,J.2.2⟩
  apply Equiv.ofBijective normMap
  constructor
  · intro I J h
    have eq : norm I.val=norm J.val := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have uniq := oriented_subsingleton (L:=K) (fixed_ideal_prime_norm _ I.2.1 I.2.2)
    let U : Oriented K (norm I.val) := ⟨I.val,rfl,by rw [I.2.2]; exact fixed_admissible K⟩
    let V : Oriented K (norm I.val) := ⟨J.val,eq.symm,by rw [J.2.2]; exact fixed_admissible K⟩
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun t : Oriented K (norm I.val) => t.val) (uniq.allEq U V))
  · rintro ⟨p,prime,J,card,ray⟩
    exact ⟨⟨J,prime_ideal_of_card (moduli K) (level_coprime K) prime J card,ray⟩,Subtype.ext card⟩

      let h := h₀+(L:ℤ)*k
      ((kernelMod r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ h ∧
      (∀ p∈ supportPlaces r, h ≡ (p:ℤ)^comparisonDepth r p [ZMOD (p:ℤ)^(comparisonDepth r p+1)]) ∧
      ∀ i, (adjacentNorm (π i) (flip i):ℤ) ∣ h ∧
        (adjacentNorm (π i) (!(flip i)):ℤ) ∣ (h-anchor) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.comparisonMod

  | .inl j => m j
  | .inr (i,s) => order i s

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.comparisonRes

def comparisonRes {ι J : Type*} (C : ℕ) (r : J → ℕ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    J ⊕ (ι × Bool) → ℕ
  | .inl j => r j
  | .inr (i,s) => if (s ^^ x i) then C else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.Constraint
declarations.snippet:
inductive Constraint {ι J : Type*} (order : ι → Bool → ℕ) (m r : J → ℕ) (C : ℕ) :
    Option ι → Option ι → Bool → Prop where
  | pair (i j : ι) (s t : Bool) (bad : ¬(order i s).gcd (order j t) ∣ C) :
    Constraint order m r C (some i) (some j) (s ^^ t)
  | pin (j : J) (i : ι) (s : Bool) (t : Bool)
      (bad : ¬r j ≡ (if t then C else 0) [MOD (m j).gcd (order i s)]) :
    Constraint order m r C none (some i) (!(s ^^ t))

declarations.snippet:
theorem edge_iff {ι J : Type*} (order : ι → Bool → ℕ) (m r : J → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (x : ι → Bool)
    (base : ∀ i j, r i ≡ r j [MOD (m i).gcd (m j)]) :
    (∀ {u v d}, Edge order m r C u v d →
      ((u.elim false x) ^^ (v.elim false x)) = d) ↔
    ∀ i j, comparisonRes C r x i ≡ comparisonRes C r x j
      [MOD (comparisonMod order m i).gcd (comparisonMod order m j)] := by

    (nz : ∀ i s, 0 < order i s) (nz' : ∀ j, 0 < m j)
    (base : ∀ i j, r i ≡ r j [MOD (m i).gcd (m j)]) :
    (∀ v, ¬Walk (Edge order m r C) v v true) ↔
    ∃ (x : ι → Bool) (h : ℤ) (step : ℕ), 0<step ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ i,
      h + (step:ℤ)*k ≡ (comparisonRes C r x i : ℤ) [ZMOD (comparisonMod order m i : ℤ)] := by

    (fixed : ∀ j,h ≡ (r j:ℤ) [ZMOD (m j:ℤ)])
    (left : ∀ i,h ≡ 0 [ZMOD (orders i (x i):ℤ)])
    (right : ∀ i,h ≡ (C:ℤ) [ZMOD (orders i (!(x i)):ℤ)]) :
    ∀ v,¬Walk (Edge orders m r C) v v true := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.Walk
declarations.snippet:
inductive Walk {V : Type*} (edge : V → V → Bool → Prop) : V → V → Bool → Prop where
  | nil (v : V) : Walk edge v v false
  | step {u v w : V} {s t : Bool} :
      Walk edge u v s → edge v w t → Walk edge u w (s ^^ t)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.Walk.join
declarations.snippet:
theorem join {u v w : V} {a b : Bool} (first : Walk edge u v a) (second : Walk edge v w b) :

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.Walk.rev
declarations.snippet:
theorem rev {u v : V} {a : Bool} (path : Walk edge u v a)
    (symm : ∀ {u v b}, edge u v b → edge v u b) : Walk edge v u a := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.balanced_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem balanced_iff {V : Type*} (edge : V → V → Bool → Prop)
    (symm : ∀ {u v b}, edge u v b → edge v u b) :
    (∃ f : V → Bool, ∀ {u v b}, edge u v b → (f u ^^ f v) = b) ↔
    ∀ v, ¬Walk edge v v true := by

declarations.snippet: theorem admits_of_patterns (sieve : PrimePatterns) {X : ℤ} (w : Window X) : AdmitsRow w := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.solve_at_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem solve_at_orders {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (orders : ι → Bool → ℕ) (r : ℤ)
    (nz : ∀ i s, 0<orders i s)
    (clear : ∀ v, ¬Walk (Edge orders (fixedMod r) (fixedRes r) (Nat.factorial 576)) v v true) :
    ∃ (flip : ι → Bool) (h₀ : ℤ) (L : ℕ), 0<L ∧ ∀ k : ℤ,
      let h := h₀+(L:ℤ)*k
      ((kernelMod r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ h ∧
      (∀ p∈supportPlaces r, h ≡ (p:ℤ)^comparisonDepth r p [ZMOD (p:ℤ)^(comparisonDepth r p+1)]) ∧
      ∀ i, (orders i (flip i):ℤ) ∣ h ∧ (orders i (!(flip i)):ℤ) ∣ (h-anchor) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.rational_trace
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_trace {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {u v : ℕ} (values : PrimeValues A u v)
    (one : A 0=1) (alive : ∀ j,A j≠0) (vp : 0<v)
    (z : (i : ↥(shifts A))→ZMod (values.value i)) (sq : ∀ i,(z i)^2=2)
    (flip : ↥(shifts A)→Bool) (large : ∀ d∈shifts A,65<values.value d)
    (exclude : ∀ j, ∀ p∈selected values j, ¬p∣dilation A ∧ ¬p∣separation ∧ padicValRat p (A j)=0)
    {X q h : ℤ} {n : Fin 4→ℤ} {points : NinePoints}
    (orders : ∀ i, (curveOrders (z i) (flip i):ℤ)∣h ∧ (curveOrders (z i) (!(flip i)):ℤ)∣(h-anchor))
    (represented : Consequences points fixedMultiplier anchor ⟨q,h,n,fun i=>h*n i⟩)
    (root : lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3)=0) (firstRoot : beta X=(n 0:ℚ)) :
    ∀ j, let t:=argument A u v j
      let T:=ordinaryTraceAt points fixedMultiplier anchor (beta X) (A j) t
      ∀ p∈selected values j, T≠0 ∧ padicValRat p T=0 ∧ padicValRat p (detector (A j) t/T^2)=1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.RationalRow
declarations.snippet:
def RationalRow {X : ℤ} (w : Window X) : Prop :=
  let A:=fixedScale w.n
  ∃ (u v : ℕ) (values : PrimeValues A u v),
    0<v ∧ requiredDivisor A∣v ∧ slopeThreshold A w.C (1/2)<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧ RayValues values ∧
    (∀ j,∀ p∈selected values j,¬p∣dilation A ∧ ¬p∣separation ∧ padicValRat p (A j)=0) ∧
    ∃ z : (i : ↥(shifts A))→ZMod (values.value i), (∀ i,(z i)^2=2) ∧
      ∀ j, ¬Walk (Edge (fun i s=>curveOrders (z i) s) (fixedMod (integerRadicand X))
        (fixedRes (integerRadicand X)) (Nat.factorial 576)) j j true

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.redX
declarations.snippet: def redX {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (z : ZMod p) : ZMod p := (57-28*z)/8

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.redY
declarations.snippet: def redY {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (z : ZMod p) : ZMod p := (-660+417*z)/32

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.equation
declarations.snippet:
private theorem equation {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (size : 65<p) {z : ZMod p} (sq : z^2=2) :
    (shortCurve (-(3-z)^2)).toAffine.Equation (redX z) (redY z) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.reducedPoint
declarations.snippet:
def reducedPoint {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (size : 65<p) {z : ZMod p} (sq : z^2=2) :
    (shortCurve (-(3-z)^2)).toAffine.Point := by
  let _ := finite_elliptic size sq
  exact Point.mk (equation size sq)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.pointPeriod
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.period_dvd

    pointPeriod size sq ∣ pointCount p (-(3-z)^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.period_pos
declarations.snippet:
theorem period_pos {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (size : 65<p) {z : ZMod p} (sq : z^2=2) :
    0 < pointPeriod size sq := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (period_dvd size sq) (by unfold pointCount;omega)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.Window
declarations.snippet:
structure Window (X : ℤ) where
  c : ℤ
  q : ℤ
  n : Fin 4→ℤ
  C : ℝ
  early : (stepMod (integerRadicand X) fixedMultiplier:ℤ)∣c
  roots : AdmissibleRoots X c q n
  one : 1≤C
  progression : ∀ η : ℚ, slopeThreshold (fixedScale n) C (1/2) < η →
    ∀ (h₀ : ℤ) (L : ℕ), 0<L →
    ∃ (h : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (B : Fin 9→AffineInput),
      h=h₀+(L:ℤ)*k ∧
      let w:=(nineAffine B).doubles
      Consequences w fixedMultiplier anchor ⟨q,h,n,fun i=>h*n i⟩ ∧
      coordinateProduct n=rootProduct w fixedMultiplier ∧
      (∀ i,|scalarEntries w fixedMultiplier i|≤1) ∧
      ∀ j,RealPole w fixedMultiplier anchor (beta X) ((pointScale w fixedMultiplier j)^2) η (1/2)

    Nonempty (Window X) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.fixedWindow

def fixedWindow {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [CompactSpace G]

    Window X := Classical.choice (exists_window orbit model X)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.AdmitsRow
declarations.snippet:
def AdmitsRow {X : ℤ} (w : Window X) : Prop :=
  let A:=fixedScale w.n
  ∃ (u v : ℕ) (values : PrimeValues A u v) (π : ↥(shifts A)→Gaussian),
    0<v ∧ requiredDivisor A∣v ∧ slopeThreshold A w.C (1/2)<(slope A u v:ℝ) ∧
    (∀ d∈shifts A,65<values.value d) ∧
    (∀ j,∀ p∈selected values j,¬p∣dilation A ∧ ¬p∣separation ∧ padicValRat p (A j)=0) ∧
    NormRays A values π ∧ BalancedOrders π (integerRadicand X)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.FixedWindowRows

    [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] (orbit : Orbit G) (model : ParameterModel orbit) : Prop :=
  ∀ X : ℤ, AdmitsRow (fixedWindow orbit model X)

declarations.name: Sun28.QualitativeRows.TraceProgression
declarations.snippet:
def TraceProgression {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {u v : ℕ} (values : PrimeValues A u v)
    (w : Window X) : Prop :=
  ∃ (b : ℤ) (L : ℕ), 0<L ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, let h:=b+(L:ℤ)*k
    (kernelMod (integerRadicand X):ℤ)∣h ∧
    (∀ p∈supportPlaces (integerRadicand X), h ≡ (p:ℤ)^comparisonDepth (integerRadicand X) p
      [ZMOD (p:ℤ)^(comparisonDepth (integerRadicand X) p+1)]) ∧
    ∀ (B : Fin 9→AffineInput), Consequences (nineAffine B).doubles fixedMultiplier anchor
      ⟨w.q,h,w.n,fun i=>h*w.n i⟩ →
      ∀ j, ∀ p∈selected values j, padicValRat p (ordinaryTraceAt (nineAffine B).doubles fixedMultiplier

declarations.snippet:
def conjugateRing : GaussianInt →+* GaussianInt where
  toFun:=star
  map_one':=star_one _
  map_zero':=star_zero _
  map_add':=star_add
  map_mul' x y:=by simp

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.tuple_conjugate
declarations.snippet:
theorem tuple_conjugate (a b:ℤ) (dy:((a:ZMod 16),(b:ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
    (odd:∀i,(a:ZMod (q i))^2+(b:ZMod (q i))^2≠0) :
    ∃ (dy':((a:ZMod 16),((-b:ℤ):ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
      (odd':∀i,(a:ZMod (q i))^2+((-b:ℤ):ZMod (q i))^2≠0),
      primeTuple q a (-b) dy' odd' = joinedAut q dyadicConj (primeTuple q a b dy odd) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.conjugate_ideal
declarations.snippet:
theorem conjugate_ideal (J:coprimeIdeals (M q)) :
    ∃ K:coprimeIdeals (M q), K.val = J.val.map conjugateRing ∧
      idealCoordinates q cop (K:idealRay q) =
        joinedAut q dyadicConj (idealCoordinates q cop (J:idealRay q)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianRed
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianRed (m : ℕ) : GaussianInt →+* GR m where
  toFun z := ⟨z.re,z.im⟩
  map_one' := by ext <;> simp
  map_zero' := by ext <;> simp
  map_add' x y := by ext <;> simp
  map_mul' x y := by ext <;> simp [Zsqrtd.re_mul,Zsqrtd.im_mul]

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianRed_surjective
declarations.snippet: theorem gaussianRed_surjective (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] : Function.Surjective (gaussianRed m) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianRed_kernel
declarations.snippet:
theorem gaussianRed_kernel (m : ℕ) :
    RingHom.ker (gaussianRed m) = principal (m:GaussianInt) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianQuotient
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianQuotient (m:ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    GaussianInt ⧸ principal (m:GaussianInt) ≃+* GR m :=
  (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (gaussianRed_kernel m).symm).trans
    ((gaussianRed m).quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (gaussianRed_surjective m))

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianQuotient_mk
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem gaussianQuotient_mk (m:ℕ) [NeZero m] (x:GaussianInt) :
    gaussianQuotient m (residue (principal (m:GaussianInt)) x)=gaussianRed m x := rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.modulus

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianCRT
declarations.snippet:
def gaussianCRT [∀i,NeZero (m i)] (cop:Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime m)) :
    GaussianInt ⧸ modulus m ≃+* ∀ i,GR (m i) :=
  (Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient _ (ideals_coprime m cop)).trans
    (RingEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i=>gaussianQuotient (m i)))

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.gaussianCRT_mk
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem gaussianCRT_mk [∀i,NeZero (m i)] (cop:Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime m))
    (z:GaussianInt) (i:I) :
    gaussianCRT m cop (residue (modulus m) z) i = gaussianRed (m i) z := rfl

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.coprimeIdeals
declarations.snippet:
def coprimeIdeals : Submonoid (Ideal R) where
  carrier := {J | J ⊔ M = ⊤}
  one_mem' := by simp
  mul_mem' h k := ((Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr h).mul_left
    (Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr k)).sup_eq

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.idealClass
declarations.snippet:
def idealClass (J : coprimeIdeals M) : unitClasses M :=
  classOf M (generator J.val) ((invertible_iff M _).2 (by
    change Ideal.span {generator J.val} ⊔ M = ⊤
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_generator]
    exact J.2))

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.ideal_ray_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem ideal_ray_iff (J K : coprimeIdeals M) :
    idealEquivalent M J.val K.val ↔ idealClass M J = idealClass M K := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.idealClass_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem idealClass_spec (J : coprimeIdeals M) (x : R) (hx : IsUnit (residue M x))
    (hJ : principal x = J.val) : idealClass M J = classOf M x hx := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.class_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem class_product (x y : R) (hx : IsUnit (residue M x)) (hy : IsUnit (residue M y)) :
    classOf M (x*y) (map_mul (residue M) x y ▸ hx.mul hy) = classOf M x hx * classOf M y hy := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.idealClassHom
declarations.snippet:
def idealClassHom : coprimeIdeals M →* unitClasses M where
  toFun := idealClass M
  map_one' := by
    rw [idealClass_spec M 1 1 (by simp) (by simp [principal])]
    unfold classOf
    exact (congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' _) (Units.ext (v := 1) (by simp))).trans (map_one _)
  map_mul' J K := by
    let x := generator J.val
    let y := generator K.val
    have hx : IsUnit (residue M x) := (invertible_iff M _).2 (by unfold principal x; rw [Ideal.span_singleton_generator]; exact J.2)
    have hy : IsUnit (residue M y) := (invertible_iff M _).2 (by unfold principal y; rw [Ideal.span_singleton_generator]; exact K.2)
    have hxy : IsUnit (residue M (x*y)) := map_mul (residue M) x y ▸ hx.mul hy
    rw [idealClass_spec M (J*K) (x*y) hxy (by
      change Ideal.span {x*y}=J.val*K.val
      rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
      simp [x,y])]
    exact class_product M x y hx hy

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.idealClass_surjective
declarations.snippet: theorem idealClass_surjective : Function.Surjective (idealClassHom M) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.rayCongruence
declarations.snippet:
theorem rayCongruence (J K : coprimeIdeals M) :
    (Con.ker (idealClassHom M)).r J K ↔ idealEquivalent M J.val K.val :=

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.rayEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def rayEquiv :
    (Con.ker (idealClassHom M)).Quotient ≃* unitClasses M :=
  Con.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective _ (idealClass_surjective M)

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.primary_generator
declarations.snippet:
theorem primary_generator (J:coprimeIdeals (M q)) :
    ∃ z:GaussianInt, principal z=J.val ∧ ((z.re:ZMod 16),(z.im:ZMod 16))∈primarySet ∧
      ∀ i,(z.re:ZMod (q i))^2+(z.im:ZMod (q i))^2≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.prime_ideal_data
declarations.snippet:
theorem prime_ideal_data (J:coprimeIdeals (M q)) :
    ∃ (z:GaussianInt) (dy:((z.re:ZMod 16),(z.im:ZMod 16))∈primarySet)
      (odd:∀ i,(z.re:ZMod (q i))^2+(z.im:ZMod (q i))^2≠0),
      principal z=J.val ∧ Nat.card (GaussianInt ⧸ J.val)=z.norm.natAbs ∧
      idealCoordinates q cop (J:idealRay q)=primeTuple q z.re z.im dy odd := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.residue
declarations.snippet: abbrev residue := Ideal.Quotient.mk M

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.principal
declarations.snippet: abbrev principal (x:R) := Ideal.span {x}

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.unitReduction
declarations.snippet: abbrev unitReduction := Units.map (residue M).toMonoidHom

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.unitClasses
declarations.snippet: abbrev unitClasses := (R ⧸ M)ˣ ⧸ (unitReduction M).range

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.classOf
declarations.snippet:
def classOf (x:R) (h:IsUnit (residue M x)) : unitClasses M :=
  QuotientGroup.mk' _ h.unit

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.idealEquivalent
declarations.snippet:
def idealEquivalent (A B:Ideal R) : Prop :=
  ∃ c d:R, c≠0 ∧ d≠0 ∧ residue M c=1 ∧ residue M d=1 ∧ principal c*A=principal d*B

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.invertible_iff
declarations.snippet: theorem invertible_iff (x:R) : IsUnit (residue M x) ↔ principal x ⊔ M=⊤ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.class_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem class_eq (x y:R) (hx:IsUnit (residue M x)) (hy:IsUnit (residue M y)) :

declarations.name: Sun28.Reciprocity.residueNontrivial
declarations.snippet:
instance residueNontrivial : Nontrivial (GaussianInt ⧸ M q) := by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
  intro h
  have m : (1:GaussianInt) ∈ M q := (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 h
  have h16 : (1:GaussianInt) ∈ piece (levels q) none :=
    (iInf_le (piece (levels q)) none) m
  change (1:GaussianInt) ∈ principal ((16:ℕ):GaussianInt) at h16
  rw [←gaussianRed_kernel 16] at h16
  have e : gaussianRed 16 1 = 0 := h16
  rw [map_one] at e
  exact (by decide : (1:ZMod 16)≠0) (congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.re e)

declarations.name: Sun28.RealCharts.parameterModel_of_hom
declarations.snippet:
def parameterModel_of_hom (a : Orbit G) (π : ∀ s : Bool,G →+ EmbeddedPoint (place s))
    (continuous : ∀ s,Continuous (π s)) (generator : ∀ s,π s a.generator=embedded (place s) (paperGenerator sqrt2_sq)) :
    ParameterModel a where
  z s := parameterOn _ ∘ π s
  value s m := by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,map_zsmul,generator,←embedded_multiple,parameter_agrees,real_parameter_agrees]
    rfl
  zero_continuous s := by
    have h : ContinuousAt (parameterOn _) (π s 0) := (π s).map_zero.symm ▸ (at_infinity _).2
    exact ContinuousAt.comp (f:=π s) h (continuous s).continuousAt
  affine_continuous s m _ := by
    have h : ContinuousAt (parameterOn _) (π s (m • a.generator)) := by
      rw [map_zsmul,generator,←embedded_multiple]
      exact embedded_chart_continuous _ _
    exact ContinuousAt.comp (f:=π s) h (continuous s).continuousAt

declarations.name: Sun28.RealCharts.parameterModel_on_subgroup
declarations.snippet:
def parameterModel_on_subgroup (D : AddSubgroup RealPair) (a : Orbit D)
    (generator : (a.generator : RealPair)=diagonalGenerator) : ParameterModel a := by
  let π : ∀ s : Bool,D →+ EmbeddedPoint (place s) := fun s => match s with
    | false => (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _).comp D.subtype
    | true => (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _).comp D.subtype
  apply parameterModel_of_hom a π
  · intro s
    cases s
    · exact continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val
    · exact continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val
  · intro s
    cases s
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst generator
    · exact congrArg Prod.snd generator

declarations.name: Sun28.RealCharts.embeddedHom
declarations.snippet:
def embeddedHom (σ : K0 →+* ℝ) : PaperPoint →+ EmbeddedPoint σ where
  toFun := embedded σ
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := by
    rintro (_ | ⟨x₁,y₁,h₁⟩) (_ | ⟨x₂,y₂,h₂⟩)
    any_goals simp only [← Point.zero_def,zero_add,add_zero,embedded]
    by_cases pair : x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=W.negY x₂ y₂
    · have eq₁ := congrArg σ pair.1
      have eq₂ : σ y₁=(W.map σ).negY (σ x₂) (σ y₂) := by rw [pair.2,map_negY]
      rw [Point.add_of_Y_eq pair.1 pair.2]
      change (0 : EmbeddedPoint σ)=_+_
      symm
      exact Point.add_of_Y_eq eq₁ eq₂
    · have lifted : ¬(σ x₁=σ x₂ ∧ σ y₁=(W.map σ).negY (σ x₂) (σ y₂)) := by
        intro h
        exact pair ⟨σ.injective h.1,σ.injective (by simpa only [map_negY] using h.2)⟩
      rw [Point.add_some pair]
      simp only [Point.add_some lifted,map_slope,map_addX,map_addY]

declarations.name: Sun28.RealCharts.coefficient
declarations.snippet:
private def coefficient (i j : Fin 3) : Plane → ℝ :=
  Quotient.lift (fun v : V => v i*v j / sumSquares v) (by
    rintro x y ⟨u,rfl⟩
    have scale : sumSquares (u • y)=(u:ℝ)^2*sumSquares y := by
      change ((u:ℝ)*y 0)^2+((u:ℝ)*y 1)^2+((u:ℝ)*y 2)^2=_*(_+_+_)
      ring
    rw [scale]
    change ((u:ℝ)*y i)*((u:ℝ)*y j)/(_^2*sumSquares y)=_
    by_cases zero : sumSquares y=0
    · simp [zero]
    · field_simp [zero,u.ne_zero])

declarations.name: Sun28.RealPoleBounds.above_threshold
Sun28.RealPoleBounds.RealPole
declarations.snippet:
def RealPole (w : NinePoints) (M : ℕ) (anchor : ℤ) (β A η : ℚ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  let t:=A*η
  let r:=detector A t
  let T:=ordinaryTraceAt w M anchor β A t
  t∉marks ∧ t≠3 ∧ 0<r ∧ productAt r (t-3) (ordinaryAt w M anchor β)≠0 ∧
    0<T ∧ 0<r/T^2 ∧ ((r/T^2:ℚ):ℝ)<ε

    (C ε : ℝ) (ep : 0<ε) (scales : Fin 3→ℚ) (positive : ∀ j,0<scales j)
    (η : ℚ) (large : slopeThreshold scales C ε < η)
    (bounds : ∀ i,∀ σ : K0 →+* ℝ,|σ (ordinaryAt w M anchor β i)|≤C) :
    ∀ j, RealPole w M anchor β (scales j) η ε := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RealPoleBounds.integer_three_pole_windows
declarations.snippet:
theorem integer_three_pole_windows (a : Orbit G) (model : ParameterModel a) (X anchor : ℤ)
    (M D : ℕ) (positive : 0<M) (six : 6∣M) (dpos : 0<D) (dil : M∣D) (cmin : ℤ) (ε : ℝ) (ep : 0<ε) :
    ∃ (c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ) (C : ℝ), (D:ℤ)∣c ∧ max cmin 0<c ∧ c=(M:ℤ)*q ∧
      n 0=2*X^2+3 ∧ n 1=c+1 ∧ (∀ i,0<n i ∧ Odd (n i)) ∧ lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3)=0 ∧ 1≤C ∧
      ∀ η : ℚ,slopeThreshold (fixedScale n) C ε < η →
      ∀ (h₀ : ℤ) (L : ℕ),0<L → ∀ (bad : Set ℤ),bad.Finite → ∀ hmin : ℤ,
      ∃ (h : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (B : Fin 9→AffineInput),
        h=h₀+(L:ℤ)*k ∧ max (max anchor hmin) 0<h ∧ h∉bad ∧
        let w:=(nineAffine B).doubles
        Consequences w M anchor ⟨q,h,n,fun i=>h*n i⟩ ∧ coordinateProduct n=rootProduct w M ∧
        (∀ i,|scalarEntries w M i|≤1) ∧
        (truncAt w.H≠0 ∧ conjugation (truncAt (translatedBase w anchor))≠0) ∧
        (∀ i,∀ σ : K0 →+* ℝ, |σ (ordinaryAt w M anchor (2*(X:ℚ)^2+3) i)|≤C) ∧
        ∀ j,RealPole w M anchor (2*(X:ℚ)^2+3) ((pointScale w M j)^2) η ε := by

    (n : Fin 4→ℤ) (nz : ∀ i,n i≠0) (prod : coordinateProduct n=rootProduct w M)
    (η : ℚ) (large : slopeThreshold (fixedScale n) C (1/2) < η)
    (bounds : ∀ i,∀ σ : K0 →+* ℝ,|σ (ordinaryAt w M anchor β i)|≤C) :

theorem detector_trace_small {A t : ℚ} {C ε : ℝ} (ap : 0<A) (ep : 0<ε)
    (late : depthThreshold A C ε < (t-3:ℚ)) (D : OrdinaryTest→K0)

    0<detector A t/(thetaAt (detector A t) (t-3) D)^2 ∧
    ((detector A t/(thetaAt (detector A t) (t-3) D)^2:ℚ):ℝ) < ε := by

declarations.snippet:
theorem bounded_ordinary_pole (w : NinePoints) (M : ℕ) (anchor : ℤ) (β A t : ℚ)

declarations.name: Sun28.RealRatio.parameterModel_of_projections
declarations.snippet:
def parameterModel_of_projections (a : Orbit G)
    [∀ s : Bool,TopologicalSpace (EmbeddedPoint (place s))]
    (π : ∀ s : Bool,G→EmbeddedPoint (place s))
    (pcont : ∀ s,Continuous (π s))
    (orbit : ∀ s (m : ℤ),π s (m • a.generator)=embedded (place s) (paperMultiple m))
    (at_origin : ∀ s,ContinuousAt (realParameter (place s)) 0)
    (at_affine : ∀ s (m : ℤ),m≠0 →
      ContinuousAt (realParameter (place s)) (embedded (place s) (paperMultiple m))) :
    ParameterModel a where
  z s := realParameter (place s) ∘ π s
  value s m := by
    change realParameter (place s) (π s (m • a.generator))=_
    rw [orbit,real_parameter_agrees]
    rfl
  zero_continuous s := by
    have y : π s 0=0 := by simpa [paperMultiple,embedded,Point.zero_def] using orbit s 0
    exact (y ▸ at_origin s).comp (pcont s).continuousAt
  affine_continuous s m live := (orbit s m ▸ at_affine s m live).comp (pcont s).continuousAt

declarations.name: Sun28.RealWindows.integer_affine_windows
declarations.snippet:
theorem integer_affine_windows (a : Orbit G) (model : ParameterModel a) (X anchor : ℤ)
    (M D : ℕ) (positive : 0<M) (six : 6∣M) (dpos : 0<D) (dil : M∣D) (cmin : ℤ) :
    ∃ (c q : ℤ) (n : Fin 4→ℤ) (C : ℝ), (D:ℤ)∣c ∧ max cmin 0<c ∧ c=(M:ℤ)*q ∧
      n 0=2*X^2+3 ∧ n 1=c+1 ∧ (∀ i,0<n i ∧ Odd (n i)) ∧ lucas (n 1) (n 2) (n 3)=0 ∧ 1≤C ∧
      ∀ (h₀ : ℤ) (L : ℕ),0<L → ∀ (bad : Set ℤ),bad.Finite → ∀ hmin : ℤ,
      ∃ (h : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (A : Fin 9→AffineInput),
        h=h₀+(L:ℤ)*k ∧ max (max anchor hmin) 0<h ∧ h∉bad ∧
        let w:=(nineAffine A).doubles
        Consequences w M anchor ⟨q,h,n,fun i=>h*n i⟩ ∧
        coordinateProduct n=rootProduct w M ∧
        (∀ i,|scalarEntries w M i|≤1) ∧
        (truncAt w.H≠0 ∧ conjugation (truncAt (translatedBase w anchor))≠0) ∧
        (∀ i,∀ σ : K0 →+* ℝ, |σ (ordinaryAt w M anchor (2*(X:ℚ)^2+3) i)|≤C) ∧
        ∀ i,∀ ν : InfinitePlace K0, ν (ordinaryAt w M anchor (2*(X:ℚ)^2+3) i)≤C := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower
declarations.snippet:
inductive ParamTower (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : ℕ → Type u
  | base : ParamTower R 0
  | adjoin {n : ℕ} (prior : ParamTower R n) (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
      (hf : f.Monic) : ParamTower R (n+1)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.elim
declarations.snippet:
def elim : {n : ℕ} → ParamTower R n → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R → R
  | _, .base, g => MvPolynomial.eval Fin.elim0 g
  | _, .adjoin T f _, g => elim T (f.resultant (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R _ g))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.Satisfies
declarations.snippet:
def Satisfies (φ : R →+* L) : {n : ℕ} → ParamTower R n → (Fin n → L) → Prop
  | _, .base, _ => True
  | _, .adjoin T f _, x => Satisfies φ T (Fin.tail x) ∧
      (f.map (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (Fin.tail x))).IsRoot (x 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.eval_cons
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_cons (φ : R →+* L) {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → L) (a : L) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin (n+1)) R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (Fin.cons a x) g =
      ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n g).map (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x)).eval a := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.eval_empty
declarations.snippet:
private theorem eval_empty (φ : R →+* L) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 0) R) :
    φ (MvPolynomial.eval Fin.elim0 g) = MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) g := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.elim_zero_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem elim_zero_iff [IsAlgClosed L] (φ : R →+* L) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    φ (elim T g) = 0 ↔ ∃ x : Fin n → L, Satisfies φ T x ∧ MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g = 0 := by
