declarations.snippet: local instance : DecidableEq Ω

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.satisfies_hom
declarations.snippet:
theorem satisfies_hom {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (φ : R →+* K) (η : K →+* L)
    {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (x : Fin n → K) :
    Satisfies (η.comp φ) T (fun i => η (x i)) ↔ Satisfies φ T x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.rational_locator_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_locator_at {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) {b : ℕ}
    (hi : Set.InjOn (separator (b:AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
        ((rootTuples ((algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).comp φ) T).toFinset : Set (Fin n → AlgebraicClosure ℚ)))
    (z : ℚ) :
    ((imagePolynomial T (linearForm R n b)).map φ).IsRoot z ↔
      ∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies φ T x ∧ separator (b : ℚ) x = z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.rational_locator
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_locator {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) {b : ℕ}
    (hi : Set.InjOn (separator (b:AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
        ((rootTuples ((algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).comp φ) T).toFinset : Set (Fin n → AlgebraicClosure ℚ))) :
    (∃ z : ℚ, ((imagePolynomial T (linearForm R n b)).map φ).IsRoot z) ↔
      ∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies φ T x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.exists_rational_locator
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_rational_locator {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* ℚ) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, b ≤ T.degreeProduct.choose 2*(n-1) ∧
      ((∃ z : ℚ, ((imagePolynomial T (linearForm R n b)).map φ).IsRoot z) ↔
        ∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies φ T x) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.linearForm
declarations.snippet:
def linearForm (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (n b : ℕ) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, MvPolynomial.X i * (b : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)^(i : ℕ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.sample
declarations.snippet:
def sample {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (b j : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) : R[X] :=
  imagePolynomial T (linearForm R n b + (j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)*f)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.sample_eq_resolvent
declarations.snippet:
theorem sample_eq_resolvent {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (b j : ℕ) (z : L) :
    ((sample T b j f).map φ).eval z =
      (resolvent (rootTuples φ T).toFinset (separator (b:L)) (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x f)
         (fun x => (rootTuples φ T).count x) z).eval (j:L) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.finite_guard_samples
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_guard_samples [CharZero L] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (φ : R →+* L)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) {b : ℕ}
    (hi : Set.InjOn (separator (b:L)) ((rootTuples φ T).toFinset : Set (Fin n → L)))
    (x : Fin n → L) (hx : Satisfies φ T x) :
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ T.degreeProduct → ((sample T b j f).map φ).IsRoot (separator (b:L) x)) ↔
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x f = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.baseChange
declarations.snippet:
def baseChange (θ : R →+* S) : {n : ℕ} → ParamTower R n → ParamTower S n
  | _, .base => .base
  | _, .adjoin T f hf => .adjoin (baseChange θ T) (f.map (MvPolynomial.map θ)) (hf.map _)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.satisfies_baseChange
ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.rootTuples_baseChange
declarations.snippet:
theorem rootTuples_baseChange (θ : R →+* S) (φ : S →+* L) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) :
    rootTuples φ (baseChange θ T) = rootTuples (φ.comp θ) T := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial
ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_isRoot_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_isRoot_iff [IsAlgClosed L] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (φ : R →+* L) (z : L) :
    ((imagePolynomial T g).map φ).IsRoot z ↔
      ∃ x : Fin n → L, Satisfies φ T x ∧ MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g = z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_eval_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_eval_product [IsAlgClosed L] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (φ : R →+* L) (z : L) :
    ((imagePolynomial T g).map φ).eval z =
      ((rootTuples φ T).map fun x => z - MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g).prod := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_map [IsAlgClosed L] [Infinite L] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (φ : R →+* L) :
    (imagePolynomial T g).map φ =
      ((rootTuples φ T).map fun x => X-C (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g)).prod := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_degree
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_degree [IsAlgClosed L] [Infinite L] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (φ : R →+* L) :
    ((imagePolynomial T g).map φ).natDegree = T.degreeProduct := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_monic
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_monic [IsDomain R] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) : (imagePolynomial T g).Monic := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.imagePolynomial_natDegree
declarations.snippet:
theorem imagePolynomial_natDegree [IsDomain R] {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) : (imagePolynomial T g).natDegree = T.degreeProduct := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.rootTuples
ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.degreeProduct
declarations.snippet:
def degreeProduct : {n : ℕ} → ParamTower R n → ℕ
  | _, .base => 1
  | _, .adjoin T f _ => degreeProduct T * f.natDegree

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.card_rootTuples
declarations.snippet:
theorem card_rootTuples [IsAlgClosed L] (φ : R →+* L) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) :
    (rootTuples φ T).card = T.degreeProduct := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.mem_rootTuples
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_rootTuples (φ : R →+* L) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (x : Fin n → L) :
    x ∈ rootTuples φ T ↔ Satisfies φ T x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.ParamTower.elim_product
declarations.snippet:
theorem elim_product [IsAlgClosed L] (φ : R →+* L) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    φ (elim T g) = ((rootTuples φ T).map (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x g)).prod := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.specialize_resultant
declarations.snippet:
theorem specialize_resultant (φ : R →+* L) (f g : R[X]) (hf : f.Monic) :
    φ (f.resultant g) = ((f.map φ).roots.map (g.map φ).eval).prod := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunResultant.specialize_resultant_zero_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem specialize_resultant_zero_iff (φ : R →+* L) (f g : R[X]) (hf : f.Monic) :
    φ (f.resultant g) = 0 ↔ ∃ z : L, (f.map φ).IsRoot z ∧ (g.map φ).IsRoot z := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.polynomial
declarations.snippet:
def polynomial (k : Branch) (A B D : R) : R[X] :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => X^4 - C (4*D*A)*X^2 + C (8*D^2*B^2)
  | .realPart => X^2 - C (4*D*A)
  | .radicalPart => X^2 - C (2*D*A)
  | .zero => X

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.polynomial_monic
declarations.snippet: theorem polynomial_monic (k : Branch) (A B D : R) : (polynomial k A B D).Monic := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.value
declarations.snippet:
def value (k : Branch) (a b d w : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => w^4 - 4*d*a*w^2 + 8*d^2*b^2
  | .realPart => w^2 - 4*d*a
  | .radicalPart => w^2 - 2*d*a
  | .zero => w

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.specialized_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem specialized_root (φ : R →+* ℚ) (k : Branch) (A B D : R) (w : ℚ) :
    ((polynomial k A B D).map φ).IsRoot w ↔ value k (φ A) (φ B) (φ D) w = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.guard
declarations.snippet:
def guard (k : Branch) (a b d w : ℚ) : Prop := d ≠ 0 ∧ match k with
  | .mixed => b ≠ 0 ∧ w ≠ 0
  | .realPart | .radicalPart => b = 0 ∧ a ≠ 0
  | .zero => a = 0 ∧ b = 0

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.reconstruct
declarations.snippet:
def reconstruct (k : Branch) (b d w : ℚ) : K :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => pair (w/(2*d)) (b/w)
  | .realPart => pair (w/(2*d)) 0
  | .radicalPart => pair 0 (w/(2*d))
  | .zero => 0

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.reconstruct_scaled
declarations.snippet:
theorem reconstruct_scaled (k : Branch) (b d t : ℚ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    reconstruct k b d (2*d*t) = k.point (b/d) t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.condition_scaled
declarations.snippet:
theorem condition_scaled (k : Branch) (a b d t : ℚ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    k.condition (a/d) (b/d) t ↔
        guard k a b d (2*d*t) ∧ value k a b d (2*d*t) = 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.square_iff_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem square_iff_root (φ : R →+* ℚ) (A B D : R) (y : K) :
    (φ D ≠ 0 ∧ y^2 = pair (φ A / φ D) (φ B / φ D)) ↔
      ∃ (k : Branch) (w : ℚ), guard k (φ A) (φ B) (φ D) w ∧
        ((polynomial k A B D).map φ).IsRoot w ∧ y = reconstruct k (φ B) (φ D) w := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.zeroTests
declarations.snippet:
def zeroTests (k : Branch) (A B : R) : List R[X] :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => []
  | .realPart | .radicalPart => [C B]
  | .zero => [C A,C B]

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.nonzeroTests
declarations.snippet:
def nonzeroTests (k : Branch) (A B D : R) : List R[X] :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => [C D,C B,X]
  | .realPart | .radicalPart => [C D,C A]
  | .zero => [C D]

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.guard_polynomials
declarations.snippet:
theorem guard_polynomials (φ : R →+* ℚ) (k : Branch) (A B D : R) (w : ℚ) :
    guard k (φ A) (φ B) (φ D) w ↔
      (∀ E ∈ zeroTests k A B, (E.map φ).eval w = 0) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ nonzeroTests k A B D, (G.map φ).eval w ≠ 0) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.stage
Sun28.RootCharts.asTest
declarations.snippet:
def asTest {n : ℕ} (E : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) : MvPolynomial (Fin (n+1)) R :=
  (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).symm E

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.eval_asTest
declarations.snippet:
theorem eval_asTest (φ : R →+* ℚ) {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℚ) (w : ℚ)
    (E : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (Fin.cons w x) (asTest E) =
      (E.map (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x)).eval w := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.stage_square_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem stage_square_iff (φ : R →+* ℚ) {n : ℕ} (T : ParamTower R n) (x : Fin n → ℚ)
    (A B D : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (y : K) :
    let ev := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ x
    (ParamTower.Satisfies φ T x ∧ ev D ≠ 0 ∧ y^2 = pair (ev A / ev D) (ev B / ev D)) ↔
      ∃ (k : Branch) (w : ℚ), ParamTower.Satisfies φ (stage T k A B D) (Fin.cons w x) ∧
        (∀ E ∈ zeroTests k A B, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (Fin.cons w x) (asTest E) = 0) ∧
        (∀ G ∈ nonzeroTests k A B D, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (Fin.cons w x) (asTest G) ≠ 0) ∧
        y = reconstruct k (ev B) (ev D) w := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.coordinates
declarations.snippet:
def coordinates (k : Branch) (B D : R) : R[X] × R[X] × R[X] :=
  match k with
  | .mixed => (X^2, C (2*D*B), C (2*D)*X)
  | .realPart => (X, 0, C (2*D))
  | .radicalPart => (0, X, C (2*D))
  | .zero => (0, 0, 1)

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.coordinates_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem coordinates_spec (φ : R →+* ℚ) (k : Branch) (A B D : R) (w : ℚ)
    (hg : guard k (φ A) (φ B) (φ D) w) :
    let v := Polynomial.eval₂RingHom φ w
    let q := coordinates k B D
    v q.2.2 ≠ 0 ∧
      reconstruct k (φ B) (φ D) w = pair (v q.1 / v q.2.2) (v q.2.1 / v q.2.2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.realNumerator
declarations.snippet: def realNumerator (U V : R) : R := U^3+6*U*V^2-11*U+12*V

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.radicalNumerator
declarations.snippet: def radicalNumerator (U V : R) : R := 3*U^2*V+2*V^3-11*V+6*U

declarations.name: Sun28.RootCharts.curve_iff_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem curve_iff_root (φ : R →+* ℚ) (U V : R) (y : K) :
    y^2 = (pair (φ U) (φ V))^3 - pair 11 (-6)*pair (φ U) (φ V) ↔
      ∃ (k : Branch) (w : ℚ),
        guard k (ordinateReal (φ U) (φ V)) (ordinateRadical (φ U) (φ V)) 1 w ∧
        ((polynomial k (realNumerator U V) (radicalNumerator U V) (1:R)).map φ).IsRoot w ∧
        y = reconstruct k (ordinateRadical (φ U) (φ V)) 1 w := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.resultant_nonzero
declarations.snippet:
theorem resultant_nonzero (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    shiftedResultant (projected S ell wt) ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.resultant_degree
declarations.snippet:
theorem resultant_degree (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    (shiftedResultant (projected S ell wt)).natDegree=(∑ x ∈ S, wt x)^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.CoefficientMinimum
declarations.snippet:
def CoefficientMinimum (R : ℕ → K[X]) (B b d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (R b).coeff d≠0 ∧ ∀ j ≤ B, ∀ k<d, (R j).coeff k=0

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.coefficientMinimum_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientMinimum_iff {R : ℕ → K[X]} (live : ∀ j, R j≠0) {B b : ℕ} :
    (∃ d≤(R b).natDegree, CoefficientMinimum R B b d) ↔
    ∀ j≤B, (R b).natTrailingDegree≤(R j).natTrailingDegree := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.separates_iff_coefficient_branch
declarations.snippet:
theorem separates_iff_coefficient_branch [CharZero K] {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → K))
    (wt : (Fin n → K) → ℕ) (positive : ∀ x ∈ S, 0<wt x)
    {b B : ℕ} (bound : S.card.choose 2*(n-1)≤B) :
    Set.InjOn (separator (b:K)) (S : Set (Fin n → K)) ↔
    ∃ d≤(∑ x ∈ S, wt x)^2, CoefficientMinimum
      (fun j : ℕ => shiftedResultant (projected S (separator (j:K)) wt)) B b d := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.differences
declarations.snippet:
def differences (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) : K[X] :=
  ∏ z ∈ S ×ˢ S, (X-C (ell z.2-ell z.1))^(wt z.1*wt z.2)

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.order_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem order_differences [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    (differences S ell wt).rootMultiplicity 0 =
      ∑ z ∈ S ×ˢ S, if ell z.1=ell z.2 then wt z.1*wt z.2 else 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.order_eq_diagonal_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem order_eq_diagonal_iff (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ)
    (positive : ∀ x ∈ S, 0<wt x) :
    (differences S ell wt).rootMultiplicity 0 = ∑ x ∈ S, wt x^2 ↔
      Set.InjOn ell (S : Set ι) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.diagonal_le_order
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_le_order (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    (∑ x ∈ S, wt x^2) ≤ (differences S ell wt).rootMultiplicity 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.separates_iff_minimizes
declarations.snippet:
theorem separates_iff_minimizes [CharZero K] {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → K))
    (wt : (Fin n → K) → ℕ) (positive : ∀ x ∈ S, 0<wt x)
    (b B : ℕ) (bound : S.card.choose 2*(n-1) ≤ B) :
    Set.InjOn (separator (b:K)) (S : Set (Fin n → K)) ↔
      ∀ j : ℕ, j≤B → (differences S (separator (b:K)) wt).rootMultiplicity 0 ≤
        (differences S (separator (j:K)) wt).rootMultiplicity 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.projected
declarations.snippet:
def projected (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) : K[X] :=
  ∏ x ∈ S, (X-C (ell x))^wt x

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.shiftedResultant
Sun28.Collision.lift_projected
Sun28.Collision.resultant_differences
declarations.snippet:
theorem resultant_differences (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    shiftedResultant (projected S ell wt) = differences S ell wt := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Collision.resultant_coefficient
declarations.snippet:
theorem resultant_coefficient [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset ι) (ell : ι → K) (wt : ι → ℕ) :
    let d := ∑ z ∈ S ×ˢ S, if ell z.1=ell z.2 then wt z.1*wt z.2 else 0
    let R := shiftedResultant (projected S ell wt)
    R.coeff d≠0 ∧ ∀ j<d, R.coeff j=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.equations
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def equations (P : K[X]) : List K[X] → K[X]
  | [] => P
  | E :: rest => equations (EuclideanDomain.gcd P E) rest

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.equations_dvd
declarations.snippet: theorem equations_dvd (P : K[X]) (eqs : List K[X]) : equations P eqs ∣ P := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_equations
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_equations (P : K[X]) (eqs : List K[X]) (t : K) :
    (equations P eqs).IsRoot t ↔ P.IsRoot t ∧ ∀ E ∈ eqs, E.IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.product_guard
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_guard (guards : List K[X]) (t : K) :
    ¬ guards.prod.IsRoot t ↔ ∀ G ∈ guards, ¬ G.IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.filtered
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def filtered (P : K[X]) (eqs guards : List K[X]) (N : ℕ) : K[X] :=
  keep (equations P eqs) guards.prod N

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_filtered
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_filtered {P : K[X]} (hP : P≠0) (eqs guards : List K[X]) {N : ℕ}
    (bound : P.natDegree≤N) (t : K) :
    (filtered P eqs guards N).IsRoot t ↔
    P.IsRoot t ∧ (∀ E ∈ eqs, E.IsRoot t) ∧ (∀ G ∈ guards, ¬G.IsRoot t) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.fibre
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def fibre {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* K)
    (P : R[X]) (eqs guards : List R[X]) : K[X] :=
  filtered (P.map φ) (eqs.map (Polynomial.map φ)) (guards.map (Polynomial.map φ)) P.natDegree

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_fibre {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* K) (P : R[X])
    (eqs guards : List R[X]) (live : P.map φ ≠ 0) (t : K) :
    (fibre φ P eqs guards).IsRoot t ↔
      P.eval₂ φ t=0 ∧ (∀ E ∈ eqs, E.eval₂ φ t=0) ∧ (∀ G ∈ guards,G.eval₂ φ t≠0) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.map_equations
declarations.snippet:
theorem map_equations {L : Type*} [Field L] [DecidableEq L] (f : K →+* L)
    (P : K[X]) (eqs : List K[X]) :
    (equations P eqs).map f = equations (P.map f) (eqs.map (Polynomial.map f)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_map_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_map_fibre {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field L] [DecidableEq L]
    (φ : R →+* K) (f : K →+* L) (P : R[X]) (eqs guards : List R[X])
    (live : P.map φ≠0) (t : L) :
    ((fibre φ P eqs guards).map f).IsRoot t ↔
    P.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t=0 ∧ (∀ E ∈ eqs, E.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t=0) ∧
      ∀ G ∈ guards, G.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_fibre_monic
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_fibre_monic {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field L] [DecidableEq L]
    (φ : R →+* K) (f : K →+* L) {P : R[X]} (monic : P.Monic)
    (eqs guards : List R[X]) (t : L) :
    ((fibre φ P eqs guards).map f).IsRoot t ↔
    P.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t=0 ∧ (∀ E ∈ eqs, E.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t=0) ∧
      ∀ G ∈ guards, G.eval₂ (f.comp φ) t≠0 :=

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.keep
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def keep (P G : K[X]) (N : ℕ) : K[X] := P / EuclideanDomain.gcd P (G^N)

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.keep_mul_gcd
declarations.snippet:
theorem keep_mul_gcd (P G : K[X]) (N : ℕ) :
    keep P G N * EuclideanDomain.gcd P (G^N) = P := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.keep_ne_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem keep_ne_zero {P : K[X]} (hP : P≠0) (G : K[X]) (N : ℕ) :
    keep P G N ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_keep
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_keep {P G : K[X]} {N : ℕ} (hP : P≠0) (bound : P.natDegree≤N) (t : K) :
    (keep P G N).IsRoot t ↔ P.IsRoot t ∧ ¬ G.IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.map_keep
declarations.snippet:
theorem map_keep {L : Type*} [Field L] [DecidableEq L] (f : K →+* L) (P G : K[X]) (N : ℕ) :
    (keep P G N).map f = keep (P.map f) (G.map f) N := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.isRoot_map_keep
declarations.snippet:
theorem isRoot_map_keep {L : Type*} [Field L] [DecidableEq L] (f : K →+* L)
    {P G : K[X]} {N : ℕ} (hP : P≠0) (bound : P.natDegree≤N) (t : L) :
    ((keep P G N).map f).IsRoot t ↔ (P.map f).IsRoot t ∧ ¬(G.map f).IsRoot t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.changing_guard
declarations.snippet:
theorem changing_guard {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (a : K) :
    (fibre (evalRingHom a) (X : K[X][X]) [] [X-C (X : K[X])]).IsRoot 0 ↔ a≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Guard.generic_root_lost
declarations.snippet:
theorem generic_root_lost (K : Type*) [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    [DecidableEq (FractionRing K[X])] :
    (fibre (algebraMap K[X] (FractionRing K[X])) (X : K[X][X]) [] [X-C (X : K[X])]).IsRoot 0 ∧
    ¬(fibre (evalRingHom (0:K)) (X : K[X][X]) [] [X-C (X : K[X])]).IsRoot 0 := by

    {r δ Γ W : ℚ} (D : ℕ) (sign : δ=1 ∨ δ= -1)
    (positive : 0<padicValRat p r) (odd : Odd (padicValRat p r))
    (gn : Γ≠0) (gu : padicValRat p Γ=0) (live : W≠0)

  first : reciprocal (h • paperGenerator root)=pair ρ (g 0) (g 1)

Sun28.ScalarHeight.TraceCertificate

def TraceCertificate {ρ : K} (root : ρ^2=2) (h s : ℤ) (r Γ : ℚ) (D : ℕ) (M : Finset ℚ) : Prop :=
  let H:=h • paperGenerator root
  let R:=(s-1) • paperGenerator root
  scalarTheta r (reciprocal H) (parameter R/parameter H) ≠ 0 ∧
    polePredicate M (scalarValue r Γ (D:ℚ) (reciprocal H) (parameter R/parameter H))

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarHeight.tree_prime48
declarations.snippet:
theorem tree_prime48 {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (big : 3<p) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver ((Rat.HeightOneSpectrum.primesEquiv (R:=𝓞 ℚ)).symm ⟨p,Fact.out⟩).asIdeal]
    {ρ : K} (root : ρ^2=2) (charts : MinimalFormalGroupTheorems p w)

theorem rational_pencil {x:ℚ} {u c:ℤ} (nonzero:x≠0) (split:x.num=u*c) :
    let A:=(beta x).num
    let B:ℤ:=(beta x).den
    let T:=heightRadical A B
    let P:=u.natAbs.primeFactors
    ∃ (h k:ℤ) (X Y Z:ℚ), h≠0 ∧ k≠0 ∧
      (6:ℤ).natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧ h.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧
      k.natAbs.primeFactors⊆support A B ∧
      (6:ℕ)≤2^32*T ∧ h.natAbs≤2^32*T ∧ k.natAbs≤2^32*T ∧
      X.den.primeFactors⊆P ∧ Y.den.primeFactors⊆P ∧ Z.den.primeFactors⊆P ∧
      6*X^2-(h:ℚ)*Y^2=((-4*c^2:ℤ):ℚ) ∧
      6*X^2-(k:ℚ)*Z^2=((-6*c^2:ℤ):ℚ) ∧ x=(c:ℚ)/X := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarQuotients.localPairs
declarations.snippet:
def localPairs (p n:ℕ) [NeZero n] (h:p∣n) (d:ℤ) (C:Finset (ℕ×ℕ)) : Finset (ℕ×ℕ) :=
  let sqs:Finset (ZMod n):=Finset.univ.image fun u:ZMod n=>u^2
  let twists:=sqs.image fun z=>(d:ZMod n)*z
  let prim:=(sqs ×ˢ sqs).filter fun t=>
    ¬(ZMod.castHom h (ZMod p) t.1=0 ∧ ZMod.castHom h (ZMod p) t.2=0) ∧
      values t.1 t.2∈twists
  C.filter fun kl=>∃t∈prim,
    2*t.1+3*t.2∈sqs.image (fun z=>(kl.1:ZMod n)*z) ∧
    t.1+t.2∈sqs.image (fun z=>(kl.2:ZMod n)*z)

    (p n:ℕ) [NeZero n] (hp:p.Prime) (h:p∣n) {C:Finset (ℕ×ℕ)} (c:(k,l)∈C) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.four_classes
declarations.snippet: theorem four_classes {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) (single:Concentrated x j) : FourClasses x j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.keep
declarations.snippet: def keep (j:Fin 5) : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := j.succAbove

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.fourProduct
declarations.snippet: def fourProduct (j:Fin 5) (a b:ℤ) : ℤ := ∏ i : Fin 4, oldForm (keep j i) a b

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.signedTwist
declarations.snippet: def signedTwist (j:Fin 5) (x:ℚ) := sqfInt (fourProduct j x.num x.den)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.product_twist
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_twist {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) {j:Fin 5} (single:Concentrated x j) :
    (signedTwist j x).natAbs ∣ 210 ∧ ∃ w:ℤ, w≠0 ∧ fourProduct j x.num x.den=signedTwist j x*w^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.order_product
declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet:
theorem concentrated_iff_twist {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.concentrated_iff_four_classes
declarations.snippet:
theorem concentrated_iff_four_classes {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.chart
declarations.snippet: def chart (j:Fin 5) (x:ℚ) := if j=0 then x⁻¹ else x

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.chart_product
ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.baseCoordinate
declarations.snippet: def baseCoordinate (j:Fin 5) (x:ℚ) : ℚ := if j=0 then (x.num:ℚ) else x.den

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.homogeneous_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem homogeneous_chart {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.OnTwist
declarations.snippet: def OnTwist (j:Fin 5) (x:ℚ) (d:ℤ) : Prop := ∃ y:ℚ,y≠0 ∧ y^2=(d:ℚ)*cubic j (chart j x)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.base_ne
declarations.snippet: private theorem base_ne {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) : baseCoordinate j x≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.point_on_twist
declarations.snippet: theorem point_on_twist {x:ℚ} (off:offMarks x) (j:Fin 5) : OnTwist j x (signedTwist j x) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.OriginalConcentrated.twist_dvd

declarations.snippet: theorem finite_height {x:ℚ} (mem:x∈finiteSlopes) : ¬failure x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.finiteProduct
declarations.snippet: def finiteProduct (A B : ℤ) := A*(A-B)*(A-2401*B)*(32*A+343*B)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.twistCoefficient
declarations.snippet: def twistCoefficient (A B : ℤ) := sqfInt (finiteProduct A B)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.finiteQuartic
declarations.snippet: def finiteQuartic (s : ℚ) := s*(s-1)*(s-2401)*(32*s+343)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.coordinate
declarations.snippet: def coordinate (s : ℚ) := (2401-s)/(75*s)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.four_mark_identity
declarations.snippet:
theorem four_mark_identity {s : ℚ} (nz : s≠0) :
    21*cubic 1 (coordinate s)=finiteQuartic s*(343/(375*s^2))^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.four_mark_squareclass
declarations.snippet:
theorem four_mark_squareclass {A B : ℤ} (b : B≠0) (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) :
    ∃ y : ℚ, y≠0 ∧ finiteQuartic ((A:ℚ)/B)=(twistCoefficient A B:ℚ)*y^2 := by

declarations.snippet:

    ∃ P:(elliptic (21*(twistCoefficient A B:ℚ))).toAffine.Point, ¬IsOfFinAddOrder P := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.support
declarations.snippet: def support (A B : ℤ) := univ.biUnion fun i : Fin 5 => rowPrimes i A B

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.weight
declarations.snippet: def weight (A B : ℤ) := ∏ i : Fin 5,(kernel i A B).natAbs

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.row_subset
declarations.snippet: private theorem row_subset (i : Fin 5) (A B : ℤ) : rowPrimes i A B ⊆ support A B :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.product_by_prime
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_by_prime {A B : ℤ} (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) :
    weight A B = ∏ p ∈ support A B,p^(hitRows A B p).card := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.atPrime
declarations.snippet:
private def atPrime (p : ℕ) :=
  (if p=2 then 2 else 1)*(if p=3 then 9 else 1)*(if p=5 then 25 else 1)*(if p=7 then 49 else 1 : ℕ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.max_power
declarations.snippet: private theorem max_power (p : ℕ) : p^multiplicity p=p*atPrime p := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.excess
declarations.snippet: private theorem excess (S : Finset ℕ) : (∏ p ∈ S,atPrime p) ∣ 22050 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.joint_divides
declarations.snippet:
theorem joint_divides {A B : ℤ} (cop : Int.gcd A B=1) (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) :
    weight A B ∣ 22050*primeProduct (support A B) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.support_outside
declarations.snippet: theorem support_outside (A B : ℤ) : support A B \ oldCutoff=oddSupport A B := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.weight_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem weight_bound {A B : ℤ} (cop : Int.gcd A B=1) (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.rowPrimes
declarations.snippet:
def rowPrimes (i : Fin 5) (A B : ℤ) : Finset ℕ := (formPrimes i A B).filter
  fun p => Odd ((oldForm i A B).natAbs.factorization p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.hitRows
declarations.snippet: def hitRows (A B : ℤ) (p : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 5) := univ.filter fun i => p∈rowPrimes i A B

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.multiplicity
declarations.snippet: def multiplicity (p : ℕ) : ℕ := if p=2 then 2 else if p=3 ∨ p=5 ∨ p=7 then 3 else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.radical_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem radical_row (i : Fin 5) {A B : ℤ} (off : oldForm i A B≠0) :

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.residueRows
declarations.snippet:
private def residueRows (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (a b : ZMod p) : Finset (Fin 5) :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.MurtyPastenEstimate
declarations.snippet:
def MurtyPastenEstimate : Prop := ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ p∈S,p.Prime) → ∀ x y : ℚ,
  RationalSUnit S x → RationalSUnit S y → x+y=1 →
  4*max (logHeight₁ x) (logHeight₁ y)-2*Real.log 2 <
    (96/5:ℝ)*(primeProduct S:ℝ)*Real.log (primeProduct S:ℝ)
     +(26617/500:ℝ)*(primeProduct S:ℝ)+49273/500

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.FiveCovers.chartBound
declarations.snippet: def chartBound (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (24/5:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ)+14*(n:ℝ)+57

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.core
declarations.snippet: def core : Finset ℕ := {2,3,5,7}

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.firstRamified
declarations.snippet: def firstRamified (d e : ℤ) := (parameterPrimes d e).filter fun p=>p∈e.natAbs.primeFactors

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.secondRamified
declarations.snippet:
def secondRamified (d e : ℤ) := (parameterPrimes d e).filter fun p=>
  ¬(p∈d.natAbs.primeFactors ↔ p∈e.natAbs.primeFactors)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.localCost
ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.sum_local
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_local (d e : ℤ) :
    (∑ p∈parameterPrimes d e,localCost d e p)=
      2*(firstRamified d e).card+2*(secondRamified d e).card := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.rank
declarations.snippet: def rank (j : Bool) (c : ℚ) : ℕ := Module.finrank ℤ (model j c).toAffine.Point

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.DescentRankBounds
declarations.snippet:
def DescentRankBounds : Prop := ∀ d e : ℤ, Squarefree d → Squarefree e →
  rank false (e:ℚ)≤2*(core∪firstRamified d e).card ∧
  rank true ((d:ℚ)*e)≤2*(core∪secondRamified d e).card

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.total_rank
declarations.snippet:
theorem total_rank (descent : DescentRankBounds) {d e : ℤ} (sd : Squarefree d) (se : Squarefree e) :
    rank false (e:ℚ) + rank true ((d:ℚ)*e) ≤ 16+∑ p∈parameterPrimes d e,localCost d e p := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.RankCount.FixedCurveCount
declarations.snippet:
def FixedCurveCount (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d e : ℤ, Squarefree d → Squarefree e → ∀ Y : Finset (ℚ×ℚ),
    (∀ q∈Y,q.1≠0 ∧ q.2≠0 ∧ (e:ℚ)*q.2^2=sextic d q.1) →
      (Y.card:ℝ)≤γ*(7:ℝ)^(rank false (e:ℚ)+rank true ((d:ℚ)*e))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Arc
declarations.snippet:
structure Arc where
  x : ℝ
  y : ℝ
  z : ℝ
  posX : 0 < x
  posY : 0 < y
  posZ : 0 < z
  pythagoras : x^2+y^2=z^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Arc.t
declarations.snippet: def t (a : Arc) : ℝ := a.x/(a.z+a.y)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Arc.s
declarations.snippet: def s (a : Arc) : ℝ := (a.z+a.y)/2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Arc.parametrization
declarations.snippet:
theorem parametrization (a : Arc) :
    a.x=2*a.s*a.t ∧ a.y=a.s*(1-a.t^2) ∧ a.z=a.s*(1+a.t^2) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Arc.bounds
declarations.snippet: theorem bounds (a : Arc) : 0<a.t ∧ a.t<1 ∧ 0<a.s ∧ a.s≤a.z := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.volume
declarations.snippet:
def volume {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y z X Y Z a b c : R) : R :=
    x*(Y*c-Z*b)-y*(X*c-Z*a)+z*(X*b-Y*a)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.arc_volume
declarations.snippet:
theorem arc_volume (a b c : Arc) :
    volume a.x a.y a.z b.x b.y b.z c.x c.y c.z =
      4*a.s*b.s*c.s*(a.t-b.t)*(a.t-c.t)*(b.t-c.t) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Dir
declarations.snippet:
structure Dir where
  u : ℕ
  v : ℕ
  w : ℕ

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.Fits
declarations.snippet:
structure Fits (i j k : ℕ) (P : Dir) : Prop where
  x : 0 < i*P.u^2
  y : 0 < j*P.v^2
  z : i*P.u^2 + j*P.v^2 = k*P.w^2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.coordinate_pos
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coordinate_pos {i u : ℕ} (pos : 0 < i*u^2) :
    0 < Real.sqrt (i:ℝ)*(u:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.weighted
declarations.snippet:
def weighted (i j k : ℕ) (P : Dir) (h : Fits i j k P) : Arc where
  x := Real.sqrt (i:ℝ)*P.u
  y := Real.sqrt (j:ℝ)*P.v
  z := Real.sqrt (k:ℝ)*P.w
  posX := coordinate_pos h.x
  posY := coordinate_pos h.y
  posZ := coordinate_pos (h.z ▸ add_pos h.x h.y)
  pythagoras := by
    rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
      Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _),Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact_mod_cast h.z

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.lattice_volume
declarations.snippet:
theorem lattice_volume {i j k : ℕ} {P Q R : Dir}
    (p : Fits i j k P) (q : Fits i j k Q) (r : Fits i j k R) :
    volume (weighted _ _ _ _ p).x (weighted _ _ _ _ p).y (weighted _ _ _ _ p).z
      (weighted _ _ _ _ q).x (weighted _ _ _ _ q).y (weighted _ _ _ _ q).z
      (weighted _ _ _ _ r).x (weighted _ _ _ _ r).y (weighted _ _ _ _ r).z =
      (volume (P.u:ℤ) P.v P.w Q.u Q.v Q.w R.u R.v R.w:ℤ)*
      (Real.sqrt (i:ℝ)*Real.sqrt (j:ℝ)*Real.sqrt (k:ℝ)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.cell
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def cell (H : ℕ) (a : Arc) := ⌊(3*(H:ℝ))*a.t⌋₊

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.cell_lt
declarations.snippet: theorem cell_lt {H : ℕ} (Hpos : 0<H) (a : Arc) : cell H a < 3*H := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.cell_diff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem cell_diff {H : ℕ} {a b : Arc} (eq : cell H a=cell H b) :
    |3*(H:ℝ)*a.t-3*(H:ℝ)*b.t|≤1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SplitRows.three_in_cell
declarations.snippet:
theorem three_in_cell {i j k H : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 0 < k) (_hp : 0 < H)
    {P Q R : Dir} (p : Fits i j k P) (q : Fits i j k Q) (r : Fits i j k R) :
    let a := weighted _ _ _ _ p
    let b := weighted _ _ _ _ q
    let c := weighted _ _ _ _ r
    a.z≤H → b.z≤H → c.z≤H → cell H a=cell H b → cell H a=cell H c →
      a.t=b.t ∨ a.t=c.t ∨ b.t=c.t := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Diagonal210.Fibre
declarations.snippet:
def Fibre (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] (c : Fin 4 → ℚ) (s : ℚ) :=
  {y : Fin 4 → K // ∀ i,(y i)^2=algebraMap ℚ K (c i*(s-mark i))}

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Diagonal210.fibreEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def fibreEquiv {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] {c : Fin 4 → ℚ}
    (v : Fin 4 → ℚ) (h : ∀ i,v i≠0 ∧ c i=coefficient i*(v i)^2) (s : ℚ) :
    Fibre K c s ≃ Fibre K coefficient s where
  toFun y := ⟨fun i=>y.1 i/algebraMap ℚ K (v i),by
    intro i
    have ne := (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℚ K)).mpr (h i).1
    rw [div_pow,y.2 i,(h i).2]
    simp only [map_mul,map_pow]
    field_simp [ne]⟩
  invFun y := ⟨fun i=>y.1 i*algebraMap ℚ K (v i),by
    intro i
    rw [mul_pow,y.2 i,(h i).2]
    simp only [map_mul,map_pow]
    ring⟩
  left_inv y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ ((map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℚ K)).mpr (h i).1)
  right_inv y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ ((map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℚ K)).mpr (h i).1)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Diagonal210.quarticI

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Diagonal210.rootCubic
declarations.snippet:

    rootCubic d (mark 0) (mark 2) (mark 3),
    rootCubic d (mark 0) (mark 1) (mark 3),
    rootCubic d (mark 0) (mark 1) (mark 2)] i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchId.fromInfinity
declarations.snippet:
def fromInfinity (q : InfinityOpen K) : Fibre K coefficient (mark 2) := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_⟩:=ratios q
  refine ⟨![49*q.1 1/q.1 0,60*q.1 2/q.1 1,0,735*q.1 1/4],?_⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [mark,coefficient,div_pow,mul_pow,a,b,(ratios q).2.2]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchId.toInfinity
declarations.snippet:
def toInfinity (p : Fibre K coefficient (mark 2)) : InfinityOpen K := by
  let v:=4*p.1 3/735
  refine ⟨![49*v/p.1 0,v,p.1 1*v/60],?_⟩
  have ⟨a,b,_,d⟩:=finite_ratios p
  norm_num [quadrics,v,div_pow,mul_pow,a,b,d]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchId.infinity_equiv_42
declarations.snippet:
def infinity_equiv_42 : InfinityOpen K ≃ Fibre K coefficient (mark 2) where
  toFun := fromInfinity
  invFun := toInfinity
  left_inv p := by
    have ⟨a,b,_⟩:=ratios p
    have u : p.1 0≠0 := by intro h; rw [h] at a; norm_num at a
    have v : p.1 1≠0 := by intro h; rw [h] at b; norm_num at b
    apply Subtype.ext; funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      norm_num [toInfinity,fromInfinity] <;> field_simp [u,v]
  right_inv p := by
    have ⟨a,_,c,d⟩:=finite_ratios p
    have u : p.1 0≠0 := by intro h; rw [h] at a; norm_num at a
    have v : p.1 3≠0 := by intro h; rw [h] at d; norm_num at d
    apply Subtype.ext; funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      norm_num [toInfinity,fromInfinity,c] <;> field_simp [u,v]

ZInQBlueprint.BranchId.recover_slope

theorem recover_slope {i : Fin 4} {s x Y : K} {z : Fin 3 → K} (hit : omitted i s z)
    (live : Y≠0) (coords : ∀ j,quad i j x=z j*Y) :
    Y^2=published i x ∧ numerator i x/Y^2=s := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.BranchId.quarticEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def quarticEquiv (i : Fin 4) : PublishedOpen i K ≃ OmittedOpen i K where
  toFun v := ⟨(numerator i v.1.1/v.1.2^2,fun j=>quad i j v.1.1/v.1.2),to_omitted v.2.1 v.2.2⟩
  invFun v := by
    let r:=readout i 2 v.1.2
    let x:=readout i 1 v.1.2/r
    let Y:K:=1/r
    have n : Y≠0 := div_ne_zero one_ne_zero v.2.2
    have C (j) : quad i j x=v.1.2 j*Y := by
      simpa only [x,Y,r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] using reconstruct_coordinates v.2.1 v.2.2 j
    exact ⟨(x,Y),(recover_slope v.2.1 n C).1,n⟩
  left_inv v := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext

  right_inv v := by

    have C (j) : quad i j (readout i 1 v.1.2/r)=v.1.2 j*(1/r) := by
      simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] using reconstruct_coordinates v.2.1 v.2.2 j
    apply Subtype.ext

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DiamondHeight.scalarTower_of_local_characters
declarations.snippet:
def scalarTower_of_local_characters {R : ℕ} (L : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar)
    [IsGalois ℚ L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ L] (degree : Module.finrank ℚ L≤576)
    (dy : GQ →* ℂˣ) (dy2 : ∀ g, (dy g)^2=1)
    (ι : ∀ p:ℕ, GQ →* (ZMod p)ˣ) (χ : ∀ p:ℕ, (ZMod p)ˣ →* ℂˣ)
    (b : markingGroup L →* ℂˣ)
    (b2 : ∀ x, (b x)^2 = dy (x:GQ) * ∏ p ∈ R.primeFactors, χ p (ι p (x:GQ)))
    (inv : ∀ g x y, (y:markingGroup L).val = g*(x:markingGroup L).val*g⁻¹ → b y=b x)
    (det : GQ →* ℂˣ) (det2 : ∀ g ∈ b.ker.map (markingGroup L).subtype, (det g)^2=1) :
    ScalarTower R where
  marking := markingGroup L
  marking_pos := (marking_index L) ▸ Module.finrank_pos
  marking_degree := (marking_index L).trans_le degree
  m := 2*unitOrders R
  m_pos := by
    have pos : 0<unitOrders R := Finset.prod_pos fun p hp => by
      have q := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
      omega
    omega
  order_bound := le_rfl
  scalar := b
  exponent_bound := fun x => by rw [pow_mul,b2];exact local_character_product R dy dy2 ι χ x.val
  normal := by
    let : (markingGroup L).Normal:=(AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L : GQ →* (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L)).normal_ker
    exact normal_scalar_kernel _ b (fun g x => inv g x _ rfl)
  determinant := det
  square := det2

structure InflatedSplitting {G Q K:Type*} [Group G] [Group Q] [CommGroup K] (q:G →* Q) where
  b : G → K
  factor : Q → Q → K
  left_one : ∀ a, factor 1 a=1
  right_one : ∀ a, factor a 1=1
  split : ∀ x y, b x*b y=factor (q x) (q y)*b (x*y)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.DiamondHeight.InflatedSplitting.restrict
declarations.snippet:
def InflatedSplitting.restrict (F : InflatedSplitting (K:=K) q) : q.ker →* K where
  toFun x := F.b x
  map_one' := by
    have h:=F.split 1 1
    simp only [map_one,F.left_one,one_mul,mul_one] at h
    exact mul_left_cancel (show F.b 1*F.b 1=F.b 1*1 by simpa using h)
  map_mul' x y := by
    have h:=F.split x.val y.val
    rw [(show q x.val=1 from x.property),F.left_one,one_mul] at h
    exact h.symm

    (left : ∀ x,c 1 x=1) (right : ∀ x,c x 1=1) (u s:G → ℂˣ)
    (root : ∀ x,(u x)^2=χ x) (sign : ∀ x,(s x)^2=1)
    (boundary : ∀ x y, (u x*u y/u (x*y))*((s x*s y)/s (x*y))=c (q x) (q y)) :
    ∃ F : InflatedSplitting (K:=ℂˣ) q, F.factor=c ∧ (∀ x,(F.b x)^2=χ x) ∧
      ∀ x,(F.b x)^(2*m)=1 := by

    (degree : Module.finrank ℚ L≤576)
    (F : InflatedSplitting (K:=ℂˣ) (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L : GQ →* (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L)))
    (dy:GQ →* ℂˣ) (dy2 : ∀ g, (dy g)^2=1)
    (ι : ∀ p:ℕ, GQ →* (ZMod p)ˣ) (χ : ∀ p:ℕ, (ZMod p)ˣ →* ℂˣ)
    (square : ∀ g, (F.b g)^2 = dy g * ∏ p ∈ R.primeFactors, χ p (ι p g))
    (det:GQ →* ℂˣ) (det2:∀ g ∈ F.restrict.ker.map (markingGroup L).subtype, (det g)^2=1) :
    ScalarTower R :=
  scalarTower_of_local_characters L degree dy dy2 ι χ F.restrict
    (fun x => square x.val) F.restrict_conjugate det det2

private theorem blocks (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) (i j k : Fin 2) (v:V) :
    block β i j (block β j k v) = block β i k v := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.diagonal
declarations.snippet:
private theorem diagonal (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) (v:V) :
    block β 0 0 v+block β 1 1 v=v := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.different_blocks
declarations.snippet:
private theorem different_blocks (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V)
    (i j k l : Fin 2) (h : j≠k) (v:V) : block β i j (block β k l v)=0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.firstBlock
declarations.snippet: abbrev firstBlock (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) := LinearMap.range (block β 0 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.intoBlock
ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.first_fixed
declarations.snippet:
private theorem first_fixed (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) (x : firstBlock β) :
    block β 0 0 (x:V)=x := by obtain ⟨v,h⟩:=x.property;rw [←h,blocks]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.two_blocks
declarations.snippet:
def two_blocks (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) :
    V ≃ₗ[K] firstBlock β × firstBlock β where
  toFun v := (intoBlock β 0 v,intoBlock β 1 v)
  map_add' := by intros;ext <;> simp
  map_smul' := by intros;ext <;> simp
  invFun z := z.1.val + block β 1 0 z.2.val
  left_inv v := by change block β 0 0 v + block β 1 0 (block β 0 1 v)=v; rw [blocks,diagonal]
  right_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change block β 0 0 _=_
      rw [map_add,first_fixed,different_blocks β 0 0 1 0 (by decide),add_zero]
    · change block β 0 1 _=_
      rw [map_add,blocks,first_fixed]
      obtain ⟨v,h⟩:=z.1.property
      rw [←h,different_blocks β 0 1 0 0 (by decide),zero_add]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.block_dimension
declarations.snippet:
theorem block_dimension [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) (dim : Module.finrank K V=4) :
    Module.finrank K (firstBlock β)=2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.WildLevel.repeated_action
declarations.snippet:
theorem repeated_action (β : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Module.End K V) (T:V →ₗ[K] V)
    (compatible : ∀ (M:Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) v,T (β M v)=β M (T v)) :
    ∃ S : firstBlock β →ₗ[K] firstBlock β,∀ v,
       two_blocks β (T v)=(S (two_blocks β v).1,S (two_blocks β v).2) := by

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.poly3
declarations.snippet: def poly3 (co:Fin 4→ℤ) (u v:ℤ) := co 0*v^3+co 1*u*v^2+co 2*u^2*v+co 3*u^3

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.polyNorm
declarations.snippet: def polyNorm (co:Fin 4→ℤ) := |co 0|+|co 1|+|co 2|+|co 3|

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.bezout_relations
declarations.snippet:
theorem bezout_relations (j:Fin 5) (u v:ℤ) :
    (poly3 (cof j 0) u v * N (a j) (b j) (c j) u v+
       poly3 (cof j 1) u v * D (a j) (b j) (c j) u v=bezoutR j*u^7) ∧
    (poly3 (cof j 2) u v * N (a j) (b j) (c j) u v+
       poly3 (cof j 3) u v * D (a j) (b j) (c j) u v=bezoutR j*v^7) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.cofactor_bounds
declarations.snippet:
theorem cofactor_bounds (j:Fin 5) : 0<bezoutR j ∧
    polyNorm (cof j 0)+polyNorm (cof j 1)≤2^180 ∧
    polyNorm (cof j 2)+polyNorm (cof j 3)≤2^180 := by fin_cases j <;> decide

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.F
declarations.snippet: def F (a b c u v : R) : R := u^3 + a*u^2*v + b*u*v^2 + c*v^3

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.D
declarations.snippet: def D (a b c u v : R) : R := 4*v*F a b c u v

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.three_identity
declarations.snippet:
theorem three_identity (a b c u v:R) :
    N a b c u v*v - D a b c u v*u = -v*Psi a b c u v := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.twist
declarations.snippet: def twist (a b c d : ℚ) : WeierstrassCurve ℚ := ⟨0,a*d,0,b*d^2,c*d^3⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.Represents
declarations.snippet:
def Represents {a b c d : ℚ} (P:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Point) (u v : ℚ) : Prop :=
  match P with
  | .zero => v=0
  | .some x _ _ => d*u=x*v

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.curve_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem curve_eq {a b c d x y : ℚ} (valid:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    y^2 = x^3+(a*d)*x^2+(b*d^2)*x+c*d^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.tangent_identity
declarations.snippet:
private theorem tangent_identity (a b c d t y : ℚ) (dn:d≠0) (yn:y≠0)
    (e:y^2=d^3*F a b c t 1) :
    d*N a b c t 1 =
      (((3*(d*t)^2+2*(a*d)*(d*t)+b*d^2)/(2*y))^2-a*d-d*t-d*t)*D a b c t 1 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.represents_double
declarations.snippet:
theorem represents_double {a b c d u v : ℚ} (dn:d≠0)
    (P:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Point) (rep:Represents P u v) :
    Represents (P+P) (N a b c u v) (D a b c u v) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.cross
declarations.snippet:
theorem cross {a b c d u v s t : ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Point)
    (p:Represents P u v) (q:Represents P s t) : u*t=v*s := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.represents_neg
declarations.snippet:
theorem represents_neg {a b c d u v : ℚ} (P:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Point) :
    Represents (-P) u v ↔ Represents P u v := by cases P <;> rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.primitivePair
declarations.snippet:
def primitivePair {j:Fin 5} {d:ℚ} (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point) : ℤ×ℤ :=
  match P with
  | .zero => (1,0)
  | .some x _ _ => ((x/d).num,(x/d).den)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.pointBox
declarations.snippet:
def pointBox {j:Fin 5} {d:ℚ} (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point) : ℤ :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.pair_represents
declarations.snippet:
theorem pair_represents {j:Fin 5} {d:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point) :
    Represents P ((primitivePair P).1:ℚ) ((primitivePair P).2:ℚ) ∧
      IsCoprime (primitivePair P).1 (primitivePair P).2 ∧ 0<pointBox P := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.duplication_growth
declarations.snippet:
theorem duplication_growth {j:Fin 5} {d:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point) :
    (pointBox P)^4 ≤ 2^180*pointBox (P+P) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.finite_box
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_box {j:Fin 5} {d:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point)
    (tor:IsOfFinAddOrder P) : pointBox P≤2^60 := by

declarations.snippet:
private theorem height_of_rep {j:Fin 5} {d t:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point)
    (h:Represents P t 1) (tor:IsOfFinAddOrder P) : logHeight₁ t≤60 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.torsion_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem torsion_height {j:Fin 5} {d s:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (P:(model j d).toAffine.Point)
    (rep:Represents P ((k j:ℚ)*chart j s) 1) (tor:IsOfFinAddOrder P) : logHeight₁ s≤80 := by

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.box
declarations.snippet: def box (u v:ℤ) : ℤ := max |u| |v|

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.primitive_proportional

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.poly3_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem poly3_bound (co:Fin 4→ℤ) (u v:ℤ) :
    |poly3 co u v| ≤ polyNorm co*(box u v)^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.primitive_growth
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_growth (j:Fin 5) {u v n e g:ℤ} (prim:IsCoprime u v)
    (nrep:N (a j) (b j) (c j) u v=g*n)
    (erep:D (a j) (b j) (c j) u v=g*e) (hp:0<box u v) :
    (box u v)^4 ≤ 2^180*box n e := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.model

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.monic_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem monic_chart (j:Fin 5) (t:ℚ) :
    F (a j:ℚ) (b j) (c j) ((k j:ℚ)*t) 1 = (k j:ℚ)^2*cubic j t := by

declarations.snippet: private theorem scale_nonzero (j:Fin 5) : (k j:ℚ)≠0 := by fin_cases j <;> decide

ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.translated_height

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.dup
declarations.snippet: def dup (a b c:R) (p:R×R) : R×R := (N a b c p.1 p.2, D a b c p.1 p.2)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.Test
declarations.snippet:
inductive Test | atStart | atDouble | atFour | threeAfterDouble
  deriving DecidableEq

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.test
declarations.snippet:
def test (a b c : R) (i:Test) (u v:R) : R :=
  let p := dup a b c (u,v)
  let q := dup a b c p
  match i with
  | .atStart => F a b c u v
  | .atDouble => F a b c p.1 p.2
  | .atFour => F a b c q.1 q.2
  | .threeAfterDouble => Psi a b c p.1 p.2

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.exponent_test
declarations.snippet:
theorem exponent_test {a b c d u v:ℚ} (dn:d≠0) (vn:v≠0)
    (P:(twist a b c d).toAffine.Point) (h:Represents P u v)
    (ord:(4:ℕ) • P=0 ∨ (6:ℕ) • P=0 ∨ (8:ℕ) • P=0) :
    ∃ j, test a b c j u v=0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.weight
declarations.snippet:
def weight : Test → ℕ
  | .atStart => 3 | .atDouble => 12 | .atFour => 48 | .threeAfterDouble => 16

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.f_scale
declarations.snippet: private theorem f_scale (a b c k u v:R) : F a b c (k*u) (k*v) = k^3*F a b c u v := by unfold F;ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.n_scale
declarations.snippet: private theorem n_scale (a b c k u v:R) : N a b c (k*u) (k*v) = k^4*N a b c u v := by unfold N;ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.d_scale
declarations.snippet: private theorem d_scale (a b c k u v:R) : D a b c (k*u) (k*v) = k^4*D a b c u v := by unfold D;rw [f_scale];ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.psi_scale
declarations.snippet: private theorem psi_scale (a b c k u v:R) : Psi a b c (k*u) (k*v) = k^4*Psi a b c u v := by unfold Psi;ring

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.test_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem test_scale (a b c k u v:R) (j:Test) :
    test a b c j (k*u) (k*v) = k^weight j * test a b c j u v := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.map_test
declarations.snippet:
theorem map_test (g:R →+* S) (a b c u v:R) (j:Test) :
    g (test a b c j u v)=test (g a) (g b) (g c) j (g u) (g v) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.top
declarations.snippet:
def top : Test → ℤ
  | .threeAfterDouble => 3 | _ => 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.test_at_infty
declarations.snippet: theorem test_at_infty (a b c:R) (j:Test) : test a b c j 1 0=(top j:R) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.primitive_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_root {a b c u v : ℤ} (prim:Nat.Coprime u.natAbs v.natAbs)
    (j:Test) (h:test a b c j (u+3*v) v=0) :
    u.natAbs ∣ (test a b c j 3 1).natAbs ∧ v.natAbs ∣ (top j).natAbs := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.MarkedTorsion.rational_root
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_root {a b c:ℤ} (z:ℚ) (j:Test) (h:test (a:ℚ) b c j (z+3) 1=0) :
    z.num.natAbs ∣ (test a b c j 3 1).natAbs ∧ z.den ∣ (top j).natAbs := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.divisor_box

    (∑ m ∈ Icc 1 K, ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, f d) =

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.sum_omega

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.flip

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.flip_square

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.flip_inj
declarations.snippet: private theorem flip_inj {z : ℚ} (nz:z≠0) {a b : Bool} (h : flip a z=flip b z) : a=b := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.four_points
declarations.snippet:
theorem four_points (C : ℝ) (point : PointCount C) {d e : ℤ} (sd : Squarefree d)

    (lifts : ∀x : ↥X, ∃q : ℚ×ℚ, q.1≠0 ∧ q.2≠0 ∧

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.supportSet

    ((exceptions B).card:ℝ)≤C*(K:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (K:ℝ))^n := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.choiceWeight
declarations.snippet: def choiceWeight (i : Fin 3) : ℕ := ![49,2401,49] i

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.choices
declarations.snippet: abbrev choices (m : ℕ) := (p : m.primeFactors) → Fin 3

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.assignmentWeight
declarations.snippet: def assignmentWeight {m : ℕ} (f : choices m) : ℕ := ∏ p, choiceWeight (f p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.sum_choices
declarations.snippet: theorem sum_choices (m : ℕ) : (∑ f : choices m, assignmentWeight f) = 2499^omega m := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.code
declarations.snippet:
def code (m : ℕ) (x : ℚ) : choices m := fun p=>
  if p.1∈(D x.num x.den).natAbs.primeFactors then
    if p.1∈(E x.num x.den).natAbs.primeFactors then 2 else 0 else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.signs
declarations.snippet:
def signs (x : ℚ) : Bool × Bool :=
  (decide (D x.num x.den < 0),decide (E x.num x.den < 0))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.TwistCountCertificate
declarations.snippet:
def TwistCountCertificate (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (s : Bool × Bool) (f : choices m) (X : Finset ℚ),
    (∀ x∈X, offMarks x ∧ label x=m ∧ signs x=s ∧ code m x=f) →
    (X.card:ℝ)≤C*(assignmentWeight f:ℝ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.supportCount_of_certificate
declarations.snippet:
theorem supportCount_of_certificate {C : ℝ} (cert : TwistCountCertificate C) :
    SupportCount 2499 (4*C) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.exceptional_count_of_twists
declarations.snippet:
theorem exceptional_count_of_twists {B K : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (c : 0≤C) (cert : TwistCountCertificate C)
    (threshold : Real.log (B:ℝ)≤((K+1:ℕ):ℝ)^24) :
    ((exceptions B).card:ℝ)≤4*C*(K:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (K:ℝ))^2498 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.position
declarations.snippet:
def position (d e : ℤ) (p : ℕ) : Fin 3 :=
  if p∈d.natAbs.primeFactors then if p∈e.natAbs.primeFactors then 2 else 0 else 1

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.primeCost
declarations.snippet: def primeCost (d e : ℤ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ parameterPrimes d e,choiceWeight (position d e p)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.cost_eq
declarations.snippet:
theorem cost_eq {x : ℚ} {m : ℕ} (hx : label x=m) :
    primeCost (D x.num x.den) (E x.num x.den)=assignmentWeight (code m x) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.squarefree_determined
declarations.snippet:
private theorem squarefree_determined {a b : ℤ} (sa : Squarefree a) (sb : Squarefree b)
    (f : a.natAbs.primeFactors=b.natAbs.primeFactors) (s : (a<0 ↔ b<0)) : a=b := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.same_twist
declarations.snippet:
theorem same_twist {x y : ℚ} {m : ℕ} (ox : offMarks x) (oy : offMarks y)
    (lx : label x=m) (ly : label y=m) (sg : signs x=signs y) (types : code m x=code m y) :
    D x.num x.den=D y.num y.den ∧ E x.num x.den=E y.num y.den := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.PointCount
declarations.snippet:
def PointCount (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d e : ℤ, Squarefree d → Squarefree e → ∀ Y : Finset (ℚ×ℚ),
    (∀ q∈Y, q.1≠0 ∧ q.2≠0 ∧ (e:ℚ)*q.2^2=sextic d q.1) →
    (Y.card:ℝ)≤C*primeCost d e

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.certificate_of_pointCount
declarations.snippet: theorem certificate_of_pointCount {C : ℝ} (c : 0≤C) (point : PointCount C) : TwistCountCertificate C := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwistCount.exceptional_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem exceptional_count {B K : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (c : 0≤C) (point : PointCount C)
    (threshold : Real.log (B:ℝ)≤((K+1:ℕ):ℝ)^24) :
    ((exceptions B).card:ℝ)≤4*C*(K:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (K:ℝ))^2498 :=

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.form
declarations.snippet: def form (j : Bool) (t : ℚ) := if j then reversed t else cubic t

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.lead
declarations.snippet: def lead (j : Bool) : ℚ := if j then -900000 else 823543

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.coeff2
declarations.snippet: def coeff2 (j : Bool) : ℚ := if j then 2623575 else -2547118

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.coeff1
declarations.snippet: def coeff1 (j : Bool) : ℚ := if j then -2547118 else 2623575

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.coeff0
declarations.snippet: def coeff0 (j : Bool) : ℚ := if j then 823543 else -900000

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.reciprocal
declarations.snippet: theorem reciprocal {t : ℚ} (ht : t≠0) : reversed t⁻¹ = cubic t/t^3 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.model
declarations.snippet:
def model (j : Bool) (c : ℚ) : WeierstrassCurve ℚ :=
  ⟨0,c*coeff2 j,0,c^2*lead j*coeff1 j,c^3*(lead j)^2*coeff0 j⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.cubic_coefficients
declarations.snippet:
theorem cubic_coefficients (j : Bool) (t : ℚ) :
    form j t=lead j*t^3+coeff2 j*t^2+coeff1 j*t+coeff0 j := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.smooth
declarations.snippet: private theorem smooth (j : Bool) {c : ℚ} (hc : c≠0) : (model j c).Δ≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.cubic_point
declarations.snippet:
theorem cubic_point (j : Bool) {t v c : ℚ} (hc : c≠0) (eqn : v^2=c*form j t) :
    ∃ P:(model j c).toAffine.Point, P.xRep 0=c*lead j*t ∧ P≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.two_images
declarations.snippet:
theorem two_images {d e : ℤ} {x y : ℚ} (nd : d≠0) (ne : e≠0) (nx : x≠0)
    (curve : (e:ℚ)*y^2=sextic d x) :
    let t:ℚ:=(d:ℚ)*x^2
    ∃ P:(model false (e:ℚ)).toAffine.Point, ∃ Q:(model true ((d:ℚ)*e)).toAffine.Point,
      P.xRep 0=(e:ℚ)*lead false*t ∧ Q.xRep 0=((d:ℚ)*e)*lead true*t⁻¹ ∧ P≠0 ∧ Q≠0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.lift_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem lift_iff {d e : ℤ} {t v : ℚ} (he : (e:ℚ)≠0) (ht : t≠0) (hv : v≠0)
    (onCubic : v^2=(e:ℚ)*cubic t) :
    (∃ x y : ℚ, x≠0 ∧ y≠0 ∧ t=(d:ℚ)*x^2 ∧ v=(e:ℚ)*y ∧ (e:ℚ)*y^2=sextic d x) ↔
      ∃ x : ℚ, t=(d:ℚ)*x^2 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TwoEllipticMaps.images_of_slope
declarations.snippet:
theorem images_of_slope {A B : ℤ} (off : ∀ i,oldForm i A B≠0) :
    ∃ x y : ℚ, x≠0 ∧ y≠0 ∧ parameter (D A B) x=(A:ℚ)/B ∧
      let t:ℚ:=(D A B:ℚ)*x^2
      ∃ P:(model false (E A B:ℚ)).toAffine.Point, ∃ Q:(model true ((D A B:ℚ)*E A B)).toAffine.Point,
        P.xRep 0=(E A B:ℚ)*lead false*t ∧ Q.xRep 0=((D A B:ℚ)*E A B)*lead true*t⁻¹ ∧ P≠0 ∧ Q≠0 := by

Sun28.ScalarPlaces.dyadic_coordinates

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.transport
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.transport_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
private theorem transport_coordinates {a b : K0} (e : a=b) (Q : (curve a).Point) :
    reciprocal (transport e Q)=reciprocal Q ∧ parameter (transport e Q)=parameter Q := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scalar_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_coordinates (Q : CPoint) :
    reciprocal (scalarEquiv Q)=reciprocal (b:= -delta^2) Q ∧
    parameter (scalarEquiv Q)=parameter (b:= -delta^2) Q :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scaled_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem scaled_coordinates (Q : genCurve.toAffine.Point) :
    reciprocal (scalarEquiv (theta Q))=xi Q/(epsilon^4) ∧
    parameter (scalarEquiv (theta Q))=zCoord (A:= -genD^2) Q/(epsilon^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scaled_multiple
declarations.snippet:
theorem scaled_multiple (n : ℤ) :
    reciprocal (scalarEquiv (n • P))=xi (n • genP0)/epsilon^4 ∧
    parameter (scalarEquiv (n • P))=zCoord (A:= -genD^2) (n • genP0)/epsilon^2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.unit_epsilon
declarations.snippet: theorem unit_epsilon {π : Zs} (hπ : Prime π) : vP π hπ epsilon=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.parameter_order_multiple
declarations.snippet:
theorem parameter_order_multiple {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ)) {A : K} (hA : 0≤v A)
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {e : ℤ} (ep : 1≤e) (small : e≤3) (hp : v (p:K)=(e:WithTop ℤ))
    (res : ∀ m : ℤ, ¬(p:ℤ)∣m → v (m:K)=0)
    {k : ℤ} {Q : (shortCurve A).toAffine.Point} (mem : Q∈W1 v A)
    (depth : v (zCoord Q)=(k:WithTop ℤ)) {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) :
    v (zCoord (m • Q))=((k+e*padicValInt p m:ℤ):WithTop ℤ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.formalZ
declarations.snippet: abbrev formalZ (Q : genCurve.toAffine.Point) := zCoord (A:= -genD^2) Q

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scalarRec
declarations.snippet: abbrev scalarRec (n : ℤ) := reciprocal (scalarEquiv (n • P))

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scalarParam
declarations.snippet: abbrev scalarParam (n : ℤ) := parameter (scalarEquiv (n • P))

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scaled_orders
declarations.snippet:
theorem scaled_orders {π : Zs} (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℤ) :
    vP π hπ (scalarRec n)=vP π hπ (xi (n • genP0)) ∧
    vP π hπ (scalarParam n)=vP π hπ (formalZ (n • genP0)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.pair_at
declarations.snippet:
private theorem pair_at (π : Zs) (hπ : Prime π) {κ : ℕ}
    (positive : 0<κ) {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {e : ℤ} (ep : 1≤e) (small : e≤3)
    (hp : vP π hπ (p:K0)=(e:WithTop ℤ))
    (res : ∀ m : ℤ, ¬(p:ℤ)∣m → vP π hπ (m:K0)=0)
    (inGroup : (κ:ℤ) • genP0∈W1 (vP π hπ) (-genD^2))
    {h c : ℤ} (hn : h≠0) (cn : c≠0) (dh : (κ:ℤ)∣h) (dc : (κ:ℤ)∣c) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, 1≤k ∧
      (let depth (n : ℤ) := k+e*((padicValInt p n:ℤ)-padicValNat p κ)
       ((2*depth h:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vP π hπ (scalarRec h) ∧
       ((2*depth c:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vP π hπ (scalarRec c) ∧
       vP π hπ (scalarParam c/scalarParam h)=((e*((padicValInt p c:ℤ)-padicValInt p h):ℤ):WithTop ℤ)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.odd_pair
declarations.snippet:
theorem odd_pair {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (odd : p≠2) (π : Zs) (hπ : Prime π)
    (above : π∣(p:Zs)) {κ : ℕ} (positive : 0<κ) (multiple : orderAbove p∣κ)
    {h c : ℤ} (hn : h≠0) (cn : c≠0) (dh : (κ:ℤ)∣h) (dc : (κ:ℤ)∣c) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, 1≤k ∧
      (let depth (n : ℤ) := k+((padicValInt p n:ℤ)-padicValNat p κ)
       ((2*depth h:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vP π hπ (scalarRec h) ∧
       ((2*depth c:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vP π hπ (scalarRec c) ∧
       vP π hπ (scalarParam c/scalarParam h)=((((padicValInt p c:ℤ)-padicValInt p h):ℤ):WithTop ℤ)) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.dyadic_pair
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_pair {κ : ℕ} (positive : 0<κ) {h c : ℤ} (hn : h≠0) (cn : c≠0)
    (dh : (κ:ℤ)∣h) (dc : (κ:ℤ)∣c) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, 1≤k ∧
      (let depth (n : ℤ) := k+2*((padicValInt 2 n:ℤ)-padicValNat 2 κ)
       ((2*depth h:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vS (scalarRec h) ∧
       ((2*depth c:ℤ):WithTop ℤ)≤vS (scalarRec c) ∧
       vS (scalarParam c/scalarParam h)=((2*((padicValInt 2 c:ℤ)-padicValInt 2 h):ℤ):WithTop ℤ)) :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.supportPlaces
declarations.snippet: def supportPlaces (r : ℤ) : Finset ℕ := primes ∪ r.natAbs.primeFactors

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.support_prime
declarations.snippet: theorem support_prime {r : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p∈supportPlaces r) : p.Prime := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.kernelMod
declarations.snippet:
def kernelMod (r : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  (Nat.factorial 576) * ∏ p∈supportPlaces r, (p * orderAbove p)

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.comparisonDepth
declarations.snippet:
def comparisonDepth (r : ℤ) (p : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  6 + padicValNat p (kernelMod r) + padicValInt p r

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.stepMod
declarations.snippet:
def stepMod (r : ℤ) (M : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  M * kernelMod r * ∏ p∈supportPlaces r, p^(comparisonDepth r p + 1 + 48 * padicValInt p r)

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.kernel_positive
declarations.snippet: theorem kernel_positive (r : ℤ) : 0<kernelMod r :=

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.step_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem step_spec (r : ℤ) {M : ℕ} (hm : 0<M) :
    0<stepMod r M ∧ M∣stepMod r M ∧ kernelMod r∣stepMod r M := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.local_steps
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_steps {r : ℤ} {M p : ℕ} (hp : p∈supportPlaces r) {h c : ℤ} (cn : c≠0)
    (dc : (stepMod r M:ℤ)∣c) (exact_h : padicValInt p h = comparisonDepth r p) :
    orderAbove p∣kernelMod r ∧
    1+padicValInt p r≤(padicValInt p h:ℤ)-padicValNat p (kernelMod r) ∧
    1+48*(padicValInt p r:ℤ)≤(padicValInt p c:ℤ)-padicValInt p h := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.multiple_depths
declarations.snippet:
theorem multiple_depths {r h c : ℤ} {p M : ℕ} (pp : p∈supportPlaces r)
    (mp : 0<M) (hn : h≠0) (cn : c≠0) (hc : (kernelMod r:ℤ)∣h) (cc : (stepMod r M:ℤ)∣c)
    (exact_h : padicValInt p h=comparisonDepth r p) :
    Deep p (1+padicValInt p r) (scalarRec h) ∧ Deep p (1+padicValInt p r) (scalarRec c) ∧
    Deep p (1+48*padicValInt p r) (scalarParam c/scalarParam h) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scalar_unit_of_indices
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_unit_of_indices {r : ℤ} (rn : r≠0) {p M : ℕ} (pp : p∈supportPlaces r)
    (mp : 0<M) {w : NinePoints} {a : Labels} {b c : ℤ} (data : Consequences w M b a)
    (step : a.n 1-1=c) (hc : (kernelMod r:ℤ)∣a.h) (cc : (stepMod r M:ℤ)∣c)
    (exact_h : padicValInt p a.h=comparisonDepth r p) :
    scalarTree (r:ℚ) (scalarEntries w M)≠0 ∧ padicValRat p (scalarTree (r:ℚ) (scalarEntries w M))=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.divided_coefficient
declarations.snippet:
theorem divided_coefficient {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {r : ℤ} (rn : r≠0)
    {k : ℕ} {x : ℚ} (bound : x≠0 → 1+(k:ℤ)*padicValInt p r≤padicValRat p x) :
    1≤ratOrder p (x/(r:ℚ)^k) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarPlaces.scalar_unit_of_depths
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_unit_of_depths {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {r : ℤ} (rn : r≠0)
    (w : NinePoints) (M : ℕ)
    (h : Deep p (1+padicValInt p r) (reciprocal (scalarEquiv w.H)))
    (s : Deep p (1+padicValInt p r) (reciprocal (scalarEquiv (scalarPoint w M))))
    (quotient : Deep p (1+48*padicValInt p r)
      (parameter (scalarEquiv (scalarPoint w M))/parameter (scalarEquiv w.H))) :
    scalarTree (r:ℚ) (scalarEntries w M)≠0 ∧
      padicValRat p (scalarTree (r:ℚ) (scalarEntries w M))=0 := by

Sun28.Scalar.curve
declarations.snippet: def curve (b : K) : WeierstrassCurve.Affine K := ⟨0,0,0,b,0⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.parameter
declarations.snippet:
def parameter {b : K} : (curve b).Point → K
  | .zero => 0
  | .some x y _ => -x/y

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.reciprocal
declarations.snippet:
def reciprocal {b : K} : (curve b).Point → K
  | .zero => 0
  | .some x _ _ => x⁻¹

declarations.snippet:

    y^2=x^3+b*x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.double_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem double_coordinates {b x y : K} (h : (curve b).Nonsingular x y) (hy : y≠0) :
    ∃ (u v : K) (h' : (curve b).Nonsingular u v),
      (2:ℕ) • (Point.some x y h : (curve b).Point) = Point.some u v h' ∧
      u*(4*(-x/y)^2)=1-4*b*(-x/y)^4 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.FormalComparison
declarations.snippet:
def FormalComparison (p : ℕ) (w : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ)) {b : K}
    (P : (curve b).Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m n : ℤ), m ≠ 0 → n ≠ 0 →
    0 < w (reciprocal (m • P)) → 0 < w (reciprocal (n • P)) →
    parameter (m • P) ≠ 0 → parameter (n • P) ≠ 0 →
    w (parameter (m • P) / parameter (n • P)) =
      ((padicValInt p m : ℤ) - (padicValInt p n : ℤ) : ℤ)

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.parameter_of_reciprocal_order
declarations.snippet:
private theorem parameter_of_reciprocal_order (w : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ)) {b : K}
    (hb : 0≤w b) (H : (curve b).Point) (hr : reciprocal H ≠ 0)
    (high : (1:WithTop ℤ)≤w (reciprocal H)) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, 0<d ∧ w (parameter H)=(d:WithTop ℤ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Scalar.scalar_index_dvd
declarations.snippet:
theorem scalar_index_dvd {p k : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 2<p)
    (w : AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ)) {b : K} (hb : 0≤w b) (h2 : w (2:K)=0)
    (P : (curve b).Point) (compare : FormalComparison p w P)
    {h n : ℤ} (hn : n≠0) (hh : h≠0)

declarations.name: Sun28.ShortFormal.kernelChart
declarations.snippet:
def kernelChart {b : L} (hb : 0≤vK L b) : EllipticKernelChart (vK L) b where
  kernel := formalNbhd b hb
  membership := by
    intro P hx hp
    apply (mem_formalNbhd_iff hb P).2
    cases P with
    | zero => exact zero_mem_W1 _
    | some x y hy =>
      change 0<vK L x⁻¹ at hx
      have nz : x≠0 := by rintro rfl; exact hp (by simp [parameter])
      obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := val_eq_coe (v:=vK L) nz
      rw [val_inv_coe hm] at hx
      change vK L x<0
      rw [hm]
      have hn : (0:ℤ)< -m := by exact_mod_cast hx
      exact_mod_cast (show m<0 by omega)
  F := ↥(formalNbhd b hb)
  addGroup := inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup ↥(formalNbhd b hb))
  coordinate := fun P => zCoord P.val
  integral := fun P => P.2.2
  chart := AddEquiv.refl ↥(formalNbhd b hb)
  chart_parameter := by
    rintro ⟨P,hP⟩
    change zCoord P=parameter P
    cases P <;> rfl

  toFun := fun P => ellLog ((show ↥(formalNbhd b hb) from P).val)
  map_zero' := ellLog_zero

    let h := a.gaussian j
    tcoord g h * (g.1-h.1) = gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2 - xcoord g h*zcoord g h := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.order_difference
declarations.snippet:
theorem order_difference (a : Candidate A d H Y) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) :
    (adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true : ℤ) - adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false =
      gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2 + 2*tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.ray_order_difference_ne_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem ray_order_difference_ne_zero (a : Candidate A d H Y) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) :
    gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2 + 2*tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j) ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.chart_product_identity
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_product_identity (t x z k v : ℤ) :
    (k*v^2 - x*z+t^2+2*t)^2+t^2*(x+z)^2 -
      (t^2+x^2)*(t^2+z^2) =
    (k*v^2+2*t)*(k*v^2+2*t+2*t^2-2*x*z) := by ring

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.mixed_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem mixed_chart {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (a : Candidate A d H Y)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (plus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true)
    (minus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false) :
    let g := a.gaussian i
    let h := a.gaussian j
    let t := tcoord g h
    let x := xcoord g h
    let z := zcoord g h
    (p:ℤ) ∣ gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2+2*t ∧
    ((p:ℤ) ∣ t^2+x^2 ∨ (p:ℤ) ∣ t^2+z^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.divisor_or_single_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem divisor_or_single_chart {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (a : Candidate A d H Y)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (away : ¬(p:ℤ) ∣ gap i j)
    (plus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true)
    (minus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false) :
    p ∣ a.v ∨
      (¬(p:ℤ) ∣ tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)) ∧
      (p:ℤ) ∣ gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2+2*tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j) ∧
      ((p:ℤ) ∣ tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)^2+xcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)^2 ∨
       (p:ℤ) ∣ tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)^2+zcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.inert_divides_parameter
declarations.snippet:
theorem inert_divides_parameter {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (a : Candidate A d H Y)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (away : ¬(p:ℤ) ∣ gap i j) (inert : p%4=3)
    (plus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true)
    (minus : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false) : p ∣ a.v := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.ray_t_ne_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem ray_t_ne_zero (a : Candidate A d H Y) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) :
    tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j) ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.primitive_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_fibre {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {K x z : ℤ}
    (cong : (m:ℤ) ∣ K-x*z) :
    0 < Int.gcd (m:ℤ) x ∧
    Int.gcd (m:ℤ) x ∣ K.natAbs ∧
    (∀ z' : ℤ, (m:ℤ) ∣ K-x*z' →
      z ≡ z' [ZMOD (m:ℤ)/(Int.gcd (m:ℤ) x:ℤ)]) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.prime_divisors_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem prime_divisors_card {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.primeFactors.card ≤ Nat.log 2 n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.primitive_root
Sun28.SieveTail.roots_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem roots_card {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (U : ZMod p) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun X : ZMod p => X^2= -U^2)).card ≤ 2 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.candidate_chart
declarations.snippet:
theorem candidate_chart {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (a : Candidate A d H Y)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (ij : i≠j)
    (hp : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian i) true)
    (hm : p ∣ adjacentNorm (a.gaussian j) false) :
    let t := tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)
    let x := xcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)
    let z := zcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)
    let K := gap i j*(a.v:ℤ)^2
    t≠0 ∧ K≠0 ∧ p ∈ (K+2*t).natAbs.primeFactors ∧
      ∃ X Z : ℤ, ((X=x ∧ Z=z) ∨ (X=z ∧ Z=x)) ∧
        (p:ℤ) ∣ t^2+X^2 ∧ (t.natAbs:ℤ) ∣ K-X*Z ∧
        Int.gcd (t.natAbs:ℤ) X ∣ K.natAbs ∧
        (∀ Z' : ℤ, (t.natAbs:ℤ) ∣ K-X*Z' →
          Z ≡ Z' [ZMOD (t.natAbs:ℤ)/(Int.gcd (t.natAbs:ℤ) X:ℤ)]) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.chart_injective
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_injective (boxes : CountingBoxes A d H Y) (N : ℕ)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) {a b : Candidate A d H Y}
    (ha : a∈boxes.records N) (hb : b∈boxes.records N)
    (hv : a.v=b.v)
    (ht : tcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)=tcoord (b.gaussian i) (b.gaussian j))
    (hx : xcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)=xcoord (b.gaussian i) (b.gaussian j))
    (hz : zcoord (a.gaussian i) (a.gaussian j)=zcoord (b.gaussian i) (b.gaussian j)) : a=b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.interval_class
declarations.snippet:
theorem interval_class (a b r v : ℤ) (ab : a ≤ b) (pr : 0 < r) :
    (((Finset.Ico a b).filter (fun n => n ≡ v [ZMOD r])).card:ℚ) ≤
      ((b:ℚ)-a)/r+1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.interval
declarations.snippet: def interval (B : ℕ) : Finset ℤ := Finset.Ico (-(B:ℤ)) ((B:ℤ)+1)

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.one_class
declarations.snippet:
theorem one_class (B r : ℕ) (rpos : 0<r) (S : Finset ℤ)
    (bound : S⊆interval B)
    (same : ∀ x∈S,∀ y∈S,x ≡ y [ZMOD (r:ℤ)]) :
    (S.card:ℚ) ≤ (2*(B:ℚ)+1)/r+1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.fibre_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem fibre_bound {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (f : α→β)
    (into : (S:Set α).MapsTo f T) (C : ℚ)
    (per : ∀ t∈T,((S.filter (fun s => f s=t)).card:ℚ) ≤ C) :
    (S.card:ℚ) ≤ T.card*C := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.horizontal_count
declarations.snippet:
theorem horizontal_count {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (B g : ℕ) (gp : 0 < g) (U : ℤ)
    (S : Finset ℤ) (bound : S⊆interval B) (multiples : ∀ x∈S,(g:ℤ) ∣ x)
    (root : ∀ x∈S, (p:ℤ) ∣ ((g:ℤ)*U)^2+x^2) :
    (S.card:ℚ) ≤ if p∣g then (2*(B:ℚ)+1)/g+1 else 2*((2*(B:ℚ)+1)/(g*p)+1) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.fixed_slice
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixed_slice {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (B g q : ℕ) (gp : 0 < g) (qp : 0 < q)
    (K : ℤ) (S : Finset (ℤ×ℤ))
    (inBox : ∀ a∈S,a.1∈interval B ∧ a.2∈interval B)
    (common : ∀ a∈S, Int.gcd ((g*q:ℕ):ℤ) a.1=g)
    (hyper : ∀ a∈S, ((g*q:ℕ):ℤ) ∣ K-a.1*a.2)
    (form : ∀ a∈S,(p:ℤ) ∣ ((g*q:ℕ):ℤ)^2+a.1^2) :
    let L := 2*(B:ℚ)+1
    (S.card:ℚ) ≤ (if p∣g then L/g+1 else 2*(L/(g*p)+1))*(L/q+1) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.slice_cutoff
declarations.snippet:
theorem slice_cutoff {B g q p R : ℕ} (gp : 0 < g) (_qp : 0 < q) (rp : 0 < R) (large : R < p) :
    sliceBound B g q p ≤ 2*((2*(B:ℚ)+1)/R+1)*((2*(B:ℚ)+1)/q+1) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.prime_count_uniform
declarations.snippet:
theorem prime_count_uniform (K : ℤ) {t : ℤ} {B : ℕ} (ht : t.natAbs≤B)
    (R : ℕ) :
    ((K+2*t).natAbs.primeFactors.filter (fun p => R<p)).card ≤ Nat.log 2 (K.natAbs+2*B) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.sum_progression_cost
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.fixed_v_saving
declarations.snippet:
theorem fixed_v_saving {A : Fin 3→ℚ} {d : ℕ} {H Y : ℝ}
    (boxes : CountingBoxes A d H Y) (N V B R : ℕ) (rp : 0 < R)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (ij : i≠j) (bounds : chartBox boxes N V B i j) :
    let K := gap i j*(V:ℤ)^2
    let L := 2*(B:ℚ)+1
    ((pairRecords boxes N V R i j).card:ℚ) ≤
      K.natAbs.divisors.card * (8*(Nat.log 2 (K.natAbs+2*B):ℚ)*(L/R+1))*(L*harmonic B+B) := by

    let m := (κ*(v:ℤ)^2).natAbs
    (m.divisors.card:ℝ) ≤ ((divisorConstant k*κ.natAbs:ℕ):ℝ)^((k:ℝ)⁻¹)*(N:ℝ)^((k:ℝ)⁻¹) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.Uniform.harmonic_mono

declarations.name: Sun28.SieveTail.Uniform.offdiag_uniform
declarations.snippet:
theorem offdiag_uniform {N V R : ℕ} (boxes : CountingBoxes A d H Y) (rp : 0 < R)
    (i j : ↥(shifts A)) (ij : i≠j) (vs : V^2≤N) (k : ℕ) (kp : 0 < k) :
    let B := commonRadius N i j
    let L := 2*(B:ℝ)+1
    let c := (gap i j).natAbs
    ((pairRecords boxes N V R i j).card:ℝ) ≤
      ((divisorConstant k*c:ℕ):ℝ)^((k:ℝ)⁻¹)*(N:ℝ)^((k:ℝ)⁻¹)*
        (8*(Nat.log 2 (c*N+2*B):ℝ)*(L/R+1))*(L*(harmonic B:ℝ)+B) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.box_covers
Sun28.SinglePrime.numericalBoxes
declarations.snippet:
def numericalBoxes (width : ℕ→ℕ)
    (grows : ∀ m : ℕ,∃ b₀ : ℕ,∀ b : ℕ,b₀≤b → m≤width b)
    (short : ∀ ε : ℝ,0<ε → ∃ b₀ : ℕ,∀ b : ℕ,b₀≤b → (width b:ℝ)^2≤ε*b) :
    CountingBoxes A d H Y where
  width := width
  grows := grows
  short := short
  records b := box b (width b)
  inBox _ _ h := box_mem h
  uniquePair _ _ ha _ hb := box_unique ha hb
  covers _ a low high w := by
    obtain ⟨a',mem,eq⟩:=box_covers a low high w
    exact ⟨a',mem,congrArg Prod.fst eq,congrArg Prod.snd eq⟩

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.radius_bounds

theorem radius_bounds (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (t V : ℕ) (v : V ≤ side t) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) :
    let S:=side t
    let N:=lengthAt t
    let E:=envelope A
    let b:=radius N V i j
    let a:=Nat.sqrt (N+(offset (dilation A) i.val).natAbs*V^2)
    a≤b ∧ 2*b+1≤E*S ∧ (gap i j*(V:ℤ)^2).natAbs+2*b≤E*N ∧
      a^2+1≤E*N ∧ N+maxCoefficient A*V^2+1≤E*N := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.dyadic_scales
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_scales (t : ℕ) :
