declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.accepts
declarations.snippet:
def accepts (P M : Prop) : Test→Prop
  | .plus => P
  | .minus => M
  | .both => P ∧ M

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.rectangle
declarations.snippet:
def rectangle {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (j : Test) (t : ι→F p) : Finset ((i : ι)→Circle p (t i)) :=
  match j with
  | .plus => safeBox t true
  | .minus => safeBox t false
  | .both => safeBox t true ∩ safeBox t false

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.rectangle_card
declarations.snippet:
theorem rectangle_card {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (j : Test) (t : ι→F p) :
    (rectangle j t).card=∏ i,(univ.filter fun z : Circle p (t i) =>
      accepts (z∉bad p (t i) true) (z∉bad p (t i) false) j).card := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.fraction
declarations.snippet:
def fraction {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (j : Test) (t : ι→F p) : ℝ :=
  ((rectangle j t).card:ℝ)/Fintype.card ((i:ι)→Circle p (t i))

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.fractions_at_norms
declarations.snippet:
theorem fractions_at_norms {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t : ι→F p) (unit : ∀ i,t i≠0) :
    1-((((obstructed t).card:ℝ)/Fintype.card ((i:ι)→Circle p (t i)))) =
      fraction .plus t+fraction .minus t-fraction .both t := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.averageBox
declarations.snippet:
def averageBox {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ι→F p) (j : Test) : ℝ :=
  (∑ w : F p, ∑ u : F p,if ∀ i,norms c u w i≠0 then fraction j (norms c u w) else 0)/(p:ℝ)^2

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.signed_average
declarations.snippet:
theorem signed_average {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ι→F p) :
    unitRate c-averageLoss c=averageBox c .plus+averageBox c .minus-averageBox c .both := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.localProportion
declarations.snippet:
def localProportion (A : Fin 3→ℚ) (p : ℕ) (j : Test) : ℝ :=
  if h : p.Prime then
    let _ : Fact p.Prime:=⟨h⟩
    averageBox (coefficients A p) j / unitRate (coefficients A p)
  else 0

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.signed_local
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.middleMass

    middleMass T κ L (splitAt t) (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N W)≤
      (C/(L:ℝ)+1/((j:ℝ)+1))*((N:ℝ)*W)

  ∃ ω : ℕ→ℕ,(∀ j,∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,ω b≤rowWidth j b) ∧
    ∀ (w : ℕ→ℕ) (grow : Tendsto w atTop atTop)
      (short : ∀ ε : ℝ,0<ε → ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,(w b:ℝ)^2≤ε*b),
      (∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,ω b≤w b) →
        CountsAt A d H Y T κ K L (numericalBoxes w (fun m=>eventually_atTop.mp (tendsto_atTop.mp grow m))
          (fun ε ep=>eventually_atTop.mp (short ε ep))) σ

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.pairBound
declarations.snippet:
def pairBound (N V R : ℕ) (i j : ↥(shifts A)) : ℚ :=
  if i=j then
    let B:=Nat.sqrt (N+(offset (dilation A) i.val).natAbs*V^2)
    (2*(B:ℚ)+1)*(Nat.log 2 (B^2+1):ℚ)*((2*(B:ℚ)+1)/R+1)
  else
    let B:=radius N V i j
    let K:=gap i j*(V:ℤ)^2
    let L:=2*(B:ℚ)+1
    K.natAbs.divisors.card*(8*(Nat.log 2 (K.natAbs+2*B):ℚ)*(L/R+1))*(L*harmonic B+B)

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.removed_le_sum
declarations.snippet:
theorem removed_le_sum (boxes : CountingBoxes A d H Y) (N R : ℕ) (two : 2≤R) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ p∈T,p≤R) (hκ : ∀ p∈κ.primeFactors,p≤R) :
    removedMass T κ R (boxes.records N) ≤ weightBound A N (boxes.width N)*
      (∑ k∈indices A (boxes.width N),pairBound N k.1 R k.2.1 k.2.2 : ℚ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.numerical_tail
declarations.snippet:
theorem numerical_tail (N W R : ℕ) (two : 2≤R) (T : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ p∈T,p≤R) (hκ : ∀ p∈κ.primeFactors,p≤R) :
    removedMass T κ R (box (A:=A) (d:=d) (H:=H) (Y:=Y) N W) ≤ weightBound A N W*
      (∑ k∈indices A W,pairBound N k.1 R k.2.1 k.2.2 : ℚ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.rowWidth
declarations.snippet: def rowWidth (j b : ℕ) : ℕ := b.sqrt / (j+1)

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.row_grows
declarations.snippet: theorem row_grows (j m : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,m≤rowWidth j b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.row_area
declarations.snippet: theorem row_area (j b : ℕ) : (rowWidth j b:ℝ)^2*((j:ℝ)+1)≤b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.diagonal_level
declarations.snippet:
theorem diagonal_level (P : ℕ→ℕ→Prop) (h : ∀ j,∀ᶠ b in atTop,P j b) :
    ∃ stage : ℕ→ℕ,Tendsto stage atTop atTop ∧ ∀ᶠ b in atTop,P (stage b) b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.eventual_error
declarations.snippet:
theorem eventual_error {stage : ℕ→ℕ} (g : Tendsto stage atTop atTop)
    {ε : ℝ} (pos : 0<ε) : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,1/((stage b:ℝ)+1)≤ε := by

declarations.name: Sun28.SinglePrime.choose_width
declarations.snippet:
theorem choose_width (ω : ℕ→ℕ) (P : ℕ→ℕ→Prop)
    (slow : ∀ j,∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,ω b≤rowWidth j b)
    (rows : ∀ j,∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,P j b) :
    ∃ stage : ℕ→ℕ,Tendsto stage atTop atTop ∧
      (∀ᶠ b in atTop,P (stage b) b ∧ ω b≤rowWidth (stage b) b) ∧
      Tendsto (fun b=>rowWidth (stage b) b) atTop atTop ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ,0<ε → ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,(rowWidth (stage b) b:ℝ)^2≤ε*b := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.curveGenerator
declarations.snippet: abbrev curveGenerator : curveC.toAffine.Point := 2 • pointR

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.curveX
declarations.snippet:
def curveX : curveC.toAffine.Point → K0
  | .zero => 0
  | .some x _ _ => x

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.indexX
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def indexX (m : ℤ) : K0 := curveX (m • curveGenerator)

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.coordinateProduct
declarations.snippet: noncomputable def coordinateProduct (m : Fin 4 → ℤ) : K0 := ∏ i, indexX (m i)

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.generator_coordinates
declarations.snippet:
theorem generator_coordinates :
    curveGenerator = .some twoRX twoRY twoR_nonsingular := two_smul_pointR

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.generator_cast
declarations.snippet:
theorem generator_cast :
    (Scalar.curve (-(3-sqrt2)^2) = curveC.toAffine) ∧
    HEq (Scalar.paperGenerator sqrt2_sq) curveGenerator := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.index_nonidentity
declarations.snippet: theorem index_nonidentity {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) : m • curveGenerator ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.index_affine
declarations.snippet:
theorem index_affine {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) :
    ∃ y h, m • curveGenerator = .some (indexX m) y h := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.quadratic_index_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem quadratic_index_height (m : ℤ) :
    (m:ℝ)^2 ≤ hK0 (indexX m) + Real.log 676 / 3 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.val_order_iff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem val_order_iff {w : FinitePlace K0} {x y : K0} (xn : x≠0) (yn : y≠0) :
    discreteOrder (w.maximalIdeal.valuation K0) x ≤ discreteOrder (w.maximalIdeal.valuation K0) y ↔ w y ≤ w x := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.delta_order_nonneg
declarations.snippet:
private theorem delta_order_nonneg (u : AddValuation K0 (WithTop ℤ)) :
    0 ≤ u delta := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.finite_pole_companion
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_pole_companion (w : FinitePlace K0) {m k : ℤ} (odd : Odd m) (nk : k≠0)
    (pole : 1 < w (indexX m)) : w delta^2 ≤ w (indexX k) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.finite_max_factor
declarations.snippet:
private theorem finite_max_factor (w : FinitePlace K0) (m : Fin 4 → ℤ) (odd : ∀ j, Odd (m j)) (i : Fin 4) :
    max (w (indexX (m i))) 1 ≤ max (w (coordinateProduct m)) 1 * max (w (delta⁻¹^6)) 1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.arch_max_factor
declarations.snippet:
private theorem arch_max_factor (w : InfinitePlace K0) (m : Fin 4 → ℤ) (odd : ∀ j, Odd (m j)) (i : Fin 4) :
    max (w (indexX (m i))) 1 ≤ max (w (coordinateProduct m)) 1 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.global_domination
declarations.snippet:
private theorem global_domination {x c e : K0} (xn : x≠0) (cn : c≠0) (en : e≠0)
    (infinite : ∀ w : InfinitePlace K0, max (w x) 1 ≤ max (w c) 1)
    (finite : ∀ w : FinitePlace K0, max (w x) 1 ≤ max (w c) 1 * max (w e) 1) :
    hK0 x ≤ hK0 c + hK0 e := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.abscissa_product_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem abscissa_product_bound (m : Fin 4 → ℤ) (odd : ∀ j, Odd (m j)) (i : Fin 4) :
    hK0 (indexX (m i)) ≤ hK0 (coordinateProduct m) + 3 * Real.log 7 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.odd_torsion
declarations.snippet: private theorem odd_torsion (n : ℤ) (odd : Odd n) : n • cT0 = cT0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.distinct_cosets
Sun28.Ordinary.abscissa_translate
declarations.snippet:
theorem abscissa_translate (m : ℤ) (nz : m≠0) :
    ∃ y h, m • curveGenerator+cT0 = .some (-delta^2 / indexX m) y h := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.local_order_separation
declarations.snippet:
theorem local_order_separation (v : AddValuation K0 (WithTop ℤ))
    (int : 0 ≤ v (-delta^2)) (i j : ℤ) (odd : Odd i) (nj : j≠0)
    (pole : v (indexX i) < 0) : v (indexX j) ≤ v (-delta^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.paperProduct
declarations.snippet:
def paperProduct (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) : K0 :=
  ∏ i, (Scalar.reciprocal (n i • Scalar.paperGenerator sqrt2_sq))⁻¹

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.affineX
declarations.snippet:
private def affineX {A : WeierstrassCurve.Affine K0} : A.Point → K0
  | .zero => 0
  | .some x _ _ => x

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.indexX_paper
declarations.snippet:
theorem indexX_paper (m : ℤ) :
    indexX m = (Scalar.reciprocal (m • Scalar.paperGenerator sqrt2_sq))⁻¹ := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.coordinateProduct_paper
declarations.snippet: theorem coordinateProduct_paper (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) : coordinateProduct n=paperProduct n := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.paper_three_scales
declarations.snippet:
theorem paper_three_scales (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) (odd : ∀ j, Odd (n j)) (η : ℚ) (nonzero : η≠0) :
    ∀ H : ℝ, 1 ≤ H → (∀ j, logHeight₁ ((scaleRoot (paperProduct n).re (paperProduct n).im j)^2*η) ≤ H) →
      indexSize n ^ 2 ≤ (3/2)*H+10 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.generator_real_lower
declarations.snippet:
theorem generator_real_lower (σ : K0 →+* ℝ) (emb : 1 ≤ σ delta) {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) :
    σ delta ≤ σ (indexX m) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.indexX_nonzero
declarations.snippet: theorem indexX_nonzero {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) : indexX m≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.all_infinite_abscissas
declarations.snippet:
theorem all_infinite_abscissas {m : ℤ} (nz : m≠0) (w : InfinitePlace K0) :
    1 ≤ w (indexX m) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.twice_height_le_one_add_square
declarations.snippet:
theorem twice_height_le_one_add_square (r : ℚ) :
    2 * logHeight₁ r ≤ logHeight₁ (1+r^2) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.coefficient_heights
Sun28.Ordinary.three_scale_product_height
Sun28.Ordinary.scale_constant
declarations.snippet: private theorem scale_constant : 3/2*Real.log 2+Real.log 676/3+3*Real.log 7 < (10:ℝ) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.Ordinary.three_scales
declarations.snippet:
theorem three_scales (m : Fin 4 → ℤ) (odd : ∀ j, Odd (m j)) (η : ℚ) (nonzero : η≠0)
    (H : ℝ) (hH : 1≤H)
    (tests : ∀ j, logHeight₁ ((scaleRoot (coordinateProduct m).re (coordinateProduct m).im j)^2*η) ≤ H) :
    (indexSize m)^2 ≤ (3/2)*H+10 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.separator
declarations.snippet: def separator (z : L) (x : Fin n → L) : L := ∑ i, x i * z ^ (i : ℕ)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.eval_coeffs
declarations.snippet:
private theorem eval_coeffs [DecidableEq L] (z : L) (x : Fin n → L) :
    (ofFn n x).eval z = separator z x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.collision_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem collision_bound (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) :
    ∃ bad : Finset L, bad.card ≤ S.card.choose 2 * (n-1) ∧
      ∀ b ∉ bad, Set.InjOn (separator b) (S : Set (Fin n → L)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.exists_bounded_separator
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_bounded_separator [CharZero L] (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, b ≤ S.card.choose 2 * (n-1) ∧ Set.InjOn (separator (b:L)) (S : Set (Fin n → L)) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.resolvent
declarations.snippet:
def resolvent (S : Finset ι) (ell f : ι → L) (mult : ι → ℕ) (t : L) : L[X] :=
  ∏ x ∈ S, (C (t - ell x) - C (f x) * X) ^ mult x

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.linear_zero
declarations.snippet: private theorem linear_zero (a c : L) : C a - C c * X = 0 ↔ a=0 ∧ c=0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.resolvent_zero_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem resolvent_zero_iff (S : Finset ι) (ell f : ι → L) (mult : ι → ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < mult x) (t : L) :
    resolvent S ell f mult t = 0 ↔ ∃ x ∈ S, ell x = t ∧ f x = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.resolvent_degree
declarations.snippet:
theorem resolvent_degree (S : Finset ι) (ell f : ι → L) (mult : ι → ℕ) (t : L) :
    (resolvent S ell f mult t).natDegree ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, mult x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.resolvent_samples_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem resolvent_samples_iff [CharZero L] (S : Finset ι) (ell f : ι → L) (mult : ι → ℕ)
    (t : L) {d : ℕ} (hd : (∑ x ∈ S, mult x) ≤ d) :
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ d → (resolvent S ell f mult t).eval (j:L) = 0) ↔
      resolvent S ell f mult t = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.resolvent_at_separated
declarations.snippet:
theorem resolvent_at_separated (S : Finset ι) (ell f : ι → L) (mult : ι → ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < mult x) (hi : Set.InjOn ell (S : Set ι)) {x : ι} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    resolvent S ell f mult (ell x) = 0 ↔ f x = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.distinctValues
declarations.snippet:
def distinctValues [DecidableEq L] {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) (b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (S.image (separator (b:L))).card

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.separating_iff_maximizes
declarations.snippet:
theorem separating_iff_maximizes [DecidableEq L] [CharZero L] {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → L))
    {b B : ℕ} (hB : S.card.choose 2*(n-1) ≤ B) :
    Set.InjOn (separator (b:L)) (S : Set (Fin n → L)) ↔
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ B → distinctValues S j ≤ distinctValues S b := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.reduced_projection_degree
declarations.snippet:
theorem reduced_projection_degree [DecidableEq L] {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) (b : ℕ) :
    (∏ t ∈ S.image (separator (b:L)), ((X : L[X])-C t)).natDegree = distinctValues S b := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.Tests
declarations.snippet:
def Tests (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) (x : Fin n → L) : Prop :=
  (∀ f ∈ eqs, MvPolynomial.aeval x f = 0) ∧ (∀ f ∈ neqs, MvPolynomial.aeval x f ≠ 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.tests_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem tests_map {M : Type*} [Field M] [Algebra K M] (φ : L →ₐ[K] M)
    (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) (x : Fin n → L) :
    Tests eqs neqs (fun i => φ (x i)) ↔ Tests eqs neqs x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.accepted
declarations.snippet:
def accepted (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] (T : Tower K n)
    (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) : Finset (Fin n → L) := by
  classical
  exact (solutions L T).filter (Tests eqs neqs)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.mem_accepted
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_accepted (T : Tower K n) (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (x : Fin n → L) : x ∈ accepted L T eqs neqs ↔ Satisfies T x ∧ Tests eqs neqs x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.exists_filtered_projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_filtered_projection (T : Tower ℚ n) (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℚ)) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (p : ℚ[X]), b ≤ T.degreeBound.choose 2*(n-1) ∧ p.Monic ∧
      p.natDegree ≤ T.degreeBound ∧
      p.map (algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) = projection (accepted (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) T eqs neqs) b ∧
      ((∃ z : ℚ, p.IsRoot z) ↔ ∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies T x ∧ Tests eqs neqs x) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.sun_projection_budget
declarations.snippet:
theorem sun_projection_budget (T : Tower ℚ 26) (hdegree : T.degreeBound ≤ 4^18*2^8)
    (eqs neqs : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin 26) ℚ)) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (p : ℚ[X]), b ≤ (2^44).choose 2*25 ∧ p.Monic ∧ p.natDegree ≤ 2^44 ∧
      p.map (algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) = projection (accepted (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) T eqs neqs) b ∧
      ((∃ z : ℚ, p.IsRoot z) ↔ ∃ x : Fin 26 → ℚ, Satisfies T x ∧ Tests eqs neqs x) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Stable
declarations.snippet:
def Stable (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra K L] (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : Fin n → L), x ∈ S → (fun i => σ (x i)) ∈ S

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.projection
declarations.snippet:
def projection (S : Finset (Fin n → L)) (b : ℕ) : L[X] :=
  ∏ x ∈ S, (X - C (separator (b:L) x))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.maps_separator
declarations.snippet:
private theorem maps_separator (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (b : ℕ) (x : Fin n → L) :
    σ (separator (b:L) x) = separator (b:L) (fun i => σ (x i)) := by simp [separator]

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.projection_lifts
declarations.snippet:
theorem projection_lifts [IsGalois K L] {S : Finset (Fin n → L)}
    (hS : Stable K S) (b : ℕ) : ∃ p : K[X], p.map (algebraMap K L) = projection S b := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.rational_tuple_of_separating
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_tuple_of_separating [IsGalois K L] {S : Finset (Fin n → L)}
    (hS : Stable K S) {b : ℕ} (hi : Set.InjOn (separator (b:L)) (S : Set (Fin n → L)))
    {x : Fin n → L} (hx : x ∈ S) (r : K) (hr : separator (b:L) x = algebraMap K L r) :
    ∃ y : Fin n → K, (fun i => algebraMap K L (y i)) = x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.exists_rational_root_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_rational_root_iff [CharZero L] [IsGalois K L] {S : Finset (Fin n → L)}
    (hS : Stable K S) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (p : K[X]), b ≤ S.card.choose 2*(n-1) ∧ p.Monic ∧ p.natDegree = S.card ∧
      p.map (algebraMap K L) = projection S b ∧
      ((∃ z : K, p.IsRoot z) ↔ ∃ y : Fin n → K, (fun i => algebraMap K L (y i)) ∈ S) := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower
declarations.snippet:
inductive Tower (K : Type u) [Field K] : ℕ → Type u
  | base : Tower K 0
  | adjoin {n : ℕ} (prior : Tower K n) (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
      (hf : f.Monic) : Tower K (n+1)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.degreeBound
declarations.snippet:
def degreeBound : {n : ℕ} → Tower K n → ℕ
  | _, .base => 1
  | _, .adjoin T f _ => degreeBound T * f.natDegree

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.Satisfies
declarations.snippet:
def Satisfies : {n : ℕ} → Tower K n → (Fin n → L) → Prop
  | _, .base, _ => True
  | _, .adjoin T f _, x => Satisfies T (Fin.tail x) ∧
      (f.map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R:=K) (Fin.tail x)).toRingHom).IsRoot (x 0)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.solutions
declarations.snippet:
def solutions (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] : {n : ℕ} → Tower K n → Finset (Fin n → L) := by
  classical
  exact fun {n} T => match n,T with
    | _, .base => {fun i => Fin.elim0 i}
    | _, .adjoin prior f _ =>
        (solutions L prior).biUnion fun x =>
          (((f.map (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom).roots.toFinset).image (fun a => Fin.cons a x))

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.mem_solutions_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_solutions_iff {n : ℕ} (T : Tower K n) (x : Fin n → L) :
    x ∈ solutions L T ↔ Satisfies T x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.card_solutions_le
declarations.snippet:
theorem card_solutions_le (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] {n : ℕ} (T : Tower K n) :
    (solutions L T).card ≤ T.degreeBound := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.satisfies_map
declarations.snippet:
theorem satisfies_map {M : Type*} [Field M] [Algebra K M] (φ : L →ₐ[K] M)
    {n : ℕ} (T : Tower K n) (x : Fin n → L) :
    Satisfies T (fun i => φ (x i)) ↔ Satisfies T x := by

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.SunTower.Tower.exists_projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_projection {n : ℕ} (T : Tower ℚ n) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (p : ℚ[X]), b ≤ T.degreeBound.choose 2*(n-1) ∧ p.Monic ∧
      p.natDegree ≤ T.degreeBound ∧
      p.map (algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) = projection (solutions (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) T) b ∧
      ((∃ z : ℚ, p.IsRoot z) ↔ ∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, Satisfies T x) := by

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.Accepts
declarations.snippet:
def Accepts (φ : R →+* ℚ) (a : Packet R) (Uo Us : Finset ℚ)
    (e z : Fin 3 → ℚ) (eS zS : ℚ) : Prop :=
  Guards φ a.guards ∧ (∀ j, poleAt Uo (val φ (a.ordinary j)) (e j) (z j)) ∧
    poleAt Us (val φ a.scalar) eS zS

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.packet_at
declarations.snippet:
theorem packet_at {φ : R →+* ℚ} {p : Codes R} {w : NinePoints} (hp : Inputs φ p w)
    (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) {x η Γ : E R} {a h γ : ℚ} (hx : RatValue φ x a)
    (hη : RatValue φ η h) (hΓ : RatValue φ Γ γ) (D : ℕ) (Uo Us : Finset ℚ)
    (e z : Fin 3 → ℚ) (eS zS : ℚ) :
    (∃ pos : Bool, Accepts φ (Program.eval φ (packet p M c x η Γ D pos)) Uo Us e z eS zS) ↔
      (∀ j, side (pointScale w M j) h) ∧
      (∀ j, let s := pointScale w M j; ordinaryAtPair w M c (beta a) (s^2) (s^2*h) Uo (e j) (z j)) ∧
      scalarAtPair w M (scalarRadicand (beta a)) γ D Us eS zS := by

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.slot

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.ordOutput
declarations.snippet:
def ordOutput (p : Codes R) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (b η : E R) (j : Fin 3) : Program R (OrdOutput R) :=
  Program.bind (fun a =>
    let s : E R := .pure a
    let A := power s 2
    Program.bind (fun t =>
      let T : E R := .pure t
      Program.bind (fun marks =>
        Program.bind (fun tr =>
          Program.bind (fun v => .pure ⟨[a.re,t.re-3*t.den,marks.re,tr.re],frac v⟩)
            (div (detection A T) (power (.pure tr) 2)))
          (trace p M c b A T))
        (markProd T))
      (mul A η)) (scales p M j)

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.ordOutput_spec
declarations.snippet:
theorem ordOutput_spec {φ : R →+* ℚ} {p : Codes R} {w : NinePoints} (hp : Inputs φ p w)
    (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) {b η : E R} {β h : ℚ} (hb : RatValue φ b β) (hη : RatValue φ η h) (j : Fin 3) :
    let u := Program.eval φ (ordOutput p M c b η j)
    let s := pointScale w M j
    let A := s^2
    let t := A*h
    let H := ordinaryTraceAt w M c β A t
    (Guards φ u.guards ↔ side s h ∧ H≠0) ∧ φ u.b.2≠0 ∧ val φ u.b=detector A t/H^2 := by

def packet (p : Codes R) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (x η Γ : E R) (D : ℕ) (pos : Bool) : Program R (Packet R) :=
  let b := βcode x
  let o := ordOutput p M c b η
  Program.bind (fun a => Program.bind (fun b₁ => Program.bind (fun d =>
    Program.bind (fun s => .pure (assemble a b₁ d s)) (scalarOutput p M (rad b) Γ D pos)) (o 2)) (o 1)) (o 0)

    Guards φ (assemble (o 0) (o 1) (o 2) s).guards ↔ (∀ j, Guards φ (o j).guards) ∧ φ s.guard≠0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.TraceAtlas.PacketSpec
declarations.snippet:
structure PacketSpec (φ : R →+* ℚ) (a : Packet R) (w : NinePoints) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ)
    (x η Γ : ℚ) (D : ℕ) (pos : Bool) : Prop where
  guards : Guards φ a.guards ↔
    (∀ j, let s:=pointScale w M j; side s η ∧ ordinaryTraceAt w M c (beta x) (s^2) (s^2*η)≠0) ∧
      scalarTree (scalarRadicand (beta x)) (scalarEntries w M)≠0
  ordinary : ∀ j, let s:=pointScale w M j; let t:=s^2*η
    φ (a.ordinary j).2≠0 ∧ val φ (a.ordinary j)=detector (s^2) t/(ordinaryTraceAt w M c (beta x) (s^2) t)^2
  scalar : φ a.scalar.2≠0 ∧ val φ a.scalar = signedValue (scalarRadicand (beta x)) (sign pos) Γ D
    (scalarTree (scalarRadicand (beta x)) (scalarEntries w M))

    (hη : RatValue φ η h) (hΓ : RatValue φ Γ γ) (D : ℕ) (pos : Bool) :
    PacketSpec φ (Program.eval φ (packet p M c x η Γ D pos)) w M c a h γ D pos := by

declarations.snippet:
def ordinary (p : Codes R) (M : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (b : E R) : OrdinaryTest → E R :=
  let L := fun i => ratio (.pure (p.u i)) (.pure p.h)
  let V := shifted p M c
  let V₀ := base p c
  fun i => match i with
    | .h => recip (.pure p.h)
    | .u j => recip (.pure (p.u j))
    | .v₀ => conj (recip V₀)
    | .v j => conj (recip (V j))
    | .difference j => sub (L j) (conj (ratio (V j) V₀))
    | .delta => deltaTest (L 1) (L 2) (L 3)
    | .beta => sub (L 0) b

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarTrace.dyadic_scalarTheta
declarations.snippet:
theorem dyadic_scalarTheta {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 ℚ)) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal]
    (hname : (Rat.HeightOneSpectrum.primesEquiv v).1=2)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (hσ : σ≠1) {r : ℚ} (hr : 0≤padicValRat 2 r) {x y : K}
    (hx : discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (2:K) ≤ discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (x/algebraMap ℚ K r))
    (hy : discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (2:K) ≤ discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (y/algebraMap ℚ K r^48))
    (hx' : discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (2:K) ≤ discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (σ x/algebraMap ℚ K r))
    (hy' : discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (2:K) ≤ discreteOrder (w.valuation K) (σ y/algebraMap ℚ K r^48)) :
    scalarTheta r x y ≠ 0 ∧ padicValRat 2 (scalarTheta r x y)=0 ∧
    (scalarTheta r x y=1 ∨ 1≤padicValRat 2 (scalarTheta r x y-1)) := by

    (hr : (0:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (algebraMap F K r))
    (hx : (e:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (x/algebraMap F K r))
    (hy : (e:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (y/(algebraMap F K r)^48))
    (hx' : (e:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (σ x/algebraMap F K r))
    (hy' : (e:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (σ y/(algebraMap F K r)^48)) :
    (e:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (algebraMap F K (scalarTheta r x y)-1) ∧
    v (algebraMap F K (scalarTheta r x y))=0 := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarTrace.negLog
declarations.snippet:

  if a=0 then ⊤ else ((-WithZero.log a : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarTrace.negLog_anti
declarations.snippet: private theorem negLog_anti : Antitone negLog := by

declarations.name: Sun28.ScalarTrace.discreteOrder
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def discreteOrder {K : Type*} [Field K] (v : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰) :
    AddValuation K (WithTop ℤ) :=
  AddValuation.of (fun a => negLog (v a)) (by simp [negLog]) (by simp [negLog])
    (fun a b => by
      have h := negLog_anti (v.map_add a b)
      simpa only [negLog_anti.map_max] using h)
    (fun a b => by
      rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
      · simp [negLog]
      rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb
      · simp [negLog]
      have h₁ := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr ha
      have h₂ := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr hb
      simp [negLog,v.map_mul,h₁,h₂,mul_ne_zero h₁ h₂,WithZero.log_mul h₁ h₂,add_comm])

    (hB : (0:WithTop ℤ) ≤ v (algebraMap F K (scalarValue r Γ D₀ x y))) :

    (ι : K →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ_[p]) (σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    {r Γ D₀ : ℚ} {x y : K}
    (ho : Odd (padicValRat p r)) (hA : Γ/(1+D₀*r^2) ≠ 0)

declarations.snippet:
def evaluate : Functions →+* Germs where
  toFun f := ↑(value f)
  map_zero' := by apply Germ.coe_eq.mpr; exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>RatFunc.eval_zero _ _)
  map_one' := by apply Germ.coe_eq.mpr; exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>RatFunc.eval_one _ _)
  map_add' f g := by
    change ((value (f+g)):Germs) = ↑(fun x => value f x + value g x)
    apply Germ.coe_eq.mpr
    filter_upwards [regular f,regular g] with x hf hg
    exact RatFunc.eval_add _ _ hf hg
  map_mul' f g := by
    change ((value (f*g)):Germs) = ↑(fun x => value f x * value g x)
    apply Germ.coe_eq.mpr
    filter_upwards [regular f,regular g] with x hf hg
    exact RatFunc.eval_mul _ _ hf hg

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.Quadratic
declarations.snippet:
structure Quadratic (n : ℕ) where
  weightPred : ℕ

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.parseQuadratic
declarations.snippet:
def parseQuadratic (n : ℕ) (s : String) : Option (Quadratic n) := do
  let [w,terms] := s.splitOn "|" | none
  let weight ← w.toNat?
  let parsed ← (terms.splitOn ";").mapM (parseRow n)
  match weight with
  | 0 => none
  | k+1 => some ⟨k,parsed⟩

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.parseSystem
declarations.snippet:
def parseSystem (n : ℕ) (s : String) : Option (List (Quadratic n)) :=
  ((s.splitOn "\n").filter (· != "")).mapM (parseQuadratic n)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.fixedSystem
declarations.snippet: def fixedSystem := parseSystem 314 (include_str "data/quadrics314.txt")

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.familySystem
declarations.snippet: def familySystem := parseSystem 222 (include_str "data/quadrics222.txt")

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.value
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def value {n : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (r : Quadratic n) : ℚ :=
  eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℚ) x (fromRows A r.terms)

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.sumAt
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def sumAt {n : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) : List (Quadratic n) → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | r::rs => ((r.weightPred:ℚ)+1) * (value A x r)^2 + sumAt A x rs

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.sum_nonneg
declarations.snippet: theorem sum_nonneg {n : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (rs : List (Quadratic n)) : 0 ≤ sumAt A x rs := by

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.sum_zero_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem sum_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℚ) (rs : List (Quadratic n)) :
    sumAt A x rs = 0 ↔ ∀ r ∈ rs, value A x r = 0 := by

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.Expansion
declarations.snippet:
def Expansion {n : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (rs : List (Quadratic n)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : Fin n → ℚ, eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℚ) x P = sumAt A x rs

declarations.name: ManuscriptV15.Quadrics.RowProjection
declarations.snippet:
def RowProjection {m : ℕ} (A : ℤ) (rs : List (Quadratic (m+1))) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, (∃ w : Fin m → ℚ, ∀ r ∈ rs, value A (Fin.cons q w) r = 0) ↔ ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℚ) = q

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Rank.kummerEmbedding_of_fullTwoDescent
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def kummerEmbedding_of_fullTwoDescent (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (descent : FullTwoDescent d) : KummerEmbedding d := by
  let repr (c : modTwo d) : RationalPoint d := (QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c).choose
  have eq_repr (c : modTwo d) : QuotientAddGroup.mk (repr c) = c := (QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c).choose_spec
  let pair (c : modTwo d) : ℤ × ℤ := (class_in_selmer d hd (repr c)).choose
  have member (c : modTwo d) : pair c ∈ selmer d := (class_in_selmer d hd (repr c)).choose_spec.1
  have represented (c : modTwo d) : represents d (repr c) (pair c) := (class_in_selmer d hd (repr c)).choose_spec.2
  refine ⟨⟨fun c => ⟨pair c,member c⟩,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · intro c e he
    have eqp : pair c = pair e := congrArg Subtype.val he
    have hc := represented c
    rw [eqp] at hc
    have he' := represented e
    calc
      c = QuotientAddGroup.mk (repr c) := (eq_repr c).symm
      _ = QuotientAddGroup.mk (repr e) := (descent _ _).mpr
        ⟨class_trans (class_symm hc.1) he'.1, class_trans (class_symm hc.2) he'.2⟩
      _ = e := eq_repr e
  · intro P
    let c : modTwo d := QuotientAddGroup.mk P
    have eqc := (descent (repr c) P).mp (eq_repr c)
    exact ⟨class_trans (represented c).1 eqc.1, class_trans (represented c).2 eqc.2⟩

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.Rank.scaleY
ZInQBlueprint.Rank.scaleHom
declarations.snippet:
private def scaleHom : (short a).Point →+ (short b).Point where
  toFun := scalePoint f a b k hk hb
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := by
    rintro (_ | @⟨x₁,y₁,h₁⟩) (_ | @⟨x₂,y₂,h₂⟩)
    any_goals rfl
    have hx : k^2*f x₁=k^2*f x₂ ↔ x₁=x₂ := by simp [hk,f.injective.eq_iff]
    have hy : k^3*f y₁= -(k^3*f y₂) ↔ y₁= -y₂ := by
      have t : k^3*f y₁ = k^3*f (-y₂) ↔ y₁ = -y₂ :=
        ⟨fun h => f.injective (mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hk) h), fun h => by rw [h]⟩
      simpa only [map_neg,mul_neg] using t
    have hxy : (k^2*f x₁=k^2*f x₂ ∧ k^3*f y₁ = (short b).negY (k^2*f x₂) (k^3*f y₂)) ↔
        (x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=(short a).negY x₂ y₂) := by
      simp only [negY,short,WeierstrassCurve.toAffine,zero_mul,sub_zero,hx,hy]
    by_cases h : x₁=x₂ ∧ y₁=(short a).negY x₂ y₂
    · rw [Point.add_of_Y_eq h.1 h.2]
      have h' := hxy.mpr h
      exact (Point.add_of_Y_eq h'.1 h'.2).symm
    · have h' := mt hxy.mp h
      rw [Point.add_some h]
      change Point.some _ _ _ = Point.some _ _ _ + Point.some _ _ _
      rw [Point.add_some h', Point.some.injEq]
      constructor
      · rw [scale_slope f a b k hk hb, scaleX]
      · rw [scale_slope f a b k hk hb, scaleY]

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.Expr
declarations.snippet:
inductive Expr (n : Nat) where
  | coord (i : Fin n)
  | integer (z : Int)
  | add (p q : Expr n)
  | sub (p q : Expr n)
  | mul (p q : Expr n)
deriving Inhabited

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.Expr.eval
declarations.snippet:
def Expr.eval {n : Nat} (x : Fin n → Rat) : Expr n → Rat
  | .coord i => x i
  | .integer z => z
  | .add p q => p.eval x + q.eval x
  | .sub p q => p.eval x - q.eval x
  | .mul p q => p.eval x * q.eval x

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.squareSum
declarations.snippet:
def squareSum {n : Nat} : List (Expr n) → Expr n
  | [] => .integer 0
  | p :: ps => .add (.mul p p) (squareSum ps)

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.product
declarations.snippet:
def product {n : Nat} : List (Expr n) → Expr n
  | [] => .integer 1
  | p :: ps => .mul p (product ps)

declarations.snippet:

  guard : Expr n

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.Branch.factor
declarations.snippet:
def Branch.factor {n : Nat} (b : Branch n) (inverse : Fin n) : Expr n :=
  squareSum (.sub (.mul (.coord inverse) b.guard) (.integer 1) :: b.rows)

declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet:
theorem squareSum_zero (x : Fin n → Rat) (rows : List (Expr n)) :
    (squareSum rows).eval x = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ rows, p.eval x = 0 := by

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.product_zero
declarations.snippet:
theorem product_zero (x : Fin n → Rat) (ps : List (Expr n)) :
    (product ps).eval x = 0 ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, p.eval x = 0 := by

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.lift
declarations.snippet:
def lift : Expr n → Expr (n+1)
  | .coord i => .coord i.succ
  | .integer z => .integer z
  | .add p q => .add (lift p) (lift q)
  | .sub p q => .sub (lift p) (lift q)
  | .mul p q => .mul (lift p) (lift q)

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.eval_lift
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.compile
declarations.snippet:
def compile (bs : List (Branch n)) : Expr (n+1) :=
  product (bs.map fun b => (Branch.mk (lift b.guard) (b.rows.map lift)).factor 0)

declarations.name: GuardedWidth.projection
declarations.snippet:
theorem projection (bs : List (Branch n)) (x : Fin n → Rat) :
    (∃ v : Rat, (compile bs).eval (withInverse v x) = 0) ↔
      ∃ b ∈ bs, b.guard.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ b.rows, p.eval x = 0 := by

declarations.name: WidthTower.Literal314.readOp

private def readOp (s : String) : Option Op := do
  match s.splitOn " " with
  | ["integer",c] => return .integer (← c.toInt?)
  | ["parameter",i] => return .param (← i.toNat?)
  | ["root",i] => return .root (← i.toNat?)
  | ["add",a,b] => return .plus (← a.toNat?) (← b.toNat?)
  | ["multiply",a,b] => return .times (← a.toNat?) (← b.toNat?)

declarations.name: WidthTower.Literal314.registers
declarations.snippet:
private def registers (n : ℕ) : Array (Test 82 n) :=
  ops.foldl (fun reg op => reg.push (match op with
    | .integer c => (c : Test 82 n)
    | .param j => if h : j < 82 then MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X ⟨j,h⟩) else 0
    | .root j => if h : j < n then MvPolynomial.X ⟨n-1-j, by omega⟩ else 0
    | .plus a b => reg[a]! + reg[b]!
    | .times a b => reg[a]! * reg[b]!)) #[]

declarations.name: WidthTower.Literal314.step
declarations.snippet:
private def step {n : ℕ} (t : ParamTower (Poly 82) n) (ids : List ℕ) :
    ParamTower (Poly 82) (n+1) :=
  let values := registers n
  let coeff : Fin ids.length → Test 82 n := fun i => values[ids[i]]!
  let f := Polynomial.X ^ ids.length +
    ∑ i : Fin ids.length, Polynomial.C (coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ (i : ℕ)
  .adjoin t f (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.degree_sum_fin_lt coeff))

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.coeff
declarations.snippet:
def coeff : (n : Nat) → J R n → Nat → R
  | 0, _, _ => 0
  | _+1, f, 0 => f.1
  | n+1, f, i+1 => coeff n f.2 i

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.ext_coeff
declarations.snippet:

    (same : ∀ i, i<n → coeff n a i=coeff n b i) : a=b := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.coeff_plus
declarations.snippet:
theorem coeff_plus (n) (a b : J R n) (i) :
    coeff n (plus n a b) i=coeff n a i+coeff n b i := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.coeff_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem coeff_scale (n) (c : R) (a : J R n) (i) :
    coeff n (scale n c a) i=c*coeff n a i := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.coeff_cut
declarations.snippet:
theorem coeff_cut (n) (a : J R (n+1)) (i) (bound : i<n) :
    coeff n (cut n a) i=coeff (n+1) a i := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.times_leading
declarations.snippet:
theorem times_leading (n) (a b : J R n) (i) (bound : i<n)
    (zero : ∀ j,j<i → coeff n b j=0) :
    coeff n (times n a b) i=coeff n a 0*coeff n b i := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.plug_leading
declarations.snippet:
theorem plug_leading (n) (u f : J R n) (i) (bound : i<n)
    (zero : ∀ j,j<i → coeff n f j=0) :
    coeff n (plug n u f) i=(coeff n u 0)^i*coeff n f i := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.commutes
declarations.snippet:
def commutes : (n : Nat) → J R n → J R n → Prop
  | 0, _, _ => True
  | n+1, m, d => cut n (times (n+1) d (plug (n+1) d m)) =
      cut n (times (n+1) m (plug (n+1) m d))

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.plug_comm
declarations.snippet:
private theorem plug_comm (n) (m d f : J R n) (comm : commutes n m d) :
    plug n d (plug n m f)=plug n m (plug n d f) := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.error_doubles
declarations.snippet:
theorem error_doubles (n) (m d f : J R n) (b : R) (comm : commutes n m d)
    (chart : plug n d f=scale n 2 f) :
    plug n d (plus n (plug n m f) (scale n (-b) f)) =
      scale n 2 (plus n (plug n m f) (scale n (-b) f)) := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.linearizes
declarations.snippet:
theorem linearizes {K : Type} [Field K] [IsCharP K 0]
    (n) (m d f : J K n) (b : K) (hd : coeff n d 0=2) (hb : coeff n m 0=b)
    (hf : coeff n f 0=0) (comm : commutes n m d)
    (chart : plug n d f=scale n 2 f) :
    plug n m f=scale n b f := by

declarations.snippet:

    {p short m n} (d : PhysicalRow h p short m n) : Observation O p short m n :=
  ⟨d.primary,d.alternate,d.u,Classical.choice (d.firstPair.tangent inj d.firstPoint),
     Classical.choice (d.secondPair.tangent inj d.secondPoint),
     Classical.choice (d.firstPair.absolute inj),
     (show 4*(altChart short).k=alternateOrder short from by cases short <;> rfl) ▸
        Classical.choice (d.secondPair.absolute inj),d.firstDepth,d.secondDepth,d.crossError,d.cross⟩

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.RingMap.curve
declarations.snippet:
def curve (h : RingMap O K) {n} (f : CurveData O n) : CurveData K n := by
  let v:=h.onJets (n+1)
  have num (j : Nat) : v.map (OfNat.ofNat (α:=J O (n+1)) j)=OfNat.ofNat (α:=J K (n+1)) j := h.jet_num _ j
  refine ⟨h.map f.D, h.jet _ f.w, h.jet _ f.dup,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · have eq:=congrArg v.map f.curve
    rw [v.mul,v.mul,v.pow,v.pow,v.sub,show v.map (X _)=X _ from h.jet_X _,
       show v.map (con _ f.D)=con _ (h.map f.D) from h.jet_con ..,num 1] at eq
    exact eq
  · have eq:=congrArg v.map f.doubleW
    rw [v.mul,v.pow,v.add,num 1,v.mul,v.mul,v.pow,v.sub,num 1,num 16,
      show v.map (plug _ f.dup f.w)=plug _ (v.map f.dup) (v.map f.w) from h.jet_plug ..] at eq
    exact eq
  · have eq:=congrArg v.map f.doubleZ
    rw [v.mul,v.add,v.sub,v.mul,v.pow,num 1,num 6,v.mul,v.sub,v.pow,num 1,num 2] at eq
    exact eq

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.FiniteJet.jetRing
declarations.snippet:
instance jetRing (n) : CommRing (J R n) where
  add := plus n
  mul := times n
  neg := scale n (-1)
  sub := fun a b => plus n a (scale n (-1) b)
  natCast := ⟨fun i => con n (i:R)⟩
  ofNat := fun i => ⟨con n (i:R)⟩
  intCast := ⟨fun i => con n (i:R)⟩
  nsmul := ⟨fun i => times n (con n (i:R))⟩
  zsmul := ⟨fun i => times n (con n (i:R))⟩
  npow := ⟨power n⟩
  add_zero := by intro a; change plus n a (con n ((0:Nat):R))=_;rw [Semiring.natCast_zero,plus_zero]
  add_comm := plus_comm n
  add_assoc := plus_assoc n
  mul_assoc := times_assoc n
  mul_comm := times_comm n
  mul_one := by intro a;change times n a (con n ((1:Nat):R))=_;rw [Semiring.natCast_one,times_comm,mul_con,scale_one]
  one_mul := by intro a;change times n (con n ((1:Nat):R)) a=a;rw [Semiring.natCast_one,mul_con,scale_one]
  zero_mul := by intro a;change times n (con n ((0:Nat):R)) a=con n ((0:Nat):R);rw [Semiring.natCast_zero,zero_times]
  mul_zero := by intro a;change times n a (con n ((0:Nat):R))=con n ((0:Nat):R);rw [Semiring.natCast_zero,times_comm,zero_times]
  right_distrib := times_plus_left n
  left_distrib := times_plus_right n
  pow_zero := by intro a;change con n (1:R)=con n ((1:Nat):R);rw [Semiring.natCast_one]
  pow_succ := by intros; rfl
  ofNat_succ := by intro k;change con n ((k+1:Nat):R)=plus n (con n (k:R)) (con n ((1:Nat):R));rw [Semiring.natCast_add,con_plus]
  neg_add_cancel := by intro a;change plus n (scale n (-1) a) a=con n ((0:Nat):R);rw [Semiring.natCast_zero,neg_cancel]
  sub_eq_add_neg := by intros; rfl
  neg_zsmul := by
    intro i a
    change times n (con n ((-i:Int):R)) a=scale n (-1) (times n (con n (i:R)) a)
    rw [mul_con,mul_con,scale_scale,Ring.intCast_neg];congr 1;grobner
  zsmul_natCast_eq_nsmul := by intro k a;change times n (con n ((k:Int):R)) a=times n (con n (k:R)) a;rw [Ring.intCast_natCast]
  intCast_ofNat := by intro k;change con n ((OfNat.ofNat k:Int):R)=con n (k:R);rw [Ring.intCast_ofNat,Semiring.ofNat_eq_natCast]
  intCast_neg := by intro i;change con n ((-i:Int):R)=scale n (-1) (con n (i:R));rw [scale_con,Ring.intCast_neg];congr 1;grobner

structure Side (O : Type) [CommRing O] where
  x : O
  y : O
  nx : O
  ry : O
  nx_unit : unit nx
  ry_unit : unit ry
  regular : ∀ a b : O,y*a=y*b→a=b

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.Local.ratio
declarations.snippet: def ratio (s : Side O) (l : O) := s.y*s.ry*l=s.x*s.nx

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.Local.Tangent
declarations.snippet:
structure Tangent (s : Side O) (m a : Int) where
  rx : O
  ry : O
  same : s.x*((m:O)+s.x*rx)=s.y*((a:O)+s.y*ry)

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.Local.crossEq
declarations.snippet:
def crossEq (s t : Side O) (delta : O) :=
    (s.x*s.nx)*(t.y*t.ry)-(t.x*t.nx)*(s.y*s.ry)=(s.y*s.ry)*(t.y*t.ry)*delta

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.Local.carry
declarations.snippet:
private theorem carry (s t : Side O) {l delta : O} (left : ratio s l)
    (cross : crossEq s t delta) : ratio t (l-delta) := by

declarations.name: WitnessTransfer.Local.two_sides
declarations.snippet:
theorem two_sides {k : Type} [Field k] (p : Place O k) (s t : Side O) (m u n : Int)
    (sx : p.residue.map s.x=0) (tx : p.residue.map t.x=0)
    (first : Tangent s m (2*u)) (second : Tangent t (m-2) (2*(u-n)))
    (delta : O) (cross : crossEq s t delta) :
    ∃ l l' : O,ratio s l ∧ ratio t l' ∧ l-l'=delta := by

declarations.name: SquareProgram.Emit.emitAll
declarations.snippet:
def emitAll : IO Unit := do
  let ops:=source
  let b:=Book.make targetSeed
  let t:=bank ops
  let w:=table b ops
  let p:=compile targetSeed ops shape
  IO.println s!"SOURCE {ops.length}"
  for op in ops do IO.println (textOp op)
  IO.println s!"TARGET {p.nodes.length} {p.ordinary} {p.marked}"
  for op in p.nodes do IO.println (textOp op)
  for r in peaks++others do
    let v:=result b ops.length t w r
    let word:=ref (v.num b)
    match r with
    | .replace492 => IO.println s!"REPLACED 492 {v.exponent} {word}"
    | .inherit f i high =>
      let j:=guardedIndex ops.length t f i high
      let e:=(getA empty w j).im.isNone
      IO.println s!"SIGNED {i} {j} {v.exponent} {word} {e} {high}"

def compileStep (b : Book) (Y2 : Word) (o : Op) (v : Nat→PairWord) : PairWord :=
  match o with
  | .var i => if i=1 then ⟨none,constant (integer b 1)⟩ else ⟨constant (varWord b i),none⟩
  | .int c => ⟨constant (integer b c),none⟩
  | .add i j => ⟨addCoeff b (v i).re (v j).re,addCoeff b (v i).im (v j).im⟩
  | .mul i j =>
    ⟨addCoeff b (mulCoeff b (v i).re (v j).re) (carry b Y2 (mulCoeff b (v i).im (v j).im)),
     addCoeff b (mulCoeff b (v i).re (v j).im) (mulCoeff b (v i).im (v j).re)⟩

declarations.name: SquareProgram.compile
declarations.snippet:
def compile (seed : Array Op) (ops : List Op) (s : Shape) : Program :=
  let b:=Book.make seed;let t:=bank ops;let w:=table b ops; let n:=ops.length
  let resolve r:=(result b n t w r).num b
  let h:=collect b resolve (integer b 0) s.high
  let low:=collect b resolve (integer b 0) s.low
  let input:=varWord b 1
  finish b (plus b h low) (plus b h (times b (times b input input) low))

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: SquareProgram.tagStep
declarations.snippet:
def tagStep (f : Frame) (o : Op) (v : Nat→Tags) : Tags :=
  match o with
  | .var i => ⟨inFrame f i,decide (i≠1),decide (i=1),decide (i≠1)⟩
  | .int c => ⟨true,decide (c=0),decide (c=0),true⟩
  | .add i j =>
    let a:=v i;let b:=v j
    ⟨a.localTo && b.localTo,a.sourceZero && b.sourceZero,a.noReal && b.noReal,a.noImag && b.noImag⟩
  | .mul i j =>
    let a:=v i;let b:=v j
    ⟨a.localTo && b.localTo,a.sourceZero || b.sourceZero,
     (a.noReal || b.noReal) && (a.noImag || b.noImag),
     (a.noReal || b.noImag) && (a.noImag || b.noReal)⟩

def onFixed (e : A ≃ₐ[ℚ] B) (s : G →* (A ≃ₐ[ℚ] A)) (t : G →* (B ≃ₐ[ℚ] B))
    (commutes : ∀ g a, e (s g a) = t g (e a)) :
    fixedAlgebra s ≃ₐ[ℚ] fixedAlgebra t where
  toFun a := ⟨e a, (mem_fixedAlgebra t _).2 fun g =>
    (commutes g a).symm.trans (congrArg e ((mem_fixedAlgebra s _).1 a.2 g))⟩
  invFun b := ⟨e.symm b, (mem_fixedAlgebra s _).2 fun g => e.injective (by
    rw [commutes, e.apply_symm_apply, (mem_fixedAlgebra t _).1 b.2 g])⟩
  left_inv a := Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply a.val)
  right_inv b := Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply b.val)
  map_mul' a b := Subtype.ext (e.map_mul a.val b.val)
  map_add' a b := Subtype.ext (e.map_add a.val b.val)
  commutes' r := Subtype.ext (e.commutes r)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Specialization.invariantSpecialization

noncomputable def invariantSpecialization
    (ev : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (rigidity : Function.Injective ev) (lifts : Function.Surjective ev)

    (t : G →* (Matrix I I B ≃ₐ[ℚ] Matrix I I B))
    (equivariant : ∀ g M, ev.mapMatrix (s g M) = t g (ev.mapMatrix M)) :
    fixedAlgebra s ≃ₐ[ℚ] fixedAlgebra t :=
  onFixed (AlgEquiv.ofBijective ev ⟨rigidity, lifts⟩).mapMatrix s t equivariant

    {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) (j : K →+* hp.Corner) (r : ℚ) :

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Specialization.cornerEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def cornerEquiv (e : A ≃+* B) {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) :
    hp.Corner ≃+* (map_idempotent e hp).Corner where
  toFun x := ⟨e x.1, by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := x.2
    exact ⟨e a, by simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg e ha⟩⟩
  invFun y := ⟨e.symm y.1, by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := y.2
    exact ⟨e.symm b, by simpa only [map_mul, e.symm_apply_apply] using congrArg e.symm hb⟩⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply x.1)
  right_inv y := Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply y.1)
  map_add' x y := Subtype.ext (e.map_add x.1 y.1)
  map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (e.map_mul x.1 y.1)

theorem lift_projector_and_field (ev : A ≃+* B) {K : Type*} [Field K] {q : B}
    (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) (ι : K →+* hq.Corner) (faithful : Function.Injective ι) :
    ∃ (p : A) (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) (j : K →+* hp.Corner),
      ev p = q ∧ Function.Injective j ∧ (∀ a : K, ev (j a).1 = (ι a).1) ∧ (j 1).1 = p := by

    {A B G I K : Type*} [Ring A] [Ring B] [Algebra ℚ A] [Algebra ℚ B]
    [Group G] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Field K]
    (ev : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (rigidity : Function.Injective ev) (lifts : Function.Surjective ev)
    (s : G →* (Matrix I I A ≃ₐ[ℚ] Matrix I I A))
    (t : G →* (Matrix I I B ≃ₐ[ℚ] Matrix I I B))
    (equivariant : ∀ g M, ev.mapMatrix (s g M) = t g (ev.mapMatrix M))
    {q : fixedAlgebra t} (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) (ι : K →+* hq.Corner)
    (faithful : Function.Injective ι) :
    ∃ (p : fixedAlgebra s) (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) (j : K →+* hp.Corner),
      ev.mapMatrix p.val = q.val ∧ Function.Injective j ∧
      (∀ a : K, ev.mapMatrix (j a).1.val = (ι a).1.val) ∧ (j 1).1 = p := by

declarations.snippet:
def binarySextic {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (u v x z : A) : A :=
  (x^2 + 2*x*z - 2*z^2) * (4*u*(2*x-z)*z^3 - v*x^3*(x+4*z))

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.binary_swap

theorem binary_swap {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (u v x z : A) :
    binarySextic u v (-2*z) x = -8 * binarySextic v u x z := by

def AffinePoint (u v d : K) :=
  {p : K × K // p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ 2*d*p.2^2 = binarySextic u v p.1 1}

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.affine_swap
declarations.snippet:
theorem affine_swap (u v x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x^6 * binarySextic u v (-2/x) 1 = -8 * binarySextic v u x 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.affineMove
declarations.snippet:
def affineMove (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) (p : AffinePoint v u d) :
    AffinePoint u v d := by
  rcases p with ⟨⟨x,y⟩,hx,hy⟩
  refine ⟨(-2/x, 2*r*y/x^3), div_ne_zero (by norm_num) hx, ?_⟩
  change 2*d*(2*r*y/x^3)^2 = _
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 6 hx)
  rw [affine_swap _ _ _ hx]
  calc
    x^6 * (2*d*(2*r*y/x^3)^2) = (4*r^2)*(2*d*y^2) := by field_simp; ring
    _ = -8 * binarySextic v u x 1 := by rw [hr, hy]; ring

declarations.snippet:
private theorem affineMove_twice (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) (p : AffinePoint u v d) :
    affineMove u v d r hr (affineMove v u d r hr p) = p := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.affineEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def affineEquiv (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) : AffinePoint v u d ≃ AffinePoint u v d where
  toFun := affineMove u v d r hr
  invFun := affineMove v u d r hr
  left_inv := affineMove_twice v u d r hr
  right_inv := affineMove_twice u v d r hr

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.finiteReciprocalEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def finiteReciprocalEquiv (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) :
    {p : K × K // 2*d*p.2^2 = binarySextic v u p.1 1} ≃
      {p : K × K // 2*d*p.2^2 = binarySextic u v 1 p.1} where
  toFun := fun ⟨⟨x,y⟩,hy⟩ => ⟨(-x/2,-r*y/4), by
    change 2*d*(-r*y/4)^2 = binarySextic u v 1 (-x/2)
    have h : binarySextic u v 1 (-x/2) = (-1/8)*binarySextic v u x 1 := by
      unfold binarySextic
      ring
    rw [h]
    change 2*d*y^2 = binarySextic v u x 1 at hy
    linear_combination (d*y^2/8)*hr - (1/8)*hy⟩
  invFun := fun ⟨⟨z,w⟩,hw⟩ => ⟨(-2*z,2*r*w), by
    change 2*d*(2*r*w)^2 = binarySextic v u (-2*z) 1
    rw [binary_swap]
    change 2*d*w^2 = binarySextic u v 1 z at hw
    linear_combination 8*d*w^2*hr - 8*hw⟩
  left_inv := by
    rintro ⟨⟨x,y⟩,_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · change -2*(-x/2)=x
      ring
    · change 2*r*(-r*y/4)=y
      linear_combination -(y/2)*hr
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨⟨z,w⟩,_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · change -(-2*z)/2=z
      ring
    · change -r*(2*r*w)/4=w
      linear_combination -(w/2)*hr

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.boundaryEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def boundaryEquiv (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) :
    {y : K // 2*d*y^2 = binarySextic v u 0 1} ≃
      {w : K // 2*d*w^2 = binarySextic u v 1 0} where
  toFun := fun ⟨y,hy⟩ => ⟨-r*y/4, by
    have h : 2*d*y^2 = 8*v := by
      rw [hy]
      unfold binarySextic
      ring
    simp only [binarySextic]
    linear_combination (d*y^2/8)*hr - (1/8)*h⟩
  invFun := fun ⟨w,hw⟩ => ⟨2*r*w, by
    have h : 2*d*w^2 = -v := by simpa [binarySextic] using hw
    simp only [binarySextic]
    linear_combination 8*d*w^2*hr - 8*h⟩
  left_inv := by
    rintro ⟨y,_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change 2*r*(-r*y/4) = y
    linear_combination -(y/2)*hr
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨w,_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change -r*(2*r*w)/4 = w
    linear_combination -(w/2)*hr

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.kScalar
declarations.snippet:
private def kScalar (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] (r : K) : A :=
  algebraMap K A (2*r)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.cScalar_rel
declarations.snippet: private theorem cScalar_rel : -2*cScalar K A = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.kScalar_rel
declarations.snippet: private theorem kScalar_rel {r : K} (hr : r^2 = -2) : kScalar A r ^ 2 = -8 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.invRel
declarations.snippet: private def invRel : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K := X 0 * X 1 - 1

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.curveRel
declarations.snippet:
private def curveRel (u v d : K) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K :=
  2*C d*(X 2)^2 - binarySextic (C u) (C v) (X 0) 1

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.chartIdeal
declarations.snippet:
private def chartIdeal (u v d : K) : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) :=

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.ChartRing

declarations.snippet: def coord (u v d : K) (i : Fin 3) : ChartRing u v d := Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.eval_invRel
declarations.snippet:
private theorem eval_invRel (p : Fin 3 → A) :
    aeval p (invRel (K:=K)) = p 0*p 1-1 := by simp [invRel]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.eval_curveRel
ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.coord_onChart
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coord_onChart (u v d : K) :
    OnChart (algebraMap K _ u) (algebraMap K _ v) (algebraMap K _ d) (coord u v d) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.evaluate
declarations.snippet:
private def evaluate (u v d : K) (p : Fin 3 → A)
    (hp : OnChart (algebraMap K A u) (algebraMap K A v) (algebraMap K A d) p) :
    ChartRing u v d →ₐ[K] A :=
  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (aeval p) fun _ hf => by
    have h : chartIdeal u v d ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval p : _ →ₐ[K] A) := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro f hf
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hf with h | h
      · subst f
        change aeval p invRel = 0
        rw [eval_invRel, hp.1, sub_self]
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h]
        change aeval p (curveRel u v d) = 0
        rw [eval_curveRel, hp.2, sub_self]
    exact h hf

declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardConjugation.conjugationHom
declarations.snippet:
private def conjugationHom (u v d r : K) (hr : r^2 = -2) :
    ChartRing u v d →ₐ[K] ChartRing v u d :=
  evaluate u v d (transformed (cScalar K _) (kScalar _ r) (coord v u d))
    (transformed_onChart cScalar_rel (kScalar_rel hr) (coord_onChart v u d))

theorem integer_polynomial_of_fibre_estimates (g : ℕ) (fixed : Finset ℕ) (except : Finset ℚ)
    (bad : ℚ → Finset ℕ) (fibreHeight : ℚ → ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (fixedPrimes : ∀ p ∈ fixed, p.Prime)
    (support : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      ∀ p ∈ bad s, p.Prime ∧ (p ∈ fixed ∨ Odd (padicValRat p (primitiveBranch s))))
    (effective : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      fibreHeight s ≤ vonKanelBound g (bad s))
    (comparison : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      ratHeight (igusaRatio (chart s)) ≤ a * max 1 (fibreHeight s) + b)
    (tian : PublishedTian47) (grossZagier : ZOverQ.Bounded.SimpleZeroRank) : IntegerPolynomial := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardLocal.quadratic

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardLocal.quartic

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.PicardLocal.contact_chart_mod
declarations.snippet:
theorem contact_chart_mod {k : Type*} [CommRing k] (φ : R →+* k) (a : R) {c : R}
    (hc : φ c = 0) (V d : R) :

    ∃ w : Fin 3 → k, Function.Injective w ∧ ∀ i,

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.coefficients

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.secondInvariant

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.secondInvariant_eq
declarations.snippet:

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.discriminantValue

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.ratio
declarations.snippet: def ratio (U V : K) : K := (secondInvariant (coefficients U V))^5 / discriminantValue U V

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.ratio_factor

      ∀ p ∈ bad s, p.Prime ∧ (p ∈ fixed ∨ Odd (padicValRat p (primitiveBranch s))))
    (effective : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      fibreHeight s ≤ vonKanelBound g (bad s))
    (comparison : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      ratHeight s ≤ a * max 1 (fibreHeight s) + b) :

        (List.ofFn E₀ ++ List.ofFn E₁ ++ List.ofFn E₂ ++ List.ofFn E₃ ++ List.ofFn E₄) ↔
      ∃ c : Fin 5 → ℕ, (∀ i, (![E₀, E₁, E₂, E₃, E₄] : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℚ) i = iota (c i)) ∧
        accepts c := by

    (hM : MultiplicationExact specConstructors FixedConst.cstar.value FixedConst.ell.value T)

    (height : ∀ t : ℚ, t ∉ contactSet →

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.bracketEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def bracketEquiv (d : ℕ) (hd : d % 8 = 5) :
    BracketTerm d ≃ ↥(admissibleFactorizations d) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun T => ⟨T.factors, mem_filter.mpr (T.valid hd)⟩)
    ⟨fun _ _ h => BracketTerm.factors_injective hd (congrArg Subtype.val h),
     fun F => by
       obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := BracketTerm.exists_of_factors hd F.property
       exact ⟨T, Subtype.ext hT⟩⟩

  letI : Fintype (BracketTerm d) := Fintype.ofEquiv _ (bracketEquiv d hd).symm
  ∑ T : BracketTerm d, genusNumber T.d₀ * genusNumber T.d₁ * ∏ r ∈ T.rest, genusNumber r

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.admissiblePartitionEquiv
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def admissiblePartitionEquiv {d : ℕ} (hd : d % 8 = 5) (hs : Squarefree d) :
    {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃ BracketTerm d := by
  let e : {P : PrimePartition d // ZInQ.RouteK.Rank5b.Admissible5bNat d P} ≃
      ↥(admissibleFactorizations d) := {
    toFun := fun P => ⟨factors P.val,
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨factors_mem hs P.val, (residues_factors P.val).mpr P.property⟩⟩
    invFun := fun F => by
      obtain ⟨hF, hR⟩ := mem_filter.mp F.property
      refine ⟨partitionOf hs F.val hF, (residues_factors _).mp ?_⟩
      rwa [factors_partitionOf]
    left_inv := fun P => Subtype.ext (factors_injective (factors_partitionOf hs (factors_mem hs P.val)))
    right_inv := fun F => Subtype.ext (factors_partitionOf hs (mem_filter.mp F.property).1)
  }
  exact e.trans (bracketEquiv d hd).symm

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unique_owner
ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.partitionOf
declarations.snippet:
def partitionOf {d : ℕ} (hs : Squarefree d) (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : F ∈ factorizations d) :
    PrimePartition d := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hlt, hprod⟩ := (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero F).mp hF
  refine Finpartition.ofExistsUnique (F.image (primeBlock d)) (fun _ _ => subset_univ _) ?_ ?_
  · intro p _
    have hpr := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.property).prime
    have hdiv := (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors p.property).trans (dvd_of_eq hprod.symm)
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := (hpr.dvd_finsetProd_iff id).mp hdiv
    refine ⟨primeBlock d a, ⟨mem_image_of_mem _ ha, mem_primeBlock.mpr hpa⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro B ⟨hB, hpB⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hB
    exact congrArg (primeBlock d) (unique_owner hs (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.property)
      hprod hb ha (mem_primeBlock.mp hpB) hpa)
  · intro hemp
    obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := mem_image.mp hemp
    have had : a ∣ d := hprod ▸ dvd_prod_of_mem id ha
    have hone : a = 1 := by
      rw [← dProd_primeBlock hs had, h]
      simp [dProd]
    exact (ne_of_gt (hlt a ha)) hone

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.factorizationEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def factorizationEquiv (d : ℕ) (hs : Squarefree d) : PrimePartition d ≃ ↥(factorizations d) where
  toFun P := ⟨factors P, factors_mem hs P⟩
  invFun F := partitionOf hs F.val F.property
  left_inv P := factors_injective (factors_partitionOf hs (factors_mem hs P))
  right_inv F := Subtype.ext (factors_partitionOf hs F.property)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.Residues
declarations.snippet:
def Residues (F : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  (F.filter (fun a => a % 8 = 7)).card = 1 ∧
  (F.filter (fun a => a % 8 = 3)).card = 1 ∧
  ∀ a ∈ F, a % 8 = 7 ∨ a % 8 = 3 ∨ a % 8 = 1

theorem sum_by_factorizations {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {d : ℕ}
    (hs : Squarefree d) (w : ℕ → R) :
    (∑ F ∈ factorizations d, if Residues F then ∏ a ∈ F, w a else 0) =
    ∑ P : PrimePartition d, if Admissible5bNat d P then ∏ B ∈ P.parts, w (dProd B) else 0 := by

theorem unorderedFactorization_weight {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (w : ℕ → M)
    {d : ℕ} (hs : Squarefree d) (s : {s : Multiset ℕ // (∀ a ∈ s, 1 < a) ∧ s.prod = d}) :
    ∏ a ∈ ((unorderedFactorizationEquiv d hs) s).val, w a = (s.val.map w).prod := rfl

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unorderedSum
declarations.snippet:
noncomputable def unorderedSum {d : ℕ} (hs : Squarefree d) (keep : Finset ℕ → Prop)
    (w : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ := by
  classical
  let e := unorderedFactorizationEquiv d hs
  let _ := Fintype.ofEquiv _ e.symm
  exact ∑ s : {s : Multiset ℕ // (∀ a ∈ s, 1 < a) ∧ s.prod = d},
    if keep s.val.toFinset then (s.val.map w).prod else 0

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unorderedGenusSum_eq
declarations.snippet:

declarations.snippet:
theorem nodup_of_squarefree_product (s : Multiset ℕ) (hs : Squarefree s.prod)

declarations.name: ZInQBlueprint.TYZ.unorderedFactorizationEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def unorderedFactorizationEquiv (d : ℕ) (hs : Squarefree d) :
    {s : Multiset ℕ // (∀ a ∈ s, 1 < a) ∧ s.prod = d} ≃ ↥(factorizations d) where
  toFun s := by
    have hsq : Squarefree s.val.prod := by rw [s.property.2]; exact hs
    let F : Finset ℕ := ⟨s.val, nodup_of_squarefree_product s.val hsq s.property.1⟩
    refine ⟨F, (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero F).mpr ⟨s.property.1, ?_⟩⟩
    simpa [Finset.prod, F] using s.property.2
  invFun F := by
    obtain ⟨hlt,hprod⟩ := (mem_factorizations hs.ne_zero _).mp F.property
    refine ⟨F.val.val, hlt, ?_⟩
    change (F.val.val.map id).prod = d at hprod
    simpa only [Multiset.map_id] using hprod
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

      Even (TYZ.printedCoefficient d hd)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.AbelianPowers.baseChangePowerIso
declarations.snippet:
def baseChangePowerIso (f : R →+* S) {A : GroupScheme R} {B : GroupScheme S}
    (e : (baseChange f).obj A ≅ B) : (n : ℕ) → (baseChange f).obj (power A n) ≅ power B n
  | 0 => e
  | n+1 => by
    let U := CommGrp.forget₂Grp (Over (Spec (.of S)))
    let F := (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))).mapGrp
    apply (CommGrp.fullyFaithfulForget₂Grp _).preimageIso
    change F.obj ((power A n).toGrp ⊗ A.toGrp) ≅ (power B n).toGrp ⊗ B.toGrp
    exact (Functor.Monoidal.μIso F _ _).symm ≪≫
      tensorIso (U.mapIso (baseChangePowerIso f e n)) (U.mapIso e)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.FibrewiseProjector.fieldAction
declarations.snippet:
def fieldAction (b : G → Qbarˣ) (g : G) :
    coefficientField b ≃ₗ[ℚ] coefficientField b where
  toFun x := coefficientValue b g * x
  invFun x := (↑((coefficientUnit b g)⁻¹) : coefficientField b) * x
  left_inv x := by
    change (↑((coefficientUnit b g)⁻¹) : coefficientField b) *
      (↑(coefficientUnit b g) * x) = x
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]
  right_inv x := by
    change (↑(coefficientUnit b g) : coefficientField b) *
      (↑((coefficientUnit b g)⁻¹) * x) = x
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]
  map_add' x y := mul_add _ x y
  map_smul' r x := by
    change coefficientValue b g * (r • x) = r • (coefficientValue b g * x)
    rw [mul_smul_comm]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.FibrewiseProjector.fieldAction_mul
declarations.snippet:
theorem fieldAction_mul (b : G → Qbarˣ) (c : G × G → ℚˣ)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h))
    (g h : G) (x : coefficientField b) :
    fieldAction b g (fieldAction b h x) = (c (g,h) : ℚ) • fieldAction b (g*h) x := by

    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) (g h k : G) :
    c (g*h,k) * c (g,h) = c (h,k) * c (g,h*k) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.FibrewiseProjector.exists_projector
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_projector (b : G → Qbarˣ) (c : G × G → ℚˣ)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) :
    ∃ p : Module.End ℚ (G → ℚ), p.comp p = p ∧
      (∀ g x, twistedLeftShift c g (p x) = p (twistedLeftShift c g x)) ∧
      ∃ e : LinearMap.range p ≃ₗ[ℚ] coefficientField b,
        (∀ x, e ⟨p x, x, rfl⟩ = coefficientEvaluation b x) ∧
        Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range p) = Module.finrank ℚ (coefficientField b) ∧
        0 < Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range p) ∧
        Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range p) ≤ Nat.card G := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.FibrewiseProjector.exists_projector_of_quotient
declarations.snippet:
theorem exists_projector_of_quotient [Fintype H] [Fintype Γ] (surj : Function.Surjective π) :
    ∃ p : Module.End ℚ (H → ℚ), p.comp p = p ∧
      (∀ g x, twistedLeftShift (fun z => c (π z.1,π z.2)) g (p x) =
        p (twistedLeftShift (fun z => c (π z.1,π z.2)) g x)) ∧
      ∃ e : LinearMap.range p ≃ₗ[ℚ] coefficientField b,
        (∀ x, e ⟨p x, x, rfl⟩ = coefficientEvaluation b x) ∧
        0 < Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range p) ∧
        Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range p) ≤ Nat.card Γ := by

declarations.snippet:
private theorem component_snd (X : Over (Spec (.of K))) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    (component X σ).hom.left ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = ((F).obj X).hom := pullback.lift_snd ..

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.deck_naturality
declarations.snippet:
private theorem deck_naturality {X Y : Over (Spec (.of K))} (f : X ⟶ Y) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    ((F).map f).left ≫ deck Y.hom σ = deck X.hom σ ≫ ((F).map f).left := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.rationalComparison
declarations.snippet:
private def rationalComparison (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) : F ≅ F ⋙ G σ :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => component X σ) fun {X Y} f => by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · change (((F).map f).left ≫ (component Y σ).hom.left) ≫ _ = ((component X σ).hom.left ≫ ((G σ).map ((F).map f)).left) ≫ _
      simp only [Category.assoc, component_fst, G, Over.pullback_map_left, pullback.lift_fst, ← Category.assoc (component X σ).hom.left, component_fst]
      exact deck_naturality f σ
    · change (((F).map f).left ≫ (component Y σ).hom.left) ≫ _ = ((component X σ).hom.left ≫ ((G σ).map ((F).map f)).left) ≫ _
      simp only [Category.assoc,component_snd, G, Over.pullback_map_left, pullback.lift_snd]
      exact ((F).map f).w

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.rationalGroupComparison
ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.comparison_fst
declarations.snippet:
private theorem comparison_fst (A : GroupScheme K) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    (rationalGroupComparison A σ).hom.hom.hom.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = deck A.X.hom σ := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.sliceHom_descent
declarations.snippet:
private theorem sliceHom_descent [CharZero K] [Normal K Ω]
    {A B : Over (Spec (.of K))} [LocallyOfFiniteType A.hom] [IsReduced A.left] [IsSeparated B.hom]
    (f : (F).obj A ⟶ (F).obj B)
    (invariant : ∀ σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω, deck A.hom σ ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ deck B.hom σ) :
    ∃! g : A ⟶ B, (F).map g = f := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.groupHom_descent
declarations.snippet:
theorem groupHom_descent [CharZero K] [Normal K Ω]
    {A B : GroupScheme K} [LocallyOfFiniteType A.X.hom] [IsReduced A.X.left] [IsSeparated B.X.hom]
    (f : (FB).obj A ⟶ (FB).obj B)
    (invariant : ∀ σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω, deck A.X.hom σ ≫ f.hom.hom.hom.left =
      f.hom.hom.hom.left ≫ deck B.X.hom σ) :
    ∃! g : A ⟶ B, (FB).map g = f := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.conjugate
declarations.snippet:
def conjugate {A B : GroupScheme K} (f : (FB).obj A ⟶ (FB).obj B) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    (FB).obj A ⟶ (FB).obj B :=
  (rationalGroupComparison A σ).hom ≫ (baseChange σ.toRingHom).map f ≫
    (rationalGroupComparison B σ).inv

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.conjugate_deck
declarations.snippet:
theorem conjugate_deck {A B : GroupScheme K} (f : (FB).obj A ⟶ (FB).obj B) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    deck A.X.hom σ ≫ f.hom.hom.hom.left =
      (conjugate f σ).hom.hom.hom.left ≫ deck B.X.hom σ := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.epi_of_finite_flat
declarations.snippet:
theorem epi_of_finite_flat {A B : GroupScheme K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    [IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left] [Flat f.hom.hom.hom.left] [Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left] :
    Epi f := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.finite_surjective_of_baseChange
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_surjective_of_baseChange {A B : GroupScheme K}
    (proper : IsProper A.X.hom) (separated : IsSeparated B.X.hom) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (finite : IsFinite ((FB).map f).hom.hom.hom.left)
    (surj : Surjective ((FB).map f).hom.hom.hom.left) :
    IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.hom_rat_injective
declarations.snippet:
theorem hom_rat_injective (multiply_epi : ∀ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 → Epi (z • 𝟙 U)) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : U ⟶ V => (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.afterHom
declarations.snippet:
def afterHom (f : U ⟶ V) :
    (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End U) →ₗ[ℤ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] (U ⟶ V)) :=
  TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id
    ((Preadditive.rightComp U f).comp End.addEquiv.toAddMonoidHom).toIntLinearMap

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.afterHom_one
declarations.snippet: theorem afterHom_one (f : U ⟶ V) : afterHom f 1 = (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.restriction_of_fixes
declarations.snippet:
theorem restriction_of_fixes (σ : Gal(Qbar/M)) :
    restriction M (σ.restrictScalars ℚ) = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.coefficientUnit_at_fixes
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientUnit_at_fixes
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ) (c : Gal(M/ℚ) × Gal(M/ℚ) → ℚˣ) (hc : c (1,1) = 1)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) (σ : Gal(Qbar/M)) :
    coefficientUnit b (restriction M (σ.restrictScalars ℚ)) = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.isogeny_of_splitting_law
declarations.snippet:
theorem isogeny_of_splitting_law
    {A B : GroupScheme M} [LocallyOfFiniteType A.X.hom] [IsReduced A.X.left]
    (proper : IsProper A.X.hom) (separated : IsSeparated B.X.hom)
    (b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ) (c : Gal(M/ℚ) × Gal(M/ℚ) → ℚˣ) (hc : c (1,1) = 1)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h))
    (φ : coefficientField b →ₐ[ℚ] (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] End ((F).obj A)))
    (κ : (F).obj A ⟶ (F).obj B)
    (finite : IsFinite κ.hom.hom.hom.left) (surj : Surjective κ.hom.hom.hom.left)
    (multiples : ∀ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 →
      let nz := (z • 𝟙 ((F).obj A)).hom.hom.hom.left
      IsFinite nz ∧ Flat nz ∧ Surjective nz)
    (law : ∀ σ : Gal(Qbar/M), (1:ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (conjugate κ σ) = afterHom κ
      (φ (↑((coefficientUnit b (restriction M (σ.restrictScalars ℚ)))⁻¹) : coefficientField b))) :
    ∃! f : A ⟶ B, (F).map f = κ ∧ IsFinite f.hom.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.GuitartDescent.quadratic_field_action
declarations.snippet:
theorem quadratic_field_action {E A : Type} [Field E] [NumberField E] [Ring A]
    [Nontrivial A] [Algebra E A] [Algebra ℚ A] [IsScalarTower ℚ E A]
    (d : E) (ns : ¬ IsSquare d) (u : A) (hu : u*u = algebraMap E A d) :
    ∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : NumberField L),
      Module.finrank ℚ L = 2 * Module.finrank ℚ E ∧ Nonempty (L →ₐ[ℚ] A) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.Residues
declarations.snippet: abbrev Residues := AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.frob
declarations.snippet: private def frob : WittRing p →+* WittRing p := WittVector.map (frobenius (Residues p) p)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.residueExtension
declarations.snippet:
def residueExtension (n : ℕ) : Subfield (Residues p) :=
  (iterateFrobenius (Residues p) p n).eqLocusField (RingHom.id _)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.residueExtension_finite
declarations.snippet: theorem residueExtension_finite {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Finite (residueExtension p n) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.inclusion
declarations.snippet:
def inclusion (F : Subfield (Residues p)) : WittVector p F →+* WittRing p :=
  WittVector.map F.subtype

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.inclusion_injective
declarations.snippet: theorem inclusion_injective (F : Subfield (Residues p)) : Function.Injective (inclusion p F) :=

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.coeff_iterate
declarations.snippet:
private theorem coeff_iterate (n : ℕ) (w : WittRing p) (j : ℕ) :
    (((frob p)^[n]) w).coeff j = iterateFrobenius (Residues p) p n (w.coeff j) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.mem_witt_range
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_witt_range {n : ℕ} {w : WittRing p} (h : ((frob p)^[n]) w = w) :
    w ∈ Set.range (inclusion p (residueExtension p n)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.finite_ring_for_roots
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_ring_for_roots (P : (WittRing p)[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hf : P.map (frob p) = P) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ w, P.IsRoot w → w ∈ Set.range (inclusion p (residueExtension p n)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.upper
declarations.snippet: def upper {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : ℤ) (ρ : R) : R := (a:R)+ρ*(b:R)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.lower
declarations.snippet: def lower {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : ℤ) (ρ : R) : R := (a:R)-ρ*(b:R)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.twisted
declarations.snippet:
def twisted {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b e : ℤ) (ρ : R) : R[X] :=
  C (2*(e:R)) * sextic ((upper a b ρ)^6) ((lower a b ρ)^6)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.sextic_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem sextic_scale {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (c U V : R) :
    sextic (c*U) (c*V) = C c*sextic U V := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.primitive_chart_scale
declarations.snippet:
theorem primitive_chart_scale {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (s : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (he : e ≠ 0) (ρ : K) :
    let v := 2*(e:K)*(s.den:K)^3
    v ≠ 0 ∧ twisted s.num s.den e ρ =
      C (v^2)*sextic (((s:K)+ρ)^6/(2*(e:K))) (((s:K)-ρ)^6/(2*(e:K))) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.coordinates_nonzero
declarations.snippet:
theorem coordinates_nonzero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R]
    (a b : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) {ρ : R} (hρ : ρ^2 = -3) :
    upper a b ρ ≠ 0 ∧ lower a b ρ ≠ 0 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.finite_ring_for_family
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_ring_for_family (a b : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) {ρ : WittRing p} (hρ : ρ^2 = -3) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ρ ∈ Set.range (inclusion p (residueExtension p n)) ∧
      (∀ z : WittRing p, z^2 = -2 → z ∈ Set.range (inclusion p (residueExtension p n))) ∧
      ∀ w, (sextic ((upper a b ρ)^6) ((lower a b ρ)^6)).IsRoot w →
        w ∈ Set.range (inclusion p (residueExtension p n)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.fromPadics
declarations.snippet:
def fromPadics : ℤ_[p] →+* WittVector p k :=
  (WittVector.map (ZMod.castHom (by simp) k)).comp (WittVector.equiv p).symm.toRingHom

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.congruence
declarations.snippet:
private theorem congruence {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (q : R) (m : ℕ) (x y : M) :
    x ≡ y [SMOD ((Ideal.span {q})^m • ⊤ : Submodule R M)] ↔
    ∃ z : M, q^m • z = x-y := by

declarations.snippet:
private theorem pi_precomplete (ι : Type*) :
    IsPrecomplete (maximalIdeal ℤ_[p]) (ι → ℤ_[p]) := by

declarations.snippet: theorem finite_witt : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (WittVector p k) := by

ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.witt_unramified

theorem witt_unramified : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (WittVector p k) ∧

declarations.snippet: theorem witt_finite_etale : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (WittVector p k) ∧ Algebra.Etale ℤ_[p] (WittVector p k) := by

declarations.snippet:
private theorem toFraction_injective : Function.Injective
    (algebraMap ℤ_[p] (FractionRing (WittVector p k))) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.wittFractionAlgebra
declarations.snippet:
@[instance_reducible] def wittFractionAlgebra : Algebra ℚ_[p] (FractionRing (WittVector p k)) :=
  (IsFractionRing.lift (toFraction_injective p k)).toAlgebra

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.witt_fraction_unramified
declarations.snippet:
theorem witt_fraction_unramified :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (FractionRing (WittVector p k)) ∧
    IsIntegralClosure (WittVector p k) ℤ_[p] (FractionRing (WittVector p k)) ∧
    (maximalIdeal (WittVector p k)).ramificationIdx ℤ_[p] = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.relative_finite_etale
declarations.snippet:
theorem relative_finite_etale (K : IntermediateField ℚ_[p] (FractionRing (WittVector p k))) :
    let S := WittVector p k
    let L := FractionRing S
    let O := integralClosure ℤ_[p] K
    ∃ ψ : O →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] S,
      (∀ x : O, algebraMap S L (ψ x)=algebraMap K L (x:K)) ∧
      letI := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite O S ∧ Algebra.Etale O S ∧
        (maximalIdeal S).ramificationIdx O = 1 ∧ ((maximalIdeal S).under O).ramificationIdx ℤ_[p] = 1 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.FiniteSplitting
declarations.snippet:
structure FiniteSplitting where
  field : Subfield (Residues p)
  finite : Finite field
  rho : WittVector p field
  inclusion_rho : inclusion p field rho = ρ
  radical : ∀ z : WittRing p, z^2 = -2 → z ∈ Set.range (inclusion p field)
  splits : (twisted a b e rho).Splits
