declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_twisted_splitting (hb : b ≠ 0) (hρ : ρ^2 = -3)
    (hs : (sextic ((upper a b ρ)^6) ((lower a b ρ)^6)).Splits) :
    Nonempty (FiniteSplitting p a b e ρ) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.Index
declarations.snippet: abbrev Index := Fin 2 × Fin 3

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.Cluster
declarations.snippet: abbrev Cluster := Finset Index

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.Configuration
declarations.snippet:
structure Configuration {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (c : R) where
  point : Index → R
  root : ∀ i, f.IsRoot (point i)
  deep : ∀ i j : Index, i ≠ j → i.1 = j.1 → i.1 ∈ A →
    ∃ z : Rˣ, point i-point j = c*(z:R)
  shallow : ∀ i j : Index, i ≠ j → ¬(i.1 = j.1 ∧ i.1 ∈ A) → IsUnit (point i-point j)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.configuration_two
ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.configuration_one
ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.unit_value
declarations.snippet:
private theorem unit_value {R K Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K]
    [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ] (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ)
    (hunit : ∀ u : Rˣ, v (ι (u:R))=0) {x : R} (hx : IsUnit x) : v (ι x) = 0 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.distances
declarations.snippet:
def distances {Γ : Type*} [Zero Γ] [Top Γ] (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (m : Γ) (i j : Index) : Γ :=
  if i=j then ⊤ else if i.1=j.1 ∧ i.1∈A then m else 0

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.pairwise_valuations
declarations.snippet:
theorem pairwise_valuations {R K Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K]
    [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ] {f : R[X]} {A : Finset (Fin 2)} {c : R}
    (T : Configuration f A c) (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ)
    (units : ∀ u : Rˣ, v (ι (u:R))=0) (i j : Index) :
    v (ι (T.point i)-ι (T.point j)) = distances A (v (ι c)) i j := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.recenter
declarations.snippet:
private theorem recenter {K Γ : Type*} [CommRing K] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    (v : AddValuation K Γ) (x b z : K) (t : Γ) (hb : t ≤ v (b-z)) :
    t ≤ v (x-z) ↔ t ≤ v (x-b) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.geometric_disc
declarations.snippet:
theorem geometric_disc {R K Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    {f : R[X]} {A : Finset (Fin 2)} {c : R} (T : Configuration f A c)
    (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ) (units : ∀ u : Rˣ, v (ι (u:R))=0)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ v (ι c)) (z : K) (t : Γ) (b : Index) (hb : t ≤ v (ι (T.point b)-z)) :
    {i | t ≤ v (ι (T.point i)-z)} = if t ≤ 0 then Set.univ else
      if t ≤ v (ι c) ∧ b.1∈A then {i : Index | i.1=b.1} else {b} := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.row
declarations.snippet: def row (i : Fin 2) : Cluster := Finset.univ.filter fun b => b.1=i

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.tree
declarations.snippet:
def tree (A : Finset (Fin 2)) : Finset Cluster :=
  {Finset.univ} ∪ A.image row ∪ Finset.univ.image (fun i : Index => {i})

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.mem_tree
declarations.snippet:
theorem mem_tree : ∀ (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (s : Cluster), s∈tree A ↔
    s=Finset.univ ∨ (∃ i∈A, s=row i) ∨ ∃ b : Index, s={b} := by decide

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.coe_row
declarations.snippet: theorem coe_row (i : Fin 2) : (row i : Set Index) = {b | b.1=i} := by ext; simp [row]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.geometric_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem geometric_iff {R K Γ : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ]
    {f : R[X]} {A : Finset (Fin 2)} {c : R} (T : Configuration f A c)
    (ι : R →+* K) (v : AddValuation K Γ) (units : ∀ u : Rˣ, v (ι (u:R))=0)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ v (ι c)) (hactive : A.Nonempty → 0 < v (ι c))
    (hmore : ∃ t, v (ι c)<t ∧ t<⊤) (s : Cluster) :
    (s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ z t, t<⊤ ∧ (s:Set Index)={i | t≤v (ι (T.point i)-z)}) ↔ s∈tree A := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.children
declarations.snippet:
def children (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (s : Cluster) : Finset Cluster :=
  (tree A).filter fun t => t ⊂ s ∧ ∀ u ∈ tree A, ¬(t ⊂ u ∧ u ⊂ s)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.principal
ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.principal_iff
declarations.snippet:
theorem principal_iff (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (s : Cluster) :
    principal A s ↔ (s=Finset.univ ∧ A≠Finset.univ) ∨ ∃ i ∈ A, s=row i := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.proper_odd
declarations.snippet: theorem proper_odd : ∀ (A : Finset (Fin 2)), ∀ s ∈ tree A, s ≠ Finset.univ → Odd s.card := by decide

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.joinRoot
declarations.snippet:
def joinRoot (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (s : Cluster) (r : Index) : Cluster :=
  ((tree A).filter fun t => s ⊆ t ∧ r∈t).inf id

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.LocalSupport.join_row
declarations.snippet:
theorem join_row : ∀ (A : Finset (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 2), i∈A → ∀ r : Index,

  point := T.point

    exact ⟨e*u, by rw [hu, h, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]⟩

    (D : FibreData p a b e ρ A m) :
    let F := D.finiteModel.field
    letI : Finite F := D.finiteModel.finite
    ∃ T : Configuration (twisted a b e D.finiteModel.rho) A ((p:WittVector p F)^m),
      (∀ i, inclusion p F (T.point i)=D.roots.point i) ∧
      (∀ w, (twisted a b e D.finiteModel.rho).IsRoot w ↔ ∃ i, T.point i=w) ∧
      ∀ s, principal A s → Even (nu
        ((addVal (WittVector p F) (twisted a b e D.finiteModel.rho).leadingCoeff).toNat:ℤ) A
        (fun i j => addVal (WittVector p F) (T.point i-T.point j)) s) := by

  ∀ (B : GroupScheme ℚ) (g : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ), 0 < g → (∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) →

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Assembly.GoodWitt
ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Assembly.SerreTateAt
declarations.snippet:
def SerreTateAt : Prop := ∀ (k : Subfield (Residues p)) [Finite k],
  letI := wittFractionAlgebra p k
  let K := FractionRing (WittVector p k)
  (∀ (A B : GroupScheme K), IsAbelianScheme A → IsAbelianScheme B →
    ∀ f : A ⟶ B, Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left → GoodWitt p k A → GoodWitt p k B) ∧
  (∀ B : GroupScheme ℚ_[p], IsAbelianScheme B →
    GoodWitt p k ((baseChange (algebraMap ℚ_[p] K)).obj B) → HasGoodReduction p B)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Assembly.UnramifiedQuotient
declarations.snippet:
def UnramifiedQuotient (B : GroupScheme ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : Subfield (Residues p)) (_ : Finite k),
    letI := wittFractionAlgebra p k
    let K := FractionRing (WittVector p k)
    let Bp := (baseChange (algebraMap ℚ ℚ_[p])).obj B
    ∃ (A : GroupScheme K) (f : A ⟶ (baseChange (algebraMap ℚ_[p] K)).obj Bp),
      IsAbelianScheme A ∧ GoodWitt p k A ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.hom.left

    (abelian : IsAbelianScheme B) (dimension : SmoothOfRelativeDimension g B.X.hom)
    (action : HasGL2Type B g) (st : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 3 < p → SerreTateAt p)
    (maps : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 3 < p → p ∉ fixed → ClusterCondition p s → UnramifiedQuotient p B) :
    RationalFactor g fixed s where
  B := B
  abelian := abelian
  dimension := dimension
  fieldAction := action
  reduction := fun p _ gt away data =>
    reduction_of_unramified_quotient p (st p gt) abelian (maps p gt away data)

    (c : G → G → ℚˣ)
    (vcomp : ∀ g h x, v g (v h x) = (c g h : ℚ) • v (g*h) x)
    (wcomp : ∀ g h x, w g (w h x) = (c g h : ℚ) • w (g*h) x)
    (q : W →ₗ[ℚ] V) (surj : Function.Surjective q)
    (equiv : ∀ g x, q (w g x) = v g (q x)) :
    ∃ (j : V →ₗ[ℚ] W), (∀ x, q (j x) = x) ∧ (∀ g x, w g (j x) = j (v g x)) ∧
      (j.comp q).comp (j.comp q) = j.comp q ∧ ∀ g x, w g (j (q x)) = j (q (w g x)) := by

declarations.snippet: private def bitSum (S : Finset (Fin 16)) (i : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ c ∈ S, (c.val / 2^i) % 2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.integralSum
ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.gopel
declarations.snippet: def gopel : Finset (Finset (Fin 16)) := (evens.powersetCard 4).filter (integralSum · = true)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.evens_card
declarations.snippet: theorem evens_card : evens.card = 10 := by decide

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.gopel_card
declarations.snippet: theorem gopel_card : gopel.card = 15 := by decide

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.complement_card
declarations.snippet: theorem complement_card {S : Finset (Fin 16)} (hS : S ∈ gopel) : (evens \ S).card = 6 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.h10
declarations.snippet: def h10 (x : Fin 16 → K) : K := ∏ i ∈ evens, x i ^ 2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.h12
declarations.snippet: def h12 (x : Fin 16 → K) : K := ∑ S ∈ gopel, ∏ i ∈ evens \ S, x i ^ 4

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.thetaRatio
declarations.snippet: def thetaRatio (x : Fin 16 → K) : K := h12 x ^ 5 / ((-120)^5 * h10 x ^ 6)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.scale_cancels
declarations.snippet:
theorem scale_cancels [CharZero K] {U V h₁₀ h₁₂ c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hd : h₁₀ ≠ 0) (h2 : (-120)*secondInvariant (coefficients U V) = c*h₁₂/h₁₀)
    (h10eq : discriminantValue U V = c^5*h₁₀) :
    ratio U V = h₁₂^5/((-120)^5*h₁₀^6) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.subset_mean
ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.pair
declarations.snippet:
private def pair (x : Fin 16 → K) : Fin 2 → K :=
  ![h12 x ^ 5, (-120)^5 * h10 x ^ 6]

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.arch_bound
declarations.snippet:
theorem arch_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (x : Fin 16 → K) :
    (⨆ i, v (pair x i)) ≤ (Real.sqrt (∑ i, v (x i)^2))^120 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.finite_bound
declarations.snippet:
private theorem finite_bound (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v) (x : Fin 16 → K) :
    (⨆ i, v (pair x i)) ≤ (⨆ i, v (x i)) ^ 120 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.height_of_theta
declarations.snippet:
theorem height_of_theta [NumberField K] (x : Fin 16 → K) (R : ℚ)
    (h : (R : K) = thetaRatio x) (hd : h10 x ≠ 0) :
    ratHeight R ≤ 120 * euclideanHeight x := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.product_scale
ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.scale_h10_h12
declarations.snippet:
theorem scale_h10_h12 {E : Type*} [Field E] (u : E) (x : Fin 16 → E) :
    h10 (fun i => u*x i) = u^20*h10 x ∧ h12 (fun i => u*x i) = u^24*h12 x := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.map_ratio
declarations.snippet:
private theorem map_ratio {E : Type*} [Field E] (emb : K →+* E) (x : Fin 16 → K) :
    emb (thetaRatio x) = thetaRatio (emb ∘ x) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.chart_invariants
declarations.snippet:
theorem chart_invariants [CharZero K] (ρ : K) (hρ : ρ^2 = -3)
    (s : ℚ) (hb : primitiveBranch s ≠ 0) :
    let U := ((s:K)+ρ)^6
    let V := ((s:K)-ρ)^6
    discriminantValue U V ≠ 0 ∧ ratio U V = (igusaRatio (chart s) : ℚ) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.PeriodForms
declarations.snippet:
structure PeriodForms (s : ℚ) (x : Fin 16 → K) (emb : K →+* ℂ) where
  ρ : ℂ
  root : ρ^2 = -3
  analytic : Fin 16 → ℂ
  projective : ℂˣ
  coordinates : ∀ i, emb (x i) = (projective:ℂ)*analytic i
  weighted : ℂˣ
  degreeTwo : -120*secondInvariant (coefficients (((s:ℂ)+ρ)^6) (((s:ℂ)-ρ)^6)) =
    (weighted:ℂ)*h12 analytic/h10 analytic
  degreeTen : discriminantValue (((s:ℂ)+ρ)^6) (((s:ℂ)-ρ)^6) = (weighted:ℂ)^5*h10 analytic

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.picard_invariant_height
declarations.snippet:
theorem picard_invariant_height [NumberField K] {s : ℚ} (hb : primitiveBranch s ≠ 0)
    {x : Fin 16 → K} {emb : K →+* ℂ} (data : PeriodForms s x emb) :
    ratHeight (igusaRatio (chart s)) ≤ 120*euclideanHeight x := by

declarations.snippet:
structure SiegelMatrix where
  z11 : ℂ
  z12 : ℂ
  z22 : ℂ
  positive : 0 < z11.im
  determinant : 0 < z11.im*z22.im - z12.im^2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.half
declarations.snippet: private def half (m : Fin 16) (i : ℕ) : ℂ := ((m.val / 2^i % 2 : ℕ):ℂ)/2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.nulls
declarations.snippet:
def nulls (Z : SiegelMatrix) (m : Fin 16) : ℂ := ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
  let p := (n.1:ℂ) + half m 2
  let q := (n.2:ℂ) + half m 3
  Complex.exp (2*Real.pi*Complex.I*((p^2*Z.z11 + 2*p*q*Z.z12 + q^2*Z.z22)/2 +
    p*half m 0 + q*half m 1))

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.actual_coeff
declarations.snippet:
private theorem actual_coeff [CharZero K] (U V : K) (i : Fin 7) :
    (PicardLocal.sextic U V).coeff i.val = coefficients U V i := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.of_streng
declarations.snippet:
def of_streng {s : ℚ} {x : Fin 16 → K} {emb : K →+* ℂ}
    (ρ : ℂ) (hρ : ρ^2 = -3) (Z : SiegelMatrix) (projective weighted : ℂˣ)
    (coords : ∀ i, emb (x i) = (projective:ℂ)*nulls Z i)
    (a : ℂ) (roots : Fin 6 → ℂ)
    (split : PicardLocal.sextic (((s:ℂ)+ρ)^6) (((s:ℂ)-ρ)^6) =
      C a * ∏ j, (X - C (roots j)))
    (two : rootI2 a roots = (weighted:ℂ)*h12 (nulls Z)/h10 (nulls Z))
    (ten : (PicardLocal.sextic (((s:ℂ)+ρ)^6) (((s:ℂ)-ρ)^6)).discr =
      (weighted:ℂ)^5 * h10 (nulls Z)) : PeriodForms s x emb := by
  refine ⟨ρ,hρ,nulls Z,projective,coords,weighted,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [matchings_eq_transvectant,←split] at two
    simpa only [actual_coeff] using two
  · have hs : ((s:ℂ)^2+3) ≠ 0 := by
      have hq : s^2+3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      exact_mod_cast hq
    have hp := sixth_product (s:ℂ) ρ hρ
    have hv := right_ne_zero_of_mul (hp.trans_ne (pow_ne_zero 6 hs))
    rwa [discr_sextic _ _ hv] at ten

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.PazukiAt
declarations.snippet:
def PazukiAt (θ H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  |θ - (H + Real.log Real.pi)/2| ≤ 96*Real.log 16 * Real.log (max θ 1 + 2)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.theta_of_isogeny
declarations.snippet:
theorem theta_of_isogeny {θ H B : ℝ} {r D : ℕ} (hr : 0<r) (hD : 0<D)
    (pazuki : PazukiAt θ H) (isogeny : |(r:ℝ)*H-B| ≤ Real.log D/2) :
    θ ≤ (7/10)*max 1 B + (7/20)*Real.log D + 2410 := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.invariant_of_isogeny
declarations.snippet:
theorem invariant_of_isogeny [NumberField K] {s : ℚ} (hb : primitiveBranch s ≠ 0)
    {x : Fin 16 → K} {emb : K →+* ℂ} (period : PeriodForms s x emb)
    {H B : ℝ} {r D : ℕ} (hr : 0<r) (hD : 0<D)
    (pazuki : PazukiAt (euclideanHeight x) H) (isogeny : |(r:ℝ)*H-B| ≤ Real.log D/2) :
    ratHeight (igusaRatio (chart s)) ≤ 84 * max 1 B + (42 * Real.log D + 289200) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.FibreAt
declarations.snippet:
def FibreAt (s : ℚ) (B : ℝ) (D : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : NumberField L) (emb : L →+* ℂ) (x : Fin 16 → L)
    (H : ℝ) (r : ℕ), 0<r ∧ Nonempty (PeriodForms s x emb) ∧
      PazukiAt (euclideanHeight x) H ∧ |(r:ℝ)*H-B| ≤ Real.log D/2

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.comparison_of_fibre
declarations.snippet:
theorem comparison_of_fibre {s : ℚ} {B : ℝ} {D : ℕ} (hb : primitiveBranch s ≠ 0)
    (hD : 0<D) (fibre : FibreAt s B D) :
    ratHeight (igusaRatio (chart s)) ≤ 84 * max 1 B + (42 * Real.log D + 289200) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.Picard.Theta.integer_polynomial_of_periods
declarations.snippet:
theorem integer_polynomial_of_periods (g D : ℕ) (hD : 0<D)
    (fixed : Finset ℕ) (except : Finset ℚ) (bad : ℚ → Finset ℕ) (B : ℚ → ℝ)
    (fixedPrimes : ∀ p ∈ fixed, p.Prime)
    (support : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      ∀ p ∈ bad s, p.Prime ∧ (p ∈ fixed ∨ Odd (padicValRat p (primitiveBranch s))))
    (effective : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 →
      B s ≤ vonKanelBound g (bad s))
    (periods : ∀ s : ℚ, s ∉ except → primitiveBranch s ≠ 0 → FibreAt s (B s) D)
    (tian : ZInQBlueprint.OriginalRank.PublishedGenusRows.PublishedTian47)
    (grossZagier : ZOverQ.Bounded.SimpleZeroRank) : ZOverQ.Qualitative.IntegerPolynomial := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.restriction
declarations.snippet:
abbrev restriction (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω) : Gal(Ω/k) →* Gal(L/k) :=
  AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.finiteRestriction
declarations.snippet:
def finiteRestriction {L M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω} (hLM : L ≤ M) :
    Gal(M/k) →* Gal(L/k) :=
  letI : Algebra L M := (IntermediateField.inclusion hLM).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k L M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.finiteRestriction_restriction
declarations.snippet:
@[simp] theorem finiteRestriction_restriction {L M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω}
    (h : L ≤ M) (σ : Gal(Ω/k)) : finiteRestriction h (restriction M σ) = restriction L σ := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.common_finite_galois_field
declarations.snippet:
theorem common_finite_galois_field (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω)
    {I A : Type*} [Finite I] (b : I → LocallyConstant Gal(Ω/k) A) :
    ∃ M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω, L ≤ M ∧
      ∃ B : I → Gal(M/k) → A, ∀ i σ, B i (restriction M σ) = b i σ := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coboundary
declarations.snippet:
def coboundary {G A : Type*} [Mul G] [AddCommGroup A] (b : G → A) (g h : G) : A :=
  b h - b (g*h) + b g

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.trivialRepresentation
declarations.snippet: abbrev trivialRepresentation (G A : Type) [Group G] [AddCommGroup A] := Rep.trivial ℤ G A

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.uniform_finite_galois_splitting
declarations.snippet:
theorem uniform_finite_galois_splitting (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω)
    (A : Type) [AddCommGroup A] [Finite (H2 (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/k) A))]
    (hTate : ∀ c : cocycles₂ (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/k) A),
      ∃ b : LocallyConstant Gal(Ω/k) A, ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/k),
        c (restriction L σ, restriction L τ) = coboundary b σ τ) :
    ∃ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField k Ω) (hLM : L ≤ M),
      ∀ c : cocycles₂ (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/k) A), ∃ b : Gal(M/k) → A,
        ∀ g h, c (finiteRestriction hLM g, finiteRestriction hLM h) = coboundary b g h := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.finite_second_cohomology
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_second_cohomology (G A : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup A]
    (hdiv : Function.Surjective (fun a : A => Fintype.card G • a))
    [Finite {a : A // Fintype.card G • a = 0}] :
    Finite (H2 (trivialRepresentation G A)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.finite_second_cohomology_units
declarations.snippet:
theorem finite_second_cohomology_units (G F : Type) [Group G] [Finite G] [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F] :
    Finite (H2 (trivialRepresentation G (Additive Fˣ))) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.Qbar
declarations.snippet: abbrev Qbar := AlgebraicClosure ℚ

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficients
declarations.snippet: abbrev coefficients := Additive Qbarˣ

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.rationalUnit
declarations.snippet: abbrev rationalUnit : ℚˣ →* Qbarˣ := Units.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar).toMonoidHom

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.rational_uniform_splitting
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_uniform_splitting (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ Qbar)
    (hTate : ∀ c : cocycles₂ (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/ℚ) coefficients),
      ∃ b : LocallyConstant Gal(Qbar/ℚ) coefficients, ∀ σ τ : Gal(Qbar/ℚ),
        c (restriction L σ, restriction L τ) = coboundary b σ τ) :
    ∃ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ Qbar) (hLM : L ≤ M),
      ∀ c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ,
        (∀ g h j, c (g*h,j) * c (g,h) = c (h,j) * c (g,h*j)) →
        ∃ b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ, ∀ g h,
          rationalUnit (c (finiteRestriction hLM g, finiteRestriction hLM h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientField
declarations.snippet:
def coefficientField {G : Type} (b : G → Qbarˣ) : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar :=
  IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range fun g => (b g : Qbar))

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientField_eq_span
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientField_eq_span {G : Type} [Group G] (b : G → Qbarˣ) (c : G × G → ℚˣ)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) :
    (coefficientField b).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule =
      Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range fun g => (b g : Qbar)) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientField_degree_le
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientField_degree_le {G : Type} [Group G] [Finite G] (b : G → Qbarˣ)
    (c : G × G → ℚˣ) (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (coefficientField b) ∧ Module.finrank ℚ (coefficientField b) ≤ Nat.card G := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.rational_uniform_splitting_degree
declarations.snippet:
theorem rational_uniform_splitting_degree (L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ Qbar)
    (hTate : ∀ c : cocycles₂ (trivialRepresentation Gal(L/ℚ) coefficients),
      ∃ b : LocallyConstant Gal(Qbar/ℚ) coefficients, ∀ σ τ : Gal(Qbar/ℚ),
        c (restriction L σ, restriction L τ) = coboundary b σ τ) :
    ∃ (M : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ Qbar) (hLM : L ≤ M),
      ∀ c : Gal(L/ℚ) × Gal(L/ℚ) → ℚˣ,
        (∀ g h j, c (g*h,j) * c (g,h) = c (h,j) * c (g,h*j)) →
        ∃ b : Gal(M/ℚ) → Qbarˣ, (∀ g h,
          rationalUnit (c (finiteRestriction hLM g, finiteRestriction hLM h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) ∧
          FiniteDimensional ℚ (coefficientField b) ∧
          Module.finrank ℚ (coefficientField b) ≤ Module.finrank ℚ M := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientValue
declarations.snippet:
def coefficientValue {G : Type} (b : G → Qbarˣ) (g : G) : coefficientField b :=
  ⟨b g, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ ⟨g,rfl⟩⟩

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientUnit
declarations.snippet:
def coefficientUnit {G : Type} (b : G → Qbarˣ) (g : G) : (coefficientField b)ˣ :=
  Units.mk0 (coefficientValue b g) (fun h => (b g).ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h))

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientEvaluation
declarations.snippet:
def coefficientEvaluation {G : Type} [Fintype G] (b : G → Qbarˣ) :
    (G → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] coefficientField b := Fintype.linearCombination ℚ (coefficientValue b)

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientValue_mul
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientValue_mul {G : Type} [Group G] (b : G → Qbarˣ) (c : G × G → ℚˣ)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) (g h : G) :
    coefficientValue b g * coefficientValue b h = (↑(c (g,h)) : ℚ) • coefficientValue b (g*h) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientEvaluation_surjective
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientEvaluation_surjective {G : Type} [Group G] [Fintype G] (b : G → Qbarˣ)
    (c : G × G → ℚˣ) (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) :
    Function.Surjective (coefficientEvaluation b) := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.twistedLeftShift
declarations.snippet:
def twistedLeftShift {G : Type} [Group G] (c : G × G → ℚˣ) (g : G) :
    (G → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (G → ℚ) where
  toFun v x := (c (g,g⁻¹*x) : ℚ) * v (g⁻¹*x)
  map_add' _ _ := funext fun _ => mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' r _ := funext fun _ => mul_left_comm _ r _

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.coefficientEvaluation_twistedLeftShift
declarations.snippet:
theorem coefficientEvaluation_twistedLeftShift {G : Type} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (b : G → Qbarˣ) (c : G × G → ℚˣ)
    (hb : ∀ g h, rationalUnit (c (g,h)) = b g * b h / b (g*h)) (g : G) (v : G → ℚ) :
    coefficientEvaluation b (twistedLeftShift c g v) = coefficientValue b g * coefficientEvaluation b v := by

declarations.name: ZOverQ.Qualitative.UniformDescent.twistedLeftShiftEquiv
declarations.snippet:
def twistedLeftShiftEquiv {G : Type} [Group G] (c : G × G → ℚˣ) (g : G) :
    (G → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] (G → ℚ) :=
  { twistedLeftShift c g with
    invFun := fun f x => (↑((c (g,x))⁻¹) : ℚ) * f (g*x)
    left_inv := fun f => funext fun x => by
      change (↑((c (g,x))⁻¹) : ℚ) * ((c (g,g⁻¹*(g*x)) : ℚ) * f (g⁻¹*(g*x))) = f x
      rw [inv_mul_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]
    right_inv := fun f => funext fun x => by
      change (c (g,g⁻¹*x) : ℚ) * ((↑((c (g,g⁻¹*x))⁻¹) : ℚ) * f (g*(g⁻¹*x))) = f x
      rw [mul_inv_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul] }
